translations.translation: allAhacyA nAvAne AraMbha karato, jo moThA kRpAvAna ANi atizaya dayA karaNArA Ahe.
sarva stuti - prazaMsA allAhakaritA Ahe, jo samasta vizvAcA pAlanahAra Ahe.
moThA kRpAvAna, atizaya dayA karaNArA Ahe.
mobadalyAcyA divasA (kayAmata) cA svAmI Ahe.
AmhI tujhIca upAsanA karato ANi tujhyAkaDeca madatIcI yAcanA karato.
AmhAlA saraLa (satya) mArga dAkhava.
azA lokAMcA mArga, jyAMcyAvara tU kRpA kelI, tyA lokAMcA navhe, jyAMcyAvara tujhA prakopa jhAlA ANi nA mArgabhraSTa jhAlelyAMcA.
Alipha, lAma, mIma.
yA graMthA (ce allAhacA graMtha asaNyA) bAbata kasalIhI zaMkA nAhI, allAhacyA AjJAbhaMgAce bhaya rAkhaNAr2yAMnA mArgadarzana karaNArA Ahe.
je loka na pAhilelyA (paralokA) vara ImAna rAkhatAta ANi namAjalA kAyama karatAta Ami AmhI pradAna kelelyA (dhana saMpattI) madhUna kharca karatAta.
ANi je loka ImAna rAkhatAta tyAvara, je tumacyAkaDe utaravile gele ANi je tumacyApUrvI utaravile gele. ANi te AkhiratavarahI aTaLa vizvAsa rAkhatAta.
heca loka ApalyA pAlanakartyAcyA tarphe khar2yA mArgAvara Aheta, ANi heca loka saphalatA (ANi muktI) prApta karaNAre Aheta.
niHsaMzaya, inkAra karaNAr2yAMnA tumhI bhaya dAkhavA kiMvA dAkhavU nakA sArakhe Ahe, he loka ImAna rAkhaNAra nAhIta.
sarvazreSTha allAhane tyAMcyA hRdayAMvara ANi kAnAMvara mohara lAvalI Ahe. ANi tyAMcyA DoLyAMvara paDadA paDalA Ahe. ANi tyAMcyAkaritA moThA bhayaMkara az2Aba (zikSA-yAtanA) Ahe.
ANi lokAMpaikI kAhI mhaNatAta, AmhI allAhavara ANi aMtima divasAvara ImAna rAkhale Ahe, paraMtu khare pAhatA te ImAnadhAraka nAhIta.
te allAhalA ANi ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMnA dhokA deta Aheta, paraMtu khare pAhatA te svataHlAca dhokA deta Aheta ANi tyAMnA samaja nAhI.
tyAMcyA manAta roga Ahe. allAhane tyAMcA roga ANakhI vADhavilA, ANi tyAMcyA khoTyA bolaNyApAyI tyAMcyAsAThI duHkhadAyaka az2Aba (zikSA-yAtanA) Ahe.
ANi jevhA tyAMnA sAMgitale jAte kI dharatIvara bighADa nirmANa karU nakA, tevhA te uttara detAta kI AmhI tara kevaLa sudhAraka Ahota.
khabaradAra! vAstavika heca loka bighADa nirmANa karaNAra Aheta, paraMtu samaja (jJAna) bALagata nAhI.

ANi jevhA tyAMnA sAMgitale jAte kI itara lokAM (arthAta sahAbA) pramANe tumhIhI ImAna rAkhA, tevhA te uttara detAta, kAya AmhI azA prakAre ImAna rAkhAve, jase mUrkha lokAMnI rAkhale Ahe? khabaradAra! vAstavika heca loka mUrkha Ahe, paraMtu jANata nAhIta.

ANi jevhA ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMzI bheTatAta, tevhA mhaNatAta kI AmhIdekhIla ImAnadhAraka Ahota. ANi jevhA ekAMtAta ApalyA thorA-moThyAM (saitAnI pravRttIcyA lokAM) javaLa jAtAta, tevhA mhaNatAta, AmhI tara tumacyAsobata Ahota. tyAMcyAzI tara AmhI kevaLa thaTTA-maskarI karato.
sarvazreSTha allAhadekhIla tyAMcyAzI thaTTA-maskarI karato ANi tyAMcyA vidroha ANi bahakaNyAta ANakhI jAsta vADha karato.
he ase loka Aheta, jyAMnI mArgabhraSTatelA, mArgadarzanAcyA mobadalyAta kharedI kele Ahe. paraMtu nA tyAMcA vyApAra phAyadezIra TharalA, nA te mArgadarzana prApta karU zakale.

yA lokAMce udAharaNa tyA mANasA sArakhe Ahe, jyAne Aga peTavalI, paraMtu jevhA AgIne tyAcyA Asa-pAsa khUpa prakAza pasaravilA, tevhA allAhane tyAMcA prakAza hirAvUna ghetalA ANi tyAMnA aMdhArAta soDUna dile, jyAmuLe tyAMnA kAhIca disata nAhI.
(he loka) muke, bahire ANi AMdhaLe Aheta. AtA te paratUna yeNAra nAhIta.

kiMvA AkAzAtUna paDaNAr2yA pAvasApramANe, jyAta aMdhAra, meghagarjanA ANi vIja asAvI. vijecyA kaDADaNyAmuLe te ApalyA kAnAta boTe khupasUna ghetAta ANi sarvazreSTha allAha kAphirAMnA (inkAra karaNAr2yAMnA) gheraNArA Ahe.

vATate kI vIja tyAMce DoLe hisakUna gheIla, jevhA tI tyAMcyAkaritA ujeDa karate tevhA te cAlatAta ANi jevhA aMdhAra karate, tevhA (jAgacyA jAgI) ubhe rAhatAta ANi allAhane icchile tara tyAMce kAna ANi DoLe hirAvUna gheIla. niHsaMzaya allAha pratyeka goSTIce sAmarthya rAkhaNArA Ahe.
he lokAMno! ApalyA tyA pAlanakartyAcI upAsanA karA, jyAne tumhAlA ANi tumacyA pUrvIcyA lokAMnA nirmANa kele, yAsAThI kI tumhI parahejagAra (durAcArApAsUna dUra rAhaNAre) banAve.

jyAne tumacyAsAThI dharatIlA bichAyata ANi AkAzAlA chata banavile ANi AkAzAtUna pAUsa pADalA. maga tyAcyAdvAre phaLe nirmANa karUna tumhAlA rojI (anna-sAmagrI) pradAna kelI. tevhA he dhyAnI ghetA, tumhI koNAlAhI allAhacA sahabhAgI banavU nakA.

ANi jara tumhAlA tyAbAbata zaMkA asela, je AmhI ApalyA dAsAvara avatarIta kele Ahe. tevhA tumhI sacce asAla tara yAsArakhI ekhAdI sUraha (adhyAya) banavUna ANA tumhAlA sUTa dilI jAte kI allAhacyA zivAya ApalyA sahabhAgIMnAhI (upAsyAMnAhI) bolAvUna ghyA.

maga jara tumhI ase kele nAhI ANi tumhI karUhI zakata nAhI. tevhA (tyAlA satya jANUna) tyA AgIce bhaya rAkhA, jice iMdhana mAnava ANi dagaDa Ahe. jI kAphirAM (inkAra karaNAr2yAM) sAThI tayAra kelI gelI Ahe.

ANi ImAna rAkhaNAr2yA ANi neka kAma karaNAr2yAMnA tyA svargAcA zubha samAcAra dyA, jyAMcyA khAlI pravAha vAhata Aheta. jevhA tyAMnA tyAMcyAtUna phaLe khANyAsa dile jAtIla, tevhA mhaNatIla kI yAcyApUrvI AmhAlA khANyAsAThI heca dile gele. tI miLatIjuLatI phaLe asatIla ANi tyAMcyAsAThI tyAta pavitra zuddha (zIlavAna) patnyA asatIla ANi te tyAta nehamI nehamI rAhatIla.

vAstavika ekhAde udAharaNa deNyAta allAhalA lajjA-saMkoca vATata nAhI, maga te udAharaNa maccharAce aso kiMvA tyAhUnahI tuccha vastUce. ImAna rAkhaNAre tyAlA ApalyA pAlanakartyAtarphe satya jANatAta, ANi kAphira (inkAra karaNAre) mhaNatAta kI asale udAharaNa deNyAta allAhace prayojana kAya Ahe? yAcyAcadvAre anekAMnA mArgabhraSTa karato ANi bahuteka lokAMnA satya-mArgAvara ANato. ANi mArgabhraSTa tara kevaLa AjJAbhaMga karaNAr2yA (durAcArI lokAM) nAca karato.

je loka allAhazI kelelyA vacana- karArA (pratijJe) lA toDUna TAkatAta ANi allAhane jyA goSTIMnA joDaNyAcA Adeza dilA Ahe, tilA toDUna TAkatAta ANi dharatIvara utpAta (phasAda) pasaravitAta. heca loka moThe nukasAna bhogaNAre Aheta.

tumhI allAhalA kase nAhI mAnata, vAstavika tumhI nirjIva hote, tevhA tyAne tumhAlA jIvana pradAna kele maga tumhAlA mRtyU deIla maga punhA dusar2yAMdA jivaMta karIla, maga tyAcyAcakaDe tumhAlA jAyace Ahe.
tyAneca tumacyAsAThI, je kAhI dharatIvara Ahe, sarva nirmANa kele. maga AkAzAcA irAdA kelA ANi tyAne sAta yathAyogya AkAza banavile ANi to pratyeka goSTa jANaNArA Ahe.

ANi jevhA tumacyA pAlanakartyAne phariztyAMnA pharmAvile kI mI dharatIvara eka khalIphA (asA samUha jo ekamekAMnaMtara yeIla) banavIta Ahe. tevhA (pharizte) mhaNAle, kAya tU dharatIvara azA lokAMnA nirmANa karazIla, je ticyAvara phasAda ANi raktapAta karatIla ANi AmhI tujhyA stutI-prazaMsesaha tujhe guNagAna ANi tujhI pavitratA varNana karato. tyAne pharmAvile, je mI jANato tumhI nAhI jANata.
ANi tyA (allAha) ne AdamalA sarva nAve zikavUna tyA cIja vastUMnA phariztyAMsamora prastuta kele ANi pharmAvile, tumhI sacce asAla tara yA cIja vastuMcI nAve sAMgA.

pharizte mhaNAle, he allAha! tU tara pavitra (doSa- vyaMga nasalelA) Ahe. AmhAlA tara tevaDheca jJAna Ahe, jevaDhe tU AmhAlA zikavile Ahe paripUrNa jJAna ANi buddhI kuzalatA rAkhaNArA kevaLa tUca Ahe.

sarvazreSTha allAhane AdamalA pharmAvile, tumhI yAMcI nAve sAMgA. jevhA tyAMnI tI nAve sAMgitalI tevhA pharmAvile, kAya mI tumhAlA sAMgitale navhate kI mI AkAzAMcyA ANi dharatIcyA adRzya goSTI jANato ANi je tumhI karatA kiMvA lapavitA tehI jANato.
ANi jevhA AmhI phariztyAMnA pharmAvile kI AdamalA sajadA karA. tevhA iblIsazivAya sarvAMnI sajadA kelA. tyAne inkAra kelA ANi ghameMDa dAkhavilI ANi to kAphirAM (inkArI lokAM) paikIca hotA.
ANi AmhI pharmAvile he Adama! tumhI ANi tumacI patnI jannatamadhye rAhA ANi jithUna icchA hoIla tithUna vATela tevaDhe khA va pyA. paraMtu yA jhADAcyA javaLa jAU nakA, anyathA atyAcArI TharAla.

paraMtu saitAAnAne tyAMnA bahakavUna tithUna bAhera ghAlavileca ANi AmhI sAMgUna TAkale kI utarA yethUna (jA, cAlate vhA), tumhI ekamekAMce zatrU AhAta ANi eka TharAvika veLeparyaMta tumhAlA dharatIvara rAhAyace ANi lAbha ghyAyace Ahe.

Adamane ApalyA pAlanakartyAkaDUna kAhI vacane zikUna ghetalI (ANi allAhajavaLa kSamAyAcanA kelI). allAhane tyAMcI taubA (kSamAyAcanA) kabUla kelI. niHsaMzaya toca taubA kabUla karaNArA, dayA karaNArA Ahe.

AmhI pharmAvile, tumhI sarva yethUna utarA, maga jara tumacyAjavaLa mAjhyAkaDUna mArgadarzana Ale tara jo koNI mAjhyA ucita mArgAcA svIkAra karIla tyAMcyAvara kasalehI bhaya rAhaNAra nAhI, nA te duHkhI hotIla.
ANi je kupra (inkAra) ANi asatyAdvAre AmacyA AyatIMnA khoTe TharavatIla te jahannamamadhye rAhaNAre Aheta. nehamI tyAtaca rAhatIla.

he isrAIlacyA putrAMno! mAjhyA tyA kRpA- deNagIce smaraNa karA, jI mI tumacyAvara kelI, ANi mAjhyAzI kelelA vacana- karAra pUrNa karA, mI tumacyAzI kelelA vacana- karAra pUrNa karIna ANi phakta mAjheca bhaya rAkhA.

ANi tyA (zarIata) vara ImAna rAkhA, jilA mI tyAcI satyatA siddha karaNyAsAThI avatarIta kele, jo (taurAta) tumacyAjavaLa Ahe, ANi tumhI yAce sarvaprathama inkArI banU nakA ANi mAjhyA AyatIMnA thoDyAzA kiMmatIvara vikU nakA ANi phakta mAjheca bhaya rAkhA.
ANi satyA (haka) cI asatyA (bAtila) zI bhesaLa karU nakA ANi satya lapavU nakA. tumhI tara svataH he jANatA.
ANi namAja kAyama karA ANi jakAta dyA ANi rukuu karaNAr2yAM (jhukaNAr2yAM) saha rukuu karA (jhukA)
kAya, lokAMnA satkarma karaNyAcA Adeza detA, ANi svataHlA visarUna jAtA? vAstavika tumhI graMtha vAcatA tara kAya tumhAlA evaDhIhI akkala nAhI?
ANi dhIra-saMyama va namAjadvAre madata prApta karA ANi hI phAra moThI goSTa Ahe, paraMtu allAhace bhaya rAkhaNAr2yAMkaritA nAhI.
je he jANatAta kI ApalyA pAlanakartyAzI bheTAyace Ahe ANi tyAcyAkaDe paratUna jAyace Ahe.
he isrAIla (yAkUba) cyA mulAMno! mAjhyA tyA kRpA deNagIce smaraNa karA jo mI tumacyAvara upakAra kelA ANi mI tumhAlA sAr2yA jagAtIla lokAMvara zreSThatA pradAna kelI.

ANi tyA divasAce bhaya bALagA, jyA divazI koNIhI koNAcyA upayogI paDaNAra nAhI, nA tyAcI ekhAdI ziphArasa mAnya kelI jAIla, nA tyAcyAkaDUna ekhAdA mobadalA svIkAralA jAIla ANi nA tyAMnA madata dilI jAIla.

ANi jevhA AmhI tumhAlA phiraaunacyA lokAMpAsUna suTakA dilI, je tumhAlA khUpa vAITa zikSA- yAtanA deta rAhile. tumacyA putrAMcI hatyA karIta rAhile ANi tumacyA mulIMnA jivaMta soData rAhile. yAtUna suTakA karaNyAta tumacyA pAlanakartyAcA moThA upakAra hotA.
ANi jevhA AmhI tumacyAsAThI samudra phADalA ANi tyAtUna tumhAlA pAra kele ANi phiraaunacyA sAthIdArAMnA tumacyA DoLyAMdekhata buDavile.
ANi AmhI mUsAlA cALIsa rAtrIMce vacana dile, maga tumhI vAsarAlA upAsya (daivata) banavUna ghetale ANi atyAcArI banale.
paraMtu AmhI, ase asatAnAhI tumhAlA mApha kele, yAsAThI kI tumhI upakAra mAnAla.
ANi AmhI mUsAlA, tumacyA mArgadarzanAsAThI graMtha (taurAta) ANi Iza-camatkAra (mojijA) pradAna kelA.

ANi jevhA mUsA ApalyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMnA mhaNAle, he mAjhyA jamAtIcyA lokAMno! tumhI vAsarAlA (daivata) banavUna svataHvara moThA julUma kelA Ahe. AtA tumhI ApalyA nirmANa karaNAr2yAkaDe dhyAna dyA. svataHlA (gunhegArAlA) ApalyA hAtAMnI ThAra karA. allAhacyA dRSTIne yAtaca tumacyAsAThI bhalAI Ahe. tevhA allAhane tumacI taubA (kSamAyAcanA) kabUla kelI. niHsaMzaya toca taubA kabUla karaNArA ANi dayA karaNArA Ahe.

ANi (tumhI tyA goSTIcehI smaraNa karA) jevhA tumhI mUsAlA mhaNAle hote kI joparyaMta AmhI allAhalA (pratyakSa) samora pAhUna gheta nAhI toparyaMta kadhIhI ImAna rAkhaNAra nAhI (yA avajJecI zikSA mhaNUna) tumacyAvara, tumacyA DoLyAMdekhata vIja kosaLalI.
(paraMtu) maga AmhI tumhAlA mRtyunaMtara jIvana yAsAThI dile kI tumhI AbhAra mAnAveta.

ANi AmhI tumacyAvara DhagAMcI sAvalI kelI, ANi tumacyAvara manna ANi salavA utaravilA (ANi pharmAvile) AmhI pradAna kelelyA svaccha zuddha vastU khA; ANi tyAMnI AmacyAvara atyAcAra nAhI kelA ulaTa te svataHca ApalyAvara atyAcAra karIta hote.

ANi AmhI tumhAlA pharmAvile kI tyA vastIta jA ANi je kAhI, jyA ThikANAhUna icchA hoIla manasokta khA va pyA ANi daravAjAtUna Doke namavUna dAkhala vhA ANi toMDAne mhaNata jA, AmhI kSamA yAcanA karato. AmhI tumace aparAdha mApha karU ANi bhalAI karaNAr2yAMnA ANakhI jAsta pradAna karU.
maga tyA atyAcArI lokAMnI, hI goSTa, jI tyAMnA sAMgitalI gelI, badalUna TAkalI. (pariNAmI) AmhIhI tyA atyAcArI lokAMvara tyAMcyA AjJAbhaMgAmuLe AkAzAtUna az2Aba (zikSA yAtanA) avatarIta kelA.

ANi jevhA mUsAne ApalyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMkaritA pANI mAgitale tevhA AmhI pharmAvile kI ApalI kAThI dagaDAvara mArA, jyAtUna bArA srota (jhare) phuTUna vAhU lAgale. pratyeka samUhAne ApApalA srota jANUna ghetalA (ANi AmhI pharmAvile kI) allAhane pradAna kelelI annasAmagrI khA va pyA ANi dharatIvara utpAta (phasAda) pasaravita phirU nakA.

ANi jevhA tumhI mhaNAle, he mUsA! AmhAlA ekAca prakAracyA jevaNAne dhIra-saMyama rAkhalA jANAra nAhI, yAstava ApalyA pAlanakartyAjavaLa duA-prArthanA karA kI tyAne AmhAlA jaminItUna utpanna jhAlelI bhAjI, kAkaDI, gahU, masUra ANi kAMdA dyAvA. mUsA mhaNAle kI uttama vastUMaivajI tuccha vastU kA mAgatA? maga tara ekhAdyA zaharAta jA, tithe tumhAlA tumacyA pasaMtIcyA yA sarva cIja-vastU miLatIla. tyAMcyAvara apamAna ANi durdazA TAkalI gelI ANi te allAhacA az2Aba (prakopa) gheUna paratale. he azAsAThI kI te allAhacyA AyatIMnA mAnata navhate, ANi paigaMbarAMcI nAhaka hatyA karIta hote. tyAMcyA julUma atirekAcA hA pariNAma hoya.

niHsaMzaya, jo muslima aso, yahUdI (jyU) aso, nasArA (khrizcana) aso kiMvA sAbI aso, jo koNI sarvazreSTha allAha ANi kayAmatIcyA divasAvara ImAna rAkhIla ANi satkarme karIla tara tyAcA mobadalA tyAcyA pAlanakartyAjavaLa Ahe. tyAMnA nA kasalehI bhaya rAhIla, ANi nA kasale duHkha rAhIla.

ANi jevhA AmhI tumacyAkaDUna vacana ghetale ANi tumacyAvara tUra parvata ANUna ubhA kelA ANi pharmAvile, je AmhI tumhAlA pradAna kele Ahe, te majabUtIne dharUna ThevA ANi je kAhI tyAta Ahe te dhyAnAta rAkhA, yAsAThI kI tumhI durAcArApAsUna ApalA bacAva karU zakAve.
maga tyAnaMtarahI tumhI pATha phiravalI jara sarvazreSTha allAhacI kRpA ANi dayA tumacyAvara rAhilI nasatI, tara tumhI nukasAna ucalaNAre Tharale asate.
ANi avazya tumhAlA tyA lokAMviSayIhI mAhitI Ahe. tumacyApaikI jyAMnI zanivArabAbata maryAdece ullaMghana kele. maga AmhI (dekhIla) pharmAvile kI tumhI apamAnita vAnharee vhA.
yAlA AmhI puDhacyA-mAgacyA lokAMkaritA sAvadha rAhaNyAce kAraNa banavile, ANi bhaya rAkhaNAr2yAMkaritA bodha Ahe.

ANi mUsA jevhA ApalyA jamAtIcyA lokAMnA mhaNAle kI sarvazreSTha allAha tumhAlA eka gAya jibaha karaNyAcA (baLI deNyAcA) Adeza deto tevhA te mhaNAle, kAya, tumhI AmacyAzI thaTTA maskarI karatA? mUsA mhaNAle, mI azA mUrkhatepAsUna sarvazreSTha allAhace zaraNa gheto.

te mhaNAle, he mUsA! allAhajavaLa duA prArthanA karA kI AmhAlA tyAviSayI mAhitI dyAvI. mUsA mhaNAle, aikA, tI gAya nA tara mhAtArI asAvI ANi nA vAsarI, kiMbahunA madhyama vayAcI asAvI. AtA jo Adeza tumhAlA dilA gelA Ahe, to amalAta ANA.

te punhA mhaNAle kI, allAhazI duA-prArthanA karA kI tyAne AmhAlA he sAMgAve kI ticA raMga kasA asAvA? sAMgitale, allAha pharmAvito kI gAya, gaDada sonerI raMgAcI asAvI, ANi pAhaNAr2yAMce mana prasanna karaNArI asAvI.

te mhaNU lAgale kI ApalyA pAlanakartyAjavaLa duA karA kI tyAne AmhAlA spaSTapaNe sAMgAve kI tI kazI asAvI? yA prakAracyA bahuteka gAyI Aheta, tevhA umajata nAhI. allAhane icchile tara AmhAlA mArgadarzana prApta hoIla.

mUsA mhaNAle, allAhacA Adeza Ahe kI tI gAya zeta-jaminIvara nAMgara oDhaNArI ANi zetIlA pANI deNyAcyA kAmAcI nasAvI, tI zarIrAne pUrNa nirogI ANi DAgavirahita asAvI. loka mhaNAle, AtA tumhI spaSTapaNe sAMgitale. tarIhI te AdezAMce pAlana karaNAre navhate, paraMtu tyAMnI mAnale ANi gAyIcI kurabAnI (baLI) dilI.
ANi jevhA tumhI ekA jIvAcI hatyA kelI, maga ekamekAMvara Aropa ThevU lAgale ANi allAhalA tumhI lapavilelI goSTa ughaDa karAyacI hotI.
AmhI pharmAvile kI tyA gAIcA eka tukaDA mRta zarIrAvara mArA (to jivaMta hoIla) azA prakAre sarvazreSTha allAha melelyAMnA jivaMta karUna tumacyA buddhimAnatekaritA nizANyA dAkhavito.

maga tyAnaMtara tumacI mane pASANAsArakhI, kiMbahunA tyAhUna adhika kaThora jhAlIta. kAhI dagaDAMmadhUna tara jala-pravAha nighUna vAhU lAgatAta. ANi kAhI, allAhacyA bhaya-dahazatIne khAlI kosaLatAta ANi tumhI allAhalA ApalyA AcaraNApAsUna anabhijJa jANU nakA.

(he musalamAnAMno!) kAya, tumhI icchitA kI tyA (yahUdI) nI tumacyAvara vizvAsa karAvA vAstavika tyAcyAta kAhI asehI Aheta, je allAhacA graMtha aikatAta maga tyAlA samajUna ghetalyAnaMtara tyAta pherabadala karatAta ANi ase te jANUna karatAta.

ANi jevhA ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMzI bheTatAta, tevhA ApaNa ImAnadhAraka asalyAce jAhIra karatAta ANi ApasAta gAThI bheTI karatAta, tevhA mhaNatAta kI musalamAnAMpAveto tyA goSTI kA pohacavitA, jyA allAhane tumhAlA zikavilyA Aheta. kAya he nAhI jANata kI yA goSTI tara allAhacyA samora tumacyAvara tyAMcA purAvA TharatIla.
kAya yAMnA he nAhI mAhIta kI sarvazreSTha allAha tyAcyA lapalelyA va ughaDa azA sarvaca goSTI jANato.
ANi tyAMcyApaikI kAhI azikSita asehI Aheta, je AzA-apekSAMzivAya graMthAsa jANata nAhIta ANi kevaLa kAlpanika goSTI karatAta.

tyA lokAMsAThI vinAza Ahe, je svataH ApalyA hAtAMnI lihilelyA graMthAsa allAhacA graMtha mhaNatAta. ANi azA prakAre yA jagAcI kamAI karatAta. ApalyA hAtAMnI lihiNyAmuLe tyAMcA sarvanAza Ahe ANi ApalyA yA kamAImuLe tyAMcA vinAza Ahe.

ANi he loka mhaNatAta kI AmhI tara kAhI mojake divasa jahannamamadhye rAhU, (tyAMnA) sAMgA kI, kAya tumhI sarvazreSTha allAhakaDUna ekhAde vacana ghetale Ahe jara ghetale Ahe tara khAtrIne sarvazreSTha allAha ApalyA vacanAcA bhaMga karaNAra nAhI kiMvA tumhI allAhacyA saMbaMdhAne azA goSTI sAMgatA jyA tumhI jANata nAhI.
niHsaMzaya, jyAnedekhIla aparAdha kelA ANi tyAcyA aparAdhAne tyAlA gherale to jahannamI Ahe. to nehamIkaritA jahannamamadhye rAhIla.
ANi jyA lokAMnI ImAna rAkhale ANi satkarma kele, te jannatI Aheta. te nehamIkaritA jannatamadhye rAhatIla.

ANi jevhA AmhI isrAIlacyA putrAMkaDUna vacana ghetale kI tumhI allAhacyA zivAya dusar2yA koNAcIhI bhaktI-upAsanA karU nakA ANi AI-bApAzI cAMgale vartana rAkhA ANi tyAcapramANe javaLace nAtevAIka, anAtha ANi garIba lokAMzI sad‌vyavahAra karA ANi lokAMnA cAMgalyA- bhalyA goSTI sAMgA. namAja kAyama karA ANi jakAta (kartavya dAna) deta rAhA. paraMtu kAhI loka vagaLatA, tumhI sarva mukarale ANi toMDa phiravile.
ANi jevhA AmhI tumacyAkaDUna vacana ghetale kI ApasAta raktapAta karU nakA (hatyA karU nakA) ANi ApalyAca lokAMnA dezAbAhera ghAlavU nakA. tumhI mAnya kele ANi tumhI yAce sAkSIdArahI banale.

tarIhI tumhI svajanAMcI hatyA kelI ANi ApalyA ekA samUhAlA dezAbAhera ghAlavile ANi aparAdha va dveSa karaNyAcyA kAmAta tyAMcyAvirUddha dusar2yAcI bAjU dharalI. mAtra jevhA te kaidI banUna tumacyAjavaLa Ale tevhA tumhI tyAMcyA mobadalyAta dhana dile (jyAlA phidIyA mhaNatAta) paraMtu tyAMnA dezAbAhera ghAlaviNe je tumacyAvara harAma hote (tyAcI kAhIca kALajI ghetalI nAhI) kAya tumhI graMthAtalyA kAhI goSTIMnA mAnya karatA ANi kAhI goSTIMnA nAkAratA? tumacyApaikI jo koNI ase karIla, tyAcI zikSA yAkherIja kAya asAvI kI yA jagAta apamAna ANi kayAmatIcyA divazI bhayaMkara zikSA- yAtanAMcA mArA! ANi allAha tumacyA karmAMpAsUna gAphIla nAhI.
he ase loka Aheta jyAMnI aihika jIvanAlA AkhiratacyA mobadalyAta kharedI kele Ahe. tyAMcI nA zikSA kamI hoIla ANi nA tyAMcI kAhI madata kelI jAIla.

ANi AmhI mUsAlA graMtha pradAna kelA ANi tyAMcyAnaMtara satata rasUla (paigaMbara) hI pAThavile ANi AmhI mariyama-putra IsAlA spaSTa nizANyA pradAna kelyA ANi pavitra AtmA (hajarata jibrIla) dvAre tyAMnA samarthana dile gele. paraMtu jevhA jevhA tumacyAjavaLa rasUla (paigaMbara) tI goSTa gheUna Ale, jI tumacyA vicArAMcyA virUddha hotI, tumhI tatkALa ghameMDa dAkhavilI, maga kAhIMnA tumhI khoTe Tharavile ANi kAhIMnA jIve ThAra mArale.
ANi te mhaNAle, AmacI mane jhAkalelI Aheta (nAhI, nAhI) kiMbahunA tyAMcyA kupra (inkArA) muLe, allAhane tyAMnA dhikkArale Ahe. tevhA tyAMcyAta ImAna rAkhaNAre phAra thoDeca Aheta!

ANi jevhA tyAMcyAjavaLa tyAMcA graMtha (taurAta) cI puSTI karaNyAkaritA eka graMtha (pavitra kuraAna) yeUna pohacalA, vAstavika yAcyApUrvI he svataH yAcyAdvAre kAphirAMvara (inkAra karaNAr2yAMvara) vijaya icchita hote, tevhA yeUna pohocalyAnaMtara ANi oLakhUna ghetalyAnaMtara tyAMnI nakAra dilA. sarvazreSTha allAhatarphe dhikkAra aso inkAra karaNAr2yAMvara!

atizaya vAITa Ahe tI goSTa, jicyA mobadalyAta tyAMnI svataHlA vikUna TAkale. te tyAMce kupra (inkAra) karaNe hoya, allAhatarphe avatarIta graMthAlA kevaLa yA goSTIcA dveSa karUna kI allAhane ApalI kRpA deNagI, jyA dAsAvara icchile avatarIta kelI. yA kAraNAne te prakopAvara prakopAce bhAgIdAra Tharale. ANi tyA kAphirAM (inkAra karaNAr2yAM) karitA apamAnadAyaka az2Aba (zikSA-yAtanA) Ahe.

ANi jevhA tyAMnA sAMgitale gele kI tyAvara ImAna rAkhA je allAhane avatarIta kele Ahe, tevhA te mhaNAle kI je AmacyAvara (taurAta) utaravile gele, tyAvara Amace ImAna Ahe ANi te tyAlA soDUna dusar2yA graMthAcA (pavitra kuraAnAcA) inkAra karatAta. vAstavika to satya Ahe. tyAMcyAjavaLa asalelyA (dharmagraMthA) cI satyatA siddha karIta Ahe. (he paigaMbara!) tyAMnA sAMgA kI jara tumhI ApalyA graMthAvara ImAna rAkhatA tara yApUrvI allAhacyA paigaMbarAMcI hatyA kA kelI?
ANi tumacyAjavaLa mUsA yAca nizANyA gheUna Ale, paraMtu tarIhI tumhI vAsarAcI pUjA kelI. tumhI AhAtaca atyAcArI!

ANi jevhA AmhI tumacyAkaDUna vacana ghetale ANi tumacyAvara tUra parvata (adhAMtarI) ubhA kelA (ANi pharmAvile) kI AmhI je kAhI pradAna kele Ahe te majabutIne dharA ANi aikA. tevhA te mhaNAle, AmhI aikale ANi AjJAbhaMga kelA ANi tyAMcyA manAta vAsarAce prema (jaNU kAhI) pAjale (rujavale) gele. tyAMcyA kupra (inkArA) muLe. (tyAMnA) sAMgA kI tumace ImAna tumhAlA vAITa Adeza deta Ahe. jara tumhI ImAnadhAraka asAla.
(tumhI tyAMnA) sAMgA kI jara allAhajavaLa Akhiratace ghara tumacyAsAThIca Ahe, anya koNAsAThI nAhI tara yA, ApalI satyatA siddha karaNyAsAThI mRtyucI yAcanA karA.
paraMtu ApalyA karmAMcA vicAra karatA, te kadhIhI mRtyucI yAcanA karaNAra nAhIta ANi allAha atyAcArI lokAMnA cAMgalyA prakAre oLakhato.

kiMbahunA (he paigaMbara!) aihika jIvanAcI sarvAMta jAsta AsaktI rAkhaNAre tumhAlA teca ADhaLUna yetIla. jIvanAcA lobha rAkhaNyAta he mUrtIpUjakAMpekSAhI jAstaca Aheta. tyAMcyApaikI pratyekajaNa hajAra varSAMce AyuSya icchito. vAstavika he dIrghAyuSya dile jANehI tyAMnA az2Aba (zikSA-yAtanAM) pAsUna vAcavU zakata nAhI. allAha tyAMce karma cAMgalyA prakAre pAhata Ahe.

(he paigaMbara!) tumhI sAMgA kI jo jibrIlacA zatrU asela, jyAne tumacyA hRdayAvara allAhacA saMdeza utaravilA Ahe, jo saMdeza tyAcyA javaLacyA graMthAcI satyatA siddha karaNArA ANi ImAnadhArakAMnA mArgadarzana ANi zubha-samAcAra deNArA Ahe (tara allAhadekhIla tyAMcA zatrU Ahe).
jo manuSya allAhacA ANi tyAcyA phariztyAMcA ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAMcA va jibrIla ANi mikAIlacA zatrU asela tara azA adharmI lokAMcA zatrU svataH allAha Ahe.
ANi niHsaMzaya, AmhI tumacyAkaDe spaSTa nizANyA pAThavilyA Aheta. jyAMcA inkAra, durAcArI lokAMzivAya anya koNI karata nAhI.
he loka, jevhA jevhA ekhAdA vacana-karAra karatAta, tevhA tyAMcyAtalA eka na eka gaTa tyAcA bhaMga karato. kiMbahunA tyAMcyApaikI adhikAMza loka beImAna (ImAna nasalele) Aheta.

ANi jevhAdekhIla tyAMcyAjavaLa allAhacA ekhAdA rasUla (paigaMbara) tyAMcyA graMthAcI puSTI karaNyAsa AlA, tevhA tyA graMthadhArakAMcyA ekA gaTAne allAhacyA graMthAlA azA prakAre pAThImAge TAkale, jaNU jANata navhate.

ANi azA goSTIcyA mAge lAgale jilA saitAnI loka, hajarata sulemAnacyA sAmrAjyAta paDhata asata. sulemAnane tara kupra (inkAra) kelA navhatA. kiMbahunA he kupra-karma saitAnAMce hote. te lokAMnA jAdU-ToNA zikavita asata ANi bAbIlamadhye hAruta va mAruta yA dona phariztyAMvara jo utaravilA gelA hotA, te doghehI koNatyAhI mANasAlA tyA veLaparyaMta zikavita nasata, joparyaMta he sAMgata nasata kI AmhI tara eka kasoTI mAtra Ahota, tU kupra karU nakosa. maga loka tyAMcyAkaDUna azI vidyA zikata kI jyAdvAre patI-patnIcyA daramyAna phUTa pADAvI. vAstavika allAhacyA marjIvinA te koNAlA kasalehI nukasAna pohacavU zakata nAhI. he loka te kAhI zikatAta, je yAMnA na nukasAna pohacavIla ANi nA phAyadA pohacavU zakela ANi te khAtrIpUrvaka jANatAta kI he prApta karaNAr2yAcA Akhiratamadhye kAhIca hissA nAhI ANi tI atizaya vAITa goSTa Ahe, jicyA mobadalyAta te svataHlA vikata Aheta. yAMnI he jANale asate tara!
ANi jara yA lokAMnI ImAna rAkhale asate va allAhace bhaya bALagale asate tara allAhacyA tarphe yAMnA bhalAI (zubha-mAMgalya) lAbhalI asatI. yAMnI he jANale asate tara!

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! tumhI (paigaMbara sallallAhu alaihi vasallama yAMnA) AmacyAkaDe lakSa dyA kiMvA AmacA vicAra karA ase mhaNU nakA, kiMbahunA AmacyAkaDe pAhA ase mhaNata jA, ANi lakSapUrvaka aikata rAhA, ANi inkAra karaNAr2yA lokAMkaritA duHdAyaka az2Aba (zikSA-yAtanA) Ahe.

nA tara graMtha lAbhUnahI tyAcA inkAra karaNAre ANi nA mUrtIpUjaka ase icchitAta kI tumacyAvara tumacyA pAlanakartyAtarphe bhalAI utarAvI (tyAMcyA yA dveSa-matsarAne kAya jhAle?) allAha jyAlA icchila tyAlA ApalI dayA kRpA vizeSa rItIne pradAna karIla ANi allAha moThA kRpAzIla Ahe.
jyA AyatIlA AmhI radda karato kiMvA ticA visara pADato tara tyAhUna cAMgalI kiMvA ticyAsArakhI ANakhI ANato. kAya tumhI nAhI jANata kI allAha pratyeka goSTIce sAmarthya bALagato.
kAya tumhAlA nAhI mAhIta kI dharatI ANi AkAzAMcI rAjya-sattA kevaLa allAhakaritAca Ahe, ANi allAhacyA zivAya tumacA koNI saMrakSaka ANi sahAyyaka nAhI.

kAya tumhI ApalyA rasUla (paigaMbara) lA tase prazna vicArU icchitA, jase yApUrvI mUsAlA vicArale gele (aikA!) jo ImAnacA mArga soDUna kupra (inkAra) cA mArga dharato, to saraLa mArgApAsUna bhaTakato.

yA graMthadhArakAMpaikI adhikAMza loka satya prakaTa jhAlyAnaMtarahI kevaLa dveSa-matsarAmuLe tumhAlAhI ImAnApAsUna dUra karU icchitAta, tevhA tumhIhI mApha karA ANi soDUna dyA, yethaparyaMta kI allAhane ApalA phaisalA lAgU karAvA. niHsaMzaya allAha pratyeka kArya karaNyAce sAmarthya rAkhato.

tumhI namAja (nitya-nemAne) adA karIta rAhA, ANi jakAta (dharma dAna) deta rAhA ANi jI bhalAI tumhI ApalyAsAThI puDhe pAThavAla, tI sarvakAhI allAhajavaLa prApta karAla. niHsaMzaya, allAha tumace pratyeka karma pAhata Ahe.

ANi he mhaNatAta kI jannatamadhye yahUdI ANi khrizcanAMkherIja anya koNI jANAra nAhI. yA tyAMcyA kAlpinaka AzA- apekSA Aheta. tyAMnA sAMgA, tumhI (ApalyA kathanAta) sacce asAla tara ekhAdA purAvA tarI prastuta karA.

aikA! jyAne svataHlA allAhacyA havAlI kele, ANi neka-sadAcArI Ahe, tara tyAcyAcakaritA, tyAcyA pAlanakartyA (allAha) cyA ThikANI cAMgalA mobadalA Ahe ANi nA tyAMnA kasale bhaya rAhIla nA ekhAde duHkha.

yahUdI mhaNatAta, khrizcana ucita mArgAvara nAhIta ANi khrizcana mhaNatAta kI yahUdI ucita mArgAvara nAhIta. vAstavika he taurAtace vAcana karatAta azA prakAre yAMcyAsArakhI goSTa ajJAnI lokahI bolatAta. kayAmatIcyA divazI allAha yAMcyA yA matabhedAcA phaisalA karIla.

ANi tyAhUna moThA atyAcArI koNa Ahe? jo allAhacyA masjidImadhye allAhace smaraNa karaNyApAsUna rokhIla, ANi tyAMnA ujADaNyAcA prayatna karIla? azA lokAMnI allAhace bhaya rAkhata, tyAta dAkhala jhAle pAhije. tyAMcyAkaritA yA jagAtahI apamAna Ahe ANi Akhirata (maraNottara jIvana) madhyehI moThamoThyA zikSA-yAtanA Aheta.
ANi pUrva ANi pazcimecA svAmI allAhaca Ahe. tumhI jikaDe dekhIla toMDa karAla, tikaDe allAhace toMDa Ahe. allAha atizaya sAmarthyazAlI khUpa khUpa jANaNArA Ahe.

ANi he mhaNatAta kI allAhalA saMtAna Ahe (muLIca nAhI, kiMbahunA) to pavitra (vyaMga-doSa virahIta) Ahe. dharatI ANi AkAzAMcyA samasta nirmitIvara tyAcI zAsana-sattA Ahe ANi pratyeka tyAcA AjJAdhAraka Ahe.
to, AkAzAMnA va dharatIlA navyAne banavUna utpanna karaNArA Ahe, ANi to jyA kAmAcA nirNaya gheto, tevhA mhaNato, hoUna jA ANi te kAma hote.

ANi azA prakAre aDANI-azikSita lokadekhIla mhaNAle kI svataH allAha AmacyAzI saMbhASaNa kA nAhI karIta kiMvA AmacyAjavaLa ekhAdI nizANI kA nAhI yeta. azA prakArace kathana tyAMcyA pUrvIcyA lokAMnIhI kele hote, tyAMcI ANi yAMcI mane ekasamAna jhAlIta. AmhI tara vizvAsa (zraddhA) ThevaNAr2yAMkaritA nizANyAMce nivedana kele Ahe.
AmhI tumhAlA satyAsaha khUzakhabara deNArA ANi saceta karaNArA banavUna pAThavile Ahe ANi jahannamI lokAMviSayI tumhAlA vicAraNA kelI jANAra nAhI.

ANi yahUdI va khrizcana tumacyAzI kadhIhI khUza hoNAra nAhIta, joparyaMta tumhI tyAMcyA dharmAce anusaraNa na karAla. (tumhI) sAMgA kI allAhace mArgadarzanaca, mArgadarzana asate ANi jara tumhI, ApalyAjavaLa jJAna gheUna pohocalyAnaMtarahI tyAMcyA icchA abhilASAMce anusaraNa kele tara allAhacyA javaLa tumacA nA koNI samarthaka asela, nA koNI sahAyyaka.

jyAMnA AmhI graMtha pradAna kelA ANi te tyAlA azA prakAre vAcatAta, jasA tyAcyA vAcanAcA hakka Ahe. te yA graMthAvarahI ImAna rAkhatAta ANi je yAvara ImAna rAkhata nAhIta te svataH ApalA toTA karUna ghetAta.
he isrAIlacyA putrAMno! mI tumhAlA jyA kRpA- deNagyA pradAna kelyA Aheta, tyAMcI AThavaNa karA ANi he kI mI tumhAlA sAr2yA jagAta zreSThatA pradAna kelI hotI.

ANi tyA divasAce bhaya bALagA, jyA divazI koNIhI koNAlA phAyadA pohacavU zakaNAra nAhI, ANi nA koNAkaDUna kAhI mobadalA svIkAralA jAIla, nA tyAlA ekhAdyAcI ziphArasa lAbha deU zakela, nA tyAlA madata kelI jAIla.

ANi jevhA ibrAhImacI tyAMcyA pAlanakartyAne aneka goSTIMdvAre kasoTI ghetalI ANi tyAMnI sarva kasoTyAMmadhye saphala hoUna dAkhavile, tevhA (allAhane) pharmAvile kI mI tumhAlA lokAMcA imAma (pramukha) banavIna. vicArale, ANi mAjhyA saMtatIlA? uttara dile kI mAjhA vAyadA atyAcArI lokAMbAbata(sAThI) nAhI.

ANi AmhI baitullAha (kAbA) lA mAnavAkaritA puNya (savAba) ANi zAMtIce ThikANa banavile. tumhI mukAme ibrAhIma (ibrAhimace sthAna- kAbAgRhAta eka nirdhArIta ThikANAce nAva Ahe, je kAbAgRhAcyA daravAjAsamora, kiMcita DAvIkaDe Ahe.) lA musallA (namAja paDhaNyAce sthAna) TharavUna ghyA ANi AmhI ibrAhIma ANi ismAIla yAMcyAkaDUna vacana ghetale kI mAjhyA gharAlA tavApha (pradakSiNA) ANi etikApha (kAhI kALa masjidIta dhyAna lAvUna upAsanA) karaNAr2yAMsAThI ANi rukuu ANi sajadA karaNAr2yAMsAThI pavitra ANi sApha-svaccha rAkhA.

ANi jevhA ibrAhIma mhaNAle, he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! tU yA ThikANAlA zAMtIpUrNa zahara banava ANi ithalyA rahivAzAMnA je allAha ANi kayAmatacyA divasAvara ImAna rAkhaNAre asatIla, phaLAMcI rojI (anna-sAmagrI) pradAna kara. allAhane pharmAvile kI mI kAphIra (inkAra karaNAr2yA) lokAMnAhI thoDA lAbha pohacavIna, maga tyAMnA AgIcyA az2Aba (zikSA-yAtane) kaDe vivaza karUna TAkIna. pohacaNyAce moThe vAITa ThikANa Ahe he!
jevhA ibrAhIma ANi ismAIla kAbAgRhAcA pAyA (ANi bhiMtI) racata hote ANi mhaNata jAta hote kI he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! tU AmacyAkaDUna (hI sevA) svIkAra kara. niHsaMzaya tUca aikaNArA ANi jANaNArA Ahe.

he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! AmhAlA tujhA AjJAdhAraka banava ANi AmacyA saMtatImadhUna ekA samUhAlA tujhA AjJAdhAraka banava ANi AmhAlA tujhyA upAsanecyA rItI zikava ANi AmacI taubA (kSamA-yAcanA) kabUla kara. niHsaMzaya tU taubA kabUla karaNArA, dayA karaNArA Ahe.

he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! tyAMcyAta, tyAMcyAmadhUnaca eka rasUla (paigaMbara) pAThava. jyAMnI tyAMcyAjavaLa tujhyA AyatIMce paThaNa karAve ANi tyAMnA graMtha va hikamata zikavAve ANi tyAMnA svaccha- pavitra karAve. niHsaMzaya, tU varcasvazAlI ANi buddhIkauzalya bALagaNArA Ahe.
ANi ibrAhImacyA dIna (dharmA) pAsUna toca toMDa phiravila, jo svataH mUrkha asela. AmhI tara tyAlA yA jagAtahI pasaMta kele ANi AkhiratamadhyehI to neka-sadAcArI lokAMpaikI Ahe.
jevhA (dekhIla) tyAMcyA pAlanakartyAne pharmAvile kI AtmasamarpaNa karA tevhA te mhaNAle kI mI samasta vizvAcyA pAlanakartyAsAThI AtmasamarpaNa kele.

yAca goSTIcI tAkIda ibrAhIma ANi yAkUba yAMnI ApalyA saMtatIlA kelI kI he AmacyA putrAMno! allAhane tumacyAsAThI hA dIna (dharma) nirdhArita kelA Ahe. tevhA khabaradAra! tumhI muslima asaNyAcyA sthitItaca marA.

kAya tumhI (hajarata) yAkUbacyA mRtyusamayI hajara hote? jevhA tyAMnI ApalyA saMtatIlA mhaTale kI tumhI mAjhyA mRtyunaMtara koNAcI upAsanA karAla? tevhA sarvAMnI uttara dile kI tumacyA pAlanakartyAcI ANi tumace vADavaDIla ibrAhIma ANi ismAIla ANi isahAka yAMcyA upAsyA (daivatA) cI, jo ekameva Ahe ANi AmhI tyAceca tAbedAra banUna rAhU.
hA janasamUha tara hoUna gelA, tyAMnI je kele te tyAMcyAsAThI Ahe ANi tumhI je karAla te tumacyAsAThI Ahe. tyAMcyA karmAviSayI tumhAlA vicArale jANAra nAhI.

he mhaNatAta kI yahUdI (jyU) ANi khrizcana vhAla tara mArgadarzana lAbhela. tumhI sAMgA kI saraLa ANi ucita mArgAvara tara ibrAhImacyA mArgAce anusaraNa karaNAre Aheta ANi ibrAhIma kevaLa allAhace AjJAdhAraka hote. te mUrtIpUjaka navhate.

(he ImAnadhArakAMno!) tumhI sarva sAMgA, AmhI allAhavara ImAna rAkhale ANi tyAvarahI je AmacyAkaDe utaravile gele ANi je ibrAhIma, ismAIla, isahAka, yAkUba ANi tyAMcyA saMtatIvara utaravile gele ANi je kAhI allAhacyA tarphe mUsA, IsA ANi anya paigaMbarAMnA dile gele. AmhI tyAMcyApaikI koNAcyAhI daramyAna pharaka karIta nAhI. AmhI allAhace tAbedAra Ahota.

jara te tumacyAsArakhe ImAna rAkhatIla tara mArgadarzana prApta karatIla ANi jara toMDa phiravatIla tara virodhAta Aheta. allAha tyA sarvAMcyA virodhAta bhaviSyAta tumacI madata karIla. allAha cAMgalyA prakAre aikaNArA ANi jANaNArA Ahe.
allAhacA raMga dhAraNa karA, ANi allAhapekSA uttama raMga ANi koNAcA asela? AmhI tara tyAcIca upAsanA karaNAre Ahota.

(tumhI) sAMgA, kAya tumhI AmacyAzI allAhabAbata vAda ghAlatA, jo AmacA ANi tumacA pAlanakartA Ahe. AmacyAsAThI AmacI karme Aheta, tumacyAsAThI tumacI karme. AmhI tara kevaLa allAhazIca sacce, prAmANika Ahota.

kAya tumhI ase mhaNatA kI ibrAhIma, ismAIla, isahAka ANi yAkUba va tyAMcI saMtatI yahUdI kiMvA khrizcana hotI? sAMgA, kAya tumhI jAsta jANatA kI allAha? allAhacyA javaLa purAvA lapaviNAr2yAMpekSA jAsta atyAcArI ANakhI koNa Ahe? ANi allAha tumacyA karmAMpAsUna gAphIla nAhI.
hA eka janasamUha hotA jo hoUna gelA, tyAMnI je (karma) kele te tyAMcyAsAThI Ahe ANi je tumhI kele te tumacyAsAThI. tumhAlA tyAMcyA karmAMviSayI vicArale jANAra nAhI.1

lavakaraca he mUrkha loka mhaNatIla kI jyA kiblA (jyA dizekaDe toMDa karUna namAja paDhalI jAte) vara he hote, tyAkaDUna yAMnA koNatyA goSTIne phiravile? (tumhI tyAMnA) sAMgA kI pUrva ANi pazcimecA mAlaka allAha Ahe. to jyAlA icchito saraLa mArga dAkhavito.

ANi AmhI azA prakAre tumhAlA madhalI (saMtulita) ummata (janasamUha) banavile, yAsAThI kI tumhI lokAMvara sAkSI rAhAve ANi rasUla (sa.) tumacyAvara sAkSI rAhAveta ANi jyA kiblAvara tumhI pUrvIpAsUna hote, to AmhI kevaLa evaDhyAsAThI nizcita kelA hotA kI (yAdvAre) AmhI he jANUna ghyAve kI rasUlacA saccA tAbedAra koNa Ahe ANi koNa Ahe jo ulaTyA pAvalI parata phirato. vAstavika he kaThINa kAma Ahe, paraMtu jyAMnA allAhane mArgadarzana kele Ahe (tyAMcyAsAThI kAhIca kaThINa nAhI) allAha tumace ImAna vAyA jAU deNAra nAhI. niHsaMzaya, allAha, lokAMzI prema rAkhaNArA ANi dayA karaNArA Ahe.

AmhI tumace toMDa vAraMvAra AkAzAkaDe vara hota asalele pAhata Ahota, AtA AmhI tumhAlA tyA kiblAkaDe phiravUna deU jyAmuLe tumhI khUza vhAla. tumhI Apale toMDa masjide harAma (kAbA) kaDe phiravUna ghyA ANi tumhI koThehI asA, Apale toMDa tyAcyAcakaDe phiravUna gheta jA. graMthadhArakAMnA, hI goSTa allAhatarphe satya asaNyAce khare jJAna Ahe ANi sarvazreSTha allAha tyAMcyA tyA karmAMpAsUna gAphIla nAhI, jI karme he karatAta.

ANi tumhI jara graMthadhArakAMnA sarva purAve sAdara karUna dyAla, tarIhI te tumacyA kiblAce anusaraNa karaNAra nAhIta ANi nA tumhI tyAcA kiblA mAnya karaNAre vhAla, nA he ApasAta ekamekAMcA kiblA mAnaNAre Aheta. tumacyAjavaLa spaSTa jJAna yeUna pohocalyAnaMtarahI jara tumhI tyAMcyA icchA-AkAMkSA pUrNa karaNyAsAThI tyAMce anusaraNa karU lAgAla tara nizcitaca tumhIdekhIla atyAcArI TharAla.
jyAMnA AmhI graMtha dilA Ahe, te tara yAlA azA prakAre oLakhatAta, jyA prakAre ekhAdA manuSya ApalyA putrAMnA oLakhato, tyAMcyAtalA eka samUha satyAlA oLakhUnahI te lapavito.
tumacyA pAlanakartyAtarphe he paripUrNa satya Ahe. sAvadhAna! tumhI zaMkA-saMzaya karaNAr2yAMpaikI hoU nakA.

ANi pratyeka manuSya koNatyA na koNatyA dizekaDe parvRtta (lakSa keMdrita karaNArA) asato. tumhI nekI (satkarmAM) kaDe dhAva ghyA. tumhI koThehI asA allAha tumhAlA gheUna yeIla. niHsaMzaya, allAha pratyeka goSTIce sAmarthya bALagato.

ANi tumhI jyA ThikANAhUnahI nighAla Apale toMDa masjide harAAma (AdaraNIya masjida arthAta kAbA) kaDe karUna gheta jA. tumacyA pAlanakartyAtarphe heca satya Ahe ANi je kAhI tumhI karIta AhAta, tyApAsUna allAha gAphIla nAhI.

ANi jyA ThikANAhUnahI tumhI nighAla Apale toMDa masjide harAmakaDe karUna ghyA ANi jyA ThikANIdekhIla tumhI rAhAla Apale toMDa tyAcyAcakaDe (arthAta kAbAkaDe) karUna gheta jA, yAsAThI kI lokAMnA vAda ghAlaNyAce koNatehI pramANa bAkI rAhU naye, tyAMcyAkherIja je yAMcyAta atyAcArI Aheta. tumhI tyAMce bhaya bALagU nakA, phakta mAjheca bhaya bALagA, yAsAThI kI mI ApalI kRpA- deNagI (nemata) tumacyAvara pUrNa karAvI, ANi yAsAThI kI tumhI mArgadarzana prApta karU zakAve.

jyA prakAre AmhI tumacyAta, tumacyAmadhUnaca rasUla (paigaMbara muhammada sallallAhu alaihi vasallama) yAMnA pAThavile, jo AmacyA AyatI (pavitra kuraAna) tumacyAsamora vAcUna aikavito ANi tumhAlA svaccha zuddha karato ANi tumhAlA graMtha ANi hikamata (buddhimAnatA) zikavito ANi tyA goSTIce jJAna deto, jyAviSayI tumhI ajANa hote.
yAsAThI tumhI mAjhe smaraNa karA, mIdekhIla tumace smaraNa rAkhIna ANi mAjhyAzI kRtajJazIla rAhA ANi kRtaghnatA dAkhavU nakA.
he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! dhIra-saMyama ANi namAjadvAre madata mAgA. niHsaMzaya, allAha dhIra-saMyama rAkhaNAr2yAMnA sAtha deto.
ANi allAhacyA mArgAta zahIda hoNAr2yAMnA melele mhaNU nakA, te tara jivaMta Aheta, paraMtu tumhI samajU zakata nAhI.
ANi AmhI koNatyA nA koNatyA prakAre tumacI kasoTI jarUra gheU. zatrUMcyA bhaya-dahazatIne, tahAna bhUkene, saMpattI ANi prANa, phaLAMcyA kamataratene ANi tyA saburI rAkhaNAr2yAMnA khUzakhabara dyA.
tyAMnA jevhA jevhA ekhAdyA saMkaTAlA toMDa dyAve lAgate, tevhA te mhaNata asatAta kI AmhI tara svataH sarvazreSTha allAhakaritA Ahota, ANi AmhI tyAcyAcakaDe parataNAra Ahota.
heca te loka hota, jyAMcyAvara tyAMcyA pAlanakartyAcI rahamata (dayA-kRpA) ANi meharabAnI Ahe ANi heca loka saraLa mArgAvara Aheta.

niHsaMzaya, saphA ANi maravaha (he donhI parvata) allAhacyA nizANyAMpaikI Aheta. yAsAThI allAhacyA gharA (kAbA) cA haja ANi umarA karaNAr2yAMvara yAMcyA daramyAna pher2yA karUna gheNyAta kAhIca harakata nAhI. ApalyA AvaDIne nekI (satkarma) karaNAr2yAMcA allAha sanmAna karato ANi tyAMnA cAMgalyA prakAre jANaNArA Ahe.

je loka AmhI avatarIta kelelyA nizANyAMnA ANi mArgadarzanAlA lapavitAta yAnaMtarahI kI AmhI ApalyA graMthAta (pavitra kuraAnAta) lokAMsAThI tyAMce nivedana kelele Ahe, azA lokAMcA allAhatarphe ANi sarva dhikkAraNAr2yAMtarphe dhikkAra Ahe.

paraMtu te loka, je taubA (kSamA yAcanA) karatIla ANi (ApalyA AcaraNAta) sudhAra karUna ghetIla, ANi je lapavile te sAMgUna TAkatIla tara mI tyAMcI taubA kabUla karato, ANi mI taubA kabUla karaNArA ANi dayA karaNArA Ahe.
niHsaMzaya, je kAphira (inkArI loka) inkAra karaNyAcyA sthitItaca maraNa pAvatIla tara tyAMcyAvara allAhatarphe, phariztyAMtarphe ANi sarva lokAMtarphe dhikkAra Ahe.
yAta te nehamIkaritA rAhatIla, nA tyAMcyAvarIla az2Aba (zikSA- yAtanA) halakI (saumya) kelI jAIla ANi nA tyAMnA DhIla dilI jAIla.
ANi tumhA sarvAMcA mAbUda (upAsya) eka allAhaca Ahe. tyAcyAzivAya koNIhI saccA (vAstava) upAsya nAhI, to atizaya kRpALU ANi moThA dayALU Ahe.

niHsaMzaya, AkAza ANi dharatIcI nirmitI, rAtra ANi divasAcA pherabadala, lokAMcyA lAbhadAyaka vastU gheUna naukAMce samudrAta cAlaNe, AkAzAtUna pANI utaravUna mRta jaminIlA jivaMta karaNe, tyAta pratyeka prakArace jIva pasaraviNe, vAr2yAMcI (havecI) dizA badalaNe ANi Dhaga je AkAza va dharatIcyA daramyAna hukUmAdhIna Aheta, yAta buddhimAnAMkaritA allAhacyA sAmarthyAcI nizANI Ahe.

ANi kAhI loka asehI Aheta je dusar2yAMnA allAhacA sahabhAgI TharavUna tyAMcyAzI ase prema rAkhatAta, jase prema allAhazI asAyalA have ANi ImAnadhAraka tara allAhazI prema rAkhaNyAta moThe sakta asatAta. mUrtIpUjaka lokAMnI he jANale asate tara! vAstavika allAhacyA zikSA- yAtanA pAhUna (jANUna ghetIla) kI sarva prakArace sAmarthya allAhalAca Ahe ANi allAha sakta az2Aba (zikSA-yAtanA) deNArA Ahe. (tara kadhIhI mUrtIpUjA kelI nasatI.)
jyA veLI pramukha (pezavA) loka ApalyA anuyAyIMpAsUna vegaLe hotIla ANi az2AbalA ApalyA DoLyAMnI pAhUna ghetIla ANi sarva nAte-saMbaMdha tuTatIla.

ANi anuyAyI mhaNU lAgatIla, AmhAlA punhA ekadA jagAta jAyalA miLAle tara kitI bare hoIla, maga tara AmhIhI tyAMcyApAsUna aseca vegaLe hoU jase he AmacyapAsUna Aheta. azA prakAre allAha tyAMnA tyAMce karma dAkhavila tyAMcyA pazcAttApAsAThI. jahannamamadhUna bAhera paDaNe tyAMnA kadhIca zakya hoNAra nAhI.
he lokAMno! dharatIvara jevaDhyAdekhIla halAla (vaidha) ANi pAka (svaccha-zuddha) vastU Aheta tyA khA va pyA ANi saitAnAcyA mArgAvara cAlU nakA to tumacA ughaDa zatrU Ahe.
to tumhAlA phakta vAITa ANi nirlajjapaNAcA ANi allAhacyA saMbaMdhAne azA goSTI sAMgaNyAcA Adeza deto, jyA tumhI jANatahI nAhI.

ANi jevhA jevhA tyAMnA sAMgitale jAte kI allAhane avatarIta kelelyA graMthAnusAra AcaraNa karA, tevhA uttara detAta kI AmhI tara tyAca mArgAce anusaraNa karU, jyAvara AmhAlA Apale vADavaDIla ADhaLale, vAstavika tyAMce vADavaDIla mUrkha ANi bhaTakalele asale tarI.
ANi kAphira (inkArI loka) tyA janAvarAMsArakhe Aheta, je ApalyA gurAkhyAcI phakta hAka ANi AvAja ekatAta (samajUna gheta nAhIta) te bahire, muke ANi AMdhaLe Aheta, tyAMnA akkalaca nAhI.
he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! jI (pAka) vastU AmhI tumhAlA pradAna kelI Ahe, tI khA va pyA ANi allAhace AbhArI banUna rAhA. jara tumhI phakta tyAcIca upAsanA karata asAla.

tumacyAsAThI melele ANi rakta, DukarAMce mAMsa, ANi azI tI pratyeka vastU jicyAvara allAhacyA nAvAzivAya dusar2yAMce nAva ghetale jAve, harAma Ahe. paraMtu jo lAcAra hoIla ANi to maryAdA olAMDaNArA va atyAcArI nasAvA, tyAcyAvara te khANyAta kAhI gunhA nAhI. niHsaMzaya, allAha moThA mApha karaNArA, dayA karaNArA Ahe.

niHsaMzaya, je loka sarvazreSTha allAhane avatarIta kelelA graMtha lapavitAta ANi tyAlA thoDyAzA kiMmatIvara vikatAta, khAtrIne te ApalyA poTAta Aga bharata Aheta. kayAmatacyA divazI allAha tyAMcyAzI saMbhASaNahI karaNAra nAhI nA tyAMnA pAka (svaccha-zuddha) karIla. tyAcyAsAThI moThI sakta zikSA-yAtanA Ahe.
heca te loka Aheta, jyAMnI mArgadarzanAcyA mobadalyAta mArgabhraSTatelA ANi mAphIcyA mobadalyAta az2Aba kharedI kelA. he loka AgIcA az2Aba kitI sahana karaNAre Aheta.
yA zikSA-yAtanAMce kAraNa heca Ahe kI sarvazreSTha allAhane saccA (satyAMvara AdhArIta) graMtha utaravilA ANi yA graMthAcyA saMdarbhAta matabheda rAkhaNAre nizcitaca dUracyA virodhAta paDale.

samasta nekI (satkarma) kevaLa pUrva ANi pazcimekaDe toMDa karaNyAtaca nAhI, kiMbahunA vAstavika bhalA mANUsa to Ahe jo allAhavara, kayAmatacyA divasAvara, phariztyAMvara, allAhacyA graMthAvara ANi paigaMbarAvara ImAna rAkhaNArA Ahe. dhana saMpattIcA moha asatAnAhI jo Apale dhana nAtevAIkAMvara, anAthAMvara, gora garIbAMvara, pravAzAMvara ANi yAcakAMvara kharca karato. baMdI jhAle tyAMnA mukta karato. namAja niyamitapaNe paDhato ANi jakAta (dharma dAna) adA karato. jevhA vAyadA karato tara tyAlA pUrNa karato. dhana saMpattIcI taMgI-aDacaNa, duHkha-yAtanA ANi laDhAIcyA prasaMgI dhIra-saMyama rAkhato. heca loka sacce Aheta ANi heca parahejagAra (allAhace bhaya rAkhUna durAcArApAsUna alipta rAhaNAre) Aheta.

he ImAnadhArakAMno! tumacyAvara hatyA kelyA gelelyA mANasAcA (raktAcA) mobadalA gheNe anivArya kele gele Ahe, svataMtra mANasAcyA mobadalyAta svataMtra mANUsa, gulAmAcyA mobadalyAta gulAma, strIcyA badalyAta strI, mAtra jara ekhAdyAlA, tyAcyA bhAvA tarphe mApha kele jAIla, tyAne bhalepaNAcA Adara rAkhalA pAhije ANi sahajapaNe phidiyA (ekhAdyAcyA khunAcI nukasAnabharapAI mhaNUna dile jANAre dhana) adA kele pAhije. tumacyA pAlanakartyAtarphe hI sUTa (savalata) Ahe. ANi rahamata (dayA-kRpA) Ahe. tyAnaMtarahI jo maryAdece ullaMghana karIla, tara tyAlA atizaya sakta zikSA- yAtanelA toMDa dyAve lAgela.
buddhimAnAMno! kisAsa (hatyAdaMDA) madhye tumacyAkaritA jIvana Ahe. yA kAraNAne tumhI (hatyA karaNyApAsUna) svataHlA rokhAla.

tumacyAsAThI he baMdhanakAraka kele gele Ahe kI jevhA tumacyApaikI ekhAdyAce maraNa javaLa yeUna Thepela ANi to ApalyA mAge dhana-saMpattI soDUna jAta asela tara tyAne ApalyA mAtA-pityAsAThI ANi nAtevAIkAMsAThI bhalepaNAne vasIyata (mRtyupatra) karUna jAve. allAhace bhaya rAkhaNAr2yAMvara he anivArya kartavya Ahe.
AtA jo manuSya tyAlA aikUna ghetalyAnaMtara tyAta badala karIla tara tyAcA gunhA, badala karaNAr2yAvaraca rAhIla. niHsaMzaya, sarvazreSTha allAha sarvakAhI aikaNArA va jANaNArA Ahe.

tathApi jyAlA mRtyupatra karaNAr2yAtarphe pakSapAta ANi aparAdhAce bhaya jANavela, tyAne jara tyAMcyA daramyAna sudhAra-samajhotA ghaDavUna ANalA tara tyAcyAvara gunhA nAhI. niHsaMzaya, allAha mApha karaNArA, meharabAna Ahe.

he ImAnadhArakAMno! tumacyAvara roje (upavAsa vrata je ramajAnacyA mahinyAta rAkhale jAte) pharja (bandhanakAraka) kele geleta, jyA prakAre tumacyA pUrvIcyA lokAMvara pharja kele gele hote. yAsAThI kI tumhI takavA (allAhace bhaya) cA mArga dharAvA.

kAhI mojakeca divasa Aheta, paraMtu tumacyApaikI jara ekhAdA manuSya AjArI asela kiMvA pravAsAta asela tara tyAne itara divasAta gaNanA pUrNa karUna ghyAvI ANi jyAlA yA goSTIce sAmarthya asela tyAne phidiyAcyA svarUpAta ekA garIbAlA jeU ghAlAve, maga jo manuSya ApalyA AvaDIne yAhUna jAsta nekI karIla tara te tyAcyAcakaritA uttama Ahe, paraMtu tumacyA hakkAta roje rAkhaNe heca adhika cAMgale karma Ahe. jara tumhI jANAra asAla.

ramajAna mahinA to Ahe, jyAta kuraAna utaravilA gelA, jo lokAMkaritA mArgadarzana Ahe ANi jo mArgadarzaka ANi satya va asatyAcyA daramyAna nirNAyaka Ahe. tevhA tumacyApaikI jo koNI yA mahinyAsa prApta karIla, tyAne roje rAkhale pAhijeta, paraMtu jo AjArI asela, kiMvA pravAsAta asela tara tyAne itara divasAta hI saMkhyA pUrNa karUna ghetalI pAhije. allAha tumacyAkaritA sahaja-sulabhatA icchito, saktI- aDacaNa icchita nAhI. to icchito kI tumhI gaNanA pUrNa karUna ghyAvI ANi allAhane pradAna kelelyA mArgadarzanAnusAra tyAcI mahAnatA varNana karA ANi tyAce kRtajJazIla (dAsa) banUna rAhA.

ANi jevhA mAjhe upAsaka mAjhyAviSayI tumhAlA vicAratIla, tevhA tyAMnA sAMgA kI mI agadI javaLa Ahe. pratyeka prArthanA karaNAr2yAcyA prArthanelA, jevhA jevhA to malA pukArato, mI kabUla karato. yAstava lokAMnIhI mAjhA hukUma mAnalA pAhije ANi mAjhyAvara ImAna rAkhale pAhije. heca tyAMcyA bhalAIce kAraNa Ahe.

rojAMcyA rAtrIta ApalyA patnIcyA javaLa jANyAcI tumhAlA paravAnagI Ahe. tyA tumacyA poSAkha Aheta ANi tumhI tyAMce poSAkha AhAta. tumhI lapUna chapUna kelelyA khiyAnatIce allAhalA jJAna Ahe. tyAne tumacI taubA (kSamA-yAcanA) kabUla karUna tumhAlA mApha kele. AtA tumhAlA tyAMcyAzI samAgama karaNyAcA ANi allAhane lihUna Thevalele prApta karaNyAcA Adeza Ahe. tumhI khAta-pIta rAhA.yetheparyarMta kI prAtaHkALacyA saphedIcA dhAgA aMdhArAcyA kALyA dhAgyApAsUna vegaLA vhAvA, maga rAtra hoIparyaMta rojA pUrNa karA ANi ApalyA patnIzI azA veLI saMbhoga karU nakA, jevhA tumhI masjidIMmadhye etikApha (ekA TharAvika avadhIparyaMta, allAhacI upAsanA karaNyAcyA hetUne svataHlA masjidacyA haddItaca rokhaNee) madhye asAla, yA allAhane ghAtalelyA maryAdA Aheta. tumhI tyAMcyA javaLahI jAU nakA. azA prakAre allAha ApalyA nizANyA, lokAMnA spaSTa karUna sAMgato, yAsAThI kI tyAMnI allAhace bhaya rAkhUna duSkarmAMpAsUna dUra rAhAve.
ANi ekamekAMce dhana cukIcyA rItIne khAU nakA, nA hakkadAra lokAMnA lAcalucapata pohacavUna ekhAdyAcI kAhI saMpattI julUmAne haDapa karA, jarI tumhI he jANata asAla.

loka tumhAlA navyA caMdrAviSayI vicAratAta. tumhI tyAMnA sAMgA kI he lokAMcyA upAsanecyA veLA ANi hajacyA avadhIkaritA Ahe (eharAmacyA avastheta) ANi gharAMcyA mAgacyA bAjUne tumace praveza karaNe kAhI nekIce kAma navhe. kiMbahunA neka kAma (satkarma) tara te Ahe je allAhace bhaya rAkhUna kele jAve. gharAMmadhye tyAMcyA daravAjyAmadhUna praveza karIta jA, ANi allAhace bhaya bALagUna rAhA. yAsAThI kI tumhI saphala vhAve.
ANi laDhA allAhacyA mArgAta tyAMcyAzI, je tumacyAzI laDhatAta ANi atyAcAra karU nakA. niHsaMzaya, allAha atyAcArIlA pasaMta karIta nAhI.

ANi tyAMnA ThAra karA jithe jithe te ADhaLatIla ANi tyAMnA bAhera kADhA jithUna tyAMnI tumhAlA bAhera ghAlavile Ahe. ANi (aikA) phitanA (bhAMDaNa-taMTA, phasAda) hatyA karaNyApekSAhI vAITa Ahe. ANi masjide harAma (kAbA) cyA javaLa tyAMcyAzI laDhAI karU nakA, joparya Mta te svataH tumacyAzI na laDhAveta. jara te tumacyAzI laDhatIla tara tumhIhI tyAMnA ThAra karA, inkArI lokAMcA hAca mobadalA Ahe.
maga jara te (laDhaNe) thAMbavatIla, tara allAha moThA mApha karaNArA, dayA karaNArA Ahe.

ANi tyAMcyAzI toparyaMta laDhA, joparyaMta phitanA (phasAda, upadrava) pUrNapaNe miTata nAhI ANi allAhacA dIna (dharma) kAyama rAhAta nAhI, paraMtu jara te (laDhaNe) thAMbavatIla tara (maga tumhIhI thAMbA). julUma atyAcAra kevaLa atyAcArI lokAMvara Ahe.

Adara-sanmAnavAlyA mahinyAMcyA mobadalyAta Adara-sanmAnapUrNa mahine Aheta, ANi Adara-sanmAnAcyA sarva goSTIMmadhye barobarIcA vicAra rAkhalA pAhije. jo tumacyAvara atyAcAra karIla tara tumhIhI tyAcyAvara tasAca julUma karA jasA tumacyAvara kelA gelA Ahe ANi sarvazreSTha allAhace bhaya bALagata rAhA ANi cAMgale dhyAnAta ThevA kI allAha, durAcArApAsUna dUra rAhaNAr2yAMcyA sobata Ahe.
ANi allAhacyA mArgAta kharca karA ANi ApalyAca hAtAMnI svataHlA halAkhIta TAkU nakA. bhalAI (nekI) karIta rAhA. niHsaMzaya allAha bhalAI karaNAr2yAMzI prema rAkhato.

ANi allAhakaritA haja va umarA pUrNa karA jara mArgAta rokhale jAla tara jedekhIla kurbAnIce janAvara asela, tyAcI kurbAnI karUna TAkA, ANi joparyaMta kurbAnI, kurbAnIcyA ThikANAvara pohacata nAhI, toparyaMta ApalyA DokyAvarIla kesa kADhU nakA. ANi tumacyApaikI jo AjArI asela kiMvA tyAcyA DokyAlA kAhI trAsa asela jyAmuLe to DokyAvarace kesa kADhUna gheIla tara tyAvara phidiyA (daMDa) Ahe kI, vATalyAsa tyAne rojA (vrata) rAkhAvA kiMvA vATalyAsa sadakA (dAna) dyAvA, kiMvA kurbAnI karAvI. paraMtu zAMtIpUrNa avasthA lAbhatAca jo umarAsaha haja karaNyAcA lAbha gheU icchila tara tyAne, jIdekhIla kurbAnI hajara asela, tI karUna TAkAvI. jyAlA he sAmarthya nasela, tyAne tIna roje hajacyA divasAta rAkhAve ANi sAta roje haja hUna paratatAnA rAkhAveta, he pUrNa dahA jhAle. hA Adeza tyAMcyAsAThI Ahe, je masjide harAma (makkA) ce rahivAzI nasAveta. (lokAMno!) allAhace bhaya bALagUna rAhA ANi jANUna asA kI sarvazreSTha allAha phAra kaThora zikSA-yAtanA deNArA Ahe.

hajace mahine nirdhArIta Aheta. yAstava jo yA TharAvika divasAta hajacA pakkA irAdA karIla tara tyAne ApalyA patnIzI saMbhoga karaNyApAsUna, aparAdha karaNyApAsUna ANi bhAMDaNa-taMTA karaNyApAsUna dUra rAhAve. tumhI je savAba (puNya) ce kAma karAla, te sarvazreSTha allAha jANaNArA Ahe, ANi ApalyAsobata pravAsakharca (sAdhana-sAmagrI) avazya ghyA. sarvAMta uttama asA pravAsakharca tara allAhace bhaya Ahe. ANi he buddhimAnAno! mAjhe bhaya bALagata rAhA.

ApalyA pAlanakartyAcI kRpA zodhaNyAta tumacyAvara kasalAhI gunhA nAhI. jevhA tumhI araphAta (yA ThikANApAsUna) parata vhAla, tevhA mazaare harAma (mujdaliphA) javaLa allAhace smaraNa karA ANi azA prakAre smaraNa karA, jase tyAne tumhAlA zikavile Ahe. vAstavika yApUrvI tumhI mArgabhraSTa lokAMmadhye hotA.
maga tumhI tyA sthAnApAsUna parata phirA, jyA sthAnApAsUna sarva loka parata phiratAta ANi allAhajavaLa mAphI mAgata rAhA. niHsaMzaya, allAha moThA mApha karaNArA, dayA karaNArA Ahe.

maga jevhA tumhI hajace pratyeka kAma (vidhI) pUrNa karUna ghyAla, tevhA allAhace smaraNa karA jyAprakAre tumhI ApalyA thora-bujUrga lokAMce smaraNa karIta hote, kiMbahunA tyAhUna jAsta. kAhI loka tara asehI Aheta, je mhaNatAta, ‘‘he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! AmhAlA yA jagAta deUna TAka’’ azA lokAMcA Akhiratamadhye kAhIca hissA nAhI.
ANi kAhI loka asehI Aheta, je mhaNatAta, ‘‘he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! AmhAlA yA jagAtahI bhalAI pradAna kara ANi AkhiratamadhyehI bhalAI pradAna kara ANi AmhAlA jahannamacyA az2AbapAsUna vAcava.’’
he loka ase Aheta, jyAMcyAsAThI tyAMcyA karmAMcA hissA (cAMgalA mobadalA) Ahe ANi sarvazreSTha allAha lavakaraca hizoba gheNArA Ahe.

ANi tyA kAhI TharAvika divasAMmadhye (‘tazarIka’cyA divasAMta) allAhace smaraNa karA. dona divasAMtaca ghAI karaNAr2yAMvara kAhI gunhA nAhI, ANi jo mAge rAhIla tyAcyAvarahI kAhI gunhA nAhI. he allAhace bhaya rAkhaNAr2yAMkaritA Ahe ANi allAhace bhaya bALagata rAhA ANi lakSAta ThevA kI tumhI sarva tyAcyAcakaDe ekatra (jamA) kele jAla.
ANi kAhI lokAMcyA sAMsArika jIvanAcyA goSTI tumhAlA AnaMdita karatAta ANi to ApalyA manAtalyA goSTIMvara allAhalA sAkSI Tharavito, vAstavika to moThA bhAMDakhora Ahe.
ANi jevhA to paratUna jAto, tevhA dharatIvara daMgA-dhopA, raktapAta pasaraviNyAcA, zetI-vADI ANi vaMzAcA vinAza karaNyAcA prayatna karIta rAhato. ANi allAha utpAta-upadravAlA pasaMta karIta nAhI.

ANi jevhA tyAlA sAMgitale jAte kI allAhace bhaya rAkha, tevhA tyAcI ghameMDa tyAlA aparAdha karaNyAsa pravRtta karate. azA mANasAkaritA phakta jahannamaca Ahe ANi niHsaMzaya te atizaya vAITa ThikANa Ahe.
ANi kAhI loka asehI Aheta, je allAhacI marjI prApta karaNyAsAThI ApalA prANadekhIla vikUna TAkatAta ANi allAha, ApalyA dAsAMvara moThA sneha- prema rAkhaNArA Ahe.
he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! islAmamadhye pUrNapaNe dAkhala vhA ANi saitAnAcyA pAvalAMvara pAUla ThevUna cAlU nakA. to tumacA ughaDa zatrU Ahe.
jara tumhI nizANyA yeUna pohocalyAnaMtarahI ghasarUna jAla tara lakSAta ThevA, allAha moThA jabaradasta ANi hikamata rAkhaNArA Ahe.
kAya lokAMnA yA goSTIcI pratikSA Ahe kI allAha svataH ghanadATa DhagAMmadhye prakaTa vhAvA ANi phariztedekhIla ANi maga kAma tamAma kele jAve! allAhakaDeca sarva kAme rujU kelI jAtAta.

isrAIlacyA saMtatIlA vicArA kI AmhI tyAMnA kitI spaSTa nizANyA pradAna kelyA, ANi jo, allAhacI kRpA- deNagI prApta jhAlyAnaMtara tilA badalUna TAkIla tara (tyAne dhyAnI ghyAve) kI allAha kaThora zikSA deNArA Ahe.

kAphirAM (inkAra karaNAr2yAM) sAThI yA jagAce jIvana suzophita kele gele Ahe ANi te ImAnadhArakAMcI thaTTA uTavitAta, tathApi je allAhace bhaya rAkhUna durAcArApAsUna dUra rAhaNAre Ahe, kayAmatacyA divazI (darjAmadhye) tyAcyApekSA phAra moThe asatIla. allAha jyAlA icchito agaNita pradAna karato.

vAstavika, suruvAtIcyA kALAta sarva loka ekAca janasamUhAce (dIna-dharmAce) hote. maga allAhane paigaMbarAMnA zubha samAcAra deNyAsAThI ANi saceta karaNyAsAThI pAThavile ANi tyAMcyAsobata graMtha avatarita kele, yAsAThI kI lokAMcyA daramyAna asalelyA pratyeka matabhedAcA phaisalA vhAvA, ANi kevaLa tyAca lokAMnI, je tyAMnA dile gele hote, ApalyAjavaLa pramANa yeUna pohacalyAnaMtarahI ApalyA dveSa ANi ghameMDImuLe tyAta matabheda kelA. yAkaritA allAhane ImAnadhArakAMcyA yA matabhedAtahI satyAkaDe ApalyA AjJene mArgadarzana kele ANi allAha jyAlA icchito saraLa mArgAkaDe mArgadarzana karato.

kAya tumhI azI kalpanA karUna basalAta kI jannatamadhye agadI sahajapaNe praveza karAla? vAstavika ajUna tumacyAvara tI avasthA nAhI AlI, jI tumacyA pUrvIcyA lokAMvara AlI hotI. tyAMnA sakta garIbI va rogarAIcA sAmanA karAvA lAgalA. tyAMnA itake jhiMjoDale gele kI rasUla (paigaMbara) ANi tyAMcyA sobatace ImAnadhAraka loka mhaNUna lAgale kI allAhacI madata kevhA yeIla? aikA allAhacI madata javaLaca Ahe!

tumhAlA te vicAratAta kI tyAMnI kazAvara kharca karAvA? tumhI tyAMnA sAMgA kI tumhI jo kAhI mAla (dhana) kharca karAla to mAtA-pityAkaritA, nAtevAIkAMkaritA, anAtha va goragarIbAMkaritA ANi pravAzAMkaritA Ahe. ANi tumhI jI kAhI bhalAI karAla, allAha tI cAMgalyA prakAre jANato.

tumacyAvara jihAda pharja (baMdhanakAraka kartavya) kele gele. jarI te tumhAlA apriya vATata asale tarIhI, zakya Ahe kI tumhI ekhAdyA goSTIlA vAITa jANAve ANi khare pAhatA toca tumacyAsAThI bhalI asAvI ANi hehI zakya Ahe kI tumhI jyA goSTIlA cAMgalI samajAve tI tumacyAsAThI vAITa asAvI. khare jJAna tara allAhalAca Ahe. tumhI mAtra ajANa AhAta.

loka tumhAlA Adara-sanmAnAcyA mahinyAta laDhAIviSayI vicAratAta. tumhI sAMgA, tyA mahinyAta laDhAI karaNe phAra moThe aparAdha karma Ahe. paraMtu allAhacyA mArgAta rokhaNe, allAhacA inkAra karaNe, masjide harAmapAsUna rokhaNe ANi tithalyA rahivAzAMnA tithUna bAhera ghAlaviNe, allAhajavaLa tyApekSAhI moThA gunhA Ahe, ANi phitanA (phitUra mAjavaNe) hatyA karaNyApekSAhI moThA gunhA Ahe. he loka tumacyAzI laDhAI karataca rAhatIla, yethaparyaMta kI tyAMnA zakya jhAlyAsa tumhAlA tumacyA dharmApAsUna phiravatIla ANi tumacyApaikI je loka ApalyA dharmApAsUna parata phiratIla ANi tyAca kupra (inkArI) avastheta maraNa pAvatIla tara tyAMcI yA jagAcI va AkhiratacI sarva karme vAyA jAtIla. he loka jahannamI asatIla ANi nehamIkaritA jahannamamadhyeca rAhatIla.

paraMtu jyAMnI ImAna kabUla kele ANi sthalAMtara kele ANi allAhacyA mArgAta jihAda kele (dharmAcyA rakSaNAsAThI allAhacyA mArgAta laDhale) teca allAhacyA dayA-kRpecI AzA bALagatAta ANi allAha moThA mApha karaNArA, dayA karaNArA Ahe.

loka tumhAlA dArU ANi jugArAviSayI vicAratAta. tumhI sAMgA, yA donhI goSTIMta moThA gunhA Ahe. ANi lokAMnA yAMpAsUna yA jagAcA lAbhahI hoto, paraMtu tyAMcA gunhA tyAMcyA phAyadyApekSA aneka paTIMnI jAsta Ahe, tumhAlA hehI vicAratAta kI kAya kharca karAve. tumhI sAMgA, garajepekSA je jAsta asela te. allAha azA prakAre ApalA Adeza spaSTapaNe tumhAlA sAMgato yAsAThI kI tumhI vicAra-ciMtana karAve.

aihika ANi maraNottara jIvanAcyA AcaraNAlA, ANi tumhAlA anAthAMviSayI vicAratAta. tyAMnA tumhI sAMgA kI tyAMcI bhalAI karaNeca uttama Ahe. jara tumhI Apale dhana tyAMcyA dhana-saMpattIta misaLUna ghyAla tarI te tumace bAMdhava Aheta. vAITa irAdA rAkhaNArA ANi neka irAdA rAkhaNArA sarvAMnAca allAha pUrNapaNe jANato ANi allAhane icchile asate tara tumhAlA aDacaNIta (kaSTa-yAtaneta) TAkale asate. niHsaMzaya, sarvazreSTha allAha moThA jabaradasta ANi hikamatazAlI Ahe.

ANi anekezvaravAdI striyAMzI toparyaMta vivAha karU nakA, joparyaMta tyA ImAna svIkArata nAhIta. ImAnadhAraka dAsI anekezvaravAdI svataMtra strIpekSA adhika cAMgalI Ahe. jarI tumhAlA AnekezvaravAdI strI kitIhI cAMgalI vATata asalI tarIhI, ANi nA anekezvaravAdI puruSAMnA ApalyA (ImAnadhAraka) striyAMzI vivAha karU dyA, joparyaMta te ImAna svIkArIta nAhI. ImAnadhAraka gulAma (muslima dAsa) svataMtra (gulAma nasalelyA) anekezvaravAdI puruSApekSA adhika cAMgalA Ahe, jarI tumhAlA anekezvaravAdI khUpa cAMgalA vATata asalA tarIhI. he loka jahannamakaDe bolavitAta, ANi allAha jannatakaDe ANi mAphIkaDe ApalyA hukUmAne bolavito. to ApalyA nizANyA lokAMkaritA spaSTapaNe sAMgato, yAsAThI kI tyAMnI bodha (upadeza) prApta karAvA.

ANi tumhAlA mAsika pALIviSayI vicAratAta, sAMgA tI ghANeraDI avasthA Ahe. mAsika pALIcyA veLI striyAMpAsUna alaga rAhA ANi joparyaMta tyA pAka (svaccha-zuddha) hota nAhIta tyAMcyA javaLa jAU nakA, mAtra jevhA tyA pAka hotIla, tevhA tyAMcyA javaLa jA, jazI allAhane tumhAlA anumatI dilI Ahe. niHsaMzaya, allAha mAphI mAgaNAr2yAlA ANi svaccha-zuddha (pAka) rAhaNAr2yAlA pasaMta karato.

tumacyA patnyA tumacI zete Aheta. ApalyA zetAMmadhye vATela tyA prakAre yA ANi svataHkaritA (puNya) puDhe pAThavA ANi sarvazreSTha allAhace bhaya bALagata rAhA ANi lakSAta asU dyA kI allAhazI tumacI bheTa hoNAraca Ahe ANi ImAnadhArakAMnA khUzakhabara aikavA.

ANi sarvazreSTha allAhalA ApalyA zapathAMsAThI (azA prakAre) nizAnA banavU nakA kI bhalAI ANi durAcArApAsUna aliptatA ANi lokAMcyA daramyAna sudhAraNA karaNe soDUna basAve. ANi sarvazreSTha allAha sarva kAhI aikaNArA, jANaNArA Ahe.

sarvazreSTha allAha tumhAlA tumacyA tyA zapathAMbAbata dharaNAra nAhI, jyA pakkyA (majabUta) nasatIla, mAtra tumacI pakaDa tyA goSTIbAbata Ahe, jI tumhI manApAsUna kelI Ahe, ANi allAha mApha karaNArA moThA sahanazIla Ahe.
je loka ApalyA patnIjavaLa na jANyAcI zapatha ghetIla tara tyAMcyAsAThI cAra mahinyAMcI mudata Ahe. maga jara te ApalI zapatha mAge ghetIla, tara allAha moThA mApha karaNArA, dayA karaNArA Ahe.
ANi jara talAka deNyAcAca irAdA karUna ghyAla tara sarvazreSTha allAha sarva kAhI aikaNArA, jANaNArA Ahe.

jyAMnA talAka dilA gelA tyA (ghaTasphoTita) striyAMnI svataHlA tIna mAsika pALI yeIpAparyaMta rokhUna ThevAve. tyAMcyAkaritA he ucita navhe kI allAhane tyAcyA udarAta je nirmANa kele asela, tyAlA lapavAve, jara tyAMce allAhavara ANi kayAmatacyA divasAvara ImAna asela. tyAMcyA patIlA yA mudatIta, tyAMnA parata yeNyAcA pUrNa hakka Ahe, jara tyAMcA irAdA sudhAraNA karaNyAcA asela. striyAMcehI taseca hakka Aheta, jase tyAMcyAvara puruSAMce bhalAIsaha Aheta. mAtra puruSAMnA striyAMvara zreSThatA prApta Ahe ANi allAha jabaradasta hikamata rAkhaNArA Ahe.

yA prakAracI talAka dona veLA Ahe. maga ekatara bhalepaNAne rokhAve kiMvA ucita rItIne soDUna dyAve ANi tumacyAsAThI he yogya navhe kI tumhI tyAMnA je kAhI dile Ahe, tyAtUna kAhI parata ghyAve. mAtra hI goSTa vegaLI kI doghAMnA allAhacyA maryAdA kAyama na rAkhalyA jANyAce bhaya asela, yAstava jara tumhAlA bhaya asela kI he doghe allAhacyA maryAdA kAyama rAkhU zakaNAra nAhIta, tara strIne suTakA prApta karUna gheNyAsAThI kAhI deUna TAkAve. yAta doghAMvara kasalAhI gunhA nAhI. yA allAhane bAMdhalelyA sImA Aheta. sAvadhAna! yAMce ullaMghana karU nakA ANi je loka allAhacyA sImA olAMDatIla, te atyAcArI Aheta.

maga jara tilA (tisar2yA khepesa) talAka dilI gelI tara AtA tI strI tyAcyAkaritA halAla nAhI, joparyaMta tI strI tyAcyAzivAya dusar2yA koNAzI vivAha karUna na gheIla. maga jara tohI talAka deUna TAkIla tara tyA doghAMvara punhA ekatra yeNyAta kAhI gunhA nAhI, mAtra tyAMnI he jANUna ghyAve kI allAhacyA (nirdhArIta) sImA kAyama rAkhatIla. yA allAhacyA maryAdA Aheta, jyAMnA to jANaNAr2yAMkaritA sAMgata Ahe.

ANi jevhA tumhI striyAMnA talAka dyAla ANi tyA ApalI iddata (tIna mAsika pALIparyaMtacA avadhI) saMpaviNyAcyA betAta asatIla tara AtA tyAMnA cAMgalyA prakAre rAkhA (nAMdavA) kiMvA bhalepaNAne alaga karA ANi tyAMnA hAnI pohacaviNyAcyA hetUne, atyAcAra va atirake karaNyAsAThI rokhU nakA. jo manuSya ase karIla tara tyAne ApalyA jIvAvara julUma kelA. tumhI allAhacyA AdezAlA thaTTA-kheLa banavU nakA ANi allAhacI jI kRpA-deNagI (nemata) tumacyAvara Ahe ticI AThavaNa karA ANi je kAhI graMtha ANi hikamata tyAne avatarita kelI Ahe, jyAdvAre tumhAlA zikavaNa deta Ahe tilAdekhIla, ANi allAhace bhaya bALagUna asA ANi lakSAta ThevA kI allAha pratyeka goSTa cAMgalyA prakAre jANato.

ANi jevhA tumhI ApalyA striyAMnA talAka dyAla ANi tyA ApalI iddata pUrNa karUna ghetIla, tara tyAMnA tyAMcyA patIMzI vivAha karaNyApAsUna rokhU nakA, jevhA te ApasAta bhalepaNAne rAjIkhuzI asatI. hI zikavaNa tyAMnA dilI jAte, tumacyApaikI jyAMcA allAhavara ANi kayAmatacyA divasAvara vizvAsa ANi ImAna asela. yAta tumacyAsAThI cAMgalI zuddhatA- pavitratA Ahe ANi allAha jANato, tumhI nAhI jANata.

ANi mAtAMnI ApalyA bALAMnA pUrNa dona varSAMparyaMta dUdha pAjAve jyAMcA irAdA dUdha pAjaNyAcyA pUrNa mudatIcA asela ANi jyAMcI tI saMtatI Ahe tyAMcI hI jabAbadArI Ahe kI tyAMnA anna-vastra dyAve. je bhalepaNAne asAve, pratyeka mANasAlA evaDhIca kaSTa-yAtanA dilI jAte jevaDhI tyAcyA aMgI zaktI asela. mAtelA ticyA saMtatIcyA kAraNAne kiMvA pityAlA tyAcyA mulAbALAMcyA kAraNAne kasalAhI trAsa kiMvA hAnI pohacivalI jAU naye, vArasAvaradekhIla tazI jabAbadArI Ahe, maga jara doghe (pita-patnI) ApalyA hokAra ANi ekamekAMcyA irAdyAne dUdha soDavU icchita asatIla tara doghAMvara kAhI gunhA nAhI ANi jara tumhI ApalyA bAlakAMnA dUdha pAjU icchita asAla tarIhI tumacyAvara kAhI gunhA nAhI. jevhA tumhI tyAMnA jaga rahATInusAra tyAMnA (je kAhI Tharale te) deUna TAkA. sarvazreSTha allAhace bhaya bALagata rAhA ANi jANUna asA kI allAha tumace pratyeka karma pAhata Ahe.

tumacyApaikI je loka maraNa pAvatIla ANi ApalyA mAge patnyA soDUna jAtIla, tara tyA striyAMnI svataHlA cAra mahine va dahA divasAMcyA iddatamadhye rAkhAve. maga jevhA tyA, hI mudata saMpavatIla tara je kAhI bhalepaNAne svataHsAThI karAla tyAta tumacyAvara kasalAhI gunhA nAhI ANi allAha tumacyA eka eka karmAlA jANaNArA Ahe.

ANi tumacyAvara yA bAbatItahI kAhI gunhA nAhI kI tumhI izAr2yAne kiMvA nakaLatarityA tyA striyAMzI vivAhAbAbata bolAve kiMvA ApalyA manAta irAdA lapavAvA. allAhalA cAMgale mAAhitI Ahe kI tumhI avazya tyAMcI AThavaNa karAla. paraMtu tumhI lapUna chapUna tyAMcyAzI vAyadA karU nakA, mAtra hI goSTa vegaLI kI tumhI bhalepaNAcI ekhAdI goSTa bolAvI ANi joparyaMta iddatacI mudata pUrNa hota nAhI, vivAhAce baMdhana majabUta karU nakA. lakSAta ThevA, allAhalA tumacyA manAtalyA goSTIMcehI jJAna Ahe. tumhI tyAce bhaya bALagata rAhA ANi hehI lakSAta ThevA kI allAha moThA mApha karaNArA ANi sahana karaNArA Ahe.

jara tumhI striyAMnA hAta na lAvatA ANi mahara nirdhArIta na karatA talAka dyAla tara azAhI sthitIta tumacyAvara kAhI gunhA nAhI, mAtra tyAMnA kAhI na kAhI phAyadA pohacavA. dhanavAnAne ApalyA hizobAne ANi garIbAne ApalyA tAkadIcyA hizobAne niyamAnusAra cAMgalA phAyadA dyAvA. bhalAI karaNAr2yAMkaritA he Avazyaka Ahe.

ANi jara tumhI striyAMnA yApUrvI talAka dyAla kI tumhI tyAMnA hAta lAvalA asela ANi tumhI tyAMcA maharahI nizcita kelA asela tara maga TharalelyA maharacI nimmI rakkama (mahara) dyA, AtA tine svataHca mApha kele tara goSTa vegaLI kiMvA tyA mANasAne mApha karAve jyAcyA hAtI nikAhace baMdhana Ahe. tumace he mApha karaNe takavA (allAhace bhaya rAkhaNyA) zI agadI javaLace Ahe. ANi ekamekAMcyA pratiSThelA visarU nakA. niHsaMzaya, allAha tumacyA pratyeka karmAlA pAhata Ahe.
namAjAMce rakSaNa karA, vizeSataH madhalyA namAjacI ANi allAhakaritA namratApUrvaka ubhe rAhAta jA.

jara tumhAlA ekhAde bhaya asela tara pAyI cAlata kiMvA vAhanAvara basUna ANi jara zAMtIpUrNa sthitI jhAlyAsa allAhacA mahimA varNana karA, jyA prakAre tyAne tumhAlA yA goSTIcI zikavaNa dilI Ahe, jI tumhI jANata navhate.

ANi tumacyApaikI je maraNa pAvatIla ANi mAge patnyA soDUna jAtIla tyAMnI vasIyata (mRtyupatra) karUna jAve kI tyAMcyA patnIMnI eka varSAparyaMta gujarANa karaNyAcA lAbha ghyAvA. tyAMnA koNI gharAbAhera ghAlavU naye, paraMtu jara tyA svataH nighUna jAtIla tara tumacyAvara yAta kAhI gunhA nAhI, je tI svataHsAThI bhalepaNAne karIla. allAha tara moThA jabaradasta, hikamatazAlI Ahe.
ANi talAka dilyA gelelyA striyAMnA cAMgalyA prakAre phAyadA pohacaviNe allAhace bhaya rAkhaNAr2yAMkaritA Avazyaka Ahe.
azA prakAre allAha tumacyAsAThI ApalyA AyatI spaSTapaNe sAMgato, yAsAThI kI tumhI akalecA vApara karAvA.

kAya tumhI tyAMnA nAhI pAhile, je hajAroMcyA saMkhyene mRtyucyA bhayAmuLe ApalyA gharAMmadhUna bAhera paDale. allAhane tyAMnA pharmAvile kI marA, ANi naMtara tyAMnA jivaMta kele. niHsaMzaya, allAha lokAMvara moThA kRpA karaNArA Ahe, paraMtu adhikAMza loka AbhAra mAnata nAhIta.
ANi allAhacyA mArgAta laDhA ANi he jANUna ghyA kI allAha sarva kAhI aikaNArA, jANaNArA Ahe.
asA koNa Ahe, jo allAhalA cAMgale karja deIla? jyAsa allAhane aneka paTIMnI jAsta karUna pradAna karAve ANi allAhaca kamI-adhika karato ANi tumhI tyAcyAcakaDe dusar2yAMdA jAla.

kAya tumhI mUsAnaMtaracyA isrAIlI vaMzAcyA jamAtIsa nAhI pAhile, jevhA tyAMnI ApalyA paigaMbarAsa mhaTale kI AmacyAvara ekhAdyAlA bAdazahA nemUna dyA, yAsAThI kI AmhI allAhacyA mArgAta laDhAve. paigaMbara mhaNAle, saMbhavataH jihAda pharja (anivArya) jhAlyAnaMtara tumhI jihAda karaNyAsa inkAra karAla. loka mhaNAle, AmhI allAhacyA mArgAta kA nAhI laDhaNAra? AmhAlA tara ApalyA gharAdArAMpAsUna ANi mulAbALAMpAsUna dUra kele gele Ahe. maga jevhA tyAMcyAvara jihAda pharja (anivArya) kelA gelA tevhA kAhI thoDyA lokAMkherIja itara sarva mukarale, ANi allAha atyAcArI lokAMnA khUpa cAMgale jANato.

ANi tyAMnA tyAMce paigaMbara mhaNAle, allAhane tAlUta (nAvAcyA vyaktI) lA, tumacA bAdazahA banavile Ahe. tevhA te mhaNU lAgale, tyAcI rAjya-sattA AmacyAvara kazI bare asU zakate. tyAcyApekSA khUpa jAsta rAjya-sattece hakkadAra tara AmhI Ahota. tyAlA tara vipula dhanahI pradAna kele gele nAhI. paigaMbara mhaNAle, aikA! sarvazreSTha allAhane tyAlA tumacyAvara prAdhAnya dile Ahe ANi tyAlA jJAna va zArIrika zaktIhI jAsta pradAna kelI Ahe. kharI goSTa azI kI allAha jyAlA icchito ApalA mulUkha pradAna karato. allAha moThI vyApakatA ANi jJAna rAkhaNArA Ahe.

tyAMce paigaMbara punhA tyAMnA mhaNAle, tyAcyA mulUkhAcI spaSTa nizANI hI Ahe kI tumacyAjavaLa tI peTI parata yeIla, jicyA tumacyA pAlanakartyAtarphe manAcyA zAMtIcI sAmagrI Ahe ANi mUsAcyA saMtatIne va hArUnacyA saMtatIne ApalyA mAge soDalele sAmAna Ahe. phirazte tI peTI ucalUna ANatIla. niHsaMdeha, hI tara tumacyAsAThI spaSTa nizANI Ahe, jara tumhI ImAna bALagata asAla.

maga jevhA tAlUta sainya gheUna nighAle tevhA mhaNAle, aikA, ekA nadIcyAdvAre allAhalA tumacI kasoTI ghyAyacI Ahe, tevhA jo koNI tyA nadItUna pANI pIla to mAjhA navhe ANi jo ticyAtUna piNAra nAhI to mAjhA Ahe. AtA hI goSTa vegaLI kI jo ApalyA hAtAne eka oMjaLabhara gheIla ( tara harakata nAhI) tathApi kAhIMcyA kherIja itara sarvAMnI pANI piUna ghetale. (hajarata) tAlUta jevhA nadIlA pAra karUna gele ANi je tyAMcyAsobata ImAnadhAraka hote, tara te mhaNAle kI Aja tara AmacyAta evaDhe baLa nAhI kI jAlUta ANi tyAcyA phaujAMzI laDhAve. paraMtu jyAMnA allAhacyA bheTIbAbata pUrNa vizvAsa hotA te mhaNAle, anekadA lahAnasahAna jamAta, allAhacyA hukUmAne bhArI bharakama (moThyA) jamAtIvara vijaya prApta karate ANi allAha saburI (dhIra-saMyama) rAkhaNAr2yAMcyA sobata Ahe.

ANi jevhA tyAMcA jAlUta ANi tyAcyA sainyAMzI mukAbalA jhAlA tevhA tyAMnI duA (prArthanA) kelI, ‘‘he AmacyA pAlanahAra (allAha)! AmhAlA dhIra-saMyama pradAna kara ANi Amace pAya sthira rAkha ANi inkArI janasamUhAcyA virodhAta AmacI madata kara.’’

yAstava, allAhacyA hukUmAne tyAMnI zatrUlA parAbhUta kele ANi dAUdane jAlUtalA ThAra mArale ANi allAhane tyAlA rAjya ANi hikamata taseca jevaDhe icchile jJAnahI pradAna kele ANi jara allAha, kAhI lokAMnA itara samUhAdvAre haTavita rAhilA nasatA tara dharatIvara phasAda pasaralA asatA, paraMtu allAha yA jagAtIla lokAMvara phAra kRpA karaNArA Ahe.
yA allAhacyA AyatI Aheta, jyA AmhI tumhAlA satyAcyA AdhAre vAcavUna aikavita Ahota ANi nizcitaca tumhI paigaMbarAMpaikI AhAta.

he sarva rasUla (paigaMbara) Aheta, jyAMcyApaikI AmhI kAhIMnA, kAhIMvara zreSThatA pradAna kelI Ahe. tyAMcyApaikI kAhIMzI sarvazreSTha allAhane saMbhASaNa kele Ahe, ANi kAhIMcA darjA uMcAvilA Ahe ANi AmhI mariyamace putra IsA yAMnA camatkAra (mojijA) pradAna kelA ANi pavitra AtmyAdvAre tyAMnA samarthana dile allAhane icchile asate tara tyAMcyAnaMtara Alele loka, spaSTa nizANyA yeUna pohocalyAvarahI ApasAta laDhale nasate. paraMtu tyA lokAMnI matabheda kelA. tyAMcyApaikI kAhIMnI ImAna rAkhale ANi kAhI kAphira (inkArI) jhAle ANi allAhane icchile asate tara he ApasAta laDhale nasate, paraMtu allAha je kAhI icchito te karato.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! jI kAhI rojI AmhI tumhAlA dilI Ahe, tyAtUna kharca karIta rAhA, yApUrvI kI to divasa yAvA, jyA divazI nA saudebAjI, nA dostI ANi nA ziphArasa kAhIhI upayogI paDaNAra nAhI ANi satyAcA inkAra karaNAre lokaca atyAcArI Aheta.

allAhaca saccA mAbUda (upAsanA karaNyAyogya) Ahe, jyAcyAzivAya dusarA koNIhI mAbUda nAhI, jo jivaMta Ahe ANi nehamI kAyama rAhaNArA Ahe, jyAlA nA DulakI (guMgI) yete nA jhopa. tyAcyA svAmItvAta jamIna va AkAzAcyA samasta cIja vastU Aheta. asA koNa Ahe, jo tyAcyA AdezAvinA, tyAcyAsamora ziphArasa karU zakela. to jANato je kAhI nirmitIcyA samora Ahe va je kAhI tyAMcyA mAge Ahe ANi te tyAcyA jJAnApaikI koNatyAhI goSTIlA ApalyA adhikArakakSeta gheU zakata nAhI, paraMtu jevaDhe to icchila tyAcyA sattAkeMdrA (kursI) cyA vyApakatene samasta jamIna va AkAzAlA ApalyA adhikArakakSeta rAkhale Ahe. yA sarvAMce rakSaNa karaNyAta to thakatahI nAhI, ANi kaMTALatahI nAhI. to moThA AlIzAna va moThA mahimAvAna Ahe.

dIna (dharmA) cyA saMdarbhAta kasalIhI jorajabaradastI nAhI. satya, asatyApAsUna alaga jhAle, yAstava jo manuSya tAgUta (allAhazivAya itara upAsyAM) nA nAkArUna ekameva allAhavara ImAna rAkhIla, tara tyAne moThA majabUta AdhAra dharalA, jo kadhIhI tuTaNAra nAhI ANi sarvazreSTha allAha aikaNArA, jANaNArA Ahe.

allAha svataH ImAnadhArakAMcA saMrakSaka (valI) Ahe. to tyAMnA aMdhArAkaDUna prakAzAkaDe gheUna jAto ANi kAphirAMce (inkArI lokAMce) mitra tara saitAna Aheta. te tyAMnA prakAzAkaDUna aMdhArAkaDe netAta. he loka jahannamI Aheta, je nehamI tyAtaca paDUna rAhatIla.

kAya tumhI tyAlA nAhI pAhile, jyAne rAjya-sattA prApta karUna ibrAhImazI, tyAcyA pAlanakartyAbAbata bhAMDaNa kele. jevhA ibrAhIma mhaNAle kI, mAjhA raba (pAlanakartA) tara to Ahe jo jivaMta karato ANi mArato. to mhaNU lAgalA, mIdekhIla jivaMta karato ANi mArato. ibrAhIma mhaNAle, allAha tara sUryAlA pUrva dizekaDUna ugavato tU tyAlA pazcimekaDUna ugava. AtA mAtra to kAphira niruttara ANi thakka jhAlA ANi allAha atyAcArI lokAMnA sanmArga dAkhavita nAhI.

kiMvA tyA mANasAsArakhe, jyAce jANe ekA vastIvarUna jhAle, jI ApalyA chatAsameta pAlathI paDalI hotI. to mhaNU lAgalA, tyAcyA mRtyunaMtara allAha tyAlA kazA prakAre jivaMta karIla, tevhA allAhane tyAlA zaMbhara varSAMkaritA mRtyu dilA. maga naMtara tyAlA (jivaMta karUna) uThavile. allAhane vicArale, ‘‘kitI kALa tU melelyA avastheta hotAsa?’’ tyAne uttara dile kI eka divasa kiMvA divasAcA kAhI hissA. allAhane phamArvile, ‘‘kiMbahunA tU zaMbhara varSAMparyaMta (mRtAvastheta) rAhilA, maga AtA tU ApalyA khANyA-piNyAcyA vastUMkaDe pAhA kI tyA muLIca kharAba jhAlyA nAhIta ANi ApalyA gADhavAkaDehI pAhA. AmhI tulA lokAMkaritA nizANI banavito. tU pAhA kI AmhI kazA prakAre hADe ubhI karato, maga tyAMvara mAMsa caDhavito.’’ jevhA tyAlA he sarva spaSTa karUna Ale, tevhA to mhaNU lAgalA, mI cAMgale jANUna ghetale kI sarvazreSTha allAha sarva kAhI jANaNArA Ahe.

ANi jevhA ibrAhIma mhaNAle, ‘‘he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! malA dAkhava kI tU melelyAlA kazA prakAre jivaMta karazIla?’’ allAhane pharmAvile, ‘‘kAya tumace (yA goSTIvara) ImAna nAhI?’’ uttara dile, ‘‘ImAna tara Ahe, paraMtu azAne mAjhyA manAlA samAdhAna lAbhela.’’ allAhane pharmAvile, ‘‘cAra pakSI ghyA. tyAMce tukaDe karUna TAkA, maga pratyeka parvatAvara tyAMcA eka eka hissA ThevUna dyA, naMtara tyAMnA hAka mArA, te tumacyA javaLa dhAvata yetIla ANi jANUna asA kI allAha moThA jabaradasta hikamata rAkhaNArA Ahe.’’

je loka allAhacyA mArgAta ApalA mAla (dhana) kharca karatAta, tyAMce udAharaNa tyA dANyAsArakhe Ahe, jyAtUna sAta kaNase nighAvIta ANi pratyeka kaNasAta zaMbhara dANe asAveta ANi allAha jyAlA icchila aneka paTIMnI deIla, ANi allAha moThA vyApakatA rAkhaNArA ANi jJAna rAkhaNArA Ahe.

je loka Apale dhana, allAhacyA mArgAta kharca karatAta, maga tyAnaMtara upakAra darzavita nAhI ANi kleza-yAtanAhI deta nAhIta, tyAMcA mobadalA, tyAcyA pAlanakartyAjavaLa Ahe. tyAMnA nA kasale bhaya rAhIla, nA te duHkhI-kaSTI hotIla.
bhalI goSTa bolaNe ANi mApha karaNe tyA dAnApekSA uttama Ahe, je dilyAnaMtara duHkha pohacavile jAve ANi allAha nispRha ANi sahanazIla Ahe.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! Apale dAna, upakAra darzavUna ANi duHkha pohacavUna vAyA jAU deU nakA, jyApramANe to manuSya, jo Apale dhana lokAMnA dAkhaviNyAsAThI kharca karIla ANi nA allAhavara ImAna rAkhIla, nA kayAmatavara, tara tyAce udAharaNa tyA cikaNyA dagaDAsArakhe Ahe, jyAcyAvara thoDIzI mAtI asAvI, maga tyAvara jorAcA pAUsa paDAvA, pariNAmI pAvasAne tyAlA agadI sApha ANi sakta (kaThora) soDAve. yA dekhAvA karaNAr2yAMnA ApalyA kamAIpAsUna kAhIca hAtI lAgaNAra nAhI ANi allAha inkAra karaNAr2yAMcyA samudAyAlA mArgadarzana karIta nAhI.

je loka Apale dhana allAhacI marjI (prasannatA) prApta karaNyAkaritA manAcyA khuzIne ANi vizvAsAne kharca karatAta, tyAMce udAharaNa tyA bAgesArakhe Ahe jI jaminIcyA uMca bhAgAvara asAvI ANi joradAra pAvasAne tI ApalI phaLe duppaTa deIla ANi ticyAvara pAUsa jarI paDalA nAhI, tarI pAvasAcA halakA varSAvahI puresA Ahe ANi allAha tumacyA karmAMnA pAhata Ahe.

kAya tumacyApaikI koNI ase icchito kI tyAcyAjavaLa khajUrIcyA ANi drAkSAMcyA bAgA asAvyAta, jyAta pANyAce pravAha vAhata asAveta ANi pratyeka prakAracI phaLe asAvIta ANi bAgecA mAlaka mhAtArA jhAlelA asAvA, tyAlA lahAna mulehI asAvIta ANi acAnaka tyA bAgevara AgIce joradAra vAdaLa yAve ANi tI jaLUna khAka vhAvI. azA prakAre sarvazreSTha allAha tumhAlA ApalyA nizANyA spaSTapaNe sAMgato, yAsAThI kI tumhI vicAra karAvA.

he ImAnadhArakAMno! ApalyA (kaSTAcyA) halAla kamAImadhUna ANi jaminItUna tumacyAsAThI AmhI kADhalelyA vastUMmadhUna kharca karA. tyAMcyAtalyA kharAba vastU kharca karaNyAcA (deNyAcA) irAdA karU nakA, jyA tumhI svataH gheNAra nAhIta paraMtu DoLe miTUna ghyAla tara goSTa vegaLI. ANi lakSAta ThevA allAha nispRha ANi prazaMsanIya Ahe.
saitAna tumhAlA garIbIce bhaya dAkhavito, ANi nirlajjatecA Adeza deto. ANi allAha tumacyAzI ApalyA dayA-kRpecA vAyadA karato. allAha moThA meharabAna ANi jJAnasaMpanna Ahe.
to jyAlA icchito jJAna, buddhI pradAna karato ANi jyAlA buddhimAnatA pradAna kelI gelI, tyAlA phAra moThI bhalAI pradAna kelI gelI ANi bodha- upadeza kevaLa buddhimAna lokaca grahaNa karatAta.
tumhI vATela tevaDhA kharca karA (kiMvA dAna-puNya karA) ANi jo kAhI navasa mAnA allAha te jANato. ANi atyAcArIMcA koNI sahAyaka nAhI.

jara tumhI dAna-puNya khuleAmapaNe karAla tara tehI cAMgale Ahe, ANi jara tumhI te gupacUpapaNe garIbAMnA dyAla tara he tumacyAsAThI sarvAMta adhika cAMgale Ahe. sarvazreSTha allAha tumace aparAdha miTavIla ANi allAhalA tumacyA samasta karmAMcI khabara Ahe.

tyAMnA sanmArgAvara ANaNe tumacyA avAkhyAtIla goSTa navhe, kiMbahunA allAha jyAlA icchito mArgadarzana karato ANi tumhI jI cAMgalI vastU allAhacyA mArgAta dyAla, tyAcA lAbha svataH prApta karAla. tumhI kevaLa sarvazreSTha allAhacI prasannatA prApta karaNyAkaritA kharca kelA pAhije. tumhI je kAhI dhana kharca karAla, tyAcyA purepUra mobadalA tumhAlA dilA jAIla ANi tumacA hakka mAralA jANAra nAhI.

dAnAsa pAtra kevaLa te garIba Aheta, je allAhacyA mArgAta rokhale geleta, je jaminIvara phirU zakata nAhIta. nAdAna loka tyAMcyA na mAgaNyAne tyAMnA zrImaMta samajatAta. tumhI tyAMcyA cehar2yAMvarIla lakSaNe pAhUna tyAMnA oLakhUna ghyAla. te lokAMkaDUna agadI pAThIzI lAgUna bhikSA mAgata nAhIta. tumhI je kAhI dhana kharca karAla, allAha te jANaNArA Ahe.
je loka Apale dhana rAtraM-divasa gupacUpapaNe kiMvA jAhIrapaNe kharca karatAta, tyAMcyAsAThI tyAMcyA pAlanakartyAjavaLa mobadalA Ahe, tyAMnA nA kasale bhaya rAhIla ANi nA te duHkhI hotIla.

vyAja khANAre loka ubhe rAhaNAra nAhIta. paraMtu taseca jasA to manuSya ubhA rAhato jyAlA saitAna bilagUna veDasara banavito. he azAsAThI kI he mhaNata asata kI vyApAradekhIla vyAjApramANeca Ahe. vAstavika allAhane vyApAra halAla (vaidha) kelA ANi vyAjAlA harAma. ANi jo manuSya ApalyAjavaLa AlelA allAhacA upadeza aikUna (vyAja gheNyApAsUna) thAMbalA tara tyAcyAsAThI te Ahe je hoUna gele ANi tyAcA mAmalA allAhacyA supUrda Ahe ANi tarIhI jo (harAmakaDe) paratalA, to jahannamI Ahe ANi ase loka nehamI tyAtaca paDUna rAhatIla.
sarvazreSTha allAha vyAjAlA miTavito ANi dAnAlA vADhavito ANi allAha ekhAdyA kRtaghna ANi inkAra karaNAr2yAlA mitra banavita nAhI.

je loka ImAnAsaha (paigaMbarAMcyA AcaraNa zailInusAra) kAma karatAta, namAjAMnA kAyama karatAta ANi jakAta adA karatAta tyAMcA mobadalA tyAMcyA pAlanakartyAcyA javaLa Ahe. tyAMnA nA kasale bhaya rAhIla ANi nA kasale duHkha rAhIla.
he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAno! allAhace bhaya rAkhA ANi je vyAja bAkI rAhile Ahe, te soDUna dyA, jara tumhI kharokharace ImAnadhAraka asAla!
jara ase karata nasAla tara allAha ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAzI laDhaNyAsAThI tayAra vhA ANi jara mAphI mAgAla tara tumace muddala tumaceca Ahe. nA tumhI julUma karA ANi nA tumacyAvara julUma kelA jAvA.
ANi jara koNI garIba asela tara tyAlA savaDa miLeparyaMta veLa dilI pAhije ANi sadakA (dAna) karAla tara tumacyAsAThI adhika cAMgale Ahe jara tumhI jANata asAla.
ANi tyA divasAce bhaya bALagA, jyA divazI tumhI sarva allAhakaDe paratavile jAla ANi pratyeka mANasAlA tyAcyA karmAnusAra purepUra mobadalA dilA jAIla ANi tyAMcyAvara atyAcAra kelA jANAra nAhI.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! jevhA tumhI ApasAta ekA TharAvika mudatIkaritA ekamekAMzI udhAra-usanavArIcA vyavahAra karAla tara lihUna gheta jA ANI lihaNAr2yAne apasAtalA mAmalA nyAyAsaha lihUna dyAvA ANi lihiNAr2yAne lihUna deNyAsa inkAra karU naye, jase allAhane tyAlA zikavile Ahe tase tyAnedekhIla lihUna dile pAhije ANi jyAcyAvara hakka deNe baMdhanakAraka Ahe tyAne svataH sAMgUna lihavUna ghyAve ANi ApalyA allAhace bhaya rAkhAve, jo tyAcA pAnalakartA Ahe. ANi hakka-adhikArAta kAhIhI ghaTavU kiMvA kamI karU naye, mAtra jyA mANasAvara hakka baMdhanakAraka asatIla ANi to nAdAna asela kiMvA kamajora asela kiMvA lihUna gheNyAcI zaktI rAkhata nasela tara tyAcyAtarphe tyAcyA kArabhArI kiMvA vArasadArAne nyAyAsaha lihUna dyAve ANi ApalyAmadhUna dona puruSAMnA sAkSI karUna ghyA. jara dona puruSa upalabdha nasatIla tara eka puruSa ANi dona striyA jyAMnA tumhI sAkSI mhaNUna pasaMta karAla, azAsAThI kI ekIlA visara paDalyAsa dusarInee AThavaNa karUna dyAvI. ANi sAkSa deNAr2yAMnI, jevhA tyAMnA bolavile jAve, Ale pAhije. yeNyAsa inkAra karU naye. ANi karja, jyAcI mudata nizcita Ahe, maga te lahAna aso kiMvA moThe lihiNyAta ALasa karU nakA, sarvazreSTha allAhajavaLa hI goSTa phAra nyAyasaMgata Ahe, ANi sAkSa yathAyogya rAkhaNArI ANi zaMkA-saMvazayApAsUnahI vAcaviNArI Ahe. AtA hI goSTa vegaLI kI to vyavahAra rokha vyApArAcyA svarUpAta asela, je ApasAta deNe-gheNe karAla tara to na lihiNyAta tumacyAvara kAhI gunhA nAhI. kharedI-vikrI karateveLIhI sAkSIdAra TharavUna gheta jA ANi (lakSAta ThevA) nA tara lihiNAr2yAlA nukasAna pohocavile jAve ANi nA sAkSIdArAMnA ANi jara tumhI ase karAla tara hI tumacI ughaDa avajJA Ahe. allAhace bhaya rAkhA. allAha tumhAlA tAkIda karata Ahe ANi allAha sarva kAhI jANaNArA Ahe.

ANi jara tumhI pravAsAta asAla ANi lihiNArA ADhaLalA nAhI tara tAraNa gahANa ThevUna vyavahAra karUna ghyA ANi jara ApasAta ekamekAMvara vizvAsa asela tara jyAlA anAmata dilI gelI Ahe, tI tyAne adA karAvI ANi allAhace bhaya bALagUna rAhAve, jo tyAcyA pAlanakartA Ahe. ANi sAkSa lapavU nakA, ANi jo sAkSa lapavIla, to manAne pApI Ahe ANi tumhI je kAhI karatA, allAha te cAMgalyA prakAre jANato.

jamIna ANi AkAzAcI pratyeka vastU allAhacyA adhikArakakSeta Ahe. tumacyA manAta je kAhI Ahe, te tumhI jAhIra karA kiMvA lapavA, allAha tyAcA hizoba gheIla. maga jyAlA icchila mApha karIla ANi jyAlA icchila sajA deIla ANi allAha pratyeka goSTIce sAmarthya bALagato.
