paigaMbarAMnI tyAvara ImAna rAkhale, je tyAMcyAkaDe sarvazreSTha allAhatarphe avatarita kele gele ANi ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMnIhI ImAna rAkhale. yA sarvAMnI allAha ANi tyAcyA phariztyAMvara ANi tyAcyA graMthAMvara ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAMvara ImAna rAkhale. tyAcyA paigaMbarAMpaikI koNAcyAhI daramyAna AmhI pharaka karIta nAhI. te mhaNAle kI AmhI aikale ANi AjJApAlana kele. AmhI tujhyAjavaLa mAphI mAgato. he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! ANi AmhAlA tujhyAcakaDe paratAyace Ahe.

allAha koNatyAhI AtmyAvara tyAcyA kuvatIpekSA jAsta ojhe TAkata nAhI, je satkarma karIla tara tyAcA mobadalA tyAcyAsAThI Ahe ANi je vAITa karma karIla tara tyAce saMkaTa tyAcyAvaraca Ahe. he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! jara AmhI visaralo kiMvA AmacyAkaDUna cUka jhAlyAsa AmhAlA tyAcyAbaddala pakaDIta gheU nakosa, he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! AmacyAvara te ojhe TAkU nakosa je AmacyA pUrvIcyA lokAMvara TAkale hote. he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! AmacyAvara ase ojhe TAkU nakosa je ucalaNyAcI AmacyAta zaktI nasAvI ANi AmhAlA mApha kara, ANi AmhAlA mAphI pradAna kara ANi AmacyAvara dayA kara. tUca AmacA svAmI (mAlaka) Ahesa. AmhAlA kAphira (inkArI) janasamUhAvara vijaya pradAna kara.
alipha-lAma-mIma.
allAha to Ahe, jyAcyAzivAya koNIhI upAsanIya nAhI. to sadaiva jivaMta Ahe ANi sarvAMcA rakSaNakartA Ahe.
jyAne satyAsaha hA graMtha (kuraAna) avatarita kelA, jo ApalyA pUrvIcyA (avatarita dharmagraMthAM) cI satyatA siddha karato. ANi tyAneca (yApUrvIce dharmagraMtha) taurAta ANi iMjIla avatarita kele

yApUrvIcyA lokAMcyA mArgadarzanAsAThI, ANi kuraAnadekhIla tyAneca utaravile. je loka allAhacyA AyatIMcA inkAra karatAta, tyAMcyAsAThI moThA sakta (kaThora) az2Aba Ahe. ANi allAha jabaradasta Ahe ANi sUDa gheNArA.
niHsaMzaya, sarvazreSTha allAhapAsUna dharatI ANi AkAzAcI koNatIhI vastU lapalelI nAhI.
toca mAtecyA garbhAta tumacA ceharA-moharA, jase icchito banavito. tyAcyAzivAya koNIhI vastutaH upAsanA karaNyAyogya nAhI. to zaktI-sAmarthya bALagaNArA ANi hikamatazAlI Ahe.

toca allAha hoya, jyAne tumacyAvara graMtha avatarita kelA, jyAta spaSTa ANi Thosa AyatI Aheta, jo mULa graMtha Ahe ANi kAhI samAna AyatI Aheta. maga jyAMcyA manAta vakratA Ahe tara te samAna AyatIMcyA mAge paDatAta, phiturI mAjaviNyAkaritA ANi tyAcyA spaSTIkaraNAkaritA, paraMtu tyAMcyA khar2yA uddiSTAlA allAhazivAya koNIhI jANata nAhI. ANi paripUrNa va majabUta jJAna rAkhaNAre vidvAnadekhIla heca mhaNatAta kI AmhI tara tyAMcyAvara ImAna rAkhale Ahe. he sarva AmacyA pAlanakartyAtarphe Ahe, ANi bodha-upadeza tara kevaLa buddhimAna lokaca prApta karatAta.
he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! AmhAlA mArgadarzana kelyAnaMtara AmacyA manAta vAkaDepaNA yeU deU nakosa ANi AmhAlA ApalyA javaLUna dayA- meharabAnI pradAna kara. niHsaMzaya, tUca sarvAMta moThA dAtA Ahesa.
he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! nizcitaca tU eka divasa lokAMnA ekatra karaNAra Ahe, jyAcyA yeNyAviSayI kAhIca zaMkA nAhI. niHsaMzaya, sarvazreSTha allAha ApalyA vAyadyAvirUddha jAta nAhI.
inkArI lokAMnA tyAMcI dhana-daulata ANi tyAMcI saMtatI allAhacyA az2Aba (zikSA-yAtane) pAsUna soDivaNyAta kAhI kAmI yeU zakaNAra nAhI ANi he loka tara jahannamace iMdhana Ahetaca.

jyApramANe phiraaunacyA saMtatIcI durdazA jhAlI ANi tyAMcI, je tyAMcyApUrvI hoUna gele tyAMnI AmacyA AyatIMnA khoTe Tharavile, maga allAhane tyAMnA tyAMcyA aparAdhAbaddala pakaDIta ghetale ANi allAha moThI sakta (kaThora) zikSA deNArA Ahe.
kAphira lokAMnA (inkAra karaNAr2yAMnA) sAMgA kI tumhA lokAMnA nikaTa bhaviSyAta parAbhUta kele jAIla ANi tumhAlA jahannamakaDe jamA kele jAIla ANi kitI vAITa ThikANa Ahe te!

niHsaMzaya, tumacyAsAThI (bodhadAyaka) nizANI hotI, tyA dona samUhAMmadhye je ApasAta bhiDale hote. tyApaikI eka samUha allAhacyA mArgAta laDhata hotA ANi dusarA samUha kAphirAMcA (inkArI lokAMcA) hotA, jo tyAMnA ApalyA DoLyAMnI duppaTa jhAlele pAhAta hotA. ANi allAha jyAlA icchito, ApalyA madatIne majabUta (sAmarthyavAna) karato. niHsaMzaya, DoLe asaNAr2yAMkaritA yAta moThA bodha-upadeza Ahe.

AvaDatyA va manapasaMta goSTIMce prema lokAMsAThI suzobhita kele gele Ahe. udAharaNArtha, striyA ANi putra, sone-cAMdIce jamA kelele khajine, ANi nivaDaka nizANIce ghoDe ANi gure-Dhore va zetI vagaire. hI sarva aihika jIvanAcI sAmagrI Ahe ANi parataNyAce uttama ThikANatara allAhacyAca javaLa Ahe.

tumhI sAMgA, kAya mI tumhAlA yAhUna uttama azI goSTa sAMgU allAhace bhaya rAkhaNAr2yA lokAMkaritA, tyAMcyA pAlanakartyAjavaLa jannatI Aheta jyAMcyA khAlI pravAha vAhata Aheta. jyAta te nehamI nehamI rAhatIla, ANi pAka sApha (svaccha-zuddha) patnyA ANi sarvazreSTha allAhacI prasannatA Ahe ANi sarvacyA sarva dAsa allAhacyA najareta Aheta.
je ase mhaNatAta kI, he AmacyA pAlanartyA! AmhI ImAna rAkhale, yAstava AmacyA aparAdhAMnA kSamA kara ANi AmhAlA AgIcyA az2Aba (zikSA-yAtane) pAsUna vAcava.
je dhIra-saMyama rAkhaNAre, ANi sacce-prAmANika va AjJAdhAraka ANi allAhacyA mArgAta dhana kharca karaNAre Aheta ANi rAtrIcyA akheracyA bhAgAta (mokSa prAptIkaritA) kSamA-yAcanA karaNAre Ahe.

allAha, tyAce pharizte ANi jJAnI vidvAnAMnI sAkSa dilI Ahe kI allAhazivAya koNIhI mAbUda (upAsanA karaNyAyogya) nAhI, to nyAyAlA kAyama rAkhaNArA Ahe, toca jabaradasta hikamata rAkhaNArA Ahe. tyAcyAzivAya koNIhI upAsanA karaNyAsa yogya nAhI.

niHsaMzaya, allAhacyA javaLa dIna (dharma) kevaLa islAmaca Ahe. (allAhakaritA paripUrNa AtmasamarpaNa) ANi jyAMnA graMtha dilA gelA, tyAMnI jJAna yeUna pohocalyAnaMtara ApasAtIla dveSa-matsarAmuLe matabheda kelA ANi jo allAhacyA AyatIMnA (pavitra kuraAnAlA) na mAnela tara allAha lavakaraca hizoba gheIla.

jara te tumacyAzI bhAMDaNa-taMTA karatIla tara tumhI sAMgA kI mI ANi mAjhyA anuyAyIMnI svataHlA allAhakaritA samarpita kele ANi tumhI graMthadhAraka va azikSita lokAMnA sAMgA kI kAya tumhI islAmacA svIkAra kelA Ahe. jara te islAmacA svIkAra karatIla tara tyAMnI saraLa mArga prApta karUna ghetalA ANi jara toMDa phiravatIla tara tumacI jabAbadArI kevaLa (saMdeza) pohacaviNyAcI Ahe, ANi allAha ApalyA dAsAMnA svataHca pAhata Ahe.

niHsaMzaya, je loka allAhacyA AyatIMcA inkAra karatAta ANi allAhacyA paigaMbarAMcI nAhaka hatyA karatAta ANi je loka nyAyAcI goSTa bolatAta tyAMcIhI hatyA karatAta, tara (he paigaMbara!) tumhI tyAMnA phAra moThyA az2Aba (zikSA-yAtane) cI sUcanA dyA.
tyAMcI sarva satkarme yA jagAta ANi Akhiratamadhye vAyA gelIta. ANi tyAMcA koNIhI sahAyyaka (madata karaNArA) nAhI.

kAya tumhI nAhI pAhile jyAMnA graMthAcA eka bhAga dilA gelA Ahe te ApalyA ApasAtIla phaisalyAkaritA allAhacyA graMthAkaDe bolAvile jAtAta, tarIdekhIla tyAMcyAtalA eka samUha toMDa phiravUna parata jAto.
yAlA kAraNa tyAMce ase mhaNaNe Ahe kI tyAMnA kAhI mojakeca divasa Aga sparza karIla. yA tyAMcyA manAne racalelyA goSTIMnI tyAMnA tyAMcyA dIna (dharmA) bAbata dhokyAta TAkalele Ahe.

maga kAya avasthA hoIla, jevhA tyAMnA AmhI tyA divazI ekatrita karU jyA divasAcyA yeNyAviSayI kAhIca zaMkA nAhI ANi pratyeka mANasAlA ApalyA kRta-karmAcA purepUra mobadalA dilA jAIla ANi tyAMcyAvara atyAcAra kelA jANAra nAhI.

tumhI sAMgA, he allAha! he sAr2yA jagAcA svAmI! tU jyAlA icchito rAjya pradAna karato ANi jyAcyAkaDUna icchito rAjya hirAvUna gheto ANi tU jyAlA icchito mAna-pratiSThA pradAna karato ANi jyAlA icchito apamAnita karato. tujhyA hAtI sarva bhalAI Ahe. niHsaMzaya, tU pratyeka goSTIcA sAmarthya bALagato.

tUca rAtrIlA divasAta dAkhala karato ANi tUca divasAlA rAtrIta dAkhala karato. tUca nirjIvAtUna sajIvAlA nirmANa karato ANi sajIvAtUna nirjIva bAhera kADhato ANi to tUca Ahesa jo, jyAlA icchito agaNita va amaryAda rojI (AjivikA) pradAna karato.

ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMnI, ImAnadhArakAMnA soDUna kAphira lokAMnA (inkArI lokAMnA) ApalA mitra banavU naye ANi jo koNI ase karIla tara tyAlA allAhatarphe koNetahI samarthana nAhI. paraMtu he kI tyAcyA bhaya-dahazatImuLe ekhAdyA prakAracyA saMrakSaNAcA irAdA asela ANi sarvazreSTha allAha svataH tumhAlA Apale bhaya dAkhavita Ahe ANi (zevaTI) allAhakaDeca paratUna jAyace Ahe.

sAMgA, vATalyAsa tumhI ApalyA manAtIla goSTI lapavA kiMvA jAhIra karA allAha tyA sarva goSTI jANato. AkAzAMmadhye ANi dharatIvara je kAhI Ahe te sarva tyAlA mAhIta Ahe. allAha pratyeka goSTa karaNyAce sAmarthya rAkhato.

jyA divazI pratyeka manuSya ApalyA cAMgalyA-vAITa kRta-karmAlA hajara asalele (samakSa) pAhIla tevhA hI icchA karIla kI tyAcyA ANi aparAdhAcyA daramyAna khUpa dUrace aMtara asate tarI kitI cAMgale jhAle asate! allAha tumhAlA Apale bhaya rAkhaNyAcI tAkIda karato ANi allAha ApalyA dAsAMvara atizaya meharabAna va kRpAvAna Ahe.

tumhI sAMgA, jara tumhI sarvazreSTha allAhazI (sacce) prema rAkhata asAla tara mAjhyA mArgAce anusaraNa karA, allAha svataH tumacyAvara prema karIla ANi tumace aparAdha mApha karIla ANi sarvazreSTha allAha moThA mApha karaNArA dayA karaNArA Ahe.

tumhI sAMgA kI allAha ANi rasUla (paigaMbara sallallAhu alaihi vasallama) yAMce AjJApAlana karA. jara te toMDa phiravatIla tara niHsaMzaya, sarvazreSTha allAha kAphirAMnA (inkArI lokAMnA) dosta rAkhata nAhI.
niHsaMzaya, allAhane sarva lokAMmadhUna AdamalA ANi nUhalA ANi ibrAhImacyA gharANyAlA va imarAnacyA gharANyAlA nivaDUna ghetale.
kI he sarva ApasAta ekamekAMcI saMtAna Aheta ANi sarvazreSTha allAha sarva kAhI aikato ANi jANato.

jevhA imarAnacI patnI mhaNAlI, ‘‘he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! mAjhyA garbhAta je kAhI Ahe mI tyAlA tujhyA nAvAne mokaLe soDaNyAcA navasa mAnalA, tevhA tU yA navasAcA svIkAra kara. niHsaMzaya, tU cAMgalyAprakAre aikaNArA ANi jANaNArA Ahesa.’’

jevhA bALAlA janma dilA, tevhA mhaNU lAgalI, he mAjhyA pAlanahAra! malA tara mulagI jhAlI Ahe. allAha cAMgalyA prakAre jANato kI kAya janmAlA ghAtale Ahe ANi mulagA mulIsArakhA nAhI. mI tice nAva mariyama Thevale Ahe. mI tilA va ticyA saMtatIlA tiraskRta saitAnA (cyA upadravA) pAsUna tujhyA AzrayAkhAlI dete.

tilA ticyA pAlanakartyAne cAMgalyA prakAre svIkArale ANi tice sarvAMta uttama prakAre pAlanapoSaNa karavile, jakariyAlA ticA dekhabhAla karaNArA banavile. jevhA jevhA jakariyA mariyamacyA kholIta (upAsanA-kakSeta) jAta tevhA tyAMnA tyAMcyAjavaLa anna-sAmagrI ThevalelI ADhaLUna yeta ase. jakariyA vicArIta kI he mariyama! tumacyAjavaLa hI rojI (AjivikA) koThUna AlI? tI uttara deta ase kI he sarvazreSTha allAhacyA javaLUna Ahe. niHsaMzaya, allAha jyAlA icchito amaryAda rojI pradAna karato.
tyAca sthAnAvara jakariyA yAMnI ApalyA pAlanakartyAjavaLa duA- prArthanA kelI. mhaNAle kI he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! malA ApalyA javaLUna neka saMtAna pradAna kara. niHsaMzaya, tU duA aikaNArA Ahe.

maga phariztyAMnI hAka mAralI jevhA te ApalyA hujur2yAta ubhe rAhUna namAja paDhata hote, kI allAha tumhAlA yahiyA (nAvAcyA putrAcA) zubha samAcAra deto jo allAhacyA vacanA (kalimA) cI satyatA siddha karaNArA, janasamUhAcA pramukha, allAhace bhaya rAkhUna vAgaNArA ANi paigaMbara asela, neka va sadAcArI lokAMpaikI.
jakariyA mhaNU lAgale, he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! malA putra kasA bare hoIla? mI khUpa mhAtArA jhAlo Ahe ANi mAjhI patnI vAMjha Ahe. (pharizte) mhaNAle, azAca prakAre allAha je icchito karato.

jakariyA mhaNAle, he pAlanakartyA! mAjhyAsAThI ekhAdI nizANI de. pharmAvile, nizANI hI kI tIna divasaparyaMta tU lokAMzI bolU zakaNAra nAhIsa, kevaLa izAr2yAMnI samajAvazIla. tU ApalyA pAlanakartyAce jAstItajAsta smaraNa kara, ANi sakALa-saMdhyAkALa tyAcI mahAnatA varNana kara.
ANi jevhA pharizte mhaNAle, he mariyama! allAhane tujhI nivaDa kelI, ANi tulA pAka (svaccha-zuddha) kele ANi sarva jagAtIla striyAMmadhye tujhI nivaDa kelI.
he mariyama! tumhI ApalyA pAlanakartyAcyA AdezAMce pAlana karA ANi sajadA karA (allAhacyA puDhe mAthA TekA) ANi rukuu karaNAr2yAMsaha (jhukaNAr2yAMsobata) rukuu karA (jhukata jA).

yA g2aiba (aparokSa) cyA bAtamyA Aheta, jyA AmhI tumhAlA vahayI karIta Ahota. tevhA tumhI tyA veLI tyAMcyAjavaLa navhate, jevhA te Apale kalama (lekhaNI) TAkU lAgale hote kI tyAMcyApaikI mariyamace pAlanapoSaNa koNa karIla? ANi nA tumhI tyAMcyA bhAMDaNaprasaMgI tyAMcyAjavaLa hote.

jevhA pharizte mhaNAle, he mariyama! allAha tumhAlA ApalyA ekA kalimA cA zubha samAcAra deto jyAce nAva mariyamacA putra masIha IsA Ahe, jo yA jagAta ANi maraNottara jIvanAta sanmAnita Ahe ANi to mAjhyA nikaTa dAsAMpaikI Ahe.
to lokAMzI pALaNyAta (asatAnAhI) saMbhASaNa karIla ANi moThyA vayAtahI ANi to neka sadAcArI lokAMpaikI asela.

mariyama mhaNAlI, ‘‘he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! malA mulagA kasA bare hoIla? vAstavika malA adyApa koNA puruSAne sparzahI kelelA nAhI.’’ pharizte mhaNAle, ‘‘azA prakAre allAha je icchito nirmANa karato. allAha jevhA ekhAde kArya karU icchito tevhA phakta evaDheca mhaNato- ‘hoUna jA’ ANi te ghaDUna yete.’’
ANi sarvazreSTha allAha tyAlA lihiNe ANi buddhimAnatA ANi taurAta va iMjIla zikavIla.

ANi to isrAIlacyA saMtatIcA rasUla (paigaMbara) asela kI mI tumacyAjavaLa tumacyA pAlanakartyAcI nizANI ANalI Ahe, mI tumacyAsAThI pakSyAcyA rUpAsArakhIca mAtIcI eka cimaNI banavito, maga ticyAta phuMkara mArato tara tI allAhacyA hukumAne (jivaMta) pakSI banate ANi mI allAhacyA hukumAne janmajAta AMdhaLyAlA ANi koDhI isamAlA cAMgale karato, ANi melelyAlA jivaMta karato ANi je kAhI tumhI khAUna yetA ANi je kAhI tumhI ApalyA gharAMmadhye jamA karatA mI te tumhAlA sAMgato. yAta tumacyAsAThI moThI nizANI Ahe, jara tumhI ImAna rAkhaNAre asAla!

ANi mI taurAtacI satyatA sAbIta karaNArA Ahe, jo mAjhyAsamora Ahe ANi mI azAsAThI Alo Ahe kI tumacyAsAThI tyA kAhI vastUMnA halAla (vaidha) karAve, jyA tumacyAsAThI harAma (avaidha) kelyA gelyA Aheta. ANi mI tumacyAjavaLa tumacyA pAlanakartyAcI nizANI gheUna Alo Ahe yAstava tumhI allAhace bhaya rAkhA ANi mAjhyA mArgAce anusaraNa karA.
niHsaMzaya, mAjhA ANi tumacA pAlanahAra allAhaca Ahe, tumhI sarva tyAcIca upAsanA karA. hAca saraLa mArga Ahe.

paraMtu jevhA (hajarata) IsA yAMnA, tyA lokAMcA inkAra jANavalA tevhA mhaNU lAgale, ‘‘allAhacyA mArgAta mAjhI madata karaNArA koNa-koNa Ahe?’’ havArIMnI uttara dile kI AmhI Ahota allAhacyA mArgAta madatanIsa. AmhI allAhavara ImAna rAkhale ANi tumhI sAkSI rAhA kI AmhI muslima Ahota.
he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! AmhI tU avatarita kelelyA (saMdezA) vara ImAna rAkhale ANi AmhI tujhyA rasUla (paigaMbarA) cA mArga patkaralA, tevhA AtA tU AmhAlA satyAcI sAkSa deNAr2yAMmadhye lihUna ghe.
ANi inkAra karaNAr2yAMnI SaG‌yaMtra racale ANi allAhanedekhIla yojanA banavilI ANi sarvazreSTha allAha sarva yojanA AkhaNAr2yAMpekSA uttama Ahe.

jevhA allAhane phamArvile, ‘‘he IsA! mI tumhAlA pUrNataH gheNAra Ahe ANi tumhAlA ApalyAkaDe ucalUna gheNAra Ahe ANi tumhAlA inkArI lokAMpAsUna mukta rAkhaNAra Ahe ANi kayAmatacyA divasAparyaMta tumacyA anuyAyIMnA inkArI lokAMvara zreSThatama rAkhaNAra Ahe.’’ maga tumhI sarvAMnA mAjhyAkaDeca paratAvayAce Ahe, mIca tumacyA daramyAna samasta matabhedAMcA phaisalA karIna.
maga inkAra karaNAr2yAMnA tara mI yA jagAta ANi Akhiratamadhye atizaya sakta az2Aba (kaThora zikSA-yAtanA) deIna ANi tyAMnA koNI madata karaNArAhI nasela.
paraMtu ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMnA ANi satkarma karaNAr2yAMnA allAha purepUra mobadalA pradAna karIla ANi allAha, atyAcArI lokAMzI prema rAkhata nAhI.
he je AmhI tumhAlA vAcUna aikivata Ahota, AyatI Aheta ANi bodha-patra Ahe (hikamatIne pUrNa asA saMdeza Ahe.)
allAhajavaLa IsAce udAharaNa AdamasArakhe Ahe, jyAlA mAtIdvAra nirmANa karUna pharmAvile, ‘‘hoUna jA’’ basa to ghaDUna AlA.
tumacyA pAlanakartyAtarphe satya heca Ahe, khabaradAra! zaMkA-saMvazaya dharaNAr2yAMpaikI hoU nakA.

yAstava jo koNI, tumacyAjavaLa he jJAna yeUna pohocalyAnaMtarahI tumacyAzI yAbAbata vAda ghAlIla tara tumhI sAMgA kI yA AmhI ANi tumhI ApApalyA putrAMnA ANi AmhI va tumhI ApApalyA patnIMnA ANi AmhI va tumhI svataH ApalyAlA bolAvUna gheU, maga AmhI sarva miLUna duA (prArthanA) karU yA ANi khoTyA lokAMvara allAhacA dhiHkkAra pAThavU yA.
niHsaMzaya, heca satya nivedana Ahe ANi allAhazivAya dusarA koNIhI upAsanA karaNyAsa yogya nAhI ANi niHsaMzaya, allAha moThA zaktizAlI ANi hikamatazAlI Ahe.
tarIhI jara te mAnya na karatIla tara allAhadekhIla vidroha (baMDa) karaNAr2yAMnA cAMgalyA prakAre jANaNArA Ahe.

tumhI sAMgA kI, ‘‘he graMtha bALagaNAr2yA lokAMno! azA nyAyapUrNa goSTIkaDe yA jI AmacyA va tumacyA daramyAna samAna Ahe kI AmhI allAhazivAya anya koNAcIhI upAsanA karU naye ANi nA allAhasobata dusar2yA koNAlA sahabhAgI karAve nA allAhalA soDUna ApasAta ekamekAlA raba (pAlanahAra) banavUna ghyAve.’’ jara te toMDa phiravatIla tara sAMgA kI sAkSI rAhA kI AmhI tara muslima Ahota.
he graMthadhArakAMno! tumhI ibrAhImacyA bAbatIta kA vAda ghAlatA? vAstavika taurAta ANi iMjIla (he graMtha) tara tyAMcyAnaMtara avatarita kele gele. maga kAya tumhI tarIhI samajata nAhIta?
aikA! tumhI loka AtA yA goSTIbAbata vAda ghAlUna cukalAta, jice tumhAlA jJAna hote. AtA yA goSTIbAbata kA jhagaDatA, jice tumhAlA ajibAta jJAna nAhI? ANi allAha sarvakAhI jANato, tumhI nAhI jANata.
ibrAhIma nA tara yahUdI hote, nA khrizcana, kiMbahunA te tara pUrNapaNe muslima hote. te mUrtipUjakahI navhate.
sarva lokAMpekSA jAsta ibrAhImacyA nikaTa te loka Aheta jyAMnI tyAMce mhaNaNe mAnya kele ANi he paigaMbara ANi te loka jyAMnI ImAna rAkhale, ImAnadhArakAMcA mitra ANi madatakartA allAha Ahe.
graMthadhArakAMcI eka ToLI ase icchite kI tumhAlA (satya mArgApAsUna) vicalita karAve. vAstavika te svataHca svataHlA bhaTakAvita Aheta ANi samajata nAhIta.
he graMthadhArakAMno! tumhI svataH sAkSI asatAnAhI allAhacyA AyatIMnA kA mAnata nAhIta?
he graMthadhArakAMno! jANUna ghetalyAnaMtarahI satya ANi asatyAce mizraNa kA karatA, ANi satya kA lapavitA?

ANi graMthadhArakAMcA eka samUha mhaNAlA kI je kAhI ImAnadhArakAMvara utaravile gele Ahe, tyAvara divasAcyA suruvAtIlA ImAna rAkhA ANi saMdhyAkALa hotAca inkAra karA, yAsAThI kI yA lokAMnIhI parata phirAve.

(te asehI mhaNatAta) ANi tumacyA dIna-dharmAvara cAlaNAr2yAMzivAya ANakhI koNAvarahI vizvAsa ThevU nakA. tumhI sAMgA, niHsaMzaya, mArgadarzana tara allAhaceca mArgadarzana Ahe (ANi asehI mhaNatAta kI yA goSTIvarahI vizvAsa ThevU nakA) kI koNAlA tyAsArakhe dile jAve, jase tumhAlA dile gele Ahe kiMvA he kI he tumacyAzI tumacyA pAlanakartyAjavaLa vAda ghAlatIla. tumhI sAMgA kI phaj़la (zreSThatA) tara allAhacyA hAtI Ahe. to jyAlA icchito pradAna karato. allAha atizaya mahAna ANi sarva kAhI jANaNArA Ahe.
tI ApalyA dayA-kRpene jyAlA icchito khAsa karUna gheto, ANi allAha moThA kRpAzIla ANi atizaya mahAna Ahe.

ANi kAhI graMthadhAraka asehI Aheta kI tumhI tyAMnA khajInyAce vizvasta banavAla tarIhI tumhAlA parata karatIla ANi tyAMcyApaikI kAhI asehI Aheta kI jara tumhI tyAMnA eka dinArahI Theva mhaNUna dyAla tara joparyaMta tumhI tyAMcyA DokyAvara ubhe na rAhAla toparyaMta tumhAlA parata karaNAra nAhIta. he azAsAThI kI tyAMnI sAMgUna Thevale Ahe kI yA azikSitAMcA hakka mAraNyAta AmacyAvara kAhIca gunhA nAhI. he loka jANUna ghetalyAnaMtarahI allAhacyA saMbaMdhAne khoTe bolatAta.
kA nAhI (pakaDa hoIla) paraMtu jo manuSya ApalA phAyadA pUrNa karIla ANi allAhace bhaya rAkhIla tara allAha azA bhaya rAkhaNAr2yAMnA ApalA dosta rAkhato.

niHsaMzaya, je loka allAhazI kelelA vacana-karAra ANi ApalyA zapathAMnA thoDyAzA kiMmatIvara vikUna TAkatAta tyAMcyAsAThI Akhiratamadhye kAhIca hissA nAhI. sarvazreSTha allAha nA tara tyAMcyAzI saMbhASaNa karIla, nA kiyAmatacyA divazI tyAMcyAkaDe pAhIla, nA tyAMnA pAka (pavitra) karIla, ANi tyAMcyAsAThI moThA duHkhadAyaka az2Aba (zikSA-yAtanA) Ahe.

nizcitaca tyAMcyAta eka samUha asAhI Ahe jo graMthAce vAcana karatAnA ApalyA jIbhelA moDa deto, yAsAThI kI tumhI tyAlA graMthAtalAca majakUra samajAve. vAstavika to graMthAtalA majakUra nAhI ANi te asehI mhaNatAta kI te allAhatarphe Ahe, vAstavika te allAhatarphe nAhI. te jANUnabujUna allAhacyA saMbaMdhAne khoTe bolatAta.

jyAlA allAhane graMtha, hikamata (buddhimAnatA) ANi preSitva pradAna karAve azA ekhAdyA mANasAkaritA he ucita navhe kI tarIhI tyAne lokAMnA sAMgAve kI allAhalA soDUna mAjhe dAsa (upAsaka) banA, kiMbahunA to tara aseca mhaNela kI tumhI sarva loka ‘raba’ (pAlanakartyA) ce vhA jyAarthI tumhI graMtha zikavitA ANi tyAcA pAThadekhIla detA.
ANi to tumhAlA hA Adeza nAhI deNAra kI phariztyAMnA ANi paigaMbarAMnA Apale ArAdhya daivata banavUna ghyA, kAya AjJAdhAraka jhAlyAnaMtara to tumhAlA avajJAkArI banaNyAcA Adeza deIla?

ANi jevhA allAhane paigaMbarAMkaDUna vacana ghetale kI je kAhI mI tumhAlA graMtha ANi hikamata deIna, maga tumacyAjavaLa to rasUla (paigaMbara) yeIla jo tumacyAjavaLa asalelyA graMthAcI satyatA darzavIla tara tyAcyAvara ImAna rAkhaNe va tyAcI madata karaNe tumacyAvara baMdhanakAraka Ahe. pharmAvile kI tumhI kAya he kabUla karatA ANi tyAvara mAjhI jabAbadArI ghetA? sarva mhaNAle, AmhAlA mAnya Ahe. pharmAvile, tara sAkSI rAhA ANi mI svataHdekhIla tumacyAsobata sAkSI Ahe.
AtA yAnaMtarahI jo parata phirela, to nizcitaca avajJAkArI Ahe.

kAya te allAhacyA dIna-dharmAlA soDUna dusar2yA ekhAdyA dIna-dharmAcyA zodhAta Aheta? vAstavika AkAzAMmadhye va dharatIvara vAstavya karaNAre sarvacyA sarva allAhace AjJAdhAraka Aheta. maga rAjIkhuzIne aso kiMvA lAcAra hoUna, sarvAMnA tyAcyAcakaDe paratavile jAIla.

tumhI sAMgA, ‘‘AmhI allAhavara ANi je kAhI AmacyAvara utaravile gele Ahe ANi je ibrAhIma ANi ismAIla ANi yAkUba ANi tyAMcyA saMtatIvara utaravile gele ANI je kAhI musA ANI IsA ANi itara paigabarAMnA allahAcyA tarphe pradAna kele gele tyA sarvAMvara ImAna ( vizvAsa) rAkhalee,AmhI tyAMcyApaikI koNAcyAhI daramyAna pharaka karIta nAhI ANi AmhI sarvazreSTha allAhace AjJadhAraka Ahota.’’
ANi jo koNI islAmaaivajI anya ekhAdyA dIna-dharmAcA zodha karIla tyAcA to dIna-dharma kabUla kelA jANAra nAhI ANi to Akhiratamadhye toTA ucalaNAr2yAMpaikI rAhIla.

allAha kazAprakAre tyA lokAMnA mArgadarzana karIla, je svataH ImAna rAkhalyAnaMtara, paigaMbarAMcI satyatA jANaNyAcI sAkSa dilyAnaMtara ANi ApalyA svataHjavaLa spaSTa nizANI yeUna pohocalyAnaMtarahI inkArI vhAveta. allAha azA atyAcArIMnA saraLa mArga dAkhavita nAhI.
tyAMcI zikSA hI kI, tyAMcyAvara allAhacA dhiHkkAra Ahe ANi phariztyAMcA va samasta lokAMtarphehI dhiHkkAra Ahe.
te sadaiva tyAta rAhatIla nA tyAMcI sajA halakI (saumya) kelI jAIla ANi nA tyAMnA kasalI sUTa dilI jAIla.
paraMtu je loka yAnaMtara taubA (kSamA-yAcanA) karUna (ApalyA AcaraNAta) sudhAra karUna ghetalI tara niHsaMzaya, allAha moThA mApha karaNArA, meharabAna Ahe.

niHsaMzaya, je loka svataH ImAna rAkhalyAnaMtara kupra (inkAra) karatIla maga inkAra karaNyAta adhika puDhe jAtIla tara tyAMcI taubA (kSamA-yAcanA) kadhIhI kabUla kelI jANAra nAhI ANi heca loka mArgabhraSTa Aheta.

niHsaMzaya, je loka kAphira (inkArI, avizvAsI) asatIla, ANi mareparyaMta kAphira rAhatIla, tyAMcyApaikI jara koNI az2AbapAsUna suTakA miLaviNyAsAThI daMDa (phidiyA) mhaNUna jaminIitake sone deIla, tarIhI te kadhIhI svIkArale jANAra nAhI. azAca lokAMkaritA sakta az2Aba (atizaya kaThora zikSA-yAtanA) Ahe ANi tyAMcA koNI madatakartA nAhI.

joparyaMta tumhI ApalyA AvaDatyA va priya dhana-saMpattItUna allAhacyA mArgAta kharca na karAla, toparyaMta tumhAlA bhalAI lAbhaNAra nAhI, ANi je kAhI tumhI kharca karAla, allAha te cAMgalyA prakAre jANato.

taurAta (hA graMtha) utaraNyApUrvIca (hajarata) yAkUba yAMnI jyA vastUlA svataHsAThI harAma karUna ghetale hote, tyAcyAvyatirikta sarva khAdyavastU isrAIlacyA saMtatIkaritA halAla hotyA. (he paigaMbara!) tumhI tyAMnA sAMgA kI tumhI sacce asAla tara taurAta ANA, ANi vAcUna aikavA.
tarIhI je loka sarvazreSTha allAhavara khoTA Aropa lAvatIla tara ase loka atyAcArI Aheta.
tumhI sAMgA kI allAha ApalyA kathanAta saccA Ahe. tumhI sarva ibrAhImacyA janasamUhAcyA mArgAce anusaraNa karA, je mUrtipUjaka navhate.
niHsaMzaya, (sarvazreSTha allAhace) pahile ghara, je lokAMsAThI banavile gele, teca Ahe, je makkA yethe Ahe, je sAr2yA jagAkaritA zubha- maMgalaprada ANi mArgadarzaka Ahe.

jyAta spaSTa nizANyA Aheta. ‘mukAme ibrAhIma’ (eka dagaDa Ahe, jyAvara kAbAgRhAce bAMdhakAma karatAnA hajarata ibrAhIma ubhe rAhAta) ithe jo koNI dAkhala jhAlA, tyAlA zAMtI lAbhalI. allAhane tyA lokAMvara, je yA gharAparyaMta yeNyAce sAmarthya rAkhatAta, yA gharAce hajja Avazyaka Tharavile Ahe ANi jo koNI inkAra karIla tara sarvazreSTha allAhalA sarva jagAcyA lokAMcI kAhI parvA nAhI.
tumhI tyAMnA sAMgA, he graMthadhArakAMno! tumhI allAhacyA AyatIMcA inkAra kA karatA? ANi tumhI je kAhI karatA, allAha tyAvara sAkSI Ahe.

tyA graMthadhArakAMnA sAMgA kI tumhI allAhacyA mArgA (dharmA) pAsUna tyA lokAMnA kA rokhatA, jyAMnI ImAna rAkhale Ahe, ANi tyAta vAITapaNA zodhatA, vAstavika tumhI svataH sAkSI AhAta ANi allAha tumacyA karmAMzI anabhijJa nAhI.
he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! jara tumhI graMthadhArakAMcyA ekhAdyA samUhAce mhaNaNe aikAla tara tumhI ImAna rAkhalyAnaMtarahI to tumhAlA inkAra (kupra) kaDe phiravIla.

ANi (arthAta he kAraNa Ahe) tumhI kazA prakAre inkAra karU zakatA, vAstavika tumhAlA allAhacyA AyatI vAcUna aikavilyA jAtAta, ANi tumacyA daramyAna paigaMbara (sallallAhu alaihi vasallama) hajara Aheta, ANi jo allAhacyA dIna-dharmAlA majabUtapaNe dharela tara niHsaMzaya tyAlA saraLamArga dAkhavilA gelA Ahe.
he ImAnadhArakAMno! allAhace evaDhe bhaya rAkhA, jevaDhe tyAce bhaya rAkhale pAhije ANi pAhA mareparyaMta ImAnadhArakaca rAhA.

ANi allAhacA dora sarvAMnI miLUna majabUtapaNe dharUna ThevA, ANi ApasAta gaTabAjI karU nakA ANi allAhacI tyA veLIcI nemata AThavA jevhA tumhI ApasAta ekamekAMce zatrU hote. allAhane tumacyA hRdayAta prema nirmANa kele ANi tumhI tyAcyA kRpA deNagIne bAMdhava jhAle ANi tumhI AgIcyA khaDyAcyA kinAr2yAparyaMta pohocale hote tevhA allAhane tumhAlA vAcavile. sarvazreSTha allAha azA prakAre ApalyA AyatIMce nivedana karato yAsAThI kI tumhI mArgadarzana prApta karU zakAve.
ANi tumacyApaikI eka samUha asA asalA pAhije, jyAne bhalyA kAmAMkaDe bolavAve Ami satkarmAMcA Adeza dyAvA ANi vAITa kAmAMpAsUna rokhAve ANi heca loka saphala hoNAre Aheta.
ANi tumhI tyA lokAMsArakhe hoU nakA, jyAMnI ApalyAjavaLa spaSTa pramANa yeUna pohocalyAnaMtara hI phUTa pADalI va matabheda karU lAgale, azA lokAMsAThI sakta sajA-yAtanA Ahe.

tyA divazI kAhI cehare sapheda (tejasvI) asatIla ANi kAhI cehare kALe asatIla. kALyA cehar2yAMcyA lokAMnA sAMgitale jAIla kI tumhI ImAna rAkhalyAnaMtara kupra (inkAra, avizvAsa) kA kelA? AtA ApalyA inkAra karaNyAcI sajA cAkhA.
ANi sapheda (tejasvI) cehar2yAMce loka allAhacyA dayeta (kRpAchatrAkhAlI) asatIla ANi tyAta nehamI nehamI rAhatIla.
(he paigaMbara!) AmhI yA satya AyatI tumhAlA vAcUna aikavita Ahota, ANi lokAMvara julUma atyAcAra karaNyAcA, allAhacA irAdA nAhI.
ANi je kAhI AkAzAMmadhye va dharatIvara Ahe te sarva allAhaceca Ahe. allAhacyAkaDeca sarva kAmAMnA rujU vhAyace Ahe.

tumacA janasamUha, sarvottama janasamUha Ahe, jo lokAMsAThI nirmANa kelA gelA Ahe, kAraNa tumhI satkarmAMcA Adeza detA ANi duSkarmAMpAsUna rokhatA ANi allAhavara ImAna rAkhatA. jara graMthadhArakAMnIhI ImAna rAkhale asate tara tyAMcyAsAThI phAra cAMgale jhAle asate. tyAta kAhI ImAna bALagaNArehI Aheta paraMtu adhikAMza loka durAcArI Aheta.
ase loka tumhAlA satAviNyAkherIja ANakhI jAsta kAhI nukasAna pohacavU zakata nAhIta ANi jara tumacyAzI laDhAI jhAlI tara pATha dAkhavUna paLa kADhatIla. maga koNI tyAMcI madata karAyalA yeNAra nAhI.

ase loka pratyeka ThikANI apamAnita hota rAhatIla, tathApi allAhacyA kiMvA lokAMcyA AzrayAkhAlI asatIla tara goSTa vegaLI. mAtra he loka allAhacyA prakopAsa pAtra Tharale ANi tyAMcyAvara dAridyra ANi durdazA TAkalI gelI. he azAsAThI jhAle kI he loka allAhacyA AyAtIMcA inkAra karIta hote, ANi paigaMbarAMcI nAhaka hatyA karIta hote. hA mobadalA tyAMcyA AjJAbhaMgAcA ANi maryAdA pAra karaNyAcA Ahe.

he sarvacyA sarva ekasamAna nAhIta, kiMbahunA yA graMthadhArakAMta eka samUha (satyAvara) kAyamahI Ahe, je rAtrI allAhacyA AyatIMce paThaNa karatAta va sajadA (allAhasamora mAthA Tekata) karIta asatAta.
he loka allAha ANi kayAmatacyA divasAvara ImAna rAkhatAta, satkarmAMcA Adeza detAta ANi duSkarmAMpAsUna rokhatAta ANi bhalyA kAmAMmadhye ghAI karatAta. he neka va sadAcArI lokAMpaikI Aheta.
ANi he je kAhI nekIce kAma karatIla, tyAcI upekSA kelI jANAra nAhI ANi sarvazreSTha allAha, parahejagAra (allAhace bhaya rAkhUna vAgaNAr2yA) lokAMnA cAMgalyA prakAre jANato.
niHsaMzaya, inkArI lokAMnA tyAMcI dhana-saMpattI ANi tyAMcI saMtatI allAhacyA ithe kAhIca upayogI paDaNAra nAhI. he tara jahannamI (narakavAsI) Aheta, jyAta te nehamI paDUna rAhatIla.

te je kAhI yA aihika jIvanAta kharca karatAta, te tyA vAdaLAsArakhe Ahe, jyAta kaDAkyAcI thaMDI asAvI, je ekhAdyA julamI janasamUhAcyA zetAvarUna jAve ANi tyAcA sarvanAza karUna TAkAvA allAhane tyAMcyAvara atyAcAra nAhI kelA, ulaTa te svataH ApalyA prANAMvara atyAcAra karIta hote.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! tumhI ApalA jIvalaga mitra ImAnadhArakAMzivAya dusar2yA koNAlA banavU nakA (tumhI nAhI pAhata dusare loka tara) tumacA sarvanAza karaNyAta kAhIca kasara bAkI Thevata nAhI. te tara ase icchitAta kI tumhI duHkhAtaca paDUna rAhAve. tyAMcI zatrUtA tara svataH tyAMcyA toMDUna ughaDa jhAlI Ahe ANi tyAMcyA manAta je kAhI Ahe te tara ANakhI jAsta Ahe. AmhI ApalyA AyatI tumhAlA spaSTa karUna sAMgitalyA tumhI akkalavAna asAla (tara kALajI ghyA)

tumhI tara ase AhAta kI tyAMcyAzI prema rAkhatA, paNa te tumacyAzI prema rAkhata nAhIta, tumhI allAhacA saMpUrNa graMtha mAnUna ghetA ANi (te nAhI mAnata, tara maga prema kase?) he tumacyAsamora tara Apale ImAna kabUla karatAta, paraMtu jevhA ekaTe asatAta tevhA rAgAne ApalyA boTAMcA cAvA ghetAta. tyAMnA sAMgA, marAla aseca rAgAcyA bharAta! sarvazreSTha allAha manAtalyA supta goSTIhI cAMgalyA prakAre jANato.

jara tumhAlA ekhAdI bhalAI lAbhate tara tyAMnA moThe vAIca vATate, mAtra jevhA duHkha yAtanA pohacate tevhA mAtra khUpa AnaMdita hotAta. jara tumhI saburI (dhIra-saMyama) rAkhAlA ANi svataHlA durAcArApAsUna dUra Thevata rAhAla tara tyAMcI kUTanItI tumhAlA kAhIca nukasAna pohacaviNAra nAhI, sarvazreSTha allAhane tyAMcyA kAravAyAMnA gherA TAkalA Ahe.

(he paigaMbara! tyA veLece smaraNa karA) jevhA sakALI sakALI tumhI ApalyA gharAbAhera paDUna ImAnadhArakAMnA laDhAIcyA morcAvara ThAva ThikANa dAkhavUna basavita hote ANi allAha sarvakAhI aikaNArA va jANaNArA Ahe.
jevhA tumacyAtalyA dona gaTAMce pAya DagamagU lAgale, jevhA allAha tyA doghAMcA madata karaNArA hajara hotA ANi tyAca allAhavara ImAnadhArakAMnI bharosA rAkhalA pAhije.
ANi allAhane badracyA yuddhAta tumacI azA veLI madata kelI, jevhA tumhI khUpa halAkhIcyA avastheta hote, yAstava allAhace bhaya rAkhA, yAsAThI kI tumhI kRtajJazIla vhAve.
jevhA tumhI ImAnadhArakAMnA dhIra deta hote, kAya tumacyAsAThI he purese nAhI kI allAhane tIna hajAra pharizte utaravUna tumacI madata karAvI.

kA nAhI? jara tumhI dhIra-saMyama ANi durAcArApAsUna aliptatA patkarAla ANi tyAca kSaNI he loka tumacyAjavaLa AlyAsa, tumacA pAlanakartA, pAca hajAra phariztyAMdvAre tumacI madata karela, je nizANI asalele asatIla.
ANi AmhI yAlA tumacyAsAThI phakta zubha-samAcAra ANi tumacyA manAcyA samAdhAnAkaritA banavile, anyathA madata tara varcasvazAlI, hikamatazAlI allAhakaDUnaca asate.
(allAhacyA yA madatIcA uddeza hA hotA kI, allAhane) inkArI lokAMcA eka gaTa kApUna TAkAvA kiMvA tyAMnA apamAnita karUna TAkAve ANi maga tyAMnI asaphala hoUna parata phirAve.
(he paigaMbara!) tumacyA akhatyArIta kAhI eka nAhI allAha icchila tara tyAMcI taubA (kSamA-yAcanA) kabUla karIla kiMvA tyAMnA sajA deIla, kAraNa te atyAcArI loka Aheta.
AkAzAMmadhye ANi dharatIvara je kAhI Ahe, sarva allAhaceca Ahe, to jyAlA icchila mApha karIla ANi jyAlA icchila az2Aba (zikSa-yAtanA) deIla ANi allAha mApha karaNArA, dayA karaNArA Ahe.
he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! duppaTa, tippaTa karUna vyAja khAU nakA, ANi allAhace bhaya bALagA, yAsAThI kI tumhAlA saphalatA lAbhAvI.
ANi tyA AgIce bhaya rAkhA, jI kAphirAMsAThI tayAra kelI gelI Ahe.
ANi allAha ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAMcyA AdezAMce pAlana karA, yAsAThI kI tumacyAvara meharabAnI kelI jAvI.
ANi ApalyA pAlanakartyAcyA mAphIkaDe ANi tyA jannatakaDe dhAva ghyA, jicA vistAra AkAzAMcyA va jaminIcyA itakA Ahe, jI durAcArApAsUna dUra rAhaNAr2yAMkaritA tayAra kelI gelI Ahe.

je loka susaMpanna avastheta ANi taMgI-aDacaNIcyA avasthetahI (allAhacyA mArgAta) kharca karatAta, rAga giLUna TAkatAta ANi lokAMce aparAdha mApha karatAta, allAha azA neka sadAcArI lokAMnA dosta rAkhato.

jevhA tyAMcyAkaDUna ekhAde vAITa kRtya ghaDate kiMvA te ekhAdA aparAdha karUna basatAta, tevhA tvarIta allAhace smaraNa ANi ApalyA aparAdhaAMcI mAphI mAgatAta ANi vAstavika allAhazivAya aparAdha mApha karaNArA dusarA koNa Ahe? ANi te jANUnabujUna ApalyA kRta-karmAvara aDUna basata nAhIta.
tyAMcA mobadalA tyAMcyA pAlanakartyAtarphe mAphI ANi jannata Ahe, jicyAkhAlI naharI (pravAha) vAhata Aheta, jyAta te nehamI rAhatIla, ANi neka-sadAcArI lokAMcA hA kitI cAMgalA mobadalA Ahe!
tumacyA pUrvIpAsUna niyama cAlata AlA Ahe. tumhI jaminIvara hiMDUna phirUna pAhA kI, jyAMnI allAhacyA AyatIMcA inkAra kelA, tyAMcA kazA prakAre zevaTa jhAlA.
lokAMkaritA he eka pharmAna (nivedana(Adeza)) Ahe ANi allAhace bhaya rAkhUna AcaraNa karaNAr2yAMkaritA mArgadarzana ANi upadeza Ahe.
tumhI hatAza hoU nakA ANi duHkhI-kaSTI hoU nakA. tumhI (kharokhara) ImAna rAkhaNAre asAla tara tumhI vijayI vhAla.

(yA yuddhAta) jara tumhI jakhamI jhAle asAla tara tedekhIla (badracyA yuddhaAta) azA prakAre jakhamI jhAle Aheta ANi yA divasAMnA AmhI lokAMcyA daramyAna alaTata-pAlaTata rAhato, yAsAThI kI allAhane ImAnadhArakAMnA (vegaLe karUna) pAhAve, ANi tumacyApaikI kAhIMnA zahIda banavAve, ANi allAha atyAcArI lokAMzI prema rAkhata nAhI.
ANi yAsAThI kI, allAhane ImAnadhArakAMnA alaga karUna ghyAve, ANi kAphirAMcA (inkArI lokAMcA) sarvanAza karUna TAkAvA.
kAya tumhI he gRhita dharale Ahe kI jannatamadhye dAkhala hoUna jAla, vAstavika allAhane ajUna he pAhile nAhI kI tumacyApaikI koNa jihAda (dharmayuddha) karatAta ANi koNa dhIra-saMyama rAkhatAta.
ANi tumhI yApUrvI maraNAcI icchA dharata hote, AtA tara tumhI mRtyulA ApalyA DoLyAMnI pAhUna ghetale.

ANi muhammada tara kevaLa eka rasUla (paigaMbara) Aheta. yApUrvI aneka rasUla hoUna geleta, maga jara te maraNa pAvatIla kiMvA jIve mArale jAtIla, tara kAya tumhI (islAmakaDe pATha phiravUna) ulaTa pAvalI parata phirAla? ANi jo koNI ulaTa pAvalI parata phirela to allAhalA kasalehI nukasAna pohacavU zakaNAra nAhI ANi allAha kRtajJazIla lokAMnA phAra lavakara mobadalA pradAna karela.

ANi sarvazreSTha allAhacyA hukUmAvinA koNatAhI jIva marU zakata nAhI, TharalelI veLa likhita Ahe. yA jagAzI prema rAkhaNAr2yAMnA AmhI thoDese yA jagAtaca deUna TAkato ANi Akhiratace puNya prApta karU icchiNAr2yAMnA AmhI tedekhIla pradAna karato ANi AbhAra mAnaNAr2yAMnA AmhI lavakaraca cAMgalA mobadalA pradAna karU.

ANi aneka paigaMbarAMcyA sobata(rAhUna)aneka allAhavAlyAMnI jihAda (dharmayuddha) kele Ahe. tyAMnAhI allAhacyA mArgAta duHkha-yAtanA pohacalyA, paraMtu nA tara tyAMnI dhairya soDale, nA kamajora paDale ANi nA prabhAvita (dabale gele) jhAle ANi allAha dhIra-saMyama rAkhaNAr2yAMzI prema rAkhato.

ANi te heca mhaNata rAhile kI, he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! AmacyA aparAdhAMnA mApha kara ANi jara AmacyAkaDUna AmacyA kAmAMmadhye nAhaka kAhI julUma-atireka jhAlA asela tara tohI mApha kara ANi AmhAlA majabUtI pradAna kara ANi AmhAlA inkArI lokAMcyA janasamUhAcyA virodhAta sahAyatA pradAna kara.
ANi sarvazreSTha allAhane tyAMnA yA jagAcAhI mobadalA pradAna kelA ANi AkhiratacyA puNyAcI vizeSatAhI pradAna kelI, ANi sarvazreSTha allAha satkarma karaNAr2yAMnA ApalA dosta rAkhato.
he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! jara tumhI inkArI lokAMce mhaNaNe mAnAla tara te tumhAlA ulaTa pAvalI parata phiravatIla (arthAta tumacyA dharmApAsUna alaga karatIla) pariNAmI tumhI toTyAta rAhAla.
kiMbahunA allAha tumacA svAmI ANi mAlaka Ahe ANi toca tumacA sarvottama sahAyyakartA Ahe.

AmhI lavakaraca inkArI lokAMcyA manAta bhaya nirmANa karU yA kAraNAstava kI te allAhacyA sobata tyA cIja vastUMnAhI sahabhAgI karatAta, jyAMcyAviSayI koNatehI pramANa allAhane utaravile nAhI, tyAMce ThikANa jahannama Ahe ANi tyA atyAcArI lokAMce vAITa ThikANa Ahe.

ANi allAhane ApalA vAyadA kharA karUna dAkhavilA, jevhA allAhacyA hukumAnusAra tumhI tyAMcA niHpAta karIta hote, yethaparyaMta kI, jevhA tumacI hiMmata khacata hotI ANi AdezAbAbata matabheda karU lAgale ANi AjJApAlana kele nAhI. he sarva tumhI tyAnaMtara kele, jevhA allAhane tumhAlA tumacA manapasaMta vijaya dAkhavUna dilA hotA. tumacyApaikI kAhIjaNa yA jagAcA lAbha icchita hote ANi kAhI AkhiratacI icchA karIta hote. maga tyAne tumhAlA zatrUMkaDUna phiravile, yAsAThI kI tumacI kasoTI ghyAvI ANi niHsaMzaya allAhane tumacyA cukA mApha kelyA ANi ImAnadhArakAMsAThI allAha atizaya meharabAna, kRpAvAna Ahe.

jevhA tumhI caDhata jAta hote ANi mAge vaLUna koNAlA pAhAtahI navhate, ANi allAhace rasUla (paigaMbara) tumhAlA pAThImAgUna hAka mArIta hote, tevhA tumhAlA duHkhAvara duHkha pohacale, yAsAThI kI tumhI ApalyA hAtUna nisaTalelyA (vijayA) vara duHkha na karAve ANi nA tyA (mAnasika AghAta) vara, jo tumhAlA pohacalA, ANi allAha tumacyA sarva karmAMnA cAMgale jANato.

maga tyA duHkhAnaMtara tumacyAvara zAMtI avatarita kelI ANi tumacyApaikI ekA samUhAlA zAMtIpUrNa DulakI yeU lAgalI, tathApi kAhI loka asehI hote jyAMnA kevaLa ApalyA jIvAcI dhAstI lAgalI hotI. te allAhaviSayI nAhaka mUrkhatApUrNa vicAra karU lAgale ANi mhaNU lAgale kI AmhAlAhI kAhI hakka (adhikAra) Aheta. tumhI tyAMnA sAMgA, kAma tara sarvacyA sarva allAhacyA adhikArakakSeta Ahe. he loka ApalyA manAtale rahasyabheda tumhAlA nAhI sAMgata. te mhaNatAta kI jara AmhAlA thoDAsAhI adhikAra asatA tara yA ThikANI jIve mArale gelo nasato. tumhI sAMgA, jara tumhI ApalyA gharAMtahI asate, tarIhI jyAMcyA nazibI mArale jANe lihile hote, te vadhasthaLAkaDe cAlata gele asate. allAhalA tumacyA manAtalyA goSTIMcI parIkSA ghyAyacI hotI ANi je kAhI tumacyA manAta Ahe tyApAsUna tumhAlA svaccha-zuddha karAyace hote ANi allAha aparokSa (gaiba) jANaNArA Ahe. (manAta daDalele rahasyabheda to cAMgalyA prakAre jANato.)

jyA divazI dona samUha ekamekAMzI mukAbalyAsAThI bhiDale, ANi tyA veLI tumacyApaikI jyA lokAMnI pATha dAkhavalI, he loka ApalyA kAhI karmAMmuLe saitAnAcyA bahakaviNyAta Ale, paNa tarIdekhIla allAhane tyAMnA mApha kele. niHsaMzaya allAha mApha karaNArA, sahanazila (burdabAra) Ahe.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! tumhI tyAMcyAsArakhe hoU nakA, je kRtaghna jhAle, ANi tyAMcyA bAMdhavAMbaddala, jevhA te jaminIvara pravAsAlA kiMvA jihAdakaritA nighAle, tevhA mhaNAle kI jara te AmacyAjavaLa rAhile asate tara mele nasate, nA mArale gele asate (tyAMcyA yA vicArAce kAraNa he Ahe kI) allAhane tyAMcyA manAta haLahaLa nirmANa karAvI. jIvana ANi mRtyu kevaLa allAhacyA avAkhyAta Ahe, ANi allAha tumacyA sarva karmAMnA pAhata Ahe.
jara tumhI allAhacyA mArgAta zahIda vhAlA kiMvA maraNa pAvAla tara allAhacI mAphI ANi dayA kRpA tyA (dhana-saMpattI) pekSA cAMgalI Ahe, jI te jamA karIta Aheta.
ANi tumhI maraNa pAvAla kiMvA mArale jAla (koNatyAhI sthitIta) tumhAlA allAhacyA javaLaca ekatra vhAyace Ahe.

allAhacyA kRpemuLe tumhI tyAMcyAsAThI komala banale AhAta ANi jara tumhI phaTakaLa toMDAce ANi kaThora manAce asate tara he sarva tumacyA javaLUna dUra paLAle asate, yAstava tyAMnA mApha karA ANi tyAMcyAsAThI kSamA-yAcanA karA ANi kAmAsaMbaMdhI tyAMcyAzI sallAmasalata karA. maga jevhA tumacA irAdA pakkA hoIla tevhA allAhavara bharosA karA, ANi allAha bharosA karaNAr2yAMnA ApalA dosta rAkhato.

jara allAha tumhAlA madata karIla tara koNIhI tumacyAvara varcasvazAlI TharU zakata nAhI ANi jara to tumhAlA soDUna deIla tara asA koNa Ahe jo tumhAlA madata karIla? ANi ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMnI allAhavaraca bharosA ThevalA pAhije.

ANi he agadI asaMbhava Ahe kI paigaMbarAMnI kAhI lapavUna ThevAve. pratyeka lapavUna ThevaNArA kayAmatacyA divazI Apale lapavUna Thevalele gheUna hajara hoIla, maga pratyeka mANasAlA ApalyA karmAcA purepUra mobadalA dilA jAIla ANi tyAMcyAvara atyAcAra kelA jANAra nAhI.
kAya to manuSya, jyAne allAhacyA mArgAce anusaraNa kele, tyA mANasAsArakhe Ahe, jo allAhacA prakopa gheUna paratalA? ANi tyAce ThikANa jahannama Ahe ANi te atizaya vAITa ThikANa Ahe.
allAhacyA javaLa tyAMce vegavegaLe darje Aheta ANi tyAMcyA samasta karmAMnA allAha cAMgalyA prakAre pAhAta Ahe.

niHsaMzaya, ImAnadhArakAMvara allAhacA moThA upakAra Ahe kI tyAne tyAMcyAtUnaca eka rasUla tyAMcyAmadhye pAThavilA, jo tyAMnA allAhacyA AyatI vAcUna aikavito ANi tyAMnA pAka (pavitra) karato, ANi tyAMnA graMtha ANi akalecyA goSTI zikavito ANi niHsaMzaya, he sarva tyApUrvI ughaDapaNe bhaTakalele hote.

he kAya kI jevhA tumacyAvara eka saMkaTa kosaLale, jyAcyA duppaTa tumhI tyAMnA pohacavile, tara tumhI mhaNAle kI he koThUna Ale? (he paigaMbara!) tumhI sAMgA kI he saMkaTa tumhI svataH ApalyAvara oDhavUna ghetale Ahe. niHsaMzaya, allAha pratyeka goSTIce sAmarthya bALagato.
ANi donhI samUha mukAbalyAsAThI jyA divazI ekamekAMzI bhiDale tevhA tumhAlA je kAhI pohacale tara he allAhacyA AdezAne pohocale, ANi yAsAThI kI allAhane ImAnadhArakAMnA ughaDapaNe jANUna ghyAve.

ANi DhoMgI (varakaraNI) musalamAnAMnAhI jANUna ghyAve jyAMnA sAMgitale gele kI yA, allAhacyA mArgAta laDhA kiMvA zatrUcyA hallyApAsUna bacAva karA, tevhA te mhaNAle kI AmhAlA jara he mAhIta asate kI laDhAI hoIla tara avazya tumhAlA sAtha dilI asatI. te tyA divazI ImAnAcyA tulaneta kupra (inkArA) cyA adhika javaLa hote. ApalyA mukhAne azI goSTa bolata hote, jI tyAMcyA manAta navhIta ANi allAha te jANato, je he lapavitAta.

heca te loka hota je svataH gharAta basUna rAhile ANi ApalyA bAMdhavAMbaddala mhaNAle, kI tyAMnI jara Amace mhaNaNe aikUna ghetale asate tara jIve mArale gele nasate. tyAMnA sAMgA kI tumhI sacce asAla tara ApalyAvarUna mRtyulA TALUna dAkhavA.
ANi je loka allAhacyA mArgAta ThAra kele gele tyAMnA mRta (melele) samajU nakA, kiMbahunA te jivaMta Aheta. tyAMnA tyAMcyA pAlanartyAjavaLUna rojI (anna-sAmagrI) dilI jAta Ahe.

sarvazreSTha allAhane tyAMnA ApalI jI kRpA pradAna kelI Ahe, ticyAdvAre te phAra AnaMdita Aheta ANi tyA lokAMbAbata AnaMda sAjarA karIta Ahe je adyApa tyAMcyAjavaLa pohocatale nAhIta, tyAMcyA mAge Aheta. yA goSTIbaddala kI tyAMnA nA kasale bhaya Ahe ANi nA kasale duHkha.
te allAhacyA kRpA deNagIne khUza hotAta ANi yA goSTInehI kI allAha ImAnadhArakAMcA mobadalA vAyA jAU deta nAhI.
jyA lokAMnI jakhamI avasthetahI allAha ANi rasUlacA Adeza mAnalA tyAMcyApaikI je satkarma karIta rAhile ANi allAhace bhaya rAkhUna durAcArApAsUna dUra rAhile, tyAMcyAsAThI phAra moThA mobadalA Ahe.

he te loka Aheta, jyAMnA bhItI dAkhavalI gelI kI loka tumacyAsAThI ekatra jhAle Aheta, tevhA tumhI tyAMce bhaya rAkhA pariNAmI tyAMce ImAna ANakhI vADhale ANi te mhaNAle kI allAha AmacyAsAThI puresA Ahe ANi to sarvottama saMrakSaka ANi kArya pAra pADaNArA Ahe.
(tAtparya) te allAhacyA kRpA deNagIsaha paratale. tyAMnA kasalehI duHkha pohocale nAhI, tyAMnI allAhacyA marjIcA mArga patkaralA ANi allAha moThA kRpAzIla Ahe.
hA saitAnaca Ahe, jo ApalyA mitrAMdvAre bhayabhIta karato, yAstava tyAMce bhaya bALagU nakA, phakta mAjheca bhaya rAkhA jara tumhI ImAnadhAraka asAla.

je zIghratene kupra (inkAra karaNyAta) phasata jAta Aheta, tyAcyAbAbata tumhI duHkhI hoU nakA. allAhace te kAhIca bighaDavU zakaNAra nAhIta. AkhiratacyA veLI allAha tyAMnA kAhIca hissA deU icchita nAhI ANi azA lokAMsAThI mahAbhayaMkara az2Aba (zikSA-yAtanA) Ahe.
ImAnacyA badalyAta kupra kharedI karaNAre loka, allAhalA kadApi koNatehI nukasAna pohacavU zakata nAhIta ANi tyAMcyAcasAThI kaThora zikSA (az2Aba) Ahe.

kAphira (inkArI) lokAMnI yA vicArAta rAhU naye kI Amace tyAMnA savaDa deNe tyAMcyAsAThI cAMgale Ahe, kiMbahunA AmhIhI savaDa azAsAThI deta Ahota kI tyAMnI ANakhI jAsta aparAdha karAveta, ANi tyAMcyAsAThIca apamAnita karaNArI zikSA-yAtanA Ahe.

jyA avastheta tumhI AhAta, tyAca avastheta, allAha ImAnadhArakAMnA soDaNAra nAhI, joparyaMta pavitra ANi apavitra vegavegaLe na karIla, ANi allAha asAhI nAhI kI tumhAlA aparokSAdvAre sUcita karIla, paraMtu allAha ApalyA paigaMbarAMmadhUna jyAcI icchito nivaDa karato. yAstava tumhI allAhavara ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAMvara ImAna rAkhA. jara tumhI ImAna rAkhAla ANi aparAdhAMpAsUna alipta rAhAla tara tumacyAsAThI phAra moThA mobadalA Ahe.

ANi jyA lokAMnA allAhane ApalyA kRpene dhanavAna kele Ahe ANi te tarIhI kaMjUSI karatAta tara tyAlA tyAMnI cAMgale samajU naye, ulaTa te tyAMcyA hakkAta atizaya vAITa Ahe. tyAMnI jyA (dhana-saMpattI) ta kaMjUSI kelI Ahe, kayAmatacyA divazI tyAMcyA gaLyAtale jokhaMDa (tauka) banela, ANi AkAzAMcA va jaminIcA vArasa kevaLa allAha Ahe ANi to tumacyA sarva karmAMcI khabara rAkhato.

niHsaMzaya, allAhane tyA lokAMce bolaNe aikUna ghetale, je ase mhaNAle kI allAha garIba, garajavAna Ahe ANi AmhI ganI (zrImaMta) Ahota, AmhI tyAMce he kathana lihUna gheU AmhI yAMcyAdvAre paigaMbarAMcyA nAhaka hatyelAdekhIla. ANi AmhI pharmAviNAra kI AtA jaLata rAhaNyAcA az2Aba cAkhA!
hI tumacI vAITa karme Aheta ANi niHsaMzaya allAha ApalyA dAsAMvara kiMcitahI atyAcAra karIta nAhI.

te mhaNAle, allAhane AmacyAkaDUna vacana ghetale Ahe kI AmhI ekhAdyA paigaMbarAvara ImAna na rAkhAve, joparyaMta to AmacyAsamora azI kurbAnI (balidAna) ANata nAhI, jilA AgIne khAUna TAkAve. tumhI tyAMnA sAMgA kI tumacyAjavaLa mAjhyApUrvI paigaMbara pramANa ANi tyAsobata tehI gheUna Ale je tumhI sAMgitale, tara maga tumhI tyAMcI hatyA kA kelI, jara tumhI sacce asAla.
tarIhI tara he loka tumhAlA khoTe TharavatIla, tara tumacyApUrvI aneka paigaMbara khoTe Tharavile gele, je ApalyAsobata spaSTa pramANa pothI (sahIphe) ANi divya-graMtha gheUna Ale.

pratyeka jIvAlA mRtyucA svAda cAkhAvA lAgaNAraca Ahe, ANi kayAmatacyA divazI tumhAlA ApalA mobadalA purepUra dilA jAIla. paraMtu jo manuSya AgIpAsUna dUra haTavilA gelA ANi jannatamadhye dAkhala kelA gelA, niHsaMzaya, to saphala jhAlA ANi yA jagAce jIvana kevaLa dhokyAcI sAmugrI Ahe.

niHsaMzaya, tumacyA dhana ANi prANAdvAre tumacI kasoTI ghetalI jAIla Ami avazya tumhAlA tyA lokAMcI jyAMnA tumacyApUrvI graMtha dilA gelA ANi anekezvaravAdyAMcI manAlA duHkha deNArI bolaNI aikAvI lAgatIla, tathApi tumhI dhIra-saMyama rAkhAlA ANi allAhacA Adeza mAnAla tara nizcitaca he phAra himatIce kAma Ahe.

ANi jevhA sarvazreSTha allAhane graMthadhArakAMkaDUna karAra ghetalA kI tumhI te sarva lokAMnA jarUra sAMgAla ANi tyAlA lapaviNAra nAhI, paNa tarIhI tyA lokAMnI to karAra pAThImAge TAkalA ANi tyAlA phAra kamI kimatIvara vikUna TAkale. tyAMcA hA vyApAra phAra vAITa Ahe.

te loka, je ApalyA kAravAyAMvara khUza Aheta ANi ase icchitAta kI je tyAMnI kele nAhI, tyAbaddalahI tyAMcI stutI-prazaMsA kelI jAvI. tumhI tyAMnA az2Aba (zikSA-yAtanA) pAsUna mukta samajU nakA. tyAMcyAsAThI tara duHkhadAyaka az2Aba Ahe.
ANi AkAzAMcA ANi jaminIcA svAmI (mAlaka) allAhaca Ahe ANi allAha pratyeka goSTIce sAmarthya rAkhato.
niHsaMzaya, AkAzAMcyA ANi jaminIcyA racanAkAryAta ANi rAtra-divasAcyA ALIpALIne ye-jA karaNyAta, buddhimAnAMkaritA nizANyA Aheta.

je loka allAhace smaraNa ubhe rAhUna, basalelyA avastheta ANi ApalyA kuzIvara pahuDale asatAnA karatAta ANi AkAzAMcyA va jaminIcyA nirmitIvara vicAra-ciMtana karatAta (ANi mhaNatAta) kI he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! tU he sarva hetuvinA banavile nAhI. tU pavitra Ahe. tevhA tU AmhAlA AgIcyA az2Aba (zikSA-yAtane) pAsUna vAcava.
he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! tU jyAlA AgIta TAkale, niHsaMzaya tU tyAlA apamAnita kele, ANi atyAcArI lokAMcA koNIhI madata karaNArA nAhI.

he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! AmhI ase aikale kI eka pukAraNArA ImAnAkaDe bolAvita Ahe kI lokAMno! ApalyA pAlanakartyAvara ImAna rAkhA ANi AmhI ImAna rAkhale. he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! AtA tarI AmacyA aparAdhAMnA kSamA kara ANi AmacyA duSkarmAMnA AmacyApAsUna dUra kara ANi neka sadAcArI lokAMsobata AmhAlA mRtyu de.

he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! AmhAlA te pradAna kara jyAcA vAyadA tU AmacyAzI ApalyA paigaMbarAMcyA toMDUna kelA Ahe, ANi AmhAlA kayAmatacyA divazI apamAnita karU nakosa. niHsaMzaya tU ApalyA vAyadyAvirUddha jAta nAhI.

yAstava tyAMcyA pAlanakartyAne tyAMcI duA (prArthanA) kabUla kelI (ANi pharmAvile) kI tumacyApaikI koNA karma karaNAr2yAcyA karmAlA, maga to puruSa aso kI strI, mI vAyA jAU deta nAhI. tumhI ApasAta ekamekAMce sahAyaka AhAta, yAstava te loka jyAMnI (dharmAsAThI) sthalAMtara kele ANi jyAMnA ApalyA gharAtUna bAhera ghAlavile gele ANi jyAMnA mAjhyA mArgAta kaSTa-yAtanA dilI gelI ANi jyAMnI jihAda kele ANi zahIda kele gele, mI avazya tyAMcI duSkarme tyAMcyApAsUna dUra karIna ANi avazya tyAMnA tyA jannatamadhye neIna, jyAMcyA khAlI pravAha vAhata Aheta. hA mobadalA Ahe allAhatarphe ANi allAhajavaLaca cAMgalA mobadalA Ahe.
zaharAMmadhye kAphirAMce (inkArI lokAMce) yeNe-jANe tumhAlA dhokyAta na TAkAve.
hA tara phAra alpasA phAyadA Ahe. tyAnaMtara tyAMce ThikANa jahannama Ahe, ANi te phAra vAITa ThikANa Ahe.

paraMtu je loka ApalyA pAlanakartyAce bhaya bALagata rAhile, tyAMcyAsAThI jannata Ahe jyAMcyA khAlI pravAha vAhata Aheta, tyAta te nehamI nehamI rAhatIla he allAhatarphe atithya (pAhuNacAra) Ahe ANi puNya-kArya karaNAr2yAMkaritA allAhajavaLa je kAhI Ahe te sarvAdhika cAMgale ANi uttama Ahe.

ANi graMthadhArakAMpaikI kAhI loka avazya ase Aheta je allAhavara ImAna rAkhatAta ANi je tumacyAvara utaravile gele Ahe ANi je tyAMcyAkaDe utaravile gele Ahe tyAvara ImAna rAkhatAta. allAhace bhaya bALagUna rAhatAta, ANi allAhacyA AyatIMnA thoDe thoDe mola gheUna vikata nAhIta tyAMcA mobadalA tyAMcyA pAlanakartyAjavaLa Ahe. niHsaMzaya allAha lavakaraca hizoba gheNAra Ahe.
he ImAnadhArakAMno! tumhI dhIra-saMyama rAkhA ANi ekamekAMnA majabutI deta rAhA ANi jihAda (dharmayuddha) sAThI tayAra rAhA, yAsAThI kI tumhI saphalatA prApta karAvI.

he lokAMno! ApalyA tyA pAlanakartyAce bhaya rAkhA, jyAne tumhAlA ekAca jIvApAsUna nirmANa kele ANi tyAcyApAsUnaca tyAcyA patnIlAhI nirmANa kele, ANi tyA doghAMpAsUna aneka strI-puruSa pasaravile ANi tyA allAhace bhaya rAkhA, jyAcyA nAvAne tumhI ekamekAMkaDe yAcanA karatAta ANi nAte-saMbaMdha toDaNyApAsUnahI (svataHlA vAcavA) niHsaMzaya, allAha tumhA sarvAMcI dekharekha karaNArA Ahe.

ANi anAthAMnA tyAMcI dhana-saMpattI deUna TAkA ANi anAthAMcA cAMgalA mAla haDapa karUna tyAaivajI kharabA mAla deU nakA. ANi ApalyA mAlAta (dhanAta) tyAMcA mAla misaLavUna giLaMkRta karU nakA. niHsaMzaya hA phAra moThA aparAdha Ahe.

ANi jara tumhAlA he bhaya vATata asela kI anAtha mulIMzI vivAha karUna tumhI nyAya (vartana) karU zakaNAra nAhIta tara maga itara striyAMpaikI jyA tumhAlA cAMgalyA vATatIla tyAMcyAzI tumhI vivAha karUna ghyA. dona-dona, tIna-tIna, cAra-cAra, paraMtu (azA sthitIta) nyAya na rAkhalA jANyAce bhaya asela tara eka (patnI) purezI Ahe athavA tumacyA mAlakIcyA dAsIMnA. he adhika nikaTa Ahe kI (ase kelyAne anyAyAkaDe ANi) ekatarphI jhukaNyApAsUna vAcAla.

ANi striyAMnA tyAMce mahara (vivAhaprasaMgI varAtarphe vadhUsAThI nirdhArIta kelelI rakkama) rAjIkhuzIne deUna TAkA ANi jara strI ApalyA marjIne kAhI mahara soDUna deIla tara to ucita samajUna khAU piU zakatA.

ApalI tI dhana-saMpattI, jilA allAhane tumacyA jIvanAcA AdhAra banavile Ahe tI nAdAna va akkala nasalelyAMnA deU nakA ANi tyAtUna tyAMnA khAU ghAlA, tyAMnA kapaDe-latte dyA ANi tyAMcyAzI naramIne bolA.

ANi anAthAMnA te vayAta yeiparyaMta tyAMcI dekharekha ThevA ANi tyAMcI parIkSA gheta rAhA. maga jevhA tumhAlA tyAMcyAta sudhAraNA va lAyakI disUna yeIla, tevhA tyAMcI saMpattI tyAMcyA havAlI karA ANi te moThe hotIla yA bhItIne tyAMce dhana ghAIghAIne udhaLapaTTI karIta khAUna TAkU nakA. zrImaMtAMnI tyAMcyA saMpattIbAbata ase karaNyApAsUna alipta rAhAve, tathApi garIba asela tara tyAne vAjavI ritInee khAve, maga jevhA tumhI tyAMnA tyAMcI saMpattI sopavAla tevhA sAkSI karUna ghyA, ANi hizoba gheNyAsAThI tara allAha puresA Ahe.

AI-bApa ANi javaLacyA nAtevAIkAMcyA saMpattIta puruSAMcA hissA Ahe, ANi striyAMcAhI (arthAta jI dhana-saMpattI AI-vaDIla ANi javaLace nAtevAIka mAge soDUna jAtIla), maga tI saMpattI kamI aso kiMvA jAsta (tyAta) hissA TharalelA Ahe.
ANi vATaNIcyA veLI jevhA nAtevAIka, anAtha ANi garIba dubaLe yetIla tara tumhI tyA saMpattItUna tyAMnAhI thoDe-phAra dyA ANi tyAMcyAzI naramIne bolA.

lokAMnI hA vicAra kelA pAhije kI ApalyA mAge jara te lahAna lahAna kamajora mulebALe soDUna mele asate tara tyAMnA ApalyA mulAMbaddala kazI bhItI vATalI asatI, svataH ApalyAvara kayAsa(aMdAja) karUna bhaya rAkhale pAhije ANi tyAMnI allAhace bhaya bALagale pAhije ANi bolatAnA yathAyogya bolale pAhije.
je loka nAhaka atyAcArapUrvaka anAthAMcI saMpattI giLaMkRta karatAta, te ApalyA poTAta Aga bharata Aheta ANi te jahannamamadhye jAtIla.

sarvazreSTha allAha tumhAlA tumacyA saMtatIviSayI Adeza deto kI ekA mulAcA hissA dona mulIMcyA hizyAitakA Ahe. jara phakta mulIca asatIla ANi tyA donapekSA jAsta asatIla tara tyAMnA, mayatAne mAge soDalelyA saMpattImadhUna dona tRtiyAMza hissA miLela ANi jara ekaca mulagI asela tara ticyAsAThI ardhA hissA Ahe ANi mayatAcyA AI-bApApaikI pratyekAlA, tyAne mAge soDalelyA saMpattIcA sahAvA hissA Ahe. mayatAlA saMtAna asela athavA saMtAna nasela, ANi AI-bApa vArasadAra asatIla tara maga tyAcyA AIcA tisarA hissA Ahe. tathApi mayatAce jara aneka bhAU asatIla tara maga tyAcyA AIcA sahAvA hissA Ahe. hA hissA mayatAne kelelyA mRtyupatrA (vasIyata) cI pUrtatA kelyAnaMtara Ahe kiMvA tyAce karja pheDalyAnaMtara. tumacA pitA asela kiMvA tumacI mule, paNa tumhI nAhI jANata kI tyAMcyApaikI koNa tumhAlA lAbha pohacaviNyAta jAsta javaLacA Ahe. he sarva hisse allAhatarphe nirdhArIta kelele Aheta. niHsaMzaya allAha sarva kAhI jANaNArA hikamatazAlI Ahe.

ANi tumacyA patnyA, jI kAhI saMpattI mAge soDUna jAtIla ANi tyAMnA mulebALe nasatIla tara tyAta tumacA ardhA hissA Ahe ANi jara tyAMnA mulebALe asatIla tara tyAMnI mAge soDalelyA saMpattIta tumacA cauthA hissA Ahe, mAtra tyAMnI kelelyA mRtyupatrAcI pUrtatA jhAlyAnaMtara kiMvA tyAMce karja pheDalyAnaMtara ANi jI saMpattI tumhI ApalyA mAge soDUna jAla, tyAta tyAMcA eka caturthAMza hissA Ahe jara tumhAlA saMtatI nasela, ANi jara tumhAlA saMtatI asela tara maga tyAMnA tumhI mAge soDalelyA saMpattIta AThavA hissA miLela, mAtra tumhI kelelyA mRtyupatrAcI pUrtatA jhAlyAnaMtara ANi tumace karja pheDUna jhAlyAnaMtara, ANi jara azA puruSa kiMvA strIne mAge soDalelyA saMpattIcA mAmalA AlA, jyAlA AI-bApa kiMvA mulebALe nasatIla, paraMtu bhAU-bahINa asatIla tara tyAMcyApaikI pratyekAlA sahAvA hissA miLela ANi jara yAhUna jAsta asatIla tara eka tRtiyAMza saMpattIta sarvAMcA hissA rAhIla. mAtra tyAne kelelyA mRtyupatrAcI pUrtatA jhAlyAnaMtara va karjAcI adAyagI jhAlyAnaMtaraca azA prakAre kI itarAMnA nukasAna pohacavile gele nasAve. he allAhatarphe nirdhArIta kelele Ahe ANi allAha pratyeka goSTa jANaNArA ANi dharya rAkhaNArA Ahe.

yA sarvazreSTha allAhane nirdhArIta kelelyA sImA Aheta ANi jo koNI allAha ANi tyAce rasUla (paigaMbara sallallAhu alaihi vasallama) yAMcyA AdezAce pAlana karIla, tyAlA allAha jannatamadhye dAkhala karIla, jyAMcyA khAlI naharI (pravAha) vAhata asatIla, jyAta te nehamI nehamI rAhatIla, ANi hI phAra moThI saphalatA Ahe.

ANi jo manuSya allAhacI ANi rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi vasallama) yAMcI avajJA karIla ANi allAhane nirdhArIta kelelyA sImAMce ullaMghana karIla tyAlA to jahannamamadhye TAkIla, jyAta to nehamI nehamI rAhIla. azA lokAMkaritA apamAnadAyaka az2Aba (zikSA-yAtanA) Ahe.

tumacyA striyAMpaikI jyA vyabhicAra karatIla tara tyAMcyAbaddala ApalyApaikI cAra sAkSIdAra bolavUna ghyA jara tyAMnI sAkSa dilI tara tyA striyAMnA gharAta baMdista karUna ThevA, yethaparyaMta kI mRtyune tyAMce AyuSya saMpavAve, kiMvA sarvazreSTha allAhane tyAMcyAsAThI ekhAdA dusarA mArga kADhAvA.

ANi tumacyApaikI je donajaNa ase kRtya karatIla tara tyAMnA duHkha-yAtanA dyA. jara te taubA (kSamA-yAcanA) karatIla ANi Apale AcaraNa sudhAratIla tara tyAMnA soDUna dyA. niHsaMzaya, sarvazreSTha allAha taubA (kSamA-yAcanA) kabUla karaNArA ANi dayA karaNArA Ahe.

allAha kevaLa azAca lokAMcI taubA kabUla karato, je ajANatepaNI vAITa kRtya karUna basatAta, paNa lavakaraca tase kRtya karaNe soDatAta ANi allAhajavaLa mAphI mAgatAta, jevhA allAhadekhIla tyAMcI kSamA-yAcanA svIkArato allAha sarva kAhI jANaNArA buddhimAna Ahe.

ANi tyAMcI taubA kadApi kabUla nAhI, je duSkarmAMvara duSkarma karIta jAtAta itake kI tyAMcyApaikI ekhAdyAce maraNa javaLa yeUna Thepate, tevhA mhaNU lAgato kI AtA mI taubA karato! ANi azA lokAMcIhI taubA kabUla kelI jAta nAhI je inkAra karaNyAcyA avasthetaca maraNa pAvatAta. azAca lokAMsAThI AmhI sakta az2Aba (kaThora zikSA-yAtanA) tayAra karUna ThevalA Ahe.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! tumacyAsAThI he halAla (vaidha) navhe kI jabaradastIne striyAMce, tyAMcyA marjIvirUddha vArasadAra banAve ANi ApaNa dilele tyAMcyAkaDUna kAhI parata ghyAve yA hetune tyAMnA rokhUna ThevU nakA mAtra jara tyA ughaDapaNe ekhAde duSkarma ANi vyabhicArAce kAma karatIla tara goSTa vegaLI. tyAMcyAzI cAMgale vartana rAkhA, maga tyA tumhAlA nApasaMta kA asenAta, kAraNa phAra zakya Ahe kI tumhI ekhAdyA goSTIlA vAITa jANAve ANi allAhane ticyAta moThI bhalAI ANi khUbI ThevalI asAvI.

ANi jara ekA patnIcyA ThikANI tumhI dusarI patnI karU icchita asAla tara tyAMcyApaikI ekhAdIlA tumhI dhana-saMpattIcA khajinA deUna ThevalA asela, tarIhI tyAtUna kAhI (parata) gheU nakA. kAya tumhI tilA badanAma karUna ughaDa azA aparAdhAne parata ghyAla?
ANi tumhI te kase parata ghyAla? yAnaMtarahI kI tumhI ekamekAMzI sahavAsa kelelA Ahe ANi tyA striyAMnI tumacyAkaDUna pakkA vAyadA-karAra ghetalA Ahe.
ANi tyA striyAMzI vivAha karU nakA, jyAMcyAzI tumacyA pityAMnI vivAha kelA asela, paraMtu yApUrvI je jhAle te jhAle he nirlajjatece kAma ANi kapaTIpaNAmuLe Ahe ANi moThA vAITa (AcaraNAcA) mArga Ahe.

tumacyAvara harAma (niSiddha) kelyA gelyA tumacyA mAtA ANi kanyA, ANi tumacyA bahiNI tumacyA AtyA tumacyA mAvazyA, bhAvAcyA mulI, bahiNIcyA mulI ANi tumacyA tyA mAtA, jyAMnI tumhAlA Apale dUdha pAjale asela ANi tumacyA (AIcyA) dudhAta sahabhAgI asalelyA bahiNI, tumacI sAsU ANi tumhI jyAMce pAlanapoSaNa kele tyA mulI jyA tumacyA kuzIta (kaDevara) Aheta tumacyA tyA striyAMpAsUna jyAMcyAzI tumhI sahavAsa kelelA Ahe, paraMtu jara tumhI tyAMcyAzI sahavAsa kelA nasela tara tumacyAvara kasalAhI gunhA nAhI, ANi tumacyA sakhyA putrAMcyA patnyAsuddhA harAma Aheta ANi dona bahiNIMnA ekAca veLA (ekatrapaNe) nikAhamadhye jamA karaNe hedekhIla harAma Ahe. mAtra yApUrvI je jhAle te jhAle. niHsaMzaya allAha moThA mApha karaNArA, meharabAna, dayAvAna Ahe.

ANi (tumacyAsAThI) vivAhita striyA (avaidha) kelyA gelyA Aheta tathApi jI (dAsI) tumacyA svataHcyA mAlakIcI asela. he Adeza allAhane tumacyAvara anivArya kele Aheta ANi yAkherIja jyA dusar2yA striyA tumacyAsAThI halAla (vaidha) kelyA gelyA Aheta kI Apale dhana (mahara) adA karUna tyAMcyAzI vivAha karA, vyabhicArAsAThI nAhI tara pAvitrya kAyama rAkhaNyAkaritA, yAstava jyAMcyApAsUna tumhI lAbha ghyAla tyAMnA tyAMcA mahara adA karA ANi tumhI TharalelyA mahara naMtara ekamekAMcyA marjIne je vATela te TharavAla tara yAta tumacyAvara kAhI gunhA nAhI. niHsaMzaya allAha sarva kAhI jANaNArA hikamatazAlI Ahe.

ANi tumacyApaikI jo svataMtra azA mulasamAna strIzI vivAha karaNyAce sAmarthya bALagata nasela tara tyAne tyA musalamAna dAsIzI (vivAha karAvA) jI svataHcyA mAlakIcI asAvI. allAha tumacyA karmAzI pUrNataH jANatA Ahe. tumhI ApasAta ekamekAMce joDIdAra AhAta, yAstava tumhI tyAMcyA kuTuMbiyAMcyA paravAnagIne tyAMcyAzI vivAha karA ANi niyamAnusAra tyAMcA mahara deUna TAkA. tyA satzIla, sadAcArI asAvyAta, ughaDapaNe durAcAra karaNAr2yA nasAvyAta, na lapUna chapUna prema-saMbaMdha rAkhaNAr2yA asAvyAta, maga jevhA tyA vivAhita jhAlyAnaMtara punhA vyabhicAra karatIla tara tyAMcyAsAThI, svataMtra striyAMnA dilyA jANAr2yA zikSecyA nimmI zikSA Ahe. hA vivAhAcA Adeza tyAcyAsAThI Ahe jyAlA ApalyA hAtUna kukarma hoIla azI bhItI Ahe dhIra dharAla tara tumacyAsAThI uttama Ahe. ANi allAha mApha karaNArA, dayA karaNArA Ahe.

allAha icchito kI tumacyAsAThI spaSTa AdezAMce nivedana karAve ANi tumhAlA tyA lokAMcyA ucita mArgAvara cAlavAve, je tumacyA pUrvI hoUna geleta ANi tumacI kSamA-yAcanA (taubA) kabUla karAvI ANi allAha jANaNArA, hikamatazAlI Ahe.
ANi allAha icchito kI tumacI taubA kabUla karAvI ANi je loka kAmavAsanecyA mAge lAgale Aheta, te icchitAta kI tumhI sanmArgApAsUna khUpa dUra haTAve.
allAha tumacA sarva bhAra halakA karU icchito ANi mANUsa moThA kamakuvata nirmANa kelA gelA Ahe.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! ApasAta ekamekAMcI dhana-saMpattI nAhaka haDapa karU nakA, paraMtu AzA padhdatIne kI tumhI ApasAta rAjIkhuzIne vyApAra-udyoga karA. ANi svataHlA jIve ThAra karU nakA. niHsaMzaya allAha tumacyAvara dayA karaNArA Ahe.
ANi je manuSya hI sImA olAMDUna ANakhI atyAcAra karIla tara phAra lavakara AmhI tyAlA AgIta TAkU ANi he allAhakaritA phAra sope Ahe.
jara tumhI yA moThyA aparAdhAMpAsUna svataHlA vAcavAla, jyAMcyAviSayI tumhAlA manAI kelI jAta Ahe tara AmhI tumacyA lahAna sahAna aparAdhAMnA mApha karU ANi mAna sanmAnAcyA daravAjyAta dAkhala karU.

ANi tyA goSTIcI icchA dharU nakA, jicyAmuLe allAhane tumacyApaikI ekAlA dusar2yAvara zreSThatA pradAna kelI Ahe. puruSAMcA hissA to Ahe, jo tyAMnI kamavilA ANi striyAMsAThI to hissA Ahe jo tyAMnI kamavIlA allAhajavaLa tyAcyA dayA-kRpecI yAcanA karA. niHsaMzaya allAha pratyeka goSTIce jJAna rAkhato.

ANi AI-bApa kiMvA javaLace nAtevAIka ApalyA mAge je kAhI soDUna maratIla, tyAce vArasadAra AmhI pratyekAce nizcita kele Aheta ANi jyAMcyAzI tumhI svataH vacana-karAra kelA Ahe. tyAMnA tyAMcA hissA deUna TAkA. niHsaMzaya, allAha pratyeka goSTa pAhAta Ahe.

puruSa, strIvara zAsaka (ANi saMrakSaka) Ahe. yA kAraNAstava kI allAhane ekAlA dusar2yAvara zreSThatva pradAna kele Ahe ANi yA kAraNAstava kI puruSAMnI Apale dhana kharca kele Ahe. yAstava neka, AjJAdhAraka striyA patIcyA anupasthitIta allAhacyA saMrakSaNAdvAre dhana-saMpattI va zIla-abrUce rakSaNa karatAta ANi jyA striyAMpAsUna tumhAlA avajJece bhaya asela tyAMnA cAMgalI tAkIda karA, tyAMce aMtharuNa vegaLe karA (tarIhI na mAnatIla) tara mArA ANi jara tumace mhaNaNe mAnUna ghetIla tara tyAMcyAvara doSAropa ThevaNyAce nimitta zodhU nakA. niHsaMzaya allAha moThA mahAna Ahe.

jara tumhAlA (patI-patnImadhye) manamuTAva hoNyAcI bhItI asela tara eka nyAya karaNArA paMca, patIcyA kuTuMbAtarphe ANi eka patnIcyA kuTuMbAtarphe TharavUna ghyA. jara he doghe samajhotA ghaDavUna ANU icchitIla tara allAha tyA doghAMcA milApa karIla. niHsaMzaya, allAha jANaNArA, khabara rAkhaNArA Ahe.

ANi allAhacI upAsanA karA. tyAcyAsaha dusar2yA koNAlA sahabhAgI karU nakA ANi AI-bApa, nAtevAIka, anAtha, garIba dubaLe, javaLace zejArI, dUrace zejArI ANi sobata asalelyA pravAzAMsII bhalepaNAce, upakArAce vartana karA, taseca pravAzI ANi tumacyA tAbyAta aselalyAMzIhI. niHsaMzaya allAha aiTa dAkhaviNAr2yA ghameMDIzI prema rAkhata nAhI.

je loka svataH kaMjUSapaNA karatAta ANi itarAMnAhI kaMjUSapaNA karaNyAsa sAMgatAta ANi sarvazreSTha allAhane, je ApalyA kRpene tyAMnA pradAna kele Ahe, te lapavitAta, tara AmhI azA kRtaghna lokAMsAThI apamAnadAyaka az2Aba (zikSA-yAtanA) tayAra karUna ThevalA Ahe.
ANi je loka Apale dhana lokAMnA dAkhaviNyAsAThI kharca karatAta, ANi allAhavara ANi kayAmatacyA divasAvara ImAna rAkhata nAhI ANi jyAcA sakhA-sobatI saitAna asela tara to moThA vAITa sobatI Ahe.

ANi tyAMce kAya bighaDale asate tara tyAMnI allAhavara ANi kayAmatacyA divasAvara ImAna rAkhale asate ANi allAhane je tyAMnA deUna Thevale Ahe, tyAtUna kharca karIta rAhile asate. allAha tyAMnA cAMgalyA prakAre jANaNArA Ahe.
niHsaMzaya, sarvazreSTha allAha ekA kaNAitakAhI atyAcAra karIta nAhI. ANi satkarma (nekI) asela tara tyAlA duppaTa karato ANi vizeSataH ApalyA javaLUna phAra moThA mobadalA pradAna karato.
tevhA kAya avasthA hoIla, jevhA pratyeka janasamUhA (ummata) madhUna eka sAkSa deNArA AmhI ANU ANi tumhAlA tyA lokAMvara sAkSIdAra banavUna ANU.

jyA divazI inkAra karaNAre ANi paigaMbarAcI avajJA karaNAre hI icchA karatIla kI tyAMnA jaminIzI sapATa (samatala) kele gele asate tara phAra bare jhAle asate ANi allAhapAsUna te kAhIhI lapavU zakaNAra nAhIta.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! jevhA tumhI nazeta cUra asAla tevhA namAjacyA javaLa jAU nakA, joparyaMta Apale mhaNaNe samajU na lAgAla ANi (saMbhogAnaMtaracyA) apavitra avastheta, joparyaMta snAna na karUna ghyAla, paraMtu rastyAne jAtAnA (namAjacyA sthAnAvarUna) jANe hota asela tara goSTa vegaLI ANi jara tumhI AjArI asAla, kiMvA pravAsAta asAla kiMvA tumacyApaikI koNI zaucAsa jAUna AlA asela kiMvA tumhI striyAMzI samAgama kelA asela ANi tumhAlA pANI miLata nasela tara sApha svaccha mAtIne tayammuma karA ANi Apale toMDa ANi Apale hAta (mAtIne) maLUna ghyA. niHsaMzaya allAha moThA mApha karaNArA ANi kSamAzIla Ahe.
kAya tumhI tyAMnA nAhI pAhile, jyAMnA graMthAcA kAhI bhAga dilA gelA? te mArgabhraSTatA kharedI karatAta ANi icchitAta kI tumhIhI mArgabhraSTa vhAve.
ANi allAha tumacyA zatrUMnA cAMgalyA prakAre jANaNArA Ahe ANi allAha puresA Ahe dosta hoNyAsAThI ANi allAha paryApta Ahe madatakartA hoNyAsAThI.

kAhI yahUdI, vANI (kalAma) lA ticyA yogya sthAnApAsUna badalUna TAkatAta. ANi mhaNatAta kI AmhI aikale ANi avajJA kelI ANi aika tyAcyAvinA kI tulA aikale na jAve ANi AmacI tAbedArI kabUla karA (paraMtu he bolatAnA) ApalyA jIbhelA moDa detAta ANi dIna (dharma) kalaMkita karatAta ANi jara he loka ase mhaNAle asate kI AmhI aikale ANi AmhI mAnya kele ANi tumhI aikA ANi AmhAlA pAhA tara he tyAMcyAsAThI phAra cAMgale jhAle asate ANi adhika uttama Tharale asate. paraMtu allAhane tyAMcyA inkArAmuLe tyAMcA dhiHkkAra kelA, tevhA he phAra kamI ImAna rAkhatAta.

he graMthadhArakAMno! je kAhI AmhI avatarita kele Ahe, je tumacyAjavaLa asalelyA (graMthA) lA satya asalyAce sAMgato, tyAvara yApUrvI ImAna rAkhA kI AmhI cehare bighaDavUna TAkAveta ANi tyAMnA phiravUna pAThIkaDe karAve kiMvA tyAMcyAvara dhiHkkArAcA mArA karAvA, jasA AmhI zanivAravAlyA lokAMvara kelA Ahe, ANi allAhacA nirNaya pUrNa jhAlyAzivAya rAhAta nAhI.

niHsaMzaya, allAha ApalyAsaha koNAlA sahabhAgI kele jANe mApha karata nAhI ANi yAcyAkherIja jyAlA icchila mApha karIla ANi jo allAhasobata dusar2yAlA sahabhAgI karIla tara tyAne allAhavara phAra moThe asatya racale.
kAya tumhI tyAMnA nAhI pAhile je svatalA phAra zuddha pavitra asalyAce sAMgatAta? kiMbahunA allAha jyAlA icchito svaccha, zuddha, pavitra karato, ANi koNAvara dhAgyAitakAhI atyAcAra kelA jANAra nAhI.
pAhA, he loka allAhavara kazA prakAre khoTA Aropa ThevatAta ANi he phAra moThA gunhA sAbIta hoNyAsa purese Ahe.

kAya tumhI tyAMnA nAhI pAhile, jyAMnA graMthAcA kAhI hissA lAbhalA Ahe je mUrtyAMvara ANi mithyA devAMvara ImAna (zraddhA) rAkhatAta ANi inkArI lokAMcyA hakkAta mhaNatAta kI he loka ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMpekSA adhika saraLa ANi satya-mArgAvara Aheta.
heca loka Aheta, jyAMcA allAhane dhiHkkAra kelA Ahe ANi allAha jyAcA dhiHkkAra karIla tara tumhAlA tyAcI madata karaNArA koNIhI ADhaLaNAra nAhI.
kAya tyAMcyAjavaLa ekhAdyA sAmrAjyAcA hissA Ahe, ase asela tara he koNAlA tILabharasuddhA deNAra nAhIta.

he lokAMzI dveSa-matsara rAkhatAta, tyAbaddala, je allAhane ApalyA kRpene tyAMnA pradAna kele Ahe, tevhA AmhI ibrAhImacyA saMtatIlA graMtha ANi hikamatahI pradAna kelI ANi moThe sAmrAjyahI pradAna kele.
maga tyAMcyApaikI kAhIMnI tara graMthAvara ImAna rAkhale ANi kAhI tyApAsUna thAMbale tevhA (azA lokAMsAThI) jahannamacI Aga purezI Ahe.

jyA lokAMnI AmacyA AyatIMcA inkAra kelA, tyAMnA AmhI avazya AgIta TAkU, jevhA tyAMcI kAtaDI zijUna gaLUna paDela, AmhI lageca ticyA jAgI dusarI kAtaDI badalUna TAkU yAsAThI kI tyAMnI az2Aba (zikSA-yAtanA) cAkhataca rAhAve. niHsaMzaya allAha jabaradasta hikamatazAlI Ahe.

ANi jyAMnI ImAna rAkhale ANi satkarma karIta rAhile, AmhI lavakaraca tyAMnA jannatacyA bAgAMmadhye dAkhala karU, jyAMcyA khAlI naharI (pravAha) vAhata Aheta, jyAta te nehamI rAhatIla. tithe tyAMcyAsAThI pAvitryapUrNa, zIlavAna patnyA asatIla ANi AmhI tyAMnA dATa sAvalIta (ArAmazIra jAgI) ThevU.

sarvazreSTha allAha tumhAlA Adeza deto kI anAmata (Theva, dharohara) tyAMcyA mAlakAMnA parata karA, ANi jevhA lokAMcyA daramyAna phaisalA karAla tara nyAyapUrvaka phaisalA karA. niHsaMzaya, tI phAra cAMgalI goSTa Ahe, jyAcI zikavaNa allAha tumhAlA deta Ahe ANi niHsaMzaya allAha sarva kAhI aikaNArA, pAhaNArA Ahe.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! allAhacyA AdezAce pAlana karA ANi rasUla (paigaMbara) sallallAhu alaihi vasallama yAMcyA AdezAce pAlana karA ANi ApalyApaikI zAsaka asalelyAMcA Adeza mAnA, maga jara ekhAdyA goSTIta matabheda karAla tara to allAha ANi paigaMbara sallallAhu alaihi vasallama yAMcyAkaDe rujU karA, jara tumhI allAhavara ANi kayAmatacyA divasAvara ImAna rAkhata asAla. he sarvAMta cAMgale Ahe ANi pariNAmAcyA dRSTInehI phAra uttama Ahe.

kAya tumhI tyAMnA nAhI pAhile, je dAvA karatAta kI, je kAhI tumacyAvara utaravile gele Ahe ANi je kAhI tumacyA pUrvI utaravile gele tyAvara te ImAna rAkhatAta, paraMtu ApasAtale taMTe soDaviNyAsAThI, allAhaaivajI te dusar2yAMjavaLa jAU icchitAta, vAstavika tyAMnA Adeza dilA gelA Ahe kI tyAMnI, tyAcA (saitAnAcA) inkAra karAvA. saitAna tara he icchitoca kI tyAMnA bahakavUna dUra phekUna dyAve.

ANi jevhA jevhA tyAMnA sAMgitale jAte kI allAhane jo (pavitra graMtha) avatarita kelA Ahe, tyAcyAkaDe ANi paigaMbarAkaDe yA, tevhA tumhI pAhAla kI he munAphika (saMdhIsAdhU) tumacyAkaDUna toMDa phiravUna thAMbatAta.

maga kAya kAraNa Ahe kI jevhA tyAMcyAvara tyAMcyA vAITa karmAMmuLe ekhAde saMkaTa yeUna kosaLate tara maga he tumacyAjavaLa yeUna allAhacI zapatha ghetAta, ANi sAMgatAta, AmacA irAdA tara kevaLa bhalAIcA ANi cAMgale saMbaMdha ghaDavUna ANaNyAcAca hotA.

he ase loka Aheta, jyAMcyA manAtIla rahasyabheda, allAhalA cAMgalyA prakAre mAhIta Ahe. tumhI tyAMcyA bolaNyAkaDe durlakSa karA, mAtra tyAMnA zikavaNa deta rAhA, ANi tyAMnA azI goSTa bolA jI tyAMcyA manAvara prabhAva TAkaNArI asela.

ANi AmhI pratyeka paigaMbara kevaLa yAsAThI pAThavilA kI allAhacyA AdezAnvaye, tyAcyA AdezAce pAlana kele jAve, ANi jara he loka, jyAMnI svataHcyA prANAMvara atyAcAra kelA, tumacyAjavaLa Ale asate ANi tyAMnI allAhajavaLa taubA (kSamA-yAcanA) kelI asatI ANi paigaMbarAMnIhI tyAMcyAsAThI mAphI mAgitalI asatI tara niHsaMzaya, allAha yA lokAMnA moThA mApha karaNArA, dayA karaNArA ADhaLalA asatA.

tevhA zapatha Ahe tumacyA pAlanakartyAcI, he loka (toparyaMta) ImAnadhAraka hoU zakata nAhI, joparyaMta sarva ApasAtIla matabhedAta tumhAlA nyAya-nivADA karaNArA svIkArIta nAhI, maga jo phaisalA tumhI karAla, tyAvara manAtUna nArAjahI nasAveta ANi AjJAdhArakApramANe tyAMnI to mAnya karUna ghyAvA.

ANi jara AmhI tyAMcyAvara he pharja (anivArya) kele asate kI svataHcI hatyA karUna ghyA, kiMvA ApalyA gharAtUna nighUna jA, tara tyAMcyApaikI phAra thoDyAca lokAMnI tyAce pAlana kele asate. ANi jara he teca karatIla jyAcI tyAMnA zikavaNa dilI jAte tara nizcitaca tyAMcyAsAThI phAra cAMgale jhAle asate ANi khUpa majabUtIce Tharale asate.
ANi maga tara AmhI tyAMnA ApalyA javaLUna phAra moThA mobadalA pradAna kelA asatA.
ANi niHsaMzaya tyAMnA satya va saraLa mArga pradAna kelA asatA.

ANi jo koNI allAha ANi rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi vasallama) yAMcyA AdezAce pAlana karIla tara to tyA lokAMsobata rAhIla, jyAMcyAvara allAhane ApalA inAma pharmAvilA Ahe, jase nabI (paigaMbara), siddIka (satyavacanI) ANi zahIda va neka sadAcArI loka. he phAra cAMgale sobatI Aheta.
hI sarvazreSTha allAhatarphe phAra moThI kRpA Ahe ANi allAha paryApta Ahe jJAna rAkhaNArA.
he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! ApalyA bacAvAcI sAmagrI sobata ghyA, maga samUhA-samUhAne kiMvA sarva ekatra miLUna kUca karA.
ANi niHsaMzaya tumacyApaikI kAhI asehI Aheta je saMkoca karatAta, maga jara tumhAlA ekhAde nukasAna pohocate, tevhA mhaNatAta kI allAhane mAjhyAvara moThI kRpA kelI mI tyAMcyAsaha hajara navhato.

ANi jara tumhAlA allAhacI ekhAdI kRpA lAbhalI tara ase bolU lAgatIla kI jaNU tumacyA va tyAMcyA daramyAna kAhI nAteca navhate, mhaNatIla kI, arere! mI tyAMcyAsobata asato tara moThI saphalatA prApta kelI asatI.

tathApi jyA lokAMnI yA jagAce jIvana, maraNottara jIvanA (Akhirata) cyA mobadalyAta vikUna TAkale Ahe, tyAMnI allAhacyA mArgAta laDhale pAhije ANi jo allAhacyA mArgAta laDhatA laDhatA zahIda hoIla kiMvA vijayI hoIla tara khAtrIne AmhI tyAlA phAra cAMgalA mobadalA pradAna karU.

bare kAya kAraNa Ahe kI tumhI allAhacyA mArgAta ANi tyA durbala puruSa striyA ANi lahAna lahAna bAlakAMcyA suTakekaritA na laDhAve? je azA prakAre duA (prArthanA) karIta Aheta kI he AmacyA pAlanahAra! yA atyAcArI lokAMcyA vastItUna AmhAlA bAhera kADhaANi AmacyAsAThI svataH ApalyAtarphe ekhAdA himAyatI (samarthaka nizcita kara, ANi AmacyAsAThI vizeSarityA ApalyAtarphe madata karaNArA pAThava.

jyA lokAMnI ImAna rAkhale Ahe, te tara allAhacyA mArgAta jihAda karatAta ANi jyA lokAMnI kupra (inkAra) kelA Ahe te tara tAgUta (saitAna) cyA mArgAta laDhatAta. tevhA tumhI saitAnAcyA mitrAMzI yuddha karA. niHsaMzaya saitAnAce (DAvapeca) atizaya kamakuvata Aheta.

kAya tumhI tyAMnA nAhI pAhile, jyAMnA Adeza dilA gelA kI ApalyA hAtAMnA rokhUna ThevA ANi namAja niyamita paDhata rAhA ANi jakAta adA karIta rAhA, maga jevhA tyAMnA jihAda (dharmayuddhA) cA Adeza dilA gelA tevhA tyAca veLI tyAMcyAtalA eka samUha, lokAMpAsUna asA bhayabhIta hotA, jaNU allAhace bhaya asAve, kiMbahunA yApekSA adhika ANi mhaNU lAgale, he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! tU AmacyAvara jihAda anivArya kA kele? ANakhI thoDe jIvana AmhAlA kA vyatIta karU dile nAhI? tumhI tyAMnA sAMgA kI yA jagAcA lAbha tara phAra thoDAsA Ahe ANi allAhace bhaya rAkhaNAr2yAMkaritA Akhirata kitItarI uttama Ahe, ANi tumacyAvara ekA dhAgyAitakAhI atyAcAra kelA jANAra nAhI.

tumhI koThehI asA, mRtyu koNatyAhI sthitIta tumhAlA yeUna dharIla, maga tumhI majabUta azA killyAmadhye asAla tarIhI. ANi jara yAMnA ekhAdI bhalAI prApta hote, tevhA mhaNatAta, kI hI sarvazreSTha allAhatarphe Ahe, ANi jara ekhAdI asaphalatA padarI paDate tevhA mhaNU lAgatAta, he tumacyAmuLe jhAle. tyAMnA sAMgA, he sarva kAhI allAhatarphe Ahe. yAMnA jhAle tarI kAya kI ekhAdI goSTa nITa samajUnahI gheta nAhI.

tumhAlA jI kAhI bhalAI lAbhate, tI allAhatarphe Ahe ANi jI kAhI hAni pohacate tI svataH tumacyAkaDUna Ahe. AmhI (he paigaMbara!) tumhAlA samasta mAnavajAtIkaritA rasUla banavUna pAThavile Ahe ANi allAha yA goSTIcI sAkSa deNyAsa puresA Ahe.

jo koNI yA paigaMbara (sallallAhu alaihi vasallama) ce AjJApAlana karIla, tyAne allAhace AjJApAlana kele ANi jo toMDa phiravIla tara AmhI tumhAlA tyAMcyAvara dekharekha ThevaNArA banavUna pAThavile nAhI.

ANi he mhaNatAta kI AmhI AjJApAlana karato paraMtu jevhA tumacyA javaLUna uThUna bAhera paDatAta, tevhA tyAMcyAtalA eka gaTa, jI goSTa tumhI kiMvA tyAne sAMgitalI Ahe tyAvirUddha rAtrI sallAmasalata karatAta. tyAMcA rAtrIMcA vArtAlApa allAha lihUna gheta Ahe. tumhI tyAMcyA bolaNyAkaDe durlakSa karA ANi sarvazreSTha allAhavara bharosA ThevA. kAma banaviNyAsAThI allAha puresA Ahe.
kAya he loka kuraAnavara vicAra-ciMtana karIta nAhI? jara hA graMtha allAhazivAya dusar2yA koNAtarphe asatA tara khAtrIne yAta aneka matabheda ADhaLale asate.

ANi jevhA tyAMnA ekhAdI khabara zAMtI yA bhItIcI pohocate, te lageca ticA pracAra karAyalA suruvAta karatAta. jara yAMnI tI khabara paigaMbara (sallallAhu alaihi vasallama) yAMcyAparyaMta pohacavilI asatI kiMvA ApalyAtalyA jabAbadAra lokAMcyA kAnAvara TAkalI asatI tara ticI jAca-paDatALa karaNAr2yAMnI ticI kharI hakIkata mAhitI karUna ghetalI asatI. ANi jara allAhacI kRpA ANi tyAcI dayAdRSTI tumacyAvara rAhilI nasatI tara kAhI lokAMnA soDUna tumhI sarva saitAnAcyA mAge cAlaNAre banale asate.

tevhA tumhI allAhacyA mArgAta jihAda karIta rAhA. tumhAlA phakta tumacyAsAThIca Adeza dilA jAta Ahe. ImAnadhArakAMnA AkarSita karIta rAhA. phAra zakya Ahe kI, allAha inkArI lokAMcA hallA rokhela ANi allAha moThA zaktizAlI Ahe ANi zikSA deNyAtahI phAra kaThora Ahe.

jo manuSya ekhAde puNya-kArya ANi satkarma karaNyAcI ziphArasa karela tara tyAlAhI tyAcA kAhI hissA miLela ANi jo durAcAra va duSkarma karaNyAcI ziphArasa karela, tyAcyAsAThIhI tyAta eka hissA Ahe, ANi allAha pratyeka goSTIce sAmarthya rAkhato.
ANi jevhA tumhAlA salAma kelA jAIla tara tumhI tyApekSA cAMgale pratyuttara dyA kiMvA teca zabda paratUna bolA. niHsaMzaya, allAha pratyeka goSTIcA hizoba gheNAra Ahe.

allAha to Ahe, jyAcyAzivAya dusarA koNI (saccA) upAsya nAhI. to tumhA sarvAMnA nizcitaca kayAmatacyA divazI ekatra karIla, jyAcyA yeNyAbAbata kAhIca zaMkA nAhI. allAhapekSA jAsta satya vacana ANakhI koNAce asU zakela?

tumhAlA jhAle tarI kAya kI munAphikAM (varakaraNI musalamAnAM) bAbata dona gaTAMta vibhAgale jAta AhAta. tyAMnA tara tyAMcyA karatUtIMmuLe allAhane toMDaghazI pADale Ahe. AtA kAya tumhI he icchitA kI tyAlA mArga dAkhavAvA jyAlA allAhane mArgabhraSTa kele Ahe? tevhA jyAlA allAha mArgabhraSTa karIla, tyAcyAsAThI tumhAlA kadhIhI, koNatAhI mArga disUna yeNAra nAhI.

yAMnA tara manApAsUna vATate kI, jase te kAphira Aheta tase tumhIhI tyAMcyAsArakhe ImAnAcA inkAra karU lAgAve ANi tumhI sarva ekasamAna vhAve, yAstava tyAMcyApaikI koNAlA ApalA kharAkhurA mitra banavU nakA, joparyaMta te allAhacyA mArgAta hijarata (deza-tyAga) karIta nAhIta. maga jara (yApAsUna) toMDa phiravatIla tara tyAMnA dharA ANi ThAra karA, jithedekhIla ADhaLatIla. khabaradAra! tyAMcyApaikI koNAlAhI ApalA mitra ANi sahAyyaka samajUna gheU nakA.

paraMtu je tyA lokAMzI nAte rAkhatAta, jyAMcyA ANi tumacyA daramyAna samajhotA jhAlelA asela kiMvA te loka je tumacyA javaLa yetAta, jyAMcI mane saMkucita jhAlI Aheta kI tumacyAzI laDhAve kI ApalyA lokAMzI laDhAve. allAhane icchile asate tara yAMnA tumacyAvara varcasva pradAna kele asate ANi te avazya tumacyAzI laDhale asate. tevhA jara ase loka tumacyApAsUna dUra rAhatIla ANi laDhAI na karatIla ANi tumacyAkaDe saMdhI-samajhotyAcA prastAva mAMDatIla tara (azA sthitIta) allAhane tumacyAsAThI, tyAMcyAvirUddha laDhAIcA koNatAhI mArga ThevalA nAhI.

tumhAlA dusare kAhI asehI loka ADhaLatIla, je tumacyApAsUna ANi ApalyA jamAtIcyA lokAMpAsUna surakSita rAhU icchitAta, paraMtu jevhA upadravAkaDe tyAMnA vaLavile jAte tara tyAta toMDaghazI paDatAta. jara te tumacyApAsUna haTale nAhIta ANi tumacyAzI samajhotA na karatIla ANi Apale hAta na rokhatIla tara te jithe sApaDatIla tithe tyAMnA dharA ANi ThAra karA. heca te loka Aheta, jyAMcyAbAbata AmhI tumhAlA khule pramANa dile Ahe.

koNatyAhI ImAnadhArakAkaritA he ucita nAhI kI tyAne ekhAdyA ImAnadhArakAcI hatyA karAvI. paraMtu ajANatepaNI tase jhAlyAsa goSTa vegaLI. ANi jo manuSya ekhAdyA ImAnadhArakAcI cukIne hatyA karIla tara tyAbaddala tyAlA eka ImAnadhAraka gulAma (kiMvA dAsI) mukta karaNe ANi mAralyA gelelyA vyaktIcyA nAtevAIkAMnA raktAcI kiMmata deNe Avazyaka Ahe. paraMtu tyAne mApha kele tara goSTa vegaLI. ANi jyAcI hatyA kelI gelI to manuSya jara tumacyA zatrU jamAtIcA, paNa muslima asela tara eka muslima gulAma mukta karaNe Avazyaka Ahe ANi jara ThAra kelI gelelI vyaktI tyA jamAtIcI Ahe jyAcyA ANi tumacyA (ImAnadhArakAMcyA) daramyAna samajhotA Ahe tara raktAcI kiMmata tyAcyA nAtevAIkAMnA dyAvI lAgela, taseca eka ImAnadhAraka (muslima) gulAmahI mukta karAvA lAgela ANi jyAlA tasA na ADhaLela, tyAlA dona mahine satata roje ThAvAve lAgatIla allAhakaDUna mApha karUna gheNyAsAThI ANi allAha jANaNArA va hikamata bALagaNArA Ahe.

ANi jo koNI ekhAdyA ImAnadhArakAlA jANUnabujUna ThAra karIla, tara tyAcI zikSA jahannama Ahe, jyAta to nehamIkaritA rAhIla, tyAcyAvara allAhacA prakopa Ahe. allAhane tyAcA dhiHkkAra kelA Ahe ANi tyAcyAsAThI phAra moThI sajA-yAtanA tayAra karUna ThevalI Ahe.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! jevhA tumhI allAhacyA mArgAta nighAla, tevhA nITa jAca-paDatALa karUna gheta jA ANi jo tumhAlA salAma karUna bolela tyAlA tumhI asehI mhaNU nakA kI tU ImAnadhAraka nAhIsa. tumhI aihika jIvanAcyA sukha-sAdhanAMcyA zodhAta AhAta, tevhA allAhajavaLa vipula sukha-sAdhane Aheta. pUrvI tumhIsuddhA aseca hote, maga allAhane tumacyAvara anugraha (upakAra) kelA. yAstava tumhI nITa chAna-bina (caukazI) karUna gheta jA. niHsaMzaya allAha tumacyA karmAMnA cAMgalyA prakAre jANato.

je ImAnadhAraka akAraNa svastha basUna rAhatIla ANi je allAhacyA mArgAta ApalyA prANAne va dhanAne jihAda karata asatIla tara doghe samAna TharaNAra nAhIta. allAhane tyAMnA, je Apale prANa ANi dhana lAvUna jihAda karatAta, svastha basUna rAhaNAr2yAMvara darjAcyA dRSTIne zreSThatA pradAna kelI Ahe. ANi tase pAhatA neka mobadalyAcA vAyadA tara pratyekAlA dilA Ahe. tathApi allAhane jihAda karaNAr2yAMnA, svastha basUna rAhaNAr2yAMvara mahAna mobadalyAcI zreSThatA pradAna kelI Ahe.
ApalyAtarphe darjAcIhI, mAphIcIhI ANi dayA-kRpecIhI, ANi allAha moThA mApha karaNArA, dayA karaNArA Ahe.

je loka svataHvara atyAcAra karatAta, jevhA pharizte tyAMce prANa tAbyAta ghetAta tevhA mhaNatAta kI tumhI koNatyA avastheta hote? te mhaNatAta, AmhI dharatIvara kamajora hoto. tevhA pharizte vicAratAta, kAya allAhacI jamIna vizAla, vyApaka navhatI kI tumhI ticyAta sthalAMtara kele asate. azAca lokAMce ThikANa jahannama Ahe ANi te moThe vAITa ThikANa Ahe.
paraMtu je puruSa, jyA striyA ANi lahAna mule lAcAra-vivaza Aheta, je kasalIhI upAyayojanA karU zakata nAhIta ANi nA mArga jANatAta.
tevhA phAra zakya Ahe kI allAha tyAMnA mApha karIla ANi allAha moThA mApha karaNArA, kSamAzIla Ahe.

ANi jo koNI allAhacyA mArgAta hijarata (deza-tyAga) karIla, tara tyAlA dharatIvara nivAsAkaritA khUpa vistRta jAgA miLela ANi khUpa samRddhIhI. ANi jo ApalyA gharApAsUna allAha ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAkaDe hijarata karIla, maga tyAlA mRtyune yeUna gAThAve, tarIdekhIla tyAcA mobadalA allAhajavaLa nizcita Ahe ANi allAha moThA mApha karaNArA, dayAvAna Ahe.

ANi jevhA jaminIvara pravAsa karIta asAla tevhA namAja kasra karaNyAta (cAra rakaatacI namAja dona rakaata paDhaNyAta) tumacyAvara kAhI gunhA nAhI, jara tumhAlA he bhaya asela kI kAphira (zraddhAhIna) tumhAlA trAsa detIla. niHsaMzaya kAphira loka tumace khule vairI Aheta.
