ANi jevhA tumhI tyAMcyA daramyAna asAla ANi tyAMcyAsAThI namAja kAyama karAla, tevhA tyAMcyAtalA eka gaTa tumacyAsobata zastrAnizI sajja ubhA rAhilA pAhije, maga jevhA he sajadA karUna ghetIla, tevhA yAMnI tethUna haTAve, va tumacyA pAThImAge yAve ANi maga dusarA gaTa, jyAne adyApa namAja adA kelI nAhI tyAne (puDhe) yAve ANi tumacyAsobata namAja adA karAvI ANi ApalA bacAva ANi ApalI hatyAre sobata bALagAvita. kAphira tara icchitAta kI tumhI kasehI karUna ApalyA hatyArAMpAsUna va ApalyA sAmugrIpAsUna gAphIla vhAve tara maga tyAMnI acAAnaka tumacyAvara hallA karAvA, mAtra jevhA tumhAlA kAhI trAsa-yAtanA asela kiMvA joradAra pAUsa athavA AjArapaNAmuLe ApalI hatyAre utaravUna ThevAla tara azA veLI tumacyAvara kAhI gunhA nAhI. ANi ApalyA bacAvAcI sAmugrI sobata rAkhata jA. niHsaMzaya allAhane inkAra karaNAr2yAMsAThI apamAnadAyaka zikSA tayAra karUna ThevalI Ahe.

maga jevhA tumhI namAja paDhUna ghyAla jevhA uThatA basatA ANi pahuDalelyA sthitIta allAhace smaraNa karIta rAhA ANi zAMtIpUrNa sthitI asela tara namAja kAyama karA. niHsaMzaya, namAja ImAnadhArakAMvara nizcita ANi nirdhArIta veLevara adA karaNe pharja (anivArya) kele gele Ahe.

ANi tyA lokAMcA pAThalAga karaNyAta ALasa karU nakA. jara tumhAlA trAsa-yAtanA hota Ahe tara tyAMnAhI trAsa-yAtanA hote, jazI tumhAlA hote, ANi tumhI allAhakaDUna tyA AzA-apekSA bALagatA, jyA te bALagata nAhIta, ANi allAha sarva kAhI jANaNArA, hikamatazAlI Ahe.

niHsaMzaya, AmhI tumacyAkaDe satyAsaha graMtha avatarIta kelA Ahe, yAsAThI kI tumhI lokAMcyA daramyAna tyAlA anusarUna nyAya-nivADA karAvA, jyAbAbata allAhane tumhAlA avagata kele ANi apahAra karaNAr2yAMce samarthaka banU nakA.
ANi allAhajavaLa kSamA-yAcanA karIta rAhA. niHsaMzaya allAha moThA mApha karaNArA, dayA karaNArA Ahe.
ANi azA lokAMzI bAjU gheUna bhAMDU nakA je svataH ApalAca vizvAsaghAta karatAta. niHsaMzaya, dhokebAja vizvAsaghAtakIzI allAha prema rAkhata nAhI.
te lokAMpAsUna tara lapatAta, paraMtu allAhapAsUna lapU zakata nAhI. to tyAMcyAsobata Ahe jevhA te rAtrI apriya goSTIMcyA yojanA AkhatAta ANi allAhane tyAMcyA kAravAyAMnA gherA TAkalelA Ahe.
he tumhI AhAta kI tyAMcyA hakkAta yA jagAta vAda ghAlatA, paraMtu kayAmatacyA divazI tyAMcyAtarphe koNa hujjata ghAlIla ANi koNa tyAMcA samarthaka banUna ubhA rAhIla?
ANi jo koNI vAITa karma karIla kiMvA svataH ApalyAvara atyAcAra karIla, naMtara allAhajavaLa mAphI mAgIla tara tyAlA allAha mApha karaNArA, dayA karaNArA ADhaLUna yeIla.
ANi jo gunhA karato, tara tyA gunhyAce ojhe tyAcyAca (zirA) vara Ahe ANi allAha sarva kAhI jANaNArA, hikamatazAlI Ahe.
ANi jo koNI duSkarma karato, maga ekhAdyA niraparAdhIvara tyAcA Aropa Thevato, tara tyAne moThe kubhAMDa(moeThA ALa ghetalA) racale ANi phAra moThA gunhA kelA.

ANi jara tumacyAvara allAhacI dayA-kRpA rAhilI nasatI, tara tyAMcyA ekA gaTAne tumhAlA mArgabhraSTa karaNyAce kArasthAna racale hote, paraMtu te svataHlAca mArgabhraSTa karatAta ANi te tumhAlA kAhIca nukasAna pohacavU zakata nAhI ANi allAhane tumacyAvara graMtha ANi jJAna utaravile Ahe ANi tumhI je jANata navhate te jJAna pradAna kele Ahe ANi tumacyAvara allAhacI phAra moThI kRpA Ahe.

tyAMcyA bahuteka gupta kAAnagoSTIMmadhye kasalIhI bhalAI nAhI. paraMtu jyAne upakAra, nekI kiMvA lokAMmadhye sudhAraNA hoNyAsAThI Adeza dilA ANi jo he kArya allAhacI marjI (prasannatA) prApta karaNyAsAThI karela, AmhI kharokhara tyAlA phAra moThA mobadalA pradAna karU.

ANi jo koNI, saraLa va satya mArga spaSTa jhAlyAnaMtara paigaMbara (muhammada sallallAhu alaihi vasallama) yAMcA virodha karIla ANi ImAnadhArakAMcyA mArgAzivAya anya mArgAvara cAlela tara AmhI tyAlA tyAca dizene, jikaDe to phirata asela, vaLavUna TAkU, maga tyAlA AmhI jahannamamadhye phekUna deU ANi te moThe vAITa sthAna Ahe.

allAha, ApalyAsaha dusar2yA koNAlA sahabhAgI kele jANe kadApi mApha karaNAra nAhI ANi yAkherIja itara aparAdhAMnA, to jyAlA icchila mApha karIla ANi jyAne allAhasaha anya koNAlA sahabhAgI Tharavile to (sanmArgApAsUna) phAra dUra bahakata gelA.
he tara allAhalA soDUna kevaLa devIMnA pukAratAta ANi vastutaH he dhiHkkAralelyA duSTa saitAnAlA pukAratAta.
jyAcA allAhane dhiHkkAra kelA Ahe ANi tyAne (saitAnAne) mhaTale Ahe kI mI tujhyA dAsAMmadhUna ApalA TharAvika hissA nizcita gheIna.

ANi tyAMnA saraLa mArgApAsUna bhaTakavita rAhIna ANi tyAMnA khoTyA AzA deta rAhIla ANi tyAMnA zikavaNa deIna kI janAvarAMce kAna cirA ANi tyAMnA sAMgena kI allAhane banavilele svarUpa vikRta karA. aikA! jo, allAhalA soDUna saitAnAlA ApalA mitra banavIla tara to ughaDa azA toTyAta rAhIla.
to tyAMcyAzI toMDI vAyade karata rAhIla ANi tyAMnA bhramAcyA hiravyA bAgA dAkhavita rAhIla (paraMtu lakSAta ThevA) saitAnAne tyAMcyAzI kelele vAyade pUrNapaNe dhokA Ahe (mRgajaLa) Ahe.
heca te loka Aheta, jyAMce ThikANa jahannama Ahe. jithUna tyAMnA kadApi suTakA miLaNAra nAhI.

ANi jyA lokAMnI ImAna rAkhale, ANi satkarma kele AmhI tyAMnA tyA jannatImadhye dAkhala karU, jyAMcyA khAlI naharI (pravAha) vAhata Aheta. jithe te nehamI nehamI rAhatIla. hA allAhacA vAyadA Ahe jo niHsaMzaya kharA Ahe. ANi allAhapekSA, ApalyA kathanAta saccA ANakhI koNa asU zakato?

tumacyA icchA-AkAMkSAMnI ANi graMthadhArakAMcyA icchA-AkAMkSAMnI kAhIhI hoNAra nAhI. jo vAITa karma karIla, tyAcI zikSA to prApta karIla ANi tyAlA allAhakherIja ApalA koNI mitra ANi madata karaNArA ADhaLaNAra nAhI.
ANi jo ImAnadhAraka asela, maga to puruSa aso kiMvA strI ANi to neka AcaraNa karIla, niHsaMzaya ase loka jannatamadhye dAkhala hotIla ANi tiLAitakAhI tyAcA hakka mAralA jANAra nAhI.

ANi dIna-dharma saMdarbhAta tyAhUna cAMgalA koNa asU zakato, jo allAhakaritA pUrNataH AtmasamarpaNa karIla ANi to neka-sadAcArIhI asela ANi ibrAhImacyA dIna-dharmAce anusaraNa kelelA asela je ekAgra hote ANi ibrAhImalA allAhane ApalA mitra banavile Ahe.
ANi je kAhI AkAzAMmadhye, ANi jaminIvara Ahe, sarva allAhaceca Ahe ANi allAhane pratyeka cIja-vastUlA ApalyA gher2yAta ghetale Ahe.

te loka striyAMbAbata tumhAlA vicAratAta. tumhI tyAMnA sAMgA kI svataH allAha tumhAlA tyAMcyAviSayI Adeza deto ANi je kAhI graMthAta (kuraAnAta) tumacyAsamora vAcale jAte, tyA anAtha striyAM (mulIM) viSayI, jyAMnA tumhI tyAMcA anivArya hakka deta nAhI ANi tyAMcyAzI vivAha karU icchitA ANi kamajora mulAMviSayI ANi he kI tumhI anAthAMbAbata nyAya karA ANi tumhI jedekhIla satkarma karAla allAha te cAMgalyA prakAre jANaNArA Ahe.

ANi jara ekhAdyA patnIlA ApalyA patIkaDUna upekSA ANi durlakSa hoNyAce bhaya asela tara tyA doghAMnI ApasAta samajhotA karUna gheNyAta kAhI vAITa nAhI ANi samajhotA adhika cAMgalA Ahe ANi lobha tara pratyeka manAta samAviSTa kelA gelA Ahe ANi jara tumhI upakAra karAla ANi allAhace bhaya rAkhUna AcaraNa aMgikArAla tara allAha tumacyA pratyeka karmAlA jANUna Ahe.

ANi tumhI manApAsUna icchA kelI tarIhI patnIMcyA daramyAna kadhIhI nyAya karU zakaNAra nAhIta. yAstava tumhI (ekIcyAcakaDe) pUrNapaNe na jhukAve kI dusarIlA adhara loMbakaLata soDUna dyAve ANi jara tumhI sudhAraNA karUna ghyAla, ANi (anyAya karaNyApAsUna) svataHlA vAcavAla tara khAtrIne allAha moThA mApha karaNArA, dayA karaNArA Ahe.
ANi jara donhI vibhakta jhAle tara allAha ApalyA dayA-kRpene doghAMnA niHspRha (beparvA) karIla ANi allAha moThA vyApakatA rAkhaNArA hikamata bALagaNArA Ahe.

ANi AkAzAMce va jaminIce sarva kAhI allAhaceca Ahe ANi AmhI tumacyA pUrvIce loka, jyAMnA graMtha dilA gelA hotA, tyAMnA ANi tumhAlA hAca Adeza dilA kI allAhace bhaya rAkhA ANi jara tumhI mAnale nAhI tara niHsaMzaya je kAhI AkAzAMmadhye va jaminIvara Ahe sarva allAhaceca Ahe ANi allAha koNAcI garaja nasalelA, prazaMsanIya Ahe.
ANi je kAhI AkAzAMmadhye va jaminIvara Ahe, sarva allAhaceca Ahe ANi kArya taDIsa neNyAsa allAha puresA Ahe.
lokAMno! jara allAhane icchile tara tumhAlA sarvAMnA haTavUna deIla, ANi dusar2yAMnA ANIla ANi allAha ase karaNyAsa pUrNataH samartha Ahe.
jo manuSya yA jagAcA mobadalA icchita asela tara (lakSAta ThevA kI) allAhajavaLa yA jagAcA va AkhiratacA (doghAMcAhI) mobadalA hajara Ahe ANi allAha aikaNArA va pAhaNArA Ahe.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! nyAyAvara majabUtIne kAyama rAhaNAre ANi allAhakaritA kharI sAkSa deNAre banA, maga to sAkSa svataH tumacyAvirUddha ANi tumace mAtA-pitA va nAtevAIkAMcyA virUddha kA asenA, maga to manuSya dhanavAna aso kiMvA garIba aso tara tyA doghAMpekSA allAhace nAte khUpa (javaLace) Ahe. yAstava nyAya karaNyAta manAlA vATela te karU nakA, ANi jara cukIce nivedana dyAla kiMvA na mAnAla tara (jANUna asA kI) allAha tumacyA pratyeka karmAlA jANUna Ahe.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! allAha ANi tyAce paigaMbara (sallallAhu alaihi vasallama) ANi tyA graMthA (pavitra kuraAna) vara jo tyAne Apale paigaMbara (sallallAhu alaihi vasallama) yAMcyAvara avatarIta kelA Ahe ANi tyA graMthAMvara je yApUrvI avatarIta kele gele, ImAna rAkhA ANi jo allAha ANi tyAcyA phariztyAMnA ANi tyAcyA graMthAMnA, tyAcyA paigaMbarAMnA ANi kayAmatacyA divasAlA na mAnela to vATa cukUna dUra gelA.
niHsaMzaya, jyAMnI ImAna rAkhale maga inkAra kelA, punhA ImAna rAkhale maga inkAra kelA, inkAra karaNyAta puDheca jAta rAhile, allAha tyAMnA kadApi mApha karaNAra nAhI ANi nA saraLa mArga dAkhavila.
munAphika lokAMnA (varakaraNI musalamAnAMnA) duHkhadAyaka zikSA-yAtanecA zubha-samAcAra dyA.
je ImAnadhArakAMnA soDUna inkArI lokAMnA ApalA mitra banavitAta kAya te tyAMcyAzI dostI karUna mAna-pratiSThA miLavU icchitAta? (lakSAta ThevA) sarva mAna-pratiSThA allAhakaritA Ahe.

ANi allAhane tumacyAsAThI ApalyA graMthAta (pavitra kuraAnAta) hA Adeza utaravilA Ahe kI jevhA tumhI allAhacyA AyatIMzI inkAra ANi thaTTA-maskarI hota asalyAce aikAla tevhA tyAMcyAsobata tyA baiThakIta basU nakA joparyaMta te dusar2yA goSTIvara bolata nAhIta kAraNa tyA veLI tumhI tyAMcyAsamAna TharAla. niHsaMzaya allAha, munAphikAMnA ANi inkArI lokAMnA jahannamamadhye ekatra karaNAra Ahe.

je tumacyA bAbatIta pratikSA karatAta, maga jara allAhatarphe tumacA vijaya asela tara he mhaNatAta kI, kAya AmhI tumacyAsobata navhato? ANi jara kAphira lokAMnA thoDIzIhI saphalatA miLAlI tara mhaNatAta kI, kAya AmhI tumhAlA (rakSaNaAsAThI) gherA TAkalA navhatA, ANi ImAnadhArakAMpAsUna tumacA bacAva kelA navhatA? tevhA, kayAmatacyA divazI allAhaca tumacyA daramyAna phaisalA karIla ANi allAha kadhIhI kAphirAMnA (inkArI lokAMnA) ImAnadhArakAMvara varcasvazAlI hoU deNAra nAhI.

niHsaMzaya, munAphika (dutoMDI) loka allAhazI kapaTa karIta Aheta, ANi allAha tyAMnA tyA kapaTanItIcA mobadalA deNAra Ahe ANi jevhA namAjasAThI ubhe rAhatAta tara kevaLa lokAMnA dAkhaviNyAsAThI ANi allAhace smaraNa phAra kamI karatAta.

te madhalyAmadheca (zaMkA-saMzayAcyA) duvidhApUrNa avastheta Aheta nA pUrNapaNe tyAMcyA bAjUlA ANi nA ucitarityA yAMcyA bAjUlA, ANi jyAlA allAha saraLa mArgApAsUna dUra karIla, tara tyAcyAsAThI tumhAlA koNatAhI mArga ADhaLaNAra nAhI.
he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! ImAnadhArakAMnA soDUna inkArI lokAMnA ApalA mitra banavU nakA. kAya tumhI ase icchitA kI ApalyAvara allAhatarphe (zikSece) khule pramANa kAyama karUna ghyAve?
niHsaMzaya, munAphika loka tara jahannamacyA sarvAMta khAlacyA darjAta jAtIla. nizcitaca tumhAlA tyAMcA koNatAhI madata karaNArA ADhaLaNAra nAhI.

paraMtu jara mAphI mAgatIla ANi Apale AcaraNa sudhAratIla ANi allAhavara pUrNa ImAna rAkhatIla ANi prAmANikapaNe allAhakaritAca dIna-dharmAce kArya karatIla tara he loka ImAnadhArakAMcyA sobata Aheta. allAha ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMnA phAra moThA mobadalA pradAna karIla.
allAha tumhAlA zikSA-yAtanA deUna kAya karIla jara tumhI kRtajJazIla rAhAla ANi ImAnAsaha rAhAla ANi allAha phAra kadara karaNArA ANi sarva kAhI jANaNArA Ahe.
uMca svarAta vAITa goSTa jAhIra karaNe allAhalA pasaMta nAhI, tathApi atyAcArapIDitAlA yAcI mubhA Ahe, ANi allAha aikaNArA va jANaNArA Ahe.
jara tumhI ekhAde satkarma ughaDapaNe karA kiMvA lapavUna karA athavA ekhAdyA vAITa goSTIlA mApha karAla tara niHsaMzaya allAha mApha karaNArA, sAmarthyazAlI Ahe.

je loka allAha ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAMvara ImAna rAkhata nAhIta ANi ase icchitAta kI allAha ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAMcyA daramyAna durAvA nirmANa karAvA ANi mhaNatAta kI AmhI kAhIMnA mAnato ANi kAhIMnA mAnata nAhI. ANi yAcyA daramyAna eka vegaLA mArga kADhU icchitAta.
niHsaMzaya, he sarva loka pakke kAphira Aheta ANi azA inkArI lokAMsAThI AmhI atizaya kaThora zikSA-yAtanA tayAra karUna ThevalI Ahe.

ANi jyA lokAMnI allAha ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAMvara ImAna rAkhale, ANi tyAMcyApaikI koNAcyA daramyAna pharaka kelA nAhI, tara azAca lokAMnA allAha tyAMcA purepUra mobadalA deIla ANi allAha moThA mApha karaNArA dayA karaNArA Ahe.

(he paigaMbara!) graMthadhAraka tumacyAjavaLa azI mAgaNI karatAta kI tumhI tyAMcyAvara AkAzAtUna ekhAdA graMtha utaravUna dAkhavA tevhA tyAMnI mUsAkaDe yApekSA moThI mAgaNI kelI hotI ANi mhaTale kI AmhAlA spaSTapaNe allAhalA dAkhavA. maga tyAMnA tyAMcyA yA atyAcArAmuLe vijene yeUna gherale, maga tyAMnI spaSTa nizANyA yeUna pohacalyAvarahI vAsarAlA upAsya banavile. tarIhI AmhI tyAMnA mApha kele ANi mUsA yAMnA spaSTa pramANa pradAna kele.

ANi tyAMcyAkaDUna vacana gheNyAkaritA, AmhI tUra parvatAlA tyAMcyAvara adhAMtarIta Thevale ANi tyAMnA Adeza dilA kI sajadA karIta daravAjyAta praveza karA ANi hAhI Adeza dilA kI zanivAracyA divazI ullaMghana karUna nakA ANi AmhI tyAMcyAkaDUna agadI pakkA vAyadA ghetalA.

maga tyAMnI AmacyAzI jo vAyadA kelA hotA, tyApAsUna mukarale ANi allAhacyA AyatIMcA inkAra karU lAgale, yethaparyaMta kI allAhacyA paigaMbarAMnA nAhaka ThAra mArale ANi asehI mhaNU lAgale hote kI AmacI mane AvaraNAkhAlI Aheta, (ase nAhI) kiMbahunA allAhane tyAMcyA inkAra karaNyApAyI tyAMcyA hRdayAMnA moharabaMda kele Ahe. tevhA tyAMcyApaikI phAra thoDeca loka ImAna rAkhatAta.
ANi tyAMcyA inkAra karaNyAmuLe ANi mariyamavara mithyA Aropa ThevaNyAmuLe.

ANi tyAMcyA yA kathanAmuLe kI AmhI mariyamace putra IsA masIhacI hatyA karUna TAkalI, je allAhace paigaMbara hote, vAstavika nA tara tyAMnI hatyA kelI, nA tyAMnA sULAvara caDhavile, paraMtu tyAMcyAsAThI IsAcI chabI banavilI gelI nizcitaca IsA yAMcyAviSayI matabheda karaNAre saMzayAta paDale Aheta. kevaLa aTakaLIcyA goSTIvara cAlaNyAkherIja tyAMnA kasalehI jJAna nAhI. evaDhe nizcita kI tyAMcA vadha kelA gelA nAhI.
kiMbahunA allAhane tyAMnA ApalyAkaDe ucalUna ghetale ANi allAha jabaradasta hikamata bALagaNArA Ahe.
graMthadhArakAMpaikI koNI asA nasela jo (hajarata) IsA yAMcyA mRtyupUrvI tyAMcyAvara ImAna na rAkhela, ANi kayAmatacyA divazI te tyAMcyAvara sAkSI rAhatIla.
yahUdI lokAMcyA julUma-atyAcArAmuLe AmhI tyAMcyAvara halAla (vaidha) cIja vastUMnA, harAma (avaidha) karUna TAkale ANi tyAMce allAhacyA mArgApAsUna lokAMnA aDavaNyAmuLe.

ANi tyAMcyA vyAja gheNyAmuLe, jyApAsUna tyAMnA rokhale gele hote, ANi lokAMcA mAla (dhana-daulata) nAhaka haDapa kelyAmuLe, ANi AmhI yAMcyAtalyA kAphirAMkaritA duHkhadAyaka zikSA-yAtanA tayAra karUna ThevalI Ahe.

paraMtu tyAMcyAta je paripakva ANi majabUta jJAna rAkhaNAre Aheta, ANi ImAnadhAraka Aheta, je tyAvara ImAna rAkhatAta, je tumacyAkaDe utaravile gele, ANi je tumacyApUrvI utaravile gele ANi namAja kAyama karaNAre Aheta, jakAta adA karaNAre Aheta, allAhavara ANi kayAmatacyA divasAvara ImAna rAkhaNAre Aheta. he ase loka Aheta, jyAMnA AmhI phAra moThA mobadalA pradAna karU.

niHsaMzaya, AmhI tumacyAkaDe tyAcapramANe saMdeza avatarIta kelA Ahe, jyApramANe nUha (alaihissalAma) ANi tyAMcyA naMtaracyA paigaMbarAMkaDe AmhI saMdeza avatarIta kelA, ANi ibrAhIma ANi ismAIla ANi isahAka ANi yAkUba ANi tyAMcyA saMtatIvara ANi IsA va ayyUba ANi yUnusa ANi hAruna ANi sulemAna yAMcyAkaDe ANi AmhI dAUda (alaihissalAma) yAMnA jabUra (graMtha) pradAna kelA.
ANi tumacyA pUrvIcyA aneka paigaMbarAMce vRttAMta AmhI tumhAlA sAMgitale Aheta, ANi bahuteka paigaMbarAMce sAMgitale nAhIta ANi (hajarata) mUsA yAMcyAzI allAhane saraLa saMbhASaNa kele.

(AmhI yA sarvAMnA) zubha vArtA deNArA ANi saceta karaNArA rasUla (paigaMbara) banavile, yAsAThI kI paigaMbarAMnA pAThavilyAnaMtara lokAMnA ekhAde nimitta vA sababa allAhapuDhe mAMDaNyAcI saMdhI rAhU naye ANi allAha moThA jabaradasta ANi hikamatazAlI Ahe.
je kAhI tumacyAkaDe utaravile gele Ahe, tyAviSayI allAha svataH sAkSa deto kI te tyAne ApalyA jJAnAne avatarIta kele Ahe ANi phariztedekhIla sAkSa detAta ANi sAkSa deNyAsa kevaLa allAha puresA Ahe.
niHsaMzaya, jyAMnI inkAra kelA ANi allAhacyA mArgA (dIna-dharmA) pAsUna rokhale, tara te khUpa dUra bhaTakale.
niHsaMzaya, jyAMnI inkAra kelA ANi julUma-atyAcAra kelA tara allAha tyAMnA mApha karaNArA nAhI ANi nA tyAMnA ekhAdA sanmArga dAkhavIla.
paraMtu jahannamacA mArga, jyAta te sadAsarvadA rAhatIla ANi he allAhakaritA phAra sope Ahe.

loka ho! tumacyAjavaLa tumacyA pAlanakartyAtarphe satya gheUna paigaMbara (muhammada sallallAhu alaihi vasallama) Ale. tyAMcyAvara ImAna rAkhA. tumacyAsAThI adhika cAMgale Ahe ANi jara tumhI inkAra kelA tara AkAzAMmadhye va dharatIvara je kAhI Ahe sarva allAhaceca Ahe ANi allAha sarvajJa ANi hikamatazAlI Ahe.

he graMthadhArakAMno! ApalyA dIna-dharmAbAbata atizayoktI karU nakA, ANi allAhacyA saMbaMdhAne satya teca bolA. niHsaMzaya mariyamaputra IsA masIha kevaLa allAhace rasUla ANi kalimA Ahe jo mariyamakaDe pAThavilA gelA ANi tyAcyAtarphe AtmA Ahe, yAstava allAha ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAMvara ImAna rAkhA ANi allAha tIna Ahe ase mhaNU nakA. he mhaNaNe thAMbavA yAtaca tumace hita Ahe. niHsaMzaya tumacA upAsya kevaLa eka allAha Ahe. to pAka-pavitra Ahe, yApAsUna kI tyAcI ekhAdI saMtAna asAvI. tyAcyAcakaritA Ahe je kAhI AkAzAMmadhye va dharatIvara Ahe ANi allAha kAma banaviNyAsAThI puresA Ahe.

masIha, allAhace dAsa hoNyAta kadhIhI tiraskAra karIta nAhIta ANi nA nikaTace pharizte, ANi jo allAhacI upAsanA karaNyApAsUna tiraskAra va ghameMDa karIla tara to tyA sarvAMnA ApalyAkaDe ekatra karIla.

tevhA, jyA lokAMnI ImAna rAkhale ANi satkarma karIta rAhile, tyAMnA tyAMcA purepUra mobadalA deIla, ANi ApalyA kRpene ANakhI jAsta pradAna karIla, paraMtu jyAMnI tiraskAra kelA ANi ghameMDa kelI tyAMnA duHkhadAyaka zikSA-yAtanA deIla, maga tyAMnA allAhazivAya ApalA koNI mitra va madata karaNArA ADhaLaNAra nAhI.
lokAMno! tumacyAjavaLa tumacyA pAlanakartyAtarphe pramANa yeUna pohacale Ahe ANi AmhI tumacyAkaDe divya teja (pavitra kuraAna) avatarIta kele Ahe.
maga jyA lokAMnI allAhavara ImAna rAkhale ANi tyAlA majabUtapaNe dharale tara allAha tyAMnA ApalyA kRpAchatrAta gheIla ANi tyAMnA ApalyAkaDe yeNyAcA saraLa mArga dAkhavIla.

te tumhAlA kalAlAviSayI (arthAta AI-bApa ANi saMtatI nasalelyA mayatAviSayI) vicAratAta. tumhI sAMgA, allAha kalAlAviSayI Adeza deto kI jara ekhAdA puruSa maraNa pAvela ANi tyAcyA vArasAMmadhye koNI saMtAna nasela ANi tyAlA eka bahINa asela tara ticyAsAThI mayatAne mAge soDalelyA dhana-saMpattIcA ardhA hissA Ahe ANi to tyA (bahiNI) cA vArasa Ahe. jara tyAlA ekhAdI saMtatI nasela, jara dona bahiNI asatIla tara tyA doghIMsAThI dona tRtiyAMza hissA Ahe. tyAtUna je to soDUna gelA. ANi jara bhAU bahiNI donhI asatIla puruSahI ANi striyAhI tara puruSAkaritA, dona striyAMcyA hizyAitakA hissA Ahe. allAha tumacyAsAThI spaSTa sAMgata Ahe, yAsAThI kI tumhI (itastataH) bhaTakata phirU naye ANi allAha sarva kAhI jANaNArA Ahe.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! Apale vacana-karAra pUrNa karA. tumacyAsAThI cAra pAyAMce pALIva pazU halAla (vaidha) kele gele Aheta, tyAMcyAkherIja, je vAcUna tumhAlA aikavile jAta Aheta. paraMtu eharAmacyA sthitIta zikAra karU nakA. niHsaMzaya allAhane je icchile tyAcA Adeza deto.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! allAhacyA dharma-pratikAMcA (zaAIracA) avamAna karU nakA, nA AdaraNIya mahinyAMcA, nA kurbAnIkaritA harama (kAbAgRhA) paryaMta nelyA jANAr2yA ANi gaLyAta paTTA ghAtalelyA janAvarAcA, nA AdaraNIya gharA (kAbAgRhA) kaDe jANAr2yA lokAMcA je allAhacI dayA ANi prasannatA zodhata Aheta. ANi jevhA eharAma utaravAla tevhA maga zikAra karU zakatAta ANi jyAMnI tumhAlA AdaraNIya masajidIpAsUna rokhale, tyAMcI zatrUtA tumhAlA hadda olAMDaNyAsa pravRtta na karAvI ANi nekI va allAhace bhaya rAkhaNyAta ekamekAMcI madata karA. aparAdha ANi atyAcArAcyA kAmAta madata karU nakA. allAhace bhaya bALagUna rAhA. niHsaMzaya allAha moThA sakta az2Aba (kaThora zikSA-yAtanA) deNArA Ahe.

tumacyAvara harAma (avaidha) kele gele Ahe melele janAvara ANi rakta ANi DukarAce mAMsa, ANi jyAvara allAhazivAya dusar2yAMce nAva ghetale gele asela ANi te janAvara je gaLA dAbalyAne mele ANi je Thosa lAgUna mele asela ANi je khAlI kosaLUna mele ANi je dusar2yA janAvarAne ziMga mAralyAne mele ANi jyAcA kAhI hissA hiMsra pazUMnI khaAUna TAkalA asela, paraMtu jyAlA tumhI jibaha karUna TAkale ANi je devasthAnAvara baLI dile gele asela ANi phA~se TAkUna (jugAra saTTyApramANe) vATaNI karaNe he sarva phAra moThe aparAdha Aheta. Aja kAphira (anekezvaravAdI) tumacyA dIna-dharmAdvAre nirAza jhAle, yAstava tyAMce bhaya bALagU nakA, phakta mAjheca bhaya bALagA. Aja mI tumacyAsAThI tumacyA dIna-dharmAlA paripUrNa kele ANi tumacyAvara ApalyA kRpA-deNagyA pUrNa kelyA ANi tumacyAsAThI islAma dharma pasaMta kelA. tathApi jo bhUkene vyAkULa hoIla ANi koNatAhI gunhA karU icchita nasela tara khAtrIne allAha mApha karaNArA, moThA dayAzIla Ahe.

te tumhAlA vicAratAta kI tyAMcyAsAThI koNakoNate khAdya ucita Ahe. tumhI sAMgA kI tumacyAsAThI svaccha zuddha va pavitra vastU ucita Aheta. ANi te zikArI janAvara, jyAlA tumhI prazikSaNa deUna tayAra kele asela, jyAMnA kAhI goSTI zikavitA, jyA allAhane tumhAlA zikavilyA, tevhA jara tumacyAsAThI te janAvara, zikAra jakhamI karUna dharUna ThevIla ANi tyAlA soDatAnA allAhace nAva tyAcyAvara ghyAla tara tI zikAra tumhI khAU zakatA ANi allAhace bhaya rAkhA niHsaMzaya, allAha lavakaraca hizoba gheNArA Ahe.

Aja sarva pAka-sApha vastU tumacyAsAThI halAla (vaidha) kelyA gelyA Aheta. ANi graMthadhArakAMnI jibaha kelele janAvara tumacyAsAThI halAla Ahe. ANi tumhI jibaha kelele tyAMcyAsAThI halAla Ahe ANi suzIla sadAcArI ImAnadhAraka striyA ANi jyAMnA tumacyApUrvI graMtha (dharmazAstra) dile gele, tyAMcyAtalyA suzIla, sadAcArI striyA, jevhA tumhI tyAMnA tyAMcA mahara adA karAla, vivAha karUna, durAcAra karaNyAsAThI navhe ANi nA lapUna chapUna preyasI banaviNyAkaritA ANi jo ImAnacA inkAra karIla tara tyAce sarva karma vAyA gele ANi to Akhiratamadhye toTyAta rAhIla.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! jevhA tumhI namAjasAThI uThAla tevhA Apale toMDa va koparAMparyaMta Apale hAta dhuvUna ghyA ANi donhI hAta pANyAne ole karUna ApalyA DokyAvarUna phiravUna ghyA ANi Apale pAya, ghoTyAparyaMta dhuvUna ghyA ANi tumhI jara nApAka (apavitra) asAla tara snAna karA ANi jara tumhI AjArI kiMvA pravAsAta asAla, kiMvA tumacyApaikI koNI zaucAsa jAUna yeIla kiMvA tumhI patnIzI sahavAsa kelA asela ANi pANI miLata nasela tara sApha svaccha mAtIne tayammuma karUna ghyA. tI mAtI ApalyA cehar2yAvara ANi hAtAMvara maLA, allAha tumhAlA aDacaNIta TAkU icchita nAhI. kiMbahunA tumhAlA svaccha zuddha va pavitra karU icchito ANi yAsAThI kI tumacyAvara ApalI kRpA-deNagI pUrNa karAvI ANi yAsAThI kI tumhI kRtajJazIla rAhAve.

ANi ApalyAvara jhAlelI allAhacI kRpA deNagI ANi tyA vacana karArAce smaraNa karA, jyAcA tumacyAzI karAra jhAlA, jevhA tumhI mhaTale kI AmhI aikale ANi mAnya kele ANi sarvazreSTha allAhace bhaya bALagata rAhA. niHsaMzaya allAha manAta lapalelyA goSTIMnAhI jANato.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! allAhakaritA satyAvara aTaLa rAhUna nyAyAcyA bAjUne sAkSI vhA, ANi ekhAdyA jamAtIcI zatrUtA tumhAlA nyAya na karaNyAvara pravRtta na karAvI. nyAya karA, te allAhace bhaya rAkhaNyAzI phAra javaLace Ahe, ANi allAhace bhaya rAkhA. niHsaMzaya, allAha tumacyA pratyeka karmAlA cAMgalyA prakAre jANUna Ahe.
jyA lokAMnI ImAna rAkhale ANi satkarma karIta rAhile, allAhane tyAMcyAzI mAphI ANi phAra moThyA mobadalyAcA vAyadA kelA Ahe.
ANi jyAMnI ImAna rAkhale nAhI ANi AmacyA AdezAMnA khoTe Tharavile teca jahannamI Aheta.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! allAhane tumacyAvara je upakAra kele Aheta, tyAMce smaraNa karA, jevhA ekA janasamUhAne tumacyAvara atyAcAra karU icchile, tevhA allAhane tyAMcyA hAtAMnA tumacyAparyaMta pohacaNyApAsUna rokhale, ANi allAhace bhaya bALagUna rAhA ANi ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMnI tara sarvazreSTha allAhavaraca bharosA ThevalA pAhije.

ANi sarvazreSTha allAhane isrAIlacyA putrAMkaDUna vacana-karAra ghetalA ANi tyAMcyAtUnaca bArA saradAra AmhI niyukta kele, ANi allAhane pharmAvile, mI nizcitaca tumacyAsobata Ahe, jara tumhI namAja kAyama rAkhAla ANi jakAta deta rAhAla ANi mAjhyA paigaMbarAMnA mAnata rAhAla ANi tyAMcI madata karIta rAhAla ANi allAhalA uttama karja deta rAhAla tara niHsaMzaya mI tumace aparAdha mApha karIna ANi tumhAlA azA jannatIMmadhye dAkhala karIna, jyAMcyA khAlI naharI (pravAha) vAhata Ahe. AtA yA vAyadyAnaMtarahI tumacyApaikI jo inkAra karIla tara niHsaMzaya to saraLa mArgApAsUna dUra bhaTakalA.

maga jevhA tyAMnI vacana-karArAcA bhaMga kelA, tevhA AmhI tyAMcyAvara dhiHkkArAcA mArA kelA ANi tyAMcI mane kaThora kelIta kI te allAhacyA vANIlA ticyA sthAnApAsUna badalUna TAkatAta ANi jo upadeza tyAMnA dilA gelA, tyAcA phAra moThA bhAga te visarale. tyAMcyA beImAnI va dagAbAjIcI eka na eka khabara tumhAlA miLata rAhIla. paraMtu thoDese (loka) asehI nAhIta, tarIhI tumhI tyAMnA mApha karIta rAhA. ANi mApha karIta rAhA. niHsaMzaya allAha upakAra karaNAr2yAMnA pasaMta karato.

ANi je svataHlA khrizcana mhaNavUna ghetAta, AmhI tyAMcyAkaDUnahI vAyadA ghetalA hotA, tyAMnIhI tyAcA moThA hissA dhyAnI rAkhalA nAhI, jI zikavaNa tyAMnA dilI gelI hotI, tevhA AmhIhI tyAMcyA daramyAna zatrUtA ANi tiraskAra nirmANa kelA, jo kayAmataparyarMta rAhIla ANi je kAhI he karatAta lavakaraca allAha tyAMnA te sarva dAkhavUna deIla.

he graMthadhArakAMno! tumacyAjavaLa Amace paigaMbara (muhammada sallallAhu alaihi vasallama) Ale Aheta, je aneka azA goSTI sAMgata Aheta, jyA graMthA (taurAta ANi iMjIla) cyA goSTI tumhI lapavita hote, ANi bahuteka goSTIMnA soData AhAta. tumacyAjavaLa allAhatarphe nUra (divya teja) ANi spaSTa asA graMtha (pavitra kuraAna) yeUna pohocalA Ahe.

jyAcyAdvAre allAha tyA lokAMnA salAmatIcA mArga dAkhavito, je tyAcyA prasannatecyA mArgAvara cAlatIla ANi tyAMnA aMdhArAtUna bAhera kADhUna ApalyA dayA-kRpecyA divya tejAkaDe ANato ANi tyAMnA saraLa mArga dAkhavito.

niHsaMzaya te loka kAphira (avizvAsI) jhAle, je mhaNAle kI mariyama-putra masIha allAha Ahe. tyAMnA sAMgA kI jara mariyama-putra masIha ANi tyAcI mAtA ANi sAr2yA jagAtIla sarva lokAMnA to naSTa karU icchila tara asA koNa Ahe, jyAlA allAhasamora (vAcaviNyAcA) tiLamAtra adhikAra Ahe? ANi AkAzAMmadhye va dharatIvara ANi je kAhI yA doghAMcyA daramyAna Ahe, sarvatra allAhacIca rAjya-sattA Ahe. to je kAhI icchito, nirmANa karato ANi allAha pratyeka goSTIce sAmarthya bALagato.

ANi yahUdI va khrizcana mhaNatAta kI AmhI allAhace putra ANi mitra Ahota. tumhI sAMgA kI maga allAha tumacyA aparAdhAMpAyI tumhAlA zikSA kA deto? navhe, kiMbahunA tumhI tyAcyA sRSTa nirmitIta eka mAnava AhAta. to jyAlA icchito, mApha karato ANi jyAlA icchito zikSA-yAtanA deto. AkAzAMcI va jaminIcI ANi yAMcyA daramyAnacI rAjyasattA kevaLa allAhacIca Ahe, ANi tyAcyAcakaDe paratAvayAce Ahe.

he graMthadhArakAMno! paigaMbarAMcyA AgamanAta eka dIrgha kALAcyA khaMDAnaMtara Amace rasUla (muhammada sallallAhu alaihi vasallama) yeUna pohocale Aheta, je tumacyAsAThI dharma vidhAnAMce nivedana karIta Aheta yAsAThI kI tumhI ase na mhaNAve kI AmacyAjavaLa koNI zubha samAcAra deNArA ANi saceta karaNArA AlA nAhI. tevhA tumacyAjavaLa eka zubha samAcAra deNArA ANi saceta karaNArA (aMtima rasUla) yeUna pohocalA Ahe. niHsaMzaya allAha pratyeka goSTIce sAmarthya bALagato.

ANi smaraNa karA jevhA mUsA (alaihissalAma) yAMnI ApalyA lokAMnA mhaTale kI he mAjhyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMno! allAhacyA tyA upakArAcI AThavaNa karA kI tyAne tumacyAmadhUna paigaMbara banavile ANi tumhAlA rAjya pradAna kele ANi tumhAlA te pradAna kele, je sAr2yA jagAta koNAlAhI pradAna kele nAhI.
he mAjhyA lokAMno! tyA pavitra bhUmIta dAkhala vhA, jI allAhane tumacyA nAve lihUna dilI Ahe. ANi ApalI pATha dAkhavU nakA kI jyAmuLe moThe hAnikAraka vhAla.

tyAMnI uttara dile, he mUsA! tithe tara zaktizAlI laDhavayye loka Aheta. ANi joparyaMta te tithUna nighUna jAta nAhIta, toparyaMta AmhI kadhIhI jANAra nAhIta, mAtra jara te tithUna nighUna jAtIla tara maga AmhI (AnaMdAne) tethe jAU.

paraMtu je allAhace bhaya bALagata hote, tyAMcyApaikI dona manuSya mhaNAle, jyAMcyAvara allAhane kRpA deNagI kelI, kI tumhI tyAMcyAvara (AkramaNAsAThI) daravAjAtUna dAkhala vhA, jevhA dAkhala vhAla tevhA tumhIca varacaDharAhAla, ANi ImAna rAkhata asAla tara allAhavaraca bharosA ThevA.
te mhaNAle, he mUsA! AmhI kadhIhI tithe jANAra nAhIta, joparyaMta te tithe rAhatIla, yAstava tumhI ANi tumacA raba (pAlanahAra) doghe jAUna laDhA, AmhI itheca basato.
mUsA mhaNAle, he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! mI phakta svataHvara ANi ApalA bhAU (hArUna) vara adhikAra rAkhato, tevhA AmacyA ANi yA durAcArI lokAMcyA daramyAna alagAva nirmANa kara.
allAhane pharmAvile, tI bhUmI tyAMcyAvara cALIsa varSAMparyaMta harAma (niSiddha) rAhIla, te dharatIvara bhaTakata phiratIla, yAstava tumhI (he mUsA!) yA durAcArI lokAMbaddala kheda karU nakA.

ANi AdamacyA dona putrAMcA kissA tyAMnA vAcUna aikavA. jevhA tyA doghAMnI eka eka kurbAnI sAdara kelI tevhA ekAcI kurbAnI svIkAralI gelI ANi dusar2yAcI svIkAralI gelI nAhI, tevhA to mhaNAlA kI mI nizcita tulA ThAra karIna, tyAvara to mhaNAlA kI allAha, durAcArApAsUna dUra rAhaNAr2yA lokAMcIca kurbAnI kabUla karato.
jara tU mAjhI hatyA karaNyAsAThI hAta puDhe karazIla tara mI tujhI hatyA karaNyAsAThI ApalA hAta puDhe karU zakata nAhI, mI allAhace bhaya rAkhato jo samasta vizvAcA svAmI ANi pAlanahAra Ahe.
mI icchito kI tU mAjhA gunhA ANi svataHcA gunhA goLA kara ANi jahannamI lokAMpaikI ho ANi atyAcArI lokAMcA hAca vAITa mobadalA Ahe.
tarIhI tyAcyA manAne ApalyA bhAvAcI nAhaka hatyA karaNyAsa pravRtta kele ANi tyAne ApalyA bhAvAlA zevaTI mArUna TAkale, jyAmuLe to nukasAna ucalaNAr2yAMpaikI jhAlA.

maga allAhane eka kAvaLa pAThavilA, jo jamIna khodata hotA, yAsAThI kI tyAlA he dAkhavAve kI, ApalyA mRta bhAvAce preta tyAne kazA prakAre lapavAve. to mhaNU lAgalA, arere! kheda Ahe mAjhyAvara! kAya mI ase karaNyAyogyahI rAhilo nAhI kI ApalyA bhAvAce preta yA kAvaLyApramANe jaminIta gADU zakalo asato? maga tara to khUpa duHkhI ANi lajjita jhAlA.

yAca kAraNAne AmhI isrAIlacyA saMtatIkaritA nirdhArIta kele kI jo manuSya ekhAdyAcI, yAvinA kI to ekhAdyAcA mArekarI asela, kiMvA dharatIvara utpAta mAjaviNArA asela, hatyA karIla tara tyAne jaNU samasta lokAMcI hatyA kelI ANi jo manuSya ekhAdyAcA jIva vAcavIla, tara tyAne jaNU samasta mAnavAMnA jIvana-dAna dile ANi tyAMcyAjavaLa Amace rasUla (paigaMbara) aneka spaSTa nizANyA gheUna Ale, paraMtu tarIhI tyAMcyApaikI adhikAMza loka julUma-atyAcAra karaNAreca rAhile.

je loka allAha ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAzI yuddha karatAta ANi dharatIvara phasAda (utpAta) mAjavitAta tara tyAMnA yA aparAdhAcI zikSA mhaNUna ThAra mArale pAhije, kiMvA tyAMnA sULAvara caDhavile pAhije kiMvA tyAMcA ekA bAjUcA hAta ANi dusar2yA bAjUcA pAya kApUna TAkalA jAvA athavA tyAMnA dezAbAhera kADhale jAve. hI apamAnAcI zikSA tyAMnA yA jagAcyA jIvanAta Ahe ANi Akhiratamadhye tara tyAMcyAsAThI mahAbhayaMkara az2Aba (zikSA-yAtanA) Ahe.
tathApi jyAMnI pakaDIta yeNyApUrvIca taubA (kSamA-yAcanA) kelI asela tara khAtrIne allAha moThA mApha karaNArA, moThA meharabAna Ahe.
he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! allAhace bhaya bALagUna rAhA ANi tyAcyA dizene sAnnidhya prApta karaNyAcA prayatna karA ANi tyAcyA mArgAta jihAda karA, yAsAThI kI tumhAlA saphalatA lAbhAvI.

niHsaMzaya, je loka kAphira (inkArI) Aheta, tyAMnI jara allAhacyA zikSA-yAtane (az2Aba) pAsUna suTakA hoNyAkaritA, dharatIvara je kAhI Ahe, te sarvacyA sarva daMDa mhaNUna deUna TAkale ANi tevaDheca ANakhI gheUna Ale, tarIdekhIla kayAmatIcyA divazI az2AbapAsUna suTakA hoNyAkaritA kabUla kele jANAra nAhI, ANi tyAMcyAkaritA duHkhadAyaka zikSA-yAtanecA krama jArI rAhIla.
te jahannamamadhUna bAhera paDaNyAcI khUpa icchA karatIla, paraMtu tyAtUna kadhIca bAhera paDU zakaNAra nAhIta. tyAMcyAsAThI tara niraMtara az2Aba Ahe.
corI karaNArA va corI karaNArIce hAta kApUna TAkA. he tyAcyA duSkarmAce phaLa ANi allAhatarphe zikSA Ahe ANi sarvazreSTha allAha zaktizAlI ANi hikamatazAlI Ahe.

jo manuSya aparAdhAnaMtara (allAhakaDe) kSamA yAcanA karIla, ANi Apale AcaraNa sudhArela tara allAha tyAcI taubA (kSamA yAcanA) kabUla karato. niHsaMzaya sarvazreSTha allAha mApha karaNArA, dayA karaNArA Ahe.

kAya tumhI nAhI jANata kI AkAzaAMcI va jaminIcI rAjya sattA kevaLa allAhakaritAca Ahe? to jyAlA icchito az2Aba (zikSA-yAtanA) deto, ANi jyAlA icchito mApha karato. allAha pratyeka goSTIce sAmarthya bALagato.

he paigaMbara! tumhI tyAMcyAsAThI duHkhI hoU nakA je inkAra karaNyAta dhAva gheta Aheta, je ApalyA toMDAne mhaNAle kI AmhI ImAna rAkhale ANi tyAMcyA manAne ImAna rAkhale nAhI ANi je yahUdI jhAle, tyAMcyAtale kAhI khoTe bolaNyAce abhyasta ANi dusar2yA lokAMce guptahera Aheta, je tumacyAjavaLa Ale nAhIta. te vANIlA (vacanAlA) mULa sthAnApAsUna haTavUna ticA artha badalUna TAkatAta ANi ase sAMgatAta kI jara tumhAlA hA Adeza miLAlA tara kabUla karA ANi na miLAlyAsa alaga rAhA. jara allAha ekhAdyAsa bhaTakata ThevU icchila tara tyAcyAsAThI allAhavara tumhAlA kiMcitahI adhikAra nAhI. azAca lokAMcyA hRdayAMnA allAha pAka (pavitra) karU icchita nAhI. yAca lokAMsAThI yA jagAta apamAna ANi Akhiratamadhye moThA jabaradasta az2Aba Ahe.

he kAna lAvUna khoTyA goSTI aikaNAre ANi mana tRpta hoIparyaMta harAma khANAre Aheta. jara he tumacyAjavaLa yetIla tara tumhAlA adhikAra Ahe, vATalyAsa tyAMcyA daramyAna phaisalA karA, vATalyAsa karU nakA. jara tumhI tyAMcyApAsUna toDa phiravUnahI ghyAla tarIhI te tumhAlA kasalehI nukasAna pohacavU zakata nAhI ANi jara tumhI phaisalA karAla tara tyAMcyA daramyAna nyAyAsaha phaisalA karA. niHsaMzaya, nyAya karaNAr2yAMzI allAha prema rAkhato.

ANi (AzcaryAcI goSTa azI kI) svataHjavaLa taurAta asatAnA, jyAta allAhacA Adeza Ahe, te kase tumhAlA phaisalA karaNArA banavitAta, maga tyAnaMtara Adeza mAnaNyAce TALatAta. vAstavika he loka (khar2yA arthAne) ImAnadhAraka nAhIta.

AmhI taurAta AvatarIta kelI, jyAta mArgadarzana ANi nUra (divya prakAza) Ahe. yahUdI lokAMmadhye yAca taurAtadvAre allAhalA mAnaNAre paigaMbara ANi allAhavAle ANi dharmajJAnI loka phaisalA karIta asata kAraNa tyAMnA allAhacyA yA graMthAce rakSaNa karaNyAcA Adeza dilA gelA hotA ANi te yAvara svIkAraNAre sAkSI hote. AtA tumhI lokAMce bhaya bALagU nakA, kiMbahunA mAjhe bhaya bALagA. mAjhyA AyatIMnA thoDyAzA kiMmatIvara vikU nakA ANi jo, allAhane avatarIta kelelyA saMdezA (vahayI) cyA AdhArAvara phaisalA na karIla tara ase loka purepUra kAphIra Aheta.

ANi AmhI (taurAtamadhye) yahUdIMcyA hakkAta hI goSTa nirdhArIta kelI kI jIvAcyA badalyAta jIva, ANi DoLyAcyA badalyAta DoLA ANi nAkAcyA badalyAta nAka ANi kAnAcyA badalyAta kAna ANi dAtAcyA badalyAta dAta ANi khAsa jakhamAMcAhI badalA Ahe, maga jo koNI tyAsa mApha karIla tara te tyAcyAsAThI pazcAttApa Ahe ANi je loka allAhacyA AdezAnusAra phaisalA karaNAra nAhIta tara aseca loka atyAcArI Aheta.

ANi AmhI tyAMcyAmAge mariyama-putra IsAlA pAThavile, je ApalyA pUrvIcA graMtha taurAta satya asalyAce sAMgata hote ANi AmhI tyAMnA iMjIla (hA graMtha) pradAna kelA. jyAta nUra (divya prakAza) ANi mArgadarzana hote ANi to ApalyA pUrvIcA graMtha taurAta satya asalyAce sAMgata hotA ANi te spaSTa mArgadarzana ANi zikavaNa hotI, allAhace bhaya rAkhaNAr2yAMkaritA.

ANi iMjIla bALagaNAr2yAMkaritA he baMdhanakAraka Tharate kI je kAhI allAhane iMjIlamadhye avatarIta kele Ahe, tyAcyAcanusAra phaisalA karAvA ANi jo manuSyadekhIla allAhane avatarIta kelyAnusAra phaisalA karaNAra nAhI kiMvA mAnaNAra nAhI tara ase loka durAcArI Aheta.

ANi AmhI tumacyAkaDe hA satyapUrNa graMtha avatarIta kelA Ahe, jo ApalyA pUrvIcyA samasta AsamAnI graMthAMcI satyatA darzavito ANi tyAMcA saMrakSaka Ahe. yAstava tumhI tyAMcyA daramyAna, allAhane avatarIta kelelyA graMthAnusAra phaisAlA karA, yA satyAkaDe pATha phiravUna tyAMcyA icchA AkAMkSAMvara jAU nakA. tumacyApaikI pratyekAsAThI AmhI eka zarIata (dharmazAstra) ANi mArga nirdhArIta kelA Ahe. allAhane icchile asate tara tumhA sarvAMcA ekaca janasamUha (ummata) banavilA asatA. paraMtu to ase icchito kI, je kAhI tumhAlA dile Ahe, tyAta tumacI kasoTI ghyAvI, tevhA tumhI cAMgalyA mobadalyAcyA dizene tvarA karA, tumhA sarvAMnA allAhacyAcakaDe parata jAyace Ahe. maga to tumhAlA tI pratyeka goSTa dAkhavUna deIla, jyAsaMdarbhAta tumhI matabheda rAkhatA.

ANi tumhI tyAMcyA taMTyAta allAhane avatarIta kelelyA vahayInusAra phaisalA karA. tyAMcyA icchA abhilASAMce anusaraNa karU nakA ANi tyAMcyApAsUna sAvadha rAhA kI kadAcita he tumhAlA allAhacyA avatarIta kelelyA ekhAdyA AdezApAsUna DaLamaLIta na karAveta. jara he toMDa phiravatIla tara khAtrIne allAhacA hAca irAdA Ahe kI tyAMnA tyAMcyA kAhI aparAdhAMcI zikSA deUnaca TAkAvI ANi adhikAMza loka avajJAkArI asatAta.
kAya he loka punazca ajJAnatApUrNa phaisalA icchitAta? ANi ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMkaritA allAhapekSA uttama phaisalA karaNArA ANi Adeza karaNArA ANakhI koNa asU zakato?

he ImAnadhArakAMno! tumhI yahUdIMnA ANi khrizcanAMnA dosta banavU nakA, he tara ApasAtaca ekamekAMce dosta Aheta. tumacyApaikI jo koNI yAMcyAzI dostI karIla tara to tyAMcyApaikIca Tharela. atyAcArI lokAMnA allAha kadhIhI (saraLa) mArga dAkhavita nAhI.

tumhI pAhAla kI jyAMcyA manAta vikAra Ahe te dhAvata jAUna tyAMcyAta misaLatAta ANi mhaNatAta kI AmhAlA bhaya vATate kI kadAcita ase na vhAve kI ekhAde saMkaTa AmacyAvara kosaLAve, phAra zakya Ahe kI allAhane vijaya pradAna karAvA kiMvA ApalyAkaDUna anya ekhAdA phaisalA karAvA maga tara he ApalyA manAta lapavilelyA goSTIbaddala khUpa lajjita hotIla.
ANi ImAnadhAraka mhaNatIla kI kAya heca te loka hote, je moThyA vizvAsAne allAhacI zapatha gheUna mhaNatAta kI AmhI tumacyAsobata Ahota, tyAMce sarva karma vAyA gele ANi te asaphala jhAle.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! tumacyApaikI jo koNI ApalyA dIna-dharmApAsUna parAvRtta hoIla, tara sarvazreSTha allAha lavakaraca azA janasamUhAcyA lokAMnA ANIla allAha jyAMcyAzI prema rAkhIla ANi tedekhIla allAhazI prema karata asatIla. ImAnadhArakAMsAThI te komalahRdayI asatIla, paraMtu kAphirAMsAThI mAtra kaThora ANi nirdayI asatIla, te allAhacyA mArgAta jihAda karatIla, koNA niMdA-nAlastI karaNAr2yAMcyA AropAcI parvA karaNAra nAhIta. hI allAhacI kRpA Ahe, jyAlA icchito, pradAna karato, allAha sarvazaktimAna Ahe ANi atizaya jJAna bALagaNArA Ahe.

(he ImAnadhArakAMno!) tumacA mitra svataH allAha ANi tyAcA paigaMbara Ahe ANi ImAna rAkhaNAre loka Aheta. je namAja kAyama karatAta ANi jakAta deta rAhatAta ANi allAhasamora (ekAgracitta hoUna) jhukaNAre Aheta.
ANi jo manuSya, sarvazreSTha allAhazI, tyAcyA paigaMbarAzI ANi ImAnadhArakAMzI dostI rAkhIla tara tyAne vizvAsa ThevalA pAhije kI allAhace dAsaca varcasvazAlI rAhatIla.

(ImAnadhArakAMno!) tumhI azA lokAMnA ApalA mitra banavU nakA, je tumacyA dIna-dharmAlA kheLa-tamAzA banavUna thaTTA uDavitAta, maga te tyAMcyApaikI asota jyAMnA tumacyApUrvI graMtha dilA gelA kiMvA kAphira (inkArI) asota jara tumhI (kharokhara) ImAnadhAraka asAla tara allAhace bhaya bALagUna rAhA.
ANi jevhA tumhI namAjakaritA (ajAna) pukAratA tevhA te tyAsa kheLa-tamAzA TharavitAta, he azAsAThI kI te akkala bALagata nAhIta.

tumhI sAMgA, he yahUdyAMno ANi khrizcanAMno! tumhI AmacyAzI kevaLa yA kAraNAstava vaira rAkhatA kI AmhI allAhavara ANi je kAhI AmacyAkaDe utaravile gele Ahe ANi je kAhI yApUrvI utaravile gele Ahe tyAvara ImAna rAkhale Ahe ANi yAsAThIhI kI tumacyAta adhikAMza loka durAcArI Aheta.

tumhI sAMgA kI kAya mI tumhAlA sAMgU kI yAhUna jAsta vAITa mobadalA prApta karaNArA allAhacyA javaLa koNa Ahe? to, jyAcA sarvazreSTha allAhane dhiHkkAra kelA asela ANi tyAvara krodhita jhAlA asela ANi tyAMcyApaikI kAhIMnA vAnara ANi Dukkara banavile ANi jyAMnI khoTyA daivatAMcI upAsanA kelI tara heca loka vAITa darjAce Aheta ANi heca satya-mArgApAsUna phAra jAsta bhaTakalele Aheta.

ANi jevhA te tumacyAjavaLa yetAta, tevhA mhaNatAta kI AmhI ImAna rAkhale jarI te inkAra sobata gheUna Ale hote ANi tyAca inkArAsobata (yA jagAtUna) geletahI ANi he je kAhI lapavita Aheta, allAha te cAMgalyA prakAre jANato.

ANi tumhI pAhAla kI yAMcyApaikI bahuteka jaNa aparAdhAcyA kAmAMkaDe atyAcAra ANi vidrohAkaDe ANi harAma mAla (dhana) khANayAkaDe dhAva gheta Aheta. je kAhI he karIta Aheta, te atizaya vAITa karma Ahe.
tyAMnA tyAMce saMta-mahaMta ANi dharmajJAnI loka khoTe bolaNyApAsUna ANi harAma (avaidha) khANyApAsUna rokhata kA nAhI? niHsaMzaya hI vAITa karme Aheta, jI he karIta Aheta.

ANi yahUdI mhaNAle, allAhacA hAta bAMdhalelA Ahe, (ulaTa) tyAMceca hAta bAMdhalele Aheta ANi tyAMcyA yA kathanAmuLe tyAMcA dhiHkkAra kelA gelA. kiMbahunA allAhace donhI hAta khule Aheta. jyAprakAre icchito, kharca karato, ANi je kAhI tumacyAkaDe, tumacyA pAlanakartyAtarphe utaravile gele Ahe, te tyAMcyApaikI bahutekAMcyA vidroha ANi inkArAta vADhakarate, ANi AmhI tyAMcyAta ApasAta kayAmatAparyaMta zatrUtA ANi dveSa matsara perale Ahe. te jevhA jevhA yuddhAcI Aga bhaDakavU icchitAta, allAha tilA vijhavito. he jaminIvara dahazata ANi utpAda mAjavita phiratAta ANi allAha azA vidhvaMsa karaNAr2yAMzI prema rAkhata nAhI.

ANi jara yA graMthadhArakAMnI ImAna rAkhale asate ANi allAhace bhaya bALagale asate tara AmhI tyAMcyA duSkRtyAMvara paDadA TAkalA asatA ANi nizcitaca tyAMnA kRpA deNagyAMnI bharalelyA jannatamadhye dAkhala kele asate.

jara tyAMnI taurAta ANi iMjIla ANi tyA dharmazAstrAMce pAlana kele asate je tyAMcyAkaDe, tyAMcyA pAlanakartyAtarphe utaravile geleta tara tyAMnA ApalyA varUnahI ANi pAyAkhAlUnahI bharapUra (annasAmagrI) khAyalA lAbhale asate. tyAcyAtAlA eka samUha madhalyA mArgAvara Ahe, mAtra adhikAMza durAcArI Aheta.

he paigaMbara! tumacyAkaDe, tumacyA pAlanakartyAtarphe jo (saMdeza) utaravilA gelA Ahe, to lokAMparyaMta pohacavA. jara tumhI ase kele nAhI, tara tyAcyA saMdezAcA hakka adA kelA nAhI ANi allAha lokAMpAsUna tumace rakSaNa karIla niHsaMzaya allAha inkArI lokAMnA mArgadarzana karIta nAhI.

tumhI sAMgA kI, he graMthadhArakAMno! tumhAlA kasalAhI AdhAra nAhI, joparyaMta taurAta ANi iMjIla ANi jedekhIla (dharmazAstra) tumacyA pAlanakartyAtarphe tumacyAkaDe utaravile gele Ahe, tyAce pAlana na karAla ANi tumacyAkaDe je (pavitra kuraAna) tumacyA pAlanakartyAtarphe avatarIta kele gele Ahe, te yAMcyAtalyA bahuteka lokAMcyA haTTa ANi inkArAsa vADhavila. tevhA yA inkArI lokAMbaddala tumhI duHkha karU nakA.

ImAnadhAraka, yahUdI, tAr2yAMce upAsaka ANi khrizcanAMpaikI jodekhIla allAha ANi aMtima divasA (kayAmata) vara ImAna rAkhIla ANi satkarma karIta rAhIla tara azA lokAMnA, nA kasale bhaya rAhIla, nA te duHkhI hotIla.

AmhI isrAIlacyA putrAM (yahUdIM) kaDUna vAyadA ghetalA ANi tyAMcyAkaDe paigaMbarAMnA pAThavile, jevhA ekhAdA paigaMbara tyAMcyAjavaLa asA Adeza gheUna AlA jyAlA tyAMce mana svIkArata navhate tara tyAMnI ekA gaTAlA khoTe Tharavile ANi ekA gaTAcI hatyA karIta rAhile.

ANi samajUna basale kI kAhIca zikSA miLaNAra nAhI, yAstava AMdhaLe bahIre jhAle, tarIhI allAhane tyAMnA mApha kele.ase asatAnAhI tyAMcyApaikI adhikAMza loka AMdhaLe bahIre jhAle ANi allAha tyAMcyA karmAMnA khUpa cAMgalyA prakAre pAhaNArA Ahe.

te loka kAphira (inkArI) jhAleta, jyAMnI mhaTale kI mariyamacA putra masIha hAca allAha Ahe, vAstavika masIhane (svataH) mhaTale kI he isrAIlacyA putrAMno! mAjhyA ANi tumacyA pAlanakartyA allAhacI upAsanA karA kAraNa jo koNI allAhasobata dusar2yAlA sahabhAgI TharavIla tara allAhane tyAcyAsAThI jannata harAma kelI Ahe ANi tyAce ThikANa jahannama Ahe, ANi atyAcArI lokAMcA koNIhI madata karaNArA nasela.

te lokahI pUrNataH kAphira jhAle, jyAMnI mhaTale kI allAha tInacA tisarA Ahe. vAstavika allAhazivAya koNIhI upAsya nAhI ANi jara he loka ase bolaNe soDaNAra nAhIta tara tyAMcyApaikI je inkAra karata rAhatIla tara tyAMnA nizcitaca moThA sakta az2Aba pohocela.
he loka allAhakaDe kA nAhI jhukata ANi kA nAhI kSamA yAcanA karIta? allAha atizaya mApha karaNArA ANi moThA dayA karaNArA Ahe.

mariyamace putra masIha kevaLa eka paigaMbara asaNyAkherIja ANakhI kAhIhI nAhI. tyAMcyA pUrvIhI aneka paigaMbara hoUna geleta. tyAMcI mAtA eka suzIla ANi satyaniSTha strI hotI. doghe (mAtA-putra) jevaNa karIta asata. tumhI pAhA AmhI kazA prakAre tyAMcyAsamora pramANa prastuta karato, maga vicAra karA kI te kazA prakAre paratavile jAtAta.

tumhI sAMgA kI, kAya tumhI allAhazivAya tyAMcI bhaktI- upAsanA karatA je nA tumhAlA nukasAna pohacaviNyAcA adhikAra rAkhatAta, nA kasalyAhI prakAracyA phAyadyAcA. allAha cAMgalyA prakAre aikaNArA ANi pUrNataH jJAnI Ahe.

sAMgA, he graMthadhArakAMno! ApalyA dIna-dharmAta atizayoktI karU nakA ANi azA lokAMcyA icchA abhilASAMce anusaraNa karU nakA, je pUrvIpAsUna bhaTakalele Aheta. ANi bahutekAMnA pathabhraSTa karUna geleta ANi saraLa mArgApAsUna dUra jhAle Aheta.

isrAIlacyA saMtatImadhIla inkArI lokAMcA (hajarata) dAUda ANi mariyama-putra hajarata IsA yAMcyA toMDUna dhiHkkAra kelA gelA, yA kAraNAne kI te AjJA bhaMga karaNAre hote ANi maryAdece ullaMghana karIta hote.
te ApasAta ekamekAMnA vAITa kAmAMpAsUna, je te karIta asata, rokhata navhate, nizcitaca je kAhI te karIta, atizaya vAITa hote.

tyAMcyAtalyA adhikAMza lokAMnA tumhI pAhAla kI te inkArI lokAMzI maitrI karatAta. je kAhI tyAMnI ApalyA puDhe pAThavile Ahe te atizaya vAITa Ahe. (pariNAmI) sarvazreSTha allAha tyAMcyAzI nArAja jhAlA ANi te nehamI az2Aba (zikSA-yAtane) madhye rAhatIla.
jara tyAMnI allAhavara, paigaMbarAMvara ANi je avatarIta kele gele Ahe tyAvara ImAna rAkhale asate tara inkArI lokAMzI maitrI kelI nasatI, paraMtu tyAMcyApaikI bahuteka loka durAcArI Aheta.

niHsaMzaya, tumhAlA ImAnadhArakAMce sakta (kaTTara) vairI yahUdI ANi anekezvaravAdI ADhaLUna yetIla ANi ImAnadhArakAMce sarvAdhika nikaTace mitra tumhAlA jarUra tyAMcyAta ADhaLatIla, je svataHlA khrizcana mhaNatAta, he azAsAThI kI tyAMcyAta dharmajJAnI- vidvAna ANi saMta-mahAtmA Aheta, ANi yA kAraNAstava kI te ghameMDa karIta nAhIta.

ANi jevhA te paigaMbarAkaDe avatarita jhAlelA saMdeza aikatAta, tevhA tumhAlA tyAMcyA DoLyAMtUna azrUdhArA vAhatAnA disatIla. yA kAraNAne kI tyAMnI satya oLakhUna ghetale. te mhaNatAta, he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! AmhI ImAna rAkhale, tevhA tU AmhAlAhI sAkSa deNAr2yAMmadhye lihUna ghe.
ANi AmhI kA mhaNUna ImAna na rAkhAve allAhavara ANi tyA satyAvara, je AmacyAjavaLa yeUna pohocale Ahe ANi hI AzA na bALagAvI kI AmacA pAlanahAra AmhAlA neka sadAcArI lokAMmadhye sAmIla karIla.
tara allAhane tyAMcyA yA duA (prArthanA) muLe tyAMnA (jannatacyA) azA bAgA pradAna kelyA, jyAMcyAkhAlI pravAha vAhata Aheta, jyAta te sadaiva rAhatIla ANi neka lokAMcA hAca mobadalA Ahe.
ANi je kAphira (inkArI) jhAle ANi jyAMnI AmacyA AyatIMnA khoTe Tharavile, teca jahannamI Aheta.

he ImAnadhArakAMno! tyA pAka (svaccha- zuddha) vastUMnA harAma TharavUna kA jyA allAhane tumacyAsAThI halAla TharavilyA Aheta, ANi maryAdecyA bAhera jAU nakA niHsaMzaya allAha atireka karaNAr2yAMzI prema rAkhata nAhI.
ANi allAhane jI anna-sAmugrI tumhAlA pradAna kelI Ahe, tyAtUna svaccha-zuddha halAla vastU khA ANi allAhace bhaya bALagA, jyAcyAvara tumhI ImAna rAkhatA.

allAha tumacyA vyartha, nirarthaka zapathAMbaddala tumacI pakaDa karIta nAhI tathApi azAca zapathAMbaddala pakaDa karato, jyA tumhI pakkyA irAdyAne ghetalyA. tyAce prAyazcitta dahA garIbAMnA bhojana deNe, bar2yApaikI, jase ApalyA gharacyA lokAMnA khAU ghAlatA kiMvA tyAMnA kapaDe latte deNe kiMvA eka gulAma athavA dAsI mukta karaNe, ANi jyAlA he zakya nasela tara tyAne tIna divasa roje (upavAsa- vrata) rAkhAve. he tumacyA tyA zapathAMce prAyazcitta Ahe, jevhA tumhI azI zapatha ghyAla. ANi ApalyA zapathAMvara kAyama rAhUna tyAMce rakSaNa karA, azA prakAre sarvazreSTha allAha tumacyAsAThI Apale Adeza spaSTataH sAMgato yAsAThI kI tumhI AbhAra mAnAveta.
he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! madya, jugAra ANi deva-sthAna ANi bhaviSya vartaviNAre phAMse he sarva amaMgala saitAnI kAme Aheta, tevhA tumhI yApAsUna dUra rAhA, yAsAThI kI saphala vhAve.

saitAna tara icchitoca kI madya ANi jugArAdvAre tumacyA daramyAna zatrUtA ANi dveSa matsara nirmANa karAve ANi tumhAlA allAhacyA smaraNApAsUna va namAjapAsUna rokhAve, tevhA tumhI azA kAmAMpAsUna dUra kA rAhAta nAhI?

ANi allAhacyA AdezAce pAlana karA ANi paigaMbarAMce AjJApAlana karA ANi sAvadhagirI pALA ANi jara tumhI toMDa phiravale tara lakSAta ThevA kI AmacyA paigaMbarAcI jabAbadArI spaSTa saMdeza pohacaviNyAcI Ahe.

jyA lokAMnI ImAna rAkhale ANi satkarma kele, azAMvara gunhA nAhI jara pUrvI kAhI khAlle asela, vastutaH naMtara te parahejagAra (duSkarmApAsUna dUra rAhaNAre) banale, ANi ImAnadhAraka jhAle va satkarma karU lAgale, parahejagArIvara kAyama rAhile ANi ImAnAvara aTaLa rAhile, maga allAhacI avajJA karaNyApAsUna dUra rAhile ANi nekI (cyA mArgA) vara cAlata rAhile ANi allAha azA neka kAma karaNAr2yAMzI prema rAkhato.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! allAha kAhI zikAradvAre tumacI parIkSA gheto, jyA paryaMta tumace hAta ANi tumace bhAle pohocU zakatIla, yAsAThI kI allAhane he jANUna ghyAve kI koNa tyAlA na pAhatA bhaya rAkhato jo manuSya yAnaMtarahI maryAdA pAra karIla, tyAcyAsAThI kaThora sajA Ahe.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! jevhA tumhI (haja kiMvA umarAprasaMgI) eharAmacyA avastheta asAla tara zikAra karU nakA ANi tumacyApaikI jo koNI tyAlA mArela tara tyAlA phidiyA dyAvA lAgela tyAcyAsArakhyAca pALIva janAvarAne, jyAcA phaisalA tumacyApaikI dona nyAya karaNAre karatIla je kurbAnIkaritA kAbAparyaMta pohacavile jAIla kiMvA phidiyA mhaNUna garIbAMnA bhojana dyAve lAgela kiMvA tyAcyA barobarIne roje (upavAsa-vrata) ThevAve lAgatIla, yAsAThI kI ApalyA karmAce phaLa cAkhAve, je pUrvI jhAle, allAhane te mApha kele ANi jo koNI yA (manAI AdezA) naMtara punhA ase karIla tara allAha tyAcA sUDa gheIla, allAha moThA zaktizAlI sUDa gheNArA Ahe.

tumacyAsAThI samudrAtIla (prANyAcI) zikAra pakaDaNe va khANe halAla kele gele Ahe. tumacyA vAparAsAThI ANi pravAzAMsAThI, ANi joparyaMta tumhI eharAmacyA avastheta asAla, khuzkIcI zikAra harAma kelI gelI Ahe ANi allAhace bhaya rAkhA, jyAcyAjavaLa tumhI ekatra kele jAla.

allAhane kAbAgRhAlA, je Adara-sanmAnapUrNa ghara Ahe, lokAMkaritA kAyama rAhaNyAce kAraNa banavile ANi AdaraNIya mahinyAlA ANi haramamadhye kurbAnI dilyA jANAr2yA janAvarAMnAhI ANi tyA janAvarAMnAhI, jyAMcyA gaLyAta paTTe asatIla, he azAsAThI kI tumhI yA goSTIvara vizvAsa rAkhAvA kI niHsaMzaya allAha AkAzAMcyA va jaminIcyA samasta cIja-vastUMce jJAna rAkhato ANi niHsaMzaya allAha pratyeka goSTIce cAMgalyA prakAre jJAna rAkhato.
tumhI jANUna asA kI sarvazreSTha allAha zikSA yAtanAhI kaThora deNArA Ahe ANi allAha moThA mApha karaNArA ANi atizaya dayA karaNArAhI Ahe.
paigaMbarAce kartavya tara kevaLa pohacaviNyAce Ahe ANi allAha sarva kAhI jANato, je kAhI tumhI jAhIra karatA ANi je kAhI tumhI lapavitA.

tumhI sAMgA kI nApAka ANi pAka (galiccha va svaccha zuddha) samAna nAhIta, maga tumhAlA nApAkacI vipulatA cAMgalI vATata asalI tarI, allAhace bhaya bALagUna rAhA he buddhimAnAMno! yAsAThI kI tumhI saphala vhAve.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! azI goSTa vicArU nakA kI jI jAhIra kelI gelI tara tumhAlA vAITa vATela ANi jara kuraAna utarateveLI vicArAla tara tumhAlA tyAce uttara ughaDa dile jAIla. yApUrvI je jhAle te allAhane mApha kele ANi allAha moThA mApha karaNArA sahanazIla Ahe.
tumacyApUrvI kAhI lokAMnI aseca prazna vicArale, naMtara tyAce inkArI jhAle.
bahIrA, sAebA, vasIlA ANi hAma vagairecA allAhane Adeza dilA nAhI, paraMtu inkArI loka allAhavara mithyA Aropa ThevatAta, ANi tyAMcyAtale bahuteka jaNa akkala bALagata nAhI.

ANi jevhA tyAMnA sAMgitale gele kI tyA (pavitra kuraAnA) kaDe ANi paigaMbara (muhammada sallallAhu alaihi vasallama) kaDe yA, tevhA te mhaNAle kI jyA (rIti-rivAjA) vara AmhAlA Amace vADavaDIla ADhaLaleta, te AmhAlA purese Ahe. maga tyAMce te vADavaDIla kAhI jANata nasAveta ANi sanmArgAvara nasAveta, tarIhI?

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! ApalI kALajI ghyA, jevhA tumhI satya mArgAvara cAlata asAla, tara jo manuSya pathabhraSTa hoIla tara tyAmuLe tumace kAhIca nukasAna nAhI, allAhacyAca javaLa tumhA sarvAMnA jAyace Ahe, maga to tumhA sarvAMnA sAMgela tumhI kasakase karma karIta hote.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! jevhA tumacyApaikI ekhAdyAcA mRtyusamaya javaLa AlA asela tevhA vasIyata (mRtyupatra) karateveLI tumacyAtale dona nyAya karaNAre sAkSI mhaNUna asale pAhije kiMvA tumacyAkherIja itara dona jaNa jara tumhI jaminIvara pravAsa karIta asAla ANi acAAnaka mRtyuce saMkaTa tumacyAvara yAve (saMzayAcyA sthitIta) tumhI doghA (sAkSIM) nA (jamAtacI) namAja jhAlyAnaMtara rokhA, maga te doghe allAhacI zapatha ghetIla kI AmhI yA (sAkSa deNyA) cyA mobadalyAta kasalehI mUlya gheU icchita nAhI, maga koNI javaLacA nAtevAIka kA asenA ANi AmhI allAhacI sAkSa lapavU zakata nAhI, jara AmhI ase kele tara doSI TharU.

naMtara jara ase kaLAle kI te doghe (sAkSI) ekhaAdyA aparAdhaAsa pAtra Tharale Aheta, tara azA lokAMpaikI jyAMcyA virodhAta gunhA ghaDalA hotA, ANakhI dona vyaktI, jyA sarvAMta javaLacyA asatIla, jithe te doghe ubhe hote, tyA jAgI yA doghAMnI ubhe rAhAve, maga te allAhacI zapatha ghetIla kI AmacI sAkSa yA doghAMcyA sAkSIpekSA adhika kharI Ahe. ANi AmhI maryAdA pAra kelI nAhI ase kelyAsa AmacI gaNanA atyAcArI lokAMmadhye hoIla.

hA sarvAdhika javaLacA mArga Ahe kI te loka kharI sAkSa detIla kiMvA tyAMnA he bhaya asela kI zapatha ghetalyAnaMtara punhA zapatha ulaTa paDela ANi allAhace bhaya rAkhA ANi aikA! allAha durAcArI lokAMnA mArgadarzana karIta nAhI.
jyA (kayAmatacyA) divazI allAha samasta paigaMbarAMnA ekatra karIla, maga vicArela kI tumhAlA kAya uttara miLAle hote? te mhaNatIla, AmhAlA kAhIca mAhIta nAhI. gaiba (aparokSa) jANaNArA tUca Ahesa.

jevhA allAha pharmAvila, he mariyama-putra IsA! tumacyAvara ANi tumacyA mAtevara mI kelelyA kRpA deNagIce smaraNa karA. jevhA mI pavitra AtmA (jibrIla) dvAre tumacI madata kelI. tumhI pALaNyAta asatAnA va moThyA vayAta lokAMzI saMbhASaNa karIta rAhile ANi jevhA AmhI graMtha va hikamata ANi taurAta va iMjIlace jJAna dile ANi jevhA tumhI mAjhyA hukUmAne pakSIrUpa putaLA mAtIne tayAra karIta asata ANi tyAta phuMka mArIta asata, tevhA mAjhyA hukUmAne to (jivaMta) pakSI banata ase, ANi tumhI mAjhyA hukUmAne janmajAta AMdhaLyAlA ANi koDhI isamAlA cAMgale karIta asata, ANi mAjhyA hukUmAne melelyAMnA (jivaMta karUna) bAhera kADhIta asata ANi jevhA mI isrAIlacyA putrAMnA tumacyApAsUna rokhale. jevhA tumhI tyAMcyAjavaLa mojijA gheUna Ale tevhA tyAMcyAtale inkArI loka mhaNAle, kI hI kevaLa ughaDa jAdU Ahe.
ANi jyAarthI mI havArIMnA prerita kele kI tumhI mAjhyAvara ANi mAjhyA paigaMbarAMvara ImAna rAkhA, tevhA te mhaNAle, AmhI ImAna rAkhale ANi tumhI sAkSI rAhA kI AmhI pUrNataH AjJAdhAraka Ahota.

smaraNa karA, jevhA havArI mhaNAle kI he mariyama-putra IsA! kAya tumacA pAlanakartA AmacyAvara AkAzAtUna (bhojanAcI) eka thALI utaravU zakato? IsA mhaNAle, ImAna rAkhata asAla tara allAhace bhaya bALagA.
te mhaNAle kI AmhI tyAtUna khaAU icchito ANi AmacyA manAlA samAdhAna lAbhAve ANi AmacI khAtrI vhAvI kI tumhI AmhAlA khare sAMgitale ANi AmhI tyAvara sAkSI rAhAve.

mariyama-putra IsA mhaNAle, he allAha! AmacyAvara AkAzAtUna eka thALI utarava, jI AmacyA pUrvIcyA ANi naMtaracyA lokAMkaritA AnaMdAcI goSTa TharAvI ANi tujhyAtarphe eka nizANI TharAvI ANi amhAlA rojI (AjivikA) pradAna kara. tU uttama rojI deNArA Ahesa.

allAhane pharmAvile kI mI te bhojana tumhA lokAMsAThI utaravita Ahe, maga tumacyApaikI jo koNI yAnaMtarahI kupra (inkAra) karIla tara mI tyAlA azI sakta sajA deIna kI tazI sajA sAr2yA jagAta koNAlAhI deNAra nAhI.

ANi (tyA veLecehI smaraNa karA) jevhA sarvazreSTha allAha pharmAvila kI he mariyama-putra IsA! kAya tumhI tyA lokAMnA ase sAMgitale hote kI malA ANi mAjhyA mAtelA allAhazivAya upAsya banavUna ghyA? IsA uttara detIla kI mI tara tulA pratyeka vyaMga- doSApAsUna mukta (pAka) samajato tevhA malA azA prakAre zobhela kI mI azI goSTa bolAve, jI bolaNyAcA malA kAhIca hakka nAhI, jara mI ase bolalo asela tara tulA te mAhItahI asela. tU tara mAjhyA manAtIla goSTahI jANato, mAtra tujhyA manAta je kAhI Ahe, te mI nAhI jANata. kevaLa tUca aparokSa goSTIMcA jJAtA Ahesa.

mI tyAMnA kevaLa teca sAMgitale, jyAcA tU malA Adeza dilA kI tumacA va mAjhA pAlanakartA asalelyA allAhacI upAsanA karA ANi joparyaMta mI tyAMcyAta rAhilo, tyAMcyAvara sAkSI rAhilo, ANi jevhA tU malA ucalUna ghetale tevhA tUca tyAMcA dekharekhakartA hotA, ANi tU pratyeka goSTIvara sAkSI Ahe.
jara tU yAMnA az2Aba (zikSA-yAtanA) dezIla tara he tujheca dAsa Aheta ANi jara tU yAMnA mApha karazIla tara tU moThA jabaradasta hikamata bALagaNArA Ahe.

allAha pharmAvila kI hA to divasa Ahe kI satyaniSTha lokAMce satya tyAMcyAkaritA lAbhadAyaka Tharela. tyAMnA (jannatacyA) bAgA miLatIla, jyAMcyAkhAlI pravAha vAhata asatIla, jyAta te nehamI nehamI rAhatIla. allAha tyAMcyAzI prasanna ANi te allAhazI khUza asatIla. hI phAra moThI saphalatA Ahe.
allAhacIca rAjya-sattA Ahe AkAzAMmadhye va jaminIvara ANi je kAhI yAMcyA daramyAna Ahe tyAvaradekhIla! ANi allAha sarva kAhI karaNyAce sAmarthya bALagato.

sarva prazaMsA tyA allAhakaritA Ahe, jyAne AkAzAMnA va jaminIlA nirmANa kele ANi aMdhaHkAra va prakAza banavilA tarIdekhIla ImAna na rAkhaNAre loka (itarAMnA) ApalyA pAlanakartyAcyA barobarIcA mAnatAta.
tyAneca tumhAlA mAtIpAsUna ghaDavile, maga eka avadhI TharavilA ANi eka nirdhArIta avadhI tyAcyAjavaLa Ahe tarIhI tumhI saMzayAta paDale AhAtA?
ANi toca allAha Ahe AkAzAMmadhye ANi jaminIvara. to tumace gupta bheda va jAhIra sarva kAhI jANato ANi tumacyA kamAIlA jANUna Ahe.
ANi tyAMcyAjavaLa tyAMcyA pAlanakartyAcyA nizANyAMpaikI koNatIhI nizANI ANalI gelI tarIhI te ticyApAsUna toMDa phiravitAta.
tyAMnI tyA satya-graMthAlAhI khoTe Tharavile, jevhA to tyAMcyAjavaLa yeUna pohocalA tevhA lavakaraca tyAMnA khabara miLela tyA goSTIcI jicI te thaTTA uDavita hote.

kAya tyAMnI pAhile nAhI kI AmhI tyAMcyApUrvI kityeka janasamUhAMnA naSTa karUna TAkale, jyAMnA AmhI yA jagAta evaDhe sAmarthya pradAna kele hote tase tumhAlAhI pradAna kele nAhI ANi AmhI tyAMcyAvara musaLadhAra pAUsa pADalA ANi AmhI tyAMcyA khAlUna jalapravAha jArI kele, maga AmhI tyAMnA tyAMcyA aparAdhAMpAyI barabAda karUna TAkale ANi tyAMcyAnaMtara dusarA janasamUha nirmANa kelA.

ANi jara AmhI kAgadAvara lihilelA ekhAdA graMtha jarI tumacyAvara utaravilA asatA, ANi tyAsa yA lokAMnI ApalyA hAtAMnI sparzahI kelA asatA, tarIdekhIla he inkArI loka aseca mhaNAle asate kI hI tara ughaDa jAdU Ahe ANakhI kAhI nAhI.
ANi te mhaNAle, tumacyAvara ekhAdAA phariztA kA nAhI utaravilA gelA? ANi jara AmhI phariztA utaravilA asatA tara sArA kissAca pUrNa jhAlA asatA, maga tyAMnA (thoDAsAhI) avasara dilA gelA nasatA.
ANi jara AmhI paigaMbarAlA phariztA banavile asate tara tyAlA puruSa rUpa dile asate ANi tarIdekhIla tyAvara tyAca lokAMnI saMzaya ghetalA asatA, je yA kSaNI saMzaya gheta Aheta.
ANi tumacyApUrvI aneka paigaMbarAMcI thaTTA uDavilI gelI, tara te thaTTA uDavita hote, tyAMcyA tyA thaTTA-maskarIcA duSpariNAma tyAMcyAvara ulaTalA.
tumhI sAMgA, jarA jaminIvara hiMDUna phirUna pAhA kI khoTe TharaviNAr2yAMcA kasA aMta jhAlA!

tumhI sAMgA kI, je kAhI AkAzAMmadhye va jaminIvara Ahe te sarva koNAcyA mAlakIce Ahe? tumhI sAMgA, sarva kAhI allAhacyAca mAlakIce Ahe. dayA kRpA karaNe allAhane svataHvara anivArya karUna ghetale Ahe. tumhAlA allAha kayAmatacyA divazI ekatra karIla, yAta muLIca zaMkA nAhI. jyA lokAMnI svataHcA sarvanAza karUna ghetalA Ahe, teca ImAna rAkhaNAre nAhIta.
ANi je kAhI divasa ANi rAtrIta rAhate te sarva kAhI allAhaceca Ahe ANi allAha khUpa aikaNArA ANi moThA jANaNArA Ahe.

tumhI sAMgA, kAya mI tyA allAhazivAya dusar2yAlA ApalA sahAyyaka mitra banavU, jo AkAzAMcA va jaminIcA racayitA Ahe ANi to sarvAMnA khAU ghAlato, tyAlA koNI khAU ghAlata nAhI. tumhI sAMgA, malA hA Adeza dilA gelA Ahe kI mI tyA sarvAMta prathama rAhAve, jyAMnI allAhasAThI AtmasamarpaNa kele ANi anekezvaravAdyAMpaikI kadhIhI na rAhAve.
tumhI sAMgA kI mI jara ApalyA pAlanakartyAcA Adeza mAnalA nAhI tara ekA moThyA divasAcyA az2Aba (zikSA-yAtane) ce malA bhaya vATate.
jyAcyAvarUna hA az2Aba tyA divazI haTavilA gelA, tara tyAcyAvara allAhane phAra moThI dayA kelI ANi hI spaSTa azI saphalatA Ahe.
ANi jara allAha tumhAlA kAhI trAsa-yAtanA deIla tara tilA dUra karaNArA allAhazivAya anya koNIhI nAhI ANi jara allAha tumhAlA lAbha pradAna karIla tara to pratyeka goSTIce sAmarthya bALagato.
toca ApalyA dAsAMvara prabhAvazAlI ANi varcasvazAlI Ahe ANi toca hikamata bALagaNArA, khabara rAkhaNArA Ahe.

tumhI sAMgA kI koNAcI sAkSa moThI Ahe? sAMgA kI AmacyA ANi tumacyA daramyAna allAha sAkSI Ahe ANi hA kuraAna mAjhyAkaDe vahayI (avatarIta) kelA gelA Ahe, yAsAThI kI tyAcyAdvAre tumhAlA ANi jyAMcyAparyaMta he pohocela, tyA sarvAMnA saceta karAve. kAya tumhI sAkSa detA kI allAhasobata anya itara upAsye (mAbUda) Aheta? tumhI sAMgA kI mI yA goSTIcI sAkSa nAhI deta. tumhI sAMgA, to ekaca upAsanA karaNyAyogya Ahe ANi mI tumacyA zirkapAsUna mukta Ahe.

jyAMnA AmhI graMtha (taurAta ANi iMjIla) dilA Ahe te tumhAlA (hajarata muhammada sallallAhu alaihi vasallama yAMnA) tyAcapramANe oLakhatAta, jyApramANe ApalyA putrAMnA oLakhatAta. je svataH ApalyAlA haravUna basale Aheta, teca ImAna rAkhaNAra nAhIta.
ANi yA hUna moThA atyAcArI koNa Ahe, jo allAhavara khoTA ALa gheIla tyAcyA nizANyAM (pratikAM) nA khoTe jANela. niHsaMzaya, atyAcArI loka saphala hota nAhIta.
ANi jyA divazI AmhI sarvAMnA ekatra karU, maMga jyAMnI allAhasobata dusar2yAMnA sahabhAgI Tharavile, tyAMnA sAMgU, koThe Aheta te, jyAMnA tumhI (allAhacA) sahabhAgI jANata hote (to divasa AThavato).
maga tyAMcyA zirkacI, yAkherIja koNatIhI sababa nasela kI mhaNatIla, AmacyA pAlanakartyA allAhacI zapatha, AmhI aneka IzvarAMcI upAsanA karaNAre navhato.
baghA, ApalyAviSayI tyAMnI kase khoTe sAMgitale ANi tyAMce te mithyA Aropa tyAMcyAkaDUna haravale, gAyaba jhAle.

tyAMcyApaikI kAhIjaNa tumacyAkaDe kAna lAvUna basatAta ANi AmhI tyAMcyA hRdayAMvara paDade TAkUna Thevale Aheta kI tyAsa samajAve ANi tyAMce kAna badhIra Aheta ANi sarva nizANyA tyAMnI pAhUna ghetalyA tarIhI tyAMcyAvara ImAna rAkhaNAra nAhIta, yethaparyaMta kI jevhA te tumacyAjavaLa yetAta, bhAMDaNa karatAta, ImAna na rAkhaNAre mhaNatAta kI yA sarva thora bujUrga lokAMcyA kathA-kahANyA Aheta.
ANi he loka yAcyApAsUna dusar2yAMnAhI rokhatAta ANi svataHdekhIla dUra dUra rAhatAta ANi he svataHcA sarvanAza karUna gheta Aheta ANi dhyAnI gheta nAhI.

ANi jara tumhI tyA veLI pAhAla, jevhA yA lokAMnA jahannamacyA javaLa ubhe kele jAIla, tevhA mhaNatIla, arere! AmhAlA punhA parata pAThavile gele tara kitI cAMgale hoIla (ANi ase jhAlyAsa) tara AmhI ApalyA pAlanakartyAcyA nizANyAMnA khoTe TharavaNAra nAhI ANi AmhI ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMpaikI hoU.

kiMbahunA jyA goSTIlA yApUrvI lapavita asata, tI tyAMcyAsamora AlI Ahe. jara yA lokAMnA punhA parata pAThavile gele, tarIhI he teca karatIla, jyApAsUna yAMnA rokhale gele hote ANi niHsaMzaya he loka khoTe Aheta.
ANi he ase mhaNatAta kI kevaLa he aihika jIvanaca Amace jIvana Ahe ANi AmhAlA dusar2yAMdA jivaMta kele jANAra nAhI.

ANi jara tumhI tyA veLI pAhAla, jevhA he loka ApalyA pAlanakartyAsamora ubhe kele jAtIla, allAha pharmAvila, kAya he khare nAhI? te mhaNatIla, niHsaMzaya, pAlanakartyAcI zapatha, he khare Ahe. allAha pharmAvila, tara maga ApalyA ImAna na rAkhaNyAcyA pariNAmI az2Aba (zikSA-yAtanA) sahana karA.

niHsaMzaya, moThyA toTyAta paDale te loka jyAMnI allahAcI bheTa hoNyAlA khoTe Tharavile, yethaparyaMta kI jevhA tI nirdhArIta veLa tyAMcyAvara acAnaka yeIla, tevhA mhaNatIla, kI arere! kheda Ahe AmacyA sustIbaddala jI yA bAbatIta jhAlI ANi tyAMcI avasthA azI hoIla kI Apale ojhe ApalyA kamarevara lAduna ghetalele asatIla. zAvadhAna! te moThee vAITa ojhe lAdUna ghetIla.
ANi yA jagAce jIvana tara, kheLa-tamAzAvyatirikta ANakhI kAhIca nAhI. ANi aMtima ghara (Akhirata) allAhace bhaya rAkhaNAr2yAMkaritA adhika cAMgale Ahe, kAya tumhI vicAra ciMtana karIta nAhI?
AmhI he cAMgalyA prakAre jANato kI, tyAMcyA kathanAMnI tumhI duHkhI kaSTI hotA, tara he loka tumhAlA khoTe mhaNata nAhIta, tara he atyAcArI allAhacyA AyatIMcA inkAra karatAta.

ANi tumacyA pUrvIcyA paigaMbarAMnAhI khoTe Tharavile gele Ahe ANi tyAMnI, tyA khoTe Tharavile jANyAvara dhIra-saMyama rAkhalA ANi tyAMnA trAsa-yAtanA dilI gelI, yethapAveto kI tyAMcyAjavaLa AmacI madata pohocalI. allAhace pharmAna koNI badalaNArA nAhI ANi tumacyAjavaLa paigaMbarAMce vRttAMta yeUna pohocale Aheta.

ANi jara tyAMce toMDa phiraviNe tumhAlA asahya hota asela tara tumacyAne he zakya asela tara jaminIta ekhAde bhuyAra kiMvA AkAzAta (caDhUna jANyAsAThI) ekhAdI ziDI zodhA ANi tyAMnA ekhAdA mojijA (camatkAra) ANUna dAkhavA. allAhane icchile asate tara tyA sarvAMnA satya mArgAvara jamA kele asate. yAstava nAdAna lokAMpaikI hoU nakA.
ANi teca loka svIkAra karatAta, je aikatAta ANi melelyA lokAMnA allAha jivaMta karUna uThavila, maga sarva tyA (allAhacyAca) kaDe ANale jAtIla.

ANi te mhaNAle kI, tyAMcyAvara tyAMcyA pAnalakartyAtarphe ekhAdA mojijA (camatkAra) kA nAhI utaravilA gelA? tumhI sAMgA kI allAha ekhAdA camatkAra utaraviNyAce purepUra sAmarthya rAkhato tathApi bahuteka loka jANata nAhIta.

ANi jitakyA prakArace sajIva jaminIvara cAlaNAre Aheta, ANi jitakyA prakArace paMkhAMnI uDaNAre pakSI Aheta, tyAMcyApaikI koNIhI asA nAhI, jo tumacyAsArakhA eka samUha nasAvA. AmhI graMthAta lihUna ThevaNyAta ekahI goSTa soDalI nAhI, maga sarva loka ApalyA pAlanakartyAjavaLa jamA kele jAtIla.
ANi jyA lokAMnI AmacyA AyatIMcA inkAra kelA, te bahIre, muke Aheta, aMdhArAta paDale Aheta. allAha jyAlA icchito pathabhraSTa karato ANi jyAlA icchito sanmArgAsa lAvato.

tumhI sAMgA kI ApalI kAya avasthA hoIla te sAMgA kI jara tumacyAvara allAhacA ekhAdA az2Aba yeUna kosaLAvA kiMvA tumacyAparyaMta kayAmataca yeUna pohacAvI, tara kAya allAhazivAya itarAMnA pukArAla? (sAMgA) jara tumhI sacce asAla.
kiMbahunA, vizeSataH tyAlAca pukArAla, maga jyAsAThI tumhI pukArAla, jara tyAne icchile tara tyAsa haTavUnahI deIla ANi jyAMnA tumhI allAhace sahabhAgI TharavitA, tyA sarvAMnA visarUna jAla.
ANi AmhI tumacyApUrvI hoUna gelelyA itara janasamUhAMkaDehI paigaMbara pAThavile hote. tyAMnAdekhIla AmhI garIbI va rogarAIne dharale, yAsAThI kI tyAMnI gayAvayA karAvI.
azA prakAre jevhA tyAMnA AmacI sajA miLAlI tara te kamajora kA nAhI paDatIla? paraMtu tyAMcI mane kaThora jhAlIta ANi saitAnAne tyAMcyA karmAMnA, tyAMcyA vicArAta cAMgale karUna dAkhavile.

ANi jevhA te tyA upadezAlA visarale, jyAcI tyAMnA zikavaNa dilI gelI hotI, tara AmhI tyAMcyAvara pratyeka cIja-vastUce daravAje khule kele, yethaparyaMta kI jevhA ApaNa prApta kelelyA cIjavastUMvara te ghameMDa karU lAgale tevhA tyAMnA AmhI acAnaka tAvaDIta ghetale, maga te nirAza hoUna basale.
maga atyAcArI lokAMcI pALemuLe kApalI gelI ANi sarvazreSTha allAhacI prazaMsA Ahe, jo sAr2yA jagAcA pAlanahAra Ahe.

tumhI tyAMnA sAMgA, bare he sAMgA kI jara allAha tumacI aikaNyAcI va pAhaNyAcI zaktI pUrNataH hirAvUna gheIla ANi tumacyA hRdayAMvara mohara lAvUna deIla tara allAhazivAya koNI upAsya (mAbUda) Ahe jo tumhAlA he punhA parata karIla? tumhI pAhA kI AmhI kazA prakAre ApalyA nizANyAMnA aneka rUpAMnI prastuta karIta Ahota, tarIdekhIla te kAnADoLA karIta Aheta.
tumhI sAMgA, bare he sAMgA kI jara tumacyAvara allAhacA az2Aba acAnaka kiMvA sAvadha asatAnA kosaLUna paDalA tara (yA sthitIta) kAya atyAcArI lokAMzivAya dusarA koNI mAralA jAIla?

ANi AmhI paigaMbara azAsAThI pAThavito kI tyAMnI zubha-vArtA dayAvI ANi lokAMnA (duSpariNatIce) bhaya dAkhavAve, maga jo koNI ImAna rAkhIla ANi Apale vartana sudhArela tara azAMnA nA kasale bhaya rAhIla ANi nA te duHkhI hotIla.
ANi je loka AmacyA AyatIMnA khoTe TharavatIla, tara tyAMnA allAhacA az2Aba yeUna gherela, kAraNa te avajJAkArI Aheta.

tumhI sAMgA kI mI nA tara tumhAlA he sAMgato kI mAjhyAjavaLa allAhacA khajinA Ahe ANi nA mI parokSa goSTIMnA jANato ANi nA mI ase sAMgato kI mI phariztA Ahe, mI tara kevaLa, je kAhI vahayIcyA rUpAne mAjhyAjavaLa yete, tyAce anusaraNa karato. tumhI sAMgA kI AMdhaLA ANi DoLasa doghe samAna kase asU zakatAta? tara maga tumhI vicAra ciMtana kA nAhI karIta?

ANi azA lokAMnA bhaya dAkhavA, je yA goSTIce bhaya bALagatAta kI ApalyA pAlanakartyAsamora azA sthitIta ekatra kele jAtIla kI allAhakherIja jevaDhe Aheta, nA tyAMcI madata karatIla ANi nA koNI ziphArasa karaNArA asela, yA Azesaha kI tyAMnI bhaya rAkhAve.

ANi tumhI tyAMnA bAhera kADhU nakA, je sakALa-saMdhyAkALa ApalyA pAlanakartyAcI upAsanA karatAta, vizeSataH tyAcI marjI prApta karU icchitAta, tyAMcyA hizobAzI tumacA kiMcitahI saMbaMdha nAhI ANi tumacyA hizobAzI tyAMcA kiMcitahI saMbaMdha nAhI kI jyAmuLe tumhI tyAMnA bAhera ghAlavAve, kiMbahunA tumhI atyAcAra karaNAr2yAMpaikI TharAla.

ANi azA prakAre AmhI tyAMnA ApasAta kasoTIta TAkale, yAsAThI kI tyAMnI mhaNAve, kAya allAhane AmacyAmadhUna phakta yAMcyAvaraca upakAra kelA? tevhA kAya ase nAhI kI allAha kRtajJazIla lokAMnA cAMgalyA prakAre jANato.

ANi tumacyAjavaLa jevhA te loka yetIla, je AmacyA AyatIMvara ImAna rAkhatAta, tara tyAMnA sAMgA, tumacyAvara salAmatI aso tumacyA pAlanakartyAne svataHvara dayA anivArya karUna ghetalI Ahe kI tumacyApaikI jyAne mUrkhapaNAne vAITa kRtya kele maga tyAnaMtara kSamA yAcanA kelI ANi sudhAraNA karUna ghetalI tara allAha moThA mApha karaNArA dayA karaNArA Ahe.
azA prakAre AmhI ApalyA AyatIMce savistara nivedana karato yAsAThI kI aparAdhI lokAMcA mArga spaSTa vhAvA.

tumhI sAMgA kI malA yA goSTIpAsUna rokhale gele Ahe kI mI tyAMcI upAsanA karAvI, jyAMnA allAhazivAya tumhI pukAratA. tumhI sAMgA kI mI tumacyA manAcyA icchenusAra cAlaNAra nAhI kAraNa azA sthitIta mI mArgabhraSTa hoIna ANi sanmArgAvara rAhaNAra nAhI.

tumhI sAMgA, mAjhyAjavaLa mAjhyA pAlanakartyAtarphe eka pramANa Ahe ANi te tumhI khoTe TharavitA. jyA goSTIcI tumhI ghAI karIta AhAta tI mAjhyAjavaLa nAhI. allAhazivAya dusar2yA koNAcAhI Adeza nAhI allAha vAstava goSTIMnA spaSTataH sAMgato ANi toca sarvAMta cAMgalA phaisalA karaNArA Ahe.

tumhI sAMgA, jyA goSTIcI tumhI evaDhyA ghAIne mAgaNI karIta AhAta tI jara mAjhyA avAkhyAta asatI tara mAjhyA va tumacyA daramyAna kevhAca phaisalA jhAlA asatA ANi allAha atyAcArI lokAMnA cAMgalyA prakAre oLakhato.

ANi tyA (allAha) kaDeca parokSAcyA cAvyA Aheta, jyAMnA phakta toca jANato ANi je kAhI dharatIvara ANi jalAzayAta Ahe te sarva to jANato ANi jaminIcyA aMdhaHkArAta eka dANAhI khAlI paData nAhI. ANi nA ekhAdI olI va koraDI vastU paDate, paraMtu he sarva kAhI spaSTa graMthAta namUda Ahe.

toca (allAha) hoya, jo rAtrI tumacA AtmA (eka paTa) tAbyAta gheto ANi divasA je kAhI karatA tehI jANato, maga tumhAlA tyAta eka TharalelI mudata pUrNa karaNyAkaritA jAge karato. maga tumhAlA tyAcyAcakaDe parata jAyace Ahe. tevhA tumhI je kAhI karIta rAhile te tumhAlA sAMgela.

toca ApalyA dAsAMvara varcasvazAlI Ahe ANi tumacyAvara dekharekha ThevaNAre (pharizte) pAThavito, yetha paryaMta kI jevhA tumacyApaikI ekhAdyAcA mRtyu (samaya) javaLa yeto, tevhA Amace pharizte tyAcA jIva kADhUna ghetAta ANi te kiMcitahI ALasa karIta nAhIta.
maga te ApalyA saccA pAlanakartyA (allAha) javaLa ANale jAtIla sAvadhAna! tyAcAca Adeza cAlela ANi to phAra lavakara hizoba gheIla.

tumhI sAMgA, jamIna ANi jalAzayAcyA aMdhaHkArAtUna jevhA tyAlA naramI ANi haLU svarAta pukAratA kI jara AmhAlA yAtUna soDavazila tara AmhI khaAtrIne tujhe kRtajJazIla banU, tevhA koNa tumhAlA vAcavito.
tumhI svataH sAMgA kI yApAsUna ANi pratyeka saMkaTApAsUna tumhAlA allAhaca vAcavito, paNa tarIhI tumhI zirka karatA.

tumhI sAMgA, toca tumacyAvara, tumacyAvarUna kiMvA tumacyA pAyAMkhAlUna az2Aba (zikSA-yAtanA) pAThaviNyAce kiMvA tumace aneka samUha banavUna ApasAta laDhAIcI majA cAkhaviNyAce sAmarthya rAkhato. tumhI pAhA kI AmhI anekarityA kazA prakAre ApalyA AyatIMce nivedana karato, yAsAThI kI tyAMnA samajAve.
ANi tumacyA janasamUhAne tyAlA khoTe Tharavile vAstavika te satya Ahe. tumhI sAMgA kI mI tumacyAvara adhikArI (nirIkSaka) nAhI.
pratyeka khabarIcI eka nirdhArIta veLa Ahe ANi he tumhI phAra lavakara jANUna ghyAla.

ANi jevhA tumhI tyA lokAMnA pAhAla, je AmacyA AyatIMmadhye vyaMga doSa kADhata Aheta, tevhA azA lokAMpAsUna vegaLe vhA, yethaparyaMta kI te dusar2yA kAmAta guMtAveta ANi jara tumhAlA saitAna visarahI pADela tarI AThavaNa AlyAvara punhA azA atyAcArI lokAMsobata basU nakA.

ANi je loka allAhace bhaya rAkhUna vAgatAta, tyAMcyAvara tyAMcyA pakaDIcA kAhIca pariNAma hoNAra nAhI. mAtra tyAMnA zikavaNa deta rAhANe (cAMgale Ahe) kadAcita tedekhIla allAhace bhaya rAkhUna duSkarmApAsUna dUra rAhU lAgatIla.

ANi azA lokAMzI kadhIhI nAte ThevU nakA, jyAMnI ApalyA dIna (dharmA) lA kheLa-tamAzA banavUna Thevale Ahe ANi aihika jIvanAne tyAMnA dhokyAta TAkale Ahe. ANi yA kuraAnAdvAre upadeza jarUra karIta rAhA, yAsAThI kI ekhAdA manuSya ApalyA karmAMmuLe azA prakAre na phasAvA kI koNI allAhazivAya tyAcI madata karaNArA nasAvA ANi nA ziphArasa karaNArA ANi avasthA azI vhAvI kI jara sAre jaga bharUna mobadalyAta deUna TAkIla, tarIhI tyAcyAkaDUna ghetale na jAve. te aseca loka Aheta kI ApalyA karmAMmuLe aDakUna paDale. tyAMcyAsAThI khUpa garama pANI piNyAce asela ANi tyAMcyA kupra (inkArA) muLe moThI duHdAyaka zikSA-yAtanA asela.

tumhI sAMgA, kAya AmhI allAhazivAya tyAlA pukArAve jo Amace bhale-bure kAhIca karU zakata nasAvA, ANi allAhace mArgadarzana lAbhalyAnaMtara tyA mANasAsArakhe TAcA ragaData parata phiravile jAve, jaNU saitAnAne bahakavile asAve ANi to dharatIvara bhaTakata phirata asAvA. tyAce sAthIdAra tyAlA saraLa mArgAkaDe bolAvita asAveta kI AmacyA javaLa ye. tumhI sAMgA, allAhace mArgadarzanaca khar2yA arthAne mArgadarzana Ahe. ANi AmhAlA hA Adeza dilA gelA Ahe kI samasta jagAcyA svAmIsAThI svataHlA tyAcyA havAlI karAve.
ANi namAja kAyama karA ANi tyA (allAha) ce bhaya rAkhA, to, toca Ahe, jyAcyAkaDe tumhI ekatrita kele jAla.

tyAneca AkAzaAMnA va jaminIlA satyAsaha nirmANa kele, ANi jyA divazI to pharmAvila, hoUna jA tara hoUna jAIla. tyAce vacana agadI satya Ahe, ANi jyA divazI zaMkha phuMkalA jAIla, rAjya sattA tyAcIca asela. to jANaNArA Ahe parokSa ANi astitvAcA ANito hikamatazAlI va khabara rAkhaNArA Ahe.
ANi smaraNa karA, jevhA ibrAhIma Apale pitA AjaralA mhaNAle, kAya tumhI murtyAMnA upAsya (mAbUda) banavita AhAta? mI tara tumhAlA va tumacyA lokAMnA ughaDa mArgabhraSTateta pAhatoya.
ANi azA prakAre AmhI ibrAhImalA AkAzAMcI va jaminIcI rAjya-sattA dAkhavilI yAsAThI kI tyAMnI purepUra vizvAsa ThevaNAr2yAMpaikI vhAve.
maga jevhA tyAMcyAvara rAtrIcA aMdhAra pasaralA tevhA eka tArA pAhilA, mhaNAle kI hA mAjhA pAlanahAra Ahe, maga jevhA to buDAlA tevhA mhaNAle kI mI asta pAvaNAr2yAzI prema rAkhata nAhI.

maga jevhA caMdrAlA camakatAnA pAhile, tevhA mhaNAle, hA mAjhA pAlanakartA Ahe, maga jevhA to buDAlA tevhA mhaNAle kI jara mAjhyA pAlanakartyAne malA saraLa mArga dAkhavilA nAhI tara mI mArgabhraSTa jhAlelyAMpaikI hoIna.
maga jevhA sUryAlA camakatAnA pAhile, tevhA mhaNAle, hA mAjhA pAlanahAra Ahe. hA tara sarvAMta moThA Ahe, paraMtu jevhA to buDAlA tevhA mhaNAle, kI niHsaMzaya mI tumacyA zirkapAsUna mukta Ahe.
mI Apale toMDa tyAcyAkaDe phiravUna ghetale, jyAne AkAzAMnA va jaminIlA nirmANa kele ekAgratApUrvaka, ANi mI anekezvaravAdyAMpaikI nAhI.

ANi tyAMcyAzI, tyAMce loka hujjata karU lAgale. paigaMbara (ibrAhIma) mhaNAle, kAya tumhI allAhaviSayI mAjhyAzI vAda ghAlatA. vAstavika tyAne malA saraLa mArga dAkhavilA Ahe ANi jyAMnA tumhI allAhasobata sAmIla karatA, mI tyAMce bhaya rAkhata nAhI, paraMtu he kI mAjhA pAlanakartA ekhAdyA kAraNAne icchila. mAjhyA pAlanakartyAne pratyeka goSTIlA ApalyA jJAnakakSeta gheralele Ahe. kAya tumhI tarIhI vicAra karIta nAhI?

ANi mI tyA vastUce kA mhaNUna bhaya rAkhAve jilA tumhI allAhacA sahabhAgI Tharavile Ahe, vAstavika tumhI tyA vastUlA allAhacA sahabhAgI banaviNyApAsUna bhita nAhI, jyAce tumacyAjavaLa allAhane ekhAde pramANa utaravile nAhI. maga yA donhI samUhAMmadhye koNa zAMtIcA jAsta hakkadAra Ahe, jara tumhI jANata asAla.
jyA lokAMnI ImAna rAkhale ANi ApalyA ImAnAta kasalyAhI prakAracyA zirkace mizraNa kele nAhI, tyAMcyAcasAThI zAMtI Ahe ANi teca saraLa mArgAvara Aheta.
. ANi he Amace pramANa Ahe je AmhI ibrAhimalA tyAAcyA janasamUhAcyA mukAbalyAta dile. AmhI jyAlA icchito tyAce darje bulaMda (uMcavito ) niHzaMya tumacA pAlanakartA hikamatazAlI sarvajJa Ahe

ANi AmhI tyAMnA isahAka ANi yAkUba pradAna kele ANi pratyekAlA saraLa mArga dAkhavilA ANi yApUrvI nUhalA mArga dAkhavilA ANi saMtatIta dAUda ANi sulemAna ANi ayyUba ANi yUsupha ANi mUsA va hArUna yAMnA ANi azA prakAre AmhI nekI (satkarma) karaNAr2yA lokAMnA mobadalA pradAna karato.
ANi jakariyA ANi yahyA ANi IsA ANi iliyAsa yAMnA, he sarva neka sadAcArI lokAMpaikI hote.
ANi ismAIla ANi yasaa ANi yUnusa ANi lUta yAMnA, yA sarvAMnA AmhI yA jagAtIla lokAMvara zreSThatA pradAna kelI.
ANi tyAMcyA vADavaDIla, saMtatI ANi bhAvAMmadhUna ANi AmhI tyAMcI nivaDa kelI ANi tyAMnA saraLa mArga dAkhavilA.
hAca allAhacA mArga Ahe ApalyA dAsAMpaikI jyAlA icchito, tyAlA mArga dAkhavito ANi jara tyA lokAMnIhI allAhasobata dusar2yAMnA sahabhAgI kele asate tara tyAMce karma vAyA gele asate.
yAMnAca AmhI graMtha ANi hikamata ANi nubUvata (paigaMbarI) pradAna kelI ANi jara yA lokAMnI yAsa mAnale nAhI, tara AmhI azA lokAMnA tayAra karUna Thevale Ahe, je yAcA inkAra karaNAra nAhIta.

heca te loka hote, jyAMnA allAhane ucita mArga dAkhavilA, yAstava tumhI tyAMcyA mArgAce anusaraNa karA. tumhI sAMgA kI mI yAbaddala kasalAhI mobadalA mAgata nAhI. samasta jagAtIla lokAMkaritA hI kevaLa smaraNikA Ahe.

ANi tyAMnI, allAhacI jazI kadara kelI pAhije hotI tazI kadara kelI nAhI. jevhA te ase mhaNAle kI allAhane koNA mANasAvara kAhI utaravile nAhI. tumhI sAMgA, mUsA jo graMtha tumacyAjavaLa gheUna Ale, jo lokAMkaritA divya prakAza ANi mArgadarzana Ahe, to koNI utaravilA, jyAlA tumhI vegavegaLyA pAnAMmadhye ThevatA, jyAtUna kAhI jAhIra karatA ANi adhikAMza lapavitA ANi tumhAlA te jJAna dile gele, je tumhI ANi tumace vADavaDIla jANata navhate. tumhI sAMgA kI allAhaneca utaravilA hotA. maga tyAMnA tyAMcyA doSa kADhaNyAta, kheLa tamAzA karIta soDUna dyA.

ANi hAdekhIla eka zubha graMtha Ahe, jo AmhI avatarIta kelA Ahe. ApalyA pUrvIcyA graMthAMcI satyatA darzavito, yAsAThI kI tumhI mULa vastI (makkA) ANi tyAcyA javaLapAsacyA (zaharAMnA mhaNaje samasta mAnavavizvA) lA sUcita karAve ANi je Akhiratavara ImAna rAkhatAta, teca yAlA mAnatIla ANi teca ApalyA namAjAMce rakSaNa karatIla.

ANi tyAhUna moThA atyAcArI ANakhI koNa asU zakato, jo allAhavara khoTA Aropa ThevIla kiMvA ase mhaNela kI mAjhyAkaDe vahayI AlI Ahe, vAstavika tyAcyAkaDe kAhIca Ale nAhI ANi jo ase mhaNAlA kI, jyAprakAre allAhane utaravile tase mIdekhIla utaravina. jara tumhI atyAcArIMnA mRtyucyA kaThora zikSA-yAtaneta pAhAla, jevhA pharizte Apale hAta puDhe karUna mhaNatIla, ApalA jIva kADhA. Aja tumhAlA allAhavara nAhaka Aropa ThevaNyAmuLe ANi ghameMDIne tyAcyA AyatIMcA inkAra karaNyApAyI apamAnadAyaka mobadalA dilA jAIla.

ANi tumhI AmacyAjavaLa ekaTe-ekaTe AlAta, jase tumhAlA pahilyAMdA nirmANa kele gele ANi tumhAlA je dile te ApalyA mAge soDUna AlAta ANi tumacI ziphArasa karaNAre AmhAlA dRSTIsa paData nAhIta, jyAMnA tumhI ApalyA kAryAta AmacA sahabhAgI samajata hote. niHsaMzaya tumace ANi tyAMce saMbaMdha tuTale ANi tumace te vicAra tumacyApAsUna haravale.
allAhaca bIja ANi koya phADUna aMkUra bAhera kADhato. to sajIvAlA nirjIvAtUna, nirjIvAlA sajIvAtUna bAhera kADhato. toca allAha Ahe. maga tumhI koThe ulaTa bahakata jAta AhAta?
to prAtaHkALa phADaNArA Ahe ANi tyAne rAtrIlA ArAma karaNyAsAThI ANi sUrya ANi caMdrAlA hizoba lAvaNyAsAThI banavile. hI nirdhArIta goSTa Ahe, jabaradasta jJAna bALagaNAr2yA (allAha) cI.
ANi tyAneca tumacyAsAThI tAre banavile, yAsAThI kI tumhI jamIna ANi samudrAcyA aMdhArAta tyAMcyAdvAre mArga jANUna ghyAvA. AmhI tyA lokAMsAThI nizANyA sAMgitalyA Aheta, je jJAna bALagatAta.
ANi tyAneca tumhAlA ekA jIvApAsUna nirmANa kele. maga tumace eka kAyamasvarUpI ANi eka supUrda hoNyAce ThikANa Ahe. AmhI tyAMcyAsAThI nizANyA (cinhe) sAMgitalyA Aheta. je jJAna bALagatAta.

ANi toca hoya, jyAne AkAzAtUna parjanyavRSTI kelI. maga AmhI tyAdvAre sarva prakAracI vanaspatI ugavalI, maga tyAdvAre hiravegAra zetI utpanna kelI, jyApAsUna AmhI tharAvara thara asalele dhAnya ANi khajUrIcyA gAbhyAzI laTakaNAre ghoMsa ANi drAkSa va jaitUna va DALIMbAcyA bAgA utpana karato, jyA ekAca prakAracyA ANi aneka prakAracyA asatAta. tyAMcI phaLe pAhA, jevhA tI lAgatAta, tyAMce pikaNe, niHsaMzaya yA sarvAMta, tyA lokAMkaritA nizANyA (cinhe) Aheta, je ImAna rAkhatAta.

ANi lokAMnI jinnAMnA allAhace sahabhAgI banavile Ahe, vAstavika tyAneca tyAMnA nirmANa kele Ahe ANi tyA (allAha) cyAkaritA putra ANi kanyA, manAne TharavUna ghetalyA, kasalyAhI jJAnAvinA to (allAha) yAMnI sAMgitalelyA avaguNAMpAsUna mukta ANi uttama Ahe.
to AkAzAMcI va dharatIcI inirmatI karaNArA Ahe, tyAlA saMtatI kazI asU zakate? vAstavika tyAcI koNatIhI patnI nAhI ANi to pratyeka cIja-vastUcA nirmANakartA ANi jANaNArA Ahe.
toca allAha tumacA pAlanakartA Ahe, tyAcyAkherIja koNIhI upAsya (mAbUda) nAhI, pratyeka cIja-vastUcA racayitA, yAstava phakta tyAcIca upAsanA karA ANi to pratyeka goSTIcI dekhabhAla ThevaNArA Ahe.
DoLe tyAlA pAhU zakata nAhIta ANi to sarva najarA pAhato ANi to atisUkSmadarzI, bheda jANaNArA khabara rAkhaNArA Ahe.

tumacyA pAlanakartyAtarphe tumacyAjavaLa pramANa gheUna pohocale Ahe tevhA jo pAhIla, ApalyA bhalyAkaritA (pAhIla) ANi jo AMdhaLA banUna rAhIla, to Apale ahita ( nukasAna) karUna gheIla ANi mI tumacA rakSaka nAhI.

azA prakAre AmhI (pavitra kuraAnAcyA) AyatIMnA punhA punhA sAMgAta Ahota, yAsAThI kI tyAMnI sAMgAve kI tumhI vAcUna aikavile tyA lokAMkaritA je jANatAta AmhI te cAMgalyA prakAre spaSTa karUna sAMgAve.
