tumhI ApalyA pAlanakartyAcyA AdezA (vahayI) ce anusaraNa karA kI allAhazivAya koNIhI upAsya (mAbUda) nAhI ANi anekezvaravAdyAMpAsUna vimukha vhA.
ANi allAhane icchile asate tara yAMnI itarAMnA allAhace sahabhAgI Tharavile nasate ANi AmhI tumhAlA yA lokAMvara dekharekha ThevaNArA banavile nAhI, ANi nA tumhI tyAMcyAvara adhikAra rAkhaNAre AhAta.

ANi je loka allAhazivAya dusar2yAMnA pukAratAta tyAMnA apazabda vAparU nakA, anyathA zatrU banUna ajANatepaNI tedekhIla allAhasAThI apazabda vAparatIla. azA prakAre AmhI pratyeka janasamUhAsAThI tyAMce karma suzobhita banavile Ahe, maga tyAMnA ApalyA pAlanakartyAkaDeca paratAyace Ahe. yAstava to tyAMnA tyAbAbata sUcita karIla je kAhI te karIta rAhile.

ANi tyAMnI joradArapaNe allAhacI zapatha ghetalI kI tyAMcyAjavaLa ekhAdI nizANI AlI tara khAtrIne mAnatIla. tumhI sAMgA kI nizANyA allAhajavaLa Aheta ANi tumhAlA kAya mAhIta kI tyA nizANyA yeUna pohacatIla, tarIhI te mAnaNAra nAhIta.
ANi AmhI tyAMcI mane va DoLe phiravUna TAkU jase tyAMnI pUrvI yAvara ImAna rAkhale nAhI ANi tyAMnA tyAMcyA vidrohA (cyA aMdhArA) ta aseca bhaTakata ThevU.

ANi jara AmhI tyAMcyAjavaLa pharizte utaravile asate, ANi tyAMcyAzI melelyA lokAMnI bAtacita kelI asatI ANi tyAMcyApuDhe sarva cIja-vastU jamA kelI asatI tarIdekhIla allAhacyA icchevinA yAMnI ImAna rAkhale nasate, paraMtu yAMcyApaikI bahuteka loka mUrkhatA karIta Aheta.

ANi azA prakAre pratyeka paigaMbarAkaritA jinnAMcyA ANi mAnavAMcyA saitAnAMnA zatrU banavile je ApasAta bhuraLa paDaNyAkaritA manamohaka goSTI manAta ANatAta ANi jara tumacyA pAlanakartyAne icchile asate tara tyAMnI ase kele nasate. tevhA tumhI tyAMnA va tyAMcyA kArasthAnAlA soDA.
ANi yAsAThI kI tyAMcI mane tyAkaDe pravRtta vhAvIta, je Akhiratavara ImAna rAkhata nAhI ANi tazAne AnaMdita vhAveta ANi toca aparAdha karAvA jo te loka karIta hote.

tara kAya mI allAhakherIja anya ekhAdyA zAsakAcA zodha ghyAvA vAstavika tyAneca tumacyAkaDe eka savistara graMtha (kuraAna) avatarIta kelA ANi AmhI jyAMnA graMtha pradAna kelA Ahe, te jANatAta kI kharokhara to tumacyA pAlanakartyAtarphe satyAsaha Ahe, tevhA tumhI saMzaya karaNAr2yAMpaikI hoU nakA.
ANi tumacyA pAlanakartyAcI vacane satyakathana ANi nyAyAne paripUrNa jhAlIta. tyAcyA vANIlA koNIhI badalU zakata nAhI ANi to cAMgalyA prakAre aikaNArA, jANaNArA Ahe.

ANi jagAta rAhaNAr2yAMpaikI tumhI jara adhikAMza lokAMce anusaraNa karAla tara te tumhAlA allAhacyA mArgApAsUna haTavatIla. te phakta nirAdhAra kalpanAMcyA mAge cAlatAta ANi aTakaLIcyA goSTI karatAta.
niHsaMzaya tumacA pAlanakartA tyAMnA cAMgalyA prakAre jANato, je tyAcyA mArgApAsUna vicalita hotAta ANi to tyAMnAhI cAMgalyA prakAre jANato je tyAcyA mArgAvara cAlatAta.
tara jyA (janAvarA) vara allAhace nAva ghetale jAIla, tyAtUna khA, jara tumhI tyAcyA (allAhacyA) hukUmAvara ImAna rAkhata asAla.

ANi tumacyAsAThI koNatI goSTa yAce kAraNa asAvI kI tumhI azA janAvarAMmadhUna na khAve, jyAvara allAhace nAva ghetale gele asela jarI allAhane tyA sarva janAvarAMcA tapazIla sAMgitalA Ahe. jyAMnA tumacyAsAThI harAma kele gele Ahe, paraMtu tedekhIla jevhA tumhAlA sakta garaja bhAsalyAsa (vaidha Ahe) ANi he nizcita Ahe kI bahuteka loka ApalyA cukIcyA irAdyAMvara, kasalyAhI pramANAvinA bhaTakatAta. niHsaMzaya allAha atireka karaNAr2yAMnA cAMgalyA prakAre oLakhato.
tumhI ughaDa ANi lapalele ase sarva aparAdha soDUna dyA. niHsaMzaya je loka gunhA kamavitAta, tyAMnA tyAMcyA duSkarmAMcA mobadalA lavakaraca dilA jAIla.

ANi te khAU nakA, jyA janAvarAvara jibaha karateveLI allAhace nAva ghetale gele nasela ANi he duSkRtya Ahe ANi saitAna ApalyA mitrAMcyA manAta azA goSTI bharavitAta kI tyAMnI tumacyAzI bhAMDaNa karAve jara tumhI tyAMce mhaNaNe mAnale tara khacitaca tumhI zirka karaNAre vhAla.

ANi asA manuSya, jo pUrvI melelA hotA, maga AmhI tyAlA jivaMta kele ANi tyAcyAsAThI divya prakAza banavilA, jyAdvAre to lokAMmadhye cAlato, kAya tyA mANasAsArakhA asU zakato, jo aMdhArAta asAvA, ANi tyAtUna bAhera paDU zakata nasAvA? azAca adharmI lokAMkaritA tyAMce AcaraNa suzobhita banavile gele Ahe.

ANi azA prakAre AmhI pratyeka vastIcyA moThyA aparAdhyAMnA kaTa-kArasthAna racaNyAsAThI banavile yAsAThI kI tyAMnI vastIta kArasthAna racAve ANi te ApalyAca virUddha kArasthAna racatAta mAtra tyAMnA te kaLUna yeta nAhI.

ANi jevhA tyAMcyAjavaLa ekhAdI Ayata yete tevhA mhaNatAta kI AmhI kadhIhI vizvAsa ThevaNAra nAhIta joparyaMta AmhAlAhI tazIca Ayata dilI jAta nAhI, jI allAhacyA paigaMbarAMnA dilI gelI. allAha cAMgalyA prakAre jANato kI tyAne ApalI paigaMbarI (risAlata) koNatyA ThikANI rAkhAvI. lavakaraca jyAMnI aparAdha kele Aheta, tyAMnA allAhacyA ThikANI apamAnita vhAyace Ahe ANi je kaTa-kArasthAna te karIta rAhile, tyAcA mobadalA phAra moThA az2Aba Ahe.

jyAlA allAha saraLa mArga dAkhavU icchito tyAcI chAtI (hRdaya) islAma (dharmA) karitA khulI karato ANi jyAlA mArgabhraSTa karU icchito, tyAcI chAtI ANakhI jAsta saMkucita karato, jaNU kAhI to AkAzAta caDhata Ahe. azA prakAre allAha tyAMnA ghANIta TAkato je ImAna rAkhata nAhI.
hA tumacyA pAlanakartyAcA saraLa mArga Ahe AmhI AyatIMce savistara varNana tyA janasamUhAkaritA dile Ahe, je bodha prApta karatAta.
yAMcyAcasAThI tyAMcyA pAlanakartyAcyA ThikANI salAmatIce ghara Ahe ANi toca tyAMcyA satkarmAMcyA AdhArAvara tyAMcA mitra Ahe.

ANi jyA divazI allAha yA sarvAMnA ekatra karIla (ANi pharmAvila) he jinna-samUha! tumhI mAnavAMpaikI bahutekAMnA AtmasAta kele ANi mAnavAMpaikI tyAMce mitra mhaNatIla, he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! AmhAlA ApasAta lAbha pohacava ANi AmhI tujhyA nirdhArIta veLesa, jI tU AmacyAsAThI nizcita kelI, jAUna pohocalo. (allAha) pharmAvila, kI tumacI jAgA jahannamamadhye Ahe, jyAta tumhI sadaiva rAhAla, paraMtu allAha icchila, niHsaMzaya tumacA pAlanakartA hikamatazAlI, jJAnI Ahe.
azAca prakAre AmhI atyAcArI lokAMnA tyAMcyA duSkRtyAMpAyI ekamekAMce dosta banavito.

he jinna ANi mAnavAMcyA samUhAMno! kAya tumacyAjavaLa tumacyAmadhUna rasUla (paigaMbara) nAhI Aleta? je tumacyAsamora AmacyA AyatI vAcUna aikavita hote ANi tumhAlA yA (kayAmatacyA) divasAcA sAmanA karaNyAbAbata saceta karIta rAhile. te mhaNatIla, AmhI svataHvirUddha sAkSI Ahota ANi aihika jIvanAne tyAMnA dhokyAta Thevale ANi te svataHvirUddhaca sAkSa detIla kI te kAphira (inkArI) hote.
(paigaMbara pAThavile gele) kAraNa tumacA pAlanakartA ekhAdyA vastIcyA lokAMnA ekhAdyA atyAcArApAyI naSTa karIta nAhI, jevhA tethIla rahivAzI gAphIla asAveta.
ANi pratyekAsAThI tyAcyA karmAnusAra aneka darje Aheta ANi tumacA pAlanakartA yA karmAMzI gAphIla nAhI jI te karIta Aheta.

ANi tumacA pAlanakartA niHspRha dayA karaNArA Ahe. jara tyAne icchile tara tumacA sarvanAza karUna TAkIla ANi tumacyAnaMtara jyAlA icchila tumacyA jAgI ANUna ThevIla, jase tumhAlA anya ekA janasamUhAcyA vaMzAta nirmANa kele.
jyA goSTIcA tumhAlA vAyadA dilA jAta Ahe, tI niHsaMzaya ghaDUna yeNAra Ahe ANi tumhI vivaza karU zakata nAhI.

tumhI sAMgA, he mAjhyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMno! tumhI ApalyA ThikANI Apale karma karIta rAhA, mIdekhIla (ApalyA jAgI) karma karIta Ahe. tumhAlA lavakaraca mAhIta paDela kI koNAcA zevaTa yA jagAnaMtara (cAMgalA) hoto. niHsaMzaya atyAcAra karaNAre kadhIhI saphala hoNAra nAhIta.

ANi allAhane jI zetI ANi janAvare nirmANa kelIta, tyAMnI tyAMcyAtUna kAhI bhAga allAhacA TharavilA ANi ApalyA kalpanenusAra mhaNAle kI hA hissA allAhacA Ahe, ANi hA AmacyA upAsya-devatAMcA, maga jo AmacyA daivatAMcA (hissA) Ahe, to allAhaparyaMta pohacata nAhI, mAtra jo allAhacA Ahe to tyAMcyA daivatAMparyaMta pohocato. kitI vAITa phaisalA te karatAta!

ANi azA prakAre bahuteka anekezvaravAdyAMkaritA tyAMcyA daivatAMnI tyAMnA barabAda karaNyAsAThI ANi tyAMcyAvara tyAMcA dharma saMzayAspada banaviNyAsAThI, tyAMcyA saMtatIcyA hatyelA suzobhita banavile Ahe ANi allAhane icchile asate tara tyAMnI ase kele nasate tevhA tumhI tyAMnA ANi tyAMcyA manAne racalelyA goSTIlA soDUna dyA.

ANi te mhaNAle, hI janAvare ANi zetI harAma Ahe, yAlA toca khAIla, jyAlA AmhI ApalyA icchene khAyalA sAMgU ANi kAhI janAvarAMcI pATha (arthAta svAra hoNe) harAma Ahe ANi kAhI janAvarAMvara (jibaha karateveLI) allAhace nAva gheta nAhI, allAhavara khoTe racaNyAkaritA allAha tyAMnA tyAMcyA AropAcA mobadalA lavakaraca deIla.

ANi te mhaNAle, yA janAvarAMcyA garbhAta je Ahe te vizeSataH AmacyA puruSAMkaritA Ahe ANi AmacyA bAyakAMvara harAma Ahe, mAtra jara te mRta asela tara tyAta sarvAMcA hissA Ahe. to (allAha) tyAMcyA yA kathanAcA mobadalA lavakaraca deIla. niHsaMzaya to hikamatazAlI, jANaNArA Ahe.

moThyA nukasAnAta rAhile te jyAMnI jJAnAvinA mUrkhapaNAne ApalyA saMtatIcI hatyA kelI ANi allAhane jI rojI (AjIvikA) pradAna kelI tilA harAma TharavUna ghetale allAhavara khoTe racaNyApAyI, te mArgabhraSTa jhAle ANi sanmArgAvara rAhile nAhIta.

toca (allAha) Ahe, jyAne velIMcyA ANi vinAvelIMcyA bAgA nirmANa kelyA, ANi khajUra va zetI jyAMcA svAda aneka prakAracA Ahe, ANi jaitUna va DALiMbe eka prakAracI, anekavidha (anekaprakAracI). jevhA tyAMnA phaLe yetIla tevhA tumhI tI khA ANi tyAcyA kApaNIcyA divazI tyAcA hakka jarUra adA karA ANi udhaLapaTTIne kharca karU nakA. niHsaMzaya, allAha udhaLapaTTI karaNAr2yAMzI prema rAkhata nAhI.

ANi janAvarAMmadhye kAhI ojhe lAdaNyAyogya ANi kAhI jaminIlA lAgUna asalele banavile. khA, je tumhAlA allAhane pradAna kele Ahe, ANi saitAnAcyA pada-cinhAMce an‌usaraNa karU nakA. niHsaMzaya, to tumacA ughaDa zatrU Ahe.

ATha prakArace joDe (banavile) meMDhIcyA jAtIce dona, bakarIcyA jAtIce dona. tumhI sAMgA kI allAhane doghAMcyA narAlA harAma kele Ahe kiMvA doghAMcyA mAdIlA? kiMvA tyAlA jo donhI mAdyAMcyA garbhAzayAta Ahe malA jJAnAsaha sAMgA, jara sacce asAla.

ANi uMTAmadhye dona ANi gAyIcyA jAtIta dona. tumhI sAMgA, kAya allAhane donhI mAdyAMnA kiMvA donhI narAMnA harAma kele Ahe? kiMvA tyAlA, jo donhI mAdyAMcyA garbhAzayAta sAmIla asela. kAya tumhI tyA veLI hajara hote, jevhA allAhane yAcA Adeza dilA? maga tyAhUna moThA atyAcArI koNa asela, jo allAhavara khoTA Aropa ThevIla, yAsAThI kI kasalyAhI jJAnAvinA lokAMnA mArgabhraSTa karAve. niHsaMzaya, allAha atyAcArI lokAMnA mArga dAkhavita nAhI.

tumhI sAMgA, malA jo Adeza dilA gelA Ahe, tyAta koNA khANAr2yAkaritA koNatehI khAdya harAma ADhaLata nAhI. paraMtu he kI te melele asela, kiMvA vAhate rakta, kiMvA DukarAce mAMsa, yAsAThI kI te agadI nApAka (asvaccha-azuddha) Ahe kiMvA je zirkace kAraNa asela, jyAvara allAhazivAya dusar2yAMce nAva ghetale gele asela, maga jo koNI lAcAra asela vAstavika vidrohI ANi maryAdece ullaMghana karaNArA nasela tara allAha moThA mApha karaNArA, dayA karaNArA Ahe.

ANi AmhI yahUdI lokAMvara nakhe asalelI janAvare harAma kelI ANi gAya va bakarIcI carabI tyAMcyAvara harAma kelI, mAtra jI doghAMcyA pAThIvara ANi AtaDyAta asela kiMvA jI ekhAdyA hADAzI lAgUna asela. AmhI hA tyAMcyA (dharmAzI) vidrohAcA mobadalA dilA ANi AmhI sacce Ahota.
jara to tumhAlA khoTe Tharavila tara sAMgA kI tumacyA pAlanakartyA (allAha) cI dayA atizaya vistRta Ahe ANi tyAcA az2Aba (zikSA-yAtanA) aparAdhI lokAMvarUna TaLU zakata nAhI.

aneka IzvarAMcI upAsanA karaNAre mhaNatIla, allAhane icchile asate tara AmhI ANi AmacyA vADa-vaDilAMnI, allAhasobata dusar2yAMnA upAsya mAnale nasate, nA ekhAdyA vastUlA harAma Tharavile asate azA prakAre yAMcyA pUrvIcyA lokAMnI khoTe Tharavile, yethaparyaMta kI AmacyA az2AbacA svAda cAkhUna ghetalA. tyAMnA sAMgA, kAya tumacyAjavaLa ekhAde jJAna Ahe tara te AmacyAsAThI bAhera kADhA (jAhIra karA) tumhI aTakaLIvara cAlatA ANi phakta anumAna lAvatA.
tumhI sAMgA, maga allAhaceca pramANa prabhAvazAlI Ahe, yAstava tyAne jara icchile tara tumhA sarvAMnA mArgadarzana karU zakato.

tumhI sAMgA, ApalyA tyA sAkSa deNAr2yAMnA ANA, jyAMnI hI sAkSa dyAvI kI allAhane yAlA harAme kele Ahe, maga jara te sAkSa detIla tara tumhI tyAMcyAsobata sAkSa deU nakA ANi tyAMcyA manamAnI icchA-AkAMkSAMce anusaraNa karU nakA ANi jyAMnI AmacyA AyatIMnA khoTe Tharavile ANi je Akhiratavara ImAna rAkhata nAhI ANi (itarAMnA)ApalyA pAlanakartyAsamAna mAnatAta.

tumhI sAMgA kI, yA, mI vAcUna aikavU kI tumhAlA tumacyA pAlanakartyAne kazApAsUna manAI kelI Ahe. te he kI tyAcyAsobata koNatyAhI cIja-vastUlA sahabhAgI karU nakA ANi mAtA pityAzI neka vartana karA ANi ApalyA saMtatIcI garIbImuLe hatyA karU nakA. AmhI tumhAlA ANi tyAMnA rojI (AjivikA) pradAna karato ANi khulyA va chupyA nirlajjatecyA javaLa jAU nakA ANi tyA jIvAlA jyAbAbata allAhane manAI kelI Ahe, ThAra mArU nakA, paraMtu dharmazAstrIya (zarIatacyA) kAraNAne. tumhAlA tyAne yAcAca Adeza dilA Ahe, yAsAThI kI tumhI samajUna ghyAve.

ANi anAthAcyA saMpattIcyA javaLahI jAU nakA, tathApi khUpa cAMgalyA paddhatIne, yetheparyaMta kI te tAruNyAvasthesa pohocAveta, ANi nyAyAsaha mApa-tola pUrNa karA. AmhI koNAvara tyAcyA kuvatIpekSA jAsta bhAra Thevata nAhI ANi jevhA bolAla, tevhA nyAya karA, maga to javaLacA nAtevAIka kA asenA ANi allAhazI kelelA vAyadA pUrNa karA. tyAne tumhA lokAMnA yAcAca Adeza dilA Ahe yAsAThI kI tumhI smaraNa rAkhAve.

ANi hAca mAjhA saraLa mArga Ahe yAstava tyAvaraca cAlA ANi itara mArgAMvara cAlU nakA, anyathA tumhAlA tyAcyA mArgapAsUna dUra karatIla tyAne (allAhane) yAcAca Adeza dilA Ahe yAsAThI kI tumhI surakSita rAhAve.

ANi AmhI (paigaMbara) mUsA yAMnA graMtha pradAna kelA, tyAcyAvara ApalI kRpA deNagI (nemata) pUrNa karaNyAsAThI, jyAne satkarme kelIta ANi pratyeka goSTIcA tapazIla ANi mArgadarzana ANi dayA kRpAkaritA, yAsAThI kI tyAMnI ApalyA pAlanakartyAzI bheTa hoNyAvara ImAna rAkhAve.
ANi hA (pavitra kuraAna) eka zubha graMtha Ahe, jo AmhI avatarita kelA, yAstava tumhI yAce anusaraNa karA, yAsAThI kI tumacyAvara dayA kelI jAvI.
yAsAThI kI ase na mhaNAve kI AmacyA pUrvI dona janasamUhAMvara graMtha (taurAta ANi iMjIla) avatarita kele gele ANi AmhI tyAMcyA zikavaNIpAsUna anabhijJa rAhilo.

kiMvA tumhI ase na mhaNAve kI jara AmacyAvara graMtha avatarita jhAlA asatA tara AmhI tyAMcyApekSA adhika satya mArgAvara rAhilo asato. tevhA tumacyAjavaLa tumacyA pAlanakartyAtarphe spaSTa pramANa ANi mArgadarzana va dayA yeUna pohocalI Ahe. maga tyAhUna jAsta atyAcArI koNa Ahe, jyAne allAhacyA AyatIMnA khoTe Tharavile ANi tyAMcyAkaDUna toMDa phiravile AmhI lavakaraca azA lokAMnA moThA sakta az2Aba deU je AmacyA AyatIMkaDUna toMDa phiravitAta.

te phariztyAMcyA AgamanAcI pratikSA karIta Aheta kI ApalyA pAlanakartyA (allAha) cyA AgamanAcI kI tumacyA pAlanakartyAcyA ekhAdyA nizANIcyA AgamanAcI? jyA divazI tumacyA pAlanakartyAtarphe nizANI yeIla, tevhA koNatyAhI mANasAlA tyAce ImAna kAmI paDaNAra nAhI, jyAne yApUrvI ImAna rAkhale nasela kiMvA ApalyA ImAnAne ekhAde satkarma kele nasela. tumhI sAMgA, tumhI pratikSA karA, AmhI (dekhIla) pratikSA karIta Ahota.

niHsaMzaya, jyAMnI ApalyA dharmAlA vegavegaLe karUna ghetale ANi aneka dhArmika paMtha-saMpradAya banale, tyAMcyAzI tumace kasalehI nAte nAhI, tyAcA phaisalA allAhajavaLa Ahe, maga to tyAMnA tyAbAbata sAMgela kI te kasakase karma karIta rAhile.
jo manuSya satkarma karIla tara tyAlA tyAcyA dahA paTa (mobadalA) miLela ANi jo duSkarma karIla tara tyAlA tyAcyAitakIca sajA miLela ANi tyA lokAMvara kiMcitahI atyAcAra hoNAra nAhI.

tumhI sAMgA, malA mAjhyA pAlanakartyAne eka saraLa mArga dAkhavilA Ahe kI to eka majabUta va kAyama rAhaNArA dIna (dharma) Ahe jo mArga Ahe ibrAhImacA je allAhakaDe ekacitta hote ANi te anekezvaravAdyAMpaikI navhate.
tumhI sAMgA, niHsaMzaya mAjhI namAja, mAjhI sarva upAsanA, mAjhe jIvana, ANi mRtyu, samasta vizvAcyA allAhakaritA Ahe.
tyAcA (allAhacA) koNIhI sahabhAgI nAhI. malA yAcAca Adeza dilA gelA Ahe ANi mI sarvAMta prathama ImAna rAkhaNArA Ahe.

tumhI sAMgA, kAya mI allAhakherIja dusar2yA pAlanakartyAcA zodha gheU vAstavika toca pratyeka cIja vastUcA svAmI (upAsya) Ahe ANi jo koNI, je kAhI kamavIla, te tyAlAca bhogAve lAgela ANi koNIhI koNA dusar2yAMce ojhe ucalaNAra nAhI, maga tumhAlA tumacyA pAlanakartyAkaDe dusar2yAMdA jAyace Ahe. to tumhAlA tumacyA matabhedAMviSayI sAMgela.

ANi tyAneca tumhAlA dharatIta khalIphA banavile ANi ekamekAMvara darje pradAna kele, yAsAThI kI je kAhI tumhAlA pradAna kele, tyAta tumacI kasoTI ghyAvI. niHsaMzaya, tumacA pAlanakartA lavakaraca az2Aba (zikSA-yAtanA) deNAra Ahe ANi niHsaMzaya to moThA mApha karaNArA Ahe, dayA karaNArA Ahe.
Alipha. lAma. mIma. saॉda.
hA eka graMtha Ahe, jo tumacyAkaDe avatarita kelA gelA, yAsAThI kI yAdvAre saceta karaNyAta tumacyA manAta saMkoca nirmANa hoU naye, ANi ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMkaritA bodha Ahe.
je (dharmavidhAna) tumacyA pAlanakartyAtarphe utaravile gele, tyAce anusaraNa karA ANi tyAcyAkherIja itara dostAMce anusaraNa karU nakA. tumhI loka phAra kamI bodha prApta karatA.
ANi kityeka vastyA AmhI naSTa karUna TAkalyA ANi tyAMcyAvara AmacA az2Aba rAtrIcyA veLI pohocalA kiMvA azA sthitIta kI te dupAracyA veLI ArAma karIta hote.
tara jevhA tyAMcyAjavaLa AmacA az2Aba AlA, tevhA tyAMcI oraDa phakta hIca rAhilI kI te mhaNAle, AmhIca atyAcArI rAhilota.
maga AmhI tyAMnA avazya vicArU jyAMcyAjavaLa saMdeza pAThavilA gelA ANi paigaMbarAMnAhI avazya vicArU.
maga AmhI tyAMcyAsamora jJAnAsaha nivedana karU, ANi AmhI gAphIla navhato.
ANi tyA divazI ThIka vajana hoIla, maga jyAce pAraDe jaDa rAhIla, tara aseca loka saphala hotIla.
ANi jyAce pAraDe halake asela tara he ase loka asatIla, jyAMnI Apale nukasAna svataHca karUna ghetale, yA kAraNAne kI AmacyA AyatIMzI te julUma karIta hote.
ANi AmhI tumhAlA dharatIta rAhaNyAce sthAna dile ANi tyAta tumacyAsAThI jIvanasAmugrI nirmANa kelI. tumhI phAra kamI AbhAra mAnatA.

ANi AmhI tumhAlA nirmANa kele, maga tumace rUpa ghaDavile, maga AmhI phariztyAMnA pharmAvile kI AdamalA sajadA karA, tevhA iblisalA soDUna sarvAMnI sajadA kelA kAraNa to sajadA karaNAr2yAMmadhye sAmIla jhAlA nAhI.

(allAhane) pharmAvile, jevhA mI tulA sajadA karaNyAcA Adeza dilA, tevhA koNatyA kAraNAne tulA sajadA karaNyApAsUna rokhale. to mhaNAlA, mI yAcyApekSA adhika cAMgalA Ahe. tU malA AgIpAsUna nirmANa kele ANi yAlA mAtIpAsUna nirmANa kele Ahe.
(allAhane) Adeza dilA kI tU AkAzAtUna khAlI utara, AkAzAta rAhUna ghameMDa karaNyAcA tulA kAhIca hakka nAhI. tevhA cala nigha. niHsaMzaya tU dhiHkkAralelyAMpaikI Ahesa.
(saitAna) mhaNAlA, malA (kayAmataparyaMta) saMdhI pradAna kara, jevhA loka dusar2yAMdA jivaMta kele jAtIla.
(allAhane) pharmAvile, tulA tI saMdhI pradAna kelI gelI.
(saitAna) mhaNAlA, tU malA dhiHkkAralyAmuLe mI tyAMcyAsAThI tujhyA saraLa mArgAvara basena.
maga tyAMcyA samorUna ANi pAThImAgUna ANi ujavyA va DAvyA bAjUne hallA karIna ANi tulA yAMcyAta adhikAMza loka kRtajJazIla ADhaLaNAra nAhIta.
(allAhane) pharmAvile, tU yApAsUna (yethUna) apamAnita hoUna nighUna jA je tyAMcyApaikI tujhyA mArgAvara cAlatIla tara mI tumhA sarvAMnI jahannamalA bharUna TAkIna.
ANi (AmhI pharmAvile kI) he Adama! tumhI ANi tumacI patnI jannatamadhye rAhA, maga jithUna icchA hoIla tithUna khA, ANi tyA jhADAcyA javaLa jAU nakA anyathA atyAcArI TharAla.

maga saitAnAne doghAMcyA manAta kuvicAra nirmANa kelA, yAsAThI kI doghAMcyA vara tyAMcI lajjAsthAne ughaDa karAvIta ANi sAMgitale kI tumhA doghAMcyA pAlanakartyAne tumhAlA yA jhADApAsUna azAsAThI rokhale Ahe kI tumhI doghe pharizte vhAla kiMvA sadaivakALa rAhaNAre vhAla.
tyAne (saitAnAne) tyA doghAMcyA samora zapatha ghetalI kI, mI tumhA doghAMcA zubhaciMtaka Ahe.

azA prakAre dhokebAjIne doghAMnA khAlI ANale, maga tyA doghAMnI jhADAcA svAda ghetAca, doghAMvara tyAMcI guptAMge ughaDa jhAlI ANi te ApalyAvara jannatacI pAne cikaTavU lAgale, ANi tyAMcyA pAlanakartyA (allAha) ne doghAMnA pukArale kI kAya mI tumhA doghAMnA yA jhADApAsUna rokhale navhate? ANi tumhAlA sAMgitale navhate kI saitAna tumacA khulA zatrU Ahe.
doghe mhaNAle, he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! AmhI svataHvara julUna karUna ghetalA ANi jara tU AmhAlA mApha kele nAhI ANi AmacyAvara dayA kelI nAhI tara AmhI nukasAna ucalaNAr2yAMpaikI hoU.
(allAhane) pharmAvile, tumhI khAlI utarA. tumhI ApasAta vairI AhAta ANi tumhAlA eka avadhIparyaMta dharatIta rAhAvayAce ANi lAbha prApta karUna ghyAyace Ahe.
pharmAvile kI tumhI tyAtaca jIvana vyatIta karAla ANi tyAtaca maraNa pAvAla ANi tyAtUnaca bAhera kADhale jAla.

he AdamacyA putrAMno! AmhI tumhAlA ase vastra pradAna kele je tumacyA lajjAsthAnAMnA jhAkela ANi zobhA deIla ANi sarvAMta uttama vastra, allAhacyA bhayAce vastra Ahe. hI allAhacI nizANI Ahe yAsAThI kI yAMnI smaraNa rAkhAve.

he AdamacyA putrAMno! tumhAlA saitAnAne bahakavUna na dyAve, jase tumacyA mAtA-pityAlA jannatamadhUna bAhera ghAlivale. tyAne tyAMce vastra utaravUna dile, yAsAThI kI tyAMnA tyAMcI guptAMge dAkhavAvIta. niHsaMzaya to ANi tyAce jAtIbAMdhava tumhAlA azA ThikANAhUna pAhatAta kI tumhI tyAMnA pAhU zakata nAhI. AmhI saitAnAMnA azA lokAMce mitra banavile, je ImAna (vizvAsa) rAkhata nAhI.

ANi te jevhA ekhAde duSkarma karatAta, tevhA mhaNatAta kI AmhAlA Amace pUrvaja yAvaraca ADhaLUna Aleta ANi allAhane AmhAlA yAcA Adeza dilA Ahe. tumhI sAMgA kI allAha vAITa kAmAcA Adeza deta nAhI. kAya tumhI allAhasaMbaMdhI azA goSTI karatA jyA tumhI jANata nAhIta.

(he paigaMbara!) tumhI sAMgA, mAjhyA pAlanakartyAne malA nyAyAcA Adeza dilA Ahe ANi pratyeka sajadA karateveLI ApalA ceharA saraLa dizeta karUna ghyA ANi tyA (allAha) karitA dIna (dharma) saccA manAne svIkArUna tyAlA pukArA. tyAne jase tumhAlA suruvAtIlA nirmANa kele, tyAca prakAre dusar2yAMdAhI nirmANa karIla.

ANi tyA (allAha) ne kAhIMnA sanmArga dAkhavilA tara kAhI mArgabhraSTatesa pAtra Tharale. tyAMnI allAhacyA kherIja saitAnAMnA ApalA mitra banavile ANi ase samajatAta kI te mArgadarzana prApta kelele loka Aheta.

he AdamacyA putrAMno! pratyeka veLI masjidIta jAtAnA Apale vastra (poSAkha) ghAlata jA ANi khA va pyA ANi udhaLapaTTIne kharca karU nakA. niHsaMzaya amaryAda kharca karaNAr2yAMzI allAha prema rAkhata nAhI.

(he paigaMbara!) tumhI sAMgA kI tyA zobhA-sajAvaTIlA koNI harAma kele Ahe, jilA allAhane ApalyA dAsAMkaritA nirmANa kele Ahe ANi pAka (svaccha-zuddha) rojIlA. tumhI sAMgA kI he aihika jIvanAta tyA lokAMsAThI Ahe jyAMnI ImAna rAkhale (ANi) vizeSataH kayAmatacyA divazI tyAca lokAMkaritA Ahe. AmhI azA prakAre AyatIMce savistara varNana kato, tyAMcyAsAThI, je jJAna bALagatAta.

tumhI sAMgA kI mAjhyA pAlanakartyAne sarva prakaTa-aprakaTa svarUpAcyA nirlajjatecyA goSTIMnA harAma kele Ahe. ANi aparAdha va nAhaka julUma karaNyAsa, ANi allAhasobata azAlA sahabhAgI karaNyAsa, jyAcI tyAne kasalIhI sanada utaravilI nAhI ANi allAhasaMbaMdhI mAhIta nasalelyA goSTI bolaNyAsa.
ANi pratyeka ummata (janasamUha) cA eka nirdhArIta avadhI Ahe, maga jevhA tyAMcI TharalelI veLa pUrNa hoIla, tevhA nA eka kSaNa vilaMba hoIla, nA puDhe jAIla.

he AdamacyA putrAMno! jara tumacyAjavaLa tumacyAmadhUnaca mAjhe rasUla (paigaMbara) yetIla, je tumacyAsamora mAjhyA AyatIMce nivedana karatIla tara jo allAhace bhaya rAkhUna vAgela ANi Apale AcaraNa sudhArela tara azA lokAMnA nA kasale bhaya rAhIla, ANi nA to duHkhI hotIla.
ANi jyA lokAMnI AmacyA AyatIMcA inkAra kelA ANi tyAMcyAzI ghameMDa kelI teca jahannamI Aheta. teca tyAta sadaiva rAhatIla.

tyAhUna moThA atyAcArI koNa Ahe jyAne allAhavara asatya racale kiMvA tyAcyA AyatIMnA khoTe Tharavile, yAMnA graMthApAsUna TharalelA hissA pohocela, yetheparyaMta kI jevhA tyAMcyAjavaLa Amace pharizte, tyAMce prANa kADhaNyAsAThI yetIla, tevhA mhaNatIla kI te koThe Aheta, jyAMnA tumhI allAhakherIja pukArata rAhile? te mhaNatIla, AmacyApAsUna haravaleta ANi svataH kAphira (adharmI) asaNyAce svataHca kabUla karatIla.

to (allAha) pharmAvila, dAkhala vhA jahannamamadhye, jinna ANi mAnavAMcyA samUhAMsobata, je tumacyApUrvI hoUna geleta. jevhA ekhAdA samUha dAkhala hoIla, tevhA dusar2yA samUhAcA dhiHkkAra karIla.yetheparyaMta kI jevhA tyA (jahannama) madhye sarvajaNa jamA hotIla tevhA naMtarace loka ApalyA agodara gelelyAMviSayI mhaNatIla kI, he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! yAMnIca AmhAlA mArgabhraSTa kele. tU yAMnA jahannamacI duppaTa zikSA de. (allAha) pharmAvila kI sarvAMsAThI duppaTa zikSA Ahe, paraMtu tumhI jANata nAhI.
ANi agodara gelele loka, naMtaracyA lokAMnA mhaNatIla kI AmacyAvara tumhAlA kasalIhI zreSThatA nAhI, yAstava tumhIdekhIla ApalyA karmApAyI allAhacyA zikSecA AnaMda ghyA.

niHsaMzaya, jyAMnI AmacyA AyatIMnA khoTe Tharavile ANi tyAMcyAzI ghameMDa kelI, tyAMcyAsAThI AkAzAce daravAje ughaDale jANAra nAhIta ANi te jannatamadhye praveza karU zakaNAra nAhIta, joparyaMta uMTa, sUIcyA chidrAta dAkhala hota nAhI ANi AmhI aparAdhI lokAMnA asAca mobadalA deto.
tyAMcyAsAThI jahannamacyA AgIce aMtharuNa asela ANi tyAMcyAvara tyAceca pAMgharuNa asela ANi atyAcArI lokAMnA AmhI azIca sajA deto.
ANi jyAMnI ImAna rAkhale ANi satkarme kelIta tara AmhI koNatyAhI jIvAlA, tyAcyA kuvatInusAraca uttaradAyitva sopavito. heca loka jannatI Aheta. heca tyAta sadaiva rAhatIla.

ANi AmhI tyAMcyA manAtale kapaTa dUra karU, tyAMcyAkhAlI nadyA vAhata asatIla ANi te mhaNatIla, allAhakaritA sarva prazaMsA Ahe, jyAne AmhAlA yAcyA mArgAvara lAvale jara tyAne mArgadarzana kele nasate tara AmhI svataH sanmArgAsa lAgalo nasato. niHsaMzaya, AmacyA pAlanakartyAce rasUla (paigaMbara) satyAsaha Ale ANi tyAMnA pukArUna sAMgitale jAIla kI ApalyA karmAMcyA mobadalyAta tumhI yA jannatace hakkadAra banavile gele.

ANi jannatI loka, jahannamI lokAMnA hAka deUna sAMgatIla kI AmhAlA ApalyA pAlanakartyAcA vAyadA, jo AmhAlA deNyAta AlA, kharA ADhaLalA tara kAya tumhAlA, tumacyA pAlanakartyAne kelelA vAyadA kharA ADhaLalA? te mhaNatIla, hoya! maga eka ailAna karaNArA tyAMcyA daramyAna ailAna karIla kI allAhatarphe dhiHkkAra aso atyAcArI lokAMvara.
je ApalyA pAlanakartyAcyA mArgApAsUna rokhU icchitAta ANi tyAlA vAkaDe karU icchitAta ANi te AkhiratacAhI inkAra karatAta.

ANi tyA doghAMcyA daramyAna eka ADa paDadA asela ANi ArApha (uMcavaTyA) vara kAhI mANase asatIla je pratyekAlA tyAMcyA nizANAMvarUna oLakhUna ghetIla, ANi jannatI lokAMnA hAka deUna sAMgatIla kI tumacyAvara salAmatI aso, te tyA (jannata) madhye ajUna dAkhala jhAle nasatIla ANi ticI AzA bALagata asatIla.
ANi jevhA tyAMcI dRSTI jahannamI lokAMvara paDela tevhA mhaNatIla, he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! AmhAlA atyAcArI lokAMta sAmIla karU nako.
ANi ArAphavAle kAhI lokAMnA, jyAMnA tyAMcyA cinhAMvarUna oLakhata asatIla, hAka mArUna sAMgatIla kI tumacI jamAta ANi tumacI ghameMDa tumacyA upayogI paDalI nAhI.

kAya heca te loka hota jyAMcyAviSayI tumhI jora deUna zapathapUrvaka sAMgata hote kI yAM (jannatI lokAM) cyA vara allAhacI dayA kRpA hoNAra nAhI. (tyAMnA sAMgitale jAIla) kI jannatamadhye praveza karA. tumacyAvara kasalehI bhaya nAhI ANi nA tumhI duHkhI vhAla.

ANi jahannamavAle jannatacyA lokAMnA hAka detIla kI AmacyAvara thoDe pANI TAkA kiMvA allAhane jI rojI (AjIvikA) tumhAlA pradAna kelI Ahe tyAtUna thoDese dyA. te mhaNatIla, allAhane yA donhI vastU inkArI lokAMkaritA harAma kelyA Aheta.

jyAMnI ApalyA dIna (dharmA) lA manoraMjana ANi kheLa-tamAzA banavile Ahe ANi jyAMnA aihika jIvanAne dhokyAta TAkale yAstava Aja AmhI tyAMcA visara pADU jyApramANe te yA divasAlA visarale hote ANi AmacyA AyatIMcA inkAra karIta rAhile.
ANi AmhI tyAMcyAjavaLa jJAnAvara AdhArIta eka graMtha savistara varNanAsaha pAThavilA Ahe jo mArgadarzana ANi dayA Ahe tyA lokAMkaritA je ImAna rAkhatAta.

kAya te yAcyA aMtima nirNayAcI vATa pAhAta Ahe? jyA divazI yAcA aMtima nirNaya yeUna pohocela, tara jyA lokAMnI yApUrvI yAcA visara pADalA, te mhaNatIla kI AmacyA pAlanakartyAce rasUla (paigaMbara) satya gheUna Ale, tara kAya koNI AmacI ziphArasa karaNArA Ahe, jyAne AmacyAsAThI ziphArasa karAvI? kiMvA AmhAlA dusar2yAMdA (jagAta) pAThavile gele asate, tara tyAkherIja karma kele asate, je (pUrvI) karIta rAhilo. tyAMnI svataHlA nukasAnagrasta kele ANi jyA goSTI manAne racata rAhile, tyAMcyApAsUna haravalyA.

niHsaMzaya tumacA svAmI va pAlanahAra allAhaca Ahe, jyAne AkAzAMnA va jaminIlA sahA divasAMta banavile, ANi maga arza (siMhAsanA) vara ucca sthira jhAlA. to rAtrIlA divasAne azA prakAre lapavito kI tI tyAlA druta gatIne yeUna dharate ANi sUrya va caMdra ANi tAr2yAMnA kAmAsa Thevale kAraNa te tyAcyA hukUmAdhIna Aheta. aikA, tyAcIca nirmitI ANi AdezahI tyAcAca Ahe. samasta vizvAcA pAlanakartA moThA barakatavAlA (samRddhazAlI) Ahe.
ApalyA pAlanakartyA (allAha) lA namratApUrvaka ANi haLU AvAjAtahI pukArata jA. allAha maryAdece ullaMghana karaNAr2yAMzI prema rAkhata nAhI.
ANi dharatIta sudhAraNA jhAlyAnaMtara bighADa nirmANa karU nakA, ANi bhaya va Azesaha tyAcI upAsanA karA. niHsaMzaya allAhacI dayA neka sadAcArI lokAMcyA nikaTa Ahe.

ANi toca allAha Ahe jo ApalyA dayene prathama zubha samAcArAsAThI vAr2yAMnA pAThavito, yetheparyaMta kI jevhA te jaDa DhagAMnA lAdUna yetAta tevhA AmhI tyAMnA ekhAdyA koraDyA jaminIcyA dizene hAMkato, maga tyAdvAre pANyAcA varSAva karato, maga tyAdvAre pratyeka prakAracI phaLe kADhato. AmhI azAca prakAre melelyAMnA bAhera kADhU yAsAThI kI tumhI vicAra ciMtana karAve.

ANi cAMgalI (pAka) jamIna ApalyA pAlanakartyAcyA AdezAne ApalI ropaTe (pIka) ugavate ANi kharAba jamIna phAra kamI ugavate azA prakAre AmhI nizANyAMce aneka prakAre varNana karato, tyA lokAMkaritA je kRtajJatA vyakta karatAta.

AmhI nUha (alaihissalAma) yAMnA tyAMcyA janasamUhAkaDe pAThavile tevhA te mhaNAle, he mAjhyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMno! allAhacI upAsanA karatA. tyAcyAkherIja tumacA dusarA koNIhI upAsya (mAbUda) nAhI. niHsaMzaya malA tumacyAbaddala moThyA divasAcyA zikSA-yAtanece bhaya vATate.
tyAMcyA janasamUhAce saradAra mhaNAle, tumhI AmhAlA ughaDa azA mArgabhraSTateta disata AhAta.
nUha mhaNAle, he mAjhyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMno! mI mArgabhraSTa nAhI. tathApi samasta vizvAcyA pAlanakartyAcA paigaMbara Ahe.
tumhAlA ApalyA pAlanakartyAcA saMdeza pohacavito ANi tumacyA bhalyAce karIta Ahe ANi allAhatarphe te jJAna bALagato je jJAna tumhI bALagata nAhI.

kAya tumhAlA Azcarya vATate kI tumacyA pAlanakartyAtarphe tumacyAca janasamUhAcyA ekA mANasAvara ekhAdI bodhapUrNa goSTa yete, yAsAThI kI tumhAlA saceta karAve ANi tumhI allAhace bhaya rAkhUna vAgAve yAsAThI kI tumacyAvara dayA kelI jAvI.

tara tyAMnI nUhalA khoTe Tharavile, maga AmhI nUha ANi tyAMcyA anuyAyIMnA nauketa vAcavile ANi jyAMnI AmacyA AyatIMcA (nizANyAMcA) inkAra kelA, tyAMnA buDavUna TAkale. niHsaMzaya to eka AMdhaLA janasamUha hotA.

ANi Ada janasamUhAkaDe tyAMcA bhAU hUda yAMnA (paigaMbara mhaNUna) pAThavile. te mhaNAle, he mAjhyA jAtI-bAMdhavAno! allAhacI upAsanA karA, tyAcyAkherIja tumacA koNIhI upAsya nAhI. kAya tumhI bhita nAhI?
tyAMcyA janasamUhAne kAphira saradAra mhaNAle, AmhAlA tumhI mUrkha AhAta ase vATate. khAtrIne AmhI tumhAlA khoTyAMpaikI samajato.
hUda mhaNAle, he mAjhyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMno! mI mUrkha nAhI, paraMtu sAr2yA jagAcyA pAlanakartyAcA rasUla (paigaMbara) Ahe.
mI tumhAlA ApalyA pAlanakartyAcA saMdeza pohacavito, ANi tumacA prAmANika hitaciMtaka Ahe.

kAya tumhAlA Azcarya vATate kI tumacyA pAlanakartyAtarphe ekhAdI bodhapUrNa goSTa tumacyAtalyAca ekA mANasAjavaLa AlI Ahe, yAsAThI kI tyAne tumhAlA saceta karAve. smaraNa karA, jevhA allAhane tumhAlA nUhacyA janasamUhAnaMtara tyAMcyA jAgI kele ANi tumacA zarIra-bAMdhA adhika vADhavilA, yAstava tumhI allAhacyA kRpA deNagyAMce smaraNa karA yAsAThI kI saphala vhAve.

janasamUhAce loka mhaNAle, kAya tumhI AmacyAjavaLa evaDhyAsAThI AlA AhAta kI AmhI phakta eka allAhacI upAsanA karAvI ANi ApalyA vADavaDilAMcyA upAsya daivatAMcA tyAga karAvA. tevhA jyA goSTIcI tumhI AmhAlA dhamakI deta AhAta, tI ANA jara tumhI sacce asAla.

hUda mhaNAle, tumacyA pAlanakartyAtarphe tumacyAvara zikSA ANi prakopa yeUnaca pohacalA. kAya tumhI mAjhyAzI kAhI azA nAvAMviSayI vAda ghAlatA, je tumhI ANi tumacyA vADavaDilAMnI ThevUna ghetaleta jyAMce kasalehI pramANa allAhane utaravile nAhI. tumhI pratikSA karA. tumacyAsobata mIdekhIla pratikSA karato.
tevhA AmhI tyAMnA ANi tyAMcyA anuyAyIMnA ApalyA dayene vAcavUna ghetale ANi tyA lokAMcI muLe kApUna TAkalI, jyAMnI AmacyA AyatIMnA khoTe Tharavile ANi te ImAnadhAraka navhate.

ANi samUdakaDe tyAMcA bhAU saॉleha (pAThavile). saॉleha mhaNAle, he mAjhyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMno! allAhacI upAsanA karA, tyAcyAkherIja tumacA koNIhI mAbUda (upAsya) nAhI. tumacyAjavaLa tumacyA pAlanakartyAtarphe pramANa yeUna pohocale. hI allAhacI sAMDaNI tumacyAkaritA nizANI Ahe, tilA allAhacyA dharatIta khANyA (caraNyA) sAThI soDUna dyA. tilA vAITa irAdyAne hAta lAvU nakA, anyathA duHkhadAyaka az2Aba tumhAlA yeUna dharela.

ANi tumhI tyA avasthaAMce smaraNa karA jevhA (allAhane) tumhAlA Ada (janasamUhA) naMtara khalIphA banavile ANi yA dharatIta tumhAlA rAhaNyAcI jAgA dilI. tumhI samatala jaminIvara ghare banavitA ANi parvatAMnA korUna ghara banavitA, tevhA allAhacyA kRpA deNagyAMce smaraNa karA ANi dharatIta phasAda (utpAta) mAjavita phirU nakA.

tyAcyA janasamUhAce ghameMDI saradAra mhaNAle, ApalyA kamajora- dubaLyA lokAMnA, jyAMnI ImAna rAkhale hote, kAya tumacA pakkA vizvAsa Ahe kI saॉleha ApalyA pAlanakartyAtarphe pAThavile gele Aheta. te mhaNAle kI AmhI tyAvara ImAna rAkhato, jyAsaha tyAMnA pAThavile gele Ahe.
garviSTha saradAra mhaNAle, tumhI jyAcyAvara ImAna rAkhatA, AmhI ImAna rAkhata nAhI.
yAstava sAMDaNIlA tyAMnI ThAra mArale, ANi ApalyA pAlanakartyAcI avajJA kelI ANi mhaNAle, he saॉleha! jara tumhI paigaMbara asAla tara ApalI dhamakI pUrNa karA.
tara tyAMnA bhUkaMpAne gherUna TAkale ANi te ApalyA gharAMmadhye pAlathe paDUna rAhile.

saॉleha tyAMcyApAsUna toMDa phiravUna nighUna gele ANi mhaNAle, he mAjhyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMno! mI tumhAlA ApalyA pAlanakartyAcA Adeza pohacavilA ANi tumacA hitaciMtaka rAhilo paraMtu tumhI hitaciMtakAMzI prema rAkhata nAhIta.
ANi (AmhI) lUtalA (pAThavile) jevhA te ApalyA lokAMnA mhaNAle, kI tumhI ase vAITa kRtya karatA, je tumacyApUrvI sAr2yA jagAta koNIhI kele nAhI.
tumhI puruSAMzI saMbhoga karatA, striyAMnA soDUna, kiMbahunA tumhI tara maryAdA pAra kelI Ahe.
ANi tyAMcyA janasamUhAlA kAhI uttara detA Ale nAhI yAkherIja kI ApasAta mhaNU lAgale kI yA lokAMnA vastIbAhera ghAlavA. he moThe pAka sApha (satzIla, pavitra) banatAta.
jevhA AmhI tyAMnA (lUtalA) ANi tyAMcyA kuTuMbiyAMnA vAcavile tyAMcyA patnIkherIja, kAraNa tI tyAca lokAMpaikI rAhilI, je (az2Abagrasta) rAhileta.
ANi AmhI tyAMcyAvara eka navIna prakAracA pAUsa pADalA tevhA baghA tarI, tyA aparAdhyAMcA kasA zevaTa jhAlA!

ANi (AmhI) madayanakaDe tyAMce bhAU zoaiba yAMnA pAThavile. zoaiba mhaNAle, he mAjhyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMno! tumhI allAhacI upAsanA karA, tyAcyAkherIja tumacA koNIhI mAbUda nAhI tumacyA pAlanakartyAtarphe tumacyAjavaLa spaSTa nizANI yeUna pohocalI Ahe. tevhA tumhI mApa tola purepUra karIta jA, ANi lokAMnA tyAMcyA cIja-vastU kamI karUna deU nakA ANi sAr2yA dharatIvara, sudhAraNA kelI gelyAnaMtara phasAda (utpAta-upadrava) pasaravU nakA. he tumacyAsAThI lAbhadAyaka Ahe jara tumhI ImAna rAkhAla.

ANi tumhI pratyeka rastyAvara tyAMnA dhamakI deNyAsAThI ANi allAhacyA mArgApAsUna rokhaNyAsAThI, jyAMnI allAhavara ImAna rAkhale, basU nakA ANi tyAta cUkA zodhata, ANi smaraNa karA jevhA tumhI saMkhyene kamI hote, allAhane tumhAlA jAsta kele maga pAhA utpAtI lokAMcA zevaTa kasA jhAlA.

ANi jara tumacyApaikI kAhI lokAMnI tyA AdezAvara ImAna rAkhale, jyAsaha malA pAThavile gele Ahe ANi kAhIMnI ImAna rAkhale nAhI tara thoDA dhIra-saMyama rAkhA. yetheparyarMta kI allAhane AmacyA daramyAna phaisalA karAvA ANi to sarvAMta uttama phaisalA karaNArA Ahe.

tyAMcyA janasamUhAce ghameMDI ahaMkArI saradAra mhaNAle, he zoaiba! AmhI tumhAlA ANi tumacyA sobatacyA ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMnA avazya ApalyA nagarAtUna bAhera ghAlavU anyathA tumhI parata AmacyA dharmAta yA. te mhaNAle, kAya AmhAlA tyAcA kiLasa yeta asalA tarIhI?

(ase kelyAsa) AmhI tara allAhavara khoTA Aropa ThevU jara tumacyA dharmAta paratUna Alo. vAstavika allAhane AmhAlA tyAtUna mukta kele Ahe ANi AmacyAsAThI tyAta punhA parataNe zakya nAhI, paraMtu he kI allAha jara icchila, jo AmacA svAmI, pAlanakartA Ahe. AmacyA pAlanakartyAne pratyeka goSTIsa ApalyA jJAnAne gherUna Thevale Ahe. AmhI ApalyA allAhavaraca bharosA kelA Ahe. he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! AmacyA ANi AmacyA lokAMcyA daramyAna phaisalA kara satyAsaha ANi tU sarvAMta uttama phaisalA karaNArA Ahe.
ANi tyAMcyA janasamUhAcyA inkArI saradArAMnI mhaTale kI jara tumhI zoaibace anusaraNa kele tara nukasAna bhogaNAr2yAMpaikI vhAla.
tara tyAMnA bhUkaMpAne yeUna gherale, yAstava te ApalyA gharAMmadhye pAlathe paDUna rAhile.
jyAMnI zoaibalA khoTe Tharavile, tyAMcI azI avasthA jhAlI kI jaNU tyA (gharAM) madhye kadhI rAhataca navhate. jhyAMnI zoaibalA khoTe Tharavile, te loka hAnigrasta jhAle.

tyA veLI zoaiba tyAMcyAkaDUna toMDa phiravUna nighUna gele ANi mhaNAle kI he mAjhyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMno! mI ApalyA pAlanakartyAcA saMdeza tumacyAparyaMta pohacavilA ANi mI tumace hitaciMtana kele, maga mI tyA inkArI lokAMbaddala duHkhI kA vhAve?
ANi AmhI jevhAdekhIla ekhAdyA vastIta paigaMbara pAThavilA, tara tithalyA lokAMnA AmhI rogarAI ANi kaSTa yAtaneta jarUra TAkale, yAsAThI kI tyAMnI (lAcAra hoUna) gayAvayA karAvI.

maga AmhI tyA dariradratelA saMpanna avasthene badalUna TAkale, yethaparyaMta kI jevhA te sukhasaMpanna jhAle ANi mhaNU lAgale kI AmacyA vADavaDilAMnAhI cAMgalyA-vAITa sthitIzI sAmanA karAvA lAgalA, tevhA AmhI akasmAta tyAMnA pakaDIta ghetale ANi jyAMnA kaLAlesuddhA nAhI.

ANi jara tyA zaharAMcyA rahivAzIMnI ImAna rAkhale asate ANi allAhace bhaya rAkhUna AcaraNa kele asate tara AmhI tyAMcyAkaritA AkAza va jaminIcyA samRddhIce daravAje ughaDale asate. paraMtu tyAMnI khoTe Tharavile, tevhA AmhI tyAMnA tyAMcyA durAcArApAyI dharale.
kAya tarIhI yA vastyAMce rahivAzI yA goSTIpAsUna nizciMta jhAle kI tyAMcyAvara AmacA az2Aba rAtrIcyA veLI yeUna kosaLAvA, jyA veLI te jhopeta asAveta.
ANi kAya tyA vastyAMce rahivAzI yA goSTIpAsUna bephikIra jhAle Aheta kI tyAMcyAvara AmacA az2Aba divasa caDhatA yAvA, jyA veLI te kheLa-tamAzAta magna asAveta.
kAya te allAhacyA yojanepAsUna niDara jhAleta? tara allAhacyA yojanepAsUna nukasAna bhogaNAreca niDara hotAta.

tara kAya je loka dharatIta, ticyA rahivAzAMcyA vinAzAnaMtara vArasa banale Aheta, tyAMnA he mAhIta jhAle nAhI kI jara AmhI icchile tara tyAMcyA aparAdhAMpAyI tyAMnA saMkaTAta TAkU ANi tyAMcyA manAMvara mohara lAvU maga te aikU na zakAveta.

yA zaharAMcyA kAhI ghaTanA AmhI tumhAlA sAMgata Ahota ANi tyAMce paigaMbara tyAMcyAjavaLa pramANAsaha Ale, tarIhI jyAlA tyAMnI agodara mAnale nAhI tyAlA naMtara mAnaNyAyogya jhAle nAhIta. azA prakAre allAha inkArI lokAMcyA hRdayAMvara mohara lAvUna deto.
ANi AmhAlA tyAMcyAtale adhikAMza loka vacanAce pAlana karatAnA ADhaLale nAhIta, ANi AmhAlA tyAMcyAtale adhikAMza loka durAcArI disale.

maga tyAMcyAnaMtara AmhI (paigaMbara) mUsA yAMnA ApalyA nizANyAMsaha phiraauna ANi tyAcyA saradArAMjavaLa pAThavile tara tyAMnI tyA nizANyAMcA hakka adA kelA nAhI. maga pAhA, durAcArI lokAMcA kasA zevaTa jhAlA!
ANi mUsA mhaNAle, he phiraauna! mI sAr2yA jagAcyA pAlanakartyAtarphe paigaMbara Ahe.
mAjhyAkaritA heca uttama Ahe kI satyAzivAya allAhaviSayI kAhI na bolAve. mI tumacyA pAlanakartyAtarphe eka moThI nizANIhI ANalI Ahe yAstava tU isrAIlacyA saMtatIlA mAjhyAsobata pAThava.
to (phiraauna) mhaNAlA, jara tumhI ekhAdA mojijA (camatkAra) gheUna AlA asAla tara to prastuta karA jara tumhI sacce asAla.
maga mUsA yAMnI ApalI lAThI khAlI TAkalI tara acAnaka tyA kAThIcA sApa moThA ajagara banalA.
ANi ApalA hAta bAhera kADhalA tara acAnaka to sarva pAhaNAr2yAMsamora lakhkha camakaNArA banalA.
phiraaunacyA janasamUhAce saradAra mhaNAle, hA moThA niSNAta jAdUgAra Ahe.
to tumhAlA tumacyA dezAbAhera ghAlavU icchito, tevhA tumacA kAya vicAra Ahe.
te mhaNAle, tumhI tyAlA ANi tyAcyA bhAvAlA saMdhI dyA ANi zaharAMmadhye ekatra karaNAr2yAMnA (davaMDI deNAr2yAMnA) pAThavA.
kI tyAMnI sarva niSNAta jAdUgArAMnA ApalyA samora ANUna hajara karAve.
ANi jAdUgAra phiraaunajavaLa Ale ANi mhaNAle, AmhI jara saphala jhAlo tara AmacyAsAThI kAhI mobadalA Ahe kAya?
to mhaNAlA, hoya, ANi tumhI sarva javaLacyA lokAMpaikI vhAla.
jAdUgAra mhaNAle, he mUsA! vATalyAsa tumhI TAkA kiMvA AmhIca TAkato.
(mUsA) mhaNAle, tumhIca TAkA, tara jevhA tyAMnI TAkale, tevhA lokAMcI najarabaMdI kelI ANi tyAMnA bhayabhIta kele ANi eka prakAracI moThI jAdU dAkhavilI.
ANi AmhI mUsAlA Adeza dilA kI ApalI lAThI khAlI TAkA, maga acAnaka tI tyAMcyA banavilelyA kheLAlA giLU lAgalI.
tevhA, satya jAhIra jhAle ANi tyAMnI je kAhI banavile hote te sarva gAyaba jhAle.
yAstava te loka yAprasaMgI parAjita jhAle ANi bahuteka apamAnita hoUna paratale.
ANi jAdUgAra sajadyAta paDale.
mhaNAle, AmhI ImAna rAkhale sAr2yA jagAcyA pAlanakartyAvara.
jo mUsA ANi hArUna yAMcAhI pAlanakartA Ahe.

phiraauna mhaNAlA, tumhI mAjhyA AdezApUrvIca tyA (mUsA) vara ImAna rAkhale, nizcita he eka kaTa-kArasthAna Ahe je tumhI zaharAta tyAcyA rahivAzAMnA tyAtUna bAhera ghAlaviNyAsAThI racale Ahe, yAstava tumhAlA lavakaraca mAhIta paDela.
mI tumacA eka bAjUcA hAta ANi dusar2yA bAjUcA pAya kApUna TAkIna, maga tumhA sarvAMnA sULAvara laTakavIna.
tyAMnI uttara dile, AmhI (melyAvara) ApalyA pAlanakartyA javaLaca jAU.

ANi tumhI AmacyAta hAca doSa pAhilA kI AmhI ApalyA pAlanakartyAcyA AyatIM (cinhAM) vara ImAna rAkhale, jevhA tyA AmacyAjavaLa yeUna pohocalyA. he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! AmacyAvara sabra (dhIra-saMyama) ota ANi AmhAlA ImAnadhAraka asatAnAca mRtyu de.

ANi phiraaunacyA janasamUhAce saradAra mhaNAle, kAya tumhI mUsA ANi tyAcyA lokAMnA aseca soDUna dyAla kI tyAMnI dharatIvara phasAda (utpAta) karAvA, ANi tumacA va tumacyA daivatAMcA tyAga karAvA. to mhaNAlA, AmhI tyAcyA putrAMnA ThAra mArU ANi tyAMcyA striyAMnA jivaMta ThevU ANi AmhI tyAMcyAvara varcasvazAlI Ahota.

mUsA ApalyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMnA mhaNAle, allAhacI madata ghyA ANi dhIra-saMyama rAkhA, hI dharatI allAhacI Ahe. to ApalyA dAsAMpaikI jyAlA icchito, ticA uttarAdhikArI banavito ANi aMtima saphalatA tyAMnAca lAbhate, je allAhace bhaya bALagatAta.

te mhaNAle, tumacyA AgamanApUrvIhI AmhAlA kaSTa-yAtanA dilyA gelyA ANi tumacyA AgamanAnaMtarahI. mUsA mhaNAle, lavakaraca tumacA pAlanakartA tumacyA zatrUMcA sarvanAza karIla ANi yA dharatIcA vArasA tumhAlA pradAna karIla, maga he pAhIla kI tumhI kase AcaraNa karatA.
ANi AmhI phiraaunavAlyAMnA duSkALa ANi phaLAMcyA utpannAta kamIdvAre gherale, yAsAThI kI tyAMnI bodha prApta karAvA.

jara tyAMcyAjavaLa bhalAI yete, tevhA mhaNatAta kI he tara AmacyAsAThI vhAyalAca have ANi jara kaSTa-yAtanA yete, tevhA mUsA ANi tyAMcyA anuyAyIMnA apazakUnI TharavitAta. aikA, tyAMcA apazakUna allAhacyA javaLa Ahe, paraMtu adhikAMza loka jANata nAhIta.
ANi te mhaNAle, AmacyAjavaLa jIdekhIla nizANI AmacyAvara jAdU karaNyAsAThI ANAla tarI AmhI tumacyAvara ImAna rAkhaNAra nAhIta.
maga AmhI tyAcyAvara vAdaLa ANi ToLa ANi uvA ANi beDUka ANi rakta pAThavile, vegavegaLyA nizANyA, maga tyAMnI ghameMDa kelI ANi te aparAdhI loka hote.

ANi jevhA tyAMcyAvara ekhAdA az2Aba (allAhacA prakopa) yeta ase, tevhA mhaNata kI he mUsA! AmacyAsAThI ApalyA pAlanakartyAjavaLa tyA vAyadyAdvAre, jo tumhAlA dilA, duA (prArthanA) karA. jara tumhI AmacyAvarUna az2Aba haTavilA tara avazya AmhI tumacyAvara ImAna rAkhU ANi tumacyAsobata isrAIlacyA putrAMnA pAThavU.
maga jevhA AmhI tyAMcyAvarUna to az2Aba ekA TharAvika mudatIparyaMta kI tyAparyaMta tyAMnA pohacaNe kramaprApta hote, haTavita tevhA te tvarIta vacana bhaMga karU lAgata.
maga AmhI tyAcyAzI sUDa ghetalA arthAta tyAMnA samudrAta buDavile, yA kAraNAstava kI te AmacyA AyatIMnA (nizANyAMnA) khoTe Tharavita, ANi tyAMcyAbAbata gAphIlapaNA darzavita.

ANi AmhI tyA lokAMnA je atizaya durbala samajale jAta, tyA dharatIcyA pUrva ANi pazcimece mAlaka banavile, jicyAta AmhI samRddhI rAkhalI Ahe ANi tumacyA pAlanakartyAcA neka vAyadA banI isrAIlaviSayI, tyAMcyA dhIra-saMyamAmuLe pUrNa jhAlA ANi AmhI phiraauna ANi tyAcyA janasamUhAne banavilelyA kArakhAnyAMnA ANi jyA uMca imAratI te ubhArata, sarvakAhI kSata-vikSata karUna TAkale.

ANi AmhI banU isrAIla (islAIcyA mulAMnA) lA samudrApalIkaDe utaravile, maga tyAMce ekA azA jamAtIjavaLUna jANe jhAle, jI ApalyA kAhI mUrtyA (pratimA) gheUna basalI hotI. (tyAMnA pAhUna he loka) mhaNAle, he mUsA! AmacyAsAThI suddhA aseca upAsya TharavUna dyA, jazI yAMcI hI daivate Aheta. mUsA mhaNAle, kharokhara, tumhA lokAMta moThI mUrkhatA Ahe.
he loka jyA kAmAta guMtale Aheta te naSTa kele jAIla ANi tyAMce he kAma kevaLa asatya Ahe.
pharmAvile, kAya allAhakherIja anya ekhAdyAlA tumacA mAbUda (upAsya) TharavUna deU? vAstavika tyAne samasta jagAtIla lokAMvara tumhAlA prAdhAnya pradAna kele Ahe.

ANi tI veLa AThavA, jevhA AmhI tumhAlA phiraaunacyA lokAMpAsUna vAcavile je tumhAlA sakta zikSA deta asata. tumacyA putrAMcI hatyA karIta ANi tumacyA striyAMnA jivaMta soDUna deta ANi yAta tumacyA pAlanakartyAtarphe phAra moThI parIkSA hotI.

ANi AmhI mUsA yAMnA tIsa rAtrIMcA vAyadA dilA ANi dahA adhika rAtrIMnI to pUrNa kelA, azA prakAre tyAMcyA pAlanakartyAcA avadhI pUrNa cALIsa rAtrIMcA jhAlA ANi mUsA, ApalA bhAU hArUnalA mhaNAle, mI (gelyA) naMtara yA (lokAM) cI vyavasthA rAkhA ANi sudhAraNA karIta rAhA ANi upadravI va utpAtI lokAMcyA mArgAce anusaraNa karU nakA.

ANi jevhA mUsA AmacyA veLevara Ale, ANi tyAMcyA pAlanakartyAne tyAMcyAzI saMbhASaNa kele tevhA tyAMnI vinaMtI kelI, he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! malA Apale darzana ghaDU de, mI eka kSaNa tulA pAhUna gheU. Adeza jhAlA kI, tumhI malA kadhIhI pAhU zakaNAra nAhI, paraMtu tumhI yA parvatAkaDe pAhAta rAhA, jara to ApalyA jAgI sthira ubhA rAhilA tara tumhIhI malA pAhU zakAla. maga tyAMcyA pAlanakatyArtane jevhA tyA parvatAvara prakAza TAkalA tevhA tyA divya tejAne tyAce tukaDe tukaDe jhAle ANi mUsA bezuddha hoUna khAlI paDale, maga jevhA zuddhIvara Ale tevhA mhaNAle, niHsaMzaya (he allAha) tU pavitra Ahesa. mI tujhyAjavaLa ApalyA aparAdhAMcI kSamA mAgato ANi sarvAMta prathama tujhyAvara ImAna rAkhato.

allAhane pharmAvile, he mUsA! mI ApalI paigaMbarI ANi ApalyAzI kelelyA saMbhASaNAdvAre itara lokAMvara tumhAlA zreSThatA pradAna kelI Ahe tevhA je kAhI mI tumhAlA pradAna kele Ahe, tyAcA svIkAra karA ANi kRtajJatA vyakta karA.

ANi AmhI kAhI taktyAMvara pratyeka prakAracA bodha-upadeza ANi pratyeka goSTIcA tapazIla tyAMnA lihUna dilA. tumhI tyAMnA pUrNa zaktI-sAmarthyAne dharA ANi ApalyA lokAMnA tAkIda karA kI tyAtalyA cAMgalyA AdezAnusAra AcaraNa karA. AtA lavakaraca tumhA lokAMnA tyA durAcArI lokAMce sthAna dAkhavito.

mI azA lokAMnA ApalyA AyatIMpAsUna vimukhaca ThevIna, je jagAta ghameMDa karatAta, jyAcA tyAMnA kAhIca adhikAra nAhI. jara te sarva nizANyA pAhUnahI ghetIla tarIhI tyA McyAvara ImAna rAkhaNAra nAhIta ANi jara te satya mArga pAhUnahI ghetIla tarI tyAlA ApalA mArga TharaviNAra nAhIta, ANi jara te mArgabhraSTatA pAhatIla tara tilA ApalA mArga banavatIla. he azAsAThI kI tyAMnI AmacyA AyatIMnA khoTe Tharavile ANi tyAMcyApAsUna gAphIla rAhile.
ANi te loka jyAMnI AmacyA AyatIMnA ANi AkhiratacyA yeNyAlA khoTe Tharavile, tyAMce sarva AcaraNa vAyA gele, tyAMnA tazIca yAtanA dilI jAIla, jase karma te karIta hote.

ANi mUsAcyA janasamUhAne tyAMcyA pazcAta ApalyA dAginyAMnI eka vAsarU banavUna tyAlA upAsya daivata banavile, jo eka AkAra mAtra hotA jyAta eka AvAja (dhvanI) hotA. kAya tyAMnI he nAhI pAhile kI te (vAsarU) tyAMcyAzI bolatahI navhate ANi nA tyAMnA mArgadarzana karIta hote tyAlA tyAMnI (daivata) banavile ANi moThe anyAyAce kRtya kele.

ANi jevhA lajjita jhAle ANi jANUna ghetale kI kharokhara te loka vATa cukUna bahakale, mhaNU lAgale kI jara AmacyA pAlanakartyAne AmacyAvara dayA kelI nAhI ANi Amace aparAdha mApha kele nAhIta tara khAtrIne AmhI nukasAna bhogaNAr2yAMpaikI hoU.

ANi jevhA mUsA ApalyA janasamUhAkaDe parata Ale krodha ANi duHkhAta buDAlele, tevhA mhaNAle, tumhI mAjhyA pazcAtahI moThI vAITa harakata kelI. kAya ApalyA pAlanakartyAcyA AdezApUrvIca tumhIhI ghAI kelI ANi tvarene takte ekA bAjUlA TAkale ANi ApalA bhAU hArUnace Doke dharUna tyAlA ApalyAkaDe oDhU lAgale. (hArUna) mhaNAle, he mAjhyA mAtepAsUna janmalele! yA lokAMnI malA phAra kamakuvata jANale ANi bahuteka tyAMnI malA ThAra kele asate. tevhA tumhI mAjhyA zatrUMnA hasavU nakA ANi mAjhI gaNanA yA atyAcArI lokAMmadhye karU nakA.
(mUsA) mhaNAle, he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! mAjhyA ANi mAjhyA bhAvAcyA cukA mApha kara ANi AmhA doghAMnA ApalyA dayeta dAkhala kara ANi tU dayA karaNAr2yAMmadhye sarvAdhika dayA karaNArA Ahesa.

niHsaMzaya, jyA lokAMnI vAsarAcI upAsanA kelI, tyAMcyAvara lavakaraca tyAMcyA pAlanakartyAtarphe prakopa ANi apamAna yA jagAcyA jIvanAtaca kosaLela ANi AmhI khoTA Aropa ThevaNAr2yAMnA azIca zikSA deto.
ANi jyA lokAMnI duSkarme kelIta, tyAnaMtara tyAMnI tyAbaddala kSamA-yAcanA kelI ANi ImAna rAkhale tara tumacA pAlanakartA tyA kSamA-yAcanenaMtara aparAdha mApha karaNArA, dayAvAna Ahe.
ANi jevhA mUsA yAMcA krodha zAMta jhAlA, tevhA tyAMnI te takte ucalUna ghetale. tyAtalyA lekhAMmadhye, tyA lokAMkaritA je ApalyA pAlanakartyAce bhaya rAkhata, mArgadarzana ANi dayA-kRpA hotI.

ANi mUsAne ApalyA janasamUhAtUna sattara mANasAMnA AmacyA TharAvika avadhIkaritA nivaDale, tara jevhA bhUkaMpAne tyAMnA yeUna dharale, jevhA (mUsA) duA karU lAgale kI he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! jara tulA mAnya asate tara yAcyApUrvIca yAMcA ANi mAjhA nAza karUna TAkalA asatA. kAya tU AmacyApaikI kAhI mUrkhAMmuLe sarvAMcAca nAza karazIla? hI ghaTanA tujhyAtarphe kevaLa eka kasoTI Ahe, azA kasoTyAMdvAre tU jyAlA icchila mArgabhraSTa karazIla ANi jyAlA icchila mArgadarzana karazIla. tUca AmacA saMrakSaka Ahesa. AtA AmhAlA kSamA kara ANi AmacyAvara dayA kara ANi tU mApha karaNAr2yAMmadhye sarvAdhika mApha karaNArA Ahesa.

ANi AmhA lokAMcyA nAve yA jagAtahI puNya lihuna Theva ANi AkhiratamadhyehI. AmhI tujhyAcakaDe lakSa keMdrita karato. (allAha) pharmAvito kI mI ApalA prakopa tyAcyAvaraca avatarita karato, jyAvara icchito ANi mAjhyA dayA-kakSeta pratyeka goSTa Ahe tara tI dayA tyA lokAMcyA nAve avazya lihIna, je allAhace bhaya bALagatAta ANi jagAta (dharmadAna) detAta ANi je AmacyA AyatIMvara ImAna rAkhatAta.

je loka azA azikSita (jagAtIla gurujanAMdvAre zikSaNa na ghetalelyA) paigaMbarAce anusaraNa karatAta, je tyA lokAMnA ApalyA javaLacyA taurAta ANi iMjIlamadhye lihilele ADhaLatAta. te tyAMnA nekIcyA kAmAMcA Adeza detAta ANi duSkarmAMpAsUna rokhatAta ANi pAka (svaccha-zuddha) vastU halAla (vaidha) asalyAce sAMgatAta ANi nApAka (asvaccha-azuddha) vastU harAma (avaidha) asalyAce sAMgatAta ANi tyA lokAMvara je ojhe ANi gaLyAce phAsa hote, tyAMnA dUra karatAta. yAstava je loka yA (nabI) vara ImAna rAkhatAta, ANi tyAMce samarthana karatAta ANi tyAMnA madata karatAta, ANi tyA nUra (prakAzA) ce anusaraNa karatAta, jo tyAMcyAsobata pAThavilA gelA Ahe, ase loka pUrNa saphalatA prApta karaNAre Aheta.

tumhI sAMgA, loka ho! mI tumhA sarvAMkaDe, tyA allAhatarphe pAThavilA gelo Ahe, jyAcI rAjya-sattA samasta AkAzAMmadhye va dharatIta Ahe tyAcyAkherIja koNIhI upAsanA karaNyAyogya nAhI. toca jIvana pradAna karato ANi toca mRtyu deto. yAstava allAhavara ANi tyAce paigaMbara azikSita nabIvara ImAna rAkhA kI je allAhavara ANi tyAcyA hukUmAvara ImAna rAkhatAta ANi tyAMce anusaraNa karA, yAsAThI kI tumhI satya mArgAvara yAve.
ANi mUsA yAMcyA janasamUhAta eka jamAta azIhI Ahe, jI satyAlA anusarUna mArgadarzana karate ANi satyAnusAraca nyAya karate.

ANi AmhI tyAMnA bArA parivArAMmadhye vibhAgUna sarvAMcI vegavegaLI jamAta TharavUna dilI ANi AmhI mUsAlA Adeza dilA, jevhA tyAMcyA samudAyAcyA lokAMnI pANI mAgitale, kI ApalI lAThI amakyA ekA dagaDAvara mArA, maga tyAca kSaNI tyAtUna bArA srota vAhU lAgale. pratyekAne Apale pANI piNyAce sthAna jANUna ghetale ANi AmhI tyAMcyAvara DhagAMcI sAvalI kelI ANi tyAMnA manna ANi salvA pohacavile kI khA svaccha zuddha svAdiSTa vastU, jyA AmhI tumhAlA pradAna kelyA Aheta. ANi tyAMnI Amace kAhIca nukasAna kele nAhI, ulaTa te svataHceca nukasAna karIta hote.

ANi jevhA tyAMnA Adeza dilA gelA kI tumhI loka tyA vastIta jAUna rAhA ANi khA tithUna, jithe tumacI icchA hoIla ANi toMDAne mhaNata jA kI AmhI kSamA mAgato ANi jhukalelyA sthitIta daravAjAne praveza karA. AmhI tumace aparAdha mApha karU, je loka satkarma karatIla, tyAMnA yAhUna jAsta pradAna karU.
paraMtu yA atyAcArI lokAMnI, tyAMnA sAMgitalelyA vacanAaivajI dusareca vacana badalUna TAkale, tyApAyI AmhI AkAzAtUna eka saMkaTa tyAMcyAvara pAThavile, yA kAraNAstava kI te julUma karIta hote.

ANi tumhI tyA lokAMnA, tyA vastIcyA rahivAzAMcI, jI samudrAcyA javaLa vasalI hotI, tyA veLacI avasthA vicArA, jevhA te zanivAracyA divasAbAbata maryAdece ullaMghana karIta hote. vAstavika tyAMcyA zanivAracyA divazI tyAMnA mAse ughaDapaNe tyAMcyAsamora yeta ANi jevhA zanivAracA divasa nase tevhA (mAse) tyAMcyA samora yeta nasata. AmhI azA prakAre tyAMcI kasoTI gheta hoto. yA kAraNAstava kI te AjJA bhaMga karIta hote.

ANi jevhA tyAMcyAtalA eka gaTa ase mhaNAlA kI tumhI azA lokAMnA upadeza kA karatA, jyAMnA allAha pUrNapaNe barabAda karaNAra Ahe kiMvA tyAMnA kaThora zikSA deNArA Ahe. tyAvara tyAMnI uttara dile kI tumacyA pAlanakartyAsamora kSamA-yAcanA karaNyAkaritA ANi yAsAThI kI kadAcita tyAMnI (allAhace) bhaya bALagAve.

maga jevhA te tyA upadezAlA visarale, jyAcI tyAMnA AThavaNa karUna dilI jAta rAhilI, tevhA AmhI tyA lokAMnA tara vAcavUna ghetale je tyAMnA vAITa goSTIpAsUna rokhata hote, ANi tyA lokAMnA je julUma atyAcAra karIta hote ekA sakta zikSA-yAtanene dharale, yA kAraNAne kI te AjJA bhaMga karIta hote.
arthAta jevhA tyAMnA jyA kAmApAsUna manAI kelI gelI, tyAta tyAMnI maryAdece ullaMghana kele, tevhA AmhI tyAMnA mhaNAlo, tumhI apamAnita vAnhare vhA.

ANi tyA veLecehI smaraNa rAkhale pAhije kI jevhA tumacyA pAlanakartyAne sAMgitale kI to yA (yahUdI) lokAMvara kayAmataparyaMta azA mANasAlA AcchAdita ThevIla jo yAMnA kaThora zikSedvAre duHkha pohacavita rAhIla. niHsaMzaya, tumacA pAlanakartA lavakaraca zikSA-yAtanA deNAra Ahe ANi niHsaMzaya to kharokhara moThA mApha karaNArA ANi dayAvAna Ahe.

ANi AmhI yA jagAta tyAMce (vegavegaLe) gaTa pADale. tyAMcyAta kAhI neka sadAcArI hote ANi kAhI vegaLyA AcaraNAce ANi AmhI saMpanna avasthA ANi vAITa avasthedvAre tyAMcI kasoTI gheta rAhilo yAsAThI kI tyAMnI paratAve.

maga tyAMcyAnaMtara ase loka tyAMce vArasadAra banale kI jyAMnI tyAMcyApAsUna graMtha prApta kelA. te yA tuccha jagAce thoDesehI dhana gheUna TAkatAta ANi mhaNatAta kI AmhAlA avazya muktI miLela, jarI tyAMcyAjavaLa taseca dhana yeta rAhile tara tehI gheUna TAkatIla. kAya tyAMcyAzI yA graMthAcyA yA majakUrAcA vAyadA ghetalA gelA nAhI kI allAhakaDe satya goSTIzivAya dusar2yA koNatyAhI vacanAcA saMbaMdha na dAkhavatIla. ANi tyAMnI yA graMthAta je kAhI hote, te vAcale ANi Akhiratace ghara tyA lokAMsAThI cAMgale Ahe, je allAhace bhaya bALagatAta, maga kAya tumhI samajUna gheta nAhI?
ANi jyA lokAMnI graMtha majabUtapaNe dharalA (graMthAvara aTaLa rAhile) ANi je namAja kAyama karatAta, tara AmhI azA lokAMcA, je svataHce AcaraNa sudhArUna ghetIla, mobadalA vAyA jAU deNAra nAhI.

ANi tI veLahI AThavA, jevhA AmhI parvatAlA chatrIsArakhe tyAMcyAvara adhAMtarita Thevale ANi tyAMnA khAtrI jhAlI kI AtA tyAMcyAvara yeUna kosaLela ANi AmhI pharmAvile, kI AmhI jo graMtha tumhAlA pradAna kelA Ahe tyAcA dRDhatApUrvaka svIkAra karA ANi lakSAta ThevA yAtale Adeza, yAsAThI kI tumhI allAhace bhaya bALagU lAgAve.

ANi jevhA tumacyA pAlanakartyAne AdamacyA saMtatIcyA pAThIMmadhUna tyAMcI apatye kADhalI ANi tyAMcyAkaDUna tyAMcyAcabAbata vAyadA ghetalA kI kAya mI tumacA svAmI va pAlanakartA nAhI? sarvAMnI uttara dile, kA nAhI, AmhI sarva sAkSI Ahota. yAsAThI kI tumhI lokAMnI kayAmatacyA divazI ase na mhaNAve kI AmhI tara yApAsUna agadI ajANa hoto.
kiMvA he sAMgAla kI sarvAMta prathama zirka tara AmacyA vADavaDilAMnI kele ANi AmhI tyAMcyAnaMtara tyAMcyA vaMzAta Alo. tara kAya tyA cukIcyA lokAMcyA duSkRtyAMbaddala tU AmhAlA vinAzAta TAkazIla?
ANi AmhI azA prakAre AyatIMce spaSTapaNe nivedana karato, yAsAThI kI (vAITa mArgApAsUna) tyAMnI parata phirAve.

ANi tyA lokAMnA tyA mANasAcI avasthA vAcUna aikavA kI jyAlA AmhI ApalyA nizANyA pradAna kelyA, maga to tyAMcyApAsUna agadI nighUna gelA, maga saitAna tyAcyA mAge lAgalA azA prakAre to vATa cukalelyA lokAMmadhye sAmIla jhAlA.

ANi jara AmhI icchile asate tara tyAlA yA nizANyAMmuLe ucca padAvara basavile asate, paraMtu to tara jagAcyA mohapAzAta aDakalA ANi ApalyA icchA-AkAMkSAMcyA mAge cAlU lAgalA tevhA tyAcI avasthA kutryAsArakhI jhAlI kI jara tumhI tyAcyAvara hallA karAla tarIhI (jIbha bAhera kADhUna) dhApA TAkIla kiMvA tyAlA soDUna dyAla tarIhI dhApA TAkIla. hIca avasthaA tyA lokAMcI Ahe, jyAMnI AmacyA AyatIMnA khoTe Tharavile, yAstava tumhI yA avasthece nivedana karA, kadAcita tyA lokAMnI kAhI vicAra karAvA.
tyA lokAMcI avasthAdekhIla moThI vAITa avasthA Ahe, je AmacyA AyatIMnA khoTe mAnatAta, ANi Apale nukasAna karUna ghetAta.
jyAlA sarvazreSTha allAha svataH mArgadarzana karato. to saraLa mArgAvara asato ANi jyAMnA allAha mArgabhraSTa karIla, teca toTyAta Aheta.

ANi AmhI ase aneka jinna ANi mAnava jahannamakaritA nirmANa kele Aheta, jyAMcI mane azI Aheta kI jyAMcyAdvAre samajata nAhI, ANi jyAMce DoLe ase Aheta, jyAMcyAdvAre pAhata nAhIta ANi jyAMce kAna ase Aheta, jyAMcyAdvAre aikata nAhIta. he loka catuSpAda (pazU) sArakhe Aheta, kiMbahunA tyAMcyApekSAhI adhika bhaTakalele heca loka gAphIla Aheta.

ANi uttamottama nAve allAhakaritAca Aheta. yAstava yA nAvAMnI allAhalA pukArIta jA ANi azA lokAMzI saMbaMdhahI ThevU nakA, je tyAcyA nAvAMmadhye teDhanirmANa karatAta. tyA lokAMnA tyAMcyA kRta karmAcI zikSA avazya miLela.
ANi AmacyA nirmitIta eka jamAta azIhI Ahe, jI satyAsaha mArgadarzana karate ANi satyAlA anusarUna nyAya karate.
ANi je loka AmacyA AyatIM (ciMnhAM) nA khoTe TharavitAta, AmhI tyAMnA haLU haLU (tAvaDIta) azA prakAre gheta Ahota kI tyAMnA kaLatadekhIla nAhI.
ANi tyAMnA saMdhI deto, niHsaMzaya mAjhI paddhata moThI majabUta Ahe.
kAya tyA lokAMnI hI goSTa dhyAnI ghetalI nAhI kI tyAMcyA sAthIdArAlA kiMcitahI veDa lAgale nAhI, te tara kevaLa eka spaSTa bhaya dAkhaviNAre Aheta.

ANi kAya tyA lokAMnI vicAra nAhI kelA AkAzAMcyA ANi dharatIcyA vizvAta ANi dusar2yA cIja-vastUMmadhye, jyA allAhAne nirmANa kelyA Aheta ANi yA goSTIta kI saMbhavataH tyAce maraNa javaLaca yeUna Thepale asAve, maga tyA (kuraAnA) naMtara koNatyA goSTIvara he loka ImAna rAkhatIla?
jyAlA sarvazreSTha allAha mArgabhraSTa karIla tyAlA koNI sanmArgAvara ANU zakata nAhI, ANi allAha azA lokAMnA mArgabhraSTateta bhaTakata rAhaNyAsa soDUna deto.

he loka tumhAlA kayAmataviSayI vicAratAta kI tI kevhA yeIla? tumhI sAMgA kI yAce jJAna phakta mAjhyA pAlanakartyAlAca Ahe. tilA ticyA veLevara, allAhakherIja dusarA koNI jAhIra karaNAra nAhI. tI AkAzAMcI va jaminIcI phAra moThI (ghaTanA) asela. tI tumacyAvara acAnaka yeUna kosaLela. te tumhAlA azA prakAre vicAratAta, jaNU kAhI tumhI ticA zodha gheUna basalAta. tumhI sAMgA, tice jJAna vizeSarityA allAhajavaLa Ahe, paraMtu bahuteka loka jANata nAhIta.

tumhI sAMgA, mI svataH ApalyAkaritA ekhAdyA phAyadyAcA adhikAra rAkhata nAhI, ANi nA ekhAdyA nukasAnAcA, paraMtu tevaDhAca, jevaDhA allAhane icchilA asela ANi jara mI aparokSa goSTIMnA jANaNArA rAhilo asato tara mI puSkaLa lAbha prApta karUna ghetale asate, ANi ekhAde nukasAnahI malA pohacale nasate. mI tara kevaLa bhaya dAkhaviNArA ANi zubha-samAcAra deNArA Ahe, tyA lokAMsAThI je ImAna rAkhatAta.

to (allAha) asA Ahe kI jyAne tumhAlA phakta ekA jIvApAsUna nirmANa kele ANi tyAcyAdvAre tyAcI joDI banavalI, yAsAThI kI tyAne ApalyA tyA joDIdArApAsUna sukha caina prApta karAvI, maga patIne patnIzI javaLIka kelI, tevhA tilA garbha rAhilA halakAsA, maga tI tyAlA gheUna cAlata phirata rAhilI. jevhA tilA bhAra jANavU lAgalA, tevhA patI-patnI doghe allAhazI, jo tyAMcA svAmI Ahe, duA (prArthanA) karU lAgale kI jara tU AmhAlA sahIsalAmata (vyavasthita svarUpAta) saMtAna pradAna kelI tara AmhI khUpa khUpa AbhAra mAnU.

tara jevhA allAhane tyA doghAMnA yathAyogya saMtAna pradAna kelI, tevhA allAhane pradAna kelelyAta te doghe (itarAMnA) allAhacA sahabhAgI TharavU lAgale, yAstava allAha pavitra Ahe tyAcyA sahabhAgI TharaviNyApAsUna.
kAya azAMnA allAhacA sahabhAgI TharavitAta, je koNatyAhI cIja-vastUlA nirmANa karU zakata nasAve (kiMbahunA) svataH tyAMnAca nirmANa kele gele asAve.
ANi te tyAMnA kasalyAhI prakAracI madata karU zakata nAhI, ANi te svataH ApalI madata karU zakata nAhI.
ANi jara tumhI ekhAdI goSTa sAMgaNyAsAThI tyAMnA pukArAla tara tumacyA sAMgaNyAnusAra cAlaNAra nAhIta. tumacyA dRSTIne donhI goSTI sArakhyA Aheta, maga tumhI tyAMnA pukArA kiMvA gappa rAhA.

vAstavika tumhI allAhalA soDUna jyAMnA pukAratA (jyAMcI upAsanA karatA) tedekhIla tumacyAsArakheca allAhace dAsa Aheta, tara tumhI tyAMnA pukArA, maga tyAMnIhI tumacyA sAMgaNyAnusAra kele pAhije. jara tumhI sacce asAla.

kAya tyAMnA pAya Aheta, jyA AdhAre te cAlata asAveta, kiMvA tyAMnA hAta Aheta, jyAdvAre ekhAdyA vastUlA dharU zakatIla, kiMvA tyAMnA DoLe Aheta, jyAdvAre te pAhAta asAveta, kiMvA tyAMnA kAna Aheta, jyAdvAre te aikatAta. tumhI sAMgA, tumhI ApalyA sarva sahabhAgyAMnA bolAvUna ghyA, maga malA (hAnI pohacaviNyAcI) upAyayojanA karA. maga malA kiMcitahI savaDa deU nakA.
niHsaMzaya, mAjhA mitra-madatakartA allAhaca Ahe jyAne hA graMtha (pavitra kuraAna) avatarIta kelA ANi to neka sadAcArI lokAMcI madata karato.
ANi tumhI jyA lokAMnA allAhalA soDUna pukAratA (upAsanA karatA) te tumacI kAhIca madata karU zakata nAhI, ANi nA te svataH ApalI madata karU zakatAta.
ANi jara tyAMnA kAhI sAMgaNyAsAThI pukArAla tara te aikU zakaNAra nAhIta. ANi tumhI tyAMnA pAhatA kI te tumhAlA pAhata Aheta ANi te kAhIca pAhata nAhIta.
tumhI kSamAzIlatecA mArga patkarA, satkarmAMcI zikavaNa deta rAhA, ANi mUrkha lokAMpAsUna alipta rAhA.
ANi jara tumhAlA ekhAdA saMzaya saitAnAkaDUna yeU lAgela tara allAhace zaraNa mAgata jA. niHsaMzaya allAha moThA aikaNArA ANi khUpa jANaNArA Ahe.
niHsaMzaya je loka (allAhace) bhaya bALagatAta jevhA tyAMnA ekhAdA saMzaya saitAnAkaDUna ud‌bhavato, tevhA te allAhacyA smaraNAta magna hotAta, yAstava akasmAta tyAMce DoLe ughaDatAta.
ANi je saitAnAMce anuyAyI Aheta, te tyAMnA saMkaTAta oDhUna netAta. maga te thAMbata nAhI.

ANi jevhA tumhI ekhAdA mojijA (Iza-camatkAra) tyAMcyAsamora sAdara karata nAhI, tevhA te loka mhaNatAta kI tumhI hA camatkAra kA ANalA nAhI. tumhI sAMgA kI mI tyAce anusaraNa karato jo mAjhyAkaDe mAjhyA pAlanakartyAtarphe Adeza pAThavilA gelA Ahe. he mAnya karA. he tumacyA pAlanakartyAtarphe aneka pramANe Aheta ANi mArgadarzana va dayA kRpA Ahe tyA lokAMkaritA, je ImAna rAkhatAta.
ANi jevhA kuraAna paThaNa hota asela tevhA te lakSapUrvaka aikA, ANi zAMta rAhA AzA Ahe kI tumacyAvara dayA hoIla.
ANi (he mAnava!) ApalyA manAta namratA ANi bhaya rAkhUna ApalyA pAlanakartyAce smaraNa karIta rAhA. sakALa-saMdhyAkALa svara saumya ThevUna ANi gAphIla lokAMpaikI hoU nako.
niHsaMzaya, je loka tujhyA pAlanakartyAzI nikaTa Aheta te tyAcyA upAsanepAsUna ghameMDa karIta nAhI ANi tyAcI pavitratA varNana karIta tyAcyA puDhe sajadA karatAta (mAthA TekatAta).

he loka tumhAlA prApta jhAlelyA dhana-saMpattIviSayI vicAratAta, tumhI sAMgA kI yuddhAta prApta jhAlelI dhana-saMpattI allAhacI Ahe, ANi paigaMbarAcI Ahe. yAstava tumhI allAhace bhaya rAkhA ANi Apale ApasAtIla nAtesaMbaMdha sudhArUna ghyA ANi sarvazreSTha allAha ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAcyA AdezAce pAlana karA, jara tumhI ImAna rAkhaNAre asAla.

ImAna rAkhaNAreca ase asatAta kI jevhA allAhace varNana kele jAte, tevhA tyAMcI hRdaye bhayabhIta hotAta, ANi jevhA allAhacyA AyatI tyAMnA vAcUna aikavilyA jAtAta tara tyA AyatI tyAMcyA ImAnAsa vRddhiMgata karatAta ANi te loka ApalyA pAlanakartyAvara bharosA ThevatAta.
je namAja niyamitapaNe paDhatAta ANi AmhI je kAhI tyAMnA dile Ahe, tyAtUna kharca karatAta.
sacce ImAna rAkhaNAre heca loka Aheta. tyAMcyAkaritA moThe darje Aheta tyAMcyA pAlanakartyAjavaLa ANi kSamA ANi mAna sanmAnapUrNa rojI (AjIvikA) Ahe.
jase kI tumacyA pAlanakartyAne tumacyA gharApAsUna satyAsaha tumhAlA bAhera kADhale ANi ImAnadhArakAMcyA ekA gaTAlA he asahya vATata hote.
spaSTa kaLUna AlyAnaMtara te satyAviSayI tumacyAzI vAda ghAlata hote jaNU kAhI te mRtyukaDe hAMkale jAta asAveta ANi (tyAlA) pAhata asAveta.

ANi tumhI loka tyA veLecI AThavaNa karA, jevhA allAha tumacyAzI tyA dona gaTAMpaikI ekAcA vAyadA karIta hotA kI jo tumacyA hAtI lAgela ANi tumhI yA Azevara hote kI zastre nasalelA gaTa tumacyA hAtI lAgAvA ANi sarvazreSTha allAhalA mAnya hote kI ApalyA hukUmAne satyAce satya asaNe siddha karUna dyAve ANi tyA inkArI lokAMcyA muLAvara ghAva ghAlAvA.
yAsAThI kI satyAce satya asaNe ANi asatyAce asatya asaNe siddha karAve, maga yA aparAdhI lokAMnA apriya kA vATenA.

tyA veLecI AThavaNa karA, jevhA tumhI ApalyA pAlanakartyAsa duA (prArthanA) karIta hote, maga sarvazreSTha allAhane tumacI duA kabUla kelI kI mI tumacI eka hajAra phariztyAMdvAre madata karIna je lAgopATha yeta jAtIla.

ANi allAhanehI madata kevaLa yA kAraNAstava kelI kI zubha samAcAra TharAvA ANi tumacyA hRdayAMnA zAMtI samAdhAna lAbhAve ANi vijaya phakta allAhatarphe Ahe. niHsaMzaya allAha atizaya zaktizAlI ANi hikamata bALagaNArA Ahe.

tyA veLecI AThavaNa karA jevhA (allAha) tumacyAvara jhopecI guMgI caDhavita hotA, ApalyAkaDUna zAMtI samAdhAna pradAna karaNyAsAThI ANi tumacyAvara AkAzAtUna parjanyavRSTI karIta hotA kI yA pANyAdvAre tumhAlA pAka (svaccha-zuddha) karAve ANi tumacyApAsUna saitAnI zaMkA-kuzaMkA dUra karAvyAta ANi tumacyA hRdayAMnA majabUta karAve ANi tumace pAya cAMgale sthira karAveta.

tyA veLecI AThavaNa karA, jevhA tumacA pAlanakartA phariztyAMnA Adeza deta hotA kI mI tumacyA sobatIlA Ahe, yAstava tumhI ImAnadhArakAMce sAhasa vADhavA. mI AtAca kAphirAMcyA manAta bhaya TAkato. yAstava tumhI mAnAMvara ghAva ghAlA ANi tyAMcyA eka eka sAMdhyAvara prahAra karA.
hI yA goSTIcI zikSA Ahe kI tyAMnI allAhacA ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAcA virodha kelA ANi je loka allAhacA ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAcA virodha karatAta, tara sarvazreSTha allAha sakta sajA deNArA Ahe.
tevhA yA zikSecI goDI cAkhA ANi lakSAta ThevA kI kAphirAMkaritA (inkArI lokAMkaritA) AgIcI zikSA-yAtanA TharalelIca Ahe.
he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! jevhA tumhI kAphirAMzI laDhaNyAsa bhiDAla, tevhA tyAMcyAkaDUna pATha phiravU nakA.

ANi jo manuSya tyAprasaMgI tyAMcyAkaDUna pATha phiravila, paraMtu jara koNI laDhaNyAcA pavitrA badalata asela kiMvA jo ApalyA samUhAkaDe Azraya gheNyAsAThI yeta asela (tara goSTa vegaLI) mAtra jo dusarA ase karIla tara to allAhacA prakopa oDhavUna gheIla ANi tyAce ThikANa jahannama asela, ANi te atizaya vAITa ThikANa Ahe.

tevhA tumhI tyAMnA ThAra mArale nAhI, kiMbahunA allAhane tyAMnA ThAra kele ANi tumhI (mUThabhara dhULa) nAhI phekalI, paraMtu allAhane phekalI, ANi yAsAThI kI ImAnadhArakAMnA ApalyAtarphe, tyAMcyA prayatnAcA phAra moThA mobadalA pradAna karAvA. niHsaMzaya sarvazreSTha allAha khUpa aikaNArA, khUpa jANaNArA Ahe.
(eka goSTa tara) hI jhAlI (dusarI goSTa azI) kI sarvazreSTha allAhalA kAphirAMce kaTa kArasthAna asaphala karAyace hote.

jara tumhI loka nirNaya icchita asAla tara to nirNaya tumacyAsamora Ahe, ANi jara thAMbAla tara he tumacyAsAThI phAra uttama Ahe ANi jara tumhIdekhIla teca kAma karAla tara AmhIdekhIla teca kAma karU, maga tumacA samudAya tumacyA kAhIca upayogI paDaNAra nAhI, maga saMkhyene kitIhI moThA aso. kharI goSTa hI Ahe kI sarvazreSTha allAha ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMcyA sobata Ahe.
he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! allAhace ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAce pharmAna mAnA ANi tyA (pharmAnAlA kabUla karaNyA) pAsUna toMDa phiravU nakA, aikUna ANi jANUna ghetAnAhI.
ANi tumhI tyA lokAMsArakhe hoU nakA, je dAvA tara karatAta kI AmhI aikale, vAstavika tyAMnI kAhIca aikale nAhI.
niHsaMzaya samasta prANImAtrAta allAhacyA javaLa atizaya vAITa te loka Aheta, je bahIre Aheta, muke Aheta, je kiMcitahI samajUna gheta nAhIta.
ANi jara allAhalA tyAMcyAta kAhI cAMgulapaNA ADhaLalA asatA tara tyAMnA zravaNazaktI pradAna kelI asatI ANi jara tyAMnA AtA aikavIlahI tarI te toMDa phiravatIla durlakSa karIta.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! tumhI allAha ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAcyA AdezAMce anusaraNa karA, jevhA paigaMbara tumhAlA tumacyA jIvanadAyI viSayAkaDe bolAvita asatIla ANi smaraNa rAkhA kI allAha mAnavAcyA ANi tyAcyA hRdayAcyA daramyAna ADa banato ANi niHsaMzaya tumhAlA allAhacyAca javaLa ekatra vhAyace Ahe.

ANi tumhI azA saMkaTApAsUna svataHlA vAcavA, je vizeSataH azAca lokAMvara kosaLaNAra nAhI je tumacyApaikI tyA aparAdhaAMce doSI Aheta ANi he jANUna asA kI sarvazreSTha allAha moThA sakta zikSA deNArA Ahe.

ANi tyA avasthece smaraNa karA, jevhA tumhI dharatIvara thoDe hote kamajora dubaLe mAnale jAta hote. yA bhayAne rAhata hote kI lokAMnI kadAcita tumhAlA luTUna na ghyAve, tevhA allAhane tumhAlA rAhAyalA jAgA dilI ANi tumhAlA ApalyA madatIne sAmarthya pradAna kele, ANi tumhAlA svaccha zuddha anna-sAmugrI pradAna kelI, yAsAThI kI tumhI kRtajJatA vyakta karAvI.
he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! tumhI allAha ANi paigaMbarAcA hakka mArU nakA ANi ApalyA surakSita cIja-vastUMmadhye vizvAsaghAta karU nakA ANi tumhI cAMgale jANatA.
ANi tumhI hI goSTa jANUna asA kI tumace dhana ANi tumacI saMtatI eka kasoTI mhaNUna Ahe. (ANi hehI jANUna asA kI) sarvazreSTha allAhacyA javaLa phAra moThA mobadalA Ahe.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! jara tumhI allAhace bhaya bALagata rAhAla, tara allAha tumhAlA eka nirNayAcI goSTa pradAna karIla ANi tumacyApAsUna tumace aparAdha dUra karIla, ANi tumhAlA mApha karIla ANi allAha moThA kRpAzIla Ahe.

ANi tyA ghaTanecAhI ullekha karA, jevhA kAphira (inkArI) loka tumacyAviSayI kaTa-kArasthAna racata hote kI tumhAlA kaidI banavUna ghyAve kiMvA tumhAlA ThAra karAve kiMvA tumhAlA dezAbAhera ghAlavAve ANi te ApalA kaTa racata hote ANi sarvazreSTha allAha ApalI yojanA Akhata hotA ANi sarvazreSTha allAha sarvAMta uttama yojanA banaviNArA Ahe.

ANi jevhA tyAMcyAsamora AmacyA AyatI vAcUna aikavilyA jAtAta tevhA mhaNatAta kI AmhI aikale, jara AmhI icchile tara AmhIdekhIla yAcyAsArakheca sAMgUna dAkhavU. he tara kAhIca nAhI phakta pUrvajAMcyA purAvA nasalelyA goSTI Aheta.
ANi jevhA te loka mhaNAle, he allAha! jara hA kuraAna kharokharaca tujhyAtarphe Ahe tara AmacyAvara AkAzAtUna dagaDAMcA varSAva kara kiMvA AmacyAvara ekhAdA duHkhadAyaka az2Aba utarava.
ANi allAha ase nAhI karaNAra kI tyAMcyAta tumhI asatAnA tyAMnA zikSA-yAtanA deIla, ANi allAha tyAMnA zikSA deNAra nAhI, yA avastheta kI te kSamA-yAcanAhI karIta asAveta.

ANi tyAMcyAta ase kAya Ahe kI, allAhane tyAMnA zikSA na dyAvI? ase asatAnAhI kI te lokAMnA masajide harAma (kAbAgRhA) pAsUna rokhatAta, vAstavika te yA masjidIcI dekhabhAla karaNAre nAhIta. tice saMrakSaka allAhacyA AjJadhAraka dAsAMkherIja koNIhI nAhI, paraMtu tyAMcyAtale adhikAMza loka he jANata nAhIta.
ANi tyAMcI namAja kAbAgRhAjavaLa phakta hIca hotI, ziTyA vAjaviNe, TALyA vAjaviNe. tevhA ApalyA inkArApAyI yA zikSA-yAtanecA svAda cAkhA.

niHsaMzaya he inkArI loka Apale dhana azAsAThI kharca karIta Aheta kI allAhacyA mArgApAsUna rokhAve tara he loka Apale dhana aseca kharca karata rAhatIla, maga te dhana tyAMcyAsAThI pazcAttApAce kAraNa Tharela, maga parAbhUta hotIla ANi kAphirAMnA jahannamakaDe ekatra kele jAIla.

yAsAThI kI allAhane nApAka (asvaccha-azuddha) lokAMnA pAka (svaccha zuddha) lokAMpAsUna vegaLe karAve ANi nApAka lokAMcI ekamekAMzI bheTa karUna dyAvI, maga tyA sarvAMnA ekatra karAve, maga tyA sarvAMnA jahannamamadhye TAkAve. ase loka pUrNataH toTyAta Aheta.

tumhI inkArI lokAMnA sAMgA kI jara he loka (azI harakata) thAMbavatIla tara yAMce sarva aparAdha, je pUrvI kele Aheta, mApha kele jAtIla, ANi jara ApalI tIca rIta kAyama rAkhatIla tara pUrvIcyA (kAphirAMsAThI) niyama lAgU jhAlelAca Ahe.

ANi tumhI tyAMcyAzI tyA veLeparyaMta saMgharSa karIta rAhA kI tyAMcyA zraddheta bighADa zillaka na rAhAvA ANi dharma allAhacAca vhAvA. maga jara he (harakatI) thAMbavatIla tara allAha tyAMcyA karmAMnA cAMgalyA prakAre pAhato.
ANi jara toMDa phiravatIla tara vizvAsa ThevA kI sarvazreSTha allAha tumacA mitra Ahe. to atizaya cAMgalA mitra ANi cAMgalA madata karaNArA Ahe.

ANi jANUna ghyA kI, yuddhAta hastagata kelelA koNatyAhI prakAracA mAla (dhana-saMpadA) tumhI prApta karAla tara tyAcA pAcavA hissA tara allAha ANi rasUla ANi nAtevAIka ANi anAtha ANi goragarIba, ANi pravAzAMkaritA Ahe. jara tumhI allAhavara ImAna rAkhale Ahe ANi tyAvara je AmhI ApalyA dAsAvara tyA divazI avatarita kele, jo satya ANi asatyAcyA daramyAna alagAvAcA hotA, jyA divazI donhI sainye ApasAta bhiDalI hotI ANi allAha pratyeka goSTIce sAmarthya bALagaNArA Ahe.

jevhA tumhI javaLacyA kinAr2yAvara ANi te dUracyA kinAr2yAvara hote ANi kAphilA tumacyApAsUna (phAra) khAlI hotA, jara tumhI ApasAta vAyadA kelA asatA tara TharalelyA veLevara pohocaNyAta matabheda kelA asatA, tathApi allAhalA eka kAma karUnaca TAkAyace hote, je Tharale gele hote, yAsAThI kI, jo naSTa hoIla, to pramANAvara (arthAta Tharalele jANUna) naSTa vhAvA ANi jo jivaMta rAhIla, todekhIla pramANAvara (satya oLakhUna) jivaMta rAhAvA, ANi allAha cAMgalyA prakAre aikaNArA, jANaNArA Ahe.

jevhA tumhAlA tumacyA svapnAta allAhane tyAMcI saMkhyA kamI dAkhavalI. jara tyAMnA jAsta dAkhavile asate tara tumhI bhyADa banale asate ANi yAbAbata ApasAta matabheda karU lAgale asate, paraMtu allAhane (yApAsUna) vAcavile. niHsaMzaya allAha chAtItalyA (manAta lapalelyA) goSTIhI jANaNArA Ahe.

ANi jevhA tyAne bheTa hoteveLI tyAMnA tumacyA najareta phAra kamI (saMkhyene) dAkhavile ANi tumhAlA tyAMcyA najareta kamI dAkhavile azAsAThI kI allAhane te kArya taDIsa nyAve, je karAyaceca hote ANi sarva kArye allAhakaDeca vaLavilI jAtAta.
he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! jevhA tumhI ekhAdyA (zatrU) sainyAzI bhiDAla, tevhA aTaLa rAhA ANi allAhace jAstIta jAsta smaraNa karA, yAsAThI kI tumhAlA saphalatA prApta vhAvI.

ANi allAhace ANi tyAcyA rasUla (paigaMbara) ce AjJApAlana karIta rAhA, ApasAta matabheda ThevU nakA, anyathA bhyADa va bhitre vhAla, ANi tumacA pAyA DaLamaLIta hoIla ANi tumacA joma nAhIsA hoIla ANi dhairya-saMyama va vizvAsa rAkhA. niHsaMzaya allAha dhIra-saMyama rAkhaNAr2yAMcyA pAThIzI Ahe.

ANi tyA lokAMsArakhe hoU nakA, je moThI ghameMDa dAkhavita ANi lokAMmadhye abhimAna va ahaMkAra karIta ApalyA gharApAsUna cAlale hote ANi allAhacyA mArgApAsUna rokhata hote. je kAhI te karIta Aheta allAha tyAsa gherUna TAkaNArA Ahe.

ANi jevhA tyAMcyA karmAMnA saitAna tyAMnA suzobhita karUna dAkhavita hotA ANi sAMgata hotA kI mANasAMpaikI koNIhI Aja tumacyAvara varcasvazAlI hoU zakata nAhI. mI svataH tumacA samarthaka Ahe, paraMtu jevhA donhI gaTa jAhIra jhAle, tevhA ApalyA ulaTapAvalI phirAlA ANi mhaNU lAgalA kI mI tara tumacyApAsUna vegaLA Ahe, vibhakta Ahe. mI te kAhI pAhata Ahe je tumhI pAhata nAhI. mI allAhace bhaya bALagato ANi allAha moThA sakta az2Aba deNArA Ahe.

jevhA munAphika (DhoMgI) loka mhaNata hote ANi tedekhIla, jyAMcyA manAta roga hotA kI tyAMnA tara tyAMcyA dharmAne dhokyAta TAkale Ahe. ANi jo manuSyadekhIla allAhavara bharosA karIla tara sarvazreSTha allAha nizcitaca moThA jabaradasta ANi hikamatazAlI Ahe.

ANi tumhI jara te dRzya pAhile asate jevhA pharizte kAphirAMce (ImAna na rAkhaNAr2yAMce) prANa kADhatAta, tyAMcyA toMDAvara ANi kamarevara mAratAta (ANi mhaNatAta) tumhI jaLaNyAcyA zikSecI goDI cAkhA.
he tyA karmAMmuLe, jI tumacyA hAtAMnI pUrvIca pAThavUna ThevalIta. niHsaMzaya sarvazreSTha allAha ApalyA dAsAMvara kiMcitahI julUma- atyAcAra karIta nAhI.

phiraaunacyA anuyAyIMcyA avasthesArakhe ANi tyAMcyA bujUrga lokAMcyA kI tyAMnI allAhacyA AyatIMvara vizvAsa ThevalA nAhI, tevhA allAhane tyAMcyA aparAdhAMpAyI tyAMnA dharale. niHsaMzaya allAha moThA jabaradasta ANi tyAcI zikSA moThI sakta Ahe.

he azAsAThI kI sarvazreSTha allAha asA nAhI kI ekhAdyA janasamUhAvara ekhAdI kRpA deNagI (nemata) pradAna karUna punhA badalUna TAkIla, joparyaMta to svataH ApalyA tyA avasthelA badalUna TAkata nAhI, jI tyAMcI svataHcI hotI ANi he kI sarvazreSTha allAha aikaNArA jANaNArA Ahe.

phiraaunace loka ANi tyAcyA pUrvIcyA lokAMpramANe kI tyAMnI ApalyA pAlanakartyAcyA goSTIMnA khoTe Tharavile, tevhA AmhI tyAcyA aparAdhAMpAyI tyAMnA barabAda karUna TAkale ANi phiraaunavAlyAMnA buDavUna TAkale ANi he sarva atyAcArI hote.
samasta sajIvAMmadhye sarvAdhika vAITa allAhacyA javaLa te loka Aheta je kupra (inkAra) karatAta, maga te ImAna rAkhata nAhIta.
jyAMcyAkaDUna tumhI vacana ghetale, tarIhI te daraveLesa ApalyA vacanAcA bhaMga karatAta ANi kadhIhI allAhace bhaya rAkhUna vAgata nAhI.
yAstava jevhA tumhI tyAcyAvara yuddhAta varcasvazAlI TharAla, tevhA tyAMnA asA jabaradasta mAra dyA kI tyAMcyA mAge asalelyAMnIhI paLa kADhAvA. kadAcita tyAMnI bodha grahaNa karAvA.

ANi jara tumhAlA ekhAdyA janasamUhAkaDUna dhokA kiMvA dagAbAjI kelI jANyAce bhaya asela tara samAnatecyA sthitIta tyAMcA samajhotA toDUna TAkA. allAha vizvAsaghAta (apahAra) karaNAr2yAMzI prema rAkhata nAhI.
ANi inkArI lokAMnI hA vicAra karU naye kI te paLa kADhatIla. yAta zaMkA nAhI kI te lAcAra va agatika karU zakata nAhI.

ANi tumhI tyAMcyAzI laDhaNyAkaritA ApalyA kSamatenusAra sAmarthya tayAra karA ANi ghoDe tayAra ThevaNyAcehI kI tyAdvAre tumhI allAhacyA zatrUMnA ANi ApalyA zatrUMnA bhayabhIta karU zakAve, ANi tyAMcyAkherIja itarAMnAhI, jyAMnA tumhI jANata nAhIta, allAha tyAMnA cAMgalyA prakAre jANato ANi je kAhI allAhacyA mArgAta kharca karAla te tumhAlA purepUra dile jAIla ANi tumacyA hakkAce nukasAna kele jANAra nAhI.
ANi jara te samajhotyAkaDe jhukatIla, tara tumhIhI samajhotyAkaDe jhukA ANi allAhavara bharosA ThevA. niHsaMzaya allAha aikaNArA jANaNArA Ahe.
ANi jara te tumacyAzI dhokebAjI karU icchitIla tara allAha tumacyAsAThI puresA Ahe. tyAneca ApalyA madatIdvAre ANi ImAnadhArakAMdvAre tumhAlA samarthana dile Ahe.

ANi tyAMcyA manAta ekamekAMce premahI tyAneca nirmANa kele Ahe. jara tumhI dharatIcyA samasta cIja-vastU kharca kelyA asatyA, tarIhI tyAcyA manAta prema-bhAvanA nirmANa karU zakata navhate, paraMtu allAhaneca tyAMcyA manAta prema TAkale. niHsaMzaya to varcasvazAlI hikamata bALagaNArA Ahe.
he paigaMbara! tumacyAsAThI ANi tumace anusaraNa karaNAr2yA ImAnadhArakAMsAThI allAha puresA Ahe.

he paigaMbara! ImAnadhArakAMnA jihAda (dharmayuddhA) sAThI protsAhita karA. jara tumacyApaikI vIsa dhairyazAlIhI asatIla tara te donaze jaNAMvara varcasvazAlI rAhatIla ANi jara tumacyApaikI zaMbhara asatIla tara eka hajAra ImAna na rAkhaNAr2yAMvara varcasvazAlI rAhatIla. yA kAraNAne kI te nAsamaja loka Aheta.

AtA allAha tumace ojhe halake karato. to cAMgalyA prakAre jANato kI tumacyA durbalatA Ahe, tevhA jara tumacyApaikI zaMbhara dhairyazIla asatIla tara te donaze jaNAMvara varcasvazAlI rAhatIla. ANi jara tumacyApaikI eka hajAra asatIla tara te allAhacyA hukumAne dona hajAra (zatrUMvara) varcasvazAlI asatIla ANi allAha dhaiya-saMyama rAkhaNAr2yA lokAMcyA sobata Ahe.

paigaMbarAMcyA hAtI kaidI asAyalA nako, joparyaMta dezAta hiMsaka yuddha na vhAve. tumhI tara yA jagAce dhana icchitA ANi allAhacA irAdA AkhiratacA Ahe ANi allAha varcasvazAlI, hikamata bALagaNArA Ahe.
jara pUrvIpAsUnaca allAhatarphe he likhita nasate tara je kAhI tumhI ghetale Ahe, tyAcyAviSayI tumhAlA ekhAdI sakta zikSA jhAlI asatI.
ANi je halAla ANi svaccha zuddha dhana yuddhAdvAre prApta karUna ghyAla te khA ANi allAhace bhaya bALagUna rAhA. niHsaMzaya sarvazreSTha allAha moThA mApha karaNArA ANi dayA karaNArA Ahe.

he paigaMbara! ApalyA hAtAkhAlacyA kaidyAMnA sAMgA kI jara sarvazreSTha allAha tumacyA manAta neka irAdA pAhIla tara je kAhI tumacyADUna ghetale gele Ahe, tyAhUna cAMgale tumhAlA pradAna karIla ANi allAha mApha karaNArA, dayA karaNArA Ahe.

ANi jara te tumacyAzI vizvAsaghAta karaNyAcA irAdA karatIla, tara yAMnI yAcyApUrvI khudda allAhazI vizvAsaghAta kelelA Ahe. zevaTI tyAne tyAMnA kaida karavile ANi sarvazreSTha allAha sarvajJa, hikamatazAhI Ahe.

niHsaMzaya, jyA lokAMnI ImAna rAkhale ANi allAhasAThI dezatyAga kelA arthAta hijarata kelI ANi jihAda kele dhanAne va manAne allAhacyA mArgAta, ANi jyAMnI azA lokAMnA Azraya dilA, ANi tyAMnA madata kelI tara te ekamekAMce ApasAta mitra Aheta ANi jyAMnI ImAna rAkhale, paNa dezatyAga kelA nAhI tara tumacyAzI tyAMcI kiMcitahI maitrI nAhI, paraMtu jara te dharmAcyA bAbatIta tumacyAkaDe madata mAgatIla tara tyAMnA madata karaNe tumacyAsAThI Avazyaka Ahe, mAtra tyA lokAMkherIja, kI tumacyA va tyAMcyA daramyAna pratijJA karAra jhAlA Ahe ANi je kAhI tumhI karIta AhAta, allAha te cAMgalyA prakAre pAhata Ahe.
ANi kAphira (ImAna na rAkhaNAre) ekamekAMce mitra Aheta, jara tumhI ase kele nAhI tara dezAta upadrava pasarela ANi moThA utpAta nirmANa hoIla.

jyA lokAMnI ImAna rAkhale ANi dezatyAga kelA ANi allAhacyA mArgAta jihAda kele ANi jyAMnI azA lokAMnA Azraya dilA, ANi madata pohacavilI tara heca loka sacce ImAnadhAraka Aheta, tyAMcyAsAThI kSamA ANi mAna-sanmAnapUrNa rojI (AjIvikA) Ahe.

ANi jyA lokAMnI yAnaMtara ImAna rAkhale ANi dezatyAga kelA ANi tumacyA sobatIne jihAda kelA tara ase lokahI tumacyApaikIca Aheta ANi nAtevAIka tyAMcyApaikI ApasAta ekamekAMcyA jAsta nikaTa Aheta, allAhacyA AdezAnvaye. niHsaMzaya allAha sarva kAhI jANaNArA Ahe.
hI allAha ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAtarphe vacanamuktIcI ghoSaNA Ahe tyA anekezvaravAdyAMbAbata, jyAMcyAzI tumhI vacana karAra kelA Ahe.
tevhA (he anekezvaravAdyAMno!) tumhI dezAta cAra mahine pravAsa karUna ghyA ANi jANUna ghyA kI tumhI allAhalA vivaza karU zakata nAhI ANi allAha inkArI lokAMnA apamAnita karaNAra Ahe.

allAha ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAtarphe haja akabara (moThyA haja) cyA divazI sApha ailAna Ahe kI allAha anekezvaravAdyAMpAsUna vibhakta Aheta ANi tyAcA paigaMbaradekhIla. jara attAhI tumhI taubA (kSamA-yAcanA) karAla tara tumacyAsAThI adhika cAMgale Ahe ANi jara tumhI toMDa phiravAla, tara jANUna asA kI tumhI allAhalA agatika karU zakata nAhI ANi kAphirAMnA sakta zikSecI khabara dyA.

paraMtu ase anekezvaravAdI, jyAMcyAzI tumhI vacana karAra kelelA Ahe ANi tyAMnI tumhAlA kiMcitahI nukasAna pohacavile nAhI, ANi tumacyA virodhAta koNAcI madata kelI nAhI, tara tumhIdekhIla karArAcA avadhI tyAMcyAsaha pUrNa karA. niHsaMzaya allAha bhaya rAkhUna vAgaNAr2yAMzI prema karato.
