maga AdaraNIya mahine saMpatAca anekezvaravAdyAMnA, ADhaLatIla tithe ThAra karA, tyAMnA kaidI banavA, tyAMnA gherA TAkA ANi pratyeka ghAtAcyA ThikANI tyAMcyAvara TapUna basA paraMtu jara te taubA (kSamA yAcanA) karUna ghetIla ANi nityanemAne namAja paDhU lAgatIla ANi jakAta adA karU lAgatIla tara tumhI tyAMcA mArga soDUna dyA. niHsaMzaya, sarvazreSTha allAha mApha karaNArA, dayA karaNArA Ahe.

jara anekezvaravAdyAMpaikI koNI tumacyA javaLa Azraya mAgela tara tumhI tyAlA Azraya dyA, yethaparyaMta kI tyAne allAhacI vANI aikUna ghyAvI, maga tyAlA tyAcyA zAMtI-sthaLAparyaMta pohacavA. he azAsAThI kI te loka ajANa Aheta.

anekezvaravAdyAMcA vAyadA allAha ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAzI kasA kAya rAhU zakato, tyAMcyAkherIja, jyAMcyAzI tumhI masajide harAmajavaLa vacana karAra kelA Ahe, tara joparyaMta te loka tumacyAzI karAra-pAlana karatIla, tumhIhI tyAMcyAzI kelelyA vAyadyAvara kAyama rAhA. sarvazreSTha allAha, bhaya rAkhUna vAgaNAr2yA lokAMzI prema rAkhato.

tyAMcyA vacana-vAyadyAMcA kAya bharosA? tyAMnA jara tumacyAvara varcasva lAbhale tara te nA nAtesaMbaMdhAcA vicAra karatIla, nA vacana-karArAcA. ApalyA mukhAne he tumhAlA rijhavita Aheta, paraMtu yAMcI mane mAnata nAhIta ANi tyAMcyAta adhikAMza loka phAsika (durAcArI) Aheta.
tyAMnI allAhacyA AyatIMnA phAra kamI kimatIta vikale, ANi tyAcyA mArgApAsUna rokhale. moThe vAITa Ahe, je he karIta Aheta.
he tara ekhAdyA ImAnadhArakAcyA hakkAta kasalyAhI nAtyAcI kiMvA vacanAcI kALajI karIta nAhI. he Ahetaca hadda olAMDUna jANAre.

ajUnahI jara te taubA (pazcAttApayukta kSamA yAcanA) karatIla ANi namAja niyamitapaNe paDhU lAgatIla ANi jakAta deta rAhatIla tara tumace dharma-bAMdhava Aheta ANi AmhI tara samaMjasa lokAMsAThI ApalyA AyatIMce tapazIlapUrvaka nivedana karIta Ahota.

jara he loka vacana-vAyadyAnaMtarahI ApalyA vacanAcA bhaMga karatIla ANi tumacyA dharmAcI niMdA-nAlastIhI karatIla tara tumhIhI azA kAphirAMcyA saradArAMzI bhiDA. tyAMcI zapatha kAhIca nAhI. saMbhavataH azA prakAre te (ase karaNe) thAMbavatIla.

tumhI tyA lokAMcI DokI ThecaNyAsAThI kA tayAra hota nAhI, jyAMnI ApalyA zapathA toDUna TAkalyA ANi (aMtima) paigaMbarAlA dezAbAhera ghAlaviNyAcyA vicArAta Ahe, ANi svataHca pahilyAMdA tyAMnI tumacI cheDa kADhalI Ahe. kAya tumhI tyAMnA bhitA? vastutaH allAhalAca sarvAMta jAsta hakka Ahe kI tumhI tyAce bhaya rAkhAve, jara tumhI ImAnadhAraka asAla.
tumhI tyAMcyAzI yuddha karA. allAha tumacyA haste tyAMnA duHkha yAtanA deIla, tyAMnA apamAnita karIla. tyAMcyA virodhAta tumacI madata karIla ANi ImAnadhArakAMcyA hRdayAMnA zitalatA pohacavIla.
ANi tyAMcyA manAce duHkha ANi krodha dUra karIla ANi allAha jyAcyAkaDe icchito dayA kRpene dhyAna deto ANi sarvazreSTha allAha jANaNArA, hikamatazAlI Ahe.

kAya tumhI he samajUna basalA AhAta kI tumhAlA aseca soDUna dile jAIla? adyApa sarvazreSTha allAhane tumacyApaikI tyAMnA ughaDakIsa ANale nAhI, je jihAdace sainika Aheta, ANi jyAMnI allAha, tyAcA rasUla ANi ImAnadhArakAMkherIja koNAlAhI mitra banavile nAhI, ANi sarvazreSTha allAha khUpa cAMgalyA prakAre jANato, je tumhI karIta AhAta.

zakya navhe kI anekezvaravAdI, allAhacyA masjidIlA AbAda karatIla, vAstavika sthitI hI Ahe kI he ApalyA inkArAce svataH sAkSI Aheta. tyAMcI sarva karme vAyA gelIta ANi te nehamIkaritA jahannamamadhye rAhatIla.

allAhacyA masjidInA tara te loka AbAda karatAta, je allAhavara ANi AkhiratacyA divasAvara ImAna rAkhatIla, namAja niyamita paDhatIla, jakAta detIla ANi allAhazivAya koNAlAhI bhita nasatIla. saMbhavataH heca loka khAtrIne mArgadarzana lAbhalele Aheta.

kAya tumhI hAjI lokAMnA pANI pAjaNe ANi masjIde harAma (kAbAgRha) cI sevA karaNe, tyAcyAsamAna Tharavile Ahe, jo allAhavara ANi kayAmatacyA divasAvara ImAna rAkhIla ANi allAhacyA mArgAta jihAda (saMgharSa) karIla. he allAhajavaLa samAna nAhI ANi sarvazreSTha allAha atyAcArI lokAMnA mArga dAkhavita nAhI.
jyA lokAMnI ImAna rAkhale, dezatyAga kelA, allAhacyA mArgAta ApalyA dhanAne va prANAne saMgharSa kelA, te allAhacyA samora khUpa moThyA darjAce Aheta ANi heca loka saphalatA prApta karaNAre Aheta.
tyAMcA pAlanakartA tyAMnA ApalI dayA ANi prasannatA ANi azA jannatIMcI khUzakhabara deto, jyAMcyAta tyAMcyAsAThI niraMtara sukha Ahe.
tithe te sadaivakALa rAhatIla allAhacyA nikaTa, niHsaMzaya hA phAra moThA mobadalA Ahe.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! ApalyA pityAMnA ANi ApalyA bAMdhavAMnA mitra banavU nakA, jara te kupra (inkArA) lA ImAnApekSA jAsta cAMgale samajatIla. tumacyApaikI jodekhIla tyAMcyAzI dostI ThevIla, to pUrNapaNe (aparAdhI ANi) atyAcArI Ahe.

tumhI sAMgA kI jara tumace pitA, tumace putra ANi tumace bAMdhava ANi tumacyA patnyA ANi tumace kuTuMba ANi kamavilele dhana ANi to vyApAra, jyAcyA kamataratece tumhI bhaya rAkhatA ANi tI ghare, jI tumhAlA phAra priya Aheta (jara) he sarva tumhAlA allAha ANi tyAcA paigaMbara ANi allAhacyA mArgAta jihAdapekSA jAsta priya Ahe tara maga pratikSA karA kI sarvazreSTha allAhane ApalA az2Aba (zikSA-yAtanA) ANAvI. sarvazreSTha allAha durAcArI lokAMnA mArga dAkhavata nAhI.

niHsaMzaya, sarvazreSTha allAhane tumhAlA aneka yuddhabhUmIta vijaya pradAna kelA Ahe ANi hunaina-yuddhAcyA divazIhI, jevhA tumhAlA ApalyA jAsta saMkhyebaddala ghameMDa hotI, paraMtu azAne tumhAlA kAhIca lAbha jhAlA nAhI, tathApi dharatI ApalI vizAlatA (bALagata) asatAnAhI tumacyAsAThI saMkucita (taMga) jhAlI, maga tumhI pATha phiravUna dUra paLAle.

maga allAhane ApalyAtarphe salAmatI ApalyA paigaMbarAvara ANi ImAnadhArakAMvara avatarita kelI ANi Apale te sainya pAThavile je tumhI pAhata navhate ANi kAphirAMnA (inkArI lokAMnA) pUrNa zikSA dilI ANi yA kAphirAMcA hAca mobadalA hotA.
maga tyAnaMtarahI jyAlA icchila, sarvazreSTha allAha mApha karIla ANi allAhaca mApha karaNArA dayA karaNArA Ahe.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! niHsaMzaya anekezvaravAdI nApAka (asvaccha azuddha) Aheta. jyAMnI yA varSAnaMtara masajide harAma (AdaraNIya masajida-kAbAgRhA) cyA javaLahI yetA kAmA naye jara tumhAlA garIbIce bhaya asela tara allAha tumhAlA ApalyA dayA kRpene dhanavAna karIla jara allAha icchila. niHsaMzaya allAha sarvajJa ANi hikamatazAlI Ahe.

tyA lokAMzI laDhA je allAhavara ANi Akhiratavara ImAna rAkhata nAhI. je allAha ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAdvAre harAma TharavilelyA vastUlA harAma samajata nAhI, nA te satya-dharmAcA svIkAra karatAta. tyA lokAMpaikI jyAMnA graMtha pradAna kelA gelA Ahe, yethaparyaMta kI tyAMnI apamAnita hoUna svahaste jijiyA (Taॅksa) adA karAvA.

yahUdI mhaNatAta kI uz2aira allAhacA putra Ahe ANi khristI mhaNatAta kI masIha allAhacA putra Ahe, he kathana phakta tyAMcyA toMDacI goSTa Ahe. pUrvIcyA kAphirAMcyA kathanAcI hedekhIla barobarI karU lAgale Aheta. allAha sarvanAza karo yAMcA, he koThe bharakaTata cAlale Aheta?

tyA lokAMnI allAhalA soDUna ApalyA dharma-jJAnI ANi dharmAcAryAMnA raba (svAmI, pAlanahAra) banavile Ahe, ANi mariyamaputra masIhalA vAstavika tyAMnA ekameva allAhacIca upAsanA karaNyAcA Adeza dilA gelA hotA, jyAcyAkherIja koNIhI upAsanA-yogya nAhI to tyAMcyA zirka karaNyApAsUna pavitra (pAka) Ahe.
te allAhacyA divya prakAzAlA ApalyA toMDAMnI vijhavU icchitAta ANi allAha inkAra karato, paraMtu he kI ApalyA divya prakAzAlA pUrNatvAsa pohacavAve, maga kAphirAMnA kitIhI apriya vATo.
tyAneca ApalyA paigaMbarAlA saccA mArga ANi satya dharmAsaha pAThavile kI tyAlA itara sarva dharmAMvara varcasvazAlI karAve, mana anekezvaravAdI lokAMnA kitIhI vAITa vATo.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! bahuteka dharma-jJAnI ANi upAsaka, lokAMcA mAla nAhaka giLaMkRta karatAta ANi allAhacyA mArgApAsUna rokhatAta ANi je loka sone-cAMdIce khajine bALagatAta ANi allAhacyA mArgAta kharca karIta nAhI, tyAMnA kaThora zikSA-yAtanecI khabara aikavA.

jyA divazI tyA khajinyAlA jahannamacyA AgIta tApavile jAIla, maga tyAdvAre tyAMce kapALa ANi kUsa- bagala ANi pAThIMnA DAgale jAIla (tyAMnA sAMgitale jAIla) heca te, jyAlA tumhI ApalyAsAThI jamavUna Thevale hote, tara ApalyA yA sAThavUna ThevalelyA khajinyAMcI goDI cAkhA.

mahinyAMcI gaNanA allAhacyA javaLa, allAhacyA graMthAta bArA Ahe, tyAca divasApAsUna, jevhApAsUna AkAzAMnA ANi jaminIlA tyAne nirmANa kele Ahe. tyAMcyApaikI cAra mahine Adara ANi pratiSThece Aheta. hAca pavitra dharma Ahe. tumhI yA mahinyAMcyA kALAta ApalyA prANAMvara atyAcAra karU nakA ANi tu‌hI sarva anekezvaravAdyAMzI jihAda karA jase te tumhA sarvAMzI laDhatAta ANi lakSAta ThevA kI allAha bhaya rAkhUna karma karaNAr2yAMcyA sobata Ahe.

mahinyAMnA puDhe mAge karaNe, kupra (adharma) lA vADhaviNe Ahe. tyAdvAre tyAMnA mArgabhraSTa kele jAte, je kAphira Aheta, ekA varSAlA halAla karUna ghetAta ANi ekA varSAlA harAma TharavitAta kI allAhane je harAma Tharavile Ahe, tyAcyA gaNaneta barobarIne karUna ghyAve, maga jyAlA harAma kele Ahe, tyAlA halAla TharavAve. tyAMcI vAITa karme tyAMnA cAMgalI dAkhavilI gelI Aheta ANi allAha kAphirAMnA mArgadarzana karIta nAhI.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! tumhAlA jhAle tarI kAya kI jevhA tumhAlA sAMgitale jAte kI calA, allAhacyA mArgAta dezatyAga karA, tara tumhI jaminIlA bilagatA. kAya tumhI AkhirataaivajI aihika jIvanAvara rAjI jhAlAta? aikA yA jagAce jIvana AkhiratacyA tulaneta atizaya lahAna Ahe.

jara tumhI dezatyAga (hijarata) kelA nAhI tara sarvazreSTha allAha tumhAlA duHkhadAyaka zikSA deIla ANi tumacyAkherIja dusar2yA lokAMnA badalUna ANIla. tumhI sarvazreSTha allAhalA koNatehI nukasAna pohacavU zakata nAhI ANi allAha sarva kAhI karaNyAsa samartha Ahe.

jara tumhI paigaMbara (muhammada sallallAhu alaihi vasallama) cI madata na karAla tara allAhaneca tyAMcI madata kelI azA veLI jevhA kAphira lokAMnI tyAMnA (dezA) bAhera ghAlavile hote. donapaikI dusarA jevhA te doghe gupheta hote, jevhA te ApalyA sAthIdArAsa sAMgata hote, ciMtA karU nakA allAha AmacyA sobata Ahe. tevhA allAhaneca ApalyAtarphe zAMtI-samAdhAna utaravUna azA sainyAMdvAre tyAMnA madata pohacivalI, jyAMnA tumhI pAhilesuddhA nAhI. tyAne kAphirAMcA bola khAlI pADalA ANi moThA va uttama bola tara allAhacAca Ahe. sarvazreSTha allAha varcasvazAlI ANi hikamata bALagaNArA Ahe.
nighA, uThA halakyA avastheta asAla tarIhI ANi bhArI avajaDa asAla tarIhI ANi allAhacyA mArgAta ApalyA tana-mana-dhanAne jihAda karA. heca tumacyAkaritA cAMgale Ahe jara tumhI jANata asAla.

jara tvarita prApta hoNArI dhana-saMpadA asatI, ANi halakAsA pravAsa asatA tara he avazya tumacyA mAge nighAle asate, paraMtu tyAMnA tara lAMba aMtarAcA pravAsa moThA kaThINa vATalA ANi AtA tara he allAhacI zapatha gheUna sAMgatIla kI AmacyA aMgI jara zaktI-sAmarthya rAhile asate tara AmhI avazya tumacyAsobata nighAlo asato. te ApalyA prANAMnA svataHca vinAzAkaDe neta Aheta. tyAMcyA khoTepaNAce khare jJAna allAhalA Ahe.
allAha tumhAlA kSamA karo, tumhI tyAMnA paravAnagI kA dilI, yAvinA kI tumacyA samora sacce va prAmANika loka spaSTapaNe jAhIra vhAveta ANi tumhI khoTyA lokAMnAhI jANUna ghyAve.

allAhavara ANi kayAmata (pralayA) cyA divasAvara ImAna ANi dRDha vizvAsa rAkhaNAre loka tara dhanAne va prANAne jihAda karaNyApAsUna thAMbUna rAhaNyAcI paravAnagI tumacyAkaDe kadhIhI mAgaNAra nAhIta ANi sarvazreSTha allAha, duSkarmAMpAsUna dUra rAhaNAr2yA lokAMnA cAMgalyA prakAre jANato.

hI paravAnagI tara tumacyAjavaLa teca loka mAgatAta, jyAMce nA allAhavara ImAna Ahe, nA AkhiracyA divasAvara aTaLa vizvAsa Ahe, jyAMcI mane saMzayagrasta Aheta ANi te ApalyA saMzayAtaca bhaTakata Aheta.

jara tyAMcA irAdA (jihAdakaritA) nighaNyAcA asatA tara tyAMnI yA pravAsAkaritA sAdhanAMcI tayArI kelI asatI, paraMtu allAhalA tyAMce uThaNe priya navhate, yAstava tyAMnI kAhI karaNyApAsUna rokhale ANi tyAMnA sAMgitale gele kI tumhI basUna rAhaNAr2yAMsobata basUnaca rAhA.

jara he tumacyAca sobata nighAlehI asate tara tumacyAsAThI upadravAkherIja dusar2yA koNatyAhI goSTIcI vADha kelI nasatI, kiMbahunA tumacyA daramyAna utpAta mAjaviNyAsAThI dhAvapaLa kelI asatI ANi tumacyAta phUTa pADaNyAcI saMdhI zodhata rAhile asate, tyAMnA mAnaNAre svataH tumacyAta hajara Aheta ANi sarvazreSTha allAha atyAcArI lokAMnA cAMgalyA prakAre jANato.

he tara yApUrvIhI phUTa pADaNyAcI saMdhI zodhata rAhile ANi tumacyAsAThI kAryAta ulaTaphera karIta rAhile, yethaparyaMta kI satya gheUna pohocale ANi allAhacA Adeza prabhAvI jhAlA, tarIdekhIla te loka vAITa mAnataca rAhile.
tyAMcyApaikI koNI mhaNato kI malA Adeza dyA, malA saMkaTAta TAkU nakA. jANUna asA kI te saMkaTagrasta jhAle Aheta ANi niHsaMzaya jahannama kAphirAMnA gherUna TAkaNArI Ahe.

tumhAlA jara ekhAdI bhalAI prApta jhAlI tara tyAMnA vAITa vATate, ANi jara kaSTa yAtanA pohocalI tara mhaNatAta, AmhI tara ApalI vyavasthA pahilyApAsUna ThIkaThAka karUna ghetalI hotI, maga khUpa tor2yAne aiTa dAkhavita parata jAtAta.

tumhI sAMgA, AmhAlA tyAkherIja koNatIhI goSTa pohocU zakata nAhI, jI allAhane AmacyAsAThI lihUna ThevalI Ahe. to AmacA svAmI Ahe ANi (tumhI sAMgA) ImAnadhArakAMnI allAhavaraca pUrNa bharosA ThevalA pAhije.

tumhI sAMgA, tumhI AmacyAbAbata jyA goSTIMcyA pratikSeta AhAta, tI dona cAMgalyA goSTIMpaikI eka Ahe ANi AmhI tumacyAbAbata yA goSTIcyA pratikSeta Ahota kI ekatara allAhane tumhAlA ApalyAtarphe ekhAdI zikSA dyAvI kiMvA AmacyA hAtUna, tevhA ekA bAjUlA tumhI pratikSA karA, dusar2yA bAjUlA AmhI tumacyAsobata pratikSA karIta Ahota.
tumhI sAMgA kI tumhI khuzIne kharca karA kiMvA nAkhuzIne, kabUla tara kadhIhI kelA jANAra nAhI. niHsaMzaya tumhI durAcArI loka AhAta.
tyAMce kharca karaNe kabUla na hoNyAce kAraNa yAkherIja koNatehI nAhI kI he allAha ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAce avajJAkArI Aheta ANi moThyA sustIne namAjalA yetAta ANi vAITa manAne kharca karatAta.

yAstava tyAMcI dhana-saMpattI ANi saMtatIne tumhAlA AzcaryAta TAkU naye. allAha heca icchito kI tyAMnA yA jagAcyA jIvanAtaca zikSA dyAvI ANi tyAMcyA inkAra karaNyAcyA avasthetaca tyAMcA prANa nighAvA.
ANi he allAhacI zapatha gheUna sAMgatAta kI he tumacyA gaTAce loka Aheta, vAstavika te tumacyA gaTAce nAhIta, goSTa kevaLa evaDhIca kI he bhitre loka Aheta.
jara yAMnA ekhAde surakSita sthAna kiMvA ekhAdI guphA kiMvA koNatIhI ghusUna basaNyAcI jAgA miLAlI tara lageca dhAva gheta paLata suTatIla.
tyAMcyAta tedekhIla Aheta, je dAnAcyA dhanAcyA vATaNIbAbata tumacyAvara Aropa ThevatAta, jara tyAtUna tyAMnA miLAlyAsa AnaMda hoto ANi jara tyAtUna kAhI na miLAle tara tvarita nArAja hoU lAgatAta.

jara he loka allAha ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAnI dilelyAvara khUza rAhile asate ANi mhaNAle asate kI allAha AmhAlA puresA Ahe, allAha ApalyA kRpene AmhAlA deIla ANi tyAcA paigaMbarahI. AmhI tara allAhakaDUnaca apekSA rAkhaNAre Ahota.

dAna kevaLa phakIrAMkaritA Ahe ANi garIbAMkaritA ANi tyAMce kAma karaNAr2yAMkaritA ANi tyA lokAMkaritA jyAMcI manadharaNI kelI jAta asela ANi gulAma mukta karaNyAkaritA ANi karjadAra lokAMkaritA, ANi allAhacyA mArgAta ANi pravAzAMkaritA, anivArya kartavya Ahe allAhatarphe ANi allAha sarvajJa hikamatazAlI Ahe.

ANi tyAMcyAta asedekhIla Aheta, je paigaMbarAlA duHkha yAtanA pohacavitAta ANi mhaNatAta kI halakyA kAnAcA Ahe (tumhI) sAMgA, kI to kAna tumacyA bhalAIsAThI Ahe. to allAhavara ImAna rAkhato ANi ImAnadhArakAMcyA bolaNyAvara vizvAsa Thevato ANi tumacyApaikI je ImAnadhAraka Aheta, he tyAMcyAsAThI dayA kRpA Aheta ANi allAhace rasUla yAMnA je loka duHkha yAtanA pohacavitAta, tyAMcyAsAThI duHkhadAyaka az2Aba (zikSA-yAtanA) Ahe.
te kevaLa tumhAlA khUza karaNyAsAThI tumacyAsamora allAhacI zapatha ghetAta, vastutaH he ImAna rAkhaNAre asate tara allAha ANi tyAce rasUla (paigaMbara) khUza kele jANyAsa adhika pAtra hote.
kAya he nAhI jANata kI jo koNI allAhacA ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAcA virodha karIla, tyAcyAsAThI nizcitaca jahannamacI Aga Ahe, jicyAta te nehamI rAhatIla. hA phAra moThA apamAna Ahe.

munAphika lokAMnA arthAta DhoMgI musalamAnAMnA (nehamI) he bhaya vATata asate kI kadAcita tyAMcyAvara (ImAnadhArakAMvara) ekhAdI Ayata na avatarita vhAvI, jI tyAMcyA manAtalyA goSTI tyAMnA sAMgUna TAkIla. tumhI sAMgA kI tumhI thaTTA maskarI karIta rAhA. niHsaMzaya sarvazreSTha allAha te jAhIra karaNArA Ahe, jyApAsUna tumhI bhayabhIta AhAta.

jara tumhI vicArAla tara sApha mhaNatIla kI AmhI tara aseca ApasAta thaTTA vinoda karIta hoto. tyAMnA sAMgA kI kAya allAha tyAcyA AyatI ANi tyAcA rasUla evaDheca tumacyA thaTTA-maskarIkaritA bAkI rAhileta?

tumhI bahANe banavU nakA. niHsaMzaya tumhI ApalyA ImAna rAkhalyAnaMtara kAphira (inkArI) jhAle. jara AmhI tumacyApaikI kAhI lokAMnA mApha jarI kele tarI kAhI lokAMnA tyAMcyA atyAcArAcI sakta sajA deNAraca.

sarvaca munAphika (dAMbhika) puruSa ANi striyA ApasAta sArakheca Aheta. te vAITa goSTIMcA Adeza detAta ANi bhalyA goSTIMpAsUna rokhatAta ANi ApalI mUTha baMda ThevatAta, he allAhalA visarale, allAhanehI tyAMcA visara pADalA. niHsaMzaya munAphika (dutoMDI) lokaca durAcArI Aheta.

sarvazreSTha allAhane yA munAphika puruSa-striyAMzI ANi kAphirAMzI jahannamacyA AgIcA vAyadA kelelA Ahe, jithe te nehamI rAhatIla teca tyAMcyAsAThI purese Ahe. tyAMcA allAhatarphe dhiHkkAra Ahe ANi tyAMcyAsAThI kAyamasvarUpI zikSA yAtanA Ahe.

tumacyApUrvI hoUna gelelyA lokAMpramANe, je tumacyApekSA zUra ANi dhana-saMpattI va saMtatI jAsta bALagata hote, tara tyAMnI ApalA dhArmika bhAga ucalalA, maga tumhIhI ApalA hissA ucalata AhAta. jyApramANe tumacyApUrvIce loka ApalyA hizyAMdvAre lAbhAnvita jhAle ANi tumhIdekhIla tyAcapramANe maskarIcI goSTa kelI, jazI tyAMnI kelI hotI. tyAMcI karme yA jagAta ANi Akhiratamadhye vAyA gelIta ANi heca loka toTyAta Aheta.

kAya tyAMnA ApalyApUrvI hoUna gelelyA lokAMcI khabara nAhI pohocalI? nUha ANi Ada ANi samUdace janasamUha ANi ibrAhImacA janasamUha ANi madayanace rahivAzI ANi ulaTUna pAlathyA ghAtalelyA vastyAMcyA lokAMcI. tyAMcyAjavaLa paigaMbara spaSTa nizANyA gheUna pohocale tevhA sarvazreSTha allAha asA navhatA kI tyAMcyAvara atyAcAra karIla. ulaTa tyAMnI svataHca ApalyAvara atyAcAra karUna ghetalA.

ImAnadhAraka puruSa ANi striyA ApasAta ekamekAMce (sahAyyaka ANi) mitra Aheta. te cAMgalyA goSTIMcA Adeza detAta, ANi vAITa goSTIMpAsUna rokhatAta. namAja niyamitapaNe paDhatAta. jakAta adA karatAta. allAha ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAMce mhaNaNe mAnya karatAta. azAca lokAMvara allAha lavakaraca dayA kRpA karIla. niHsaMzaya allAha varcasvazAlI, hikamata bALagaNArA Ahe.

yA ImAnadhAraka puruSa ANi striyAMzI allAhane tyA jannatIMcA vAyadA kelA Ahe, jyAMcyAkhAlI pravAha vAhata Aheta, jithe te nehamIkaritA rAhatIla, ANi tyA pAka svaccha gharAcA, je tyA avinAzI jannatamadhye Ahe ANi allAhacI prasannatA sarvAMta mahAna Ahe. hIca phAra moThI saphalatA Ahe.
he nabI! kAphirAMzI ANi munAphika lokAMzI jihAda karIta rAhA ANi tyAMcyAvara saktI karA. tyAMce khare ThikANa jahannama Ahe. je atizaya vAITa ThikANa Ahe.

he allAhacI zapatha gheUna sAMgatAta kI tyAMnI ase mhaTale nAhI. vAstivaka satyAcA inkAra tyAMnI ApalyA toMDAnI kelelA Ahe. ANi he islAmacA svIkAra kelyAnaMtarahI kAphira jhAleta ANi yAMnI tyA kAmAcA irAdAhI kelA Ahe, jyAlA te prApta karU zakale nAhIta. he kevaLa yAca goSTIcA sUDa gheta Aheta kI tyAMnA allAhane ApalyA kRpene ANi yAcyA paigaMbarAne dhanavAna kele jara he ajUnahI taubA (pazcAttApa) karUna ghetIla tara he tyAMcyA hakkAta cAMgale Ahe ANi jara toMDa phiravatIla tara allAha tyAMnA yA jagAta ANi Akhiratamadhye duHkhadAyaka zikSA deIla ANi saMpUrNa dharatIta tyAMnA koNI mitra ANi madata karaNArA lAbhaNAra nAhI.
yAMcyAta asedekhIla Aheta, jyAMnI allAhazI vAyadA kelA hotA kI jara to AmhAlA ApalyA kRpene dhana pradAna karIla tara AmhI avazya dAna karU ANi pUrNataH neka sadAcArI lokAMpaikI hoU.
paraMtu jevhA allAhane ApalyA kRpene tyAMnA dile tevhA he tyAta kaMjUsapaNA karU lAgale ANi TALATALa karUna toMDa phiravile.
tevhA yAcI zikSA mhaNUna allAhane tyAMcyA manAta phUTIratA TAkalI allAhacyA bheTIcyA divasaparyaMta kAraNa tyAMnI allAhazI kelelyA vAyadyAcA bhaMga kelA, ANi khoTe bolata rAhile.
kAya te he nAhI jANata kI allAhalA tyAMcyA manAtalA gupta bheda ANi tyAMcyA kAnagoSTI sarva mAhIta Ahe ANi allAha sarva lapalelyA goSTIMnA jANaNArA Ahe.

je loka azA ImAnadhArakAMvara Aropa ThevatA, je mokaLyA manAne dAna karatAta ANi tyA lokAMvara, jyAMnA ApalyA mehanatIkherIja kAhIca sAdhya nAhI, tara he tyAMcI thaTTA uDavitAta, allAhadekhIla tyAMcI thaTTA uDavito ANi yAca lokAMsAThI moThI sakta zikSA yAtanA (az2Aba) Ahe.

tumhI tyAMcyAsAThI taubA (kSamA yAcanA) karA kiMvA na karA, jara tumhI sattara veLAhI yAMcyAsAThI taubA karAla tarIdekhIla allAha tyAMnA kadApi mApha karaNAra nAhI. kAraNa tyAMnI allAha ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAcA inkAra kelA Ahe ANi azA durAcArI lokAMnA allAha mArgadarzana karIta nAhI.

mAge rAhUna jANAre loka, allAhace rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi vasallama) yAMcyAvirUddha ApalyA basUna rAhaNyAvara khUza Aheta. tyAMnI allAhacyA mArgAta ApalyA dhanAne va prANAne jihAda karaNe apriya jANale ANi te mhaNAle kI yA bhayaMkara unhAta nighU nakA. tyAMnA sAMgA kI jahannamacI Aga yAhUna atizaya tApadAyaka Ahe. yAMnI he samajUna ghetale asela tara bare jhAle asate.
tevhA tyAMnI hasaNe phAra kamI ANi raDaNe jAsta kele pAhije. ApalyA yA kRtakarmAMcyA mobadalyAta.

tevhA jara sarvazreSTha allAha tumhAlA tyAcyA ekhAdyA samUhAkaDe paratavUna neIla maga he tumacyAzI laDhAIcyA maidAnAta jANyAcI anumatI mAgatIla tevhA tumhI sAMgA kI tumhI mAjhyAsobata kadhIhI nighU zakata nAhI ANi nA mAjhyAsaha zatruzI laDhU zakatA. tumhI pahilyA khepelAca basUna rAhaNe pasaMta kele hote, tevhA AtAhI tumhI mAge rAhUna jANAr2yAMmadhyeca basUna rAhA.

ANi yAMcyApaikI koNI maraNa pAvalA tara tyAcyA janAjAcI namAja tumhI kadhIhI paDhU nakA ANi nA tyAcyA kabarIvara jAUna ubhe rAhA, he allAha ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAcA inkAra karaNAre loka Aheta ANi mareparyaMta durAcArIca rAhile.

ANi tumhAlA tyAMcI dhana-saMpattI ANi saMtatI kAhIca bhalI vATU naye. sarvazreSTha allAha heca icchito kI tyAMnA yA goSTIdvAre yA jagAta sajA dyAvI ANi he ApalA jIva nigheparyaMta kAphira (kRtaghna) ca rAhile.

ANi jevhA ekhAdI sUraha (pavitra kuraAnAtIla adhyAya) avatarita kelI jAte kI allAhavara ImAna rAkhA ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAsaha miLUna jihAda karA, tevhA tyAMcyApaikI dhanavAna lokAMcA eka gaTa tumacyAjavaLa yeUna anumatI gheto kI AmhAlA tara basUna rAhaNAr2yAMmadhyeca soDUna dyA.
he tara gharAta rAhaNAr2yA striyAMnA sAtha deNyAvara rAjI jhAle, ANi tyAMcyA hRdayAMvara mohara lAvalI gelI. AtA te kasalehI samaja umaja bALagata nAhI.
paraMtu svataH paigaMbara ANi tyAMcyAsobatace ImAnadhAraka ApalyA dhanAne va prANAne jihAda karatAta. tyAMcyAcasAThI bhalAI Ahe. ANi heca loka saphalatA prApta karaNAre Aheta.
yAca lokAMsAThI sarvazreSTha allAhane tI jannata tayAra kelI Ahe, jicyAkhAlI pravAha vAhata Aheta. jyAta te nehamI rAhatIla ANi hIca phAra moThI saphalatA Ahe.

grAmINa bhAgAtIla azikSita, bahANA karaNAre loka hajara jhAle kI tyAMnA anumatI dilI jAvI ANi te basUna rAhAveta jyAMnI allAhazI ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAzI asatya kathana kele hote. AtA tara tyAMcyAta jevaDhe kAphira (adharmI) Aheta tyAMnA duHkhadAyaka az2Aba pohacalyAvinA rAhaNAra nAhI.

kamajora dubaLe ANi AjArI asalelyAMvara ANi azA lokAMvara je kharca karaNyAsa asamartha Aheta doSa nAhI, joparyaMta te allAha ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAce zubhaciMtaka asatIla. azA neka sadAcArI lokAMvara kasalIhI kAravAI kelI jAU naye ANi allAha moThA mApha karaNArA meharabAna Ahe.

ANi nA tyA lokAMvara je tumacyAjavaLa yetAta kI tumhI tyAMcyAsAThI vAhanAcI vyavasthA karUna dyAvI, tevhA tumhI tyAMnA uttara detA kI malA tumacyA vAhanAsAThI kAhIca ADhaLata nAhI, tevhA te duHkhAne raData, azrU DhALIta parata jAtAta kI tyAMnA kharca karaNyAsAThI kAhIhI prApta nAhI.

niHsaMzaya, Aropa azA lokAMvara Ahe je dhanavAna asUnahI tumacyAjavaLa anumatI mAgatAta. striyAMsobata gharI basUna rAhaNyAvara he khUza Aheta ANi allAhane tyAMcyA hRdayAMvara mohara lAvalI Ahe. jyAmuLe te ajANa banale Aheta.

jevhA tumhI tyAMcyAjavaLa jAla tevhA tumacyAsamora sababI mAMDatIla. (he paigaMbara!) sAMgA kI bahANe banavU nakA. AmhI tumacyAvara vizvAsa ThevaNAra nAhI. allAhane tumacyA karatutIMzI AmhAlA avagata kele Ahe ANi allAha ANi tyAcA paigaMbara tumace AcaraNa pAhatIla, maga tumhI adRzya ANi dRzya goSTI jANaNAr2yAkaDe paratavile jAla, maga to tumhAlA sAMgela kI je kAhI tumhI karIta hote.

jevhA tumhI tyAMcyAjavaLa parata jAla tevhA te tumacyAsamora allAhacI zapatha ghetIla, yAsAThI kI tumhI tyAMnA tyAMcyA dazevara soDAve, yAstava tumhI tyAMnA tyAMcyA dazevara soDA. nizcitaca te moThe apavitra Aheta ANi tyAMce ThikANa naraka (jahannama) Ahe, tyAMcyA tyA karmAMcyA mobadalyAta, je te karIta hote.
he tumacyAjavaLa azAsAThI zapatha ghetIla kI tumhI tyAMcyAzI rAjI vhAve. tevhA jara tumhI tyAMcyAzI rAjIhI jhAlAta tara allAha azA durAcArI lokAMzI rAjI hota nAhI.

grAmINa loka inkAra ANi varakaraNIpaNAta khUpaca sakta asatAta, ANi tyAMnI ase asalehI pAhije kI tyAMnA tyA AdezAMce jJAna nasAve, je Adeza allAhane ApalyA paigaMbarAvara avatarita kele Aheta ANi allAha khUpa khUpa jJAna bALagaNArA, moThA hikamatazAlI Ahe.

ANi tyA grAmINa lokAMpaikI kAhI ase Aheta kI je kAhI kharca karatAta tyAlA sajA samajatAta ANi tumhI ImAnadhArakAMsAThI vAITa divasAcyA pratikSeta asatAta. vAITa prasaMga tara tyAcyAvaraca yeNAra Ahe ANi allAha aikaNArA ANi jANaNArA Ahe.

ANi grAmINAMpaikI kAhI asehI Aheta, je allAhavara ANi kayAmatacyA divasAvara ImAna rAkhatAta ANi je kAhI kharca karatAta tyAlA allAhace sAnnidhya ANi paigaMbarAMcyA duA- prArthanece sAdhana mAnatAta. lakSAta ThevA kI tyAMce he kharca karaNe, nizcita tyAMcyAsAThI, allAhacI nikaTatA prApta karaNyAce sAdhana Ahe. tyAMnA allAha avazya ApalyA kRpA-chatrAta dAkhala karIla. allAha moThA mApha karaNArA, dayA karaNArA Ahe.

ANi he muhAjira (makkehUna madInA yethe Alele) ANi ansAra (madInA yethIla mULa rahivAzI) prathama Aheta ANi jevaDhe loka, kasalyAhI garajevinA tyAMce anuyAyI Aheta allAha tyA sarvAMzI rAjI jhAlA ANi te sarva allAhazI rAjI jhAle ANi allAhane tyAMcyAsAThI azA bAgAMcI vyavasthA karUna ThevalI Ahe jyAMcyAkhAlI pravAha vAhata Aheta, jyAta te sadaiva rAhatIla. hI phAra moThI saphalatA Ahe.

ANi kAhI tumacyA javaLapAsacyA grAmINAMpaikI ANi madInecyA vastIta ase DhoMgI ImAnadhAraka Aheta, je dAMbhikatevara aTaLa Aheta. tumhI tyAMnA nAhI jANata, tyAMnA AmhI jANato. AmhI tyAMnA duherI zikSA deU, maga te phAra moThyA zikSA- yAtanekaDe pAThavile jAtIla.

ANi kAhI dusare loka Aheta, je ApalyA cukA mAnya karatAta, jyAMnI mizra svarUpAcI karme kelIta. kAhI cAMgalI tara kAhI vAITa. allAhakaDUna AzA Ahe kI tyAMcI taubA (kSamA-yAcanA) kabUla karIla. niHsaMzaya, allAha moThA mApha karaNArA ANi dayA karaNArA Ahe.

tumhI tyAMcyA dhanAtUna sadakA (dAna) svIkAra karA, jyAdvAre tumhI tyAMnA svaccha- zuddha karAla ANi tyAMcyAsAThI duA- prArthanA karA, niHsaMzaya tumacI duA tyAMcyAsAThI samAdhAnAce sAdhana Ahe, ANi allAha cAMgalyA prakAre aikato, cAMgalyA prakAre jANato.
kAya tyAMnA he mAhIta nAhI kI allAhaca ApalyA dAsAMcI taubA (kSamA-yAcanA) kabUla karato ANi toca dAna kabUla karato ANi he kI allAhaca taubA kabUla karaNyAta ANi dayA karaNyAta paripUrNa Ahe.

ANi sAMgA kI tumhI karma karIta rAhA. tumace karma allAha svataH pAhIla ANi tyAcA paigaMbara ANi ImAna rAkhaNAre (hI pAhatIla) ANi nizcitaca tumhAlA azAjavaLa jAyace Ahe jo sarva lapalelyA va ughaDa goSTI jANaNArA Ahe. yAsAThI kI to tumhAlA tumhI kelele pratyeka karma dAkhavUna deIla.

ANi kAhI dusare loka Aheta, jyAMcA mAmalA allAhacA Adeza yeIparyaMta sthagita Ahe. eka tara to tyAMnA sajA deIla kiMvA tyAMcI kSamA-yAcanA kabUla karIla ANi allAha moThA jANaNArA, phAra hikamatazAlI Ahe.

ANi kAhI ase Aheta, jyAMnI yA hetUne masjida banavilI kI nukasAna pohacavAve ANi inkArapUrNa goSTI karAvyAta ANi ImAnadhArakAMmadhye phUTa pADAvI, ANi azA mANasAcyA rAhaNyAcI vyavasthA karAvI, jo yAcyA pUrvIpAsUna allAha ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAcA virodhaka Ahe, ANi zapatha ghetIla kI bhalAIkherIja AmacA koNatAhI hetu nAhI ANi allAha sAkSI Ahe kI te pUrNataH khoTe Aheta.

ApaNa tyA masjida kadhIhI ubhe na rAhAve, paraMtu jyA masjidIcA pAyA pahilyA divasApAsUnaca takavA (allAhace bhaya rAkhaNyA) vara ThevalA gelA asela, tara tI yAyogya Ahe kI tumhI ticyAta ubhe rAhAve. yAta ase loka Aheta kI te adhika svaccha-zuddha (pAka) hoNe cAMgale samajatAta, ANi sarvazreSTha allAha adhika pAka rAhaNAr2yAMnA priya rAkhato.

maga kAya asA manuSya adhika cAMgalA Ahe, jyAne ApalyA imAratIcA pAyA allAhace bhaya rAkhaNyAvara ANi allAhacI prasannatA prApta karaNyAvara ThevalA asela kiMvA to manuSya, jyAne ApalyA gharAcA pAyA ekhAdyA utAra asalelyA darIcyA (ghATAcyA) kinAr2yAvara, jI kosaLaNyAcyA betAta asAvI, tyAvara racalA asela; maga to tyAsaha jahannamacyA AgIta jAUna paDAvA ANi sarvazreSTha allAha azA atyAcArIMnA mArga dAkhavita nAhI.

tyAMce he ghara, je tyAMnI banavile Ahe, nehamI tyAMcyA manAlA saMzayAmuLe (kATyAsarakhe) bocata rAhIla. paraMtu he kI tyAMcI hRdayeca kSata-vikSata vhAvIta, ANi allAha jJAna bALagaNArA ANi hikamatazAlI Ahe.

niHsaMzaya, allAhane ImAnadhArakAMkaDUna tyAMcyA prANAMnA va dhanAMnA jannatacyA mobadalyAta kharedI kele Ahe. te allAhacyA mArgAta laDhatAta jyAta te ThAra karatAta ANi ThAra kele jAtAta, yAbAbata saccA vAyadA Ahe taurAta, iMjIla ANi kuraAnAmadhye ANi allAhapekSA jAsta ApalyA vAyadyAce pAlana koNa karU zakato? yAstava tumhI ApalyA yA vikaNyAvara, jo (saudA) tumhI karUna ghetalAta, AnaMdita vhA ANi hI phAra moThI saphalatA Ahe.

he ase loka hote, je taubA (kSamA-yAcanA) karaNAre, allAhacI upAsanA karaNAre, tyAcI stutI-prazaMsA karaNAre, rojA (upavAsa-vrata) rAkhaNAre (kiMvA satya mArgAvara cAlaNAre) rukUa (jhukaNAre) sajadA karaNAre (mAthA TekaNAre), cAMgalyA goSTIMcA upadeza karaNAre, ANi vAITa goSTIMpAsUna rokhaNAre ANi allAhacyA niyamAMnA dhyAnAta rAkhaNAre Aheta ANi azA ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMnA zubha samAcAra dyA.
paigaMbara ANi itara ImAnadhArakAMnA anumatI nAhI kI anekezvaravAdyAMkaritA mAphIcI duA- prArthanA karAvI, maga te nAtevAIka kA asenAta. hA Adeza spaSTa jhAlyAnaMtara kI te loka narakAta jAtIla.

ANi ibrAhImace ApalyA pityAkaritA mAphIcI duA-prArthanA karaNe he kevaLa tyA vacanAcyA sababIvara hote, je tyAMnI ApalyA pityAsa dile hote, maga jevhA tyAMnA hI goSTa spaSTataH kaLAlI kI to (pitA) allAhacA zatrU Ahe, tevhA te tyAcyApAsUna dUra jhAle. vAstavika ibrAhIma moThe komalahRdayI sahanazIla hote.

ANi allAha ase nAhI karata kI ekhAdyA janasamUhAlA mArgadarzana kelyAnaMtara mArgabhraSTa karIla, joparyaMta tyA goSTI spaSTataH sAMgUna TAkata nAhI jyAMcyApAsUna tyAMnI alipta rAhAve. niHsaMzaya allAha pratyeka goSTa cAMgalyA prakAre jANato.
niHsaMzaya, AkAzAmadhye va dharatIta allAhacIca rAjya-sattA Ahe. toca jiMvata Thevato ANi mRtyu deto ANi tumacA allAhakherIja koNIhI mitra nAhI ANi nA koNI madata karaNArA.

sarvazreSTha allAhane paigaMbarAMcyA sthitIvara dayA-dRSTI kelI ANi dezatyAga karUna AlelyAMvara ANi tyAMnA madata karaNAr2yA ansAra lokAMcyA sthitIvarahI, jyAMnI azA aDacaNIcyA veLI paigaMbarAMnA sAtha dilI, tyAnaMtara kI tyAMcyAtalyA ekA gaTAcI mane DaLamaLU lAgalI hotI. maga allAhane tyAMcyA avasthevara dayA kelI. niHsaMzaya, allAha tyA sarvAMvara atizaya meharabAna ANi dayA karaNArA Ahe.

ANi tIna mANasAMcyA avasthevarahI, jyAMcA mAmalA sthagita kelA gelA hotA yethaparyaMta kI jevhA jamIna ApalyA (vizAla) vistArAnaMtarahI tyAMcyAsAThI saMkucita (taMga) hoU lAgalI ANi te svataH ApalyA astitvAzI hairANa jhAle ANi tyAMnI samajUna ghetale kI allAhapAsUna koThehI Azraya lAbhU zakata nAhI, yAkherIja kI tyAMcyAkaDe vaLale jAve. maga tyAMcyA avasthevara dayA kelI. yAsAThI kI tyAMnI bhaviSyAtahI kSamA-yAcanA karAvI. niHsaMzaya sarvazreSTha allAha taubA (kSamA-yAcanA) kabUla karaNArA ANi atizaya dayA karaNArA Ahe.
he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! sarvazreSTha allAhace bhaya bALagA ANi khar2yA lokAMsobata rAhA.

madInA ANi tyAcyA javaLapAsacyA gAvAta rAhaNAr2yAMkaritA yogya navhate kI allAhacyA paigaMbarAMcI sAtha soDUna mAge rAhAve ANi na he kI ApalyA prANAlA, tyAMcyA prANApekSA adhika priya ApalyA prANAlA, tyAMcyA prANApekSA adhika priya jANAve. he azAmuLe kI tyAMnA allAhacyA mArgAta jI tahAna lAgalI ANi jo thakavA pohocalA ANi jI bhUka lAgalI ANi je cAlata gele, je kAphirAMkaritA krodhAcI sababa banalI asAvI ANi zatrUMcA jo kAhI samAcAra ghetalA, tyA sarvAMbaddala tyAMcyA nAve (eka eka) satkarma karaNAr2yAMcA mobadalA vAyA jAU deta nAhI.

ANi jo kAhI lahAna moThA kharca tyAMnI kelA ANi jevaDhI maidAne tyAMnA pAra karAvI lAgalI, he sarvadekhIla tyAMcyA nAve lihile gele yAsAThI kI sarvazreSTha allAhane tyAMcyA kAmAMcA cAMgalyAta cAMgalA mobadalA pradAna karAvA.

ANi ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMnI sarvacyA sarva miLUna nighU naye. tevhA ase kA na kele jAve kI tyAMcyA pratyeka moThyA gaTAmadhU lahAna gaTa nighAvA yAsAThI kI tyAMnI dIna (dharmA) cI samaja prApta karUna ghyAvI ANi yAsAThI kI tyAMnI ApalyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMnA, jevhA te yAMcyAjavaLa yetIla (allAhace) bhaya dAkhavAve, yAsAThI kI tyAMnI bhyAve.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! tyA kAphirAMzI (inkArI lokAMzI) laDhA je tumacyA bhovatI Aheta ANi tyAMnA tumacyA aMgI kaThoratA ADhaLalI pAhije. ANi hA vizvAsa rAkhA kI sarvazreSTha allAha takavA (dhairya-saMyama) rAkhaNAr2yAMcyA sobata Ahe.

ANi jevhA ekhAdI sUraha (adhyAya) avatarita kelI jAte, tevhA kAhI DhoMgI ImAnadhAraka mhaNatAta kI yA sUrahane tumacyApaikI koNAce ImAna vADhavile Ahe? tevhA je (sacce) ImAnadhAraka Aheta, yA sUrahane tyAMcyA ImAnAta vRddhI kelI Ahe ANi te AnaMdita hota Aheta.
ANi jyAMcyA manAta roga (vikRtI) Ahe, yA sUrahane tyAMcyAta tyAMcyA galicchatesaha ANakhI galicchatA vADhavUna dilI Ahe ANi te kupra (inkAra karaNyA) cyA sthitItaca maraNa pAvale.
ANi kAya tyAMnI pAhile nAhI kI he loka daravarSI ekadA kiMvA donadA koNatyA na koNatyA saMkaTAta TAkale jAtAta, tarIhI te nA taubA (kSamA-yAcanA) karatAta, nA bodha prApta karatAta.

ANi jevhA ekhAdI sUraha (adhyAya) avatarita kelI jAte tevhA ekamekAMnA pAhU lAgatAta kI tumhAlA koNI pAhata tara nAhI, maga cAlU lAgatAta. allAhane yAMce mana phiravile Ahe yA kAraNAne kI te samajUna na gheNAre loka Aheta.

tumacyAjavaLa ekA azA paigaMbarAce Agamana jhAle Ahe, je tumacyApaikIca Aheta, jyAMnA tumacyA hAnIviSayaka goSTI khUpa klezadAyaka vATatAta je tumacyA lAbhAce moThe icchuka asatAta. ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAsAThI atizaya snehazIla va meharabAna Aheta.

maga jara te (loka) toMDa phiravatIla tara tumhI tyAMnA sAMgA kI mAjhyAsAThI allAha puresA Ahe, tyAcyAkherIja koNIhI saccA mAbUda (upAsya) nAhI. mI tyAcyAvaraca bharosA kelA ANi to phAra moThyA arza (siMhAsanA) cA mAlaka (svAmI) Ahe.
alipha. lAma.raॉ yA hikamata ANi buddhimattApUrNa graMthAcyA AyatI Aheta.

kAya tyA lokAMnA yA goSTIce Azcarya vATale kI AmhI tyAMcyAtalyA ekA mANasAjavaLa vahayI (avatarita saMdeza) pAThavilI kI samasta mAnavAMnA (allAhace) bhaya dAkhavAve ANi je ImAna rAkhatIla tyAMnA hI khUzakhabara dyA kI tyAMcyA pAlanakartyAjavaLa tyAMnA purepUra mobadalA ANi mAna-sanmAna lAbhela. inkArI loka mhaNAle kI hA mANUsa khAtrIne spaSTa jAdUgAra (tAMtrika) Ahe.

niHsaMzaya, tumacA pAlanakartA allAhaca Ahe, jyAne sahA divasAMta AkAzAMnA va jaminIlA nirmANa kele, maga arza (siMhAsanA) vara sthira (kAyama) jhAlA. to pratyeka kAmAcI vyavasthA rAkhato. tyAcyA anumatIvinA tyAcyAjavaLa koNI ziphArasa karaNArA nAhI. asA allAha tumacA raba (pAlanakartA) Ahe. tevhA tumhI tyAcIca upAsanA karA. maga kAya tarIhI tumhI bodha prApta karIta nAhI?

tumhA sarvAMnA allAhacyAca javaLa jAyace Ahe. allAhane saccA vAyadA kelelA Ahe. niHsaMzaya toca pahilyAMdA nirmANa karato, maga toca dusar2yAMdA nirmANa karIla, yAsAThI kI azA lokAMnA, jyAMnI ImAna rAkhale ANi satkarme kelIta, tyAMnA nyAyapUrvaka mobadalA dyAvA ANi jyAMnI inkAra kelA, tyAMnA piNyAsAThI ukaLate pANI miLela ANi duHkhadAyaka zikSA-yAtanA lAbhela tyAMcyA inkAra karaNyApAyI.

to (allAha) asA Ahe, jyAne sUryAlA tejasvI banavile ANi caMdrAlA prakAzamAna banavile ANi tyAcyAsAThI sthAna (gaMtavya) nirdhArIta kele, yAsAThI kI tumhI varSAMcI gaNanA va hizoba lAvU zakAve va hizobAlA jANUna ghyAve. allAhane yA sarva vastU vyartha nirmANa kelyA nAhIta, to hA purAvA tyAMnA spaSTa sAMgata Ahe je akkala rAkhatAta.
niHsaMzaya rAtra ANi divasAcyA ekA pAThopATha yeNyAta, ANi allAhane AkAzAta va dharatIta je kAhI nirmANa kele Ahe, tyA sarvAMta azA lokAMkaritA purAvA (pramANa) Ahe je allAhace bhaya bALagatAta.
jyA lokAMnA AmacyAjavaLa yeNyAvara vizvAsa nAhI ANi te aihika jIvanAvara rAjI jhAle Aheta ANi tyAtaca jIva guMtavUna basale Aheta ANi je AmacyA AyatIMpAsUna gAphIla Aheta.
azA lokAMce ThikANa tyAMcyA karmAMmuLe naraka (jahannama) Ahe.

niHsaMzaya, jyA lokAMnI ImAna rAkhale ANi tyAMnI satkarme kelIta, tara tyAMcA pAlanakartA te ImAnadhAraka asaNyAcyA sababIvara tyAMnA (tyAMcyA dhyeya uddiSTAprata) pohacavila, sukhAcyA azA bAgAMmadhye, jyAMcyA khAlI pravAha vAhata asatIla.

tithe tyAMcyA toMDUna ud‌gAra nighela subahAnallAha (allAha pavitra Ahe) ANi tyAMce ekamekAMzI abhivAdana asela assalAmu alaikuma (salAmatI aso tumacyAvara) ANi zevaTI te he mhaNatIla kI samasta stutI prazaMsA allAhakaritAca Ahe, jo samasta vizvAMcA pAlanakartA Ahe.

ANi jara allAhane lokAMnA tvarita hAnI pohacavilI asatI, jase loka tvarita lAbha icchitAta, tevhA tyAMcyA vAyadA kevhAca pUrNa jhAlA asatA yAstava AmhI tyA lokAMnA tyAMcyA dazevara soDato, jyAMnA AmacyAjavaLa gheNyAvara vizvAsa nAhI, yAsAThI kI tyAMnI ApalyA vidrohAta bhaTakata rAhAve.

ANi jevhA mANasAlA ekhAdI duHkha-yAtanA pohocate, tevhA AmhAlA pukArato, pahuDalelyA sthitItahI, basalelyA sthitItahI, ubhA asatAnAhI. maga jevhA AmhI tyAcI duHkha-yAtanA dUra karato, tevhA to asA hoto kI jaNU tyAne ApalyAlA pohocalelyA duHkha-yAtanekaritA AmhAlA kadhI pukAraleca navhate1 yA maryAdA olAMDaNAr2yAMcI karme tyAcyAkaritA tyAcapramANe manapasaMta banavilI gelI Aheta.

ANi AmhI tumacyApUrvI kityeka azA janasamUhAMcA sarvanAza kelA jevhA tyAMnI atyAcAra kelA, vAstavika tyAMcyAjavaLa tyAMce paigaMbarahI nizANyA gheUna Ale hote ANi te kevhA ase hote kI ImAna rAkhale asate? aparAdhI lokAMnA AmhI azAca prakAre daMDa deto.
maga tyAMcyAnaMtara AmhI yA jagAta tyAMcyAjAgI tumhAlA AbAda kele yAsAThI kI AmhI he baghAve kI tumhI kazA prakAracI kAme karatAta.

ANi jevhA tyAMcyAsamora AmacyA AyatI vAcalyA jAtAta, jyA agadI spaSTa Aheta, tevhA he loka, jyAMnA AmacyAjavaLa yeNyAvara vizvAsa nAhI, ase mhaNatAta kI yAcyAkherIja dusarA kuraAna ANi kiMvA yAta kAhI pherabadala karUna TAkA. tumhI (sa.) tyAMnA sAMgA kI malA yAcA adhikAra nAhI kI ApalyAtarphe tyAta kAhI badala karAvA. mI tara tyAceca anusaraNa karena je mAjhyAjavaLa vahayIdvAre Ale Ahe. jara mI ApalyA pAlanakartyAcI avajJA karena tara mI ekA moThyA divasAcyA zikSA-yAtanece bhaya rAkhato.

tumhI sAMgA kI jara allAhane icchile asate, tara nA mI tumhAlA te vAcUna aikavile asate ANi nA allAhane tumhAlA tyAcI khabara dilI asatI, kAraNa yApUrvI tara mI AyuSyAcyA dIrgha avadhIparyaMta tumacyAta rAhilo Ahe. maga kAya tumhI samaja bALagata nAhI?
tevhA, tyAhUna jAsta atyAcArI koNa asela jo allAhaviSayI khoTe racela kiMvA tyAcyA AyatIMnA khoTe mhaNela. niHsaMzaya ase aparAdhI loka kadhIhI saphala hoNAra nAhIta.

ANi he loka allAhalA soDUna azA vastUMcI upAsanA karatAta, je nA tyAMnA hAnI pohacavU zakatIla ANi nA tyAMnA lAbha pohacavU zakatIla ANi mhaNatAta kI he allAhacyA samora AmacI ziphArasa karaNAre Aheta. tumhI sAMgA, kAya tumhI allAhalA azA goSTIMcI khabara detA, jyA to jANata nAhI AkAzamadhye va dharatIta. to pavitra ANi zreSTha Ahe tyA lokAMcyA zirka (sahabhAgI karaNyA) pAsUna.

ANi samasta loka ekAca ummata (dharmasamudAyA) ce hote, maga tyAMnI matabheda nirmANa kele ANi jara eka goSTa nasatI jI tumacyA pAlanakartyAtarphe nirdhArIta kelI gelI Ahe tara jyA goSTIta he loka matabheda karIta Aheta tyAMcA pUrNapaNe nikAla lAvalA gelA asatA.

ANi he loka ase mhaNatAta kI tyAMcyAvara allAhacA ekhAdA camatkAra (mojijA) kA nAhI avatarita jhAlA? (tevhA tumhI) sAMgA kI aparokSAce (gaibace) jJAna kevaLa allAhalA Ahe, tevhA tumhIhI pratikSA karA, mIdekhIla tumacyAsobata pratikSeta Ahe.

ANi jevhA AmhI lokAMnA duHkha pohacalyAnaMtara sukhAcA svAda cAkhavato tevhA te tvarita AmacyA AyatIMviSayI cAlabAjI karU lAgatAta. tumhI sAMgA kI allAha yojanA AkhaNyAta tumacyApekSA adhika capaLa Ahe. niHsaMzaya, Amace pharizte tumacI kapaTa kArasthAne lihita Aheta.

to (allAha) asA Ahe, jo tumhAlA samudrAta ANi khuSkIta pravAsAce sAmarthya deto, yethaparyaMta kI jevhA tumhI nauketa asatA ANi tyA nAvA, lokAMnA anukUla vAr2yAdvAre neta asatAta, ANi te loka tyAMcyApAsUna AnaMdita hotAta. tyAMcyAvara vAdaLI vAr2yAcA jhokA yeto ANi sarva bAjUMnI lATA uThatAta ANi te samajatAta kI (vAITarityA) yeUna gherale gelo (tyA veLI) sarvaca, sacoTIcyA ImAna ANi zraddhesaha allAhalAca pukAratAta kI jara tU yA (saMkaTA) pAsUna vAcavazIla tara AmhI avazya (tujhe) kRtajJazIla banU.

maga jevhA savazreSTha allAha tyAMnA vAcavato tevhA tvarita te dharatIta nAhaka utpAta (phasAda) mAjavU lAgatAta. he lokAMno! tumacA hA vidroha tumacyAsAThI duHkhadAyaka TharaNAra Ahe, aihika jIvanAce kAhI lAbha Aheta, maga (naMtara) tumhAlA AmacyAkaDe yAyace Ahe. tevhA AmhI tumhAlA tumacyA sarva harakatI dAkhavU.

aihika jIvanAcI sthitI azI Ahe, jaNU AkAzAtUna AmhI pAUsa pADalA, maga tyAdvaAre jaminIcI vanaspatI (jhADe-jhuDape) jyAMnA mAnava ANi jAnavare khAtAta, khUpa hiravI TavaTavIta hoUna nighAlI, yethaparyaMta kI jevhA tyA jaminIne ApalyA zobhA- sajAvaTIcA pUrNa hissA ghetalA ANi tI khUpa suMdara jhAlI ANi ticyA mAlakAMnA vATale kI AtA AmhI hicyAvara pUrNapaNe hakkadAra jhAlo tevhA divasA kiMvA rAtrI, ticyAvara AmacyAtarphe ekhAdA (ApattIcA) Adeza AlA, tara AmhI tilA ase sApha karUna TAkale kI jaNU kAla (paravA) yethe navhatIca. azA prakAre AmhI nizANyAMnA savistarapaNe sAMgato tyA lokAMsAThI te vicAra ciMtana karatAta.
ANi sarvazreSTha allAha, tumhAlA salAmatIcyA gharAkaDe bolAvito ANi jyAlA icchito, saraLa mArga dAkhavito.
jyA lokAMnI satkarma kele Ahe, tyAMcyAsAThI bhalAI Ahe ANi kAhI jAstahI ANi tyAMcyA mukhAvara kALokhI nasela ANi nA apamAna he loka jannatamadhye rAhaNAre Aheta. te nehamI tyAta rAhatIla.

ANi jyA lokAMnI vAITa karma kele, tyAMnA tyAMcyA duSkarmAMcI zikSA samAna miLela ANi tyAMcyAvara apamAna AcchAdita hoIla, tyAMnA allAhapAsUna koNIhI vAcavU zakaNAra nAhI, tyAMcyA toMDAvara jaNU kAhI aMdhAr2yA rAtrIce thara guMDALale gele asatIla. he loka narakAta rAhaNAre Aheta, te sadaiva tethe rAhatIla.

ANi to divasadekhIla AThavaNa karaNyAyogya Ahe, jyA divazI AmhI tyA sarvAMnA ekatra karU; maga aneka IzvarAMcI bhaktI- ArAdhanA karaNAr2yAMnA sAMgU kI tumhI ANi tumace sahabhAgI Izvara ApalyA jAgI thAMbA, maga AmhI tyAMcyAta ApasAta phUTa pADU ANi tyAMce te sahabhAgI mhaNatIla kI tumhI AmacI upAsanA (pUjA) karIta navhatA.
tevhA AmacyA ANi tumacyA daramyAna allAha puresA Ahe, sAkSIcyA svarUpAta kI AmhAlA tumacyA upAsanecI khabaradekhIla navhate.

tyA ThikANI, pratyeka manuSya ApaNa pUrvI kelelyA karmAMcI jAca-paDatALa karela ANi he loka allAhakaDe, jo tyAMcA kharAkhurA svAmI Ahe, paratavile jAtIla ANi jI asatya (ArAdhya daivate) tyAMnI banavilI hotI tI sarva tyAMcyApAsUna gAyaba hotIla.

tumhI sAMgA kI to koNa Ahe, jo tumhAlA AkAza va jaminItUna rojI (annasAmugrI) pohacavito kiMvA to koNa Ahe jo kAnAMvara ANi DoLyAMvara pUrNa adhikAra rAkhato ANi to koNa Ahe jo nirjIvAtUna sajIva bAhera kADhato, ANi nirjIvAlA sajIvAtUna bAhera kADhato ANi to koNa Ahe jo samasta kAryAMce vyavasthApana rAkhato. niHsaMzaya te heca mhaNatIla kI allAha! tevhA tyAMnA sAMgA kI, maga tumhI bhaya kA rAkhata nAhI?
tara hA Ahe allAha, jo tumacA saccA svAmI va pAlanakartA Ahe, maga satyAnaMtara ANakhI kAya bAkI rAhile bhaTakaNyAzivAya, maga koThe bhaTakata jAta AhAta?
azAca prakAre tumacyA pAlanakartyAce he pharmAna kI he ImAna rAkhaNAra nAhIta, sarva durAcArI lokAMbAbata siddha Tharale Ahe.

tumhI (azA prakAre) sAMgA kI, kAya tumacyA sahabhAgI IzvarAMpaikI koNI asA Ahe jo pahilyAMdAhI nirmANa karIla, maga dusar2yAMdA nirmANa karIla tumhI sAMgA, allAhaca pahilyA khepesa nirmANa karato, maga toca dusar2yA khepesahI nirmANa karIla, maga tumhI ulaTapAvalI koThe jAta AhAta?

tumhI sAMgA, kI tumacyA tyA sahabhAgI IzvarAMmadhye koNI asA Ahe jo satya mArga dAkhavita asela? tumhI sAMgA kI allAhaca satyAcA mArga dAkhavito, tevhA maga je sAmarthya satyAcA mArga dAkhavita asela te jAsta anusaraNa karaNyAsa pAtra Ahe kI to manuSya, jyAlA sAMgitalyAvinA svataHca mArga disUna na yAvA, tevhA tumhAlA jhAle tarI kAya, tumhI kazA prakAre nirNaya ghetA?

ANi tyAMcyApaikI bahuteka loka nirAdhAra vicArAMcyA mAge cAlata Aheta. niHsaMzaya, anumAna aTakaLI, satya (oLakhaNyA) saMdarbhAta kAhIca upayogI paDU zakata nAhI. he loka je kAhI karIta Aheta, nizcitaca allAha te sarva kAhI jANato.

ANi hA kuraAna asA nAhI kI allAha (cyA vahayI) zivAya (svataHca) racUna ghetalA gelA asela. kiMbahunA hA tara (tyA graMthAMcyA) satyatece samarthana karaNArA Ahe, je yApUrvI avatarita kele gele Aheta. ANi graMthA (Avazyaka AdezAM) ce savistara varNana Ahe. yAta muLIca zaMkA nAhI kI (hA graMtha) samasta vizvAMcyA pAlanakartyAtarphe Ahe.

kAya he loka ase mhaNatAta kI tumhI yA graMthAlA (ApalyA manAne) racale Ahe? tumhI sAMgA, tara maga tumhI yAsArakhI eka tarI sUraha (adhyAya) banavUna ANA, ANi allAhakherIja jyAMnA jyAMnA bolAvU zakAla tyAMnA bolAvUna ghyA jara tumhI sacce asAla.

kiMbahunA te azA goSTIlA khoTe TharavU lAgale, jilA tyAMnI ApalyA jJAna-kakSeta ANale nAhI ANi ajUna tyAMnA yAcA aMtima pariNAma lAbhalA nAhI. je loka yAMcyApUrvI hoUna geleta, tyAMnIhI aseca khoTe Tharavile hote, tara pAhA tyA atyAcArIMcA zevaTa kasA jhAlA?
ANi tyAMcyApaikI kAhI ase Aheta, je yAvara ImAna rAkhatIla, ANi kAhI ase Aheta kI tyAvara ImAna rAkhaNAra nAhIta, ANi tumacA pAlanakartA upadravI lokAMnA cAMgalyA prakAre jANato.

ANi jara te tumhAlA khoTe Tharavita rAhile tara tyAMnA he sAMgA kI mI kelele malA lAbhela ANi tumhI kelele tumhAlA lAbhela. tumhI mI kelelyA (karmAM) sAThI jabAbadAra nAhIta ANi mI, tumhI kelelyA (karmAM) sAThI jabAbadAra nAhI.
ANi tyAMcyAta kAhI ase Aheta, je tumacyAkaDe kAna lAvUna aikatAta, kAya tumhI bahir2yA lokAMnA aikavatA, tyAMnA akkala nasalI tarIhI?
ANi tyAMcyAta kAhI ase Aheta kI tumhAlA pAhAta Aheta. maga kAya tumhI AMdhaLyAMnA mArga dAkhavU icchitA, te DoLe rAkhata nasale tarIhI?
niHsaMzaya, allAha lokAMvara kiMcitahI atyAcAra karIta nAhI, paraMtu loka svataHca ApalyAvara atyAcAra karatAta.

ANi tyAMnA tyA divasAcI AThavaNa karUna dyA, jyA divazI allAha tyAMnA (ApalyA samora) azA sthitIta ekatra karIla kI (tyAMnA vATela) kI (jagAta) divasAcA eka ardhA kSaNa rAhile asAveta ANi ApasAta ekamekAMnA oLakhaNyAsAThI ubhe asatIla. vAstavika hAnIgrasta jhAle te loka, jyAMnI allAhajavaLa jANyAlA khoTe Tharavile ANi te mArgadarzana prApta karaNAre navhate.

ANi AmhI jyA goSTIcA tyAMcyAzI vAyadA karIta Ahota, ticA kAhI bhAga tumhAlA dAkhavUna dyAvA kiMvA (to jAhIra hoNyApUrvI) AmhI tumhAlA mRtyu dyAvA, tevhA tyAMnA AmacyAjavaLa tara yAyaceca Ahe, maga allAha sAkSI Ahe yAMcyA sarva kAmAMvara.
ANi pratyeka samudAyA (ummata) sAThI eka rasUla (sandeSTA) Ahe. maga jevhA tyAMcA paigaMbara yeUna pohacato tevhA tyAMcA nirNaya nyAyapUrvaka kelA jAto ANi tyAMcyAvara julUma kelA jAta nAhI.
ANi he loka mhaNatAta, hA kAyadA kevhA pUrNa hoIla jara tumhI sacce asAla?

tumhI sAMgA, mI svataH ApalyAkaritA tara kasalyAhI lAbha ANi hAnIcA adhikAra rAkhata nAhI, paraMtu tevaDhAca jazI allAhacI marjI asela, pratyeka samudAyA (ummata) karitA eka TharalelI veLa Ahe, jevhA tyAMcyA to nirdhArIta samaya yeUna pohocato tevhA nA eka kSaNa mAge sarakU zakatAta ANi nA puDhe jAU zakatAta.
tumhI sAMgA kI he tara sAMgA kI jara tumacyAvara allAhacA az2Aba (prakopa) rAtrI yeUna kosaLela kiMvA divasA, tevhA zikSA yAtaneta azI koNatI goSTa Ahe kI aparAdhI loka tI lavakara mAgata Aheta.
maga kAya to (az2Aba) yeUna kosaLalyAvaraca ImAna rAkhAla, AtA (ImAna) svIkArale, vAstavika tumhI tyAcI (az2Aba) cI ghAI mAjavita hote.
maga atyAcArI lokAMnA pharmAvile jAIla AtA niraMtara prakopAcI goDI cAkhA, tumhAlA tara tumhI kelelyA karmAMcAca mobadalA lAbhalA Ahe.
ANi te tumhAlA vicAratAta kI kAya to (az2Aba) kharI goSTa Ahe? tumhI sAMgA, mAjhyA pAlanakartyAcI zapatha, tI agadI kharI goSTa Ahe ANi tumhI allAhalA kazAhI prakAre vivaza karU zakata nAhI.

ANi jara pratyeka jIva, jyAne atyAcAra (zirka) kelA Ahe, tyAcyAjavaLa evaDhe asAve kI saMpUrNa jamIna bharUna jAvI, tarIhI te deUna ApalA prANa vAcavU lAgela ANi tevhA az2Aba pAhUna ghetIla, tevhA lajjA lapavUna ThevatIla ANi tyAMcA phaisalA nyAyapUrvaka hoIla ANi tyAMcyAvara atyAcAra kelA jANAra nAhI.
lakSAta ThevA, jevaDhyA vastU AkAzAMmadhye va jaminIta Ahe, tyA sarva allAhacyAca Aheta. lakSAta ThevA, allAhacA vAyadA agadI saccA Ahe, paraMtu adhikAMza loka he jANata nAhIta.
toca jIva TAkato ANi toca jIva bAhera kADhato ANi tumhI sarva tyAcyAcakaDe ANale jAla.

he lokAMno! tumacyAjavaLa tumacyA pAlanakartyAtarphe eka azI goSTa AlI Ahe, jI bodha- upadeza Ahe ANi hRdayAta je (vikAra) Aheta, tyAMcyAkaritA rogamuktI Ahe ANi mArgadarzana karaNArI Ahe ANi (allAhacI) dayA- kRpA Ahe ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMsAThI.
tumhI sAMgA kI lokAMnI allAhacyA dayA- kRpevara AnaMdita jhAle pAhije te tara tyAhUna kityeka paTIMnI adhika cAMgale Ahe, je he jamA karIta Aheta.

tumhI sAMgA, jarA he sAMgA kI allAhane tumacyAsAThI jI rojI (annasAmugrI) pAThavilI hotI, maga tumhI ticyAtalA kAhI hissA harAma ANi kAhI hallA karUna ghetalA. tumhI tyAMnA vicArA kI kAya tumhAlA allAhane tasA Adeza dilA hotA kiMvA allAhabAbata ugAca khoTe racUna ghetA?

ANi je loka allAhacyA saMbaMdhAne khoTe racatAta, tyAMcA kayAmataviSayI kAya vicAra Ahe? vAstavika lokAMvara, sarvazreSTha allAhacA phAra moThA upakAra Ahe. paraMtu adhikAMza loka kRtajJatA vyakta karIta nAhI.

ANi tumhI koNatyAhI sthitIta asA ANi yA sthitIMmadhye tumhI koThUnahI kuraAna paThaNa karA ANi tumhI loka je kAmadekhIla karatA AmhAlA sarvAMcIca khabara asate. jevhA tumhI tyA kAmAta vyasta asatA ANi tumacyA pAlanakartyApAsUna tiLamAtra vastU lapalelI nAhI, nA dharatIta, nA AkAzAta ANi nA ekhAdI vastU tyAhUna lahAna ANi nA ekhAdI moThI, tathApi he sarva khulyA- spaSTa graMthAta Ahe.
lakSAta ThevA, allAhacyA mitrAMnA nA kasale bhaya Ahe, nA te duHkhI hotIla.
he ase loka Aheta, ImAna rAkhatAta ANi (durAcArApAsUna) takavA (allAhace bhaya) bALagatAta.
tyAMcyAkaritA yA jagAcyA jIvanAtahI ANi AkhiratamadhyehI khUzakhabara Ahe. sarvazreSTha allAhacyA pharmAnAta kAhIca badala hota nasato. hI phAra moThI saphalatA Ahe.
ANi tumhI tyAMcyA bolaNyAne duHkhI-kaSTI hoU nakA. paripUrNa varcasva allAhakaritAca Ahe. to aikaNArA, jANaNArA Ahe.

lakSAta ThevA, je kAhI AkAzAMmadhye Ahe ANi je kAhI dharatIta Ahe te sarva allAhaceca Ahe, ANi je loka allAhalA soDUna itara sahabhAgIMnA pukAratAta, te koNatyA goSTIce anusaraNa karIta Aheta. kevaLa kAlpanika vicArAMceca anusaraNa karIta Aheta ANi phakta aTakaLIcyAca goSTI karIta Aheta.

to (allAha) asA Ahe, jyAne tumacyAsAThI rAtra banavilI, yAsAThI kI tumhI rAtrI ArAma karAvA ANi divasahI azA prakAre banavilA kI to pAhaNyAce sAdhana Ahe. niHsaMzaya yAta nizANyA Aheta, tyA lokAMkaritA je aikatAta.

te mhaNatAta kI allAha saMtatI bALagato, to yA goSTIpAsUna pavitra Ahe. to tara koNAcAhI garajavaMta nAhI je kAhI AkAzAMmadhye Ahe ANi je kAhI dharatIta Ahe sarva tyAceca Ahe. tumacyAjavaLa (tumacyA kathanAcA) koNatAhI purAvA nAhI. kAya allAhazI azA goSTIcA saMbaMdha joDatA jice tumhI jJAna bALagata nAhI.
tumhI sAMgA kI je loka allAhaviSayI khoTe racatAta, te saphala hoNAra nAhIta.
(he) yA jagAta thoDese sukha Ahe, maga tyAMnA AmacyAkaDe yAyace Ahe. maga AmhI tyAMnA tyAMcyA kupra (avizvAsA) cyA mobadalyAta sakta sajA cAkhavU.

ANi tumhI tyAMnA nUhacA vRttAnta vAcUna aikavA, jevhA te ApalyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMnA mhaNAle, he mAjhyA jAtIbAMdhavAMno! jara tumhAlA mAjhe rAhaNe ANi allAhacyA AdezAMcI zikavaNa deNe jaDa jAte (asahya hote) tevhA mAjhA tara allAhavaraca bharosA Ahe. tumhI ApalI yojanA ApalyA sAthIdArAMzI miLUna majabUta karUna ghyA, mAtra tumacI yojanA, tumacyAsAThI mana gudamaraNyAce kAraNa TharU naye. maga mAjhe (kAya karAyace te) karUna TAkA ANi malA saMdhIhI deU nakA.

tarIhI jara tumhI toMDa phiravita rAhAla tara mI tumacyAkaDUna kAhI mobadalA tara mAgitalA nAhI, mAjhA mobadalA tara phakta allAhaca deIla ANi malA Adeza dilA gelA Ahe kI mI islAma svIkAraNAr2yAMpaikI rAhAve.

tara te loka tyAMnA khoTe Tharavita rAhile, maga AmhI tyAMnA, ANi je tyAMcyAsobata nauketa svAra hote, tyA sarvAMnA suTakA pradAna kelI ANi tyAMnA vArasa banavile ANi jyAMnI AmacyA AyatIMnA khoTe Tharavile hote tyAMnA buDavUna TAkale, tevhA vicAra kelyA pAhije kI kasA zevaTa jhAlA tyA lokAMcA, jyAMnA pahilyApAsUna bhaya dAkhavile gele hote.

maga nUhanaMtara AmhI dusar2yA paigaMbarAMnA tyAMcyA janasamUhAkaDe pAThavile tevhA te tyAMcyAjavaLa spaSTa pramANa gheUna Ale, paraMtu jyA goSTIlA tyAMnI pahilyA khepesa khoTe Tharavile, naMtara ticyAvara ImAna rAkhale asate ase jhAle nAhI. azA prakAre AmhI maryAdA pAra karaNAr2yAMcyA hRdayAMva mohara lAvato.
maga AmhI tyA (paigaMbarAM) cyA naMtara mUsA ANi hArunalA phiraauna va tyAcyA saradArAMkaDe camatkAra gheUna pAThavile, tevhA tyA lokAMnI ghameMDa dAkhavilI ANi te aparAdhI janasamUhAce loka hote.
maga jevhA tyAMcyAjavaLa AmacyAkaDUna satya (pramANa) pohocale tevhA te loka mhaNU lAgale kI niHsaMzaya, hI tara ughaDa jAdU Ahe.
mUsA mhaNAle, kAya tumhI yA satyAviSayI, jevhA te tumacyAjavaLa yeUna pohocale Ahe, azA goSTI bolatA? kAya hI jAdU Ahe, vastutaH jAdUgAra saphala hota nAhI?

te loka mhaNAle, kAya tumhI AmacyAjavaLa azAsAThI AlA AhAta kI AmhAlA tyA mArgApAsUna haTavUna dyAve, jyA mArgAvara AmhI ApalyA pUrvajAMnA pAhile Ahe, ANi tumhA doghAMnA jagAta moThepaNA miLAvA ANi AmhI tara tumhA doghAMnA kadhIhI mAAnaNAra nAhI.
ANi phiraauna mhaNAlA, mAjhyAjavaLa samasta niSNAta jAdUgArAMnA gheUna yA.
maga jevhA jAdUgAra Ale tevhA mUsA tyAMnA mhaNAle kI TAkA je kAhI tumhI TAkU icchitA.
tara jevhA tyAMnI TAkale tevhA mUsA mhaNAle kI he je kAhI tumhI ANale Ahe, jAdU Ahe. nizcitaca allAha yAlA AtAca naSTa karUna TAkIla, niHsaMzaya allAha azA upadravI lokAMce kAma banU deta nAhI.
ANi allAha khar2yA purAvyAlA ApalyA kathanAne spaSTa karato, maga aparAdhyAlA kitIhI vAITa vATo.

maga mUsAvara tyAMcyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMpaikI kevaLa thoDyAca lokAMnI ImAna rAkhale, tehI phiraauna ANi ApalyA saradArAMzI bhaya rAkhata kI kadAcita tyAMnA duHkha na pohacAve ANi kharokhara phiraauna tyA dezAta ucca (zaktizAlI) hotA ANi hI goSTadekhIla hotI kI to maryAdecyA bAhera gelA hotA.
ANi mUsA mhaNAle, he mAjhyA jAtI-samUhAcyA lokAMno! jara tumhI allAhavara ImAna rAkhata asAla tara tyAcyAvaraca bharavasA karA jara tumhI musalamAna (allAhace AjJAdhAraka) asAla.
tevhA te mhaNAle, AmhI tara allAhavaraca bharosA kelA Ahe. he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! AmhAlA yA atyAcArI lokAMsAThI upadravA (ce lakSya) banavU nakA.
ANi AmhAlA ApalyA dayA- kRpene yA kAphirAMpAsUna suTakA pradAna kara.

ANi AmhI mUsA va tyAcyA bhAvAkaDe vahayI (avatarita saMdeza) pAThavilA kI tumhI doghe ApalyA yA lokAMkaritA misra dezAta ghara kAyama rAkhA ANi tumhI sarva tyAca gharAMnA namAja paDhaNyAce sthAna nizcita karA ANi nitya nemAne namAja adA karA ANi tumhI ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMnA khUzakhabara dyA.

ANi mUsA yAMnI duA- prArthanA kelI, he mAjhyA pAlanahAra! tU, phiraauna ANi tyAcyA saradArAMnA zobhA sajAvaTa ANi sarva prakAracI dhana-daulata yA jagAcyA jIvanAta pradAna kelI. he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! (azAsAThI pradAna kelI) kI tyAMnI tujhyA mArgApAsUna AmhAlA dUra karAve. he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! tyAMcyA dhana-daulatIlA ud‌dhvasta karUna TAka ANi tyAMcyA hRdayAMnA sakta (kaThora) banava, yAsAThI kI tyAMnA ImAna rAkhaNe azakya vhAve, yethaparyaMta kI tyAMnI duHkhadAyaka az2Aba (zikSA-yAtanA) pAhUna ghyAvI.
(sarvazreSTha allAhane) pharmAvile, tumhA doghAMcI duA- prArthanA kabUla kelI gelI. tumhI saraLa mArgAvara rAhA ANi azA lokAMcyA mArgAvara cAlU nakA, je nAdAna Aheta.

ANi AmhI isrAIlacyA saMtatIlA samudrApAra kele, maga tyAMcyA pAThopATha phiraauna ApalyA sainyAsaha julUma ANi atireka karaNyAcyA hetune nighAlA. yetheparyaMta kI jevhA to buDAyalA lAgalA tevhA mhaNAlA, mI ImAna rAkhato kI jyAvara isrAIlacyA saMtatIne ImAna rAkhale Ahe. tyAcyAkherIja koNIhI upAsanesa pAtra nAhI ANi mI islAma svIkAraNAr2yAMpaikI Ahe.
(uttarAdAkhala pharmAvile gele) AtA ImAna rAkhato, ANi pUrvI tara avajJA karIta rAhilA ANi upadravI lokAMta sAmIla rAhilA.
tevhA Aja AmhI tujhyA mRta zarIrAlA soDUna deU, yAsAThI kI tU tyA lokAMsAThI bodhacinha TharAve, je tujhyAnaMtara (yeNAra Aheta. ANi niHsaMzaya adhikAMza loka AmacyA nizANyAMpAsUna gAphIla Aheta.

ANi AmhI isrAIlacyA saMtatIlA phAra uttama rAhaNyAce ThikANa dile ANi AmhI tyAMnA svaccha- zuddha vastU khANyAsAThI pradAna kelyA, tevhA tyAMnI matabheda kelA nAhI, yethaparyaMta kI tyAMcyAjavaLa jJAna yeUna pohocale. niHsaMzaya, tumacA pAlanakartA tyAMcyA daramyAna kayAmatacyA divazI tyA goSTIMbAbata nirNaya karIla, jyAta te matabheda karIta hote.

maga jara tumhI tyAcyAviSayI saMzayagrasta asAla, je AmhI tumacyAkaDe pAThavile Ahe tara tumhI tyA lokAMnA vicArA je tumacyA pUrvIcyA graMthAMce paThaNa karatAta. niHsaMzaya tumacyAjavaLa tumacyA pAlanakartyAtarphe satyaniSTha graMtha AlA Ahe tevhA tumhI kadhIhI zaMkA karaNAr2yAMpaikI hoU nakA.
ANi nA azA lokAMpaikI vhA, jyAMnI sarvazreSTha allAhacyA AyatIMnA khoTe Tharavile anyathA tumhI toTA ucalaNAr2yAMpaikI vhAla.
niHsaMzaya, jyA lokAMviSayI tumacyA pAlanakartyAce pharmAna khare Tharale Ahe, te ImAna rAkhaNAra nAhIta.
maga tyAMcyAjavaLa sarva nizANyA pohacalyA asalyA tarI, joparyaMta te duHkhadAyaka az2Aba pAhUna na ghetIla.

yAstava koNatyAhI vastIne ImAna rAkhale nAhI kI ImAna rAkhale tyAMcyAsAThI lAbhadAyaka Tharale asate, yUnusacyA janasamUhAkherIja. jevhA tyAMnI ImAna rAkhale tevhA AmhI apamAnAcA az2Aba (prakopa) yA jagAcyA jIvanAta tyAMcyA varUna haTavilA ANi tyAMnA ekA (nizcita) veLeparyaMta sukha bhogaNyAcA avasara dilA.
ANi jara tumacyA pAlanakartyAne icchitale asate tara sAr2yA dharatIcyA samasta lokAMnI ImAna rAkhale asate. tara kAya tumhI lokAMnA vivaza karU zakatA kI tyAMnI ImAnadhAraka vhAveca.
vAstavika ekhAdyAce ImAna rAkhaNe allAhacyA hukUmAvinA zakya nAhI ANi allAha, akkala nasalelyAMnA galicchateta TAkato.
tumhI sAMgA kI jarA vicAra karA kI AkAzAMmadhye va dharatIta kasa-kazA vastU Aheta ANi je loka ImAna rAkhata nAhIta tyAMnA nizANI ANi cetAvaNI kasalAhI lAbha pohacavita nAhI.

tevhA kAya te loka kevaLa tyA lokAMsArakhyA ghaTanAMcI vATa baghata Aheta jyA tyAMcyApUrvI hoUna gelyAta. (tumhI) sAMgA kI ThIka Ahe, tara tumhI vATa baghata rAhA. mIdekhIla tumacyAsobata vATa baghaNAr2yAMpaikI Ahe.
maga AmhI ApalyA paigaMbarAMnA ANi ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMnA vAcavita hoto. azA prakAre AmacyA adhikArAta Ahe kI AmhI ImAnadhArakAMnA suTakA deta asato.

(tumhI) sAMgA, he lokAMno! jara tumhI mAjhyA dIna- dharmAviSayI saMzayagrasta asAla tara mI tyA daivatAMcI upAsanA karIta nAhI, jyAMcI tumhI allAhalA soDUna bhaktI- ArAdhanA karatAta, paraMtu ho, tyA allAhacI upAsanA karato jo tumacA prANa bAhera kADhato ANi malA Adeza dilA gelA Ahe kI mI ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMpaikI rAhAve.
ANi he kI ekAgracitta hoUna Apale toMDa yA dIna- dharmAkaDe karAve ANi kadhIhI anekezvaravAdyAMpaikI na banAve.

ANi allAhalA soDUna kadhIhI azA vastUlA pukArU nakA jI tumhAlA nA kAhI phAyadA pohacavU zakela ANi nA kAhI nukasAna pohacavU zakela tarIhI jara tumhI ase karalA tara azA sthitIta tumhI julamI lokAMpaikI TharAla.

ANi jara tumhAlA allAha ekhAde duHkha pohacavila tara tyAcyAzivAya te duHkha dUra karaNArA dusarA koNIhI nAhI ANi jara to tumhAlA ekhAde sukha deU icchila tara tyAcyA kRpelA koNIhI haTaviNAra nAhI. to ApalI kRpA ApalyA dAsAMpaikI jyAvara icchila pradAna karIla, ANi to moThA mApha karaNArA ANi atizaya dayA karaNArA Ahe.

(tumhI) sAMgA, he lokAMno! tumacyAjavaLa, tumacyA pAlanakartyAtarphe satya gheUna pohacale Ahe. yAstava jo manuSya saraLa mArgAvara yeIla, tara to svataH (cyA bhalyA) sAThI saraLa mArgAvara yeIla ANi jo manuSya saraLa mArgApAsUna bhaTakalA tara tyAce saMkaTa tyAcyAvaraca kosaLela ANi mI tumacyAvara dekharekha ThevaNArA banavilo gelo nAhI.

ANi tumhI tyAce anusaraNa karIta rAhA, je kAhI vahayI (avatarita Adeza) tumacyAkaDe pAThavile jAta Ahe ANi dhIra-saMyama rAkhA, yethaparyaMta kI allAhane nirNaya karAvA ANi to samasta zAsakAMpekSA uttama zAsaka Ahe.
alipha. lAma. raॉ. hA eka asA graMtha Ahe kI yAcyA AyatI majabUta kelyA gelyA Aheta, maga savistara sAMgitalyA gelyA Aheta ekA hikamatazAlI, pUrNa jJAna rAkhaNAr2yAtarphe.
he kI allAhazivAya koNAcIhI upAsanA karU nakA. mI tumhAlA allAhatarphe bhaya dAkhaviNArA ANi khUzakhabara deNArA Ahe.

ANi he kI tumhI ApalyA aparAdhAMnA ApalyA pAlanakartyAkaDUna mApha karavUna ghyA, maga tyAcyAcakaDe ekacitta vhA. to tumhAlA ekA nirdhArIta veLeparyaMta (jIvana) sAmugrI deIla ANi pratyeka cAMgale kAma karaNAr2yAvara adhika kRpA karIla ANi jara tumhI loka toMDa phiravita rAhilAta tara malA tumacyAbAbata ekA moThyA divasAcyA zikSecI ciMtA vATate.
tumhAlA allAhacyAca javaLa jAyace Ahe ANi to pratyeka goSTIce sAmarthya bALagato.

lakSAta ThevA te loka ApalyA chAtIMnA duherI karUna ghetAta, yAsAThI kI ApalyA goSTI (bolaNe) allAhapAsUna lapavU zakAve. lakSAta ThevA kI te loka jyA veLI Apale kapaDe guMDALatAta, tyA veLIhI to sarva kAhI jANato je kAhI lapavitAta (kAnagoSTI karatAta) ANi je kAhI sApha- spaSTa bolatAta. niHsaMzaya to manAtalyA goSTIhI jANato.

ANi jaminIvara cAlaNyA-phiraNAr2yA pratyeka sajIvAcyA annasAmugrIcI jabAbadArI allAhavara Ahe. toca tyAMcyA nivAsAce ThikANahI jANato ANi tyAMnA sopavile jANyAce ThikANahI. sarva kAhI spaSTa graMthAta Ahe.

ANi to (allAhaca) hoya, jyAne sahA divasAMta AkAzAMnA ANi jaminIlA nirmANa kele ANi tyAce siMhAsana (arza) pANyAvara hote yAsAThI kI tyAne tumacI kasoTI ghyAvI kI tumacyAta sadAcArI koNa Ahe? jara tumhI tyAMnA sAMgAla kI tumhAlA melyAnaMtara punhA jivaMta kele jAIla, tara inkArI loka uttara detIla kI hI kevaLa ughaDa jAdU Ahe.

ANi jara AmhI kAhI mudatIparyaMta tyAMcyAvarIla zikSA- yAtanA sthagita kelI tara he nizcita ud‌gAratIla kI az2AbalA koNatyA goSTIne rokhale Ahe, aikA! jyA divazI az2Aba tyAMcyA javaLa yeUna pohocela, maga to tyAMcyAvarUna TaLaNAra nAhI, maga tara jyAcI te thaTTA uDavita hote, toca tyAMcyAvara ulaTUna paDela.
ANi jara AmhI mANasAlA ekhAdyA sukhAcI goDI cAkhavUna, maga te tyAcyAkaDUna hirAvUna gheto, tevhA to phAra udAsa ANi moThA kRtaghna banato.

ANi jara AmhI tyAlA ekhAde sukha pohacavito, tyA duHkhAnaMtara je tyAlA pohocale hote, tevhA to mhaNU lAgato kI AtA mAjhyA kaSTa-yAtanA dUra jhAlyA nizcitaca to khUpa AnaMdita hoUna ghameMDa karU lAgato.
tyAMcyAkherIja, je dhIra-saMyama rAkhatAta ANi satkarma karIta rAhatAta azAca lokAMsAThI kSamAhI Ahe ANi phAra moThA mobadalAhI.

tara kadAcita tumhI tyA vahayI (Iza-saMdezA) cA ekhAdA bhAga soDUna deNAra AhAta, jo tumacyAkaDe avatarIta kelA jAto ANi tyAmuLe tumacyA manAta saMkoca Ahe kevaLa tyAMcyA yA bolaNyAvara kI yAcyAvara ekhAdA khajinA kA nAhI utaravilA gelA? kiMvA yAcyAsobata ekhAdA phariztA tarI AlA asatA. aikA! tumhI tara kevaLa bhaya dAkhaviNAreca AhAta ANi pratyeka cIjavastUcI dekharekha karaNArA kevaLa allAha Ahe.

kAya te ase mhaNatAta kI yA kuraAnAlA tyAne ApalyA manAne racale Ahe. tumhI uttara dyA kI tumhIdekhIla azA dahA sUraha (adhyAya) manAne racUna ANA ANi allAhakherIja vATela tyAlA ApalyAsobata sAmIla karUna ghyA, jara tumhI sacce asAla.

maga jara te tumace he mhaNaNe mAnya na karatIla tara tumhI khAtrIpUrvaka jANUna ghyA kI hA graMtha (kuraAna) allAhacyA jJAnAsaha avatarita kelA gelA Ahe ANi he kI allAhazivAya koNIhI upAsya nAhI. tara kAya tumhI muslima hotA?
jo manuSya aihika jIvana ANi zobhA- sajAvaTIvara Asakta asela tara azAMnA AmhI sarva karmAMcA (mobadalA) itheca pUrNataH deUna TAkato ANi ithe tyAMnA kasalIhI kamataratA ThevalI jAta nAhI.

mAtra heca te loka hota, jyAMcyAsAThI Akhiratamadhye AgIzivAya dusare kAhIhI nAhI ANi je kAhI tyAMnI ithe kele asela te tithe sarva vyartha Ahe ANi jI kAhI tyAMcI karme hotI, tI sarva nAza pAvaNArI Aheta.

to, jo ApalyA pAlanakartyAtarphe ekA pramANAvara kAyama asela, ANi tyAcyAsobata allAhatarphe sAkSI asela, ANi tyAcyApUrvI mUsAcA graMtha (sAkSI) asela jo mArgadarzaka ANi dayA- kRpA Ahe. (dusar2yAMpramANe asU zakato?) heca loka Aheta, je tyAvara ImAna rAkhatAta ANi sarva samUhAMpaikI, jodekhIla yAcA inkArI asela tyAcyA aMtima vAyadyAce ThikANa jahannama Ahe. tevhA tumhI tyAbAbata kasalyAhI saMzayAta paDU nakA. niHsaMzaya he tumacyA pAlanakartyAtarphe pUrNataH satya Ahe. paraMtu adhikAMza loka ImAna bALagaNAre nasatAta.

ANi tyAhUna adhika atyAcArI koNa asela, jo allAhabAbata khoTe racela. he loka ApalyA pAlanakartyAsamora sAdara kele jAtIla ANi sAkSa deNAre sarva mhaNatIla kI he ase loka Aheta jyAMnI ApalyA pAlanakartyAviSayI asatya racale. khabaradAra! allAhatarphe dhikkArAcA mArA Ahe azA atyAcArI lokAMvara.
je allAhacyA mArgApAsUna rokhatAta ANi tyAta cukA zodhaNyAmAge lAgatAta. heca te loka hote, je AkhiratacA inkAra karatAta.
ase loka nA yA jagAta allAhalA haravU zakale, ANi nA tyAMcA koNI madatakartA allAhakherIja jhAlA. tyAMcyAsAThI zikSA duppaTa kelI jAIla nA te aikaNyAce sAmarthya bALagata hote ANi pAhAtahI navhate.
heca te loka hote jyAMnI svataHca Apale nukasAna karUna ghetale ANi tyAMcyAkaDUna tyAMnI racalele asatya haravale.
niHsaMzaya he loka Akhirata (maraNottara jIvanA) madhye toTyAta asatIla.
niHsaMzaya, jyAMnI ImAna rAkhale ANi satkarma karIta rAhile ANi ApalyA pAlanakartyAkaDe jhukatahI rAhile, teca loka jannatamadhye jANAra Aheta jithe te nehamI nehamI rAhatIla.
donhI gaTAMce udAharaNa ase Ahe jaNU eka AMdhaLA ANi bahirA tara dusarA DoLasa ANi aikaNArA. udAharaNAta kAya he donhI samAna Aheta? kAya tarIhI tumhI bodha prApta karIta nAhIta?
ANi niHsaMzaya AmhI nUha (alai.) yAMnA tyAMcyA janasamUhAkaDe rasUla (saMdezavAhaka) banavUna pAThavile kI mI tumhAlA spaSTapaNe saceta karaNArA Ahe?
kI tumhI phakta allAhacIca upAsanA karA, malA tara tumacyAviSayI duHkhadAyaka divasAcyA zikSA- yAtanece bhaya vATate.

tyAMcyA janasamUhAcyA kAphira saradArAMnI uttara dile kI AmhI tara tumhAlA ApalyAcasArakhe manuSya asalyAce pAhato ANi tumacyA anuyAyIMnAhI pAhato kI spaSTataH khAlacyA pAtaLIcyA lokAMkherIja dusarA koNI nAhI. (je tumace anusaraNa karIta Aheta) AmhAlA tara tumhI koNatyAhI prakAre AmacyApekSA zreSTha disata nAhI, ulaTa AmhI tara tumhAlA khoTe samajato.

(nUha) mhaNAle, he mAjhyA jAtIbAMdhavAMno! malA he sAMgA, jara mI ApalyA pAlanakartyAtarphe spaSTa nizANIvara kAmaya asalelA ANi malA tyAne ApalyAkaDUna (ekhAdI cAMgalI) dayA- kRpA pradAna kelI asela, maga tI tumacyA DoLyAMta sAmAvalI nAhI tara kAya jabaradastIne tilA tumacyA gaLyAta TAkU, vAstavika tumhI tilA icchita nAhI.

he mAjhyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMno! mI yAcyA mobadalyAta tumacyAkaDUna kasalehI dhana mAgata nAhI. mAjhA mobadalA tara kevaLa sarvazreSTha allAhajavaLa Ahe, nA mI ImAnadhArakAMnA ApalyA javaLUna dUra karU zakato, tyAMnA ApalyA pAlanakartyAzI bheTAyace Ahe. paraMtu mI ase pAhato kI tumhI loka mUrkhapaNA karIta AhAta.
ANi he mAjhyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMno! jara mI ImAnadhArakAMnA ApalyApAsUna dUra karena, tara allAhacyA virodhAta koNa mAjhI madata karU zakato, kAya tumhI thoDAdekhIla vicAra karIta nAhIta?

ANi mI tumhAlA he nAhI sAMgata kI mAjhyAjavaLa allAhace khajine Aheta. (aikA!) mI aparokSAcehI jJAna bALagata nAhI, nA mI he sAMgato kI mI phariztA Ahe. nA mAjhe ase mhaNaNe Ahe kI jyAMcyAvara tumacI najara apamAnAne paData Ahe tyAMnA allAha ekhAdI bhalAI deNAraca nAhI. tyAMcyA manAta je kAhI Ahe allAha te cAMgalyA prakAre jANato. jara mI ase mhaNena tara nizcitaca mAjhIhI gaNanA atyAcArI lokAMta hoIla.
(janasamUhAce loka) mhaNAle, he nUha! tU AmacyAzI khUpa khUpa vAda ghAtalA Ahesa. AtA tara jyA goSTIce bhaya tU AmhAlA dAkhavita Ahesa tIca AmacyAjavaLa ANUna dAkhava jara tU saccA Ahesa.
uttara dile, tIdekhIla allAhaca ANIla jara to icchila, ANi hoya! tumhI allAhalA vivaza karU zakata nAhI.

ANi tumhAlA mAjhA upadeza kAhIca lAbha pohacavU zakata nAhI, maga mI kitIhI tumace bhale icchile tarIhI. jara allAhacI marjI tumhAlA bhaTakata ThevaNyAcI asela. toca tumhA sarvAMcA pAlanakartA Ahe ANi tyAcyAcakaDe tumhI paratUna jAla.

kAya he mhaNatAta kI hA graMtha paigaMbarAne svataH manAne racalelA Ahe? tara tumhI uttara dyA kI jara to mI manAne racalelA asela tara mAjhA gunhA mAjhyAvara Ahe ANi mI tyA aparAdhAMpAsUna vegaLA Ahe, je tumhI karIta AhAta.

ANi nUhakaDe vahayI (IzasaMdeza) pAThavilI gelI kI tumacyA janasamUhAmadhye jyAMnIdekhIla ImAna rAkhale Ahe, tyAMcyAkherIja AtA koNIhI ImAna rAkhaNAra nAhI. tevhA tyAMcyA karmAMbaddala duHkhI hoU nakA.
ANi eka naukA AmacyA DoLyAMdekhata ANi AmacyA vahayInusAra tayAra karA ANi atyAcArI lokAMviSayI AmhAlA kAhIhI bolU nakA, tyAMnA pANyAta buDavile jANAra Ahe.

te (nUha) nAva banavU lAgale, tyAMcyA janasamUhAce jyA jyA gaTAce loka tyAMcyA javaLUna jAta, tyAMcI thaTTA uTavita. te (nUha) mhaNata, jara tumhI AmacI thaTTA uDavita asAla tara AmhIdekhIla eka divasa tumacyAvara hasaNAra jazI tumhI thaTTA karIta AhAta.
tumhAlA lavakaraca mAhIta paDela kI koNAvara zikSA-yAtanA yeNAra Ahe jI tyAlA apamAnita karIla ANi tyAcyAvara niraMtara az2Aba utarela.

yetheparyaMta kI jevhA AmacA Adeza yeUna pohocalA ANi taMdUramadhUna pANI ucaMbaLU lAgale, AmhI sAMgitale kI yA nauketa pratyeka prakAracyA (nara va mAdA azA) joDyA svAra karUna ghyA ANi ApalyA kuTuMbiyAMnAhI, mAtra tyAMcyAkherIja jyAMcyAbaddala AdhIca phaisalA jhAlelA Ahe ANi sarva ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMnAhI. thyAMcyAsobata ImAna rAkhaNAre phAraca kamI hote.
ANi nUha mhaNAle kI yA nauketa svAra vhA allAhacyAca nAvAne hice cAlaNe ANi thAMbaNe Ahe. niHsaMzaya, mAjhA pAlanakartA moThA mApha karaNArA ANi dayA karaNArA Ahe.

ANi to naukA tyAMnA parvatAsamAna lATAMmadhUna neta hotI ANi nUhane ApalyA putrAlA, jo ekA kinAr2yAvara hotA, hAka mArUna mhaTale, he mAjhyA priya putrA! AmacyAsobata svAra ho ANi inkArI lokAMta sAmIla rAhU nakosa.

tyAne uttara dile kI mI ekhAdyA uMca parvatAcyA AzrayAlA jAIna, jo malA pANyApAsUna vAcavIla. nUha mhaNAle, Aja allAhacyA hukumAne vAcaviNArA koNIhI nAhI. kevaLa teca vAcatIla, jyAMcyAvara allAhacI dayA- kRpA hoIla, tyAca kSaNI tyAMcyA daramyAna eka lATa AlI ANi to buDaNAr2yAMpaikI jhAlA.

ANi pharmAvile gele kI, he jamIna! Apale pANI giLUna TAka, ANi he AkAza! pure kara,thAMba. tyAca veLI pANI sukavale gele ANi kAma pUrNa kele gele ANi naukA jUdI nAvAcyA parvatAzI jAUna thAMbalI ANi pharmAvile gele anyAya karaNAr2yAMvara dhikkArAcA varSAva hovo.

ANi nUhane ApalyA pAlanakartyAsa pukArale ANi mhaTale, he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! mAjhA putra tara mAjhyA kuTuMbiyAMpaikI Ahe. nizcitaca tujhA vAyadA pUrNataH saccA Ahe ANi tU samasta zAsakAMpekSA uttama zAsaka Ahe.

(allAhane) pharmAvile, he nUha! khAtrIne to tujhyA kuTuMbiyAMpaikI nAhI. tyAcI karme agadI nApasaMtIcI Aheta. tU kadhIhI azA goSTIcI yAcanA karU naye, jice tulA kiMcitahI jJAna nasAve. mI tulA upadeza karato kI tU aDANI lokAMmadhye ApalI gaNanA karaNyApAsUna thAMba.

(nUha) mhaNAle, he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! mI tujheca zaraNa mAgato, yA goSTIpAsUna kI tujhyAkaDe azA goSTIcI yAcanA karAvI, jice malA jJAnaca nasAve jara tU malA mApha kele nAhI ANi mAjhyAvara dayA kelI nAhI tara mI toTA ucalaNAr2yAMpaikI hoIna.

pharmAvile gele, he nUha! AmacyAtarphe salAmatI ANi tyA samRddhIMsaha utara jyA tujhyAvara Aheta ANi tujhyAsobatacyA aneka janasamudAyAMvara ANi aneka samudAya ase asatIla, jyAMnA AmhI lAbha tara nizcita pohocavU, paraMtu naMtara tyAMnA AmacyAtarphe duHkhadAyaka zikSAhI pohocela.

hI khabara parokSAcyA khabarIMpaikI Ahe, jyAMcI vahayI (avataraNa) AmhI tumacyAkaDe karato. yAMnA yApUrvI nA tumhI jANata hote, ANi nA tumacA janasamUha. yAstava tumhI dhIra- saMyama rAkhA. niHsaMzaya, pariNAma allAhace bhaya rAkhUna vAgaNAr2yAMkaritAca Ahe.
ANi Ada janasamUhAkaDe tyAMce bhAU hUda yAMnA pAThavile. hUda mhaNAle, he mAjhyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMno! allAhacI upAsanA karA, tyAcyAkherIja koNIhI upAsya nAhI, tumhI tara kevaLa asatya racata AhAta.
he mAjhyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMno! mI tumacyAkaDUna yAcA kAhI mobadalA mAgata nAhI. mAjhA mobadalA tara tyAcyAkaDe Ahe, jyAne malA nirmANa kele Ahe. tara kAya tarIhI tumhI akalecA vApara karIta nAhI?

ANi he mAjhyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMno! tumhI ApalyA pAlanakartyAjavaLa ApalyA aparAdhAMcI mAphI mAgA ANi tyAcyA darabArAta taubA (kSamA-yAcanA) karA. yAsAThI kI tyAne pAUsa pADaNAre Dhaga tumacyAvara pAThavAveta. ANi tumacyA zaktI-sAmarthyAta ANakhI vADha karAvI ANi tumhI gunhegAra banUna toMDa phiravU nakA.

janasamUhAce loka mhaNAle, he hUda! tU AmacyAjavaLa ekhAde pramANa tara ANale nAhI, ANi AmhI kevaLa tujhyA sAMgaNyAvarUna ApalyA daivatAMnA soDaNAra nAhIta ANi nA AmhI tujhyAvara ImAna rAkhaNAra Ahota.

kiMbahunA AmhI tara mhaNato kI tulA AmacyA ekhAdyA daivatAne jhapATUna TAkale Ahe. hUda mhaNAle, mI allAhalA sAkSI banavito ANi tumhIdekhIla sAkSI rAhA kI mI tara allAhakherIja tyA sarvAMpAsUna vegaLA Ahe, jyAMnA tumhI (allAhacA) sahabhAgI banavita AhAta.
ThIka, tumhI sarva miLUna mAjhyAvirUddha vAITa kAravAI karUna TAkA, ANi malA kadhIhI savaDa deU nakA.

mAjhA bharosA kevaLa allAhavaraca Ahe, jo mAjhA pAlanakartA ANi tumhA sarvAMcA pAlanakartA Ahe. jevaDhedekhIla cAlaNAre phiraNAre Aheta, tyA sarvAMce mastiSka (kapALa) tyAneca dharUna Thevale Ahe. niHsaMzaya mAjhA pAlanakartA agadI saraLa mArgAvara Ahe.

tarIhI tumhI toMDa phiravita asAla tara phiravA. mI tara tumhAlA to saMdeza pohacatA kelA, jo deUna malA tumacyAkaDe pAThavile gele hote. mAjhA pAlanakartA tumacyA jAgI dusar2yA lokAMnA ANIla ANi tumhI tyAce kAhIca bighaDavU zakaNAra nAhIta. niHsaMzaya mAjhA pAlanakartA pratyeka cIja vastUcA saMrakSaka Ahe.

ANi jevhA AmacA Adeza yeUna pohocalA, tevhA AmhI hUdalA ANi tyAcyA ImAnadhAraka sAthIdArAMnA ApalyA khAsa dayA-kRpene suTakA pradAna kelI ANi AmhI tyA sarvAMnA bhayaMkara (sakta) zikSA-yAtanepAsUna vAcavile.
hA hotA AdacA janasamUha, jyAMnI ApalyA pAlanakartyAcyA AyatIMcA inkAra kelA ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAMcI avajJA kelI ANi pratyeka vidrohI avajJAkArIcyA AdezAMce pAlana kele.
ANi yA jagAtahI tyAMcA dhiHkkAra va nirbhatsanA hota rAhilI ANi kayAmatacyA divazIhI pAhA, AdacyA janasamUhAne ApalyA pAlanakartyAzI inkAra kelA. hUdacA janasamUha AdacA dhiHkkAra aso.

ANi samUdacyA janasamUhAkaDe tyAMce bhAU saॉleha yAMnA pAThavile. saॉleha mhaNAle, he mAjhyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMno! tumhI allAhacIca bhaktI upAsanA karA, tyAcyAkherIja tumacA koNIhI upAsya nAhI. tyAneca tumhAlA jaminIpAsUna nirmANa kele Ahe, ANi tyAne yA dharatIvara tumhAlA AbAda kele Ahe. yAstava tumhI tyAcyAjavaLa mAphI mAgA ANi tyAcyAcakaDe taubA (kSamA-yAcanA) karA. niHsaMzaya mAjhA pAlanakartA taubA kabUla karaNArA samIpa Ahe.

janasamUhAce loka mhaNAle, he saॉleha! yAcyA pUrvI AmhI tumacyAkaDUna aneka AzA apekSA bALagUna hoto. kAya tumhI AmhAlA tyAMcyA bhaktIpAsUna rokhatA, jyAMcI bhaktI ArAdhanA Amace vADavaDIla karata Ale, AmhAlA tara yA dharmAbAbata zaMkA Ahe, jyAkaDe tumhI AmhAlA bolAvita AhAta.

sAleha mhaNAle, he mAjhyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMno! bare he sAMgA, jara mI ApalyA pAlanakartyAtarphe ekhAdyA khAsa pramANAvara asela ANi tyAne malA ApalyA javaLUna dayA-kRpA pradAna kelI asela, maga mI jara tyAcI avajJA kelI tara asA koNa Ahe, jo tyAcyAsamora mAjhI madata karela? tumhI tara mAjhyA nukasAnAtaca bhara TAkata AhAta.

ANi he mAjhyA jAtIbAMdhavAMno! hI allAhane pAThavilelI sAMDaNI Ahe, jI tumacyAkaritA allAhacA eka camatkAra Ahe. AtA tumhI tilA allAhacyA dharatIvara caraNyAsAThI mokaLe soDA ANi tilA kazAhI prakAracA trAsa pohacavU nakA, anyathA lavakaraca tumhAlA az2Aba yeUna dharela.
tarIhI tyA lokAMnI tyA sAMDaNIce pAya kApUna (mArUna TAkale). yAvara saॉleha mhaNAle, ThIka tara tumhI ApalyA gharAMmadhye tIna divasa paryaMta vAstavya karUna ghyA, hA vAyadA khoTA nAhI.

maga jevhA AmacA Adeza yeUna pohocalA, AmhI saॉleha ANi tyAMcyAvara ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMnA ApalyA dayA-kRpene tyA (zikSe) pAsUnahI vAcavile ANi tyA divasAcyA apamAnApAsUnahI. niHsaMzaya tumacA pAlanakartA zaktizAlI ANi jabaradasta Ahe.
ANi atyAcArI lokAMnA moThA bhayaMkara AvAjAne yeUna dharale, maga te ApalyA gharAMmadhye toMDaghazI marUna paDalele rAhile.
azA prakAre jaNU te tyA ThikANI kadhI rAhileca navhate. sAvadhAna! samUdacyA janasamUhAne ApalyA pAlanakartyAcA inkAra kelA. aikA! tyA samUdacyA lokAMvara dhiHkkAra Ahe.
ANi AmhI pAThivalele dUta ibrAhImajavaLa zubha samAcAra gheUna pohocale ANi salAma mhaNAle. tyAMnIdekhIla salAmace pratyuttara dile ANi vinAvilaMba bhAjalele vAsaru gheUna Ale.

ANi jevhA pAhile kI tyAMce hAtadekhIla tyA (khAdyA) kaDe pohacata nAhI, tara tyAMnA anoLakhI jANUna manAtalyA manAta bhayabhIta hoU lAgale. dUta mhaNAle, bhiU nakA. AmhAlA tara lUtacyA janasamUhAkaDe pAThavile gele Ahe.
ANi tyAMcI patnI, jI ubhI hotI, tI hasalI, tevhA AmhI tilA isahAkacA ANi tyAcyAnaMtara yAkUbacA zubha samAcAra dilA.
tI mhaNU lAgalI, hAya re durdaiva! malA mUlabALa hoU zakate? mI tara svataH mhAtArI ANi mAjhe patIhI khUpa vayaskara Aheta. nizcitaca hI moThyA AzcaryAcI goSTa hoya.

(pharizte) mhaNAle, kAya tumhAlA allAhacyA sAmarthyAviSayI Azcarya vATata Ahe. yA gharAcyA lokAMno! tumacyAvara allAhacI dayA-kRpA ANi tyAcyA barakatI (samRddhI) avatarIta hovo! niHsaMzaya samasta stutI- prazaMsA ANi zAna- vaibhava allAhakaritAca Ahe.
jevhA ibrAhIma yAMcI bhItI nAhIzI jhAlI ANi tyAMnA zubha samAcArahI kaLalA tevhA lUtacyA janasamUhAbAbata AmacyAzI vAdavivAda karU lAgale.
niHsaMzaya, ibrAhIma moThe saMyamazIla ANi komala manAce ANi allAhakaDe jhukaNAre hote.
he ibrAhIma! hA irAdA soDUna dyA. tumacyA pAlanakartyAcA Adeza yeUna pohocalA Ahe, ANi tyAMcyAvara na paratavilyA jANAr2yA zikSA- yAtanA avazya yeNAra Aheta.
ANi jevhA AmhI pAThavilele pharizte lUtajavaLa pohocale, tevhA tyAMcyA kAraNAne te phAra duHkhI jhAle ANi manAtalyA manAta duHkha karU lAgale ANi mhaNU lAgale, AjacA divasa phAra duHkhAcA divasa Ahe.

ANi tyAcyA janasamUhAce loka tyAMcyAkaDe dhAvata Ale. te tara AdhIpAsUnaca vAITa kAmAta magna hote. (lUta) mhaNAle kI, he mAjhyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMno! mAjhyA yA mulI Aheta, jyA tumacyAsAThI phAra sAphasuthar2yA Aheta. allAhace bhaya rAkhA ANi malA mAjhyA pAhuNyAMbAbata apamAnita karU nakA. kAya tumacyAta ekahI bhalA mANUsa nAhI?
janasamUhAcyA lokAMnI uttara dile kI tumhAlA cAMgalyA prakAre mAhIta Ahe kI AmhAlA tumacyA mulIvara kasalAhI adhikAra nAhI ANi tumhI AmacI kharI icchA cAMgalyA prakAre jANUna AhAta.
(lUta) mhaNAle, malA tumacyAzI laDhaNyAcI zaktI asatI tara phAra bare jhAle asate kiMvA mI ekhAdyA majabUta AzrayAlA asato.

AtA (pharizte) mhaNAle, he lUta! AmhI tumacyA pAlanakartyAce pAThavilele Ahota. azakya Ahe kI he tumacyAparyaMta pohacAveta. tevhA tumhI ApalyA kuTuMbiyAMnA gheUna thoDI rAtra bAkI rAhatAnA nighUna jA. tumacyApaikI koNIhI mAge vaLUna pAhU naye. mAtra tumacyA patnIkherIja, kAraNa tilAhI teca pohacaNAra Ahe, je sarvAMnA pohocela. nizcitaca tyAMcyA vAyadyAcI veLa sakALacI Ahe, tara kAya sakALa agadI javaLa nAhI?
maga jevhA AmacA Adeza yeUna pohocalA, AmhI tyA vastIlA ulathe pAlathe karUna TAkale. varacA hissA khAlI kelA ANi tyAMcyAvara khaMgara dagaDAMcA varSAva kelA je tharAvara thara hote.
tumacyA pAlanakartyAtarphe cinhAMkita (nizANa asalele) hote ANi te tyA atyAcArIpAsUna kiMcitacahI dUra navhate.

ANi (AmhI) madayanacyA lokAMkaDe tyAMce bhAU zuaibalA pAThavile. zuaiba mhaNAle, he mAjhyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMno! allAhacI upAsanA karA, tyAcyAkherIja tumacA koNIhI upAsya nAhI. tumhI mApa-tola karaNyAta kamI karU nakA. mI tumhAlA susaMpanna avastheta pAhAta Ahe ANi malA tumacyAbaddala gherUna TAkaNAr2yA divasAcyA az2Aba (zikSA-yAtane) ce bhayadekhIla Ahe.
he mAjhyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMno! mApa-tola nyAyapUrvaka karA, lokAMnA tyAMcyA vastU kamI (karUna) deU nakA ANi dharatIta utpAta ANi bighADa mAjavU nakA.
allAhacA halAla (vaidha) kelelA bAkI phAyadA tumacyAsAThI phAraca cAMgalA Ahe, jara tumhI ImAna rAkhaNAre asAla. mI kAhI tumacyAvara dekharekha ThevaNArA nAhI.

janasamUhAcyA lokAMnI uttara dile, he zuaiba! kAya tumacI upAsanA tumhAlA hAca Adeza dete kI AmhI ApalyA vADavaDilAMcyA ArAdhya daivatAMnA soDUna dyAve ANi AmhI ApalyA dhana-saMpattIta je kAhI karU icchito, te karaNehI soDUna dyAve. tumhI tara moThe samaMjasa ANi sadAcArI AhAta.

zuaiba mhaNAle, he mAjhyA jAtIbAMdhavAMno! pAhA, jara mI ApalyA pAlanakartyAtarphe spaSTa pramANAsaha Ahe ANi tyAne ApalyAkaDUna cAMgalI rojI (annasAmugrI) deUna ThevalI Ahe. mAjhI kadhIhI hI icchA nAhI kI tumhAlA manAI karUna svataH tyA goSTIkaDe jhukAve jicyApAsUna tumhAlA rokhata Ahe. mAjhA irAdA tara ApalyA kuvatInusAra sudhAraNA karaNyAcAca Ahe, ANi mAjhI subuddhI (tauphIka) allAhacyAca madatIne Ahe. tyAcyAvaraca mAjhA bharosA Ahe, ANi tyAcyAkaDeca malA paratUna jAyace Ahe.

ANi he mAjhyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMno! kadAcita ase na vhAve kI tumhI mAjhyA virodhAta yeUna tyA zikSA-yAtanAMnA pAtra TharAve jyA nUhacyA janasamUhAvara ANi hUdacyA janasamUhAvara ANi sAlehacyA janasamUhAvara AlyA ANi lUtacA janasamUha tara tumacyApAsUna kiMcitahI dUra nAhI!
ANi tumhI ApalyA pAlanakartyAjavaLa mAphI mAgA ANi tyAcyAcakaDe jhukA. nizcitaca mAjhA pAlanakartA atizaya dayAvAna ANi khUpa prema karaNArA Ahe.

te (loka) mhaNAle, he zuaiba! tumacyA bahuteka goSTI AmhAlA samajata nAhI ANi AmhI tumhAlA ApalyA daramyAna khUpa kamakuvata asalyAce pAhato. jara tumacyA kabilyAviSayI Adara nasatA tara AmhI tumacyAvara dagaDapheka kelI asatI ANi AmhI tumhAlA ekhAdA pratiSThita manuSya samajata nAhI.

zuaiba mhaNAle, he mAjhyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMno! kAya tumacyA dRSTIne mAjhyA kabilyAce loka allAhapekSA jAsta sanmAnita Aheta kI (jyAmuLe) tumhI tyAlA pAThImAge TAkale Ahe. niHsaMzaya, tumhI je kAhI karIta AhAta, mAjhyA pAlanakartyAne te sarva gheralele Ahe.

ANi he mAjhyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMno!
