AtA tumhI ApalyA ThikANI kAma karIta rAhA, mIdekhIla kAma karIta Ahe. lavakaraca tumhAlA mAhIta paDela kI koNAkaDe to az2Aba yeto, jo tyAlA apamAnita karUna TAkIla ANi asA koNa Ahe jo khoTA Ahe? tumhI pratikSA karA ANi mIdekhIla tumacyAsobata pratikSA karIta Ahe.

ANi jevhA AmacA Adeza (az2Aba) yeUna pohocalA, AmhI zuaibalA ANi tyAMcyAsaha samasta ImAnadhArakAMnA ApalyA khAsa kRpene muktI pradAna kelI ANi atyAcArI lokAMnA moThyA bhayaMkara AvAjAcyA az2AbAne yeUna dharale jyAmuLe te ApalyA gharAMmadhye pAlathe paDUna rAhile.
jaNU kAhI te tyA gharAMmadhye kadhI rAhileca navhate. sAvadha rAhA! madayanakaritAhI tasAca durAvA aso, jasA durAvA samUdasAThI jhAlA.
ANi niHsaMzaya, AmhIca mUsAlA ApalyA AyatI ANi spaSTa pramANAMsaha pAThavile hote.
phiraauna ANi tyAcyA saradArAMkaDe, tarIhI tyA lokAMnI phiraaunacyA AdezAMce pAlana kele ANi phiraaunacA koNatAhI Adeza ucita ANi rAsta navhatA.
to tara kayAmatacyA divazI ApalyA janasamUhAcA puDhAkAra gheUna tyA sarvAMnA narakAta ANUna ubhA karIla. to moThA vAITa ghATa Ahe jithe he loka jAUna pohacatIla.
ANi tyAMcyAvara yA jagAtahI dhiHkkAra (cA mArA) jhAlA ANi kayAmatacyA divazIhI. kitI vAITa inAma (bakSIsa) Ahe, je tyAMnA dile gele.
vastyAMcA hA kAhI samAcAra, jo AmhI tumacyAsamora nivedana karIta Ahota, tyAMcyApaikI kAhI astitvAta Aheta ANi kAhI kApaNI kelelyA pikAMsArakhyA jhAlyA.

ANi AmhI tyAMcyAvara koNatAhI julUma-atyAcAra kelA nAhI, kiMbahunA tyAMnI svataHca ApalyAvara atyAcAra kelA ANi tyAMnA tyAMcyA ArAdhya daivatAMnI kasalAhI lAbha pohacavilA nAhI, jyAMnA te allAhakherIja pukArata hote, vAstavika tumacyA pAlanakartyAcA Adeza yeUna pohocalA, kiMbahunA tyAMnI tyAMcyA nukasAnAta bharaca ghAtalI.
ANi tumacyA pAlanakartyAcyA pakaDIcA hAca niyama Ahe, jevhA to vastyAMmadhye rAhaNAr2yA atyAcArI lokAMnA tAvaDIta gheto. niHsaMzaya allAhacI pakaDa duHkhadAyaka ANi atizaya sakta Ahe.

nizcitaca yAta tyA lokAMsAThI bodha-upadeza Ahe, je kayAmatacyA bhayaMkara zikSA-yAtanece bhaya rAkhatAta. to divasa, jyA divazI sarva ekatra kele jAtIla ANi toca divazI sarva ekatra kele jAtIla ANi toca divasa kI jyA divazI sarvAMnA hajara kele jAIla.
ANi tyAlA AmhI jo vilaMba karato, to phakat‌ ekA nirdhArIta veLeparyaMtaca Ahe.
jyA divazI tI (kayAmata) yeIla, koNAlA hiMmata hoNAra nAhI kI allAhacyA anumatIvinA kAhI bolAve, tevhA tyAMcyApaikI koNI durdaivI asela ANi koNI sudaivI.
tara je durdaivI asatIla te narakAta jAtIla, tithe haLU ANi uMca svarAta oraDatIla.
te tithe sadaivakALa rAhatIla, joparyaMta AkAza va dharatI kAyama asatIla. mAtra tyA veLakherIja, jI tumacyA pAlanakartyAcI marjI asela. niHsaMzaya, tumacA pAlanakartA je kAhI icchito te karatoca.

ANi jyAMnA sudaivI kele gele te jannata (svargA) madhye asatIla jithe te nehamIkaritA rAhatIla, joparyaMta AkAza va dharatI bAkI rAhIla, paraMtu je tumacA pAlanakartA icchila hI kadhIhI na saMpaNArI deNagI Ahe.

yAstava tumhI tyA vastUMviSayI saMzayagrasta rAhU nakA, jyAMcI he loka pUjA karIta Aheta. tyAMcI upAsanA tara azA prakAre Ahe, jyA prakAre yAMcyA pUrvajAMcI yApUrvI hotI. AmhI tyA sarvAMnA purepUra hissA kamI na karatA deNAraca Ahota.

niHsaMzaya AmhI mUsAlA graMtha pradAna kelA, maga tyAta matabheda kelA gelA jara yA AdhIca tumacyA pAlanakartyAce pharmAna lAgU jhAlele nasate tara nizcitaca tyAMcA phaisalA kelA gelA asatA. tyAMnA tara yAta saMzaya vATata Ahe (he tara duvidhAgrasta Aheta).

ANi niHsaMzaya tyAMcyApaikI pratyekAlA (jevhA tyAcyAsamora jAIla tevhA) tumacA pAlanakartA tyAlA tyAcyA karmAMcA purepUra mobadalA pradAna karIla. niHsaMzaya te je kAhI karIta Aheta, allAha te sarvakAhI jANUna Ahe.

tevhA tumhI agadI aTaLa rAhA, jasA tumhAlA Adeza dilA gelA Ahe ANi te lokadekhIla jyAMnI tumacyAsaha kSamA-yAcanA kelI Ahe. (khabaradAra) tumhI maryAdA pAra karU nakA. allAha tumacyA samasta karmAMnA pAhata Ahe.
ANi pAhA, atyAcArI lokAMkaDe kadhIhI jhukU nakA. anyathA tumhAlAhI AgIcA dAha lAgela ANi allAhakherIja koNI tumacyA madatIlA ubhA rAhU zakaNAra nAhI, ANi nA tumhAlA madata dilI jAIla.
ANi divasAcyA donhI kinAr2yAMvara namAja kAyama rAkhA, ANi rAtrIcyA kAhI bhAgAtahI. niHsaMzaya satkarme vAITa goSTIMnA dUra karatAta. hA upadeza Ahe, bodha prApta karaNAr2yAMkaritA.
ANi tumhI dhIra-saMyama rAkhA. niHsaMzaya allAha satkarma karaNAr2yAMcA mobadalA vAyA jAU deta nAhI.

jevhA tumacyA pUrvIcyA kALAtIla lokAMpaikI ase bhalAI karaNAre loka kA nAhI jhAleta, jyAMnI dharatIvara phasAda (utpAta) pasaraviNyAsa pratibaMdha ghAtalA asatA, jyA thoDyA lokAMkherIja jyAMnA AmhI tyAMcyApaikI suTakA pradAna kelI hotI. atyArArI loka tara tyA goSTIcyA mAge lAgale, jyAta tyAMnA susaMpanna kele gele hote ANi te durAcArI hote.
tumacA pAlanakartA asA nAhI kI ekhAdyA vastIlA atyAcArapUrvaka naSTa karUna TAkIla, jevhA kI tithale loka allAhace bhaya rAkhaNAre asAveta.
ANi jara tumacyA pAlanakartyAne icchile asate tara samasta lokAMnA ekA mArgAvara (cAlaNArA) eka janasamudAya banavilA asatA. te tara nehamI virodha karaNAreca rAhatIla.

tyAMcyAkherIja, jyAMcyAvara tumacA pAlanakartA dayA karIla, tyAMnA tara yAsAThI nirmANa kele gele Ahe ANi tumacyA pAlanakartyAce he pharmAna pUrNa jhAlyAvinA rAhaNAra nAhI kI mI jahannamalA jinna ANi mAnava sarvAMnI bharUna TAkIna.
ANi paigaMbarAMce sarva vRttAMta AmhI tumacyAsamora, tumacyA manAlA zAMtI lAbhAvI yAsAThI sAMgata Ahota. tumacyAjavaLa yA adhyAyAtahI satya pohacale, je ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMkaritA bodha-upadeza Ahe.
ANi ImAna na rAkhaNAr2yAMnA sAMgUna TAkA kI tumhI ApalyA ThikANI kAma karIta rAhA. AmhIhI karmAMmadhye magna Ahota.
ANi tumhIhI pratikSA karA, AmhIhI pratikSA karIta Ahota.

ANi AkAzAMce va jaminIce parokSa jJAna kevaLa allAhalA Ahe. ANi samasta kAryAMce paratanehI tyAcyAcakaDe Ahe. yAstava tumhI tyAcIca upAsanA kelI pAhije ANi tyAcyAvaraca bharosA rAkhalA pAhije ANi tumhI je kAhI karatA, tyApAsUna allAha anabhijJa nAhI.
alipha. lAma. raॉ yA spaSTa graMthAcyA AyatI Aheta.
niHsaMzaya, AmhI he arabI kuraAna avatarIta kele Ahe, yAsAThI kI tumhI samajU zakAve.

AmhI tumacyAsamora sarvAMta uttama nivedana prastuta karato, yA kAraNAstava kI AmhI ApalyAkaDe hA kuraAna vahayI (avatarita saMdezA) dvAre utaravilA Ahe ANi niHsaMzaya yAcyApUrvI tumhI na jANaNAr2yAMpaikI hote.
jevhA yUsupha ApalyA pityAsa mhaNAle, he pitA! mI akarA tAr2yAMnA ANi sUrya-caMdrAlA pAhile kI te sarva malA sajadA karIta Aheta.
(yAkUba) mhaNAle, he mAjhyA priya putrA! ApalyA yA svapnAcI carcA ApalyA bhAvAMjavaLa karU nakosa, ase na vhAve kI tyAMnI tujhyAzI kAhI kapaTa karAve. saitAna tara mAnavAcA ughaDa zatrU Ahe.

ANi azA prakAre tumacA pAlanakartA tumacI nivaDa karela ANi tumhAlA ghaTanA va mAmalyAcA khulAsA (arthAta svapnaphala) sAMgaNyAcI zikavaNa deIla ANi ApalI kRpA-deNagI tumhAlA pUrNataH pradAna karIla, ANi yAkUbacyA parivArAlAhI, jazI tyAne yApUrvI tumacyA dona pUrvajAMnA arthAta ibrAhIma ANi isahAkalAhI bharapUra kRpA-deNagI pradAna kelI. niHsaMzaya tumacA pAlanakartA moThA jJAna bALagaNArA ANi hikamatazAhI Ahe.
niHsaMzaya, yUsupha ANi tyAcyA bhAvAMmadhye vicAraNAr2yAMkaritA moThyA nizANyA Aheta.
jevhA yUsuphace bhAU mhaNAle, yUsupha ANi tyAcA bhAU AmacyA pityAlA AmacyApekSA jAsta priya Aheta, vAstavika AmhI loka eka zaktizAlI jamAta Ahota. nizcitaca Amace pitA spaSTa cUka karIta Aheta.
yUsuphacI hatyA karUna TAkA kiMvA tyAlA ekhAdyA (ajJAta) sthaLI pohacavA, yAsAThI kI tumacyA pityAce dhyAna tumacyAkaDe vhAve. tyAnaMtara tumhI neka sadAcArI vhA.

tyAMcyApaikI ekajaNa mhaNAlA, yUsuphacI hatyA karU nakA, kiMbahunA tyAlA ekhAdyA osADa vihirIcyA taLAzI TAkUna dyA, yAsAThI kI tyAlA ekhAdyA pravAzI kAphilyAne ucalUna nyAve. jara tumhAlA kAhI karAyaceca Ahe tara aseca karA.
te mhaNAle, he pitA! zevaTI tumhI yUsuphacyA bAbatIta AmacyAvara vizvAsa kA nAhI Thevata, AmhI tara tyAce hitaciMtaka Ahota.
udyA tumhI tyAlA avazya AmacyAsobata pAThavA, yAsAThI kI tyAne khUpa khAve pyAve ANi kheLAve. tyAcyA saMrakSaNAcI jabAbadArI AmhI gheto.
(yAkUba) mhaNAle, tumace tyAlA gheUna jANe mAjhyAsAThI phAra duHkhadAyaka Tharela. malA he bhayadekhIla lAgUna rAhIla kI tumacyA gAphIlapaNAmuLe tyAlA lAMDagA khAUna TAkIla.
tyAMnI uttara dile, AmacyAsArakhyA moThyA zaktizAlI samUhAcyA upasthitIta jara tyAlA lAMDagA khAUna TAkIla tara AmhI agadI nikAmI TharU.

maga jevhA tyAlA gheUna nighAle ANi sarvAMnI miLUna dRDhanizcaya kelA kI tyAlA osADa va khUpa khola azA vihirIcyA taLAzI phekUna dyAve. AmhI yUsuphakaDe vahayI (IzasaMdeza) pAThavilI kI niHsaMzaya (AtA tI veLa yeta Ahe) kI tumhI tyAMnA yA goSTIcI khabara azA sthitIta sAMgAla kI te jANatahI nasatIla.
ANi rAtrI (izA) cyA veLesa (te sarva) ApalyA pityAjavaLa raData raData pohocale.

ANi mhaNU lAgale kI priya pitA! AmhI ApasAta dhAvaNyAcyA zaryatIta lAgalo, ANi yUsuphalA AmacyA sAmAnAjavaLa soDale tevhA lAMDagyAne tyAlA khAUna TAkale. tumhI tara AmacyA bolaNyAvara vizvAsa ThevaNAra nAhI, maga AmhI purepUra sacce asalo tarI.

ANi yUsuphacA sadarA khoTyA raktAne bhijavUna ANalA. (pitA) mhaNAle, (ase nAhI ghaDale) kiMbahunA tumhI ApalyA manAne eka goSTa racalI Ahe, AtA saburI karaNeca uttama Ahe ANi tumacyA managaDhata goSTIMvara allAhazIca madatIcI prArthanA (duA) Ahe.

ANi eka pravAsI kAphilA AlA ANi tyAMnI ApalyA pANI ANaNAr2yAlA pAThavile, tyAne ApalA Dola (bAdalI) vihIrIta TAkalA, ud‌gAralA, vAhavA! kAya AnaMdAcI goSTa Ahe! hA tara eka bAlaka Ahe. tyAMnI tyAlA vyApAra-sAmugrI samajUna lapavile ANi je kAhI te karIta hote, allAha cAMgale jANUna hotA.
ANi tyAMnI tyAlA phAraca thoDyA kiMmatIta (arthAta) kAhI mojakyA diramAMvara vikUna TAkale. te tara yUsuphacyA bAbatIta adhika rucihIna hote.

ANi misra dezAcyA lokAMpaikI, jyAne tyAlA kharedI kele hote, to ApalyA patnIsa mhaNAlA kI yAlA Adara-sanmAnapUrvaka ThevA. saMbhavataH hA AmhAlA lAbha pohacavIla kiMvA AmhI yAlA ApalA putraca banavUna gheU. azA prakAre AmhI (misracyA) dharatIvara yUsuphace pAya sthira kele, yAsAThI kI AmhI tyAlA svapnAcA khulAsA sAMgaNyAce kAhI jJAna zikavAve allAha ApalyA irAdyAlA pUrNa karaNyAce sAmarthya rAkhato, paraMtu adhikAMza loka anabhijJa asatAta.
ANi jevhA (yUsupha) pUrNa tAruNyAvasthesa pohocale, AmhI tyAMnA phaisalA karaNyAce sAmarthya ANi jJAna pradAna kele, AmhI bhalAI karaNAr2yAMnA azAca prakAre mobadalA deto.

ANi tyA strIne, jicyA gharI yUsupha hote, yUsuphalA phusalAvaNe surU kele, jeNekarUna tyAne ApalyA manAvara tAbA ThevaNe soDUna dyAve ANi dAra baMda karUna tI mhaNU lAgalI, yA (javaLa) yA. (yUsupha) mhaNAle, allAha rakSaNa karo! to mAjhA pAlanakartA Ahe. tyAne malA khUpa cAMgalyA prakAre Thevale Ahe. nizcitaca anyAya karaNAr2yAMce kadApi bhale hota nAhI.

ANi tyA strIne yUsuphacI icchA dharalI ANi yUsuphanehI ticI icchA dharalI asatI jara tyAMnI ApalyA pAlanakartyAce pramANa pAhUna ghetale nasate. aseca ghaDale, yAsAThI kI AmhI yUsuphapAsUna duSkarma ANi nirlajjatA dUra karAvI. niHsaMzaya te AmacyA nivaDaka dAsAMpaikI hote.

ANi doghejaNa dArAkaDe dhAvale. tyA strIne yUsuphace vastra (sadarA) mAgacyA bAjUne oDhUna phADale ANi tyA strIcA patI doghAMnA dArAzIca miLAlA, tevhA tI mhaNU lAgalI kI jo manuSya tumacyA patnIzI vAITa icchA dharela, tyAcI zikSA hIca Ahe kI tyAlA kaidI banavile jAve kiMvA dusarI ekhAdI kaThora zikSA dilI jAvI.

(yUsupha) mhaNAle, hI strIca malA phUsa lAvUna (mAjhyA manokAmanAcyA rakSaNAta beparvA karU) icchita hotI ANi strIcyA samAjAcyA ekA mANasAne sAkSa dilI kI jara tyAcA sadarA puDhacyA bAjUne phATalA asela tara strI (ApalyA kathanAta) kharI Ahe ANi yUsupha khoTe bolaNAr2yAMpaikI Ahe.
ANi jara tyAcA sadarA mAgacyA bAjUne phADalA gelA Ahe, tara strI khoTI Ahe ANi yUsupha khar2yAMpaikI Ahe.
tara patIne jevhA pAhile kI sadarA mAgacyA bAjUne phATalA Ahe, tevhA spaSTa sAMgitale kI hI tara tumhA striyAMcI cAla Ahe. niHsaMzaya tumace DAvapeca moThe bhArI Aheta.
yUsupha, AtA yA goSTIlA dRSTIADa karA ANi (he strI!) ApalyA aparAdhAMcI kSamA mAga. niHsaMzaya tU aparAdhyAMpaikI Ahesa.

ANi maga zaharAtalyA striyAMmadhye carcA hoU lAgalI kI ajIjacI patnI ApalyA (taruNa) gulAmAlA ApalI garaja pUrNa karaNyAsAThI bahakaviNyAta va phusalAviNyAta lAgalelI asate. ticyA manAta yUsuphace prema (ThANa mAMDUna) basale Ahe. AmacyA mate tara tI ughaDa cUka karIta Ahe.

tine jevhA tyAMcI hI kutsita niMdA aikalI, tevhA tyAMnA (bhojanAsAThI) AmaMtrita kele ANi tyAMcyAsAThI ekA sabhecA itamAmahI kelA ANi tyAMcyApaikI pratyekIlA eka eka cAkU dilA ANi mhaNAlI, he yUsupha! yAMcyA samora yA. tyA striyAMnI jevhA tyAMnA pAhile tevhA khUpa moThe jANale ANi (nakaLata) Apale hAta kApUna ghetale ANi tyA ud‌gAralyA, pAkI (pavitratA) allAhakaritA Ahe. r2a manuSya kadApi nAhI. hA tara khAtrIne koNI phAra moThA phariztA Ahe.

(tyA veLI misracyA ajIjacI patnI) mhaNAlI, hAca to, jyAcyAviSayI tumhI malA bare-vAITa bolata hotyA. mI sarva prakAre yAcyAkaDUna ApalI icchA pUrNa karU icchile, paraMtu hA niSkalaMka rAhilA ANi je kAhI mI yAlA sAMgata Ahe, jara te hA karaNAra nAhI tara nizcitaca yAlA kaidI banavile jAIla ANi khAtrIne hA moThA apamAnita hoIla.

yUsupha mhaNAle, he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! jyA goSTIkaDe yA striyA malA bolAvita Aheta, tyApekSA kArAgRha malA jAsta priya Ahe. jara tU yAMce kapaTa (mohajAla) mAjhyApAsUna dUra kele nAhIsa tara mI yAMcyAkaDe AkarSita hoIna ANi agadI mUrkhAMmadhye sAmIla hoIna.
tyAMcyA pAlanakartyAne tyAMcI duA (prArthanA) svIkAralI ANi tyA striyAMcyA kapaTApAsUna yUsuphalA vAcavile. niHsaMzaya to aikaNArA ANi jANaNArA Ahe.
maga tyA sarva nizANyAMnA pAhUna ghetalyAvara tyAMnA heca bhale vATale kI yUsuphalA kAhI kALa kArAgRhAta ThevAve.

ANi tyAMcyAsobata itara dona taruNa kArAgRhAta Ale. tyAMcyApaikI ekajaNa mhaNAlA, mI svapnAta svataHlA dAru gALatAnA pAhile Ahe, ANi dusarA mhaNAlA, mI svapnAta kAya pAhato kI mI ApalyA DokyAvara bhAkarI ThevalyA Aheta, jyAMnA pakSI khAta Aheta. tumhI yAcA artha (khulAsA) AmhAlA sAMgAvA. AmhAlA tara tumhI guNavAna disatA.

(yUsupha) mhaNAle, tumhAlA je bhojana dile jAte, te tumacyAjavaLa pohacaNyApUrvIca mI tumhAlA tyAcA khulAsA sAMgene, he sarva kAhI tyA jJAnAmuLe Ahe je malA mAjhyA pAlanakartyAne zikavile Ahe. mI tyA lokAMcA dIna (dharma) soDalA Ahe, je allAhavara ImAna rAkhata nAhI ANi AkhiratalAhI mAnya karIta nAhI.

mI ApalyA pityA ANi pUrvajAMcyA (dharmA) cA anuyAyI Ahe. arthAta isahAka ANi yAkUba (cyA dIna) cA. AmhAlA he kadhIhI mAnya nAhI kI AmhI allAhasobata anya ekhAdyAlA sahabhAgI TharavAve. AmacyAvara ANi itara sarva lokAMvara allAhacI hI vizeSa kRpA Ahe. paraMtu adhikAMza loka kRtaghna asatAta.
he mAjhyA kArAgRhAtIla sAthIdArAMno! kAya aneka prakAracI aneka upAsye cAMgalI Aheta kI eka jabaradasta zaktizAlI allAha cAMgalA?

tyAcyAkherIja jyAMcI upAsanA tumhI karIta AhAta te sarva nAvApurateca Aheta, jyAMnA tumhI ANi tumacyA pUrvajAMnI manAne racUna ghetale Ahe. sarvazreSTha allAhane yAMcA koNatAhI purAvA avatarita kelA nAhI. phaisalA deNe allAhaceca kAma Ahe. tyAcA Adeza Ahe kI tumhI sarva tyAcyAzivAya koNAcIhI bhaktI- upAsanA karU nakA. hAca satya dharma Ahe, paraMtu adhikAMza loka jANata nAhIta.

he kArAgRhAtIla mAjhyA sAthIdArAMno! tumhA doghAMpaikI eka tara ApalyA svAmIlA madya pAjaNyAsAThI niyukta kelA jAIla, paraMtu dusar2yAlA phAsAvara laTakavile jAIla ANi pakSI tyAce Doke Toca mArUna mArUna khAtIla. tumhI doghe jyAviSayI vicArata hote tyAcA phaisalA jhAlA.

ANi jyAcyAviSayI yUsuphacI kalpanA hotI kI doghAMpaikI jyAlA suTakA miLela, tyAlA mhaNAle, ApalyA rAjAjavaLa mAjhIhI carcA kara. maga saitAnAne tyAlA rAjAjavaLa bolaNyAcA visara pADalA ANi yUsuphalA aneka varSe kArAgRhAta rAhAve lAgale.

ANi rAjAne sAMgitale, mI svapna pAhile kI sAta dhaSTapuSTa gAyI Aheta, jyAMnA sAta dubaLyA gAyI khAta Aheta ANi sAta hiravI kaNase Aheta tara dusarI sAta kaNase agadI sukalelI. he darabArI lokAMno! mAjhyA yA svapnAcA khulAsA sAMgA, jara tumhI svapnaphala sAMgU zakata asAla.
darabArI lokAMnI uttara dile, hI tara visakaTalelyA (vicArAMcI) svapne Aheta ANi azA prakAracyA vyagracitta svapnAMcA khulAsA AmhI jANata nAhI.
ANi tyA kaidyAMpaikI suTakA jhAlelyAlA akasmAta AThavaNa jhAlI, ANi to mhaNU lAgalA, mI tumhAlA yAcA khulAsA yeUna sAMgato. malA jANyAcI paravAnagI dyAvI.

he yUsupha! he agadI sacce yUsupha! tumhI AmhAlA yA svapnAcA khulAsA sAMgA kI sAta dhaSTapuSTa gAyI Aheta, jyAMnA sAta dubaLyA gAyI khAta Aheta ANi sAta agadI hiravI kaNase Aheta ANi dusarI sAta kaNase agadI sukalelI Aheta. yAsAThI kI mI parata jAUna tyA lokAMnA sAMgAve kI tyA sarvAMnI jANUna ghyAve.
(yUsupha yAMnI) uttara dile kI tumhI satata sAta varSe savayInusAra dhAnya perA ANi (pIka AlyAvara) tyAcI kApaNI karUna kaNasAMsameta rAhU dyA. ApalyA khANyAsAThI thoDyA saMkhyezivAya.
tyAnaMtaracI sAta varSe moThyA duSkALAcI yetIla tI te dhAnya khAUna TAkatIla je tumhI tyAMcyAsAThI jamA karUna Thevale hote. tyAzivAya je thoDese tumhI rokhUna ThevAla.
maga yAcyAnaMtara je varSa yeIla, tyAta lokAMsAThI khUpa pAUsa paDela ANi tyAta te (drAkSAcA rasadekhIla) khUpa gALatIla.

ANi rAjA mhaNAlA, tyAlA (yUsuphalA) mAjhyAjavaLa ANA. jevhA saMdeza pohacaviNArA yUsuphajavaLa pohocalA tevhA yUsupha mhaNAle, ApalyA rAjAkaDe parata jA ANi tyAMnA vicArA kI tyA striyAMcI kharI kahANI kAya Ahe, jyAMnI Apale hAta kApUna ghetale hote. tyAMce kapaTa cAMgalyA prakAre jANaNArA mAjhA pAlanakartAca Ahe.

(rAjAne) vicArale, he striyAMno! tyA veLacI kharI kahANI kAya Ahe, jevhA tumhI kapaTa karUna yUsuphalA tyAcyA manApAsUna bahakavU icchita hotyA? tyAMnI spaSTa uttara dile kI (allAha jANato) AmhI yUsuphamadhye koNAtahI vAITa guNa pAhilA nAhI, maga tara ajIjacI patnIhI ud‌gAralI, AtA tara satya ughaDakIsa Aleca Ahe. mIca tyAlA bahakaviNayAcA prayatna kelA hotA tyAcyA manApAsUna (vicalita karaNyAcA) ANi niHsaMzaya to khar2yA lokAMpaikI Ahe.
he yA kAraNAstava kI (ajIja) lA mAhIta vhAve kI mI tyAcyAzI vizvAsaghAta kelA nAhI ANi hehI kI allAha kapaTa karaNAr2yAMcA DAva saphala hoU deta nAhI.

ANi mI ApalyA manAcyA pAvitryAce varNana karIta nAhI, niHsaMzaya, mana tara vAITa goSTIcIca preraNAra deNAre Ahe, paraMtu he kI mAjhA pAlanakartAca ApalI dayA- kRpA karIla. nizcitaca mAjhA pAlanakartA mApha karaNArA, dayA karaNArA Ahe.

ANi bAdazahA mhaNAlA, tyAlA mAjhyA samora ANA kI mI tyAlA ApalyA vyaktigata kAmAMkaritA nemUna ghyAve. maga jevhA tyAcyAzI vArtAlApa karU lAgalA, tevhA mhaNAlA, tumhI AjapAsUna Amace yethe sanmAnita ANi vizvasanIya (amAnatadAra) AhAta.
(yUsupha) mhaNAle, tumhI malA dezAcyA khajInyAvara niyukta karA. mI saMrakSaka ANi jANakAra Ahe.

ANi azA prakAre AmhI yUsuphalA dezAcA sUtradhAra banavile kI tyAne vATela tithe rAhAve. AmhI jyAlA icchito, tyAcyAparyaMta ApalI dayA- kRpA pohacavito, ANi AmhI satkarma karaNAr2yAMcyA AcaraNAce phaLa vAyA jAU deta nAhI.
ANi niHsaMzaya ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMcA ANi durAcArApAsUna dUra rAhaNAr2yAMcA AkhiratacA mobadalA kitItarI cAMgalA Ahe.
ANi yUsuphace bhAU Ale ANi yUsuphajavaLa gele tevhA yUsuphane tyAMnA oLakhUna ghetale, paraMtu tyAMnI tyAlA oLakhale nAhI.

ANi jevhA tyAMce sAmAna tayAra kele gele tevhA yUsupha mhaNAle, tumhI mAjhyAjavaLa ApalyA tyA bhAvAlA ANA, jo tumacyA pityApAsUna Ahe, kAya tumhI nAhI pAhile kI mI mApahI purepUra deto ANi atithIce cAMgalyA prakAre AdarAtithya karaNAr2yAMpaikI Ahe.
paraMtu jara tumhI tyAlA mAjhyAjavaLa ANale nAhI tara mAjhyAkaDUna tumhAlA kasalehI mApa miLaNAra nAhI, kiMbahunA tumhI mAjhyAjavaLahI yeU zakaNAra nAhIta.
te mhaNAle, ThIka Ahe, AmhI tyAcyA pityAzI yA saMdarbhAta goDIgulAbIne bolUna pUrNa prayatna karU.

ANi ApalyA sevakAMnA sAMgitale kI tyAMcA mAla (dhana) tyAMcyAca potyAMmadhye ThevUna dyA kI jevhA paratUna ApalyA kuTuMbAta jAtIla tevhA Apale dhana oLakhUna ghetIla, phAra zakya Ahe kI te punhA yetIla.

jevhA te loka paratUna ApalyA pityAjavaLa gele tevhA mhaNU lAgale, AmhAlA tara dhAnya deNyAvara pratibaMdha ghAtalA gelA. AtA tumhI AmacyAsobata bhAvAlA pAThavA kI AmhI mApa bharUna ANAve. AmhI tyAcyA rakSaNAcI hamI deto.

(yAkUba) mhaNAle, kAya mI yAcyA bAbatIta tumacyAvara tasAca vizvAsa ThevU jasA yApUrvI yAcyA bhAvAbAbata vizvAsa ThevalA? sarvazreSTha allAhaca sarvAMta uttama saMrakSaka Ahe ANi to samasta kRpAvAnAMmadhye jAsta kRpAvAna Ahe.

ANi jevhA tyAMnI Apale sAmAna ughaDale tevhA tyAta tyAMnA ApalI rakkama ADhaLalI, jI tyAMnA parata kelI gelI hotI. mhaNAle, he pitA! AmhAlA ANakhI kAya pAhije? hI AmacI rakkama AmhAlA parata kelI gelI Ahe ANi AmhI ApalyA kuTuMbAkaritA dhAnya ANUna deU ANi ApalyA bhAvAce rakSaNa karU ANi eka uMTAce mApa jAsta ANU. he mApa tara jAsta sope Ahe.

(yAkUba) mhaNAle, mI tara tyAlA tumacyAsobata kadhIhI pAThaviNAra nAhI, joparyaMta tumhI allAhalA madhyasthI ThevUna malA vacana dyAla kI tumhI tyAlA mAjhyAjavaLa pocavAla, yAkherIja kI tumhI sarva kaidI banavile jAla. jevhA tyAMnI pakke vacana dile tevhA te mhaNAle kI AmhI je kAhI bolata Ahota, allAha tyAcA saMrakSaka Ahe.

ANi (yAkUba) mhaNAle, he mAjhyA mulAMno! tumhI sarva ekAca dArAtUna praveza karU nakA, kiMbahunA aneka dArAMmadhUna vegavegaLe hoUna praveza karA. mI allAhatarphe AlelyA koNatyAhI goSTIlA tumacyA varUna TALU zakata nAhI. Adeza kevaLa allAhacAca cAlato, mAjhA saMpUrNa vizvAsa tyAcyAvaraca Ahe ANi pratyeka bharosA ThevaNAr2yAne tyAcyAvaraca bharosA ThevalA pAhije.

ANi jevhA te tyAca mArgAMnI, jyAMcA Adeza tyAMcyA pityAne dilA hotA, gele, kAhIca navhate kI allAhane jI goSTa nizcita kelI Ahe, ticyApAsUna te tyAMnA kiMcitahI vAcavatIla. tathApi yAkUbacyA manAta eka vicAra AlA, jo tyAne pUrNa kelA. niHsaMzaya te AmhI zikavilelyA tyA jJAnAne saMpanna hote, paraMtu adhikAMza loka jANata nAhIta.
ANi te sarva yUsuphajavaLa pohocale, tevhA yUsuphane ApalyA bhAvAlA ApalyAjavaLa basavile ANi mhaTale, mI tujhA bhAU (yUsupha) Ahe, AtApAveto he je kAhI karata rAhile, tyAbaddala duHkha karU nakosa.

maga jevhA tyAMce sAmAna (dhAnyAne bharUna) tayAra kele tevhA ApalyA bhAvAcyA sAmAnAta ApalA pANI piNyAcA pyAlA ThevUna dilA, maga ekA ailAna karaNAr2yAne ailAna kele, he kAphilAvAlyAMno! tumhI loka tara cora AhAta!
tyAMnI tyAcyAkaDe toMDa phiravUna mhaTale, tumacI koNatI vastU haravalI Ahe?
uttara dile kI zAhI pyAlA haravalA Ahe, jo to gheUna yeIla tyAlA eka uMTAce ojhe itake dhAnya miLela. yA vacanAcI mI hamI deto.
te mhaNAle, allAhacI zapatha! tumhI cAMgalyA prakAre jANatA kI AmhI dezAta upadrava nirmANa karaNyAsAThI Alo nAhIta ANi nA AmhI cora Ahota.
te mhaNAle, bare corIcI kAya zikSA Ahe jara tumhI khoTe TharAla.
uttara dile, yAcI zikSA hIca kI jyAcyA sAmAnyAta to pyAlA ADhaLUna yeIla toca tyAcyA badalI Ahe. AmhI tara atyAcArIMnA hIca zikSA deta asato.

maga (yUsupha) ne ApalyA bhAvAce sAmAna tapAsaNyApUrvI dusar2yAMce sAmAna tapAsAyalA suruvAta kelI, maga tyAne piNyAcA pyAlA ApalyA bhAvAcyA sAmAnAtUna kADhalA. AmhI yUsuphakaritA azA prakAre hI yojanA banavilI. tyA bAdazahAcyA kAyadyAnusAra to ApalyA bhAvAlA (rokhUna) ThevU zakata navhatA, paraMtu he kI allAhalA maMjUra asela. AmhI jyAlA icchito tyAcA darjA bulaMda karato. pratyeka jJAna rAkhaNAr2yAvara (moThepaNAta) eka moThA jJAnI astitvAta Ahe.

te mhaNAle, jara yAne corI kelI Ahe tara (navalAcI goSTa navhe) yAcyA bhAvAnehI yApUrvI corI kelI Ahe. yUsuphane hI goSTa ApalyA manAta ThevalI ANi tyAMcyAsamora agadI jAhIra kele nAhI, mhaTale kI tumhI vAITa ThikANI AhAta ANi je kAhI tumhI sAMgata AhAta allAha te cAMgalyA prakAre jANato.
te mhaNAle, he misra dezAcA sarvAdhikAra rAkhaNAre! yAce pitA atizaya vRddha manuSya Aheta. tumhI yAcyAaivajI AmacyApaikI ekhAdyAlA ThevUna ghyA. AmhI ase pAhato kI tumhI moThe sajjana manuSya AhAta.
(yUsupha) mhaNAle kI AmhAlA jyAcyAjavaLa AmacI vastU ADhaLUna AlI Ahe tyAlA soDUna dusar2yAMnA baMdI banaviNyApAsUna allAhace zaraNa icchito. ase kelyAne nizcitaca AmhI anyAya karaNAr2yAMpaikI TharU.

jevhA he, yUsuphakaDUna nirAza jhAle, tevhA ekAMtAta basUna sallAmasalata karU lAgale. tyAMcyApaikI jo sarvAMta moThA hotA to mhaNAlA kI tumhAlA mAhIta nAhI kI tumacyA pityAne tumacyAkaDUna allAhalA madhyasthI ThevUna pakke vacana ghetale Ahe ANi yAcyApUrvI tumhI yUsuphaviSayI aparAdha kelelA Ahe. AtA mI tara bhUmItUna pAya kADhaNAra nAhI, joparyaMta pitA svataH malA anumatI deta nAhIta kiMvA sarvazreSTha allAha mAjhyA yA samasyecA phaisalA karIla. toca sarvottama zAsaka Ahe.
tumhI sarva pityAcyA seveta parata jA ANi sAMgA kI he pitA! tumacyA putrAne corI kelI ANi AmhI tIca sAkSa dilI, jI AmhI jANata hoto. AmhI kAhI parokSa (gaiba) ce rakSaNa karaNAre tara navhato.
ANi tumhI tyA zaharAcyA lokAMnA vicArA, jithe AmhI hoto ANi tyA pravAzAMnAhI vicArA jyAMcyAsobata AmhI Alo Ahota ANi niHsaMzaya AmhI pUrNapaNe sacce Ahota.

(yAkUba) mhaNAle, ase nAhI, kiMbahunA tumhI ApalyAtarphe eka goSTa racUna ghetalI, tevhA AtA saMyama rAkhaNeca uttama Ahe. saMbhavataH sarvazreSTha allAha tyA sarvAMnA mAjhyAjavaLa pohacavila. toca jJAnI ANi hikamatazAlI Ahe.
ANi maga (yAkUbane) tyAMcyAkaDUna toMDa phiravUna ghetale ANi mhaTale, arere, yUsupha! tyAMce DoLe duHkhAtirekAne pAMDhare jhAle hote ANi te yA duHkhAlA sahana karIta hote.
(putra) mhaNAle, allAhacI zapatha! tumhI nehamI yUsuphacyA AThavaNIta bhAna harapUna rAhAla yetheparyaMta kI agadI gaLUna jAla kiMvA maraNa pAvAla.
(yAkUba) mhaNAle, mI tara ApalyA saMkaTa ANi duHkhAce gAr2hANe allAhajavaLa mAMData Ahe. malA allAhatarphe tyA goSTIMce jJAna prApta Ahe, jyAMcyAbAbata tumhI anabhijJa AhAta.

mAjhyA priya putrAMno! tumhI jA ANi yUsupha ANi tyAcyA bhAvAcA cAMgalyA prakAre zodha ghyA ANi allAhacyA dayepAsUna nirAza hoU nakA. niHsaMzaya, allAhacyA dayA-kRpepAsUna teca loka nirAza hotAta je kAphira (inkArI) asatAta.

maga jevhA he loka yUsuphajavaLa pohocale, tevhA mhaNU lAgale kI he ajIja! AmhI ANi Amace kuTuMba atizaya aDacaNIta Ahe, AmhI thoDIzI tuccha puMjI ANalI Ahe, paraMtu tumhI AmhAlA dhAnyAce pUrNa mApa deUna TAkA ANi AmhAlA dAna mhaNUna dyA. nizcitaca allAha dAna deNAr2yAMnA cAMgalA mobadalA deto.
(yUsupha) mhaNAle, tumacyA dhyAnAta tarI Ahe kA kI tumhI yUsupha ANi tyAcyA bhAvAzI ApalyA nAdAnapaNAta kAya kAya kele?

te mhaNAle, kAya (kharokhara) tUca yUsupha Ahesa? uttara dile, hoya! mIca to yUsupha ANi hA mAjhA bhAU Ahe. allAhane AmacyAvara dayA ANi kRpA kelI. kharI goSTa azI kI jo koNI allAhace bhaya rAkhUna durAcArApAsUna alipta rAhIla ANi dhIra-saMyama rAkhIla tara allAha ekhAdyA satkarma karaNAr2yAcA mobadalA vAyA jAU deta nAhI.
te mhaNAle, allAhacI zapatha! allAhane tulA AmacyAvara zreSThatA pradAna kelI Ahe ANi hehI satya Ahe kI AmhI aparAdhI Ahota.
uttara dile, Aja tumacyAvara kasalAhI Aropa nAhI, allAha tumhAlA mApha karo, to tara samasta dayA karaNAr2yAMmadhye sarvAta moThA dayA karaNArA Ahe.
mAjhA hA sadarA tumhI gheUna jA ANi to mAjhyA pityAcyA toMDAvara TAkA kI (jyAmuLe) te pAhU lAgatIla ANi yetIla ANi ApalyA saMpUrNa kuTuMbAlA mAjhyAjavaLa gheUna yA.
ANi jevhA hA kAphilA (mAyadezI) nighAlA, tevhA tyAMce pitA (yAkUba) mhaNAle, malA yUsuphacA sugaMdha yeta Ahe, jara tumhI malA mUrkha samajata nasAla.
(putra) mhaNU lAgale kI allAhacI zapatha! tumhI tara ajUnahI ApalyA tyAca junyA cukIvara kAyama AhAta!

jevhA zubha samAcAra deNAr2yAne pohocUna tyAMcyA toMDAvara to sadarA TAkalA, tyAca kSaNI tyAMnA punazca disU lAgale. mhaNAle kI, kAya mI tumhAlA sAMgata navhato kI mI allAhatarphe tyA goSTI jANato, jyA tumhI nAhI jANata.
te mhaNAle, he pitA! tumhI AmacyA aparAdhAMcI kSamA-yAcanA (mAphIcI duA) karA. niHsaMzaya AmhI aparAdhI Ahota.
mhaNAle, ThIka Ahe. mI lavakaraca tumacyAsAThI ApalyA pAlanakartyAjavaLa mAphIcI duA-prArthanA karena. nizcitaca to moThA kSamAzIla, ANi atizaya dayAvAna Ahe.
jevhA hA samasta parivAra yUsuphajavaLa pohocalA, tevhA yUsuphane ApalyA mAtA-pityAsa ApalyAjavaLa jAgA dilI ANi mhaTale, allAhane icchilyAsa tumhI sarva misra dezAta sukha-zAMtIpUrvaka rAhAla.

ANi ApalyA siMhAsanAvara ApalyA mAtA-pityAsa uccasthAnI basavile ANi sarva tyAcyAsamora sajadyAta paDale ANi sarva mhaNAle, he pitA! hA mAjhyA pahilyA svapnAcA khulAsA Ahe, mAjhyA pAlanakartyAne to pUrNa karUna dAkhavilA. tyAne mAjhyAvara phAra moThA upakAra kelA, kI jevhA malA kaidakhAnyAtUna bAhera kADhale ANi tumhI lokAMnA vALavaMTAtUna yethe ANale tyA matabhedAnaMtara, jo saitAnAne mAjhyA ANi mAjhyA bhAvAMcyA daramyAna nirmANa kelA hotA. mAjhA pAlanakartA, jyAcyAsAThI icchito, tyAcyAsAThI uttama upAyayojanA karato. niHsaMzaya to moThA jANaNArA, hikamata bALagaNArA Ahe.

he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! tU malA rAjya (sattAdhikAra) pradAna kelA ANi malA svapnAMcA artha lAvaNyAce jJAna dile. he AkAzAMcA va dharatIcA nirmANakartA! tUca yA jagAta ANi Akhiratamadhye mAjhA mitra ANi madata karaNArA Ahesa. tU malA islAmacyA avastheta mRtyu de ANi malA nekI karaNAr2yAMmadhye sAmIla kara.

he parokSA (gaiba) cyA khabarIMpaikI Ahe, je AmhI tumacyAkaDe vahayI karIta Ahota ANi tumhI tyAMcyAjavaLa navhate jevhA tyAMnI ApalA beta pakkA karUna ghetalA hotA ANi te kapaTa kArasthAna karU lAgale hote.
tumhI kitIhI icchA dharA, paNa adhikAMza loka ImAna rAkhaNAra nAhIta.
ANi tumhI tyAMcyAkaDUna yAbaddala kAhI majUrI mAgata nAhI, hA tara samasta vizvAkaritA bodha-upadeza Ahe.
ANi AkAzAMmadhye ANi dharatIta aneka nizANyA Aheta, jyAMcyApAsUna he loka toMDa phiravUna nighUna jAtAta.
ANi tyAMcyApaikI bahuteka loka allAhavara ImAna rAkhata asatAnAhI zirka karaNAre Aheta.
kAya te yA goSTIpAsUna nirbhaya jhAle Aheta kI tyAMcyAjavaLa allAhacyA zikSA-yAtanAMpaikI ekhAdI sarvasAmAnya zikSA yAvI kiMvA tyAMcyAvara acAnaka kayAmata yeUna kosaLAvI ANi te gAphIla asAveta.
(tumhI) sAMgA, mAjhA hAca mArga Ahe. mI ANi mAjhe anuyAyI allAhakaDe bolAvita Aheta pUrNa vizvAsa ANi zraddhesaha ANi allAha pavitra Ahe ANi mI anekezvaravAdyAMpaikI nAhI.

ANi tumacyApUrvI AmhI vastIvAlyAMmadhye jevaDhedekhIla paigaMbara pAThavile te sarva puruSaca hote, jyAMcyAkaDe AmhI vahayI (prakAzanA) utaravita rAhilI kAya dharatIvara yA lokAMnI hiMDUna phirUna pAhile nAhI kI tyAMcyApUrvI hoUna gelelyA lokAMcA kasA pariNAma (aMta) jhAlA? niHsaMzaya, allAhace bhaya rAkhaNAr2yA va tyAcA AjJAbhaMga karaNyApAsUna dUra rAhaNAr2yA lokAMkaritA Akhiratace ghara phAra uttama Ahe. kAya tarIhI tumhI dhyAnI gheta nAhI?

yetheparyaMta kI jevhA paigaMbara nirAza hoU lAgale ANi ummata (janasamudAyA) ce loka ase samajU lAgale kI tyAMnA khoTe sAMgitale gele, tvarita tyAMcyAparyaMta AmacI madata yeUna pohocalI. AmhI jyAlA icchile tyAlA suTakA pradAna kelI. kharI goSTa azI kI AmacA az2Aba (zikSA-yAtanA) aparAdhI lokAMvarUna TALalA jAta nAhI.

yAMcyA kahANyAM (vRttAMtA) madhye buddhimAnAMkaritA nizcitaca bodha ANi taMbI Ahe. hA kuraAna kAhI khoTyA racalelyA goSTI nAhI, kiMbahunA he satya-samarthana Ahe tyA graMthAMce je yAcyA pUrvIce Aheta, ANi pratyeka goSTIce savistara varNana ANi mArgadarzana va dayA-kRpA Ahe ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMkaritA.

Alipha.lAma.mIma.raॉ. yA kuraAnAcyA AyatI Aheta ANi tumacyA pAlanakartyAtarphe je kAhI tumacyAkaDe utaravile gele Aheta te sarva satya Ahe, paraMtu adhikAMza loka ImAna rAkhata nAhIta (vizvAsa bALagata nAhI).

allAha to Ahe, jyAne AkAzAMnA khAMbAMvinA uMca rAkhale Ahe kI tumhI pAhata AhAta, maga to arza (IzasiMhAsanA) vara sthira Ahe, tyAneca sUrya ANi caMdrAlA adhIna karUna Thevale Ahe. pratyeka nirdhArIta veLevara cAlata Ahe. toca sarva kAmAcI vyavasthA rAkhato. to ApalyA nizANyAMce spaSTapaNe nivedana karIta Ahe. yAsAThI kI tumhI ApalyA pAlanakartyAzI bheTa hoNyAvara vizvAsa karAvA.

ANi tyAneca jaminIlA pasaravUna dile Ahe ANi ticyAta parvata ANi nadyA nirmANa kelyA Aheta ANi tyAta pratyeka prakAracyA phaLAMcyA joDyA duherI nirmANa kelyA Aheta. to rAtrIne divasAlA lapavito, nizcitaca vicAra ciMtana karaNAr2yAMsAThI yAta aneka nizANyA (bodhacinhe) Aheta.

ANi jaminIta aneka prakArace tukaDe ekamekAMzI miLate juLate Aheta, ANi drAkSAMcyA bAgA Aheta ANi zete Aheta ANi phAMdyA asalelI khajurIcI jhADe Aheta ANi kAhI ase Aheta jyAMnA phAMdyA nAhIta. sarvAMnA ekAca prakArace pANI dile jAte, tarIhI AmhI ekAvara ekAlA phaLAMmadhye zreSThatA pradAna karato. yAta buddhimAna lokAMkaritA aneka nizANyA Aheta.

ANi jara tumhAlA navala vATata asela tara kharokhara tyAMce he mhaNaNe AzcaryakAraka Ahe kI kAya jevhA AmhI (melyAnaMtara) mAtI hoUna jAU tevhA kAya AmhI navyAne janma gheU? heca te loka hota, jyAMnI ApalyA pAlanakartyAzI inkAra kelA ANi heca te loka hota, jyAMcyA gaLyAta jokhaDa (phaMde) asatIla ANi heca hota je jahannamamadhye rAhaNAre Aheta, je sadaiva tyAta rAhatIla.

ANi je sukha-saMpanna avasthepUrvIca tumacyAjavaLa zikSecI yAcanA karaNyAta ghAI karIta Aheta, niHsaMzaya, tyAMcyApUrvI (udAharaNAdAkhala) zikSA-yAtanA AlelyA Aheta, ANi niHsaMzaya tumacA pAlanakartA mApha karaNArA Ahe, lokAMcyA anucita atyAcArAnaMtarahI ANi nizcitaca tumacA pAlanakartA kaThora daMDa deNArAhI Ahe.

ANi kAphira (kRtaghna loka) mhaNatAta kI tyAcyAvara tyAcyA pAlanakartyAtarphe ekhAdI nizANI (camatkAra) kA nAhI avatarita kelA gelA? kharI goSTa azI kI tumhI tara kevaLa saceta karaNAre AhAta ANi pratyeka janasamUhAsAThI mArgadarzana karaNArA Ahe.
mAdA ApalyA poTAta (garbhAta) je kAhI rAkhate te allAha cAMgalyA prakAre jANato ANi poTA (garbhAzayA) ce ghaTaNe-vADhaNehI jANato. pratyeka goSTa tyAcyAjavaLa anumAnAnusAra Ahe.
lapalelyA ANi ughaDa azA sarva goSTIMce to jJAna rAkhaNArA Ahe. sarvAMta mahAna sarvAMta ucca ANi sarvAMta uttama Ahe.
tumacyApaikI ekhAdyAce ApalI goSTa lapavUna sAMgaNe kiMvA tI moThyA AvAjAta sAMgaNe ANi jo rAtrI lapalelA asela ANi jo divasA cAlata asela, sarva allAhakaritA sArakheca Ahe.

tyAce saMrakSaka mAnavAcyA puDhe mAge tainAta Aheta, je allAhacyA AdezAne tyAce rakSaNa karatAta. ekhAdyA janasamUhAcI avasthA sarvazreSTha allAha toparyaMta badalata nAhI, joparyaMta to svataH badalata nAhI, je tyAMcyA manAta Ahe. sarvazreSTha allAha jevhA ekhAdyA janasamUhAlA sajA deNyAcA nirNaya gheto, tevhA to nirNaya badalata nAhI ANi tyAcyAkherIja koNIhI tyAMcA madatakartA nAhI.
to allAhaca hoya, jo tumhAlA vijecI camaka dAkhavito yAsAThI kI tumhI bhayabhIta vhAve ANi umeda bALagAvI ANi avajaDa DhagAMnAhI toca nirmANa karato.

ANi megha-garjanA tyAcI stutI-prazaMsA ANi guNagAna karate ANi phariztedekhIla tyAcyA bhayAne, toca AkAzAtUna vIja pADato. ANi jyAcyAvara icchito, tyAcyAvara pADato. kAphira loka allAhaviSayI vAda-vivAda ghAlata Aheta ANi allAha jabaradasta zaktizAlI Ahe.

tyAlAca pukAraNe khare Ahe. je loka tyAcyAkherIja dusar2yAMnA pukAratAta, te tyAMcyA koNatyAhI hAkelA uttara deta nAhIta jaNU ekhAdyA mANasAne Apale hAta pANyAkaDe pasaravile asAveta kI pANI tyAMcyA toMDAta yeUna paDAve, vAstavika te pANI tyAMcyA toMDAta jANAra nAhI. tyA kAphira lokAMce jevaDhe pukAraNe Ahe sarva pathabhraSTa Ahe.
ANi AkAzAMmadhye va jaminIvara asalele samasta jIva rAjI-khuzIne va nA khuzIne allAhalAca sajadA karatAta ANi tyAMcyA sAvalyAsuddhA sakALa-saMdhyAkALa allAhalA sajadA karatAta.

(tumhI) vicArA, AkAzAMcA ANi jaminIcA pAlanakartA koNa Ahe? sAMgA allAha! tyAMnA sAMgA, kAya tarIhI tumhI yAcyAkherIja dusar2yAMnA madata karaNAre banavita AhAta, je svataH ApalyA jIvAcyA lAbha-hAnIcA adhikAra bALagata nAhI. sAMgA, kAya AMdhaLA ANi DoLasa donhI samAna asU zakatAta? kiMvA aMdhAra ANi prakAza samAna asU zakato? kAya, jyAMnA he allAhacA sahabhAgI banavita Aheta, tyAMnIhI allAhapramANe kAhI nirmANa kele Ahe kI tyAMcyA pAhaNyAta nirmitIca saMdigdha TharalI? tumhI sAMgA, kevaLa allAhaca sarva vastUMnA nirmANa karaNArA Ahe. to ekaTA Ahe ANi moThA jabaradasta varcasvazAlI Ahe.

tyAneca AkAzAtUna parjanya vRSTI kelI, maga ApApalyA sAmarthyAnusAra nAle vAhU lAgale, maga pANyAcyA pravAhAne vara caDhUna phesa ucalalA ANi tyA vastUtahI jilA AgIta TAkUna tApavitAta dAgine kiMvA sAmAnAkaritA, tyAca prakAracA phesa Ahe. azA prakAre sarvazreSTha allAha satya ANi asatyAlA spaSTa karaNyAsAThI udAharaNa deto. AtA to phesa nikAmI hoUna nighUna jAto, paraMtu jyA goSTI lokAMnA lAbha pohacaviNAr2yA Aheta, tyA dharatIta TikUna rAhatAta. sarvazreSTha allAha azA prakAre udAharaNa deta asato.

jyA lokAMnI ApalyA pAlanakartyAcyA AdezAce pAlana kele, tyAMcyAkaritA bhalAI Ahe ANi jyA lokAMnI tyAcyA AdezAce anusaraNa kele nAhI, tara dharatIvara je kAhI Ahe te sarva tyAcyAjavaLa asela ANi tyAsobata tevaDheca ANakhI jAsta asela maga te sarva kAhI ApalyA badalI (bacAvAsAThI) deUna TAkIla. heca te loka hota, jyAMcyAsAThI moThA vAITa hizoba Ahe ANi tyAMce ThikANa jahannama Ahe, je phAra vAITa ThikANa Ahe.

kAya to manuSya, jyAlA he mAhIta asAve kI je tumacyAkaDe tumacyA pAlanakartyAtarphe utaravile gele Ahe te satya Ahe, kAya tyA mANasAsArakhA asU zakato jo AMdhaLA asAvA. bodha-upadeza tara teca svIkAratAta je buddhimAna asAveta.
je loka allAhalA dilele vacana pUrNa karatAta ANi vacana bhaMga karIta nAhI.
ANi allAhane jyA goSTIMnA joDaNyAcA Adeza dilA Ahe, te tyAMnA joDatAta ANi te ApalyA pAlanakartyAce bhaya rAkhatAta ANi hizobAcyA kaThoratecehI bhaya rAkhatAta.

ANi te ApalyA pAlanakartyAcyA prasannatekhAtIra dhIra-saMyama rAkhatAta ANi namAjAMnA sAtatyAne kAyama rAkhatAta ANi je kAhI AmhI tyAMnA deUna Thevale Ahe te (dhana) ughaDa ANi chupyA rItIne kharca karatAta ANi vAITa vyavahArAlA bhalepaNAne TALatAta. azAca lokAMkaritA Akhiratace ghara Ahe.
ANi nehamI rAhaNAr2yA bAgA, jithe he svataH jAtIla ANi tyAMce vADavaDIla, ANi patnyA, ANi saMtAnApaikI je neka kAma karaNAre asatIla, tyAMcyAjavaLa pharizte pratyeka dArAtUna yetIla.
(mhaNatIla kI) tumacyAvara zAMtI-salAmatI aso dhIra-saMyamAcyA mobadalyAta kitI uttama mobadalA Ahe yA AkhiratacyA gharAcA!

ANi je loka allAhalA dilele vacana, te dRDha-majabUta kelyAnaMtara toDUna TAkatAta ANi jyA goSTIMnA allAhane joDaNyAcA Adeza dilA Ahe tyAMnA toDUna TAkatAta ANi dharatIta upadrava (phasAda) pasaravitAta tyAMcyAvara dhiHkkAra Ahe ANi tyAMcyAsAThI vAITa ghara Ahe.
sarvazreSTha allAha jyAcI rojI (AjivikA) icchito vADhavito ANi jyAcI icchito ghaTavito. he loka tara aihika jIvanAtaca magna jhAleta. vAstavika he jaga, AkhiratacyA tulaneta agadI tuccha sAmugrI Ahe.

kAphira (ImAna na rAkhaNAre) mhaNatAta kI tyAcyAvara tyAcyA pAlanakartyAtarphe ekhAdI nizANI (camatkAra) kA nAhI utaravilA gelA? uttara dyA, jyAlA allAha pathabhraSTa karU icchito, tyAlA pathabhraSTa karato ANi jo tyAcyAkaDe jhukato tyAlA mArga dAkhavito.
jyA lokAMnI ImAna rAkhale, tyAMcI mane, allAhacyA smaraNAne zAMtI prApta karatAta. lakSAta ThevA kI allAhacyA smaraNAneca hRdayAlA zAMtI samAdhAna lAbhate.
jyA lokAMnI ImAna rAkhale ANi jyAMnI satkarmedekhIla kelIta tyAMcyAkaritA sukha-saMpanna avasthA Ahe ANi sarvAMta uttama sthAna Ahe.

tyAca prakAre AmhI tumhAlA tyA janasamUhAta pAThavile, jyAta yApUrvI aneka janasamUha hoUna geleta, yAsAThI kI tumhI tyAMnA, AmacyAtarphe jI vahayI (prakAzanA) tumacyAvara avatarita kelI Ahe, vAcUna aikavA. he loka parama dayALU (rahamAna) allAhacA inkAra karaNAre Aheta. tumhI sAMgA, mAjhA svAmI va pAlanakartA tara toca Ahe, niHsaMzaya, tyAcyAkherIja koNIhI upAsanesa pAtra nAhI. tyAcyAvaraca mAjhA bharosA Ahe ANi tyAcyAcakaDe malA parata jAyace Ahe.

ANi jara (gRhIta dharale kI) kuraAnadvAre parvata cAlavile gele asate kiMvA jaminIce tukaDe tukaDe kele gele asate kiMvA melelyA lokAMzI saMbhASaNa karavile gele asate (tarIhI tyAMnI ImAna rAkhale nasate). kharI goSTa azI kI samasta kArye allAhacyAca hAtI Aheta, tevhA kAya ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMce mana yA goSTIvara saMtuSTa hota nAhI kI jara allAhane icchile tara samasta lokAMnA saraLa mArgAvara ANIla. ImAna na rAkhaNAr2yAlA tara tyAMcyA inkArApAyI nehamI koNatI na koNatI sakta sajA miLataca rAhIla, kiMvA tyAMcyA gharAMcyA javaLapAsa utarata rAhIla. yetheparyaMta kI allAhacA vAyadA yeUna pohocela. niHsaMzaya sarvazreSTha allAha vAyadyAvirUddha jAta nAhI.

ANi niHsaMzaya, tumacyA pUrvIcyA paigaMbarAMzI thaTTA-maskarI kelI gelI hotI, ANi mIdekhIla tyA kAphirAMnA thoDe saila soDale, naMtara mAtra tyAMnA pakaDIta ghetale, tara kazI rAhilI mAjhI zikSA (az2Aba)?

tara kAya to allAha jo samAcAra gheNArA Ahe pratyeka mANasAcA tyAne kelelyA karmAbaddala, ANi tyA lokAMnI allAhace bhAgIdAra Tharavile Aheta. sAMgA, jarA tyAMcI nAve tara sAMgA, kiMvA allAhalA tumhI tyA goSTI sAMgata AhAta, jyA to dharatIvara jANataca nAhI, kiMvA kevaLa varavaracyA goSTI banavita AhAta. kharI goSTa azI kI kupra (inkAra) karaNAr2yAMkaritA, tyAMcI kapaTa-kArasthAne bhalehI cAMgalI dAkhavilI gelI asota ANi tyAMnA satya mArgApAsUna rokhale gele Ahe ANi jyAlA allAha mArgabhraSTa karIla, tyAlA mArga dAkhaviNArA koNIhI nAhI.
tyAMcyAsAThI yA jagAcyA jIvanAtahI duHkha Ahe ANi Akhirata (maraNottara jIvanA) cA az2Aba tara phAra sakta Ahe ANi tyAMnA allAhacyA prakopApAsUna vAcaviNArA koNIhI nAhI.

tyA jannatace udAharaNa, jyAcA vAyadA allAhace bhaya rAkhaNAr2yAMzI kelA gelA Ahe, ase Ahe kI ticyAkhAlI pravAha vAhata asatIla, ticI phaLe nehamI rAhaNArI Aheta ANi ticI sAvalIdekhIla. hA Ahe mobadalA allAhace bhaya rAkhaNAr2yAMcA ANi kAphira lokAMcA zevaTa jahannama Ahe.

ANi jyAMnA AmhI graMtha pradAna kelA Ahe, te tara tyAdvAre khUpa AnaMdita hotAta, je kAhI tumacyAvara avatarita kele jAte ANi itara saMpradAya, tyAtalyA kAhI goSTIMnA mAnya karIta nAhI. tumhI tyAMnA sAMgUna TAkA kI malA tara kevaLa hAca Adeza dilA gelA Ahe kI mI allAhacI upAsanA karAvI ANi tyAcyAsobata koNAlA bhAgIdAra na banavAve, mI tyAcyAcakaDe bolavita Ahe ANi tyAcyAcakaDe malA paratUna jAyace Ahe.

ANi azA prakAre AmhI hA kuraAna, arabI bhASetIla pharmAna avatarita kele Ahe, ANi jara tumhI yAMcyA icchA AkAMkSAMce anusaraNa kele, yAcyAnaMtarahI kI tumacyAjavaLa jJAna yeUna pohocale Ahe, tara allAhacyA virodhAta tumhAlA nA koNI samarthana deNArA bheTela ANi nA rakSaNa karaNArA.

ANi AmhI tumacyA pUrvIhI aneka rasUla (paigaMbara) pAThavile Aheta, ANi AmhI tyA sarvAMnA patnI ANi saMtAna rAkhaNArA banavile hote. allAhacyA hukumAvinA ekhAdI nizANI ANUna dAkhaviNe koNatyAhI paigaMbarAcyA akhatyArAtIla (avAkhyAtIla) goSTa nAhI. pratyeka nirdhArIta vAyadyAcA eka graMtha Ahe.
allAha je icchila miTavUna TAkIla ANi je icchila surakSita ThevIla. surakSita graMtha (lauhe mahaphUja) tyAcyAcajavaLa Ahe.

ANi tyAMcyAzI kelelyA vAyadyAMpaikI jara ekhAdA AmhI tumhAlA dAkhavUna dyAvA kiMvA tumhAlA AmhI mRtyu dyAvA tara tumacyAvara kevaLa pohacaviNyAcIca jabAbadArI Ahe, hizoba ghyAyace kAma tara Amace Ahe.
kAya te nAhI pAhata kI AmhI dharatIlA ticyA kinAr2yAMkaDUna ghaTavita Alo Ahota. allAha Adeza deto ANi koNIhI tyAcyA AdezAlA pAThImAge TAkaNArA nAhI. to lavakaraca hizoba gheNAra Ahe.

ANi tyAMcyA pUrvIcyA lokAMnIhI kapaTa-kArasthAna karaNyAta kAhI kasara soDalI navhatI, paraMtu samasta upAyayojanA allAhacIca Ahe. manuSya je kAhI karIta Ahe, allAha te jANato. ImAna na rAkhaNAr2yAMnA lavakaraca mAhIta paDela kI AkhiratacA mobadalA koNAsAThI Ahe.
ANi he inkArI loka ase mhaNatAta kI tumhI allAhace paigaMbara nAhIta. (tumhI) uttara dyA kI mAjhyA ANi tumacyA daramyAna sAkSa deNyAsAThI allAha puresA Ahe, ANi to, jyAcyAjavaLa graMthAce jJAna Ahe.

Alipha. lAma.raॉ hA (sarvAMta uttama) graMtha AmhI tumacyAkaDe avatarita kelA Ahe, yAsAThI kI tumhI lokAMnA aMdhArAtUna prakAzAkaDe ANAve tyAMcyA pAlanakartyAcyA AdezAne jabaradasta, prazaMsanIya allAhacyA mArgAkaDe.
AkAzAMmadhye ANi dharatIta je kAhI Ahe te sarva allAhaceca Ahe ANi kAphira (kRtaghna) lokAMsAThI sakta az2AbAce saMkaTa Ahe.
je loka Akhirata (paraloka) cyA tulaneta aihika jIvanAcA moha dharatAta ANi allAhacyA mArgApAsUna rokhatAta ANi tyAta vakratA nirmANa karU icchitAta, heca loka moThyA dUracyA mArgabhraSTateta Aheta.

ANi AmhI pratyeka paigaMbarAlA tyAcyA janasamUhAcyA bhASetaca pAThavile Ahe yAsAThI kI janasamUhAcyA lokAMsamora spaSTapaNe sAMgAve, AtA allAha jyAlA icchila mArgabhraSTa karIla ANi jyAlA icchila mArga dAkhavila. to moThA jabaradasta ANi hikamatazAlI Ahe.

(smaraNa karA jevhA) AmhI mUsAlA ApalyA nizANyA deUna pAThavile kI tU ApalyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMnA aMdhArAtUna kADhUna ujeDAta ANa ANi tyAMnA allAhacyA upakArAMcI AThavaNa karUna de. yAta nizANyA Aheta pratyeka dhIra-saMyama rAkhaNAr2yAkaritA.

ANi jevhA mUsA ApalyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMnA mhaNAle, kI allAhacyA tyA kRpA deNagyAMcI AThavaNa karA jyA tyAne tumhAlA dilyA Aheta, jevhA tyAne tumhAlA phiraaunacyA sAthIdArAMpAsUna soDavile je tumhAlA phAra duHkha pohacavita hote. tumacyA putrAMcI hatyA karIta ANi tumacyA mulIMnA jivaMta soDUna deta. yAta tumacyA pAlanakartyAtarphe tumacI phAra moThI kasoTI hotI.

ANi jevhA tumacyA pAlanakartyAne saceta kele kI jara tumhI kRtajJatA vyakta karAla tara niHsaMzaya mI tumhAlA ANakhI jAsta pradAna karena ANi jara tumhI kRtaghna vhAla tara nizcitaca mAjhI zikSA-yAtanA moThI sakta Ahe.
ANi mUsA mhaNAle, jara tumhI sarva ANi dharatIvara rAhaNAre samasta loka allAhazI kRtaghna hotIla, tarIhI allAha niHsvArtha ANi prazaMsanIya Ahe.

kAya tumacyAjavaLa, tumacyApUrvI hoUna gelelyA lokAMcA vRttAMta AlA nAhI? arthAta nUhacyA janasamUhAcA, ANi Ada va samUdacA ANi tyAMcyAnaMtaracyA lokAMcA, jyAMnA allAhazivAya dusarA koNIhI jANata nAhI. tyAMcyAjavaLa tyAMce paigaMbara camatkAra gheUna Ale, paraMtu tyAMnI Apale hAta ApalyA toMDAvara ThevUna ghetale ANi spaSTapaNe sAMgUna TAkale kI je kAhI deUna tumhAlA pAThavile gele Ahe AmhI te mAnata nAhI ANi jyA goSTIkaDe tumhI AmhAlA bolavita AhAta, AmhAlA tara tyAta phAra zaMkA vATate (AmacA tyAvara vizvAsa nAhI).

tyAMce paigaMbara tyAMnA mhaNAle kI kAya allAha (jo satya Ahe) tyAcyAviSayI zaMkA Ahe, jo AkAzAMcA va dharatIcA nirmANa karaNArA Ahe to tara tumhAlA azAsAThI bolAvita Ahe kI tyAne tumace sarva aparAdha mApha karAveta ANi eka TharalelyA avadhIparyaMta tumhAlA saMdhI pradAna karAvI te (loka) mhaNAle, tumhI tara AmacyAsArakheca mAnava AhAta. tumhI he icchitA kI AmhAlA tyA daivatAMcyA pUjA-arcanepAsUna rokhAve, jyAMcI bhaktI-ArAdhanA Amace vADavaDIla karata rAhile, bare tara AmacyAsamora ekhAde spaSTa pramANa tarI sAdara karA.

tyAMce paigaMbara tyAMnA mhaNAle, he agadI satya Ahe kI AmhI tumacyAsArakhe mAnava Ahota. paraMtu sarvazreSTha allAha ApalyA dAsAMpaikI jyAcyAvara icchito ApalI kRpA karato. AmacI tAkada nAhI kI AmhI allAhacyA hukumAvinA ekhAdA mojijA (camatkAra) tumhAlA dAkhavAvA ANi ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMnI kevaLa allAhavaraca bharosA ThevalA pAhije.

ANi zevaTI kAya sababa Ahe kI AmhI sarvazreSTha allAhavara bharosA na ThevAvA? vAstavika tyAneca AmhAlA AmacA mArga dAkhavilA Ahe ANi je duHkha tumhI AmhAlA pohocavAla, AmhI tyAvara nizcitaca dhIra-saMyama rAkhU. bharosA ThevaNAr2yAMsAThI heca yogya Ahe kI tyAMnI allAhavaraca bharosA ThevalA pAhije.

ANi inkArI loka ApalyA paigaMbarAMnA mhaNAle kI AmhI tumhAlA dezAbAhera ghAlavUna deU kiMvA tumhI punhA AmacyA dharmAta parata yA. tevhA tyAMcyA pAlanakartyAne tyAMcyAkaDe vahayI (prakAzanA) pAThavilI kI AmhI tyA atyAcArI lokAMcAca nAza karUna TAkU.
ANi tyAnaMtara AmhI svataH tumhAlA dharatIvara AbAda karU. he azA lokAMsAThI Ahe, je mAjhyAsamora ubhe rAhaNyApAsUna bhita rAhile ANi mAjhyA cetAvaNIce bhaya bALagata rAhile.
ANi tyAMnI nirNaya mAgitalA, ANi sarva vidrohI jiddI loka asaphala jhAle.
tyAMcyAsamora jahannama Ahe, jithe tyAMnA pIpa (pU) ce pANI pAjale jAIla.

jyAlA to moThyA trAsAne eka eka ghoTa karU pyAyacA prayatna karIla tarIhI te ghazAkhAlI utaravU zakaNAra nAhI. ANi tyAlA sagaLIkaDUna mRtyu yeta asalelA disela, paraMtu to maraNAra nAhI. tyAcyA pAThopATha sakta az2Aba (zikSA-yAtanA) Ahe.

tyA lokAMce udAharaNa jyAMnI ApalyA pAlanakartyAcA inkAra kelA tyAMce karma tyA rAkhesArakhe Ahe, jicyAvara vegavAna vArA vAdaLAcyA divazI cAlAvA. je kAhI tyAMnI kele, tyApaikI koNatyAhI goSTIvara samartha nasatIla. hIca dUracI mArgabhraSTatA Ahe.

kAya tumhI nAhI pAhile kI sarvazreSTha allAhane AkAzAMnA ANi dharatIlA sarvottama upAyayojanedvAre nirmANa kele Ahe. jara tyAne icchile tara tumhA sarvAMnA naSTa karUna TAkIla ANi navIna nirmitI (sRSTI) ANIla.
ANi allAhakaritA ase karaNe kAhIca kaThINa nAhI.

ANi sarvacyA sarva allAhasamora ubhe rAhatIla. tyA veLI kamajora loka ghameMDI lokAMnA mhaNatIla kI AmhI tara tumacyA adhIna hoto, tara kAya tumhI allAhacyA zikSA-yAtanAMmadhUna thoDI sajA AmacyAvarUna dUra karU zakaNAre AhAta? te uttara detIla kI jara allAhane AmhAlA mArgadarzana kele asate tara AmhIhI tumhAlA mArga dAkhavilA asatA. AtA tara AmacyAsAThI becaina hoNe ANi saburI rAkhaNe donhI sArakheca Ahe. AmacyAkaritA suTakecA koNatAhI mArga nAhI.

ANi jevhA kAryAcA nirNaya lAvalA jAIla tevhA saitAna mhaNela kI allAhane tara tumhAlA satyavacana dile hote ANi mI tumhAlA jo vAyadA dilA, tyAcyAvirUddha kele. mAjhA tumacyAvara kAhI jora tara navhatAca. ho, mI tumhAlA pukArale ANi tumhI mAjhe mhaNaNe mAnya kele. AtA tumhI mAjhyAvara doSAropa ThevU nakA, ulaTa svataHcAca dhiHkkAra karA. mI nA tumacI madata karU zakato, nA tumhI mAjhe gAr2hANe dUra karU zakatA. mI tara (suruvAtIpAsUna) mAnataca nAhI kI tumhI malA yApUrvI allAhacA sahabhAgI samajata rAhile. niHsaMzaya atyAcArI lokAMsAThI duHkhadAyaka az2Aba (zikSA-yAtanA) Ahe.

ANi jyA lokAMnI ImAna rAkhale ANi satkarme kelIta tara tyAMnA jannatIMmadhye dAkhala kele jAIla, jyAMcyAta naharI (pravAha) vAhata Aheta, jithe te ApalyA pAlanakartyAcyA AdezAne nehamI nehamI rAhatIla jithe tyAMce svAgata satata salAmane hoIla.
kAya tumhI nAhI pAhile kI sarvazreSTha allAhane pavitra goSTIce udAharaNa ekA pavitra vRkSAsamAna sAMgitale, jyAce mULa majabUta Ahe ANi jyAcyA phAMdyA AkAzAta Aheta.
jo ApalyA pAlanakartyAcyA AdezAne pratyeka veLI Apale phaLa deto ANi sarvazreSTha allAha lokAMsamora udAharaNa prastuta karato yAsAThI kI tyAMnI bodha prApta karAvA.
ANi apavitra va amaMgala goSTIcI tulanA galiccha vRkSAsArakhI Ahe, je jaminIcyA kiMcita varacyAca bhAgAtUna ukhaDUna ghetale gele tyAlA kasalIhI majabUtI (sthiratA) nAhI.

ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMnA sarvazreSTha allAha pakkyA va majabUta goSTIMsaha kAyama rAkhato. yA jagAcyA jIvanAtahI ANi AkhiratamadhyehI tathApi atyAcArI lokAMnA allAha mArgabhraSTa karato ANi allAha je icchito te karatoca.
kAya tumhI tyAMcyAvara najara nAhI TAkalI jyAMnI allAhacyA kRpA-deNagIcyA badalyAta kRtaghnatA vyakta kelI ANi ApalyA janasamUhAlA vinAzAcyA gharAta ANUna utaravile.
arthAta jahannamamadhye, jyAta he sarva jAtIla, te phAra vAITa ThikANa Ahe.

ANi tyAMnI allAhace samakakSa banavUna ghetale yAsAThI kI lokAMnA allAhacyA mArgApAsUna vicalita karAve. (tumhI) sAMgA kI ThIka Ahe, mauja-mastI karUna ghyA. tumace ThikANa tara zevaTI jahannama (naraka) ca Ahe.

mAjhyA ImAna rAkhaNAr2yA dAsAMnA sAMgA kI tyAMnI namAjalA kAyama rAkhAve ANi je kAhI AmhI tyAMnA deUna Thevale Ahe, tyAtUna kAhI guptapaNe ANi ughaDapaNe kharca karIta rAhAve, yApUrvI kI to divasa yAvA jyAta nA kasalI kharedI-vikrI hoIla, nA maitrI nA prema.

allAha to Ahe, jyAne AkAzAMnA ANi dharatIlA nirmANa kele Ahe ANi AkAzAtUna pAUsa pADUna tyAdvAre tumacyA rojI (annasAmugrI) karitA phaLe kADhalIta ANi naukAMnA tumacyA adhIna kele kI nadyAMmadhye tyAcyA AdezAne cAlAvyAta. tyAneca nadyA ANi kAlavyAMnA tumacyA tAbyAta karUna dile Ahe.
tyAneca tumacyAsAThI sUrya ANi caMdrAlA adhIna kele Ahe kI te satata cAlata (gatIzIla) rAhatAta. ANi rAtra va divasAlA tumacyA kAmI lAvale Ahe.

ANi tyAneca tumhAlA tumhI mAgitalelyA sarva vastUMpaikI deUna ThevalyA Aheta. jara tumhI allAhacyA kRpA-deNagyAMcI gaNanA karU icchita asAla tara purepUra gaNanA karUca zakata nAhI. niHsaMzaya manuSya moThA atyAcArI ANi kRtaghna Ahe.

(ibrAhImacyA yA duA-prArthanecehI smaraNa karA) jevhA ibrAhIma mhaNAle, he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! yA zaharAlA zAMtI-salAmatIce sthaLa banava. ANi malA ANi mAjhyA saMtatIlA mUrtIpUjA karaNyApAsUna vAcava.
he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! tyAMnI aneka lokAMnA saraLa mArgApAsUna dUra kele Ahe. AtA jo mAjhe anusaraNa karIla to mAjhA ANi ANi jo avajJA karIla tara tU moThA mApha karaNArA va dayA karaNArA Ahe.

he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! mI ApalyA kAhI saMtatIlA yA nApIka osADa jaMgalAta tujhyA pavitra gharAcyA javaLa AbAda kele Ahe. he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! he azAsAThI kI tyAMnI namAja kAyama karAvI, yAstava tU kAhI lokAMcI mane tyAMcyAkaDe AkarSita kara ANi tyAMnA phaLAMcI rojI (annasAmugrI) pradAna kara, yAsAThI kI tyAMnI kRtajJatA vyakta karAvI.
he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! tU cAMgalyA prakAre jANato, je kAhI AmhI lapavito ANi je jAhIra karato. dharatI ANi AkAzAtIla koNatIhI vastU allAhapAsUna lapalelI nAhI.
allAhacI prazaMsA Ahe, jyAne malA vRkSAvastheta ismAIla ANi isahAka pradAna kele. niHsaMzaya mAjhA pAlanakartA (allAha) duA-prArthanA aikaNArA Ahe.
he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! malA ANi mAjhyA saMtatIlA namAja kAyama rAkhaNArA banava. mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! mAjhI duA kabUla kara.
he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! malA kSamA pradAna kara ANi mAjhyA mAtA-pityAsaha mApha kara ANi itara ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMnAhI mApha kara, jyA divazI (karmAMcA) hizoba hoIla.
atyAcArI lokAMcyA karmAMpAsUna allAhalA bekhabara samajU nakA tyAne tara tyAMnA tyA divasAparyaMta saMdhI deUna ThevalI Ahe, jyA divazI DoLe visphAralele(phATalela)ee rAhatIla.
te Apale Doke vara kADhUna dhAvapaLa karata asatIla. svataH ApalyAkaDehI tyAMcI dRSTI parataNAra nAhI ANi tyAMcI mane uData ANi paData jAta (zUnya) asatIla.

ANi lokAMnA tyA divasApAsUna sAvadha karA jevhA tyAMcyAjavaLa az2Aba (zikSA-yAtanA) yeUna pohocela ANi atyAcArI loka mhaNatIla kI he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! AmhAlA phAra thoDyA javaLacyA veLeparyaMtaca saMdhI pradAna kara kI AmhI tujhe nimaMtraNa (dAvata) mAnya karAve ANi tujhyA paigaMbarAMcyA anusaraNAta magna vhAve. kAya tumhI yAcyA pUrvIhI zapatha gheta navhate kI tumhAlA yA jagAtUna TaLAyaceca nAhI.

ANi kAya tumhI tyA lokAMcyA gharAta rAhata navhate, jyAMnI ApalyA prANAMvara julUma kelA ANi kAya tumhAlA to mAmalA ughaDapaNe kaLalA nAhI kI AmhI tyAMcyAzI kazA prakAracA vyavahAra kelA? AmhI tara tumhAlA samajAviNyAsAThI aneka udAharaNe sAdara kelIta.
ANi he Apale DAvapeca kheLata Aheta ANi allAhalA tyAMcyA sarva DAvapecAMce jJAna Ahe. tyAMce DAva peca ase navhate kI tyAMcyAmuLe parvatAMnI ApalI jAgA soDalI asatI.
tumhI asA vicAra kadhIhI karU nakA kI allAha ApalyA paigaMbarAMzI kelelyA vAyadyAvirUddha jAIla. allAha moThA jabaradasta ANi sUDa gheNArA Ahe.
jyA divazI hI jamIna ekA dusar2yA jaminIcyA svarUpAta badalUna TAkalI jAIla ANi AkAzAMnAhI ANi sarvacyA sarva jabaradasta azA allAhacyA samora asatIla.
ANi tumhI tyA divazI aparAdhI lokAMnA pAhAla kI sAkhaLyAMmadhye ekatrapaNe ekA ThikANI jakhaDalele asatIla.
tyAMce kapaDe gaMdhakAce asatIla ANi tyAMcyA toMDAvara Aga pAkhaDalelI asela.
he azAsAThI kI, sarvazreSTha allAhane pratyeka mANasAlA tyAne kelelyA karmAcA mobadalA dyAvA. niHsaMzaya, hizoba gheNyAta allAhalA uzIra lAgaNAra nAhI.

hA kuraAna, samasta lokAMkaritA sUcanApatra Ahe kI yAcyAdvAre lokAMnA saceta kele jAve ANi tyAMnI pUrNapaNe he jANUna ghyAve kI allAha ekameva upAsanesa pAtra Ahe ANi yAsAThI kI buddhimAna lokAMnI vicAra ciMtana karAve.
alipha. lAma. raॉ yA (allAhacyA) graMthAcyA AyatI Aheta ANi spaSTa azA kuraAnAcyA.
azIhI veLa yeIla jevhA inkAra karaNAre ApalyA ImAnadhAraka hoNyAcI icchA karatIla.
tumhI tyAMnA khANyAta, lAbha ucalaNyAta ANi (khoTyA) apekSA bALagaNyAta magna asalele soDA. te svataH lavakaraca jANUna ghetIla.
ANi koNatyAhI vastIlA AmhI naSTa kele nAhI, paraMtu he kI ticyAkaritA nizcita ase likhita hote.
koNatAhI janasamUha ApalyA mRtyupAsUna nA puDhe jAU zakato, nA mAge rAhU zakato.
ANi te mhaNAle, he mANasA! jyAvara kuraAna avatarita kele gele Ahe nizcitaca tU ekhAdA veDA Ahe.
jara tU agadI saccA Ahe tara maga AmacyAjavaLa phariztyAMnA kA nAhI ANata?
AmhI phariztyAMnA satyAsahaca avatarita karato. ANi azA veLI tyAMnA savaDa dilI jAta nAhI.
niHsaMzaya AmhIca yA kuraAnAlA avatarita kele Ahe ANi AmhIca tyAce saMrakSaka Ahota.
ANi AmhI tumacyApUrvI hoUna gelelyA janasamUhAMmadhyehI Apale paigaMbara pAThavita rAhilo.
ANi (tathApi) jo paigaMbaradekhIla tyAMcyAjavaLa AlA, tyAcI te thaTTAca uDavita rAhile.
aparAdhI lokAMcyA manAta AmhI azAca prakAre heca racata asato.
te yAcyAvara ImAna rAkhata nAhI ANi niHsaMzaya pUrvIcyA lokAMcI hIca paddhata rAhilI Ahe.
ANi jara AmhI tyAMcyAsAThI AkAzAta (jANyAcA) daravAjAhI ughaDUna dilA ANi te tithe caDhUhI lAgale.
tarIhI heca mhaNatIla kI AmacI najarabaMdI kelI gelI Ahe, kiMbahunA AmacyAvara jAdUToNA kelA gelA Ahe.
ANi niHsaMzaya, AmhI AkAzAta buruja (rAzI) banavile Aheta ANi pAhaNAr2yAMkaritA yAlA suzobhita kele Ahe.
ANi dhiHkkAralelyA pratyeka saitAnApAsUna yAlA surakSita Thevale Ahe.
tathApi, jo lapUna chapUna aikaNyAcA prayatna karato, bhaDakatyA AgIcA nikhArA tyAcyA pAThIzI lAgato.
ANi jaminIlA AmhI pasaravUna dile Ahe ANi ticyAvara parvata Thevale Aheta ANi ticyAta pratyeka vastU AmhI nizcita pramANAta ugavilI Ahe.
ANi ticyAtaca AmhI tumacyA anna sAmugrIcI vyavasthA kelI Ahe ANi (tyAMcyAsAThIhI) jyAMnA rojI deNAre tumhI nAhIta.
ANi jevaDhyA mhaNUna cIja-vastU Aheta, tyA sarvAMcA khajinA AmacyAjavaLa Ahe, ANi AmhI pratyeka vastU ticyA nirdhArita pramANAta utaravito.
ANi AmhI vajanadAra vAr2yAMnA pAThivato, maga AkAzAtUna parjanya vRSTI karUna tumhAlA tRpta karato ANi tumhI tyAcA saMgraha karUna ThevaNAre nAhIta.
ANi AmhIca jIvana deto ANi mRtyuhI deto ANi (zevaTI) AmhIca vArasa Ahota.
ANi tumacyApaikI puDhe jANAr2yAMnA ANi mAge rAhaNAr2yAMnAhI AmhI cAMgalyA prakAre jANato.
ANi tumacA pAlanakartA samasta lokAMnA ekatrita karela. niHsaMzaya to moThA tattvadarzI, moThA jJAnI Ahe.
ANi niHsaMzaya, AmhI mAnavAlA khanakaNAr2yA (koraDyA) mAtIpAsUna, jI saDalelyA gAr2yAcI hotI, nirmANa kele Ahe.
ANi tyAcyApUrvI jinnAMnA AmhI agnizikhepAsUna nirmANa kele.
ANi jevhA tumacyA pAlanakartyAne phariztyAMnA pharmAvile kI mI eka mAnava, kALyA saDalelyA, khanakaNAr2yA mAtIpAsUna nirmANa karaNAra Ahe.
tara jevhA mI tyAlA pUrNa banavUna gheIna ANi tyAta ApalA AtmA phuMkena tevhA tumhI sarva tyAlA sajadA karA (tyAcyApuDhe mAthA TekA)
yAstava sarvacyA sarva phariztyAMnI ApalA mAthA TekalA.
paraMtu iblisane sajadA karaNAr2yAMmadhye sAmIla hoNyAsa inkAra kelA.
(allAhane) pharmAvile, he iblisa! tulA jhAle tarI kAya kI tU sajadA karaNAr2yAMmadhye sAmIla jhAlA nAhI?
to mhaNAlA, mI asA nAhI kI yA mAnavAlA sajadA karAvA, jyAlA tU kALyA ANi saDalelyA khaNakhaNaNAr2yA mAtIpAsUna nirmANa kele Ahe.
(allAhane) pharmAvile, AtA tU jannatamadhUna cAlatA ho kAraNa tU dhiHkkAralelA Ahesa.
ANi tujhyAvara kayAmatacyA divasAparyaMta mAjhyAtarphe dhiHkkAra Ahe.
to mhaNAlA, he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! malA tyA divasAparyaMta saMdhI pradAna kara kI lokAMnA dusar2yAMdA (jivaMta karUna) uThavile jAIla.
pharmAvile, (ThIka Ahe) tU tyAMcyApaikI Ahesa, jyAMnA saMdhI dilI gelI Ahe.
TharalelyA divasAcyA veLeparyaMtacI.

(saitAna) mhaNAlA, he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! tU malA mArgabhraSTa kelesa tara mIdekhIla zapatha gheto kI mI suddhA dharatIta tyAMcyAsAThI moha mAyA nirmANa karIna ANi tyA sarvAMnA bahakavUna mArgabhraSTa karIna.
mAtra tujhyA tyA dAsAMkherIja, jyAMnA tU nivaDUna ghetale Ahe.
pharmAvile, ho. hAca mAjhyAparyaMta pohacaNyAcA saraLa mArga Ahe.
mAjhyA (nivaDaka) dAsAMvara tujhA koNatAhI prabhAva paDaNAra nAhI, mAtra je vATa cukalele loka Aheta, teca tujhe anusaraNa karatIla.
ANi niHsaMzaya, tyA sarvAMcyA vAyadyAce sthAna jahannama Ahe.
jyAlA sAta daravAje Aheta. pratyeka dArAsAThI tyAMcA eka hissA vibhAjita Ahe.
niHsaMzaya, allAhace bhaya rAkhUna durAcArApAsUna dUra rAhaNAre loka bAgAMmadhye ANi jhar2yAM (pravAhAM) madhye asatIla.
(tyAMnA sAMgitale jAIla) salAmatI ANi zAMtIpUrvaka yAta dAkhala vhA.
ANi tyAMcyA manAta jI kAhI vaira- dveSa bhAvanA hotI AmhI tI sarva dUra karU. te bhAU-bhAU banUna ekamekAMsamora siMhAsanAvara basalele asatIla.
tyAMnA tithe nA ekhAde duHkha sparza karU zakate ANi nA te tithUna kadhI kADhale jAtIla.
mAjhyA dAsAMnA sAMgA kI mI moThA mApha karaNArA ANi khUpa khUpa dayA karaNArA Ahe.
ANi tyAcabarobara mAjhI zikSA yAtanAhI moThI duHkhadAyaka Ahe.
ANi tyAMnA ibrAhImacyA atithIMcA vRttAMta aikavA.
kI jevhA tyAMnI ibrAhImajavaLa yeUna salAma kelA, tevhA te mhaNAle kI AmhAlA tumace bhaya vATate.
pharizte mhaNAle, bhiU nakA, AmhI tumhAlA ekA jJAnI putrAcI zubha vArtA deto.
ibrAhIma mhaNAle, kAya yA vRddhAvasthene sparza kelyAnaMtara tumhI malA hI zubha vArtA detA! hI AnaMdAcI bAtamI tumhI kazI kAya deta AhAta?
pharizte mhaNAle, AmhI tumhAlA agadI kharI zubhavArtA aikavita Ahota. tumhI nirAza lokAMmadhye sAmIla hoU nakA.
mhaNAle, ApalyA pAlanakartyAcyA dayA kRpepAsUna kevaLa te (mArgabhraSTa ANi) bahakalele lokaca nirAza hotAta.
(ibrAhIma yAMnI) vicArale, he allAhatarphe pAThaviNyAta AlelyA (phariztyAM) no! tumace ase kAya khAsa kAma Ahe?
phariztyAMnI uttara dile, AmhAlA aparAdhI lokAMkaDe pAThavile gele Ahe.
paraMtu lUtace kuTuMba kI AmhI tyA sarvAMnA avazya vAcavU.
mAtra lUtacyA patnIkherIja kI AmhI tilA thAMbaNAr2yA va mAge rAhaNAr2yAMmadhye nizcita kele Ahe.
jevhA pAThavilele pharizte lUtacyA kuTuMbAjavaLa pohocale.
tevhA lUta mhaNAle, tumhI loka tara kAhIse anoLakhI vATatAta.
te mhaNAle, (nAhI) kiMbahunA AmhI tumacyAjavaLa tI vastU gheUna Alo Ahota, jicyA bAbatIta he loka saMzaya karIta Aheta.
ANi AmhI tara tujhyAjavaLa (ughaDa) satya gheUna Alo Ahota, ANi AmhI AhotahI purepure sacce!

AtA tumhI ApalyA kuTuMbAsaha yA rAtrIcyA ekhAdyA bhAgAta nighUna jA. tumhI svataH tyAMcyA mAge rAhA (ANi sAvadhAna!) tumacyApaikI koNIhI mAge vaLUna pAhU naye ANi jyA ThikANI jAyacA tumhAlA Adeza dilA jAta Ahe, tithe cAlata jA.
ANi AmhI tyAcyAkaDe yA goSTIcA phaisalA kelA kI sakALa hotA hotAca tyA sarvAMcI muLe kApalI jAtIla.
ANi zaharI loka moThA AnaMda sAjarA karIta Ale.
(lUta) mhaNAle, he loka mAjhe atithI Aheta, tevhA tumhI malA apamAnita karU nakA.
ANi sarvazreSTha allAhace bhaya rAkhA ANi malA apamAnita karU nakA.
te mhaNAle, kAya AmhI tumhAlA sAr2yA jagAcA ThekA gheNyApAsUna manAI kelI navhatI?
(lUta) mhaNAle, jara tumhAlA kAhI karAyaceca Ahe tara yA mAjhyA mulI hajara Aheta
tumacyA AyuSyAcI zapatha! te tara ApalyA nazeta dhuMda phirata hote.
maga sUryodaya hotA hotA tyAMnA ekA bhayaMkara sphoTAcyA AvAjAne yeUna dharale.
zevaTI AmhI tyA (zaharA) lA ulathepAlathe karUna TAkale ANi tyA lokAMvara kaMkara pASANAMcA varSAva kelA.
niHsaMzaya, pratyeka bodha prApta karaNAr2yAkaritA yAta aneka nizANyA Aheta.
ANi hI vastI azA mArgAvara Ahe, jyAvara satata ye-jA hota asate.
ANi yAta ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMsAThI moThI nizANI Ahe.
ANi ayakA vastIce rAhaNAre lokahI moThe atyAcArI hote.
jyAMcyAzI zevaTI AmhI sUDa ghetalAca. hI donhI zahare khulyA mArgAvara Aheta.
ANi hijravAlyAMnIhI paigaMbarAMnA khoTe Tharavile.
ANi tyAMnA AmhI ApalyA nizANyA pradAna kelyA hotyA, paraMtu tarI dekhIla te tyA nizANyAMpAsUna mAnA phiravitaca rAhile.
ANi he loka ApalI ghare parvatAMnA korUna banavita asata, bhaya na rAkhatA.
zevaTI tyAMnAhI sakALa hotA hotA bhayaMkara citkArAne yeUna gAThale.
yAstava tyAMcyA koNatyAhI yuktI kauzalyAne ANi kAmagirIne tyAMnA kasalAhI lAbha pohacavilA nAhI.
ANi AmhI AkAzAMnA ANi dharatIlA ANi tyAMcyA daramyAnacyA samasta vastUMnA satyAsahaca banavile Ahe ANi kayAmata avazya yeNAra Ahe, tevhA tumhI bhalyA rItIne sahana karUna ghyA.
niHsaMzaya, tumacA pAlanakartAca nirmANa karaNArA ANi jANaNArA Ahe.
niHsaMzaya AmhI tumhAlA sAta AyatI pradAna kelyA Aheta jyAMcI punarAvRttI kelI jAte, ANi mahAna kuraAna dekhIla pradAna kelA Ahe.

tumhI kadhIhI ApalI najara tyA goSTIvara TAkU nakA, jilA AmhI, tyAMcyApaikI aneka prakAracyA lokAMnA pradAna kele Ahe. tyAMcyAbaddala tumhI duHkhahI karU nakA ANi ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMsAThI ApalyA bAjU jhukavA (tyAMnA moThyA snehAcI vAgaNUka dyA).
ANi sAMgA kI mI ughaDapaNe bhaya dAkhaviNArA Ahe.
jyApramANe AmhI tyA vibhAjana karaNAr2yAMvara utaravilA.
jyAMnI yA kuraAnace tukaDe tukaDe karUna TAkale.
zapatha Ahe tumacyA pAlanakartyAcI! AmhI tyA sarvAMnA avazya vicArU.
tyA pratyeka goSTIbAbata jI te karIta hote.
tevhA tumhI hA Adeza, jo tumhAlA dilA jAta Ahe, spaSTataH aikavA, ANi anekezvaravAdyAMpAsUna toMDa phiravUna ghyA.
tumacyAzI te loka thaTTA maskarI karatAta tyAMcyA (zikSe) karitA AmhI paryApta Ahota.
je loka allAhacyA sobata ANakhI itara upAsye banavitAta, tyAMnA lavakaraca mAhIta paDela.
ANi AmhAlA cAMgalyA prakAre mAhIta Ahe kI tyAMcyA bolaNyAne tumacyA manAlA Theca pohacate.
tumhI ApalyA pAlanakartyAcI mahAnatA ANi stutI prazaMsAce varNana karIta rAhA ANi natamastaka hoNAr2yAMmadhye sAmIla vhA.
ANi ApalyA pAlanakartyAcI upAsanA karIta rAhA, yetheparyaMta kI tumhAlA maraNa yAve.

sarvazreSTha allAhacA Adeza yeUna pohocalA, AtA yAcI ghAI mAjavU nakA samasta pavitratA tyAcyAsAThI Ahe, to sarvAMta mahAna Ahe, tyA sarvAMpekSA jyAMnA he allAhacyA javaLa bhAgIdAra asalyAce sAMgatAta.

toca phariztyAMnA ApalI vahayI (prakAzanA) deUna ApalyA AdezAdvAre ApalyA dAsAMpaikI, jyAcyAvara icchito utaravito, yAsAThI kI, tumhI, lokAMnA saceta karAve kI mAjhyAzivAya dusarA koNIhI upAsanesa pAtra nAhI, yAstava tumhI mAjhe bhaya rAkhA.
tyAneca AkAzAMnA ANi dharatIlA satyAsaha nirmANa kele. to tara tyAhUna uccatama Ahe je anekezvaravAdI karatAta.
tyAne mAnavAMnA vIryApAsUna nirmANa kele, maga to ughaDa bhAMDakhora banalA.
tyAneca janAvare nirmANa kelIta, jyAta tumacyAsAThI uSNatA deNAre kapaDe Aheta. itarahI aneka phAyade Aheta ANi kAhI tumacyA khANyAsAThI upayogI paDatAta.
ANi tyAMcyAta tumacyAsAThI zobhAhI Ahe jevhA tyAMnA cArUna ANAla tevhAhI ANi jevhA cAraNyAsAThI nyAla tevhAhI.
ANi te tumace ojhe tyA zaharAMparyaMta ucalUna netAta, jithe tumhI jIva ardhA kelyAvinA pohacU zakata navhate. niHsaMzaya, tumacA pAlanakartA atizaya snehazIla ANi khUpa khUpa dayA karaNArA Ahe.

ANi ghoDyAMnA, khaccarAMnA, gADhavAMnA (tyAneca nirmANa kele) yAsAThI kI tumhI tyAMnA vAhanAcyA svarUpAta vAparAta ANAve ANi te zobhA sajAvaTIce sAdhanahI Aheta. itarahI to azA vastU nirmANa karato, jyA tumhI jANata nAhIta.
ANi allAhaparyaMta pohacaNyAcA mArga saraLa mArga Ahe ANi kAhI vAkaDe mArgahI Aheta ANi tyAne icchile asate tara tumhA sarvAMnA saraLa mArgAsa lAvale asate.
toca tumacyA phAyadyAkaritA AkAzAtUna parjanya vRSTI karato je tumhI pItA hI ANi tyAdvAre ugavalelyA jhADAMnA tumhI ApalyA janAvarAMnanA cAratAta.
yAcyAcadvAre to tumacyAsAThI zetI ANi jaitUna ANi khajUra ANi drAkSa va sarva prakAracI phaLe ugavito. niHsaMzaya, ciMtana karaNAr2yA lokAMsAThI yAta moThyA nizANyA Aheta.
ANi tyAneca rAtra ANi divasAlA ANi sUrya va caMdrAlA tumacyA seveta lAvale Ahe ANi tAre dekhIla tyAcyAca hukumAcyA adhIna Aheta. niHsaMzaya, yAta buddhimAnAMkaritA aneka prakAracyA nizANyA Aheta.

ANi itarahI (vividha prakAracyA) aneka raMga rUpa asalelyA vastU tyAne tumacyAsAThI dharatIta pasaravUna ThevalyA Aheta. niHsaMzaya, bodha prApta karaNAr2yAMkaritA yAta moThyA jabaradasta nizANyA Aheta.

ANi samudrAMnAhI tumacyA adhIna karUna Thevale Ahe kI tumhI yAtUna nighAlele tAje mAMsa khAve ANi yAtUna ApalyA aMgAvara ghAlaNyAkaritA dAgine kADhU zakAve, ANi tumhI pAhAla kI nAvA yAta pANyAlA cirata cAlatAta ANi yAsAThIhI kI tumhI tyAcyA kRpecA zodha ghyAvA ANi saMbhavataH tumhI kRtajJatAhI vyakta karAvI.
ANi tyAne dharatIvara parvata gADale Aheta, yAsAThI kI tine tumacyAsaha halU naye ANi nadyA va mArga banavile, yAsAThI kI tumhI uddiSTAprata pohacAve.
dusar2yAhI aneka nizANyA (nirdhArIta kelyA) ANi tAr2yAMdvArehI loka mArga prApta karUna ghetAta.
tara kAya to, jo nirmANa karato, tyAcyA samAna Ahe, jo nirmANa karU zakata nAhI? kAya tumhI kadhIca vicAra karIta nAhI?
ANi jara tumhI allAhacyA deNagyAMcA hizoba (gaNanA) karU pAhAla tara tumhI to kadhIca karU zakata nAhI. niHsaMzaya, allAha mophA mApha karaNArA dayA karaNArA Ahe.
ANi je kAhI tumhI lapavAla kiMvA ughaDa karAla, allAha sarva kAhI jANato.
ANi sarvazreSTha allAhakherIja jyAMnA he loka pukAratAta te koNatIhI vastU nirmANa karU zakata nAhI, ulaTa he svataH nirmANa kele gele Aheta.
melele Aheta, jivaMta nAhIta. tyAMnA tara hehI mAhIta nAhI kI kevhA (jivaMta karUna) uThavale jAtIla.
tumhA sarvAMcA mAbUda (upAsya) kevaLa allAha ekaTA Ahe, ANi Akhiratavara ImAna na rAkhaNAr2yAMcI mane bhraSTa Aheta. ANi te svataH garviSTha Aheta.
niHsaMzaya, sarvazreSTha allAha, tyA pratyeka goSTIlA, jilA te lapavitAta ANi jilA jAhIra karatAta, cAMgalyA prakAre jANato. allAha ghameMDI lokAMnA pasaMta karIta nAhI.
ANi tyAMnA jevhA vicArale jAte kI tumacyA pAlanakartyAne kAya avatarIta kele Ahe, tevhA uttara detAta kI pUrvIcyA lokAMcyA kathA kahANyA Aheta.

(yAcAca pariNAma asela) kI kayAmatacyA divazI he loka ApalyA pUrNa ojhyAsaha, tyAMcyA ojhyAcehI bhAgIdAra TharatIla, jyAMnA jJAnAvinA pathabhraSTa karIta rAhile, pAhA tara kitI vAITa ojhe ucalata Aheta.

tyAMcyA pUrvIcyA lokAMnIhI kAvebAjapaNA kelA. (zevaTI) allAhane tyAMcyA (kaTa-kArasthAnAcyA) gharAMnA muLA (pAyA) pAsUna ukhaDUna TAkale ANi tyAMcyA (DokyAMvara) chata varUna kosaLale ANi tyAMcyAjava az2Aba (zikSA-yAtanA) azA ThikANAhUna AlA, je ThikANa tyAMcyA dhyAnImanIhI navhate.

maga kayAmatacyA divazIhI sarvazreSTha allAha tyAMnA apamAnita karIla ANi pharmAvila kI mAjhe te bhAgIdAra koThe Aheta, jyAMcyAviSayI tumhI laDhata jhagaData hote. jyAMnA jJAna dile gele hote, te uttara detIla kI Aja tara inkAra karaNAr2yAMnA apamAna ANi vAITapaNAne cAMgalI miThI mAralI.

te loka, je ApalyA prANAMvara julUma atyAcAra karatAta, pharizte jevhA tyAMcA prANa kADhU lAgatAta tevhA tyA veLI te jhukatAta kI AmhI vAITa AcaraNa karIta navhato, kA nAhI? allAha cAMgalyA prakAre jANato, je kAhI tumhI karIta hote.
tevhA AtA tumhI nehamI karIta jahannamacyA daravAjAtUna (jahannamamadhye) praveza karA. tara kitI vAITa ThikANa Ahe ghameMDa karaNAr2yAMce.

ANi allAhace bhaya rAkhaNAr2yAMnA vicArale jAte kI tumacyA pAlanakartyAne kAya avatarita kele Ahe, tevhA te uttara detAta kI uttamAta uttama. jyA lokAMnI satkarme kelIta, tyAMcyAsAThI yA jagAta bhalAI Ahe, ANi niHsaMzaya Akhiratace ghara tara phAra uttama Ahe. ANi kitI cAMgale ghara Ahe, allAhace bhaya rAkhaNAr2yAMce.

sadaiva kALa rAhaNAr2yA bAgAMmadhye jAtIla, jyAMcyA khAlI pravAha vAhata Aheta. te je mAgatIla te tithe tyAMcyAsAThI hajara asela. allAhace bhaya rAkhUna durAcArApAsUna dUra rAhaNAr2yAMnA allAha asAca mobadalA pradAna karato.

te loka, jyAcA prANa pharizte azA avastheta kADhatAta kI te svaccha pavitra asAveta, mhaNatAta kI tumacyAsAThI salAmatIca salAmatI Ahe. ApalyA tyA karmAMcyA mobadalyAta jannatamadhye jA, je tumhI karIta hote.

kAya he yAca goSTIcI vATa pAhAta Aheta kI tyAMcyAjavaLa pharizte yAveta kiMvA tumacyA pAlanakartyAcA Adeza yAvA? tyA lokAMnIhI aseca kele, je yAMcyApUrvI hoUna geleta. allAhane tyAMcyAvara koNatAhI atyAcAra kelA nAhI, ulaTa te svataHca ApalyA prANAMvara atyAcAra karIta rAhile.
tevhA tyAMcyA duSkarmAMcA mobadalA tyAMnA miLAlA ANi jyA goSTIcI te thaTTA uDavita hote, tine tyAMnA yeUna gherale.

ANi anekezvaravAdI mhaNAle, jara allAhane icchile asate tara AmhI ANi Amace vADavaDIla tyAcyAkherIja dusar2yAce upAsaka jhAle nasate, nA tyAcyA hukumAvinA ekhAdyA vastUlA harAma (avaidha) Tharavile asate. heca AcaraNa tyAMcyA pUrvIcyA lokAMcehI rAhile, tevhA paigaMbarAMcI jabAbadArI kevaLa spaSTa saMdeza pohacaviNyAcI Ahe.

ANi AmhI pratyeka janasamUhAta paigaMbara pAThavile kI (loka ho!) kevaLa allAhacI upAsanA karA ANi tAgUta (allAhakherIjacI sarva asatya upAsye) pAsUna dUra rAhA, tara kAhI lokAMnA allAhane mArgadarzana pradAna kele ANi kAhIMvara mArgabhraSTatA siddha jhAlI. AtA tumhI svataH dharatIvara hiMDUna phirUna pAhA kI khoTe TharaviNAr2yAMcA zevaTa kasA jhAlA!
tarIhI tumhI tyAMnA mArgadarzana lAbhAve azI icchA bALagata rAhile paraMtu allAha jyAlA mArgabhraSTa karato, tyAlA sanmArga dAkhavita nAhI, ANi nA tyAMcA koNI madatakartA asato.

ANi te loka moThamoThyA zapathA gheUna sAMgatAta kI melelyA lokAMnA allAha jivaMta karaNAra nAhI. kA nAhI, (avazya jivaMta karela) hA tara tyAcA agadI saccA ANi pakkA vAyadA Ahe, paraMtu adhikAMza loka jANata nAhIta.
azAsAThIhI kI, he loka jyA goSTIta matabheda karIta hote, tilA allAhane spaSTa karUna sAMgAve ANi yAsAThIhI inkAra karaNAr2yAMnI svataH ApaNa khoTe asalyAce jANUna ghyAve.
AmhI jevhA ekhAdyA goSTIcA irAdA karato, tevhA AmhAlA kevaLa itakeca sAMgAve lAgate kI ghaDUna ye ANi tI goSTa ghaDUna yete.

ANi jyA lokAMnI atyAcAra sahana kelyAnaMtara, allAhacyA mArgAta dezatyAga kelA, AmhI tyAMnA sarvAMta uttama jAgA yA jagAta pradAna karU ANi AkhiratacA mobadalA tara atizaya moThA Ahe. lokAMnI he jANUna ghetale asate tara kitI bare jhAle asate!
jyA lokAMnI dhIra saMyama rAkhalA, ANi ApalyA pAlanakartyAvara bharosA karIta rAhile.
ANi tumacyA pUrvIhI AmhI puruSAMnAca (paigaMbara mhaNUna) pAThavita rAhilo, jyAMcyAkaDe vahayI (prakAzanA) avatarita karIta hoto. jara tumhI jANata nasAla tara jJAnI lokAMnA vicArA.
nizANyA ANi graMthAMsaha. he smaraNa (graMtha) AmhI tumacyAkaDe avatarita kelA Ahe kI lokAMkaDe je utaravile gele Ahe, tumhI tyAMnA te spaSTapaNe sAMgAve, kadAcita tyAMnI vicArA ciMtana karAve.

vAITa kAvebAja karaNAre, kAya yA goSTIpAsUna nirbhaya jhAle Aheta kI allAha tyAMnA jaminIta dhasavUna TAkIla kiMvA tyAMcyAjavaLa azA ThikANAhUna az2Aba (zikSA-yAtanA) yAvI, jyA ThikANAcI tyAMnA zaMkA ANi kalpanAhI nasAvI.
kiMvA tyAMnA cAlatA phiratA dharUna ghyAve, he koNatyAhI prakAre allAhalA vivaza (lAcAra) karU zakata nAhI.
kiMvA tyAMnA bhaya dAkhavUna pakaDIta ghyAve, niHsaMzaya tumacA pAlanakartA moThA karuNAzIla ANi moThA dayAzIla Ahe.
kAya tyAMnI allAhacyA nirmitIpaikI koNAlAhI pAhile nAhI kI tyAcI sAvalI ujavyA-DAvyA bAjUkaDe jhukUna allAhasamora sajadA karate, ANi ApalI lAcArI vyakta karate.
ANi niHsaMzaya, AkAzAMmadhIla ANi dharatIce samasta sajIva ANi pharizte, sarvazreSTha allAhasamora sajadA karatAta ANi kiMcitahI ghameMDa karIta nAhI.
ANi ApalyA pAlanakartyAzI, jo tyAMcyAvaratI Ahe, tharathara kApata rAhatAta ANi jo Adeza miLela, tyAce pAlana karaNyAta magna rAhatAta.
ANi sarvazreSTha allAhane sAMgUna TAkale Ahe kI dona mAbUda (upAsye) banavU nakA. mAbUda tara toca phakta ekaTA Ahe, tevhA tumhI sarva kevaLa mAjheca bhaya rAkhA.
ANi AkAzAMmadhye ANi dharatIta je kAhI Ahe, sarva tyAceca Ahe, ANi tyAcIca upAsanA nehamI anivArya Ahe. kAya tarIhI tumhI tyAcyAkherIja dusar2yAMce bhaya bALagatA?
ANi tumacyAjavaLa jevaDhyA dekhIla allAhacyA kRpA deNagyA Aheta sarva tyAneca pradAna kelelyA Aheta. AtA jevhA dekhIla tumhAlA ekhAdI kaSTa-yAtanA AlyAsa tyAcyAcakaDe duA-prArthanA karatA.
ANi jevhA mAtra tyAne tI kaSTa-yAtanA tumacyApAsUna dUra kelI tevhA tumacyApaikI kAhI loka ApalyA pAlanakartyAsobata bhAgIdAra banavU lAgatAta.
yAsAThI kI AmhI pradAna kelelyA deNagyAMzI kRtaghnatA dAkhavAvI (ThIka Ahe) thoDA lAbha prApta karUna ghyA. zevaTI tumhAlA mAhItaca paDela.
ANi jyAlA te jANatahI nAhI, tyAcA hissA AmhI dilelyA vastUMmadhye nizcita karatAta, allAhacI zapatha! tumacyA yA AropAbaddala tumhAlA avazya vicAraNA hoIla.
ANi te pavitra allAhakarItA mulI nirdhArIta karatAta, ANi svataHsAThI te, je tyAMcyA icchenusAra asela.
ANi tyAMcyApaikI jevhA ekhAdyAlA mulagI jhAlyAcI khabara dilI jAte tevhA tyAce toMDa kALavaMDate ANi to manAtalyA manAta kuDhU lAgato.
yA vAITa bAtamImuLe, lokAMpAsUna toMDa lapavita phirato vicAra karato kAya yA apamAnAlA sobataca rAhU dyAvI kI hilA mAtIta gADUna TAkAve kitI vAITa nirNaya ghetAta he!
Akhiratavara ImAna na rAkhaNAr2yAMceca vAITa udAharaNa Ahe. allAhakaritA tara atizaya ucca udAharaNa Ahe. to moThA varcasvazAlI ANi hikamata bALagaNArA Ahe.

ANi jara lokAMcyA durAcArAbaddala allAhane tyAMnA pakaDIta gheNe surU kele asate tara dharatIvara eka dekhIla jIva vAcalA nasatA, paraMtu to tara tyAMnA ekA nirdhArIta avadhIparyaMta DhIla (savaDa) deto, maga jevhA tyAMcI tI veLa yete tevhA te eka kSaNa nA mAge rAhU zakatAta ANi nA puDhe jAU zakatAta.

ANi te svataHsAThI je apriya samajatAta, te allAhasAThI siddha karatAta ANi tyAMcyA jIbhA khoTyA goSTIMce varNana karatAta kI tyAMcyAsAThI bhalAI Ahe?(muLIca nAhI), vAstavika tyAMcyAsAThI Aga Ahe ANi he loka, jahannamI lokAMcyA puDhe puDhe jANAre Aheta.

allAhacI zapatha! AmhI tumacyA pUrvIcyA janasamUhAMkaDehI Apale paigaMbara pAThavile, paraMtu saitAnAne tyAMcyA duSkarmAMnA tyAMcyA najareta cAMgale Tharavile. to saitAna Aja dekhIla tyAMcA dosta banalelA Ahe ANi tyAMcyAsAThI duHkhadAyaka az2Aba Ahe.

ANi hA graMtha AmhI tumacyAvara azAsAThI avatarita kelA Ahe kI tumhI tI pratyeka goSTa ughaDa karAvI, jyAbAbata te matabheda karIta Aheta ANi hA graMtha ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMkaritA mArgadarzana ANi dayA Ahe.
ANi sarvazreSTha allAha AkAzAtUna parjanya vRSTI karUna, tyAdvaAre dharatIlA ticyA mRtyunaMtara jivaMta karato. niHsaMzaya yAta tyA lokAMkaritA nizANyA Aheta, je aikatIla.

ANi tumacyAsAThI tara janAvarAMmadhyehI moThA bodha Ahe kI AmhI tumhAlA tyAcyA poTAta je kAhI Ahe, tyAcyAtUnaca zeNa ANi raktAcyA madhUna zuddha nirbheLa dUdha pAjato, je piNAr2yAMsAThI sahajapaNe pacavale jAte.
ANi khajurIcyA va drAkSAMcyA vRkSAMcyA phaLAMpAsUna tumhI madya tayAra karatA ANi uttama anna-sAmugrIhI. niHsaMzaya akkala rAkhaNAr2yA lokAMkaritA yAtahI phAra moThI nizANI Ahe.
ANi tumacyA pAlanakartyAne madhamAzIlAhI preraNA dilI kI parvatAMvara, jhADAMvara ANi lokAMnI banavilelyA uMca uMca imAratIMvara Apale ghara (poLe) banava.

ANi pratyeka prakArace phaLa khA ANi ApalyA (pAlanakartyAcyA) sahaja sulabha mArgAMvara cAlata phirata rAhA. tyAMcyA poTAtUna peyadrava bAhera paDato, jyAce aneka raMga Aheta, ANi jyAta lokAMsAThI svAsthya Ahe. vicAra-ciMtana karaNAr2yAMsAThI yAtahI phAra moThI nizANI Ahe.

ANi sarvazreSTha allAhaneca tumhA sarvAMnA nirmANa kele Ahe. toca naMtara tumhAlA mRtyu deIla, ANi tumacyAta kAhI asehI Aheta je atizaya vAITa vayA (khUpa mhAtAravayA) kaDe paratavile jAtAta, kI khUpa kAhI jANUna ghetalyAnaMtarahI na jANAve. niHsaMzaya sarvazreSTha allAha sarva kAhI jANaNArA ANi sAmarthya rAkhaNArA Ahe.

ANi allAhaneca tumacyApaikI ekAlA dusar2yAvara rojI (anna sAmugrI) madhye vRddhI pradAna kelI Ahe, tathApi tyAMnA jAsta pradAna kele gele Ahe te ApalI AjivikA, ApalyA adhIna asalelyA dAsAM (nokarA) nA deta nAhIta kI te ANi he tyAta sama samAna hotIla. kAya he loka allAhacyA upakArAMcA inkAra karIta Aheta?

ANi allAhane tumacyAsAThI tumacyAmadhUnaca tumacyA patnyA nirmANa kelyA ANi tumacyA patnyAMpAsUna tumace putra ANi nAtU nirmANa kele ANi tumhAlA uttamottama vastU khAyalA dilyA, tara kAya, ase asatAnAhI loka asatyAvara ImAna rAkhatIla? ANi sarvazreSTha allAhacyA kRpA deNagyAMzI kRtaghnatA dAkhavatIla?
ANi te allAhazivAya tyAMcI upAsanA karatAta, je AkAzAMmadhUna ANi jaminItUna tyAMnA kiMcitahI rojI deU zakata nAhI ANi kasalehI sAmarthya bALagata nAhI.
tevhA, sarvazreSTha allAhakaritA udAharaNa banavU nakA, allAha cAMgalyA prakAre jANato ANi tumhI nAhI jANata.

allAha eka udAharaNa sAMgata Ahe kI eka gulAma Ahe dusar2yAcyA mAlakIcA, jo kasalAhI adhikAra rAkhata nAhI ANi eka dusarA manuSya Ahe, jyAlA AmhI ApalyA javaLUna phAra uttama dhana deUna Thevale Ahe. jyAtUna to lapavUna ANi ughaDapaNe kharca karato, kAya he donhI jaNa samAna TharU zakatAta? allAhakaritAca samasta stutI- prazaMsA Ahe. paraMtu tyAMcyApaikI bahuteka jANata nAhIta.

ANi allAha eka dusare udAharaNa sAMgato dona mANasAMce, jyAMcyApaikI eka mukA Ahe ANi koNatyAhI goSTIcA adhikAra bALagata nAhI, kiMbahunA to ApalyA mAlakAvara ojhe Ahe, mAlaka tyAlA koThehI pAThavila paNa to kasalAhI bhalepaNA ANata nAhI. kAya hA ANi to, jo nyAyAcA Adeza deto ANi saraLa mArgAvarahI cAlato, samAna asU zakatAta?

ANi AkAzAMcyA va dharatIcyA (sarva) lapalelyA vastUMce jJAna kevaLa allAhalAca Ahe, ANi kayAmatacI bAba dekhIla azIca Ahe, jaNU pApaNIce jhapakaNe, kiMbahunA yAhUnahI adhika javaLa. niHsaMzaya allAha pratyeka goSTa karaNyAce sAmarthya rAkhato.

ANi allAhane tumhAlA tumacyA mAtAMcyA udarAtUna bAhera kADhale kI tyA veLI tumhI kAhIca jANata navhate. tyAneca tumace kAna ANi DoLe ANi hRdaya banavile, yAsAThI kI tumhI kRtajJatA vyakta karU zakAve.

kAya tyA lokAMnI pakSyAMnA nAhI pAhile, je AdezaAnusAra AkAzAta niyaMtrita Aheta, jyAMnA allAhakherIja dusar2yA kuNI dharUna Thevale nAhI. niHsaMzaya, yAta ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMkaritA moThyA nizANyA Aheta.

ANi allAhane tumacyAsAThI tumacyA gharAMmadhye nivAsAce sthAna banavile Ahe ANi tyAneca tumacyAsAThI janAvarAMcyA kAtaDIcI ghare (taMbU) banavile, jI tumhAlA halakI disUna yetAta, ApalyA prasthAnAcyA divazI ANi ApalyA paDAva TAkaNyAcyA divazIhI ANi tyAMcI lokara, lava (roye) ANi kesAMpAsUnahI tyAne anekavidha vastU ANi ekA nirdhArIta veLeparyaMta lAbhadAyaka vastU ANi banavilyA.

ANi allAhaneca tumacyAsAThI ApalyA nirmANa kelelyA vastUMmadhUna sAvalI banavilI Ahe, ANi tyAneca tumacyAsAThI parvatAMmadhye guhA banavilI ANi tyAneca tumacyAsAThI kapaDe banavile Aheta, je tumhAlA uSNatepAsUna surakSita rAkhatIla ANi azI cilakhate dekhIla jI tumhAlA yuddha-prasaMgI upayogI paDatIla. to azA prakAre ApalI kRpA deNagI purepUra pradAna karIta Ahe, yAsAThI kI tumhI tyAce AjJadhAraka vhAve.
tarIhI jara he toMDa phiravUnaca rAhatIla tara tumacI jabAbadArI kevaLa sApha ANi spaSTapaNe pohacavUna deNe evaDhIca Ahe.
allAhacyA kRpA deNagIMnA he jANata va oLakhata asatAnAhI tyAMcyA inkAra karIta Aheta, kiMbahunA tyAMcyAtale bahuteka jaNa tara kRtaghna Aheta.
ANi jyA divazI AmhI pratyeka janasamUhAtUna sAkSI ubhA karU, maga inkArI lokAMnA nA anumatI dilI jAIla ANi nA tyAMnA kSamA-yAcanA karaNyAsa sAMgitale jAIla.
ANi jevhA he atyAcArI loka az2Aba (zikSA-yAtanA) pAhUna ghetIla, maga nA to tyAcyAvarUna saumya kelA jAIla ANi nA tyAMnA DhIla (savaDa) dilI jAIla.

ANi jevhA allAhacA sahabhAgI TharaviNAre ApalyA sahabhAgIMnA pAhatIla tevhA mhaNatIla, he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! heca te Amace sahabhAgI, jyAMnA AmhI tulA soDUna pukArata asU, maga te tyAMnA uttara detIla kI tumhI pUrNataH khoTAraDe AhAta.
ANi tyA divazI te sarva (lAcAra hoUna) allAhasamora AjJAdhAraka hoNe mAnya karatIla ANi yApUrvI, jyA khoTyA goSTI te racata hote, tyA sarva tyAMcyApAsUna haravatIla.
jyA lokAMnI inkAra kelA ANi allAhacyA mArgApAsUna rokhale, AmhI tyAMnA az2Abavara az2Aba vADhavita jAU. hA mobadalA asela tyAMcyA upadravakAritecA!

ANi jyA divazI AmhI pratyeka janasamUhAta tyAMcyAtUnaca tyAMcyAvara sAkSa deNArA banavUna ANU ANi AmhI tumacyAvara hA graMtha avatarita kelA Ahe jyAta pratyeka goSTIce spaSTa varNana Ahe ANi musalamAnAMkaritA mArgadarzana, dayA ANi khUzakhabara Ahe.
