niHsaMzaya, allAha nyAyAcA, bhalepaNAcA ANi javaLacyA nAtevAIkAMzI cAMgale vartana karaNyAcA Adeza deto, ANi nirlajjatecyA kAmAMpAsUna ANi vAITa goSTIMpAsUna ANi atyAcArApAsUna rokhato. to svataH tumhAlA upadeza karIta Ahe, yAsAThI kI tumhI bodha prApta karAvA.

ANi allAhazI kelelA vAyadA pUrNa karA, jevhA tumhI ApasAta vAyade ANi vacana-karAra karAla ANi zapathAMnA, tyAMcyA majabUtInaMtara toDU nakA, jyAarthI tumhI allAhalA ApalA jAmIna TharavUna ghetale Ahe. niHsaMzaya, tumhI je kAhI karatA, allAha te cAMgalyA prakAre jANato.

ANi tyA (strI) sArakhe hoU nakA, jine Apale sUta majabUta kAtalyAnaMtara tukaDe tukaDe karUna TAkale kI tumhI ApalyA zapathAMnA ApasAta chaLa-kapaTAce nimitta banavAve, yAsAThI kI eka gaTa dusar2yA gaTApekSA ucca TharAvA. kharI goSTa hIca kI yA vAyadyAdvAre allAha tumacI parIkSA gheta Ahe. niHsaMzaya, sarvazreSTha allAha tumacyAsAThI kayAmatacyA divazI tumhAlA pratyeka goSTIlA spaSTa karUna sAMgela, jicyAbAbata tumhI matabheda karIta hote.

ANi allAhane icchile asate tara tumhA sarvAMnA ekAca matAce banavile asate, paraMtu to jyAlA icchito mArgabhraSTa karato, ANi jyAlA icchito sanmArga dAkhavito. niHsaMzaya, tumhI je kAhI karIta AhAta, tyAbAbata vicAraNA kelI jANAra Ahe.

ANi tumhI ApalyA zapathAMnA ApasAtIla vaira-dveSAce sAdhana banavU nakA, anyathA tumacI pAvale ApalyA majabutI (sthirate) naMtara DaLamaLU lAgatIla ANi tumhAlA sakta zikSA-yAtanA cAkhAvI lAgela, kAraNa kI tumhI allAhacyA mArgApAsUna rokhale ANi tumhAlA jAsta kaThora zikSA-yAtanA hoIla.
ANi tumhI allAhacyA vAyadyAsa thoDyAzA kiMmatIvara vikata jAU nakA. lakSAta ThevA, allAhacyA javaLacI vastUca tumacyAsAThI uttama Ahe jara tumhI jANata asAla.
tumacyAjavaLa je kAhI Ahe, te sarva nAza pAvaNAre Ahe ANi allAhajavaLa je kAhI Ahe nehamI rAhaNAre Ahe ANi saburI rAkhaNAr2yAMnA AmhI cAMgalyA karmAcA cAMgalA mobadalA avazya pradAna karU.

jo manuSya satkarma karIla, puruSa aso kiMvA strI, ANi ImAna rAkhaNArAhI asela, tara AmhI tyAlA niHsaMzaya uttama jIvana pradAna karU ANi tyAMcyA nekIcyA karmAMcA uttama mobadalAhI tyAMnA avazya pradAna karU.
kuraAna paThaNa karatAnA, dhiHkkAralelyA saitAnApAsUna allAhace zaraNa mAgata jA.
(nizcitaca) tyAcA jora azA lokAMvara kadhIhI cAlata nAhI, je ImAna rAkhatAta, ANi ApalyA pAlanakartyAvara bharosA ThevatAta.
mAtra, azA lokAMvara tyAcA prabhAva jarUra Ahe, je tyAcyAzI maitrI ThevatAta ANi tyAlA allAhacA bhAgIdAra banavitAta.

ANi jevhA AmhI ekhAdyA AyatIcyA jAgI dusarI Ayata badalato ANi je kAhI allAha avatarita karato, te to cAMgalyA prakAre jANato tevhA te mhaNatAta kI tumhI tara he svataH racUna ANatA, vAstavika tyAMcyApaikI bahuteka loka jANataca nAhIta.

tumhI sAMgA kI tyAsa tumacyA pAlanakartyAtarphe jibrIla satyAsaha gheUna Ale Aheta, yAsAThI kI ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMnA allAhane sthairya pradAna karAve ANi musalamAnAMkaritA mArgadarzana ANi khUzakhabara TharAvI.
ANi AmhAlA cAMgale mAhIta Ahe, je inkArI mhaNatAta kI tyAMnA tara eka mANUsa zikavito jyA mANasAkaDe yAMcA izArA Ahe to tara g2airaarabI (ajamI) Ahe ANi hA kuraAna tara spaSTa arabI bhASeta Ahe.
je loka allAhacyA AyatIMvara ImAna rAkhata nAhI, tyAMnA allAhatarphehI mArgadarzana lAbhata nAhI ANi tyAMcyAsAThI duHkhadAyaka az2Aba Ahe.
khoTA Aropa tara teca ThevatAta, jyAMce allAhacyA AyatIMvara ImAna nasate ANi heca loka khoTe Aheta.

jo manuSya ApalyA ImAnAnaMtara allAhazI inkAra karIla, tyAcyAkherIja, jyAlA tase karaNyAsa bhAga pADale jAve ANi tyAce mana mAtra ImAnAvara kAyama asAve, paraMtu je loka agadI mokaLyA manAne kupra (inkAra) karatIla tara azA lokAMvara allAhacA prakopa Ahe ANi azAca lokAMsAThI bhayaMkara zikSA yAtanA Ahe.
he azAsAThI kI tyAMnI aihika jIvanAlA maraNottara jIvanApekSA adhika cAMgale samajUna ghetale. niHsaMzaya, sarvazreSTha allAha inkAra karaNAr2yA lokAMnA mArga dAkhavita nAhI.
he ase loka hote, jyAMcyA hRdayAMvara ANi jyAMcyA kAnAMvara ANi DoLyAMvara allAhane mohara lAvalI Ahe ANi heca loka gAphIla Aheta.
niHsaMzaya, heca loka Akhirata (maraNottara jIvanA) madhye phAra moThe nukasAna ucalaNAra Aheta.

maga jyA lokAMnI kasoTIta TAkale gelyAnaMtara (dhArmika kAraNAMnI) dezatyAga kelA, maga jihAda kelA ANi dhIra-saMyama dAkhavilA, niHsaMzaya, tumacA pAlanakartA, yA goSTInaMtara tyAMnA mApha karaNArA ANi dayA karaNArA Ahe.
jyA divazI pratyeka manuSya svataHsAThI vAdavivAda ghAlata yeIla ANi pratyekAlA tyAcyA kRta karmAcA purepUra mobadalA dilA jAIla ANi lokAMvara kiMcitahI atyAcAra kelA jANAra nAhI.

ANi sarvazreSTha allAha tyA vastIce udAharaNa sAdara karato, jI sukha-zAMtIpUrvaka hotI. ticI rojI (AjivivakA) ticyAjavaLa susaMpannatesaha sarva mArgAMnI cAlUna yeta hotI, maga tyA vastIne allAhacyA kRpA deNagyAMcA inkAra kelA, tevhA sarvazreSTha allAhane tilA bhUka ANi bhayAcA svAda cAkhavilA. hA mobadalA hotA tyAMcyA vAITa karmAMcA.
ANi tyAMcyAjavaLa, tyAMcyAmadhUnaca paigaMbara yeUna pohocalA, tarIhI tyAMnI tyAlA khoTe Tharavile, tevhA az2Aba (zikSA-yAtanA) ne tyAMnA yeUna dharale ANi te hoteca atyAcArI.
ANi jI kAhI halAla (ucita) ANi pAka rojI (AjivikA) allAhane tumhAlA deUna ThevalI Ahe, tI khA ANi allAhacyA deNagI (nemata) baddala kRtajJatA vyakta karA, jara tumhI tyAcIca upAsanA karata asAla.

tumacyAkaritA kevaLa melele ANi rakta ANi DukarAce mAMsa ANi jyA vastUvara allAhazivAya dusar2yAce nAva ghetale jAIla, harAma Ahe. tarIhI jara ekhAdA manuSya lAcAra kelA jAvA ANi to atyAcArI nasAvA ANi nA maryAdece ullaMghana karaNArA asAvA tara niHsaMzaya allAha mApha karaNArA ANi khUpa dayA karaNArA Ahe.

ANi ekhAdyA vastUlA ApalyA toMDAne khoTeca sAMgata jAU nakA kI hI halAla Ahe ANi hI harAma Ahe kI (azAne) allAhavara khoTA Aropa lAvAla. niHsaMzaya sarvazreSTha allAhavara khoTA Aropa racaNAre saphalatepAsUna vaMcitaca rAhatAta.
tyAMnA phAra kamI lAbha prApta hoto ANi tyAMcyAsAThI duHkhadAyaka az2Aba (zikSa-yAtanA) Ahe.
ANi yahUdI lokAMvara AmhI je kAhI harAma kele hote, te AmhI yApUrvIca tumhAlA aikavile Ahe. AmhI tyAMcyAvara atyAcAra kelA nAhI kiMbahunA te svataHca ApalyA prANAMvara julUma karIta rAhile.

kI jo koNI ajJAnAne vAITa karma karIla, maga tyAnaMtara taubA (kSamA-yAcanA) karIla ANi (ApalyA AcaraNAta) sudhAraNAhI karUna gheIla tara maga tumacA pAlanakartA nizcitaca moThA mApha karaNArA ANi atizaya dayA karaNArA Ahe.

niHsaMzaya, ibrAhIma (muslima janasamUhAce) pramukha ANi sarvazreSTha allAhace moThe AjJAdhAraka, sagaLIkaDUna alaga hoUna phakta eka allAhace jhAle hote ANi aneka IzvarAMcI upAsanA karaNAr2yAMpaikI navhate.
sarvazreSTha allAhane pradAna kelelyA kRpA deNagyAMbaddala kRtajJazIla hote. allAhane tyAMnA nivaDUna ghetale hote ANi tyAMnA saraLa mArga dAkhavilA hotA.
ANi AmhI tyAMnA yA jagAtahI bhalAI pradAna kelI ANi niHsaMzaya AkhiratamadhyehI te neka sadAcArI lokAMpaikI Aheta.

maga AmhI tumacyAkaDe vahayI (prakAzanA) pAThavilI kI tumhI ibrAhImacyAca mArgAce anusaraNa karA, je sarvAMpAsUna alaga hoUna eka allAhace jhAle hote ANi te aneka IzvarAMcI upAsanA karaNAr2yAMpaikI navhate.

zanivAracyA divasAce mahattva tara phakta tyA lokAMkaritA atyAvazya Tharavile gele hote, jyAMnI tyAta matabheda kelA hotA. vAstavika tumacA pAlanakartA svataHca tyAMcyAta tyAMcyA matabhedAcA phaisalA kayAmatacyA divazI karela.

ApalyA pAlanakartyAkaDe lokAMnA hikamatIne ANi uttama azA zikavaNIsaha bolavA ANi tyAMcyAzI khUpa cAMgalyA prakAre bolA. niHsaMzaya tumacA pAlanakartA, ApalyA mArgApAsUna bhaTakalelyA lokAMnA cAMgalyA prakAre jANato ANi sanmArgAvara cAlaNAr2yAMnAhI to pUrNataH jANUna Ahe.
ANi (ekhAdyAzI) sUDa ghyAyacAca asela tara agadI tevaDhAca ghyA jevaDhe duHkha tumhAlA pohacavile gele asela ANi jara saburI rAkhAlA tara niHsaMzaya saburI rAkhaNAr2yAMsAThI heca uttama Ahe.
tumhI dhIra-saMyama rAkhA. allAhacyA dayevinA tumhI dhIra-saMyama rAkhUca zakata nAhI ANi tyAMcyA avasthene duHkhI kaSTI hoU nakA ANi jo kAvebAjapaNA he karatAta, tyAmuLe mana saMkucita karU nakA.
niHsaMzaya, je loka allAhace bhaya rAkhUna, durAcArApAsUna dUra rAhatAta ANi satkarma karIta rAhatAta, allAha tyAMcyA pAThIzI Ahe.

pavitra Ahe to (allAha), jo ApalyA dAsAlA ekA rAtrItUna AdaraNIya masjidIpAsUna, aksA masjidaparyaMta gheUna gelA, jicyA bhovatI AmhI barakatI pradAna karUna ThevalyA Aheta. yAsAThI kI AmhI tyAlA ApalyA sAmarthyAcyA kAhI moThyA nizANyA dAkhavUna dyAvyAta. niHsaMzaya sarvazreSTha allAhaca cAMgalyA prakAre aikaNArA, pAhaNArA Ahe.
ANi AmhI mUsAlA graMtha pradAna kelA ANi tyAlA isrAIlacyA saMtatIkaritA mArgadarzaka banavile kI tumhI mAjhyAzivAya dusar2yA koNAlAhI kAma banaviNArA banavU nakA.
he tyA lokAMpAsUna janmAsa AlelyAMno! jyAMnA AmhI nUhacyA sobata nauketa caDhavile hote. to AmacA moThA kRtajJazIla dAsa hotA.
ANi AmhI isrAIlacyA saMtatIkaritA tyAMcyA graMthAta spaSTataH nirNaya dilA hotA kI tumhI dharatIvara dona veLA upadrava nirmANa karAla, ANi tumhI phAra jAsta atyAcAra karAla.

yA donhI vAyadyAMpaikI pahilyA vAyadyAcI veLa yetAca AmhI tumacyAsamora ApalyA tyA dAsAMnA uThavUna ubhe kele je moThe laDhavayye hote, maga te tumacyA gharAMmadhye agadI AtAparyaMta pasarale ANi allAhacA vAyadA pUrNa hoNAraca hotA.
maga AmhI tumhAlA tyAMcyAvara varcasva deUna (tumace divasa) pAlaTale ANi vipula dhana saMpattI ANi saMtatIne tumacI madata kelI ANi tumace samUha baLa vADhavile.

jara tumhI satkarma karAla tara svataH ApalyA phAyadyAkaritA karAla ANi jara tumhI vAITa karme karAla tara te dekhIla svataHsAThIca. maga jevhA dusar2yA vAyadyAcI veLa AlI, tevhA (AmhI dusar2yA dAsAMnA pAThavile) yAsAThI kI tyAMnI tumacA ceharA bighaDavUna TAkAvA ANi pahilyA khepepramANe punhA tyAca masjidIta ghusAve ANi jI kAhI vastU tAbyAta yeIla, toDaphoDa karUna muLAsakaTa upaTUna TAkAvI.

AzA Ahe kI tumacA pAlanakartA tumacyAvara dayA karIla. paraMtu jara tumhI punhA teca karU lAgAla tara AmhI dekhIla punhA taseca karU, ANi AmhI inkAra karaNAr2yAMsAThI jahannamalA kaidakhAnA banavUna Thevale Ahe.
niHsaMzaya, hA kuraAna to mArga dAkhavito, jo sarvAMta saraLa Ahe, ANi satkarma karaNAr2yA ImAnadhArakAMnA hI khUzakhabara deto kI tyAMcyAsAThI atizaya cAMgalA mobadalA (pratiphaLa) Ahe.
ANi te loka, je Akhiratavara vizvAsa rAkhata nAhI, tyAMcyAsAThI AmhI duHkhadAyaka az2Aba tayAra karUna ThevalA Ahe.
ANi manuSya vAITa goSTIMcI duA prArthanA karU lAgato, agadI tyAcyA svataHcyA bhalAIcyA duA- prArthanesArakhI, manuSya moThA utAvaLA Ahe.

ANi AmhI rAtra ANi divasAlA (ApalyA sAmarthyAcI) nizANI banavile Ahe. rAtrIcyA nizANIlA AmhI prakAzahIna (nisteja) kele ANi divasAcyA nizANIlA prakAzamAna dAkhaviNArI banavile Ahe. yAsAThI kI tumhI ApalyA pAlanakartyAcyA kRpecA zodha gheU zakAve. ANi yAsAThIhI kI varSAcI gaNanA ANi hizoba jANU zakAve. ANi pratyeka viSayAce AmhI savistara nivedana kele Ahe.
ANi AmhI mANasAce cAMgale-vAITa tyAcyA gaLyAta TAkale Ahe, ANi kayAmatacyA divazI AmhI tyAcA karma-lekha bAhera kADhU, jo tyAlA ApalyAvara khulA asalelA ADhaLela.
AtA svataHca Apale karmapatra vAcUna ghyA. Aja tara tU svataHca ApalA phaisalA karaNyAsa puresA Ahe.

jo manuSya mArgadarzana prApta karato, to svataH ApalyA bhalyAsAThI mArgadarzana prApta karato ANi jo mArgabhraSTa hoIla tara tyAce ojhe tyAcyAvaraca Ahe. koNIhI ojhe bALagaNArA dusar2yA kuNAce ojhe ApalyAvara lAdUna gheNAra nAhI ANi AmacA hA niyama nAhI kI paigaMbara pAThaviNyApUrvIca az2Aba (zikSA-yAtanA) pAThavAvA.

ANi jevhA AmhI ekhAdyA vastIcA sarvanAza karaNyAcA irAdA karUna gheto tevhA tithalyA sukhavastU (susaMpanna) lokAMnA kAhI Adeza deto ANi te tyA vastIta ughaDapaNe avajJA karU lAgatAta, tevhA tyAMcyAvara (zikSA-yAtanecA) phaisalA lAgU hoto ANi maga AmhI tyA vastIcI ulathApAlatha karUna TAkato.
ANi AmhI nUhanaMtarahI aneka samudAya naSTa karUna TAkale ANi tumacA pAlanakartA ApalyA dAsAMcyA aparAdhAMnA cAMgalyA prakAre jANUna Ahe ANi cAMgalyA prakAre pAhaNArA Ahe.

jyAcI icchA phakta yA zIghratApUrNa jagApuratIca asela tara tyAlA AmhI ithe, jevaDhe deU icchito lavakara pradAna karato. zevaTI mAtra tyAcyAsAThI AmhI jahannama nizcita karato, jithe to moThyA vAITa avastheta, dhiHkkAralA gelelA dAkhala hoIla.

ANi jo AkhiratacI icchA bALagela, ANi tyAsAThI jasA prayatna karAyalA havA, tasA to karatahI asela ANi to ImAna rAkhaNArAhI asela tara maga heca te loka hota, jyAcyA prayatnAlA allAhacyA ThAyI purepUra sanmAna dilA jAIla.
pratyekAlA AmhI pradAna karIta asato yAMnAhI ANi tyAMnAhI, tumacyA pAlanakartyAcyA deNagyAMmadhUna, ANi tumacyA pAlanakartyAcA anugraha thAMbalelA nAhI.
pAhA, tyAMcyAta ekAlA ekAvara kazA prakAre zreSThatA pradAna kelI Ahe ANi Akhirata (maraNottara jIvana) tara darjAcyA dRSTIne atizaya uttama Ahe ANi zreSThatecyA dRSTInehI phAraca uttama Ahe.
allAhasobata dusar2yA kuNAlA upAsya banavU nakA kI zevaTI tumhI apamAnita, asahAyya hoUna basAla.

ANi tumacyA pAlanakartyAne ughaDa Adeza dilelA Ahe kI tumhI tyAcyAzivAya dusar2yA koNAcIhI upAsanA karU nakA ANi mAtA-pityAzI sad‌vyavahAra karA, jara tumacyA upasthitIta (hayAtIta) yAMcyApaikI eka kiMvA he doghe vRddhAvasthesa pohocatIla tara tyAMnA ‘are’ suddhA bolU nakA, tyAMnA dATavU nakA, ulaTa tyAMcyAzI Adara-sanmAnAne bolata jA.

ANi naramI va premAsaha tyAMcyAsamora vinamratApUrvaka hAta pasaravUna ThevA ANi duA-prArthanA karIta rAhA, he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! yAMcyAvara azIca dayA kara jazI yAMnI mAjhyA bAlapaNAta mAjhe pAlanapoSaNa karaNyAta kelI Ahe.
je kAhI tumacyA hRdayAta Ahe te tumacA pAlanakartA cAMgalyA prakAre jANato. jara tumhI neka sadAcArI asAla tara to kSamA-yAcanA karaNAr2yAMnA mApha karaNArA Ahe.
ANi nAtevAIkAMcA, ANi dIna-dubaLyAMcA ANi pravAzAMcA hakka adA karIta rAhA, ANi apavyaya karaNyApAsUna dUra rAhA.
nizcitaca, apavyaya (udhaLapaTTI) karaNAre saitAnAce bAMdhava Aheta, ANi saitAna ApalyA pAlanakartyAzI moThA kRtaghna Ahe.

ANi ApalyA pAlanakartyAcyA tyA dayA-kRpecA zodha gheNyAta, jicI tU AzA bALagato, jara tulA tyAMcyApAsUna toMDa phiravAve lAgela tara azAhI sthitIta tU tyAMnA cAMgalyA prakAre ANi naramIne samajAvile pAhije.
ANi ApalA hAta ApalyA gaLyAzI bAMdhUna ThevU nakA ANi nA to pUrNapaNe mokaLA soDA, maga dhiHkkAralelA ANi pazcAttApita hoUna basAve.

niHsaMzaya, tumacA pAlanakartA, jyAlA icchito rojI (AjivikA) vistRta karato ANi jyAcyAsAThI icchito saMkucita (taMga) karato. niHsaMzaya, to ApalyA dAsAMcI purepUra khabara rAkhato ANi khUpa cAMgalyA prakAre pAhaNArA Ahe.
ANi dAridyrAcyA bhayAne ApalyA saMtatIlA mArUna TAkU nakA. tyAMnA ANi tumhAlA AmhIca rojI (AjivikA) pradAna karato. niHsaMzaya, tyAMcI hatyA karaNe phAra moThA aparAdha Ahe.
ANi khabaradAra! vyabhicArAcyA javaLahI jAU nakA, kAraNa tI moThI nirlajjatA Ahe, ANi atizaya vAITa mArga Ahe.

ANi ekhAdyA jIvAlA, jyAlA mAraNe allAhane harAma kele Ahe, kadhIhI avaidharityA mArU nakA (tyAcI hatyA karU nakA) ANi jo manuSya niraparAdha avastheta ThAra mAralA jAIla tara AmhI tyAcyA vArasAlA hakka deUna ThevalA Ahe. paraMtu tyAne (pratizodha mhaNUna) ThAra mAraNyAta ghAI karU naye. niHsaMzaya tyAcI madata kelI gelI Ahe.

ANi anAthAcyA dhana-saMpattIcyA javaLahI jAU nakA, tyA paddhatIzivAya, jI adhika cAMgalI ase, yethaparyaMta kI te ApalyA sajJAna hoNyAcyA vayAsa pohacAveta ANi vAyadA pUrNa karIta jA kAraNa kI vAyadyAviSayI vicAraNA hoIla.
ANi jevhA mApUna dyAla tevhA pUrNa mApa bharUna dyA ANi saraLa tarAjUne tolUna dyA. heca cAMgale Ahe ANi yAcA pariNAmahI phAra cAMgalA Ahe.
ANi jyA goSTIcI tumhAlA khabarahI nasela, azA goSTIcyA mAge lAgU nakA, kAraNa kAna ANi DoLe ANi hRdaya yAMcyApaikI pratyekAlA vicAraNA kelI jANAra Ahe.
ANi jaminIvara moThyA dimAkhAne va garvAne cAlU nakA, kAraNa (azAne) nA tumhI jaminIlA phADU zakatA ANi nA parvatAMcyA uMcIparyaMta pohocU zakatA.
yA sarva kAmAMcA vAITapaNA tumacyA pAlanakartyAjavaLa atizaya apriya Ahe.

he dekhIla tyA vahayI (prakAzanA) paikI Ahe, jilA tumacyA pAlanakartyAne tumacyAkaDe hikamatIne utaravile Ahe, yAstava allAhasobata dusar2yA koNatyAhI upAsya banavU nakA anyathA dhiHkkAra karUna ANi apamAnita karUna jahannamamadhye TAkale jAla.
kAya putrAMkaritA allAhane tumhAlA nivaDUna ghetale Ahe ANi svataH ApalyAkaritA phariztyAMnA mulI banavUna ghetale? khAtrIne tumhI phAra moThe bola bolata AhAta.
ANi AmhI tara yA kuraAnAta sarva prakAre sAMgitale Ahe kI lokAMcyA dhyAnI yAve, paraMtu yAvarahI tyAMcA tiraskAraca vADhato.
tumhI sAMgA, jara allAhasobata ANakhI dusare upAsya asate, jase kI he loka sAMgatAta, tara avazya tyAMnI AtAparyaMta arzacyA svAmIkaDe mArga zodhalA asatA.
je kAhI he sAMgatAta, tyAhUna to pavitra ANi mahAna, atizaya dUra, ANi atizaya uccatama Ahe.

sapta AkAza ANi dharatI, ANi je kAhI tyAMcyAta Ahe, sarva tyAceca stuti-gAna karatAta. azI ekahI vastU nAhI, jI pavitratA ANi mahAnatesaha tyAce smaraNa karIta nasela. mAtra he khare Ahe kI tumhI tice mahimAgAna samajU zakata nAhI. niHsaMzaya allAha moThA sahanazIla ANi mApha karaNArA Ahe.
ANi jevhA tumhI kuraAna paThaNa karatA, tevhA AmhI tumacyA ANi tyA lokAMcyA daramyAna, je Akhiratavara vizvAsa Thevata nAhI, eka gupta paDadA TAkato.

ANi tyAMcyA hRdayAMvara paDade TAkale Aheta kI tyAMnI tyAlA samajAve ANi tyAMcyA kAnAta badhIratA ANi jevhA tumhI kevaLa allAhaceca varNana tyAcyA ekamevatesaha yA kuraAnAta karatA tevhA te toMDa phiravUna paLa kADhatAta.

jyA hetune te kuraAna aikatAta, tyAMce irAde AmhI cAMgalyA prakAre jANato. jevhA he tumacyAkaDe kAna lAvUna asatAta. tevhA dekhIla, ANi jevhA he sallAmasalata karatAta tevhAhI vAstavika he atyAcArI loka mhaNatAta kI tumhI azA vyaktIce anusaraNa karaNyAta magna AhAta, jyAcyAvara jAdUToNA kelA gelA Ahe.
jarA pahA tarI tumacyA sAThI te kasa kazI udAharaNe detAta yAstava te cukIcyA mArgAkaDe jAta Aheta AtA tara saraLa mArga prApta karaNe tyAMnA zakya nAhI
te mhaNAle, kAya jevhA AmhI hADe ANi dhULa mAtI hoUna jAU tara kAya AmhI navyAne janmAsa yeUna dusar2yAMdA uThavUna ubhe kele jAU?
uttara dyA kI tumhI dagaDa banA kiMvA lokhaMDa.

kiMvA ekhAdI azI vastU, jI tumacyA manAta atizaya mahAna vATata asela. maga tyAMnI vicArAve kI asA koNa Ahe, jo dusar2yAMdA Amace jIvana parata karela? tumhI uttara dyA kI toca (allAha) jyAne tumhAlA pahilyA khepesa nirmANa kele. yAvara te Apale Doke halavUna tumhAlA vicAratIla kI, bare he kevhA ghaDUna yeIla? tara tumhI uttara dyA kI navala navhe kI te lavakaraca ghaDUna yeIla.
jyA divazI to tumhAlA bolAvIla, tumhI tyAcI prazaMsA karata AjJApAlana karAla ANi anumAna lAvAla kI tumhI phAra kamI kALa rAhilAta.
ANi mAjhyA dAsAMnA sAMgA kI tyAMnI phAra uttama goSTa ApalyA mukhAtUna kADhata jAvI, kAraNa saitAna ApasAta phUTa pADato. nizcitaca saitAna mANasAcA ughaDa zatrU Ahe.

tumacA pAlanakartA tumacI avasthA tumacyApekSA adhika jANaNArA Ahe. to jara icchila tara tumacyAvara dayA karela, icchila tara tumhAlA zikSA deIla. AmhI tumhAlA tyAMcyAvara dekharekha ThevaNArA banavUna pAThavile nAhI.
ANi AkAzAMmadhye ANi dharatIta je kAhI Ahe, te sarva tumacA pAlanakartA cAMgalyA prakAre jANato, AmhI kAhI paigaMbarAMnA kAhIMvara zreSThatA pradAna kelI Ahe ANi dAUdalA jabUra AmhIca pradAna kele.
tumhI sAMgA, (allAha) zivAya jyAMnA tumhI (upAsya) samajata AhAta, tyAMnA duA-prArthanA karA, paraMtu te nA tumace ekhAde duHkha dUra karU zakatAta ANi nA badalU zakatAta.

jyAMnA he loka duA prArthanA karatAta, te svataH ApalyA pAlanakartyAcI nikaTatA zodhata asatAta kI tyAMcyApaikI koNa adhika nikaTa hoIla, te tara svataH tyAcyA dayA-kRpecI AzA bALagatAta ANi tyAcyA zikSA-yAtanepAsUna bhayabhIta rAhatAta. niHsaMzaya tumacyA pAlanakartyAcA az2Aba (zikSA-yAtanA) bhaya rAkhaNyAcI goSTa Ahe.
ANi jevaDhyA dekhIla vastyA Aheta, AmhI tyAMnA kayAmatacA divasa yeNyApUrvI ekatara ud‌dhvasta karUna TAkU kiMvA atizaya sakta zikSA deU. he tara graMthAta lihile gele Ahe.

ANi AmhAlA nizANyA (camatkAra) utaraviNyApAsUna aDasara kevaLa yAca goSTIcA Ahe kI pUrvIcyA lokAMnI yA nizANyAMnA khoTe Tharavile Ahe. AmhI samUdalA camatkArAcyA svarUpAta sAMDaNI dilI paraMtu tyAMnI ticyAvara atyAcAra kelA AmhI tara lokAMnA kevaLa dhAka dAkhaviNyAkaritA nizANyA pAThavito.

ANi smaraNa karA, jevhA AmhI tumhAlA sAMgitale kI tumacyA pAlanakartyAne lokAMnA gherale Ahe. AmhI je tumhAlA dAkhavile hote, tI lokAMkaritA spaSTa parIkSAca hotI ANi tyAcapramANe te jhADa dekhIla jyAviSayI kuraAnAta tiraskAra vyakta kelA gelA Ahe. AmhI tyAMnA saceta karIta Ahota, paraMtu azAne tyAMce vaira ANakhI jAsta vADhata jAta Ahe.
ANi jevhA AmhI phariztyAMnA Adeza dilA kI AdamalA sajadA karA, tevhA iblisakherIja sarvAMnI sajadA kelA. to mhaNAlA, kAya mI tyAlA sajadA karU, jyAlA tU mAtIpAsUna banavile Ahe.
ThIka Ahe, paNa pAhA tU tyAlA mAjhyAvara zreSThatA tara pradAna kelI Ahe, paraMtu jara tU malA kayAmataparyaMta saMdhI dezIla tara mI yAcyA saMtatIlA, phAra kamI lokAMzivAya ApalyA kAbUta karena.
(allAhane) Adeza dilA, jA, tyAMcyApaikI jo koNI tujhA anuyAyI hoIla tara tumhA sarvAMcI zikSA jahannama Ahe, jo purepUra mobadalA Ahe.

tyAMcyApaikI tU jyAlA dekhIla ApalyA bolaNyAne bahakavU zakazIla bahakava ANi tyAMcyAvara Apale svAra ANi pyAde caDhavUna ANa, ANi tyAMcyA dhana ANi saMtatImadhUna ApalAhI hissA lAva, ANi tyAMnA (khoTe) vacana de. tyAMcyAzI jevaDhI dekhIla vacane (vAyade) saitAnAce asatAta, sarvacyA sarva pUrNa dagAbAjI Ahe.
mAjhyA saccA dAsAMvara tujhA koNatAhI prabhAva ANi kAbU nAhI ANi tumacA pAlanakartA moThA kAma banaviNArA puresA Ahe.
tumacA pAlanakartA to Ahe, jo tumacyAsAThI nadIta nAvA cAlavito, yAsAThI kI tumhI tyAcyA kRpecA zodha ghyAvA. niHsaMzaya to tumacyAvara moThA dayA karaNArA Ahe.

ANi samudrAta saMkaTa kosaLatAca, jyAMnA tumhI duA-prArthanA karIta hote, te sarva visaratAta, kevaLa toca (allAha) bAkI rAhato, maga jevhA to tumhAlA khuzkIkaDe surakSita gheUna yeto, tevhA tumhI toMDa phiravUna ghetA. manuSya moThA kRtaghna Ahe.

tara kAya tumhI yA goSTIpAsUna nirdhAsta jhAlAta kI tumhAlA khuzkIcyA ekhAdyA bhUbhAgAta (neUna jaminIta) dhasavUna TAkAve kiMvA tumacyAvara dagaDAMcA varSAva karaNAre bhayaMkara vAdaLa pAThavAve, maga svataHsAThI tumhAlA koNI mitra va sahAyyakartA ADhaLaNAra nAhI.

kAya tumhI yA goSTIpAsUna nirbhaya jhAlA AhAta kI (allAhane) dusar2yAMdA tumhAlA nadIcyA pravAsAta ANAve ANi tumacyAvara vegavAna vAdaLavAre pAThavAveta ANi tumacyA inkArApAyI tumhAlA buDavAve, maga tumhAlA svataHkaritA, AmacyAvara tyAcA dAvA (pAThalAga) karaNArA koNIhI ADhaLaNAra nAhI.

ANi niHsaMzaya, AmhI AdamacyA saMtatIlA moThI pratiSThA dilI ANi tyAMnA khuzkI ANi pANyAvara cAlaNArI vAhane dilI ANi tyAMnA pAka sApha vastUMpAsUna AjivikA (anna-sAmugrI) pradAna kelI ANi ApalyA bahuteka nirmitIvara tyAMnA zreSThatA pradAna kelI.

jyA divazI AmhI pratyeka ummata (samudAyA) lA tyAcyA pezavyAMsaha bolAvU, maga jyAMnA tyAMcA karmalekha ujavyA hAtAta dilA jAIla te moThyA AnaMdAne ApalA karmalekha vAcU lAgatIla ANi dhAgyAitakA (tILamAtra) hI atyAcAra tyAMcyAvara kelA jANAra nAhI.
ANi jo koNI yA jagAta AMdhaLA rAhilA to AkhiratamadhyehI AMdhaLA ANi saraLa mArgApAsUna dUra bhaTakalelA rAhIla.

ANi he loka tumhAlA tyA vahayI (prakAzanA) pAsUna, jI AmhI tumacyAvara avatarita kelI Ahe, haTavU icchita hote kI tumhI ticyAkherIja kAhI itara goSTI AmacyA nAvAne racUna ghyAvyAta, maga tara yAMnI tumhAlA ApalA dosta banavile asate.
ANi jara AmhI tumhAlA aTaLa rAkhale nasate tara phAra zakya hote kI tumhI tyAMcyAkaDe kAhI na kAhI (pramANAta) jhukaleca asate.
maga tara AmhIhI tumhAlA yA jagAta duherI sajA dilI asatI. ANi duherI mRtyucIhI, yA sthitIta tumhAlA svataHsAThI AmacyA virodhAta koNatAhI madata karaNArA ADhaLalA nasatA.
ANi he tara tumace pAya yA bhUmItUna DagamagaviNyAcyA tayArIlA lAgaleca hote kI tumhAlA dezAbAhera ghAlavAve, maga he suddhA tumacyAnaMtara phAra kamI kALa rAhU zakale asate.
asAca niyama tyAMcA hotA, je tumacyApUrvI paigaMbara AmhI pAThavile, ANi tumhAlA AmacyA niyamAMmadhye kadhIhI badala disUna yeNAra nAhI.
sUryAstApAsUna rAtrIcA aMdhAra hoIparyaMta namAja kAyama rAkhA ANi prAtaHkALI (phajracyA veLI) kuraAnace paThaNahI, niHsaMzaya prAtaHkALI kuraAna paThaNa karaNe hajara kele gele Ahe.

ANi rAtrIcyA kAhI bhAgAta tahajjUda (cyA namAjamadhye kuraAna) paDhata jAta. hI adhikatA tumacyAsAThI Ahe. lavakaraca tumacA pAlanakartA tumhAlA mahamUda nAvAcyA (prazaMsApUrNa) sthAnAvara ubhA karela.

ANi duA-prArthanA karIta rAhA kI he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! malA jithehI nyAyace asela, cAMgalyA prakAre ne ANi jithUnahI bAhera kADhAyace asela cAMgalyA prakAre kADhaANi mAjhyAsAThI ApalyA javaLUna varcasva ANi madata nizcita kara.
ANi yA goSTIce ailAna karA kI, satya yeUna pohocale ANi asatya miTale. niHsaMzaya asatya miTaNyAcyAca yogya hote.
ANi hA kuraAna jo AmhI avatarita karIta Ahota, ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMsAThI rogamuktI, svAsthya ANi dayA-kRpA Ahe, paraMtu atyAcArIMsAThI nukasAnAzivAya kasalIhI vADha hota nAhI.
ANi jevhA dekhIla mANasAlA AmhI ApalI kRpA-deNagI pradAna karato, tevhA to toMDa phiravito ANi kuzI badalato ANi jevhA dekhIla tyAlA duHkha pohocate tevhA to nirAza hoto.
sAMgA kI pratyeka manuSya ApalyA paddhatInusAra kArya karato. je pUrNataH mArgadarzanAvara Aheta, tyAMnA tumacA pAlanakartAca cAMgalyA prakAre jANato.
ANi he loka tumhAlA AtmyAviSayI vicAratAta. (tumhI tyAMnA) uttara dyA kI AtmA mAjhyA pAlanakartyA (allAha) cyA hukUmAne Ahe. ANi tumhAlA je jJAna dile gele Ahe te phAraca kamI Ahe.
ANi jara AmhI icchile tara jI vahayI (prakAzanA) tumacyAkaDe AmhI avatarita kelI Ahe, sarva parata gheU, maga tumhAlA tyAcyAsAThI AmacyAsamora koNIhI himAyata karaNArA lAbhU zakaNAra nAhI.
tumacyA pAlanakartyAcyA dayekherIja. niHsaMzaya tumacyAvara tyAcI moThI kRpA Ahe.
sAMgA kI jara samasta mAnava ANi jinna miLUna yA kuraAnAsArakhA (graMtha) ANU icchitIla tara tyA sarvAMcyAkaDUna yAce udAharaNa ANaNe azakya Ahe, maga te ApasAta ekamekAMce sahAyyaka banale tarIhI.
ANi AmhI tara yA kuraAnAta lokAMcyA samajaNyAkaritA azA prakAre sarva udAharaNe sAMgitalI Aheta, paraMtu bahuteka loka kRtaghnapaNA dAkhaviNe thAMbavata nAhIta.
ANi te mhaNAle, AmhI tumacyAvara kadhIhI ImAna rAkhaNAra nAhI, joparyaMta tumhI AmacyAsAThI jaminItUna pANyAcA jharA kADhUna dAkhavata nAhI.
athavA svataH tumacyAsAThI ekhAdA bAga asAvA khajurAMcA ANi drAkSAMcA ANi tyAMcyA daramyAna tumhI aneka vAhate jalapravAha kADhUna dAkhavAveta.
kiMvA tumhI AkAzAlA AmacyAvara tukaDe tukaDe karUna pADAve, jasA tumacA vicAra Ahe athavA tumhI svataH allAhalA ANi phariztyAMnA AmacyAsamora ANUna ubhe karAve.

athavA svataH tumacyAsAThI ekhAde sonyAce ghara asAve kiMvA tumhI AkAzAta caDhUna jAve ANi AmhI tara tumacyA caDhUna jANyAcAhI toparyaMta vizvAsa karaNAra nAhI, joparyaMta tumhI AmacyAvara ekhAdA graMtha avatarita karata nAhI, jo AmhI svataH vAcUna ghyAvA. tumhI uttara dyA kI mAjhA pAlanakartA moThA pavitra Ahe. mI tara eka mAnava Ahe, jo rasUla (paigaMbara) banavUna pAThavilA gelo Ahe.
ANi lokAMjavaLa mArgadarzana yeUna pohocalyAnaMtara ImAna rAkhaNyApAsUna rokhaNArI kevaLa hIca goSTa rAhilI kI te mhaNAle, kAya allAhane ekA mANasAlAca rasUla (paigaMbara) banavUna pAThavile?
(tumhI) sAMgA, jara dharatIvara pharizte cAlata phirata asate ANi ithe vAstavya karaNAre rAhile asate tara maga AmhIhI tyAMcyAjavaLa ekhAdyA AsmAnI phariztyAlAca rasUla banavUna pAThavile asate.
sAMgA, mAjhyA ANi tumacyA daramyAna allAhace sAkSI asaNe purese Ahe to ApalyA dAsAMnA cAMgalyA prakAre jANUna Ahe ANi cAMgalyA prakAre pAhaNArA Ahe.

ANi allAha jyAlA mArga dAkhavila, to mArgadarzana lAbhalelA Ahe ANi jyAlA to pathabhraSTa karIla tara asaMbhava Ahe kI tumhAlA tyAcA mitra, tyAcyAkherIja dusarA koNI ADhaLela, azA lokAMnA AmhI kayAmatacyA divazI toMDaghazI pADUna azA avastheta jamA karU kI te AMdhaLe, muke ANi bahire asatIla. tyAMce ThikANa jahannama asela, jevhA tI (Aga) thoDI suddhA maMda paDU lAgela tara tilA AmhI tyAMcyAsAThI ANakhI bhaDakAvUna deU.
hA sarva AmacyA nizANyAMcA inkAra karaNyAcA ANi he sAMgaNyAcA pariNAma Ahe kI kAya jevhA AmhI rAkha ANi kaNa kaNa hoUna jAU, maga AmhAlA navyAne nirmANa karUna uThavUna ubhe kele jAIla?

kAya tyAMnI yA goSTIkaDe lakSa dile nAhI kI jyA allAhane AkAza ANi dharatIlA nirmANa kele, to tyAMcyAsArakhyAMnA nirmANa karaNyAce pUrNa sAmarthya bALagato, tyAneca tyAMcyAsAThI eka azI veLa nizcita kelI Ahe, jicyAbAbata kAhI zaMkA nAhI, paraMtu atyAcArI loka kRtaghna banalyAvinA rAhata nAhI.

tyAMnA sAMgA kI (jara samajA) jara tumhI mAjhyA pAlanakartyAcyA dayA kRpecyA khajinyAce mAlaka banale asate tara tumhI tyA veLIhI to kharca hoIla yA bhItIne tyAta kaMjUsapaNA kelA asatA ANi manuSya Aheca moThA kotyA manAcA!

ANi AmhI mUsAlA naU mojije (allAhapradatta camatkAra) agadI sApha sApha pradAna kele, tU svataH isrAIlacyA saMtatIlA vicAra, jevhA te tyAMcyAjavaLa tevhA pohocale phiraauna mhaNAlA, he mUsA! mAjhyA mate tujhyAvara jAdUToNA kelA gelA Ahe.

(mUsAne) uttara dile, he malA mAhIta jhAle Ahe kI AkAzAMcyA ANi dharatIcyA pAlanakartyAneca he camatkAra dAkhaviNyAsAThI va samajAviNyAsAThI avatarita kele Aheta, he phiraauna! malA tara vATate kI tU nakkIca naSTa kelA gelA Ahe.
zevaTI phiraaunane pakkA irAdA kelA kI tyAMnA bhUmItUnaca kADhUna phekAve, tevhA AmhI svataH tyAlA ANi tyAcyA sarva sAthIdArAMnA buDavUna TAkale.
ANi tyAnaMtara AmhI isrAIlacyA putrAMnA pharmAvile kI tyA bhUmIvara vAstavya karA, mAtra jevhA AkhiratacA vAyadA yeIla tevhA AmhI tumhA sarvAMnA ekatrita karUna neU.
ANi AmhI yA (kuraAnA) lA satyAsaha avatarita kele ANi hA dekhIla satyAsaha avatarita jhAlA ANi AmhI tumhAlA kevaLa khUzakhabara deNArA ANi saceta karaNArA banavUna pAThavile Ahe.
ANi kuraAnAlA AmhI thoDe thoDe karUna azAsAThI utaravile Ahe kI tumhI veLa miLela tyAnusAra lokAMnA aikavAve ANi AmhI svataHdekhIla yAlA thoDe thoDe karUna utaravile.
tumhI sAMgA, tumhI yAvara ImAna rAkhA kiMvA na rAkhA, jyAMnA yAcyApUrvI jJAna dile gele Ahe, tyAMcyAjavaLa jevhA dekhIla yAce paThaNa kele jAte, tevhA te mAthA TekUna sajadA karU lAgatAta.
ANi mhaNatAta kI AmacA pAlanakartA pavitra Ahe, AmacyA pAlanakartyAcA vAyadA nizcitaca pUrNa hoNAra Ahe.
ANi te mAthA TekUna raData raData sajadyAcyA avastheta khAlI paDatAta ANi hA kuraAna tyAMcI naramI ANi namratA ANakhI jAsta vADhavito.

tumhI sAMgA kI allAhalA allAha mhaNUna pukArA ANi rahamAna mhaNUna, jyA nAvAne dekhIla pukArA sarva zubha nAme tyAcIca Aheta. nA tumhI ApalI namAja phAra uMca svarAta paDhata jA ANi nA agadI haLU svarAta kiMbahunA yAMcyA madhalA mArga zodhA.

ANi sAMgA, samasta stutI- prazaMsA allAhakaritAca Ahe, jo nA saMtatI bALagato ANi nA ApalyA rAjyasatteta dusar2yA koNAlA bhAgIdAra Thevato, nA to asA kamajora Ahe kI tyAcA koNI sahAyyaka asAvA ANi tumhI tyAcI paripUrNa mahimA varNana karaNyAta magna rAhA.
sarva stutI-prazaMsA tyA allAhakaritAca Ahe, jyAne ApalyA dAsAvara hA kuraAna avatarita kelA ANi tyAta kasalIhI uNIva bAkI rAhU dilI nAhI.

kiMbahunA sarva kAhI yathAyogya rAkhale yAsAThI kI ApalyAjavaLacyA sakta zikSepAsUna saceta karAve ANi ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMnA ANi satkarma karaNAr2yAMnA khUzakhabarI aikavAvI kI tyAMcyAkaritA uttama mobadalA Ahe.
jyAta te nehamI nehamI rAhatIla.
ANi tyA lokAMnAhI bhaya dAkhavAve je mhaNatAta kI allAha saMtatI bALagato.
vAstavikata nA tyAMnA svataHlA yAce jJAna Ahe, nA tyAMcyA thora bujUrga lokAMnA. hA Aropa moThA vAITa Ahe, jo tyAMcyA toMDUna nighata Ahe, te kevaLa khoTe bolata Aheta.
maga jara yA lokAMnI yA goSTIvara ImAna rAkhale nAhI tara kAya tumhI tyAMcyA mAge yAca duHkhAta ApalyA jIvAcA nAza karUna ghyAla?
dharatIvara je kAhI Ahe, te AmhI dharatIcyA zobhA-sajAvaTIsAThI banavile Ahe kI AmhI tyAMcI kasoTI ghyAvI kI tyAMcyApaikI koNa satkarma karaNArA Ahe.
ANi yA dharatIvara je kAhI Ahe, AmhI tyAlA eka sapATa maidAna karUna TAkaNAra Ahota.
kAya tumhI ApalyA mate guphA ANi zilAlekhavAlyAMnA AmacyA nizANyAMpaikI ekhAdI moThI navalapUrNa nizANI samajata AhAta?
tyA taruNAMnI jevhA gupheta Azraya ghetalA tevhA duA-prArthanA kelI kI, he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! AmhAlA ApalyA javaLUna dayA- kRpA pradAna kara ANi AmacyA kAryAta AmacyAsAThI mArga sopA kara.
maga AmhI tyAMcyA kAnAMvara aneka varSAMparyaMta tyAca gupheta paDade TAkale.
maga AmhI tyAMnA uThavUna ubhe kele kI AmhI he jANUna ghyAve kI donhI gaTAMpaikI yA moThyA mudatIlA, jI tyAMnI pAra pADalI, koNI jAsta smaraNAta rAkhale?
AmhI tyAMcI kharI kahANI tumacyAsamora varNana karIta Ahota, yA kAhI taruNAMnI ApalyA pAlanakartyAvara ImAna rAkhale ANi AmhI tyAMcyA mArgadarzanAta pragatI pradAna kelI.

ANi AmhI tyAMcI mane majabUta kelI hotI jevhA te uThUna ubhe rAhile ANi mhaNU lAgale kI AmacA pAlanakartA toca Ahe, jo AkAzAMcA ANi dharatIcA pAlanakartA Ahe, he asaMbhava Ahe kI AmhI tyAcyAzivAya dusar2yA upAsyAlA pukArAve jara ase kele tara AmhI moThI anucita goSTa bolalo.

hA Ahe AmacA janasamUha, jyAne allAhakherIja dusarI upAsye banavUna ThevalI Aheta tyAMcyA varcasvAcA ekhAdA spaSTa purAvA kA nAhI sAdara karata? allAhazI khoTyA goSTIcA saMbaMdha joDaNAr2yApekSA adhika atyAcArI koNa Ahe?

ANi jyAarthI tumhI tyAMcyApAsUna ANi allAhakherIja tyAMcyA itara upAsyAMpAsUna vegaLe jhAlA AhAta tara AtA ekhAdyA gupheta jAUna basA, tumacA pAlanakartA (allAha) tumacyAvara ApalI dayA-kRpA karela ANi tumacyA kAryAta sahaja sulabhatA nirmANa karIla.

ANi tumhI pAhAla kI sUryodaya hotAnA sUrya tyAMcyA guphecyA ujavyA bAjUlA jhukato ANi astAsa jAtAnA tyAMcyA DAvyA bAjUlA guphecA bhAga soDUna mAvaLato ANi te tyA guphecyA prazasta sthAnAta Aheta. he allAhacyA nizANyAMpaikI Ahe, allAha jyAlA mArgadarzana karIla, to satya mArgAvara Ahe ANi jyAlA pathabhraSTa karIla tara azakya Ahe kI tumhAlA tyAcA koNI mitra ANi mArga dAkhaviNArA disUna yAvA.

ANi tumhI vicAra karAla kI te jAgata Aheta vastutaH te jhopata hote, ANi AmhI svataH tyAcI ujavI DAvI kuzI badalata rAhilo. tyAMcA kutrAdekhIla guphecyA toMDAzI hAta pasaralelyA avastheta hotA. jara tumhI Ata DokAvUna pAhU icchile asate tara nakkIca ulaTa pAvalAMnI paLa kADhalA asatA ANi tyAMcyA bhaya-dahazatIne tumhI bhAruna gele asate.

ANi tyAca prakAre AmhI tyAMnA jAge karUna uThavile kI ApasAta vicArapUsa karAvI. tyAMcyApaikI ekA bolaNAr2yAne vicArale kI tumhI (ithe) kitI kALa rAhAtIla tyAMnI uttara dile, eka divasa kiMvA ekA divasApekSAhI kamI. mhaNU lAgale, kI tumacyA vAstavyAce pUrNa jJAna allAhalAca Ahe. AtA tumhI ApalyApaikI ekhAdyAlAhI cAMdIcI (nANI) deUna zaharAta pAThavA. tyAne cAMgalyAprakAre pAhUna ghyAve kI zaharAta koNate bhojana svaccha zuddha Ahe, maga tyAtUnaca tumacyA bhojanAsAThI ANAve ANi tyAne khUpa sAvadhagirI ANi naramIne vAgAve ANi koNAlAhI tumacI khabara hoU deU naye.

jara he (kAphira) tumacyAvara varcasva prApta karUna ghetIla tara tumhAlA dagaDAMnI mArUna TAkatIla kiMvA punhA tumhAlA ApalyA dharmAta parata ghetIla, tara maga tumhI kadhIhI saphala hoU zakaNAra nAhIta.

ANi AmhI azA prakAre lokAMnA tyAMcyA avasthezI avagata kele kI tyAMnI he jANUna ghyAve kI allAhacA vAyadA pUrNataH saccA Ahe. ANi kayAmata yeNyAbAbata kAhIca zaMkA nAhI jevhA te ApalyA bolaNyAta ApasAta matabheda karIta hote, mhaNU lAgale kI guphevara eka imArata banavUna ghyA. tyAMcA pAlanakartAca tyAMcyA avasthelA adhika jANaNArA Ahe, jyA lokAMnI tyAMcyA bAbatIta varcasva prApta kele, te mhaNU lAgale kI AmhI tara yAMcyAjavaLa pAsa masjida banavU.

kAhI loka mhaNatIla kI gupheta tIna jaNa hote ANi cauthA tyAMcA kutrA hotA, kAhI mhaNatIla kI te pAca hote, sahAvA tyAMcA kutrA hotA. aparokSa (g2aiba) viSayI (cinha pAhilyAvinA) anumAnAne dagaDa mAraNe. kAhI mhaNatIla kI te sAta Aheta AThavA tyAMcA kutrA Ahe. (tumhI) sAMgA kI mAjhA pAlanakartA, tyAMcI saMkhyA cAMgalyA prakAre jANaNArA Ahe. tyAMnA phAra thoDeca loka jANatAta, maga tumhIhI tyA lokAMviSayI kevaLa saMkSipta bolata jA, ANi tyAMcyApaikI koNAzI tyAMcyAviSayI vicArapUsahI karU nakA.
ANi kadhIhI ekhAdyA kAmAbaddala ase bolU nakA kI mI he kAma udyA karena.

paraMtu tyAsobataca ‘inzA allAha’ (allAhane icchile tara) jarUra mhaNA ANi jevhA dekhIla visara paDela ApalyA pAlanakartyA (allAha) ce smaraNa karata jA ANi he mhaNata rAhA kI malA pUrNa AzA Ahe kI mAjhA pAlanakartA yAhUna jAsta mArgadarzanAcyA javaLacyA goSTIce mArgadarzana karela.
ANi te loka ApalyA gupheta tInaze varSAparyaMta rAhile, ANi naU varSe tyAMnI adhika kADhalI.

tumhI sAMgA, allAhalAca tyAMcyA vAstavyakALAce cAMgalyA prakAre jJAna Ahe. AkAzAMce ANi dharatIce parokSa jJAna kevaLa tyAlAca Ahe. to kitI cAMgalA pAhaNArA aikaNArA Ahe! allAhakherIja koNIhI tyAMcI madata karaNArA nAhI ANi allAha ApalA Adeza lAgU karaNyAta koNAlAhI sahabhAgI banavita nAhI.

ANi tumacyAkaDe, tumacyA pAlanakartyAtarphe jo graMtha avatarita kelA gelA Ahe, tyAce paThaNa karIta rAhA. tyAce pharmAna koNIhI badalU zakata nAhI. tumhAlA tyAcyAkherIja kadApi ekhAde AzrayasthAna lAbhaNAra nAhI.

ANi svataHlA azAca lokAMcyA sobata rAkhata jA, je ApalyA pAlanakartyAlA sakALa saMdhyAkALa pukAratAta ANi tyAcyAca mukhA (anugrahA) cI abhilASA karatAta. khabaradAra! tumacI dRSTI tyAMcyAvarUna haTatA kAmA naye kI aihika jIvanAcyA zobhA-sajAvaTIcyA prayatnAta magna vhAve (pAhA) tyAce mhaNaNe mAnya karU nakA, jyAcyA hRdayAlA AmhI ApalyA AThavaNIpAsUna gAphIla Thevale Ahe ANi jo icchA-AkAMkSAMcyA mAge dhAvata Ahe ANi jyAcyA karmAne maryAdA pAra kelI Ahe.

ANi ailAna karA kI he paripUrNa satya (kuraAna) tumacyA pAlanakartyAtarphe Ahe. AtA jyAcI icchA hoIla tyAne ImAna rAkhAve ANi jyAcI icchA hoIla tyAne inkAra karAvA. atyAcArI lokAMkaritA AmhI tI Aga tayAra karUna ThevalI Ahe, jicyA (AgIcyA) kanAtI tyAMnA gherUna TAkatIla. jara te gAr2hANe mAMDatIla tara tyAMcI madata tyA pANyAne kelI jAIla, je telAcyA gALAsArakhe asela, je ceharA bhAjUna TAkIla moThe vAITa pANI Ahe ANi moThe vAITa vizrAMtIsthAna (jahannama) Ahe.
niHsaMzaya jyA lokAMnI ImAna rAkhale ANi satkarma karIta rAhile tara AmhI ekhAdyA sartma karaNAr2yAcA mobadalA vAyA jAU deta nAhI.

tyAMcyAsAThI nehamI nehamI asaNArI jannata Ahe. ticyAkhAlI nadyA vAhata asatIla. tithe yAMnA suvarNa kAMkaNa ghAtale jAIla. ANi hiravyA raMgAce talama va jADa rezamAce kapaDe ghAlatIla tyA ThikANI siMhAsanAvara takke lAvUna basatIla. kitI cAMgalA mobadalA Ahe ANi kitI cAMgale ArAma karaNyAce ghara Ahe.

ANi tyAMnA tyA dona mANasAMce udAharaNahI aikavA jyAMcyApaikI ekAlA AmhI drAkSAMcyA dona bAgA deUna ThevalyA hotyA, jyAMnA khajurIcyA vRkSAMnI AmhI gherUna Thevale hote ANi doghAMcyA daramyAna zetI nirmANa kelI hotI.
donhI bAgAMnI ApalI phaLe bharapUra dilIta ANi tyA kAhIca kamataratA kelI nAhI ANi AmhI tyA bAgAMcyA daramyAna pravAha jArI kelA hotA.
ANi (azA prakAre) tyAcyAjavaLa phaLe hotI. eka divasa bolatA bolatA to ApalyA sAthIdArAlA mhaNAlA kI mI tujhyApekSA jAsta zrImaMta Ahe ANi jatthyAtahI adhika pratiSThIta Ahe.
ANi to ApalyA bAgeta gelA ANi ApalyA jIvAvara julUma karaNArA hotA, mhaNAlA, malA nAhI vATata hI bAga kadhI barabAda hoU zakela.
ANi nA mI kayAmatace prasthApita hoNyAsa mAnato ANi jara he mAnUnahI ghetalI kI mI ApalyA pAlanakartyAkaDe paratavilo gelo tara khAtrIne (te paratIce ThikANa) malA yAhUna jAsta cAMgale ADhaLela.
tyAcA sAthIdAra tyAcyAzI bolatAnA mhaNAlA, kAya tU tyA (allAha) lA nAhI mAnata, jyAne tulA mAtIpAsUna nirmANa kele, naMtara vIryApAsUna, maga tulA pUrNa mAnava (puruSa) ghaDavile.
paraMtu mI (tara pUrNa zraddhA rAkhato kI) toca allAha mAjhA svAmI va pAlanakartA Ahe, mI ApalyA pAlanakartyAsobata koNAlAhI sahabhAgI TharaviNAra nAhI.

ANi tU ApalyA bAgeta jANyAcyA veLI ase kA nAhI mhaNAlA kI allAhane je icchile te hoIla. koNatehI zaktI-sAmarthya nAhI paraMtu allAhacyA madatIne, jarI tU malA dhana ANi saMtatIta kamataratA asalelA pAhAta Ahesa.
paraMtu phAra zakya Ahe kI mAjhA pAlanakartA malA tujhyA yA bAgepekSA uttama pradAna karIla ANi yA (tujhyA bAge) vara AsamAnI saMkaTa pAThavila tara hI sapATa ANi nisaTaNAre maidAna banela.
kiMvAca hice pANI khAlI utarale ANi tujhyA AvAkyAta na rAhAve kI tU te zodhUna ANAve.

ANi tyAcI (sarva) phaLe gheralI gelIta maga to ApalyA yA kharcAbaddala, jo tyAne bAgevara kelA hotA, Apale hAta maLU lAgalA, ANi tI bAga chapparAsameta toMDaghazI paDalI hotI ANi (to manuSya) mhaNata hotA kI arere! mI ApalyA pAlanakartyAsobata dusar2yA kuNAlA bhAgIdAra banavile nasate.
tyAcyA hakkAta koNatAhI samUha uThUna ubhA rAhilA nAhI kI allAhapAsUna tyAcA kAhI bacAva karU zakalA asatA ANi nA to svataHhI sUDa gheNArA banU zakalA.
ithUnaca (siddha hote) kI samasta adhikAra tyAca allAhakaritA Aheta. to mobadalA pradAna karaNyAcyA va pariNAmAcyA dRSTIne atizaya uttama Ahe.

ANi tyAMnA yA jagAcyA jIvanAce udAharaNahI sAMgA, jaNU pANI je AmhI AkAzAtUna avatarita karato tyAdvaAre jaminIcI paidAvAra miLatIjuLatI asate, maga zevaTI tI cUrecUra hote, jilA vAre uDavita neta phiratAta ANi allAha pratyeka goSTIce sAmarthya bALagato.

dhana-saMpattI ANi saMtatI tara yA jagAcyA jIvanAcI zobhA Ahe paraMtu sadaiva TikUna rAhaNAre satkarma (nekI) tumacyA pAlanakartyAjavaLa mobadalyAcyA dRSTIne ANi (bhaviSyAcyA) cAMgalyA AzesAThI phAra uttama Ahe.
ANi jyA divazI AmhI parvatAMnA cAlavU ANi jaminIlA tumhI AvaraNa nasalelyA sthitIta pAhAla, ANi samasta lokAMnA AmhI ekatra karU tevhA tyAMcyApaikI koNAlAhI bAkI soDaNAra nAhI.

ANi sarvacyA sarva tumacyA pAlanakartyAsamora rAMgArAMgAMnI hajara kele jAtIla. niHsaMzaya tumhI AmacyAsamora tyAca prakAre Ale, jyA prakAre AmhI tumhAlA pahilyA khepesa nirmANa kele hote. paraMtu tumhI mAtra AzA bhramAta rAhile kI AmhI kadhI tumacyAsAThI ekhAdA vAyadyAcA divasa nizcita karaNAra nAhI.

ANi karma-lekha samora Thevale jAtIla, maga tumhI pAhAla kI aparAdhI tyAMcyA karmalekhApAsUna bhayabhIta hotIla ANi mhaNatahI asatIla kI arere! AmacA vinAza! hA kasA lekha Ahe, jyAne koNatAhI lahAna-moThA (gunhA) gheralyAvinA soDale nAhI, ANi tyAMnI je karma kele hote, te sarva kAhI tyAMnA disUna yeIla ANi tumacA pAlanakartA koNAvarahI atyAcAra va anyAya karaNAra nAhI.

ANi jevhA AmhI phariztyAMnA Adeza dilA kI AdamacyA puDhe sajadA karA, tevhA iblisa (saitAnA) kherIja sarvAMnI sajadA kelA to jinnAMpaikI hotA. tyAne ApalyA pAlanakartyAcyA AdezAcI avajJA kelI. kAya tarIhI tumhI tyAlA ANi tyAcyA saMtatIlA, malA soDUna ApalA mitra banavita AhAta? vAstavika to tumhA sarvAMcA zatrU Ahe. azA julamI lokAMcA kitI vAITa mobadalA Ahe.
mI tyAMnA AkAzAMcyA ANi jaminIcyA nirmitIprasaMgI hajara Thevale navhate ANi nA svataH tyAcyA nirmitIta ANi mI mArgabhraSTa karaNAr2yAMnA ApalA sahAyyaka banaviNArAhI nAhI.

ANi jyA divazI to mhaNela kI tumacyA mate mAjhe je sAthIdAra hote tyAMnA hAka mArA, he hAka mAratIla, paraMtu tyAMcyApaikI koNIhI uttara deNAra nAhI ANi AmhI tyAMcyA daramyAna vinAzAce sAdhana nirmANa karU.
ANi aparAdhI loka jahannamalA pAhUna samajUna ghetIla kI te yAtaca jANAra Aheta, paraMtu ticyApAsUna bacAvAce sthAna tyAMnA koThehI ADhaLaNAra nAhI.
ANi AmhI yA kuraAnAta pratyeka prakAracI sarva udAharaNe lokAMsAThI sAMgitalI Aheta, paraMtu samasta vastUMpekSA jAsta bhAMDakhora manuSya Ahe.

ANi lokAMjavaLa mArgadarzana yeUna pohocalyAnaMtara, tyAMnA ImAna rAkhaNyApAsUna ANi ApalyA pAlanakartyAjavaLa kSamA-yAcanA karaNyApAsUna kevaLa yAca goSTIne rokhale kI pUrvI hoUna gelelyA lokAMsArakhA vyavahAra tyAMcyAzIhI kelA jAvA kiMvA tyAMcyAsamora zikSA –yAtanA (az2Aba) ughaDa svarUpAta yAvI.

ANi AmhI tara ApalyA paigaMbarAMnA kevaLa azAsAThI pAThavito kI tyAMnI zubha-samAcAra dyAvA ANi lokAMnA saceta karAve. inkArI loka asatyAlA purAvA banavUna vivAda ghAlU icchitAta kI yAdvAre satya DaLamaLIta karAve. te mAjhyA AyatIMcI ANi jyA goSTIce bhaya dAkhavile jAve ticI thaTTA uDavitAta.

ANi tyAhUna adhika atyAcArI koNa Ahe, jyAlA tyAcyA pAlanakartyAcyA AyatIMdvAre upadeza kelA jAvA tarIhI tyAne toMDa phiravUna rAhAve ANi je kAhI tyAcyA hAtAMnI puDhe pAThavile Ahe, te visarUna jAve. niHsaMzaya, AmhI tyAMcyA hRdayAMvara te samajaNyApAsUna paDade TAkUna Thevale Aheta, ANi tyAMcyA kAnAta badhIratA. tumhI tyAMnA mArgadarzanAkaDe kitIhI bolavA, paraMtu mArgadarzana tyAMnA kadhIhI lAbhaNAra nAhI.

ANi tumacA pAlanakartA moThA mApha karaNArA ANi dayA karaNArA Ahe. to jara tyAMnA tyAMcyA karmAMcI zikSA deNyAsAThI dharU icchila tara nizcitaca tyAMnA tvarita zikSA deIla, paraMtu tyAMcyAsAThI eka vAyadyAcI veLa nirdhArIta Ahe, jyApAsUna paLa kADhaNyAce sthAna tyAMnA kadhIhI lAbhaNAra nAhI.
ANi yA tyA vastyA Aheta, jyAMnA AmhI tyAMcyA atyAcArApAyI naSTa karUna TAkale ANi tyAMcyA vinAzAcI eka veLa AmhI nizcita karUna ThevalI hotI.
ANi jevhA mUsA ApalyA taruNAlA mhaNAle kI mI tara cAlataca rAhIna yetheparyaMta kI dona nadyAMcyA saMgamAcyA ThikANI pohocena, maga tyAsAThI malA varSAnuvarSe kA cAlAve lAgenA.
jevhA te doghe tyA ThikANI pohocale, je dona nadyAMce saMgamasthAna hote, tithe ApalI mAsaLI visarale, jine nadIta bhuyArAsArakhA ApalA mArga banavUna ghetalA.
jevhA te doghe tithUna nighUna puDhe gele tevhA mUsA ApalyA taruNAlA mhaNAle, ANA AmacA nAztA dyA. AmhAlA tara yA pravAsAta khUpaca trAsa ghyAvA lAgalA.

(tyAne) uttara dile kI, kAya tumhI pAhile nAhI? jevhA AmhI dagaDAlA TekA lAvUna ArAma karIta hoto, titheca mI tI mAsaLI visaralo, vastutaH saitAnAne malA visara pADalA kI tumacyAjavaLa yA goSTIcI carcA karAvI. tyA mAsaLIne moThyA camatkArikarityA nadIta ApalA mArga banavUna ghetalA.
(mUsA) mhaNAle, heca te ThikANa hote, jyAcyA zodhAta AmhI hoto tevhA te tithUnaca ApalyA pada-cinhAMnA zodhata parata phirale.
maga tyAMnA AmacyA dAsAMpaikI eka dAsa bheTalA, jyAlA AmhI ApalyA javaLUna vizeSa dayA-kRpA pradAna kelI hotI ANi tyAlA ApalyA javaLUna khAsa jJAnahI zikavile hote.
mUsA tyAlA mhaNAle, ApaNa malA AjJA pALela kI ApaNa malA te satya jJAna zikavAve, je ApaNAsa zikavile gele Ahe.
to mhaNAlA, tumhI mAjhyAsobata dhIra-saMyama rAkhU zakata nAhI.
ANi jyA goSTIlA tumhI ApalyA jJAnakakSeta ghetale nasela tyAvara dhIra-saMyama kase rAkhU zakatA?
mUsAne uttara dile kI allAhane icchilyAsa mI tumhAlA dhIra-saMyama rAkhaNAr2yAMpaikI ADhaLUna yeIla ANi koNatyAhI bAbatIta tumacI avajJA karaNAra nAhI.
(to) mhaNAlA, jara tumhI mAjhyAsobataca cAlaNyAcA Agraha dharatA tara lakSAta ThevA kI koNatyAhI goSTIbAbata malA kAhI vicAru nakA joparyaMta mI svataH tyAbAbata na sAMgAve.

maga te doghe tethUna nighAle, yetheparyaMta kI ekA nauketa basale (khijrane) naukecyA phaLyA toDalyA. (mUsA) mhaNAle, kAya tumhI naukA toData AhAta kI nauketa basalelyAMnA buDavUna TAkAve? tumhI tara he moThe anucita kAma kele.
(khrijane) uttara dile kI mI AdhIca tumhAlA bolalo hoto kI tumhI mAjhyAsobata rAhUna dhIra-saMyama rAkhU zakaNAra nAhI.
(mUsA) mhaNAle kI mAjhyA yA cukIbaddala malA dharU nakA ANi mAjhyA bAbatIta saktIne vAgU nakA.

maga doghe nighAle, yetheparyaMta kI tyAMnA eka bAlaka disale, (khijrane) tyA bAlakAlA mArUna TAkale. (mUsA) mhaNAle kI, tumhI tara ekA niraparAdhAcA jIva ghetalA. vAstavika tyAne koNAcI hatyA kelI navhatI. niHsaMzaya, tumhI he moThe vAITa kRtya kele.
te mhaNAle, kAya mI tumhAlA sAMgitale navhate kI tumhI mAjhyAsobata rAhUna kadhIhI dhIra-saMyama rAkhU zakata nAhI.
(mUsA yAMnI) uttara dile, AtA jara yAnaMtara mI tumhAlA ekhAdyA goSTIbAbata kAhI vicArale tara belAzaka tumhI malA ApalyAsobata ThevU nakA, niHsaMzaya, mAjhyAtarphe tumhI sababIsa pohacalA AhAta.

punhA doghe nighAle, ekA gAvAcyA lokAMparyaMta pohocale ANi tyAMcyAjavaLa jevaNa mAgitale. tyAMnI tyAMcA pAhuNacAra karaNyAsa nakAra dilA. doghAMnA tyA ThikANI eka bhiMta ADhaLalI, jI kosaLaNyAcyA betAta hotI, tyAne tilA saraLa kele (mUsA) mhaNAle, jara tumhI icchile asate tara yA (kAmA) baddala majurI ghetalI asatI.
to mhaNAlA, AtA mAtra mAjhyA ANi tujhyA daramyAna vegaLe hoNyAcI veLa AlI Ahe, tevhA mI tulA tyA goSTIMcI hakIkata sAMgato, jyAvara tumhI dhIra-saMyama rAkhU zakale nAhI.

tI naukA kAhI kAhI garIba lokAMcI hotI, je nadIta kAma karIta asata. mI ticyAta kAhI toDaphoDa karaNyAce Tharavile kAraNa puDhacyA ilAkyAta eka rAjA hotA, jo pratyeka cAMgalI naukA jabaradastIne (ApalyA tAbyAta) gheta ase.
ANi tyA taruNAce AI-bApa ImAna rAkhaNAre hote. AmhAlA hI bhItI vATalI kI kadAcita hA tyAMnA ApalyA baMDakhorI ANi adhArmikatene lAcAra va vyAkULa na karUna TAko.
mhaNUna AmhI icchile kI tyAMnA tyAMcA pAlanakartA (allAha) tyAcyAaivajI tyAhUna uttama pavitra ANi tyAcyApekSA adhika priya ANi AvaDatA putra pradAna karo.

ANi bhiMtIcA kissA asA kI tyA zaharAta dona anAtha mule Aheta, jyAMcA khajinA (dhana) tyAMcyA tyA bhiMtIkhAlI gADalelA Ahe. tyAMce pitA moThe neka sadAcArI hote. tevhA tumacA pAlanakartA icchita hotA kI yA donhI anAtha mulAMnI ApalyA taruNa vayAsa pohocUna ApalA hA khajinA, tumacyA pAlanakartyAcyA dayA-kRpene ANi meharabAnIne kADhUna ghyAvA. mI svataHcyA irAdyAne (ANi icchene) koNatehI kAma kele nAhI. hI hakIkata hotI tyA ghaTanAMcI jyAMcyAbAbata tumhI dhIra-saMyama rAkhU zakale nAhIta.
ANi tumhAlA julkaranainacyA ghaTaneviSayI he loka vicAratAta, (tumhI) sAMgA kI mI tyAMcA thoDAsA vRttAMta tumhAlA vAcUna aikavito.
AmhI dharatIvara tyAlA zaktI-sAmarthya pradAna kele hote, ANi tyAlA pratyeka goSTIcI sAdhanehI pradAna kelI hotI.
to ekA mArgAmAge lAgalA.

yetheparyaMta kI sUryAstAcyA ThikANAparyaMta pohocalA ANi tyAlA (sUryAlA) ekA daladalIcyA pravAhAta buDatAnA pAhile ANi tyA pravAhAcyA ThikANAvara eka janasamUhahI ADhaLalA. AmhI sAMgitale, he julkaranaina! tU tyAMnA zikSA de kiMvA tyAMcyA bAbatIta ekhAdA cAMgalA mArga kADha.
to mhaNAlA, jo atyAcAra karela, tyAlA tara AmhIhI AtA zikSA deU. maga to ApalyA pAlanakartyAkaDe paratavilA jAIla ANi to tyAlA sakta sajA-yAtanA deIla.
paraMtu jo ImAna rAkhela ANi satkarma karela tara tyAcyAkaritA mobadalyAta bhalAI Ahe ANi tyAlA ApalyA kAmAtahI sopepaNAcA Adeza deU.
maga to dusar2yA ekA mArgAsa lAgalA.
yetheparyaMta kI jevhA to sUryodayAcyA ThikANAparyaMta pohocalA tevhA sUryAlA ekA azA janasamUhAvara ugavatAnA pAhile kI tyAMcyAkaritA AmhI tyApAsUna koNatAhI ADapaDadA rAkhalA nAhI.
ghaTanA azIca Ahe, AmhI tyAcyA javaLapAsacyA samasta khabarI gherUna ThevalyA Aheta.
maga to dusar2yA ekA mArgAkaDe nighAlA.
yetheparyaMta kI jevhA dona bhiMtIMcyA daramyAna pohocalA, tyA doghIMcyA palIkaDe azI jamAta ADhaLalI, jI goSTa samajUna gheNyAcyA javaLahI navhatI.

(tyAMnI) sAMgitale he julkaranaina! yAjUja ANi mAjUja yA dezAta moThA upadrava va utpAta pasaravita Ahe. tara kAya AmhI tumacyAkaritA kAhI dhana jamA karUna dyAve (yA aTIvara kI) tumhI AmacyA ANi tyAMcyA daramyAna ekhAdI bhiMta banavAvI.

tyAne uttara dile kI mAjhyAjavaLa, mAjhyA pAlanakartyAne je pradAna kele Ahe, teca uttama Ahe. tumhI phakta ApalI zaktI ANi sAmarthyAne mAjhI madata karA. tumacyA ANi tyAMcyA daramyAna mI bhakkama bhiMta banavUna deto.

malA lokhaMDAcI cAdara ANUna dyA, yetheparyaMta kI jevhA tyA dona parvatAMcyA daramyAna bhiMta ubhArUna dilI tevhA Adeza dilA kI phUMka mArA (arthAta prakhara Aga prajvalita karA) tyA veLeparyaMta kI lokhaMDAcyA yA cAdarIMnA agadI Aga karUna TAkale, tevhA sAMgitale, mAjhyAjavaLa ANA, yAcyAvara vitaLalele tAMbe TAkato.
maga nA tara tyAMcyAta tyA bhiMtIvara caDhaNyacAcI zaktI hotI ANi nA ticyAta ekhAde chidra karU zakata hote.

sAMgitale kI hI kevaLa mAjhyA pAlanakartyAcI dayA-kRpA Ahe, paraMtu jevhA mAjhyA pAlanakartyAcA vAyadA (Adeza) yeIla tevhA tyAce tukaDe tukaDe karUna TAkela. niHsaMzaya, mAjhyA pAlanakartyAcA vAyadA saccA Ahe.
ANi tyA divazI AmhI tyAMnA ApasAta ekamekAMzI misaLata asatAnA soDUna deU ANi sUra (zaMkha) phUMkalA jAIla, maga sarvAMnA AmhI ekAca veLI jamA karU.
ANi tyA divazI AmhI jahannamalA (dekhIla) kAphirAMcyA samora ANUna ubhI karU.
jyAMce DoLe mAjhyA smaraNApAsUna paDadyAta hote ANi (satya) aikUhI zakata navhate.
kAya kAphira hA vicAra karUna basale Aheta kI mAjhyAzivAya te mAjhyA dAsAMnA ApalA samarthaka banavUna ghetIla? (aikA) AmhI tara tyA kAphirAMcyA pAhuNacArAsAThI jahannama tayAra karUna ThevalI Ahe.
sAMgA kI (tumhI sAMgata asAla) tara mI sAMgato kI ApalyA karmAMmuLe sarvAMta jAsta nukasAna ucalaNArA koNa Ahe?
te loka Aheta, jyAMce aihika jIvanAce sarva prayatna vyartha Tharale, ANi te yAca bhramAta rAhile kI te phAra cAMgale kAma karIta Aheta.

heca te loka hote, jyAMnI ApalyA pAlanakartyA (allAha) cyA AyatIMzI ANi tyAcyAzI bheTa hoNyAcA inkAra kelA, yAstava tyAMcI sarva karme vAyA gelIta. maga kayAmatacyA divazI AmhI tyAMcA kasalAhI bhAra nizcita karaNAra nAhI.
vastutaH tyAMcA mobadalA jahannama Ahe, kAraNa tyAMnI inkAra kelA ANi mAjhyA AyatIMcI ANi mAjhyA paigaMbarAMcI thaTTA uDavilI.
jyA lokAMnI ImAna rAkhale ANi satkarma karIta rAhile, nizcitaca tyAMcyAsAThI phirdosa (jannatamadhIla sarvocca sthAna) cyA bAgAMmadhye svAgata Ahe.
jithe te nehamI rAhatIla, je sthAna badalaNyAcA kadhIhI tyAMcA irAdA hoNAra nAhI.

sAMgA kI jara mAjhyA pAlanakartyAcyA goSTI (prazaMsA va guNagAna) lihiNyAkaritA samudra zAI banalA tara tohI mAjhyA pAlanakartyAcyA goSTI saMpaNyApUrvIca saMpUna jAIla, maga vATalyAsa AmhI tyAsArakhAca dusarA (samudra) tyAcyA madatIkaritA gheUna yAve.

tumhI sAMgA kI mI tara tumacyAsArakhAca eka manuSya Ahe (hoya)mAjhyAkaDe vahyI(prakAzanA)kelI jAte kI sarvAMcA upAsya kevaLa ekaca upAsya Ahe, tara jyAlA dekhIla ApalyA pAlanakartyAzI bheTaNyAcI AzA asela, tyAne satkarma karIta rAhile pAhije, ANi ApalyA pAlanakartyAcyA bhaktI-upAsaneta dusar2yA koNAlAhI sahabhAgI karU naye.
kApha. hA. yA. eaina. zvAda.
hA ullekha Ahe tumacyA pAlanakartyAcyA tyA kRpecA, jI tyAne Apale dAsa jakariyAvara kelI hotI.
jevhA tyAMnI ApalyA pAlanakartyAjavaLa gupacupa rityA prArthanA kelI
mhaNAle he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA mAjhI hADe kamakuvata jhAlI Aheta ANi Doke mhAtArapaNAmuLe bhaDakale Ahe, paraMtu mI kadhIhI tujhyAjavaLa duA (prArthanA) karUna vaMcita rAhilo nAhI.
ANi malA ApalyA (mRtyu) naMtara, ApalyA javaLacyA nAtevAIkAMce bhaya Ahe. mAjhI patnI dekhIla vAMjha Ahe, paNa tarIhI tU malA ApalyAtarphe vArasa pradAna kara.
jo mAjhAhI vArasa asela ANi yAkUbacyA vaMzAcAhI vArasa, ANi he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! tU tyAlA ApalA AvaDatA dAsa banava.
he jakariyA! AmhI tumhAlA ekA putrA (cyA prAptI) cI khUzakhabara deto, jyAce nAva yahayA Ahe. AmhI tyAMcyApUrvI yA nAvAsArakhe nAva koNAlAhI dile nAhI.
(jakariyA) mhaNAle, he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! malA putra kasA bare hoIla, mAjhI patnI vAMjha ANi mI svataH mhAtArapaNAcyA atizaya kamakuvata avasthesa pohocalo Ahe.
Adeza jhAlA kI (vAyadA) azAca prakAre pUrNa jhAlA. tumacyA pAlanakartyAne pharmAvile Ahe kI mAjhyAkaritA tara he agadI sope Ahe ANi tumhI svataH jevhA kAhIca navhatA, mI tumhAlA nirmANa kele Ahe.

(jakariyA) mhaNAle, he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! mAjhyAsAThI ekhAdI nizANI nirdhArIta kara, Adeza dilA kI tumacyAsAThI nizANI hI kI prakRtI dhaDadhAkaTa asatAnAhI tumhI tIna rAtrI paryaMta koNatyAhI mANasAzI bolU zakaNAra nAhIta.
AtA jakariyA ApalyA kholI (hujar2yA) cyA bAhera yeUna ApalyA janasamUhAjavaLa yeUna tyAMnA izArA karatAta kI tumhI sakALa-saMdhyAkALa allAhacI pavitratA varNana karA.
he yahayA! (mAjhyA) graMthAvara ApalI pakaDa majabUta rAkhA ANi AmhI yahayAlA bAlapaNApAsUnaca jJAna pradAna kele.
ANi ApalyAkaDUna dayA-kRpA ANi pavitratA dekhIla, to allAhace bhaya rAkhUna vAgaNArA manuSya hotA.
ANi ApalyA mAtA-pityAzI neka-sadAcArI hotA, to kaThora ANi gunhegAra navhatA.
tyAcyAvara salAmatI Ahe, jyA divazI tyAne janma ghetalA ANi jyA divazI to maraNa pAvela, ANi jyA divazI to jivaMta karUna uThavilA jAIla.
yA graMthAta mariyamacyA vRttAMtAcAhI ullekha karA, jevhA tyAMnI ApalyA kuTuMbAcyA lokAMpAsUna vegaLe hoUna pUrvekaDe ekAMtavAsa patkaralA.
ANi tyA lokAMpAsUna ADa-paDadA kelA, maga AmhI ticyAjavaLa ApalA AtmA (jibrIla ale.) pAThavilA, tara to ticyAsamora saMpUrNa mAnava rUpAta prakaTa jhAlA.
tI mhaNAlI, mI tujhyApAsUna rahamAna (dayAvAna allAha) ce zaraNa mAgate, jara tU thoDAsAhI allAhace bhaya rAkhaNArA Ahesa.
to mhaNAlA, mI allAhatarphe pAThavilA gelelA rasUla (preSita) Ahe, tulA eka pavitra putra deNyAsAThI Alo Ahe.
tI mhaNAlI, malA putra kasA bare hoU zakato? malA tara ekhAdyA puruSAcA hAta dekhIla lAgalA nAhI, ANi nA mI durAcArI Ahe.

to mhaNAlA, pharmAna tara heca Ahe. (paraMtu) tumacyA pAlanakartyAcA Adeza Ahe kI te mAjhyAsAThI phAraca sope Ahe. AmhI tara tyAlA lokAMsAThI eka nizANI banavU ANi ApalI khAsa dayA hI tara eka nizcita azI goSTa Ahe.
maga tI garbhavatI jhAlI ANi yAca kAraNAstava tI ekAgracitta hoUna ekA dUracyA ThikANI nighUna gelI.
maga prasava-pIDA tilA ekA khajUrIcyA jhADAkhAlI gheUna AlI ANi ticyA toMDUna nighAle, arere! mI yApUrvI melI asatI ANi lokAMnA mAjhA agadI visara paDalA asatA.
tevaDhyAta tilA utArAkaDUna hAka aikU AlI kI, nirAza hoU nakosa, tujhyA pAlanakartyAne tujhyA pAyAkhAlI eka jharA pravAhIta kelA Ahe.
ANi tyA khajurIcyA jhADAcyA phAMdIlA ApalyAkaDe halava. tI tujhyAsamora tAjyA pikalelyA khajurI pADIla.
AtA nirdhAsta hoUna khA ANi pI ANi DoLe thaMDa rAkha, jara tulA ekhAdA manuSya disalA tara sAMga kI mI dayAvAna allAhacyA nAvAne rojA (upavAsa) ThevalA Ahe. Aja mI koNatyAhI mANasAzI bolaNAra nAhI.
AtA (hajarata IsA) yAMnA gheUna tI ApalyA lokAMmadhye AlI. sarvajaNa mhaNAle, mariyama, tU moThe vAITa kRtya kelesa.
he hArunacyA bahiNI! nA tara tujhA pitA vAITa mANUsa hotA, ANi nA tujhI AI durAcArI hotI.
(mariyamane) ApalyA bALAkaDe izArA kelA, sarva mhaNU lAgale, AtA kuzIta asalelyA bALAzI AmhI bolaNAra tarI kase.
(bALa) ud‌gArale, mI sarvazreSTha allAhacA dAsa Ahe. tyAne malA graMtha pradAna kelA Ahe ANi malA ApalA paigaMbara (dUta) banavile Ahe.
ANi tyAne malA zubha maMgaladAyI banavile Ahe, jithe dekhIla mI rAhIna ANi joparyaMta mI jivaMta rAhIna toparyaMta tyAne malA namAja ANi jakAtacA Adeza dilA Ahe.
ANi tyAne malA ApalyA mAtecA sevaka banavile Ahe ANi malA kaThora ANi durdaivI kele nAhI.
ANi mAjhyAvara mAjhyA janmAcyA divazI ANi mAjhyA mRtyucyA divazI ANi jyA divazI mI dusar2yAMdA ubhA kelA jAIna, mAjhyAvara zAMtI-salAmatI Ahe.
hI Ahe saccI kahANI mariyamacA putra IsAcI. hIca tI satya goSTahoya, jyAbAbata loka saMzayAta paDale Aheta.
allAhakaritA saMtatI asaNe ucita nAhI to tara atizaya pavitra Ahe to jevhA ekhAdyA kAmAcA saMkalpa karato tevhA tyAsAThI mhaNato hoUna jA ANi tyA kSaNI te ghaDUna yete.
ANi mAjhA ANi tumhA sarvAMcA pAlanakartA allAhaca Ahe. tevhA tumhI sarva tyAcIca upAsanA karA, hAca saraLa mArga Ahe.
maga (he) gaTa ApasAta matabheda karU lAgale. tathApi kAphirAMsAThI duHkha Ahe ekA bhayaMkara divasAcyA yeNyAne.
kitI cAMgale pAhaNAre aikaNAre asatIla tyA divazI, jevhA AmacyAsamora hajara hotIla, paraMtu Aja tara he atyAcArI loka ughaDa azA mArgabhraSTateta paDale Aheta.
ANi tumhI tyAMnA yA duHkha ANi nirAzecyA divasAce bhaya aikavA jevhA kArya pUrNatvAsa pohacavile jAIla ANi he loka gaphalatIta ANi beImAnItaca paDUna rAhatIla.
niHsaMzaya, dharatIce ANi dharatIvara rAhaNAr2yAMce vArasa AmhIca asaNAra ANi samasta loka AmacyAcakaDe paratavUna ANale jAtIla.
yA graMthAta ibrAhIma (cyA vRttAMtA) cA ullekha karA. niHsaMzaya te moThe sacce paigaMbara (IzadUta) hote.
jevhA te ApalyA pityAsa mhaNAle, he pitA! tumhI azAMcI upAsanA kA karIta AhAta je nA aikU zakatIla, nA pAhU zakatIla ANi nA tumhAlA kasalAhI lAbha pohacavU zakatIla.
he (mAjhyA priya) pitA! (tumhI pAhA) mAjhyAjavaLa te jJAna Ale Ahe je tumacyAjavaLa Aleca nAhI, tevhA tumhI mAjheca mhaNaNe mAnya karA mI agadI saraLa mArgAkaDe tumace mArgadarzana karIna.
he mAjhyA pityA! tumhI saitAnAcI upAsanA karaNyApAsUna thAMbA saitAna tara dayALU ANi kRpALU allAhacI khUpa avajJA karaNArA Ahe.
he pitA! malA bhaya vATate kI kadAcita tumacyAvara allAhacI ekhAdI zikSA yAtanA na yeUna kosaLAvI kI (jyAmuLe) tumhI saitAnAce mitra banAve.

(pityAne) uttara dile, he ibrAhIma! kAya tU AmacyA upAsyAMpAsUna toMDa phiravita Ahesa? (aika) jara tU ase karaNe thAMbavile nAhI tara mI tulA dagaDAMnI (ThecUna) mAruna TAkIna, jA ekA dIrgha mudatAparyaMta mAjhyApAsUna vegaLAca rAhA.
(ibrAhIma) mhaNAle, ThIka Ahe. salAma aso tumacyAvara mI tara ApalyA pAlanakartyAjavaLa tumacyAsAThI mAphIcI duA (prArthanA) karIta rAhIna. to mAjhyAvara atizaya jAsta meharabAnI karIta Ahe.

ANi mI tara tumhAlAhI ANi jyAMnA jyAMnA tumhI allAhazivAya pukAratA tyAMnA (sarvAMnA) hI soData Ahe. mI phakta ApalyA pAlanakartyAlA pukArita rAhIna. malA pUrNa vizvAsa Ahe kI mI ApalyA pAlanakartyAjavaLa duA (prArthanA) karaNyAta asaphala rAhaNAra nAhI.
jevhA (ibrAhIma yAMnI) tyA sarvAMcA ANi allAhazivAya tyAMcyA sarva upAsyAMcA tyAga kelA, tevhA AmhI tyAMnA isahAka ANi yAkUba pradAna kele ANi pratyekAlA paigaMbara banavile.
ANi tyA sarvAMnA AmhI ApalI bharapUra dayA-kRpA pradAna kelI ANi AmhI tyAMcyA saccA vAyadyAlA bulaMda darjA dilA.
yA graMthAta mUsAcAhI ullekha karA, jo nivaDalelA ANi rasUla ANi nabI (paigaMbara) hotA.
AmhI tyAMnA (mUsAlA) tUra parvatAcyA ujavyA kinAr2yAkaDUna pukArale ANi kAnagoSTI karIta tyAMnA javaLa kele.
ANi ApalyA vizeSa dayA-kRpene tyAMcA bhAU hAruna yAMnAhI paigaMbara pada pradAna kele.
ANi yA graMthAta ismAIla (cyA vRttAMtA) cAhI ullekha karA. te vAyadyAce moThe pakke hote ANi te dekhIla rasUla ANi nabI hote.
ANi te ApalyA kuTuMbiyAMnA satata namAja ANi jakAta (dharmadAnA) cA Adeza deta asata ANi te ApalyA pAlanakartyAcyA darabArAta priya ANi pasaMta kele gelele hote.
ANi yA graMthAta idarIsacAhI ullekha karA te dekhIla eka sacce paigaMbara hote.
AmhI tyAMnA moThe ucca sthAna pradAna kele.

heca te paigaMbara hote, jyAMcyAvara sarvazreSTha allAhane dayA ANi kRpA kelI, je AdamacyA saMtatIpaikI Aheta ANi tyA lokAMce vaMzaja Aheta, jyAMnA AmhI nUha yAMcyAsobata nauketa svAra kele hote ANi ibrAhIma ANi yAkUbacyA saMtatIpaikI ANi AmacyAtarphe mArgadarzana lAbhalele ANi AmacyA priya lokAMpaikI. yAMcyAsamora jevhA atizaya dayAvAna allAhacyA AyatIMce paThaNa kele jAta ase, te sajadA karIta ANi khUpa raData va gayAvayA karIta khAlI paData asata.
puDhe tyAMcyAnaMtara ase kuputra janmAsa Ale kI tyAMnI namAja barabAda kelI ANi manAcyA icchA-AkAMkSAMcyA mAge lAgale. yAstava tyAMce nukasAna tyAMcyAsamora yeIla.
mAtra tyAMcyAkherIja, je mAphI mAgatIla ANi ImAna rAkhatIla ANi satkarme karatIla ase loka jannatamadhye dAkhala hotIla ANi tyAMcyA hakkAMnA kiMcitahI nukasAna pohacavile jANAra nAhI.
nehamI kAyama rAhaNAr2yA jannatIMmadhye jyAMcyA aparokSa vAyadA dayAvAna allAhane ApalyA dAsAMnA dilA Ahe. niHsaMzaya, tyAcA vAyadA pUrNa jhAlyAvinA rAhaNAra nAhI.
tyAMnA tithe koNatIhI vyartha goSTa aikAyalA miLaNAra nAhI, te phakta salAmaca, salAma aikatIla tyAMcyAsAThI sakALa-saMdhyAkALa tyAMcI rojI (anna-sAmugrI) asela.
hI Ahe tI jannata jicA vArasa AmhI ApalyA dAsAMpaikI azAMnA banavito, je allAhace bhaya bALagatAta.
AmhI tumacyA pAlanakartyAcyA AdezAvinA utaruca zakata nAhI, AmacyA puDhe-mAge ANi tyA daramyAnacyA samasta vastU tyAcyAca adhikArAta Aheta ANi tumacA pAlanakartA visaraNArA nAhI.

AkAzAMcA ANi jaminIcA ANi je kAhI tyAMcyA daramyAna Ahe tyA sarvAMcA toca svAmI ANi pAnalahAra Ahe. tumhI tyAcIca upAsanA karA ANi tyAcyA upAsanevara dRDha-majabUta vhA. kAya tumacyA mAhitIta tyAcyAsArakhe nAva asalelA (ANi barobarIcA) ANakhI koNI Ahe?
ANi manuSya mhaNato kI jevhA mI maraNa pAvela, tara kAya punhA jivaMta karUna bAhera kADhalA jAIna?
kAya hA manuSya evaDhehI smaraNAta rAkhata nAhI kI AmhI tyAlA yAcyApUrvI nirmANa kele, vAstavika to kAhIca navhatA.
tumacyA pAlanakartyAcI zapatha! AmhI tyAMnA ANi saitAnAMnA ekatrita karUna nizcitaca jahannamacyA cohIbAjUlA guDaghe TekalelyA avastheta hajara karU.
maga AmhI pratyeka samUhApAsUna tyAMnA vegaLe kADhUna ubhe karU, je atizaya dayAvAna allAhapAsUna moThI akaDa dAkhavita phirata hote.
maga AmhI tyAMnAhI cAMgalyA prakAre jANato, je jahannamamadhye dAkhala hoNyAsa jAsta pAtra Aheta.
ANi tumacyApaikI pratyekajaNa tithe nizcita hajara hoNAra Ahe. hA tumacyA pAlanakartyAcA agadI aTaLa phaisalA Ahe.
maga AmhI, Amace bhaya rAkhUna durAcArApAsUna dUra rAhaNAr2yAMnA vAcavUna gheU ANi julUma atyAcAra karaNAr2yAMnA tyAtaca guDaghe TekalelyA avastheta khAlI paDalele soDU.

ANi jevhA tyAMcyAsamora AmacyA sApha ANi spaSTa AyatIMce paThaNa kele jAte, tevhA kAphira loka musalamAnAMnA mhaNatAta, (sAMgA) AmacyA-tumacyAta koNAcA mAna-martabA moThA Ahe ANi koNAcI sabhA zAnadAra Ahe?
ANi AmhI tara tyAMcyApUrvI aneka janasamUhAMnA naSTa kele Ahe je sAdhanasAmugrI ANi nAvalaukikAta yAMcyAhUna khUpa moThe hote.

sAMgA, jo mArgabhraSTateta asato, dayAvAna allAha tyAlA khUpa dIrgha saMdhI deto, yethaparyaMta kI tyAne tyA goSTI pAhUna ghyAvyAta, jyAMcyAviSayI vAyade kele jAta Aheta, arthAta allAhatarphe zikSA-yAtanA kiMvA kayAmatalA tyA veLI tyAMnA cAMgalyA prakAre kaLUna yeIla kI koNa vAITa padAcA Ahe ANi koNAcA jathA(samUha) kamakuvata Ahe.

ANi mArgadarzana lAbhalelyA lokAMcyA mArgadarzanAta allAha ANakhI bhara TAkato, ANi bAkI rAhaNArI nekI (satkarma) tumacyA pAlanakartyAjavaLa mobadalyAcyA dRSTIne ANi pariNAmAcyA dRSTIne phAraca cAMgalI Ahe.
kAya tumhI tyAlAhI pAhile, jyAne AmacyA AyatIMzI kupra (inkAra) kelA ANi mhaNAlA kI malA tara dhana ANi saMtatI avazya dilI jAIla.
kAya to aparokSa jJAna rAkhato kiMvA allAhakaDUna tyAne ekhAde vacana ghetale Ahe?
muLIca nAhI hA je kAhI bolata Ahe, te AmhI avazya lihUna gheU ANi tyAMcyAsAThI az2Aba (zikSA-yAtanA) vADhavata jAU.
ANi hA jyA vastUMbAbata bolata Ahe, tyA AmhI tyAcyA pazcAta gheUna TAkU ANi hA ekaTAca AmacyA samora hajara hoIla.
tyAMnI allAhakherIja itara devatA (upAsye) banavUna ThevalI Aheta kI te tyAMcyAsAThI sanmAnAce kAraNa Tharota.
ase kadApi hoNAra nAhI. te tara yAMcyA upAsanecAca inkAra karatIla ANi ulaTa yAMce zatrU banatIla.
kAya tumhI nAhI pAhile kI AmhI kAphirAMjavaLa saitAnAMnA pAThavito je tyAMnA khUpa prerita karatAta.
tumhI tyAMcyA bAbatIta ghAI karU nakA. AmhI tara svataHca tyAMcI kAlagaNanA karIta Ahota.
jyA divazI AmhI, allAhace bhaya rAkhUna durAcArApAsUna alipta rAhaNAr2yAMnA, dayAvAna allAhacA atithI banavUna ekatra karU.
ANi aparAdhI lokAMnA (atizaya tahAna lAgalelyA avastheta) jahannamakaDe hAkalata gheUna jAU.
koNAlAhI ziphArasa karaNyAcA adhikAra nasela, mAtra tyA lokAMkherIja, jyAMnI sarvazreSTha allAhakaDUna ekhAde vacana gheUna Thevale Ahe.
ANi tyAMce mhaNaNe tara ase Ahe kI dayAvAna allAhane dekhIla saMtatI karUna ThevalI Ahe.
niHsaMzaya tumhI moThI (vAITa ANi) bhayaMkara goSTa ANalI Ahe.
zakya Ahe kI yA kathanAmuLe AkAza phATUna jAIla ANi dharatI dubhaMgUna jAIla ANi parvatAce kaNa kaNa hotIla.
kI te rahamAna (allAha) cI saMtatI sAbIta karaNyAsa basale Aheta.
ANi rahamAna (allAha) sAThI he yogya nAhI kI tyAne saMtatI rAkhAvI.
AkAzAMmadhye ANi jaminIvara je kAhI Ahe, sarva allAhace dAsa banUnaca yeNAra Aheta.
tyA sarvAMnA tyAne gherUna Thevale Ahe ANi sarvAMcI pUrNataH gaNanAhI karUna ThevalI Ahe.
he sarvacyA sarva kayAmatacyA divazI ekaTe tyAcyAsamora hajara hoNAra Aheta.
niHsaMzaya, jyA lokAMnI ImAna rAkhale Ahe ANi jyAMnI satkarme kelI Aheta, tyAMcyAkaritA dayAvAna allAha prema nirmANa karIla.
ANi (kuraAnAlA) tumacyA bhASeta phAra sope kele Ahe kI tumhI tyAcyAdvAre neka- sadAcArI lokAMnA khUzakhabara dyAvI ANi bhAMDakhora lokAMnA khabaradAra karAve.
ANi AmhI yAcyApUrvI aneka jamAtIMnA naSTa kele Ahe, kAya tyAMcyApaikI koNA ekAcAhI cAhUla tumhAlA aikU yete kiMvA tyAMcA kiMcita AvAjahI tumacyA kAnI paDato?
tA.hA.
AmhI yA kuraAnAce avataraNa tumacyAvara azAsAThI kele nAhI kI tumhI kaSTa- yAtanAgrasta vhAve.
kiMbahunA tyAcyA bodha- upadezAkaritA, jo allAhace bhaya rAkhato.
yAce avaraNa tyAcyAcatarphe Ahe, jyAne jaminIlA ANi uMca uMca AkAzAMnA nirmANa kele Ahe.
jo atizaya dayAvAna Ahe, arza (IzasiMhAsanA) vara virAjamAna Ahe.
AkAzAMmadhye ANi dharatIvara ANi yAMcyA daramyAna ANi jaminIcyA pAtaLIkhAlI pratyeka ThikANI tyAcI rAjyasattA Ahe. (arthAta yA sarvAMcA ekameva bAdazahA toca Ahe.)
tumhI Apale mhaNaNe uMca svarAta sAMgA kiMvA haLU AvAjAta, to tara lapalelI ANi gupta svarupAcI goSTahI cAMgalyA prakAre jANato.
toca allAha hoya, jyAcyAkherIja koNIhI saccA (kharAkhurA) upAsya nAhI. sarva uttamottama nAve tyAcIca Aheta.
tumhAlA mUsAcA vRttAMta tara mAhItaca Ahe.

jevhA tyAMnI Aga pAhUna ApalyA kuTuMbIyAMnA mhaTale kI thoDA veLa ithe thAMbA, malA Aga disata Ahe. khUpa zakya Ahe kI mI tyA AgIcA nikhArA tumacyAjavaLa ANAvA kiMvA AgIjavaLUna ucita rastyAcI bAtamI prApta karUna ghyAvI.
jevhA te tyA ThikANI pohocale, tevhA AvAja aikU AlA kI, he mUsA!
niHsaMzaya, mIca tumacA svAmI va pAlanakartA Ahe. tumhI ApalyA pAyAtale joDe utaravA kAraNa tumhI ‘tovA’cyA pavitra maidAnAta AhAta.
ANi mI tumacI nivaDa kelI Ahe. AtA jI vahayI (prakAzanA) kelI jAIla tilA lakSapUrvaka aikA.
niHsaMzaya, mIca allAha Ahe. mAjhyAkherIja upAsanA karaNyAyogya dusarA koNIhI nAhI, yAstava tumhI mAjhIca upAsanA karA ANi mAjhyA smaraNArtha namAja kAyama karA.
kayAmata hamakhAsa yeNAra Ahe, jilA mI gupta ThevU icchito yAsAThI kI pratyeka mANasAlA to mobadalA pradAna kelA jAvA, jo tyAne prayatna kelA asela.
tevhA AtA yAvara ImAna rAkhaNyApAsUna tumhAlA azA mANasAne rokhU naye, jo yAvara ImAna rAkhata nasela ANi ApalyA icchA AkAMkSAMcyA mAge dhAvata asela, anyathA tumhI nAza pAvAla.
ANi he mUsA! tumacyA ujavyA hAtAta kAya Ahe?
uttara dile, hI mAjhI lAThI Ahe, jicyAvara mI TekA (AdhAra) gheto ANi jicyAdvAre mI ApalyA zeLyAMkaritA jhADAcI pAne khAlI pADUna gheto ANi ticyApAsUna malA dusarehI aneka phAyade Aheta.
(allAhane) pharmAvile, he mUsA, tilA (hAtAtUna) khAlI TAkA.
tevhA khAlI TAkatAca sApa banUna dhAvU lAgalI.
pharmAvile nirbhaya hoUna tilA dharA, AmhI tilA tyAca pahilyA avastheta punhA ANU.
ANi ApalA hAta ApalyA kAkheta (bagaleta) ghAlA, tevhA to sapheda, prakAzamAna hotAnA bAhera nighela, mAtra kasalyAhI vyaMga-doSa ANi AjArAvinA. hA dusarA Iza-camatkAra Ahe.
he azAsAThI kI AmhI tumhAlA ApalyA moThamoThyA nizANyA dAkhavU icchito.
AtA, tumhI phiraaunakaDe jA, tyAne moThA utpAta mAjavilA Ahe.
(mUsA) mhaNAle, he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! mAjhI chAtI mAjhyAkaritA ughaDa (mokaLI) kara.
ANi mAjhe kArya mAjhyAsAThI sope kara.
ANi mAjhyA jIbhecI gATha soDava.
yAsAThI kI lokAMnI mAjhe mhaNaNe cAMgalyA prakAre samajU zakAve.
ANi mAjhA vajIra mAjhyA kuTuMbIyAMpaikI banava.
(arthAta) mAjhA bhAU hArUnalA.
tU tyAcyAdvAre mAjhI kaMbara majabUta kara.
ANi tyAlA mAjhyA kAryAta sahAyyaka banava.
yAsAThI kI AmhI doghAMnI tujhI khUpa khUpa stutI-prazaMsA varNana karAvI.
ANi tujhe adhikAdhika smaraNa karAve.
niHsaMzaya, tU AmacI cAMgalyA prakAre dekhabhAla karaNArA Ahesa.
(allAhane) pharmAvile, he mUsA! tumacyA sarva mAgaNyA pUrNa kelyA gelyA.
ANi AmhI tara tumacyAvara ANakhI ekadA yAhUna moThA upakAra kelA Ahe.
jevhA AmhI tumacyA mAtecyA manAta te avatarita kele, jyAce varNana yA veLI kele jAte Ahe.

kI tumhI, yA (bALA) lA lAkaDI peTIta ThevUna tilA baMda karUna nadIta soDUna dyA, maga nadI tyA peTIlA kinAr2yAvara neIla ANi mAjhA va tyAcA svataHcA zatrU tilA gheIla ANi mI ApalyAtarphe vizeSa prema ANi pasaMtIcA tumacyAvara varSAva kelA yAsAThI kI tumace pAlanapoSaNa mAjhyA DoLyAdekhata kele jAve.

(smaraNa karA) jevhA tumacI bahINa jAta hotI ANi sAMgata hotI kI, tumhI mhaNata asAla tara mI tyAcA pattA sAMgU jo yA (bALA) cI dekharekha ThevaNArA banU zakela. azA prakAre AmhI tumhAlA punhA tumacyA mAtejavaLa pAThavile, yAsAThI kI tice netra zitala rAhAveta ANi tI duHkhI hoU naye ANi tumhI ekA mANasAcA vadha kelA hotA, tyA uparAnta AmhI tumhAlA duHkhApAsUna vAcavile, arthAta AmhI tumacI cAMgalyA prakAre kasoTI ghetalI, maga tumhI aneka varSAparyaMta madayanacyA lokAMmadhye nivAsa kelA, maga allAhacyA likhita bhAgyAnusAra he mUsA tumhI Ale.
ANi mI tumhAlA vizeSataH ApalyAsAThI pasaMta kele.
AtA tumhI ApalyA bhAvAsaha mAjhyA nizANyAMsobata gheUna jA, khabaradAra! tumhI doghehI mAjhe smaraNa karaNyAta sustI karU nakA.
tumhI doghe phiraaunacyA javaLa jA. tyAne moThA vidroha kelA Ahe.
tyAlA naramIne samAjAvUna sAMgA, kadAcita tyAne dhyAnI ghyAve kiMvA (allAhace) bhaya bALagAve.
donhI mhaNAle, he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! AmhAlA bhaya vATate kI kadAcita phiraaunane AmacyAvara ekhAdA atyAcAra na karAvA, kiMvA ApalyA baMDakhorIta ANakhI vADhAvA.
uttara miLAle kI tumhI kadhIhI bhaya rAkhU nakA, mI sadaiva tumacyA sobatIlA Ahe ANi aikata va pAhata rAhIna.

tumhI tyAcyAjavaLa jAUna tyAlA sAMgA kI AmhI tujhyA pAnalakartyAce paigaMbara (IzadUta) Ahota. tU AmacyA sobata isrAIlacyA saMtatIlA pAThava, tyAMcyA zikSA-yAtanA saMpava. AmhI tara tujhyAjavaLa, tujhyA pAlanakartyAtarphe nizANyA gheUna Alo Ahota. zAMtI salAmatI phakta tyAcyAcakaritA Ahe, jo mArgadarzanAcA majabUtapaNe aMgikAra karela.
AmacyAkaDe vahayI (prakAzanA) kelI gelI Ahe kI jo khoTe Tharavila. ANi toMDa phiravila, tyAcyAkaritA az2Aba (zikSA-yAtanA) Ahe.
(phiraaunane) vicArale kI he mUsA! tumhA doghAMcA pAlanakartA koNa Ahe?
uttara dile kI AmacA pAlanakartA to Ahe, jyAne pratyekAlA tyAce khAsa rUpa pradAna kele, maga mArgadarzanahI dile.
phiraauna mhaNAlA, (bare he sAMgA) pUrvI hoUna gelelyA lokAMcI kAya avasthA jhAlI?
uttara dile, tyAMce jJAna mAjhyA pAlanakartyAjavaLa graMthAta Ahe. mAjhA pAlanakartAnA cUka karato, nA visarato.

tyAneca tumacyAsAThI jaminIlA aMtharuNa (bichAnA) banavile Ahe ANi tyAta tumacyA cAlaNyAsAThI raste banavile Aheta, ANi AkAzAtUna parjanyavRSTI dekhIla toca karato, maga tyA pAvasAdvAre aneka prakAracI paidAvArahI AmhI nirmANa karato.
tumhI svataH khA ANi ApalyA janAvarAMnAhI cArA. niHsaMzaya yAta buddhimAnAMkaritA aneka nizANyA Aheta.
tyAca dharatImadhUna AmhI tumhAlA nirmANa kele ANi ticyAtaca punhA parata pAThavU ANi ticyAtUnaca tumhA sarvAMnA bAhera kADhUna ubhe karU.
ANi AmhI tyAlA sarva nizANyA dAkhavilyA, paraMtu tarIhI tyAne khoTe Tharavile ANi inkAra kelA.
to mhaNAlA, he mUsA! kAya tU AmacyAjavaLa azAsAThI AlA Ahe kI AmhAlA ApalyA jAdUcyA sAmarthyAne AmacyA dezAtUna bAhera kADhAve.

ThIka Ahe. maga AmhIhI tumacA sAmanA karaNyAsAThI azIca jAdU jarUra ANU. tevhA tumhI AmacyA ANi ApalyA daramyAna vAyadyAcI veLa nizcita TharavUna ghyA kI nA AmhI tyAvirUddha karAve ANi nA tumhI. mokaLyA maidAnAta hI spardhA vhAvI.
(mUsA yAMnI) uttara dile, zobhA sajAvaTa ANi samAraMbhAcyA divasAcA vAyadA Ahe, ANi he kI lokAMnI divasa caDhatAca jamA vhAve.
naMtara phiraauna paratalA ANi tyAne Apale DAvapeca goLA kele maga AlA.

mUsA tyAlA mhaNAle kI tumacA nAza hovo, allAhavara khoTe nATe ANi lAMchana lAvU nakA kI (jyAmuLe) tyAne tumacA zikSA-yAtanedvAre sarvanAza karUna TAkAvA. lakSAta ThevA! jyAne asatya racale, to kadhIhI saphala hoNAra nAhI.
maga he loka ApasAta sallAmasalata karaNyAta ekamekAMvirUddha matAce jhAle ANi lapUna chapUna kAnagoSTI karU lAgale.
mhaNAle, he doghe phakta jAdUgAra Aheta ANi yAMcA pakkA irAdA Ahe kI ApalyA jAdUcyA zaktIne tumhAlA tumacyA dezAbAhera ghAlavAve ANi tumacyA uttama dharmAcA satyAnAza karUna TAkAvA.
tevhA tumhI dekhIla Apale koNatehI DAvapeca bAkI ThevU nakA, maga paMktIbaddha hoUna rAMgeta yA, Aja jo varcasvazAlI hoIla toca bAjI jiMkela.
te mhaNU lAgale kI he mUsA! eka tara tumhI AdhI TAkA kiMvA AmhI prathama TAkaNAre banAve.
uttara dile, nAhI tumhIca agodara TAkA. AtA tara mUsA yAMnA ase vATU lAgale kI tyAMcyA tyA dor2yA ANi kAThyA tyAMcyA jAdUcyA zaktIne dhAvata jAta Aheta.
azAne mUsA manAtalyA manAta bhiU lAgale.
AmhI pharmAvile, ajibAta bhiU nakA. niHsaMzaya tumhIca varcasvazAlI ANi ucca rAhAla.

ANi tumacyA ujavyA hAtAta je Ahe te khAlI TAkA kI tyAMcyA kArAgirIlA yAne giLUna TAkAve tyAMnI je kAhI banavile Ahe te kevaLa jAdUgArAMce kalA kauzalya Ahe ANi jAdUgAra koThUnahI yevo, saphala hota nAhI.
AtA tara sarvacyA sarva jAdUgAra sajadyAta paDale ANi akasmAta udgArale kI AmhI tara hAruna ANi mUsAcyA pAlanakartyAvara ImAna rAkhale.

(phiraauna) mhaNAlA, kAya mAjhA Adeza hoNyApUrvIca tumhI tyAcyAvara ImAna rAkhale? niHsaMzaya hAca tumacA to moThA gurU Ahe, jyAne tumhA sarvAMnA jAdU zikavilI Ahe (aikA) mI tumace hAta pAya virUddha dizene kApavUna tumhA sarvAMnA khajUrIcyA phAMdyAMvara phAsAvara laTakavina ANi tumhAlA pUrNataH mAhIta paDela kI AmacyApaikI koNAcI sajA adhika sakta ANi jAsta kALa TikaNArI Ahe.

(tyAMnI) uttara dile kI, asaMbhava Ahe kI AmhI tumhAlA prAdhAnya dyAve tyA pramANAMvara, jI AmacyA samora yeUna pohocalIta ANi tyA allAhavara, jyAne AmhAlA nirmANa kele. AtA, tU vATela te kara. tU jo kAhI Adeza cAlavU zakato to yA jagAcyA jIvanAtaca Ahe.

AmhI (yA Azene) ApalyA pAlanakartyAvara ImAna rAkhale kI tyAne Amace aparAdha mApha karAveta ANi prAmukhyAne jAdUgArI (ce pApa) je kAhI tU AmacyAkaDUna vivazatene karavUna ghetale Ahe. allAhaca sarvAMta uttama ANi sadaiva kALa rAhaNArA (cirasthAyI) Ahe.
tAtparya heca kI jo koNI aparAdhI banUna allAhacyA ThikANI jAIla, tyAcyAsAThI jahannama Ahe, jithe na mRtyu asela, na jIvana!
ANi jo koNI tyAcyAjavaLa ImAnadhAraka banUna jAIla ANi tyAne satkarmehI kelI asatIla tara tyAcyAsAThI ucca ANi cAMgale darje Aheta.
kAyamasvarUpI jannata, jyAMcyAkhAlI nadyA vAhata asatIla, jithe te sadAsarvadA rAhatIla. hAca mobadalA Ahe azA tyA pratyeka mANasAcA jo pavitra (pApamukta) Ahe.

ANi AmhI mUsAkaDe vahayI (prakAzanA) avatarita kelI kI tumhI rAtrItUnaca mAjhyA dAsAMnA gheUna calA ANi tyAMcyAsAThI samudrAta koraDA mArga banavUna ghyA, maga nA tumhAlA koNAcyA yeUna dharaNyAce bhaya rAhIla nA dhAstI.
phiraaunane ApalyA sainyAsaha tyAMcA pAThalAga kelA, maga tara samudra tyA sarvAMvara AcchAdita jhAlA jase kAhI AcchAdita hoNAra hote.
ANi phiraaunane ApalyA janasamUhAlA mArgabhraSTateta TAkale ANi saraLa mArga dAkhavilA nAhI.
he isrAIlacyA putrAMno! (pAhA) AmhI tumhAlA tumacyA zatrucyA tAvaDItUna mukta kele ANi tumhAlA tUra parvatAcyA ujavIkaDace vacana dile ANi tumacyAvara manna ANi salavA utaravilA.
tumhI, AmhI pradAna kelelI svaccha zuddha rojI (AjivikA) khA ANi tyAta maryAdece ullaMghana karU nakA anyathA tumacyAvara mAjhA prakopa utarela to nizcitaca nAza pAvela.
ANi nizcitaca mI tyAMnA mApha karaNAra Ahe je mAphI mAgatIla ImAna rAkhatIla satkarme karatIla ANi saraLa mArgAvarahI rAhatIla.
ANi he mUsA! tumhAlA ApalA janasamUhAzI (gAphIla karUna) koNatyA goSTIne lavakara ANale?
sAMgitale te loka mAjhyA pAThopAThaca Aheta ANi mI, he pAlanakartyA ghAI azAsAThI kelI kI tU prasanna vhAve.
pharmAvile, AmhI tumacyA janasamUhAlA tumacyA pazcAta kasoTIta TAkale ANi tyAMnA sAmarIne mArgabhraSTa karUna TAkale.

tevhA mUsA atizaya krodhita ANi duHkhI hoUna paratale ANi mhaNAle kI he mAjhyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMno! kAya tumacyAzI tumacyA pAlanakartyAne cAMgalA vAyadA kelA navhatA? kAya tyAcI mudata tumhAlA dIrgha svarUpAcI vATalI? kI tumacA irAdAca hA Ahe kI tumacyAvara tumacyA pAlanakartyAcA prakopa kosaLAvA, mhaNUna tumhI mAjhA vAyadA toDUna TAkalA.

(lokAMnI) uttara dile, AmhI ApalyA adhikArAne tumacyAzI kelelA vAyadA toDalA nAhI, kiMbahunA AmacyAvara je dAgine, lokAMce lAdale gele hote, te AmhI TAkUna dile ANi tyAcapramANe sAmarIne dekhIla TAkale.
maga tyAne lokAMsAThI eka vAsarU ghaDavile arthAta vAsarAcI mUrtI jyAcA gAyIsArakhA AvAja hotA, maga mhaNAle kI hAca tumacAhI mAbUda (upAsya) Ahe ANi mUsAcA dekhIla, paraMtu mUsAlA visara paDalA.
kAya he vATa cukalele loka hehI pAhata nAhI kI te tara tyAMcyA bolaNyAlA uttarahI deU zakata nAhI ANi na tyAMcyA kasalyAhI cAMgalyA vAITAcA adhikAra bALagato.

ANi hArUnane yApUrvIhI tyAMnA sAMgitale hote kI he mAjhyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMno! yA vAsarAdvAre tara tumacI parIkSA ghetalI gelI Ahe. tumacA saccA pAlanahAra tara dayAvAna allAhaca Ahe, tevhA tumhI sarva mAjhe anusaraNa karA ANi mAjhe mhaNaNe mAnata jA.
(tyAMnI) uttara dile mUsAce Agamana hoIparyaMta AmhI tara yAceca pujArI banUna rAhU.
(mUsA) mhaNAle, he hArUna! yAMnA mArgabhraSTa hota asalele pAhUna (tyAMnA rokhaNyAta) tumhAlA koNatyA goSTIne rokhUna Thevale hote?
kI jyAmuLe tU mAjhyA pAThopATha AlA nAhI, kAya tU dekhIla mAjhI avajJA karaNArA banalAsa?

(hArUna) mhaNAle, he mAjhyA mAtecyA putrA! mAjhI dADhI dharU nakA, ANi DokyAce kesa oDhU nakA. mAjhyA manAta tara kevaLa hAca vicAra AlA Ahe kI kadAcita tumhI ase na mhaNAve kI tU isrAIlacyA saMtatIta phUTa pADalIsa ANi mAjhyA bolaNyAcI (AdezAcI) vATa pAhilI nAhI.
(mUsA yAMnI) vicArale, sAmarI tujhA kAya mAmalA Ahe?

(tyAne) uttara dile, malA te disale, je tyAMnA disale nAhI, tevhA mI allAhane pAThavilelyA pAUlakhuNAMtUna eka mUTha bharUna ghetalI. tilA tyAta TAkale. azA prakAre mAjhyA manAne mAjhyAsAThI hI goSTa racalI.

sAMgitale, ThIka Ahe. jA, yA jagAcyA jIvanAta tujhI zikSA hIca kI tU mhaNata rAhAve, malA sparza karU nakA ANi eka dusarA vAyadAhI tujhyAzI Ahe, jo tujhyAvarUna kadhIhI TALaNAra nAhI ANi AtA tU ApalyA yA daivatAlAhI pAhA, jyAcA tU pujArI banalA hotA, AmhI tyAlA jALUna TAkU, maga tyAlA nadIta cUrecUra uDavUna deU.
niHsaMzaya, tumhA sarvAMcA mAbUda (upAsya) kevaLa allAhaca Ahe. tyAcyAkherIja dusarA koNIhI upAsya nAhI. tyAce jJAna samasta vastUMvara prabhAvI Ahe.
azA prakAre AmhI tumacyAsamora pUrvI hoUna gelelyA ghaTanAMce varNana karato, ANi niHsaMzaya AmhI tumhAlA ApalyAkaDUna bodha- upadeza pradAna kelelA Ahe.
yApAsUna jo toMDa phiravela to nizcitaca kayAmatacyA divazI Apale avajaDa ojhe lAdalelyA sthitIta asela.
jyAta to nehamIca rAhIla ANi azAMkaritA kayAmatacyA divazI (moThe) bhayaMkara ojhe Ahe.
jyA divazI sUra (zaMkha) phuMkalA jAIla ANi aparAdhI lokAMnA AmhI tyA divazI (bhItImuLe) niLyA pivaLyA DoLyAMsaha gherUna ANU.
te ApasAta haLU haLU bolata asatIla kI AmhI tara (jagAta) kevaLa dayA divasaca rAhilo.
je kAhI te bolata Aheta, tyAcI hakIgata AmhI jANato. tyAMcyAtalA sarvAMta cAMgalyA mArgAcA isama mhaNata asela, tumhI phakta ekaca divasa rAhileta.
te tumhAlA parvatAMbaddala vicAratAta, tara (tumhI) sAMgA kI parvatAMnA mAjhA pAlanakartA (allAha) cUrecUre karUna uDavUna deIla.
ANi (jaminI) lA samatala sapATa maidAna karUna TAkIla.
jyAta nA koThe vaLaNa disela, nA uMca sakhala bhAga.
jyA divazI loka pukAraNAr2yAcyA mAge cAlatIla, jyAta kasalIhI kamI hoNAra nAhI ANi dayAvAna allAhacyA samora sarvAMce AvAja dabalele asatIla, kujabujakherIja tumhAlA kAhIca aikU yeNAra nAhI.
tyA divazI koNAcI ziphArasa kAhIca kAmI yeNAra nAhI, tathApi jyAlA dayAvAna allAha tasA Adeza deIla, ANi tyAce mhaNaNe pasaMta karIla.
je kAhI tyAMcyA puDhe ANi mAge Ahe, te (allAhaca) jANato. tyAcyA nirmitIpaikI koNIhI tyAlA ApalyA jJAnakakSeta gheU zakata nAhI.
ANi sarvAMce cehare tyA cirasajIva ANi cirasthAyI allAhasamora moThyA namratene jhukalele asatIla. niHsaMzaya, jo ApalyA pAThIvara atyAcArAce ojhe lAvUna yeIla to asaphala Tharela.
ANi jo koNI satkarma karIla, ANi ImAnadhArakahI asela tara tyAlA nA julUma atyAcArAce bhaya rAhIla, nA hakka mAralA jANyAce.
