ANi azA prakAre AmhI tumacyAvara arabI (bhASeta) kuraAna avatarita kele Ahe ANi aneka prakAre tyAta zikSecI bhItI sAMgitalI Ahe, yAsAThI kI lokAMnI allAhace bhaya rAkhUna durAcArApAsUna alipta rAhaNAre banAve kiMvA tyAMcyA manAta vicAraciMtana nirmANa vhAve.

azA prakAre allAha sarvAMta moThA saccA ANi kharAkhurA svAmI Ahe. tumhI kuraAna paThaNa karaNyAta ghAI karU nakA, yAAdhI kI tumacyAkaDe jI vahayI (prakAzanA) kelI jAte, tI pUrNa kelI jAvI ANi ase mhaNA kI, pAlanakartyA! mAjhe jJAna ANakhI vADhava.
ANi AmhI AdamalA agodaraca tAkIdapUrNa Adeza dilA hotA, paraMtu tyAMnA tyAcA visara paDalA ANi AmhAlA tyAMcyAta koNatAhI dRDhanizcaya ADhaLalA nAhI.
ANi jevhA AmhI phariztyAMnA sAMgitale kI AdamalA sajadA karA tevhA iblisakherIja sarvAMnI sajadA kelA, tyAne sApha inkAra kelA.
tevhA AmhI sAMgitale, he Adama! hA tumacA ANi tumacyA patnIcA zatru Ahe (lakSAta ThevA) ase na vhAve kI tyAne tumhA doghAMnA jannatamadhUna bAhera ghAlavAve, jyAmuLe tumhI saMkaTAta sApaDAve.
ithe tara tumhAlA hI savalata Ahe kI nA tumhI upAzI rAhatA, nA nagna.
ANi ithe nA tumhI tahAnalele rAhatA, nA unhAne trasta rAhatA.
paraMtu saitAnAne AdamacyA manAta kuvicAra TAkalA, mhaNAlA, he Adama! kAya mI tumhAlA cirasthAyI jIvanAcA vRkSa ANi tyA rAjyasattecI khabara deU jI kadhIhI junI na vhAvI.
yAstava tyA doghAMnI tyA jhADAtUna kAhI khAlle, maga tyAMcI guptAMge ughaDI jhAlIta ANi te jannatacI pAne ApalyA aMgAvara cikaTavU lAgale. Adamane ApalyA pAlanakartyAcI avajJA kelI ANi bahakale.
maga tyAMcyA pAlanakartyAne tyAMnA upakRta kele, AdamacI taubA kabUla kelI ANi tyAMce mArgadarzana kele.

(allAhane) pharmAvile, tumhI doghehI ithUna khAlI utarA. tumhI ApasAta ekamekAMce zatrU AhAta. AtA tumacyAjavaLa jevhA kadhIhI mAjhyAkaDUna mArgadarzana pohacela, tara jo koNI mAjhyA mArgadarzanAce pAlana karIla tara to na bahakela, nA kaSTa- yAtanAgrasta hoIla.
ANi jo koNI mAjhyA smaraNApAsUna toMDa phiravila, tyAce jIvana taMgI- aDacaNIce rAhIla ANi kayAmatacyA divazI AmhI tyAlA AMdhaLA karUna uThavU.
(to) mhaNela, he pAlanakartyA! malA tU AMdhaLA banavUna kA uThavile? vAstavika mI cAMgale baghU zakata hoto.
uttara miLela, aseca vhAyalA pAhije hote. tU mAjhyA (tarphe) AlelyA AyAtIMcA visara pADalA, tad‌vataca Aja tujhAhI visara pADalA jAta Ahe.

ANi AmhI asAca mobadalA pratyeka mANasAlA deta asato, jo maryAdece ullaMghana karIla ANi ApalyA pAlanakartyAcyA AyatIMvara ImAna na rAkhela ANi niHsaMzaya Akhirata (maraNottara jIvanA) cA az2Aba moThA sakta ANi cirasthAyI Ahe.

kAya tyAMnA yA goSTInehI mArgadarzana kele nAhI kI AmhI tyAMcyApUrvI aneka vastyA naSTa karUna TAkalyA Aheta. jyA rAhaNAr2yAMcyA jAgevara heca cAlata phirata Ahe niHsaMzaya akkalavAna lokAMsAThI yAta aneka nizANyA Aheta.
ANi tumacyA pAlanakartyAcA phaisalA pAhilyApAsUna nirdhArita ANi kALa TharavilA gelelA nasatA tara yAca kSaNI vinAza yeUna bilagalA asatA.

tevhA tyAMcyA bolaNyAvara dhIra- saMyama rAkhA ANi ApalyA pAlanakartyAcI pavitratA ANi mahAnatA varNana karIta rAhA, sUryodayApUrvI ANi sUryAstApUrvI ANi rAtrIcyA vegavegaLyA hizzyAMmadhyehI ANi divasAcyA hizzyAMmadhyehI allAhace guNagAna karIta rAhA. (azAne) phAra zakya Ahe kI tumhI AnaMdita vhAla.

ANi ApalI najara kadhIhI tyA vastUMvara TAkU nayA, jyA AmhI tyAMcyApaikI aneka lokAMnA aihika zobhA- sajAvaTIsAThI deUna ThevalyA Aheta, yAsAThI kI yAdvaAre tyAMcI kasoTI ghyAvI. tumacyA pAlanakartyAne pradAna keleleca (phAra) uttama ANi bAkI rAhaNAre Ahe.

ANi ApalyA kuTuMbIyAMnA namAjacA Adeza dyA ANi svataHhI tyAvara dRDhatApUrvaka rAhA. AmhI tumacyAkaDUna rojI (AjivikA) mAgata nAhI, ulaTa AmhI svataH tumhAlA rojI deto, zevaTI cAMgalI pariNatI neka va sadAcArI lokAMcIca hote.
ANi (te) mhaNAle kI yA (paigaMbarAM) ne AmacyAsAThI ApalyA pAlanakartyAtarphe ekhAdI nizANI kA nAhI ANalI? kAya tyAMcyAjavaLa pUrvIcyA graMthAMcyA spaSTa nizANyA pohacalyA nAhIta?

ANi jara AmhI yAcyA AdhIca tyAMnA az2AbadvAre naSTa karUna TAkale asate, tara khAtrIne ase mhaNAle asate kI he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! tU AmacyAjavaLa ApalA rasUla (IzadUta) kA nAhI pAThavilA kI AmhI tujhyA AyatIMce pAlana kele asate, yApUrvI kI AmhI apamAnita jhAlo asato ANi dhiHkkArale gele asato.
tyAMnA sAMgA, pratyekajaNa pariNAmAcyA pratikSeta Ahe, tevhA tumhI suddhA pratikSeta rAhA. lavakaraca pUrNataH jANUna ghyAla kI saraLa mArgAvara asalele koNa Aheta ANi mArga prApta kelele koNa Aheta?
lokAMcyA hizobAcI veLa javaLa yeUna pohocalI Ahe. tarIhI te gaphalatI (cyA avasthe) ta toMDa phiravUna Aheta.
tyAMcyAjavaLa, tyAMcyA pAlanakartyAtarphe jyA dekhIla navanavIna zikavaNI yetAta, tyAMnA te kheLaNyA bAgaDaNyAtaca aikatAta.
tyAMcI mane pUrNataH gAphIla Aheta ANi tyA atyAcArIMnI haLU haLU kAnagoSTI kelyAta kI to tumacyAsArakhAca manuSya Ahe, maga tumhI DoLyAMdekhata jAdUlA baLI paDaNyAce kAraNa kAya?
(paigaMbara) mhaNAle, mAjhA pAlanakartA AkAzAta va dharatIta asalelyA pratyeka goSTIsa cAMgalyA prakAre jANato. to khUpa khUpa aikaNArA ANi jANaNArA Ahe.

(evaDheca navhe tara) he asehI mhaNatAta kI hA kuraAna goMdhaLapUrNa svapnAMcA saMgraha Ahe, kiMbahunA tyAne svataHca racUna ghetalA Ahe, kiMbahunA to kavI Ahe anyathA tyAne AmacyAsamora ekhAdI azI nizANI ANalI asatI, jase pUrvIcyA kALAtIla paigaMbara pAThavile gele hote.
yAMcyApUrvI jevaDhyA vastyA AmhI naSTa kelyA, tyA ImAnadhAraka navhatyA, tevhA AtA kAya he ImAna rAkhatIla?

tumacyApUrvI jevaDhe dekhIla paigaMbara AmhI pAThavile, te sarva mAnava hote, jyAMcyAkaDe AmhI vahayI (prakAzanA) avatarita karIta asU tevhA tumhI jJAnI lokAMnA vicArA, jara svataH tumhAlA jJAna nasela.
ANi AmhI tyAMnA ase zarIra dile navhate kI bhojana karIta nasAveta ANi nA te sadaiva jivaMta rAhaNAre hote.
maga AmhI tyAMcyAzI kelele sarva vAyade khare karUna dAkhavile, tyAMnA ANi jyAMnA jyAMnA AmhI icchile muktI dilI ANi maryAdece ullaMghana karaNAr2yAMnA naSTa karUna TAkale.
niHsaMzaya, AmhI tumacyAkaDe graMtha avatarita kelA Ahe, jyAta tumacyAsAThI bodha- upadeza Ahe. maga kAya tarIhI tumhI akalecA vApara karIta nAhI?
ANi aneka atyAcArI vastIMnA AmhI naSTa karUna TAkale, maga tyAMcyAnaMtara AmhI dusarA janasamUha nirmANa kelA.
jevhA tyA lokAMnI AmacyA zikSA- yAtanecI jANIva karUna ghetalI tevhA tyAcyA prakopApAsUna dUra paLU lAgale.
dhAvapaLa karU nakA ANi jithe tumhAlA sukha pradAna kele gele hote, titheca parata jA ANi ApalyA gharAMkaDe jA, yAsAThI kI tumhAlA vicAraNA kelI jAvI.
te mhaNAle, Amace vAITa hovo, niHsaMzaya AmhI atyAcArI hoto.
maga tara te aseca mhaNata rAhile, yethaparyaMta kI AmhI tyAMnA muLAsakaTa kApalelyA zetIsArakhe ANi vijhalelyA AgIsArakhe karUna TAkale.
AmhI AkAza va dharatI ANi tyAMcyA daramyAnacyA vastUMnA kheLa- tamAzAkaritA banavile nAhI.
jara AmhI azAca prakAre kheLa- tamAzA icchilA asatA tara to ApalyA javaLUnaca banavilA asatA, jara AmhI ase karaNAre asato.
kiMbahunA AmhI satyAlA asatyAvara phekUna mArato tevhA satya asatyAcA ziraccheda karate ANi te tyAca kSaNI nAza pAvate. tumhI jyA goSTI racatA, tyA tumacyAsAThI vinAzakAraka Aheta.
ANi AkAzAMmadhye ANi dharatIta je kAhI Ahe, tyA (allAha) ceca Ahe ANi je tyAcyA nikaTa Aheta te tyAcyA upAsanepAsUna nA vidroha karatAta ANi nA thakatAta.
te divasa-rAtra tyAcyA pAvitryAce varNana karatAta ANi kiMcitahI sustI karata nAhIta.
tyA lokAMnI dharatIcyA (sRSTa nirmitI) madhUna jyAMnA upAsya banavUna Thevale Ahe, kAya te jivaMta karatAta?

jara AkAzAta ANi dharatIta allAhakherIja dusarIhI upAsye asatI tara yA doghAMcI ulaTApAlaTa jhAlI asatI. tevhA allAha arza (IsiMhAsanA) cA svAmI, tyA guNavaiziTyAMpAsUna pavitra Ahe jyA he mUrtIpUjaka bolatAta.
ApalyA kAmAMkaritA to (koNAsamora) uttarayAyI nAhI, mAtra sarvAMnA (tyAcyAsamora) jAba dyAvA lAgaNAra Ahe.

kAya tyA lokAMnI allAhakherIja dusarI upAsye banavUna ghetalI Aheta, tyAMnA sAMgA, ANA, ApalA purAvA sAdara karA. hA Ahe mAjhyAsobata asalelyAMcA graMtha ANi mAjhyApUrvIcyA lokAMcA purAvA! paraMtu tyAMcyApaikI bahuteka loka satyApAsUna anabhijJa Aheta, yAca kAraNAstava toMDa phiravUna Aheta.
ANi AmhI tumacyApUrvI jo dekhIla paigaMbara pAThavilA, tyAcyAkaDe hIca vahayI (IzavANI) avatarita kelI kI mAjhyAkherIja koNIhI kharAkhurA upAsya nAhI, tevhA tumhI sarva mAjhIca upAsanA karA.
ANi anekezvaravAdI mhaNatAta, rahamAna (dayAvaMta allAha) lA saMtatI Ahe. (muLIca nAhI.) to pavitra Ahe. kiMbahunA te (jyAMnA he tyAce putra samajatAta) tyAce pratiSThita dAsa Aheta.
tyAcyA (allAhacyA) samora puDhe hoUna bolaNyAce sAhasa karIta nAhI ANi tyAcyA AdezAce pAlana karatAta.
to (allAha) tyAMcyApUrvIcyA ANi naMtaracyA sarva avasthA jANUna Ahe. ANi te koNAcIhI ziphArasa karIta nAhI, tyAcyAkherIja, jyAcyAzI to (allahA) prasanna asela, te tara svataH bhayakaMpita rAhatAta.
ANi tyAMcyApaikI koNI jara sAMgela kI allAhakherIja mI ilAha (pUjanIya) Ahe tara AmhI tyAlA jahannamacI zikSA deU. julamI va atyAcArIMnA AmhI azAca prakAre zikSA deto.

kAya inkAra karaNAr2yAMnI he nAhI pAhile kI (he) AkAza va dhartAI (sarva) ApasAta juLalele hote, maga AmhI tyAMnA vegaLe vegaLe kele ANi pratyeka sajIvAlA AmhI pANyApAsUna nirmANa kele, maga kAya he loka tarIhI vizvAsa karata nAhIta?
ANi AmhI jaminIvara parvata racale, yAsAThI kI tine IzanirmitIlA halavU na zakAve ANi AmhI ticyAta tyAMcyA daramyAna ruMda raste banavile, yAsAThI kI lokAMnA mArga lAbhU zakAvA.
ANi AkAzAlA AmhI eka surakSita chata banavile Ahe. paraMtu he loka tyAcyA nizANyAMvara lakSa deta nAhI.
ANi toca (allAha) Ahe, jyAne rAtra va divasAlA ANi sUrya va caMdrAlA banavile. tyAMcyApaikI pratyeka ApApalyA kakSeta taraMgata Ahe.
ANi tumacyApUrvI AmhI koNatyAhI mANasAlA cirasajIvatA dilI nAhI, maga kAya, jara tumhI maraNa pAvalA tara he sadaiva kALa ithe rAhatIla?
pratyeka jIvAlA mRtyucA svAda cAkhAyacA Ahe ANi AmhI kasoTI gheNyAkaritA tumhAlA cAMgalyA- vAITa avastheta TAkato ANi tumhI sarvacyA sarva AmacyAcakaDe paratUna yAla.

ANi jyA lokAMnI kupra (avizvAsa) kelA, te jevhA tumhAlA pAhatAta tevhA tumacI thaTTA uDavitAta (sAMgatAta) kI, hAca kAya to, jo tumacyA daivatAMcI carcA vAITarityA karato? mAtra te svataHca rahamAna (dayAvAna allAha) cA ullekha (mahimAgAna) karaNyAsa inkAra karatAta.
mAnava janmajAta utAvaLA Ahe. mI tumhAlA ApalyA nizANyA (cinhe) lavakaraca dAkhavina. tumhI mAjhyAzI ghAI karU nakA.
ANi mhaNatAta kI jara khare asAla tara sAMgA kI to vAyadA (zikSA-yAtanecA) kevhA pUrNa hoIla?
jara yA kAphIra lokAMnA jANIva asatI kI tyA veLI nA tara he AgIlA ApalyA cehar2yAMvarUna haTavU zakatIla ANi nA ApalyA pAThIvarUna ANi nA yAMcI madata kelI jAIla.
hoya! vAyadyAcI veLa (kayAmatacA divasa) tyAMcyAjavaLa acAnaka yeUna pohocela ANi tyAMnA Azcaryacakita karUna soDela, maga nA tara he tI veLa TALU zakatIla ANi nA tyAMnA kiMcitahI savaDa dilI jAIla.
ANi tumacyA pUrvIcyA paigaMbarAMcIhI thaTTA uDavilI gelI tara jyAMnI thaTTA uDavalI, tyAMnA tyAca goSTIne yeUna gherale, jicI te thaTTA uDavita hote.
tyAMnA vicArA kI rahamAna (dayALU allAha) pAsUna rAtraMdivasa tumace rakSaNa koNa karU zakato? kiMbahunA he ApalyA pAlanakartyAce smaraNa (mahimAgAna) karaNyApAsUna parAvRtta jhAle Aheta.
kAya AmacyAkherIja tyAMcA dusarA koNI upAsya Ahe, jo tyAMnA saMkaTApAsUna vAcavita asela. koNIhI svataH ApalI madata karaNyAce sAmarthya bALagata nAhI ANi nA koNI AmacyA virodhAta sAtha deU zakato.

kiMbahunA AmhI yAMnA ANi yAMcyA bujUrga lokAMnA jIvanasAmugrI pradAna kelI, yetheparyaMta kI tyAMcyA AyuSyAcI hadda saMpalI. kAya te nAhI pAhAta kI AmhI jaminIlA ticyA kinAr2yAkaDUna ghaTavita cAlata Alo Ahota? tara AtA kAya teca varcasvazAlI Aheta?
sAMgA, mI tara kevaLa tumhAlA allAhacyA vahayI (IzavANI) dvAre saceta karato, paraMtu badhIra mANase hAka aikata nAhIta, jevhA tyAMnA sAvadha kele jAta asela.
ANi jara tyAMnA tumacyA pAlanakartyAcyA zikSA- yAtanecI nusatI vApha jarI lAgalI tara ud‌gAratIla, arere! AmacA vinAza! niHsaMzaya AmhI atyAcArI hoto.

ANi AmhI kayAmatacyA divazI tyAMcyA daramyAna yathAyogya vajana karaNArA tarAjU ANUna ThevU, maga koNAvara kazAhI prakAracA julUma kelA jANAra nAhI ANi jara eka rAIcyA dANyAitakehI karma asela tara tehI AmhI samora ANU, ANi AmhI hizoba gheNyAsAThI purese Ahota.
ANi he pUrNataH satya Ahe kI AmhI mUsA ANi hArUna yAMnA nirNaya karaNArA divya ANi neka sadAcArI lokAMkaritA bodha-upadezapUrNa graMtha pradAna kelA Ahe.
te loka, je na pAhatA ApalyA pAlanakartyAce bhaya bALagatAta ANi je kayAmata (cyA vicArA) ne bhayakaMpita rAhatAta.
ANi hA bodha- upadeza ANi barakatapUrNa kuraAna AmhIca avatarita kelA Ahe. maga kAya tarIhI tumhI yAcA inkAra karatA़?
ANi niHsaMzaya, AmhI yAcyApUrvI ibrAhImalA sAmaMjasya pradAna kele hote, ANi tyAcyA avasthezI cAMgalyA prakAre paricita hoto.
jevhA te ApalyA pityAsa ANi ApalyA jamAtIcyA lokAMnA mhaNAle kI yA mUrtyA, jyAMce tumhI pujArI banUna basalA AhAta, he kAya Ahe?
te mhaNAle, AmhAlA Amace vADavaDIla yAMcIca upAsanA karatAnA ADhaLale Aheta.
ibrAhIma mhaNAle, maga tara tumhI ANi tumace vADavaDIla ughaDa azA mArgabhraSTateta hote.
loka mhaNAle, kAya tumhI kharokhara satya gheUna AlA AhAta kI ugAca thaTTA-maskarI karata AhAta?

ibrAhIma mhaNAle, (navhe) kiMbahunA, kharokhara tumacA svAmI va pAlanakartA AkAzAMcA ANi jaminIcA svAmI va pAlanakartA Ahe, jyAne tyAM nA nirmANa kele Ahe ANi mI tara yAca goSTIcA sAkSI (ANi mAnaNArA) Ahe.
ANi allAhacI zapatha, mI tumacyA yA upAsyAMcA ilAja jarUra karena jevhA tumhI pATha phiravUna cAlate vhAla.
tevhA tyAMnI tyA sarvAMce tukaDe tukaDe karUna TAkale, kevaLa moThyA mUrtIlA soDUna dile, tehI azAsAThI kI, tyA lokAMnI tyAcyAkaDe vaLAve.
te mhaNAle kI AmacyA daivatAMcI hI durdazA koNI kelI, asA manuSya khAtrIne atyAcArI asela.
mhaNAle kI AmhI ekA taruNAlA yAMcyAviSayI bolatAnA aikale hote jyAlA ibrAhIma mhaTale jAte.
te mhaNAle, tara tyAlA sarvAMcyA DoLyAMsamora gheUna yA, yAsAThI kI sarvAMnI tyAlA pAhUna ghyAve.
mhaNU lAgale, he ibrAhIma! kAya tUca AmacyA daivatAMcI hI durdazA kelI Ahesa?
ibrAhIma yAMnI uttara dile, kiMbahunA he kAma tara tyAMcyAtalyA moThyA daivatAne kele Ahe. tumhI ApalyA daivatAMnAca vicArA, jara te bolata asatIla.
yAstava tyAMnI ApalyA manAta mAnya kele ANi (manAtalyA manAta) mhaNAle, kharokhara, tumhI svataH atyAcArI AhAta.
maga mAnA khAlI ghAlUna (kAhI vicAra karUna jarI tyAMnI mAnya kele hote, tarIhI mhaNAle) tumhI cAMgale jANatA kI he bolata nAhIta.
(ibrAhIma) tyAca kSaNI mhaNAle, arere! kAya tumhI azAMcI upAsanA karatA, je tumhAlA nA kAhI lAbha pohacavU zakatAta ANi nA hAnI!
dhiHkkAra aso tumacA ANi tyAMcA, jyAMcI tumhI allAhakherIja upAsanA karatA, kAya tumhAlA evaDhI suddhA akkala nAhI?
te mhaNAle, jara tumhAlA kAhI karAyaceca Ahe tara yAlA jALUna TAkA ANi ApalyA upAsyAMcI madata karA.
AmhI pharmAvile, he agnI! tU ibrAhImakaritA salAmatIpUrvaka thaMDa ho.
tyA lokAMnI ibrAhImace vAITa icchile asale tarI AmhI tyAMnAca asaphala kele.
ANi AmhI (ibrAhIma) ANi lUtalA vAcavUna tyA bhUbhAgAkaDe nele, jyAta AmhI sAr2yA jagAkaritA sukha-samRddhI ThevalI hotI.
ANi AmhI tyAMnA isahAka pradAna kelA ANi tyAvara ANakhI yAkUba ANi pratyekAlA neka sadAcArI banavile.

ANi AmhI tyAMnA imAma (pezavA) banavile, yAsAThI kI AmacyA hukumAnusAra lokAMnA mArgadarzana karAve ANi AmhI tyAMcyAkaDe satkarma karaNyAcI, namAja kAyama karaNyAcI ANi jakAta adA karaNyAcI vahayI (prakAzanA) kelI ANi te sarvacyA sarva Amace upAsaka hote.
ANi AmhI lUtalAhI hikamata ANi jJAna pradAna kele ANi tyAMcI tyA vastIpAsUna suTakA kelI, jithale loka ghANeraDyA kAmAMmadhye lipta hote ANi vastutaH te moThe vAITa aparAdhI loka hote.
ANi AmhI tyAMnA (lUtalA) ApalyA dayA-kRpeta sAmIla karUna ghetale. niHsaMzaya te neka- sadAcArI lokAMpaikI hote.
ANi nUhacA to kALa (AThavA) jevhA tyAMnI yApUrvI duA (vinaMtI) kelI. AmhI tyAMcI duA kabUla kelI ANi AmhI tyAMnA ANi tyAMcyA kuTuMbAlA phAra moThyA duHkhAtUna soDavile.
ANi tyA janasamUhAcyA virodhAta tyAMcI madata kelI, jyAne AmacyA AyatIMnA khoTe Tharavile hote. vAstavika te phAra vAITa loka hote, tevhA AmhI tyA sarvAMnA buDavUna TAkale.
ANi dAUda ANi sulemAna yAMcehI (smaraNa karA) jevhA te zetAbAbata nirNaya karIta hote kI kAhI lokAMcyA zeLyA tyA zetAta ghusUna caralyA ANi tyAMcyA nirNayAta AmhI hajara hoto.

tevhA AmhI tyAcA yathArtha phaisalA sulemAnalA samajAvUna dilA. niHsaMzaya AmhI pratyekAlA hikamata ANi jJAna pradAna kele hote ANi parvatAMnA dAUdacyA adhIna kele hote je allAhacI tasbIha (mahimAgAna) karIta asata, ANi pakSyAMnAhI aseca AmhI karaNAre hoto.
ANi AmhI dAUdalA tumacyAsAThI yuddhAcA poSAkha (cilakhata) banaviNe zikavile, yAsAThI kI yuddhA (cyA hAnI) pAsUna tumace rakSaNa karU zakAve, maga kAya tumhI AtA kRtajJazIla vhAla?
ANi AmhI vegavAna havelA sulemAnacyA adhIna kele, jI tyAMcyA AdezAnusAra azA jaminIkaDe vAhata ase, jicyAta AmhI samRddhI (barakata) rAkhalI hotI, ANi AmhI pratyeka goSTIlA jANato.

ANi (azAca prakAre) aneka saitAnAMnA dekhIla (tyAMce tAbedAra banavile hote) je sulemAnacyA hukumAnusAra (samudrAta) buDI gheta asata ANi yAzivAya itara aneka kAme karIta asata ANi tyAMce rakSaNakartA AmhIca hoto.
ANi ayyUba (cyA tyA avasthecI AThavaNa karA) jevhA tyAMnI ApalyA pAlanakartyAlA pukArale kI malA hA roga lAgalA Ahe ANi tU sarva dayA karaNAr2yAMpekSA jAsta dayA karaNArA Ahesa.

tevhA AmhI tyAMcI (prArthanA) aikalI ANi je duHkha tyAMnA hote te dUra kele ANi tyAMnA tyAMce kuTuMba pradAna kele, kiMbahunA, tyAMnA ApalyA khAsa dayA kRpene tyAsobata taseca ANakhIhI dile, yAsAThI kI upAsanA karaNAr2yAMkaritA upadezakAraka TharAve.
ANi ismAIla ANi idarIsa ANi julakiphla he sarva dhIra-saMyama rAkhaNAre hote.
AmhI tyAMnA ApalyA dayA-kRpeta dAkhala karUna ghetale, te sarva neka- sadAcArI loka hote.

ANi mAsaLIvAlyA (yUnusa alai.) cI (AThavaNa karA) jevhA te nArAja hoUna nighUna gele ANi ase samajata hote kI AmhI tyAMnA dharaNAra nAhI. zevaTI tyAMnI tyA aMdhArAMmadhUna pukArale, he upAsanIya (allAha)! tujhyAkherIja koNIhI upAsya nAhI. tU pavitra Ahesa. nizcitaca mI atyAcArI lokAMpaikI Ahe.
tevhA AmhI tyAMcI pukAra (vinaMtI) mAnya kelI ANi tyAMnA duHkhAtUna mukta kele ANi AmhI azA prakAre ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMnA vAcavito.
ANi jakariyAce (smaraNa karA) jevhA tyAMnI ApalyA pAlanakartyAjavaLa duA (prArthanA) kelI kI he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! malA tU ekaTA soDU nako. tU sarvAMta uttama vArasa Ahesa.

tevhA AmhI tyAMcI duA (prArthanA) svIkAralI ANi tyAMnA yahayA (nAvAcA putra) pradAna kelA, ANi tyAMcyA patnIlA tyAMcyAsAThI yathAyogya banavile. he neka- sadAcArI loka satkarmAMkaDe lavakara dhAva gheta, ANi AmhAlA moThyA AvaDIne bhaya rAkhUna pukArata asata, ANi AmacyA samora moThyA namratene rAhAta asata.
ANi tI (satzIla strI) jine ApalyA zIla-abruce rakSaNa kele, AmhI ticyAta ApalA AtmA phuMkalA ANi svataH tilA ANi ticyA putrAlA sAr2yA jagAkaritA nizANI (cinha) banavile.
hA tumacA samUha Ahe, jo vAstavika ekaca samUha Ahe ANi mI tumhA sarvAMcA pAlanakartA Ahe, yAstava tumhI sarva mAjhIca upAsanA karA.
paraMtu lokAMnI ApasAta ApalyA dIna (dharmA) madhye gaTa banavUna ghetale (tathApi) sarvAMnA AmacyAkaDe paratUna yAyace Ahe.
maga jo koNI satkarma karela ANi to ImAnadhArakahI asela tara tyAcyA prayatnAMcI kAhIca upekSA hoNAra nAhI. AmhI tara tyAce lihiNAre Ahota.
ANi jyA vastIlA AmhI naSTa karUna TAkale, ticyAkaritA anivArya Ahe kI tithale loka paratUna yeNAra nAhIta.
yetheparyaMta kI yAjUja ANi mAjUja baMdhanamukta kele jAtIla ANi te pratyeka utArAkaDUna dhAvata yetIla.
ANi saccA vAyadA javaLa yeUna Thepela, tyA veLI kAphira lokAMce DoLe visphAraleleca rAhatIla kI arere! AmhI yA avasthepAsUna gAphIla hoto, kiMbahunA khare pAhatA AmhI atyAcArI hoto.
tumhI ANi te, jyAMcI allAhakherIja tumhI upAsanA karatA, sarva jahannamace iMdhana banAla, tumhI sarva tyA (jahannama) madhye jANAra AhAta.
jara te (sacce) upAsya asate tara jahannamamadhye dAkhala jhAle nasate, ANi sarvacyA sarva tyAtaca nehamI rAhaNAra Aheta.
te tyA ThikANI moThamoThyAne oraData asatIla ANi tithe kAhIca aikU zakaNAra nAhIta.
paraMtu jyAMcyAsAThI AmacyAtarphe pahilyApAsUnaca satkarma nizcita Ahe, te sarva jahannamapAsUna dUraca Thevale jAtIla.
te tara, jahannamacI cAhUlahI aikU zakaNAra nAhIta ANi ApalyA manovAMchita vastUMsaha sadaiva rAhaNAre asatIla.
tI bhayaMkara dahazatahI tyAMnA udAsa karU zakaNAra nAhI ANi pharizte tyAMce utsphUrtapaNe svAgata karatIla kI hAca tumacA to divasa Ahe, jyAcA tumhAlA vAyadA dilA jAta rAhilA.

jyA divazI AmhI AkAzAlA azA prakAre guMDALUna TAkU, jyA prakAre rolace kAgada (patrikA) guMDALale jAtAta. jyA prakAre pahilyA khepesa AmhI nirmANa kele hote, tyAca prakAre dusar2yAMdA nirmANa karU. hA AmacA majabUta vAyadA Ahe ANi he AmhI nizcitaca karU.
ANi AmhI jabUra (graMthA) madhye sAvadhagirIcA izArA ANi bodha- upadezAnaMtara he lihile Ahe kI dharatIce vArasa mAjhe neka-sadAcArI dAsa asatIla.
upAsanA karaNAr2yA dAsAMkaritA tara yAta eka moThI khabara Ahe.
ANi AmhI tumhAlA samasta vizvAkaritA dayA-kRpA banavUna pAThavile Ahe.
sAMgA kI mAjhyAkaDe tara vahayI (IzavANI) kelI jAte kI tumhA sarvAMcA upAsya (allAha) ekaca Ahe. tara kAya tumhIhI tyAce mAnaNAre AhAta?
maga jara to toMDa phiravila tara sAMgA kI mI tumhAlA samAnarityA saceta kele Ahe. ANi malA nAhI mAhIta kI, jyA goSTIcA vAyadA tumacyAzI kelA jAta Ahe, tI javaLa Ahe kI lAMba Ahe.
niHsaMzaya (allAha) tumacyA ughaDa goSTIMnAhI jANato, taseca je kAhI tumhI lapavitA te dekhIla jANato.
ANi malA yAcehI jJAna nAhI. saMbhavataH hI tumacI kasoTI asela ANi ekA nirdhArita avadhIparyaMtacA lAbha asela.
(paigaMbara) svataH mhaNAle, he pAlanakartyA! nyAyapUrvaka phaisalA kara ANi AmacA pAlanakartA aMtizaya dayA karaNArA Ahe, jyAcyAkaDUna madata mAgitalI jAte tyA goSTIbaddala, jyA tumhI sAMgata AhAta.
loka ho! ApalyA pAlanakartyAce bhaya rAkhA, niHsaMzaya kayAmatacA bhUkaMpa phAra jabaradasta goSTa Ahe.

jyA divazI tumhI to pAhAla, pratyeka dUdha pAjaNArI mAtA ApalyA dUdha piNAr2yA bALAlA visarela ANi sarva garbhavatI striyAMcA garbhapAta hoIla, ANi tumhI pAhAla kI loka madahoza disUna yetIla, vAstavika madahoza nasatIla, paraMtu allAhacA az2Aba (zikSA- yAtanA) moThA kaThora Ahe.
ANi kAhI loka allAhaviSayI ajJAnapUrNa goSTI bolatAta, ANi pratyeka udaMDa saitAnAce anusaraNa karatAta.
jyAcyAbaddala allAhacA phaisalA lihilA gelA Ahe kI jo koNI tyAcyAzI dostI karela, to tyAlA mArgabhraSTa karela ANi tyAlA AgIcyA zikSA-yAtanekaDe neIla.

lokAMno! jara tumhAlA melyAnaMtara (punhA) jivaMta hoNyAbAbata zaMkA Ahe, tara vicAra karA, AmhI tumhAlA mAtIpAsUna nirmANa kele, maga vIryApAsUna, maga jamalelyA raktApAsUna, ANi mAMsAcyA tukaDyApAsUna je rUpa dile gele hote ANi vinArUpahI hote. he AmhI tumacyAvara spaSTa karato ANi AmhI jyAlA icchito ekA nirdhArita avadhIparyaMta mAtecyA udarAta Thevato, maga tumhAlA bALAcyA rUpAne yA jagAta ANato maga yAsAThI kI tumhI ApalyA pUrNa taruNapaNAsa pohacAve, tumacyApaikI kAhI ase Aheta je maraNa pAvatAta ANi kAhI jIrNa vayAkaDe punhA paratavile jAtAta kI te ekA goSTIzI paricita jhAlyAnaMtara dusar2yAMdA anabhijJa vhAveta. tumhI pAhatA kI jamIna nApIka ANi koraDI Ahe, maga jevhA AmhI ticyAvara pAUsa pADato tevhA tI cetanAmaya hote ANi phugate ANi pratyeka prakAracI suMdara vanaspatI ugavite.
he azAsAThI kI allAhaca satya Ahe ANi toca melelyAMnA jivaMta karato ANi to pratyeka goSTIce sAmarthya bALagato.
ANi he kI kayAmata nizcitaca yeNAra Ahe, jyAbAbata kasalIhI zaMkA nAhI ANi agadI khAtrIne allAha kabarIta asalelyAMnA dusar2yAMdA jivaMta karela.
ANi kAhI loka allAhaviSayI jJAnAvinA, ANi mArgadarzanAvinA ANi koNatyAhI divya graMthAvinA vAda ghAlatAta.

ApalA pailU vaLavUna gheNArA banUna (tATharapaNe) yAsAThI kI allAhacyA mArgApAsUna bhraSTa karAve to yA jagAtahI apamAnita hoIla, ANi kayAmatacyA divazIhI AmhI tyAlA jahannamacyA AgIta jaLaNyAcI zikSA - yAtanA cAkhavU.
he tyA karmAMpAyI, jI tujhyA hAtAMnI puDhe pAThavilI hotI, mAtra vizvAsa rAkhA kI allAha ApalyA dAsAMvara atyAcAra karaNArA nAhI.

ANi kAhI loka asehI Aheta, je ekA kinAr2yAlA rAhUna allAhacI upAsanA karatAta, jara kAhI lAbha jhAlA tara samAdhAnI hotAta, ANi jara ekhAde duHkha vATyAlA Ale tara tyAca kSaNI mAghArI phiratAta. tyAMnI ihaloka ANi paraloka doghAMce nukasAna ucalale. vastutaH heca ughaDa nukasAna Ahe.
te allAhakherIja tyAMnA pukAratAta je nA nukasAna pohacavU zakatAta nA phAyadA. hIca tI dUracI mArgabhraSTatA Ahe.
azAlA pukAratAta jyAMce nukasAna, lAbhApekSA adhika javaLa Ahe niHsaMzaya moThe vAITa saMrakSaka Aheta ANi vAITa dosta.
niHsaMzaya, ImAna (rAkhUna) satkarma karaNAr2yAMnA allAha, azA jannatamadhye dAkhala karIla jicyA khAlI pravAha vAhata asatIla. allAha je icchito te nizcita karato.

jyAlA he vATata asela kI allAha ApalyA paigaMbarAMcI madata donhI lokAta (ihaloka ANi paraloka) karaNAra nAhI, tara tyAne uMca jAgI eka dora bAMdhUna (ApalyA gaLyAta phAsa TAkUna ghyAvA) ANi gaLA ghoTUna ghyAvA, maga pAhAve kI tyAcyA caturAIne tI goSTa dUra hote jI tyAlA kAsAvisa karIta Ahe.
ANi AmhI azaAca prakAre yA kuraAnAlA spaSTa AyatIMmadhye avatarita kele Ahe ANi allAha jyAlA icchito, mArgadarzana karato.
ImAna rAkhaNAre, ANi yahUdI (jyU) ANi vidharmI ANi khrizcana ANi agnIpUjaka ANi anekezvaravAdI yA sarvAMcyA daramyAna allAha svataH nirNaya karIla. allAha pratyeka goSTIsa sAkSI Ahe.

kAya tumhI nAhI pAhAta kI allAhacyA samoraca sajadA karatAta je AkAzAta Aheta ANi jaminIvara Aheta. tyAcapramANe sUrya, caMdra, tAre, parvata, vRkSa, pazU ANi sajIva ANi aneka mAnava dekhIla. hoya bahuteka asehI Aheta, jyAMnA (allAhacI) zikSA- yAtanA lAgU jhAlI Ahe ANi jyAlA allAha apamAnita karela, tyAlA mAna-pratiSThA deNArA koNI nAhI, allAha je icchito te karato.
he donhI ApalyA pAlanakartyAviSayI matabheda rAkhaNAre Aheta, tevhA inkArI lokAMkaritA AgIce kapaDe, mApa gheUna kApale jAtIla, ANi tyAMcyA DokyAMvara ukaLatyA pANyAcI dhAra soDalI jAIla.
jyAdvAre tyAcyA poTAtIla sarva vastU ANi cAmaDI vagaire gaLUna paDela.
ANi tyAMnA zikSA- yAtanA deNyAsAThI lokhaMDI hAtoDe Aheta.
he jevhA jevhA tithalyA duHkha-yAtanepAsUna paLa kADhaNyAcA irAdA karatIla, tithe (punhA) paratavile jAtIla ANi (tyAMnA sAMgitale jAIla) jaLaNyAcyA zikSecI goDI cAkhA.

niHsaMzaya, ImAna rAkhaNAr2yA ANi satkarma karaNAr2yAMnA allAha azA jannatamadhye dAkhala karIla, jyAMcyA khAlI pravAha vAhata Aheta. jithe tyAMnA sonyAcI kAMkaNe ghAtalI jAtIla ANi assala motIhI, tyA ThikANI tyAMce vastra nirbheLa rezamAce asela.
ANi tyAMnA pavitra vacanAcA mArga dAkhavilA gelA ANi prazaMsanIya (allAhace) mArgadarzana dile gele.

jyA lokAMnI kupra (inkAra) kelA, ANi allAhacyA mArgApAsUna rokhU lAgale ANi tyA AdaraNIya masjidIpAsUnahI, jilA AmhI samasta lokAMkaritA ekasamAna kele Ahe, maga tithale rahivAzI asota kiMvA bAherUna Alele asota, jo dekhIla atyAcArapUrvaka tyA ThikANI mArgabhraSTa hoNyAcA vicAra karIla, AmhI tyAlA duHkhadAyaka az2Aba (zikSA-yAtane) cI goDI cAkhavU.

ANi jevhA AmhI ibrAhImakaritA kAbAgRhAce sthAna nizcita kele (yA aTIvara) kI mAjhyAsobata dusar2yA koNAlA sAmIla karU nakA ANi mAjhyA gharAlA tavApha (pradakSiNA) karaNAr2yA, ubhe rAhaNAr2yA, rukUa ANi sajadA karaNAr2yAMkaritA svaccha- zuddha rAkhA.
ANi lokAMmadhye hajace ailAna karA, loka tumacyAjavaLa pAyI cAlatahI yetIla ANi dubaLyA roDAvalelyA uMTAvarahI dUradUracyA sarva mArgAMnI yetIla.

yAsAThI kI tyAMnI ApalA lAbha prApta karUna gheNyAsAThI yAve ANi tyA nirdhArIta divasAmadhye allAhace nAmaHsmaraNa karAve tyA cAra pAyAMcyA pALIva pazUMvara, tevhA tumhI svataH dekhIla khA ANi upAzIpoTI asalelyA garIbAMnAhI khAU ghAlA.
maga tyAMnI ApalA maLa- ghANa dUra karAvI ANi ApalA navasa pUrNa karAvA ANi allAhacyA junyA gharAlA pradakSiNA karAvI.

he Aheta (hajace dhArmika vidhI) ANi jo, allAhane nirdhArita kelelyA pratiSThApUrNa goSTIMcA Adara rAkhela tara he tyAcyA pAlanakartyAjavaLa tyAcyAkaritA uttama Ahe ANi tumacyAsAThI gure-Dhore halAla (vaidha) Tharavile gele Aheta, mAtra tyAMcyAkherIja, jyAMcA Adeza tumhAlA aikavilA gelA Ahe, yAstava mUrtIMcyA malInatepAsUna dUra rAhA, ANi khoTe bolaNyApAsUnahI alipta rAhA.

allAhacyA tauhIda (ekezvaravAdA) lA mAnya karIta, tyAcyAsobata dusar2yA kuNAlA sahabhAgI na Tharavita. (aikA) allAhacA sahabhAgI TharaviNArA jaNU AkAzAtUna khAlI kosaLalA, AtA eka tara tyAlA pakSI ucalUna netIla kiMvA havA ekhAdyA dUracyA ThikANI phekUna deIla.
(hI Ahe vastusthitI) tevhA jo koNI allAhacyA nizANyAMcA (pratIkAMcA) Adara-sanmAna rAkhela, tara tyAcyA manAtIla allAhacyA bhayAce heca kAraNa Ahe.
tyAMcyAta tumacyAsAThI ekA nirdhArita avadhIparyaMta lAbha Ahe, maga tyAMcyA kurbAnI (baLI caDhaviNyA) cI jAgA kAbAgRhAta Ahe.

ANi pratyeka janasamUhAkaritA AmhI kurbAnIcI eka paddhata nizcita kelI Ahe, yAsAThI kI tyAMnI tyA catuSpAda pazUMvara allAhace nAva ghyAve, je allAhane tyAMnA pradAna karUna Thevale Aheta. (lakSAta ghyA) tumhA sarvAMcA kharAkhurA upAsya (ArAdhya daivata) phakta ekaca Ahe, tumhI tyAcyA adhIna ANi AjJAdhAraka vhA, vinamratA aMgikAraNAr2yAMnA khUzakhabarI dyA.

tyAMcI avasthA azI Ahe kI jevhA tyAMcyA samora allAhace nAmaHsmaraNa kele jAte, tevhA tyAMcyA hRdayAcA tharakApa hoto, jevhA tyAcyAvara saMkaTa yete tevhA tyA saMkaTAta dhIra- saMyama rAkhatAta, te namAja kAyama karaNAre Aheta, ANi je kAhI AmhI tyAMnA deUna Thevale Ahe tyAtUna deta hI rAhatAta.

kurbAnIcyA uMTAlA AmhI tumacyAsAThI allAhacyA nizANyAMpaikI Tharavile Ahe. tyAMcyAta tumacyAsAThI lAbha Ahe, tevhA tyAMnA ubhe karUna tyAMcyAvara allAhace nAva ghyA, maga jevhA tyAMce aMga jaminIlA lAgela tevhA te tumhIhI khA ANi goragarIba va yAcakAMnA ANi jo yAcaka nasela tyAlAhI khAU ghAlA. azA prakAre AmhI catuSpAda (pALIva) pazUMnA tumacyA adhIna kele Ahe, yAsAThI kI tumhI kRtajJatA vyakta karAvI.

allAhalA kurbAnIcyA janAvarAMce nA mAMsa pohacate nA tyAMce rakta kiMbahunA tyAlA tumacyA manAta asalele allAhace bhaya pohocate, tyAcapramANe allAhane tyA janAvarAMnA tumace AjJAdhAraka (tAbedAra) banavile Ahe, yAsAThI kI tumhI tyAcyA mArgadarzanA (cyA AbhArA) ta tyAcI mahAnatA varNana karAvI ANi satkarma karaNAr2yAMnA khUzakhabarI aikavA.
niHsaMzaya, saccA ImAnadhArakAMcyA zatrUMnA allAha svataH haTavito, koNatAhI vizvAsaghAtakI kRtaghna allAhalA pasata nAhI.
jyA (musalamAnAM) zI (kAphira) laDhAI karIta Aheta tyAMnA dekhIla laDhaNyAcI anumatI dilI kAraNa te atyAcArapIDita Aheta. niHsaMzaya tyAMcyA madatIkaritA allAha paripUrNa sAmarthya rAkhato.

he ase loka Aheta, jyAMnA vinAkAraNa ApalyA gharAbAhera kADhale gele kevaLa tyAMcyA yA bolaNyAvara kI AmacA svAmI va pAlanakartA allAha Ahe. jara allAha lokAMnA ApasAta ekamekAMdvAre haTavita rAhilA nasatA tara upAsanAsthaLa ANi carca ANi mazIdI, ANi yahUdI lokAMcI prArthanAsthaLe ANi tyA mazIdI dekhIla kevhAca pADalyA gelyA asatyA jithe phAra moThyA pramANAta allAhace nAmaHsmaraNa kele jAte. jo allAhacI madata karela allAha dekhIla tyAcI madata avazya karela. iMniHsaMzaya allAha moThA zaktizAlI ANi varcasvazAlI Ahe.

he loka Aheta kI jara AmhI yAMce pAya jaminIvara majabUta kele (arthAta cAMgale sthairya pradAna kele) tara he nityanemAne namAja adA karatIla ANi jakAta detIla ANi cAMgalyA kAmAMcA Adeza detIla ANi vAITa kAmAMcI manAI karatIla ANi sarva kAmAMcA pariNAma allAhacyA adhikArakakSeta Ahe.
ANi jara he loka tumhAlA khoTe TharavatIla (tara AzcaryAcI bAba navhe) tara yAMcyApUrvI nUhacA janasamUha ANi Ada va samUda
ANi ibrAhImacA janasamUha ANi lUtacA janasamUha.

ANi madayanacyA lokAMnIhI ApalyA ApalyA paigaMbarAMnA khoTe Tharavile Ahe. mUsA yAMnAhI khoTe Tharavile gele Ahe, tevhA mI inkArI lokAMnA thoDI saMdhI dilI, maga tyAMnA pakaDale. maga pAhA kazI hotI mAjhI zikSA- yAtanA!

azA aneka vastyA Aheta, jyAMnA AmhI naSTa karUna TAkale yAsAThI kI tyA atyAcArI hotyA, tevhA tyA ApalyA chatAMsaha pAlathyA paDalyA Aheta ANi bahuteka AbAda vihIrI nikAmI paDalyA Aheta ANi kitItarI pakke uMca kille osADa paDale Aheta.

kAya tyAMnI dharatIvara hiMDUna phirUna pAhile nAhI kI tyAMcyA hRdayAMnI yA goSTI samajUna ghetalyA asatyA kiMvA kAnAMnI yA (ghaTanA) aikalyA asatyA. kharI goSTa azI kI kevaLa DoLeca AMdhaLe nasatAta kiMbahunA tI hRdaye (suddhA) AMdhaLI asatAta, jI urAta Aheta.

ANi te tumacyAjavaLa allAhacyA zikSA- yAtanecI ghAI karIta Aheta. allAha Apale vacana kadApi TALaNAra nAhI. niHsaMzaya, tumacyA pAlanakartyAjavaLa eka divasa, tumacyA (kAla) gaNanenusAra eka hajAra varSAMcA Ahe.
ANi kityeka atyAcArI vastIMnA AmhI DhIla (sUTa) dilI maga zevaTI tyAMnA pakaDIta ghetale ANi mAjhyAcakaDe paratUna yAyace Ahe.
ailAna karA kI, loka ho! mI tumhAlA ughaDarityA sAvadhAna karaNArA Ahe.
tevhA jyA lokAMnI I‌mAna rAkhale Ahe ANi satkarme kelI Aheta tyAMcyAsAThI mokSaprAptI Ahe ANi mAna-sanmAnapUrNa AjivikA.
ANi je loka AmacyA AyatIMcA avamAna karaNyAmAge lAgele Aheta, teca jahannamI Aheta.

ANi AmhI tumacyApUrvI jo rasUla ANi nabI pAThavilA (tyAcyAsobata he hamakhAsa ghaDale kI) jevhA to ApalyA manAta ekhAdI icchA dharU lAgalA, saitAnAne tyAcyA manokAmaneta kAhI misaLUna dile tevhA saitAnAcyA bhesaLIlA allAha dUra karato, maga ApalyA vacanAMnA majabUta karato. sarvazreSTha allAha sarva kAhI jANaNArA, kimata bALagaNArA Ahe.
he yAsAThI kI saitAnAcyA bhesaLIlA allAhane tyA lokAMcyA kasoTIcI sAmugrI banavAve, jyAMcyA manAta roga Ahe ANi jyAMcI mane kaThora Aheta. niHsaMzaya atyAcArI loka sakta virodhAta Aheta.

ANi yAsAThIhI kI jyAMnA jJAna pradAna kele gele Ahe, tyAMnI vizvAsa karUna ghyAvA kI he tumacyA pAlanakartyAcyAca tarphe pUrNa satya Ahe, maga tyAMnI tyAvara ImAna rAkhAve ANi tyAMcI hRdaye tyAkaDe jhukAvita. niHsaMzaya allAha ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMnA satya mArgAkaDe mArgadarzana karaNAraca Ahe.

ANi inkArI (kAphira) loka allAhacyA vahayIbAbata nehamI saMzayagrastaca rAhatIla, yethaparyaMta kI acAnaka tyAMcyA DokyAvara kayAmata yeUna pohacAvI kiMvA tyAMcyAjavaLa tyA divasAcI zikSA- yAtanA yeUna pohacAvI, jyAta kiMcitahI bhalAI nAhI.
tyA divazI kevaLa allAhacIca rAjyasattA asela, toca tyAMcyA daramyAna phaisalA karela. ImAna rAkhaNAre ANi neka-sadAcArI loka tara allAhacyA deNyAMnI yukta azA jannatamadhye asatIla.
ANi jyA lokAMnI kupra (inkAra) kelA ANi AmacyA AyatIMnA khoTe Tharavile, tyAMcyAsAThI apamAnadAyaka zikSA yAtanA Ahe.

ANi jyAMnI allAhacyA mArgAta dezatyAga kelA, maga te zahIda kele gele kiMvA maraNa pAvale, allAha tyAMnA uttama rojI (AjivikA) pradAna karela ANi niHsaMzaya allAha sarvottama rojI pradAna karaNArA Ahe.
allAhA tyAMnA azA ThikANI pohacavila kI te tyA ThikANAne AnaMdita hotIla. niHsaMzaya allAha sarva kAhI jANaNArA ANi sahanazIla Ahe.

hA Ahe (tyA lokAMcA mobadalA) ANi ekhAdyAne tyAca prakAre badalA ghyAvA, jyA prakAre tyAcyAzI kele gele, mAtra jara tyAcyAvara atireka jhAlA asela tara niHsaMzaya allAha svataH tyAcI madata karela. nizcitaca allAha mApha karaNArA ANi kSamAzIla Ahe.
he azAsAThI kI allAha rAtrIlA divasAta dAkhala karato, ANi divasAlA rAtrIta neto ANi niHsaMzaya allAha aikaNArA, pAhaNArA Ahe.
he sarva yAsAThI kI allAhaca satya Ahe ANi tyAcyAkherIja jyAlA dekhIla he pukAratAta te asatya (mithyA) Ahe ANi niHsaMzaya, allAha atiucca mahAnatA bALagaNArA Ahe.
kAya tumhI nAhI pAhile kI allAha AkAzAtUna pANI varSavito tevhA dharatI hiravI TavaTavIta hote. niHsaMzaya allAha moThA meherabAna ANi jANaNArA Ahe.
AkAzAMmadhye va dharatIta je kAhI Ahe sarva tyAceca Ahe ANi niHsaMzaya allAha agadI niHspRha, guNavaiziTyAMnI yukta, ANi prazaMsanIya Ahe.

kAhI tumhI nAhI pAhile kI allAhaneca dharatIcyA samasta vastU tumacyA adhIna kelyA Aheta ANi tyAcyA AdezAne samudrAta cAlaNAr2yA naukA dekhIla. tyAneca AkAzAlA sAvarUna Thevale Ahe kI dharatIvara tyAcyA hukumAvinA kosaLUna na paDAve. niHsaMzaya allAha, lokAMsAThI moThA snehazIla, dayA karaNArA Ahe.
ANi tyAneca tumhAlA jivaMta kele, maga toca tumhAlA mRtyu deIla, maga toca tumhAlA (punhA) jivaMta karIla. yAta zaMkA nAhI kI manuSya moThA kRtaghna Ahe.

pratyeka janasamUhAkaritA AmhI upAsanecI eka paddhata nirdhArita kelI Ahe, jice te pAlana karaNAre Aheta, tevhA tyAMnI tumacyAzI yA saMdarbhAta vAda ghAlU naye. tumhI ApalyA pAlanakartyAkaDe lokAMnA bolavA. niHsaMzaya, tumhI saraLa, satya mArgAvara AhAta.
ANi tarIhI jara he loka tumacyAzI vAda ghAlU lAgatIla tara tumhI sAMgA kI tumacyA karmAMnA allAha cAMgalyA prakAre jANUna Ahe.
tumacyA samasta matabhedAMcA phaisalA kayAmatacyA divazI allAha svataH karela.
kAya tumhI nAhI jANale kI AkAza ANi dharatIcyA pratyeka vastUce allAhalA jJAna Ahe, he sarva ekA likhita graMthAta surakSita Ahe. sarvazreSTha allAhakaritA he kAma phAra sope Ahe.
ANi he allAhakherIja azAMcI upAsanA karIta Aheta, jyAMcyAkaritA allAhane koNatehI pramANa avatarita kele nAhI ANi nA te svataH yAce kAhI jJAna bALagatAta, atyAcArIMcA koNI sahAyyaka nAhI.

ANi jevhA tyAMcyAsamora AmacyA vANIcyA spaSTa AyatIMce paThaNa kele jAte, tevhA tumhI tyAMcyA cehar2yAvara nArAjIcI lakSaNe spaSTapaNe pAhatA. te tara AmacyA AyatI aikaNAr2yAMvara hallA karaNyAcyA betAta asatAta. sAMgA, kAya mI tumhAlA yAhUna vAITa bAtamI sAMgU. tI Aga Ahe, jicA vAyadA allAhane inkArI lokAMzI karUna ThevalA Ahe ANi te moThe vAITa ThikANa Ahe.

loka ho! eka udAharaNa dile jAta Ahe, jarA lakSapUrvaka aikA. allAhakherIja tumhI jyAMnA jyAMnA (upAsya samajUna) pukArata rAhilA AhAta, te eka mAzI dekhIla nirmANa karU zakata nAhI. jara sarvacyA sarva ekatra hotIla, kiMbahunA jara mAzI yAMcyAkaDUna ekhAdI vastU gheUna paLela tara he tyA vastUlA ticyAkaDUna hirAvUna gheU zakata nAhI. moThA kamakuvata Ahe mAgaNArA ANi khUpa dubaLA Ahe to jyAcyAkaDe mAgitale jAta Ahe.
tyAMnI allAhacyA mahAnatenusAra tyAce mahattva jANaleca nAhI, niHsaMzaya allAha moThA jabaradasta ANi varcasvazAlI Ahe.
phariztyAMmadhUna ANi mAnavAMmadhUna rasUla (saMdezavAhaka) allAhaca nivaDato. niHsaMzaya allAha aikaNArA, pAhaNArA Ahe.
to cAMgalyA prakAre jANato je kAhI tyAMcyA puDhe Ahe ANi je kAhI tyAMcyA mAge Ahe ANi allAhacyAcakaDe sarva vyavahAra paratavile jAtAta.
he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! rukua, sajadA karIta rAhA ANi ApalyA pAlanakartyAcI upAsanA karIta rAhA ANi satkarma karIta rAhA, yAsAThI kI tumhI saphala vhAve.

ANi allAhacyA mArgAta taseca jihAda (dharmayuddha) karA, jasA jihAdacA hakka Ahe. tyAne tumhAlA nivaDale Ahe ANi tumacyAvara dIna (dharmA) saMdarbhAta kasalIhI kamataratA rAkhalI nAhI. tumace pitA ibrAhImacA dIna (dharma kAyama rAkhA) tyAca (allAhane) ne tumace nAva muslima Thevale Ahe. yA (kuraAnA) pUrvI ANi yAcyAtahI, yAsAThI kI paigaMbara tumacyAvara sAkSI asAvA ANi tumhI lokAMvara sAkSI vhAve. tevhA tumace he kartavya Tharate kI namAja kAyama karA ANi jakAta (dharmadAna) adA karIta rAhA ANi allAhalA dRDhatApUrvaka dharA, toca tumacA saMrakSaka ANi svAmI Ahe, tevhA kitI cAMgalA svAmI ANi kitI cAMgalA sahAyya karaNArA.
niHsaMzaya, ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMnI saphalatA prApta kelI.
je ApalyA namAjamadhye vinamratA aMgikAratAta.
je nirarthaka goSTIMpAsUna toMDa phiravatAta.
je jakAta (dharmadAna) adA karaNAre Aheta.
je apalyA lajjAsthAnAMce (guptAMgAMce) saMrakSaNa karaNAre Aheta.
ApalyA patnyA ANi svAmitvAta asalelyA dAsIMkherIja. niHsaMzaya yAMcyAbAbatIta tyAMcyAvara kasalAhI doSa nAhI.
mAtra yAcyAkherIja jo itara zodhIla tara teca maryAdece ullaMghana karaNAre Aheta.
je ApalyA amAnatIcI ANi vAyadyAcI rakSA karaNAre Aheta.
je ApalyA nAmAjAMce saMrakSaNa karatAta.
heca loka uttarAdhikArI Aheta.
je phirdosa (jannatacyA sarvocca darjA) ce vArasa hotIla, jithe sadaiva rAhatIla.
ANi niHsaMzaya AmhI mAnavAlA khaNakhaNaNAr2yA mAtIcyA satvApAsUna nirmANa kele.
maga tyAlA vIrya banavUna surikSata sthAnI Thevale.

maga vIryAlA AmhI jamalelyA raktAce svarUpa dile, maga tyA raktAcyA goLyAlA mAMsAcA tukaDA banivale, maga mAMsAcyA tukaDyAta hADe banivalI, maga hADAMvara mAMsa jaDhavile, maga ekA dusar2yA svarUpAta tyAlA nirmANa kele. tevhA moThA samRddhazAlI Ahe to allAha jo sarvottama nirmitI karaNArA Ahe.
yAnaMtara tumhI sarvacyA sarva nizcita maraNa pAvaNAra AhAta.
maga kayAmatacyA divazI, avazya tumhI sarva uThavile jAla.
ANi AmhI tumacyAvara sAta AkAza banavile Aheta ANi AmhI ApalyA nirmitIpAsUna gAphIla nAhIta.
ANi AmhI ekA ucita pramANAta AkAzAtUna pANI varSavito, maga tyAlA jaminIvara saMcayita karato ANi AmhI te gheUna jANyAsa khAtrIne samartha Ahota.
yAca pANyAdvAre AmhI tumacyAsAThI khajUra ANi drAkSAMcyA bAgA nirmANa karato. tyAta tumacyAkaritA aneka phaLe Aheta, tyAtUna tumhI khAtA.
ANi te jhADa je sainA nAvAcyA parvatAvara ugate, jyAtUna tela nighate, ANi khANAr2yAMsAThI rassA (kAlavaNa).

tumacyAsAThI cAra pAyAMcyA gurAMmadhyehI moThA bodha Ahe. tyAMcyA udarAMpAsUna AmhI tumhAlA (dUdha) pAjato ANi itarahI aneka phAyade tumacyAsAThI tyAMcyAta Aheta, tyAMcyApaikI kAhIMnA tumhI khAtAdekhIla.
ANi tyAMcyAvara ANi naukAMvara svAra kele jAtAta.

niHsaMzaya AmhI nUhalA tyAcyA janasamUhAkaDe (rasUla banavUna) pAThavile. nUha mhaNAle, he mAjhyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMno! allAhacI upAsanA karA ANi tyAcyAkherIja tumacA koNIhI upAsya nAhI. kAya tumhI allAhace bhaya nAhI bALagata?

tyAMcyA samAjAcyA kAphIra saradArAMnI spaSTa sAMgitale kI hA tara tumacyAsArakhAca manuSya Ahe. hA tumacyAvara zreSThatva (ANi varcasva) prApta karU icchito. jara allAhaneca icchile asate tara ekhAdyA phariztyAlA avatarita kele asate. AmhI tara yAbAbata ApalyA pUrvajAMcyA kALAta aikalehI nAhI.
niHsaMzaya, yA mANasAlA veDa lAgale Ahe, tevhA tumhI tyAlA ekA nirdhArita veLaparyaMta sUTa (DhIla) dyA.
nUha yAMnI duA (prArthanA) kelI, he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! yAMnI malA khoTe Tharavile Ahe, tevhA tU mAjhI madata kara.

maga AmhI tyAMcyAkaDe vahayI pAThavilI kI tumhI AmacyA DoLyAMsamora AmacyA vahayInusAra eka naukA tayAra karA, jevhA AmacA Adeza yeUna pohocela, ANi taMdUra utU lAgela, tevhA tumhI pratyeka prakAracA eka eka joDA tyAta ThevUna ghyA, ANi ApalyA kuTuMbiyAMnAhI, mAtra tyAMcyAkherIja, jyAMcyAbAbata AdhIca phaisalA kelA gelA Ahe. khabaradAra! jyA lokAMnI julUma- atyAcAra kelA Ahe, tyAMcyAviSayI mAjhyAzI kAhI bolU nakA. te tara sarva buDavile jAtIla.
jevhA tumhI ANi tumace sAthIdAra nauketa cAMgalyA prakAre svAra vhAla tevhA mhaNA, samasta stutI-prazaMsA allAhakaritA Ahe jyAne AmhA lokAMnA atyAcArI janasamUhApAsUna muktI dilI.
ANi duA (prArthanA) karA, he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! malA surakSitapaNe utarava ANi tUca uttama rItIne utaraviNArA Ahesa.
niHsaMzaya, yA (ghaTane) ta moThamoThI bodhacinhe Aheta ANi nizcitaca AmhI kasoTI gheNAre Ahota.
maga tyAMcyAnaMtara AmhI dusare samudAya dekhIla nirmANa kele.
maga tyAMcyAta, tyAMcyAmadhUna paigaMbarahI pAThavilA (yA AvAhanAsaha) kI tumhI sarva allAhacI upAsanA karA, tyAcyAkherIja tumacA dusarA koNI upAsya nAhI, tevhA tumhI bhaya kA nAhI bALagata?

ANi janasamUhAcyA saradArAMnI uttara dile, je kupra (inkAra) karIta asata ANi AkhiratacyA bheTIsa khoTe Tharavita asata ANi AmhI tyAMnA aihika jIvanAta sukhI Thevale hote, mhaNU lAgale, hA tara tumacyAsArakhAca eka manuSya Ahe. je tumhI khAtA teca to khAto ANi je pANI tumhI pitA, teca to dekhIla pito.
ANi jara tumhI ApalyAsArakhyAca mANasAce AjJApAlana mAnya karUna ghetale tara nizcitaca tumhI moThyA toTyAta AhAta.
kAya hA tumhAlA yA goSTIce vacana deto kI jevhA tumhI melyAvara kevaLa mAtI ANi hADe banUna rAhAla, tara tumhI punhA jivaMta kele jAla?
navhe. dUra ANi atizaya dUra Ahe tI goSTa, jice vacana tumhAlA dile jAta Ahe.
jIvana tara kevaLa yAca jagAce jIvana Ahe, jyAta AmhI marata jagata asato he navhe kI AmhAlA (melyAnaMtara) punhA uThavile jAIla.
hA tara to manuSya Ahe, jyAne allAhavara asatya racale Ahe. AmhI tara yAcyAvara ImAna rAkhaNAra nAhI.
paigaMbarAne duA (prArthanA) kelI, he pAlanakartyA! yAMnI malA khoTe Tharavile Ahe, tevhA tU mAjhI madata kara.
uttara miLAle kI, lavakaraca he ApalyA kRtakarmAMvara pazcAttApa karatIla.
zevaTI nyAyAcyA niyamAnusAra ekA bhayaMkara AvAjAne tyAMnA yeUna dharale ANi AmhI tyAMnA kerakacarA karUna TAkale. tevhA azA atyAcArI lokAMkaritA lAMbace aMtara aso.
maga tyAMcyAnaMtara AmhI dusarehI janasamUha nirmANa kele.
koNatAhI janasamUha ApalyA mudatIpUrvI nAza pAvalA ANi nA mAge rAhilA.

tyAnaMtara AmhI sAtatyAne rasUla (paigaMbara) pAThavile. jyA janasamUhAjavaLa jyA jyA veLesa tyAcA paigaMbara AlA, tyAne tyAsa khoTe Tharavile tevhA ekA pAThopATha eka janasamUha naSTa karIta rAhilo ANi tyAMnA kissA- kahANI banavUna soDale. dhiHkkAra aso tyA lokAMcA je ImAna svIkArata nAhIta.
maga AmhI mUsAlA ANi tyAMcA bhAU hArunalA ApalyA nizANyA ANi spaSTa pramANAMsaha pAThavile.
phiraauna ANi tyAcyA sainyAkaDe, paraMtu tyAMnI garva kelA ANi te hoteca ghameMDa karaNAre loka!
te mhaNAle, kAya AmhI ApalyAsArakhyA dona mANasAMvara ImAna rAkhAve vAstavika tyAMcA svataHcA janasamUha AmacI gulAmI karIta Ahe.
tevhA tyAMnI tyA doghAMnA khoTe Tharavile. zevaTI te lokahI nAza pAvalelyA lokAMta sAmIla jhAle.
ANi AmhI tara mUsAlA graMthahI pradAna kelA, yAsAThI kI lokAMnI satya mArgAvara yAve.
ANi AmhI mariyamacA putra ANi tyAcyA mAtelA eka nizANI banavile ANi tyA doghAMnA uMca, ArAmadAyI ANi vAhate pANI asalelyA ThikANI Azraya dilA.
paigaMbarAMno! halAla (vaidha) vastU khA ANi satkarma karA. tumhI je kAhI karIta AhAta, te mI cAMgalyA prakAre jANato.
ANi niHsaMzaya tumacA hA dIna (dharma) ekaca dIna (dharma) Ahe ANi mI tumhA sarvAMcA pAlanakartA Ahe, tevhA mAjheca bhaya bALagUna rAhA.
maga tyAMnI svataHca ApalyA dharmAMce ApasAta tukaDe tukaDe karUna TAkale. pratyeka saMpradAya, tyAcyAjavaLa je kAhI Ahe, tyAvaraca ghameMDa karIta Ahe.
tevhA tumhI dekhIla tyAMnA tyAMcyA gaphalatIta kAhI kALa paDUna rAhU dyA.
kAya yAMnI ase samajUna ghetale Ahe kI AmhI jI kAhI yAMcI dhana-saMpattI ANi saMtatI vADhavita Ahota.
te tyAcyAsAThI zubha-mAMgalyAta ghAI karIta Ahota? navhe, kiMbahunA yAMnA samajataca nAhI.
niHsaMzaya, je loka ApalyA pAlanakartyA (allAhace) bhaya bALagatAta.
ANi je ApalyA pAlanakartyAcyA AyatIMvara ImAna rAkhatAta.
ANi je ApalyA pAlanakartyAsobata dusar2yA kuNAlA sahabhAgI Tharavita nAhI.
ANi je loka detAta, je kAhI detAta, azA sthitIta kI tyAMcI hRdaye bhayAne tharathara kAMpata asatAta kI te ApalyA pAlanakartyAkaDe parataNAra Aheta.
heca Aheta je tatparatene nekI (satkarma) prAptA karIta Aheta ANi heca Aheta je tyAMcyAkaDe dhAva gheNAre Aheta.
AmhI koNatyAhI jIvAvara tyAcyA kuvatIpekSA jAsta bhAra TAkata nAhI. AmacyAjavaLa eka graMtha Ahe, jo satya teca sAMgato ANi tyAMcyAvara kiMcitahI atyAcAra kelA jANAra nAhI.
paraMtu tyAMcI hRdaye yA goSTIkaDUna gAphIla (asAvadha) Aheta ANi tyAMcyAsAThI yAkherIjahI aneka karma Aheta, jI te karaNAra Aheta.
yetheparyaMta kI jevhA AmhI tyAMcyAtalyA sukha-saMpanna avasthecyA lokAMnA zikSA- yAtaneta dharale tevhA te kiMcALU lAgale.
Aja gayAvayA karU nakA. niHsaMzaya AmacyAkaDUna tumhAlA madata miLaNAra nAhI.
mAjhyA AyatI tara tumacyAsamora vAcUna aikavilyA jAta hotyA, tarIhI tumhI ApalyA TAcAMvara ulaTapAvalI paLa kADhata hote.
ghameMDa karIta, tATharatA dAkhavita, kathA- kahANI banavUna tyAsa soDUna deta.
kAya tyAMnI yA goSTIvara vicAra- ciMtana nAhI kele? kiMvA tyAMcyAjavaLa tI goSTa AlI, jI yAMcyA pUrvajAMjavaLa AlI navhatI?
kiMvA yAMnI ApalyA paigaMbarAlA oLakhale nAhI, mhaNUna tyAcA inkAra karaNAre jhAleta.
kiMvA he mhaNatAta kI yAce Doke phirale Ahe. kiMbahunA to tara tyAMcyAjavaLa satya gheUna AlA Ahe. hoya tyAMcyApaikI adhikAMza loka satyApAsUna ciDaNAre Aheta.

jara satyaca tyAMcyA icchA-AkAMkSAMce anuyAyI jhAle tara dharatI ANi AkAza ANi tyAMcyA daramyAna jevaDhyA vastU Aheta sarva astAvyasta hotIla. kharI goSTa azI kI AmhI tyAMnA tyAMcA bodha- upadeza pohacavilA Ahe, paraMtu te ApalyA bodha- upadezApAsUna toMDa phiraviNAre Aheta.
kAya tumhI tyAMcyAkaDUna kAhI pArizramika mAgatA? lakSAta ThevA, tumacyA pAlanakartyAne dilele pArizramika adhika uttama Ahe ANi to sarvAMta uttama rojI (AjivikA) pohacaviNArA Ahe.
niHsaMzaya, tumhI tara tyAMnA saraLa mArgAkaDe bolAvita AhAta.
ANi niHsaMzaya, je loka Akhiratavara ImAna rAkhata nAhIta te saraLa mArgApAsUna vicalita hoNAre Aheta.
ANi jara AmhI tyAMcyAvara dayA- kRpA kelI ANi tyAMcI kaSTa- yAtanA dUra kelI tara te ApalyA vidrohAta adhika majabUta hoUna bhaTakata rAhatIla.
ANi AmhI tyAMnA zikSA- yAtanAgrastahI kele tarIhI he loka nA tara ApalyA pAlanakartyAsamora jhukale ANi nA vinamratecA mArga patkaralA.
yetheparyaMta kI jevhA AmhI tyAMcyAvara kaThora zikSA- yAtanece dvAra khule kele tevhA tyAca veLI tvarita nirAza jhAle.
toca (allAha) Ahe, jyAne tumacyAsAThI kAna, DoLe ANi hRdaya banavile, paraMtu tumhI phAra kamI AbhAra mAnatA.
ANi toca Ahe, jyAne tumhAlA (nirmANa karUna) jaminIvara pasaravile ANi tyAcyAcakaDe tumhI ekatrita kele jAla.
ANi toca hoya jo jivaMta rAkhato ANi mRtyu deto ANi rAtra va divasAcA pherabadala karaNyAcA adhikArahI toca rAkhato. kAya tumhI akalecA vApara karIta nAhI?
kiMbahunA tyA lokAMnI dekhIla teca sAMgitale, je pUrvIce loka sAMgata Ale Aheta.
mhaNatAta kI jevhA melyAnaMtara AmhI mAtI ANi hADe hoUna jAU, kAya tarIhI AmhI avazya ubhe kele jAU?
AmacyAzI ANi AmacyA pUrvajAM (bujUrga lokAM) zI pUrvIpAsUnaca hA vAyadA hota AlA Ahe. kAhI nAhI, yA kevaLa pUrvI hoUna gelelyA lokAMcyA kathA- kahANyA Aheta.
yAMnA vicArA, jara jANata asAla tara sAMgA kI dharatI ANi ticyA samasta vastU koNAcyA mAlakIcyA Aheta?
te tvarita uttara detIla kI allAhacyA, sAMgA tara maga tumhI bodha prApta kA nAhI karIta?
tyAMnA vicArA, AkAzAMcA ANi atizaya mahAna IzasiMhAsanA (arza) cA svAmI koNa Ahe?
te loka uttara detIla, allAhaca Ahe. sAMgA, maga tumhI bhaya kA nAhI rAkhata?
yAMnA vicArA kI sarva goSTIMcA adhikAra koNAcyA hAtI Ahe, jo Azraya deto ANi jyAcyA tulaneta (virodhAta) koNI Azraya deU zakata nAhI. tumhI jANata asAla tara sAMgA.
heca uttara detIla kI, allAhaca Ahe. sAMgA, maga tumacyAvara koNIkaDUna jAdUToNA hoto?
kharI goSTa azI kI AmhI tyAMcyAparyaMta satya pohacavile Ahe, ANi niHsaMzaya he agadI khoTAraDe Aheta.

nA tara allAhane koNAlA putra banavile Ahe ANi nA tyAcyAsobata dusarA koNI upAsya Ahe, anyathA pratyeka Izvara ApalyA nirmitIlA gheUna phirata rAhilA asatA ANi pratyekajaNa ekamekAvara zreSThatama hoNyAcA prayatna karIta rAhilA asatA. jI guNavaiziTye he sAMgatAta allAha tyApAsUna pavitra Ahe.
to gupta - ughaDa jANaNArA Ahe ANi jo zirka (anekezvaravAdI goSTI) he karatAta, allAha tyAhUna atizaya uccatama Ahe.
(tumhI) duA (prArthanA) karA kI he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! jara tU malA te dAkhavazIla, jyAcA vAyadA yA lokaMnA dilA jAta Ahe.
tevhA he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! tU malA yA atyAcArI samUhAta samIla karU nakosa.
ANi AmhI je kAhI vAyade- vacana tyAMnA deta Ahota, te sarva tumhAlA dAkhavUna deNyAce sAmarthya bALagato.
vAITa goSTIlA azA rItIne dUra karA jI pUrNataH bhalepaNAcI asAvI. he je kAhI sAMgatAta te AmhI cAMgalyA prakAre jANato.
ANi duA (prArthanA) karA kI he mAjhyA pAlanakatyA! saitAnAMdvAre (manAta yeNAr2yA) zaMkA-kuzaMkAMpAsUna mI tujhe zaraNa mAgato.
ANi he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! mI yA goSTIpAsUnahI tujhe zaraNa mAgato kI tyAMnI mAjhyAjavaLa yAve.
yetheparyaMta kI tyAMcyApaikI ekhAdyAce maraNa yeUna Thepale tevhA to mhaNato kI he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! malA parata pAThava.

azAsAThI kI ApalyA soDUna AlelyA jagAta jAUna satkarma karAve, ase kadApi hoNAra nAhI. he kevaLa eka kathana Ahe, je sAMgaNArA hA Ahe tyAMcyA pAThImAge eka paTa Ahe. tyAMce dusar2yAMdA jivaMta hoNyAcyA divasAparyaMta.
maga jevhA sUra (zaMkha) phuMkalA jAIla, tyA divazI nA tara ApasAtIla saMbaMdha rAhatIla nA ekamekAMcI vicArapUsa.
tevhA jyAMcyA tarAjUce pAraDe vajanadAra asela, te tara saphalatA prApta karaNAre TharatIla.
ANi jyAMcyA tarAjUce pAraDe vajanAta halake rAhIla tara he ase loka Aheta, jyAMnI Apale nukasAna svataH karUna ghetale, je nehamIkaritA jahannamamadhye dAkhala jhAle.
tyAMcyA cehar2yAMnA Aga horapaLata rAhIla. te tithe vidrupa ANi bhayAnaka banalele asatIla.
kAya mAjhyA AyatIMce paThaNa tumacyAsamora kele jAta navhate? tarIhI tumhI tyAMnA khoTe Tharavita hote?
te mhaNatIla, he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! Amace durdaiva AmacyAvara prabhAvazAlI jhAle. kharokhara AmhI mArgabhraSTa loka hoto.
he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! AmhAlA yethUna bAhera kADha. jara AmhI punhA ase kele tara nizcitaca AmhI atyAcArI TharU.
(allAha) pharmAvila, dhiHkkAra aso tumacA, yAtaca paDUna rAhA, ANi mAjhyAzI bolU nakA.

mAjhyA dAsAMcA eka samUha asA hotA, jo satata heca mhaNata rAhilA kI he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! AmhI ImAna rAkhale Ahe. tU AmhAlA mApha kara ANi AmacyAvara dayA kara. tU sarva dayA karaNAr2yAMpekSA jAsta dayA karaNArA Ahesa.
(paraMtu) tumhI tyAMcI thaTTAca uDavita rAhile, yethe paryaMta kI (tyAMcyA mAge lAgUna) tumhI mAjhe smaraNa dekhIla visarale ANi tyAMnA hasaNyAvArI gheta rAhile.
Aja mI tyAMcyA sahanazIlatA (ANi sadAcArA) cA asA mobadalA dilA kI te saphalatA prApta karaNAre Tharale.
(sarvazreSTha allAha) vicArIla, tumhI dharatIvara varSAMcyA gaNanenusAra kitI divasa rAhilAta?
(te) mhaNatIla, eka divasa kiMvA ekA divasApekSAhI kamI. gaNanA karaNAr2yAMnAhI vicArA.
(sarvazreSTha allAha) pharmAvila, kharI goSTa azI kI tumhI tithe phAra kamI kALa rAhilAta. he tumhI pahilyApAsUna jANUna ghetale asate tara!
kAya tumhI ase samajUna basalA AhAta kI AmhI tumhAlA vyarthaca nirmANa kele Ahe, ANi he kI tumhI AmacyAkaDe paratavile jANAra nAhIta?
sarvazreSTha allAha kharAkhurA bAdazahA Ahe, to atiucca Ahe, tyAcyAkherIja koNIhI upAsanIya nAhI. toca sanmAnita siMhAsanA (arza) cA svAmI Ahe.

ANi jo manuSya, allAhasobata anya ekhAdyA IzvarAlA pukArela jyAce tyAcyAjavaLa koNatehI pramANa (purAvA) nAhI tara tyAcA hizoba tyAcyA pAlanakartyAjavaLa Ahe. niHsaMzaya kAphira (avizvAzI) loka saphalatepAsUna vaMcita Aheta.
ANi mhaNA kI he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! tU mApha kara ANi dayA kRpA kara, ANi tU sarva dayA karaNAr2yAMpekSA uttama dayA karaNArA Ahesa.
hI Ahe tI sUraha (adhyAya) jI AmhI avatarita kelI Ahe ANi nirdhArita kelI Ahe ANi jyAta AmhI spaSTa Adeza avatarita kele Aheta, yAsAThI kI tumhI smaraNAta rAkhAve.

vyabhicAra karaNAr2yA strI-puruSAMpaikI pratyekAlA zaMbhara koDe mArA. tyAMnA allAhacyA (daMDa) niyamAnusAra zikSA detAnA tumhAlA kadApI kIva vATU naye, jara tumhI allAhavara ANi kayAmatacyA divasAvara ImAna rAkhata asAla. tyAMnA zikSA deteveLI ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMcA eka samUha hajara asalA pAhije.

vyabhicArI puruSa, vyabhicArI strI kiMvA anekezvaravAdI strIzivAya dusar2yA strIzI vivAha karIta nAhI ANi vyabhicAra karaNArI strI dekhIla, vyabhicArI puruSa kiMvA anekezvaravAdI puruSAkherIja dusar2yAzI vivAha karIta nAhI ANi ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMvara he harAma (avaidha) kele gele Ahe.

ANi je loka pAvitryazIla strIvara vyabhicArAcA Aropa ThevatIla, maga cAra sAkSI sAdara karU zakata nasatIla tara tyAMnA aiMzI koDe mArA ANi tyAMcI sAkSa kadhIhI mAnya karU nakA, he durAcArI loka Aheta.
paraMtu je loka yAnaMtara mAphI mAgUna ApalA sudhAra karUna ghetIla, tara sarvazreSTha allAha mApha karaNArA ANi dayA- kRpA karaNArA Ahe.

ANi je loka ApalyA patnIvara vyabhicArAcA Aropa ThevatIla ANi tyAMcA sAkSI tyAMcyAkherIja dusarA koNI nasela tara azA lokAMpaikI pratyekAcA purAvA hA Ahe kI tyAMnI cAra veLA allAhacI zapatha gheUna sAMgAve kI te saccA lokAMpaikI Aheta.
ANi pAcavyA khepesa he kI allAhatarphe dhiHkkAra aso tyAcA, jara to khoTyAMpaikI asela.
ANi tyA (strI) varUna zikSA azA prakAre TALalI jAU zakate kI tine cAra veLA allAhacI zapatha gheUna mhaNAve kI niHsaMzaya ticA patI khoTe bolaNAr2yAMpaikI Ahe.
ANi pAcavyA khepesa mhaNAve kI ticyAvara allAhacA prakopa hovo jara ticA patI satya bolaNAr2yAMpaikI asela.
ANi jara allAhacI dayA- kRpA tumacyAvara nasatI (tara tumacyAvara duHkha kosaLale asate) ANi allAha kSamA-yAcanA kabUla karaNArA hikamatazAlI Ahe.

je loka hA phAra moThA AkSepa racUna Ale Aheta. hA dekhIla tumacyAtalA eka samUha Ahe. tumhI tyAlA ApalyAkaritA vAITa samajU nakA kiMbahunA hA tumacyAsAThI cAMgalA Ahe. mAtra tyAMcyApaikI pratyekAvara tevaDhA aparAdha Ahe, jevaDhA tyAne kamavilA Ahe ANi tyAMcyApaikI jyAne tyAta moThyA pramANAta bhAga ghetalA Ahe, tyAcI zikSAhI phAra moThI Ahe.
te aikatAca ImAna rAkhaNAr2yA puruSAMnI ANi striyAMnI ekamekAMbaddala sad‌bhAvanA kA nAhI kelI ANi ase kA nAhI mhaTale kI hA tara ughaDa Aropa Ahe.
tyAMnI yAvara cAra sAkSI kA nAhI ANale? ANi jyAarthI tyAMnI sAkSI ANale nAhIta tara hA Aropa ThevaNAre loka nizcitaca allAhajavaLa kevaLa khoTAraDe Aheta.
ANi jara tumacyAvara allAhacI kRpA ANi dayA, yA jagAta ANi Akhiratamadhye nasatI tara niHsaMzaya, jyA goSTIcI carcA tumhI surU kelI hotI, ticyApAyI tumhAlA phAra moThI zikSA pohacalI asatI.

jevhA tumhI ApalyA mukhAne yAcI carcA satata karU lAgale ANi ApalyA toMDAne tI goSTahI bolU lAgale, jicyAviSayI tumhAlA kAhIca jJAna navhate. tumhI tilA sAdhAraNa goSTa samajata rAhile asale tarI allAhacyA dRSTIne tI moThI bhayaMkara bAba hotI.
ANi tumhI tI goSTa aikatAca ase kA nAhI mhaTale kI AmhI azI goSTa toMDAne kADhaNehI cAMgale nAhI. he allAha tU pavitra Ahesa hA tara phAra moThA mithyAropa Ahe.
allAha tumhAlA upadeza karato kI punhA kadhI ase kAma karU nakA, jara tumhI sacce ImAnadhAraka asAla.
ANi allAha tumacyAsamora ApalyA AyatI nivedana karIta Ahe, ANi allAha jANaNArA, buddhIkauzalya bALagaNArA Ahe.

je loka, ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMmadhye nirlajjatA pasaraviNyAcI icchA bALagatAta, tyAMcyAsAThI yA jagAta ANi Akhiratamadhye duHkhadAyaka az2Aba (zikSA- yAtanA) Ahe, ANi allAha sarva kAhI jANato, ANi tumhI kAhIca jANata nAhI.
ANi jara tumacyAvara allAhacI dayA- kRpA rAhilI nasatI ANi hehI kI allAha atizaya snehazIla dayA karaNArA Ahe (anyathA tumacyAvara prakopa AlA asatA).

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! saitAnAcyA pAUlakhuNAMvara cAlU nakA, jo manuSya saitAnAcyA pAUlakhuNAMvara cAlela, tara to nirlajjatA ANi vAITa kAmAMcAca Adeza deIla ANi jara allAhacI dayA- kRpA tumacyAvara nasatI tara tumacyApaikI koNIhI, kadhIhI svaccha- zuddha jhAlA nasatA. paraMtu allAha jyAlA pAka (svaccha-zuddha) karU icchito, karato. ANi allAha sarva kAhI aikaNArA ANi sarva kAhI jANaNArA Ahe.

ANi tumacyApaikI je loka moThe ANi saMpanna avasthA rAkhaNAre Aheta tyAMnI azI zapatha gheU naye kI ApalyA javaLacyA nAtevAIkAMcI ANi goragaribAMcI ANi allAhacyA mArgAta dezatyAga karaNAr2yAMcI madata karaNAra nAhI, kiMbahunA mApha kele pAhije ANi tahe dila pAhije. kAya tumhI nAhI icchita kI allAhane tumace aparAdha (cukA) mApha karAveta. ANi allAha mApha karaNArA, dayA karaNArA Ahe.
je loka satzIla bhoLyA-bhAbaDyA ImAnadhAraka striyAMvara Aropa ThevatAta, te yA jagAta ANi Akhiratamadhye dhiHkkArale jANAre loka Aheta ANi tyAMcyAsAThI atizaya kaThora zikSA-yAtanA Ahe.
jevhA tyAMcyA samakSa tyAMcyA jIbhA ANi tyAMce hAta-pAya, tyAMnI kelelyA karmAMcI sAkSa detIla.
tyA divazI allAha tyAMnA purepUra mobadalA satya ANi nyAyAsaha pradAna karela ANi te jANUna ghetIla kI allAhaca satya Ahe, toca jAhIra karaNArA Ahe.

azuddha ghANeraDyA striyA azuddha ghANeraDyA puruSAMcyA yogya Aheta, ANi azuddha ghANeraDe puruSa azuddha ghANeraDyA striyAMcyA yogya Aheta, ANi svaccha- zuddha striyA, svaccha- zuddha puruSAMcyA lAyaka Aheta ANi svaccha- zuddha puruSa svaccha- zuddha striyAMcyA yogya Aheta. azA pavitra, svaccha- zuddha lokAMviSayI jI kAhI vAhyAta baDabaDa he (Aropa ThevaNAre) karIta Aheta, te tyApAsUna nirdoSa Aheta. tyAMcyAsAThI kSamA Ahe, ANi moThI sanmAnapUrNa AjivikA Ahe.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno ApalyA gharAMkherIja dusar2yAMcyA gharAta jAU nakA, joparyaMta (Ata yeNyAcI) paravAnagI na ghyAla ANi tithalyA rAhaNAr2yAMnA salAma na karAla. heca tumacyAsAThI uttama Ahe, yAsAThI kI tumhI bodha prApta karAvA.

jara tithe tumhAlA koNI bheTalA nAhI tara maga anumatI ghetalyAvinA Ata jAU nakA, ANi jara tumhAlA parata jAyalA sAMgitale gele tara tumhI parataca jA. heca tumacyAsAThI adhika nirmaLa, niSpApa Ahe. je kAhI tumhI karIta AhAta, allAha te cAMgalyA prakAre jANato.

paraMtu jyAta loka rAhata nasatIla, azA gharAMmadhye, jithe tumacA kAhI lAbha kiMvA sAmugrI asela (tyAta) praveza karaNyAta kAhI aparAdha nAhI. tumhI je kAhI jAhIra karatA ANi je kAhI lapavitA allAha te sarva kAhI jANato.

ImAna rAkhaNAr2yA puruSAMnA sAMgA kI ApalI najara khAlI rAkhAvI ANi ApalyA lajjAsthAnA (guptAMgA) ce rakSaNa karAve. yAtaca tyAMcyAkaritA pAvitrya Ahe. loka je kAhI karIta Aheta, allAha te sarva kAhI jANato.

ANi ImAna rAkhaNAr2yA striyAMnA sAMgA kI tyAMnIhI ApalI najara jhukalelI ThevAvI ANi ApalyA zIla-abruce rakSaNa karAve. ANi ApalyA zobhA- sajAvaTI (zRMgArA) lA ughaDa karU naye. tyAcyAkherIja je ughaDa Ahe, ANi ApalyA chAtIvara ApalyA oDhaNyA- dupaTTe pUrNataH pasaravUna rAkhAveta ANi ApalA zRMgAra koNAcyAhI samora jAhIra karU naye kherIja ApalyA patIcyA kiMvA ApalyA pityAcyA kiMvA ApalyA sAsar2yAcyA, kiMvA ApalyA putrAcyA kiMvA ApalyA patIcyA putrAMcyA, kiMvA ApalyA bhAvAMcyA kiMvA putaNyAMcyA kiMvA ApalyA bhAcyAMcyA, kiMvA ApalyA sakhIMcyA kiMvA dAsAMcyA kiMvA nokarAMpaikI azA puruSAMcyA jyAMnA kAmavAsanA nasAvI, kiMvA azA lahAna mulAMcyA, je striyAMcyA gupta bAbIMzI adyApa paricita jhAle nasAveta, ANi azA prakAre tyAMnI Apale pAya (jaminIvara) jorajorAne ApaTata cAlU naye kI (tazAne) tyAMcA lapalelA zRMgAra kaLUna yAvA. ANi he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno, tumhI sarvacyA sarva allAhacyA darabArAta mAphI mAgA, yAsAThI kI tumhI saphalatA prApta karAvI.

ANi tumacyApaikI je puruSa-strI tAruNyAsa pohocale asatIla tara tyAMcA vivAha karUna dyA ANi ApalyA neka sadAcArI dAsa-dAsIMcA dekhIla jara te garIbahI asatIla tara allAha ApalyA dayA kRpene tyAMnA dhanavAna banavila. allAha moThI vizAlatA bALagaNArA ANi jJAna rAkhaNArA Ahe.

ANi tyA lokAMnI satzIla rAhile pAhije, je ApalA vivAha karaNyAce sAmarthya bALagata nAhI. yetheparyaMta kI allAhane ApalyA kRpene tyAMnA dhanavAna karAve. tumacyA dAsAMpaikI jo koNI tumhAlA (dAsyamukta hoNyAkaritA) kAhI deUna muktIcA lekhI karAra karU icchitIla tara tumhI tyAMnA tasA lekhI karAra lihUna dyA. jara tumhAlA tyAMcyAta kAhI bhalepaNA disata asela, ANi allAhane jI dhana-saMpattI tumhAlA deUna ThevalI Ahe, ticyAtUna tyAMnAhI dyA. tumhI ApalyA tyA dAsIMnA, jyA satzIla (pavitra) rAhU icchitAta tyAMnA aihika jIvanAcyA phAyadyAsAThI duSkarma karaNyAsa vivaza karU nakA ANi jo tyAMnA vivaza karIla tara tyAMnA vivaza kele gelyAvara allAha (tyAMcyAsAThI) kSamAzIla ANi dayAzIla Ahe.
ANi AmhI tumacyAkaDe spaSTa AyatI avatarita kelyA Aheta ANi tyA lokAMcI udAharaNe je tumacyApUrvI hoUna gele Aheta. ANi allAhace bhaya rAkhaNAr2yAMkaritA bodha- upadeza.

allAha AkAzAMcA ANi jaminIcA nUra (prakAza) Ahe. tyAcyA nUrace udAharaNa ase kI jaNU ekhAdyA konADyAta divA Ahe ANi to divA kAcecyA (kaMdIlAcyA) Ata asAvA. kAca cakAkatAnA, lakhkha camakaNAr2yA tAr2yAsamAna asAvA ANi to divA pavitra vRkSa jaitUnacyA telAne prajvalita kelA jAta asAvA, jo vRkSa nA pUrvekaDacA Ahe, nA pazcimekaDacA ANi te tela prakAzamAna hoNyAcyA betAta asAve AgIne tyAlA kadhI sparza kelA nasalA tarI. prakAzAvara prakAza Ahe. sarvazreSTha allAha ApalyA nUracyA dizene jyAlA icchito mArgadarzana karato. lokAMnA samajAvaNyAkaritA allAha he udAharaNa deta Ahe ANi allAha pratyeka goSTIcI avasthA cAMgalyA prakAre jANato.
tyA gharAMmadhye, jyAMnA uMcaviNyAcA ANi tithe Apale nAmaHsmaraNa karaNyAcA allAhane Adeza dilA Ahe tice sakALa-saMdhyAkALa allAhacI tasbIha (guNagAna) karIta asatAta.

ase loka jyAMnA tyAMcA vyApAra ANi kharedI-vikrI allAhacyA smaraNApAsUna ANi namAja kAyama karaNyApAsUna va jakAta adA karaNyApAsUna gAphIla karIta nAhI, tyA divasAce bhaya bALagatAta, jyA divazI aneka hRdaye ANi aneka DoLe ulathe-pAlathe hotIla.
yA hetune kI allAhane tyAMnA tyAMcyA karmAcA cAMgalA mobadalA dyAvA ANi ApalyA kRpene kAhI jAstaca pradAna karAve ANi sarvazreSTha allAha jyAlA icchito agaNita rojI (AjivikA) pradAna karato.

ANi kAphira (inkArI) lokAMce karma tyA cakAkaNAr2yA vALUsArakhe Ahe jI khulyA maidAnAta asAvI. jilA tahAnalelA manuSya durUna pANI samajato, paraMtu jevhA to tyAjavaLa pohacato, tevhA tyAlA kAhIca ADhaLata nAhI, tathApi allAha ApalyA nikaTa asalyAce ADhaLate, jo tyAcA hizoba purepUra cukatA karato. ANi allAha lavakaraca hizoba cukatA karaNArA Ahe.

kiMvA tyA aMdhArAMsArakhe Ahe je khUpa khola samudrAta asAveta, jyAlA lATevara lATa jhAkata asAvI, maga tyAvara Dhaga pasarale asAveta. arthAta aMdhArAvara aMdhAra asAvA. jara ApalA hAta bAhera kADhIla tara tohI pAhaNe tyAlA zakya nasAve, ANi (vastutaH) jyAlA allAhaneca nUra na dyAvA tyAcyAjavaLa koNatAhI nUra (prakAza) nasato.

kAya tumhI nAhI pAhile kI AkAza ANi dharatIcI samasta IzanirmitI ANi paMkha pasarUna uDaNAre sarva pakSI allAhIca tasbIha (nAmasmaraNa )(guNagAna) karaNyAta magna Aheta. pratyekAcI namAja ANi tasbIha (nAmasmaraNa) tyAlA mAhIta Ahe ANi loka je kAhI karatAta, allAha te cAMgalyA prakAre jANato.
AkAzAMcI ANi dharatIcI rAjyasattA allAhacIca Ahe ANi allAhacyAcakaDe paratUna jAyace Ahe.

kAya tumhI nAhI pAhile kI allAha DhagAMnA cAlavito, maga tyAMnA ApasAta miLavato, maga tyAMnA tharAvara thara karato. maga tumhI pAhatA kI tyAMcyAmadhUna pAUsa paDato. toca AkAzAkaDUna gArAMcyA parvatAtUna gArA varSavito. maga jyAMnA icchito tyAMnA tyAMcyAjavaLa varSavito ANi jyAMcyApAsUna icchito tyAMcyApAsUna tyAMnA haTavito. DhagAMmadhUnaca nighaNAr2yA vijecI camaka azI asate kI jaNU AtA DoLyAMcI najara hirAvUna gheIla.
allAhaca divasa-rAtrIcA ulaTaphera karata rAhato. DoLe (dRSTI) rAkhaNAr2yAMkaritA yAta nizcitaca moThA bodha Ahe.

samasta cAlaNAr2yA phiraNAr2yA sajIvAlA allAhane pANyAdvAre nirmANa kele Ahe. tyAtale kAhI ApalyA poTAcyA AdhAre (sarapaTata) cAlatAta, kAhI dona pAyAMvara cAlatAta, kAhI cAra pAyAMvara cAlatAta. allAha je icchito nirmANa karato. niHsaMzaya allAha pratyeka goSTa karaNyAce sAmarthya bALagato.
niHsaMzaya, AmhI spaSTa AyatI avatarita kelyA Aheta. allAha jyAlA icchito saraLa mArga dAkhavito.
ANi je mhaNatAta kI AmhI allAha ANi rasUla (sa.) vara ImAna rAkhale ANi AjJAdhAraka jhAlota, maga tyAMcyAtalA eka samUha tyAnaMtarahI toMDa phiravito, he ImAna rAkhaNAre nAhIta.
ANi jevhA yAMnA yA goSTIkaDe bolAvile jAte kI allAha ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAne (tyAMcyA taMTyAcA) phaisalA karAvA, tarI dekhIla tyAMcA eka samUha toMDa phiraviNArA banato.
ANi jara hakka tyAMnAca pohacata asela tara paigaMbarAjavaLa moThe AjJAdhAraka banUna yetAta.

kAya tyAMcyA manAta roga Ahe? kiMvA he zaMkA-saMzayAta paDale Aheta? kiMvA tyAMnA yA goSTIce bhaya Ahe kI allAha ANi tyAcA rasUla tyAMcA hakka naSTa na karUna TAkAveta. vastutaH he svataH moThe atyAcArI Aheta.

ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMce mhaNaNe tara ase Ahe kI jevhA tyAMnA yAsAThI bolAvile jAte kI allAha ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAne tyAMcyA daramyAna phaisalA karUna dyAvA tevhA te mhaNatAta kI AmhI aikale ANi mAnya kele. heca loka saphala hoNAre Aheta.
ANi jo allAha ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAcyA AdezAce anusaraNa karIla, allAhace bhaya rAkhIla, (tyAMcyA zikSA- yAtanece) bhaya bALagUna rAhIla tara teca loka saphalatA prApta karaNAre Aheta.

ANi agadI dRDhatApUrvaka te allAhacI zapatha gheUna sAMgatAta kI tumacA Adeza hotAca tatpara nighaNyAsa sajja hoU. tyAMnA sAMgA, pure, zapatha gheU nakA. tumacyA AjJApAlanA (cI hakIgata) mAhIta Ahe. je kAhI tumhI karIta AhAta, allAha te jANato.

sAMgA, allAhacyA AdezAce pAlana karA, paigaMbarAMce AjJApAlana karA, tarIhI jara tumhI toMDa phiravile tara paigaMbarAce kartavya tara teca Ahe, je tyAcyAvara anivArya kele gele Ahe ANi tumacyAvara tyA goSTIcI jabAbadArI Ahe, jI tumacyAvara TAkalI gelI Ahe. mArgadarzana tara tumhAlA tyAca veLI lAbhela, jevhA paigaMbarAMce AjJApAlana svIkAra karAla. (aikA) paigaMbarAce kartavya kevaLa spaSTataH pohacaviNe Ahe.

tumacyApaikI jyA lokAMnI ImAna rAkhale Ahe ANi satkarma kele Ahe, allAhane tyAMcyAzI vAyadA kelelA Ahe kI to tyAMnA dharatIvara sattAdhikAra pradAna karIla, jyA prakAre tyA lokAMnA pradAna kelA hotA, je yAMcyApUrvI hoUna gele ANi niHsaMzaya tyAMcyAsAThI tyAMcyA yA dharmAlA dRDhatApUrvaka kAyama karIla jyAsa tyAne tyAMcyAsAThI pasaMta kele Ahe ANi tyAMcyA bhaya- dahazatIlA, zAMtI subatteta badalUna TAkIla. te mAjhI upAsanA karatIla, mAjhyAsobata dusar2yA koNAlA sahabhAgI karaNAra nAhIta. tyAnaMtarahI je loka kRtaghna banatIla ANi kupra (inkAra) karatIla tara nizcita te avajJAkArI Aheta.
ANi namAja kAyama karA, jakAta adA karA ANi allAhacyA paigaMbarAce AjJApAlana karIta rAhA, yAsAThI kI tumacyAvara dayA kelI jAvI.
tumhI ase kadhIhI samajU nakA kI kAphira (inkArI) loka dharatIvara (sarvatra pasarUna) AmhAlA parAbhUta karatIla. tyAMce mULa ThikANa tara jahannama Ahe je niHsaMzaya moThe vAITa ThikANa Ahe.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! tumacyA tAbyAta asalelyA dAsAMnI ANi tyAMnIhI je tumacyApaikI pUrNa vayAsa pohocale nasatIla (ApalyA yeNyAcyA) tIna veLAMmadhye tumacyAkaDUna anumatI gheNe AvaSyaka Ahe. phajra (prAtaHkAlIna) cyA namAjapUrvI ANi johara (madhyAnha) cyA veLI jevhA tumhI Apale kapaDe utaravUna ThevatA ANi IzA (rAtrI) cyA namAjanaMtara, yA tinhI veLA tumacyA (ekAMta) ANi paDadyAcyA Aheta. yA veLAMkherIja, nA tumacyAvara kAhI doSa Ahe, nA tyAMcyAvara. tumhI sarva ApasAta jAsta karUna ekamekAMcyA javaLa yeNe-jANe karaNAre Aheta. azA prakAre allAha Apale Adeza agadI spaSTa karUna sAMgata Ahe ANi allAha jANaNArA ANi hikamata bALagaNArA Ahe.

ANi tumacyApaikI jI mule taruNa (jANatyA) vayAsa pohacatIla tara jyApramANe tyAMcyA pUrvIce (moThe) loka anumatI mAgatAta, tyAMnI dekhIla anumatI gheUna Ale pAhije. allAha azA prakAre tumhAlA ApalyA AyatI spaSTataH sAMgato. allAhaca jANaNArA ANi hikamata bALagaNArA Ahe.

ANi moThyA mhAtAr2yA striyA, jyAMnA ApalyA vivAhAcI AzA (ANi icchA) ca rAhilI nasAvI, tyA jara Apale kapaDe (paDadyAsAThI vAparalele) utaravUna ThevatIla tara tyAMcyAvara kAhI doSa nAhI (mAtra yA aTIvara) kI tyA ApalI zobhA- sajAvaTa dAkhaviNAr2yA nasAvyAta. tathApi tyAMcyAsAThI heca adhika cAMgale Ahe kI tyAMnI yApAsUna alipta rAhAve. ANi allAha sarva kAhI aikaNArA va jANaNArA Ahe.

AMdhaLyAlA, pAMgaLyAlA, rogyAlA ANi svataH tumhAlA kadhIhI kasalIhI harakata nAhI kI tumhI ApalyA gharI, mAvazA kiMvA ApalyA pityAcyA gharI kiMvA ApalyA mAtAMcyA gharI kiMvA ApalyA bhAvAMcyA gharI kiMvA ApalyA bahINIMcyA gharI kiMvA ApalyA culatyAMcyA gharI kiMvA ApalyA AtyAMcyA gharI kiMvA ApalyA mAmAMcyA gharI kiMvA ApalyA mAvazIMcyA gharI kiMvA tyA gharAMmadhye, jyAMcyA killyA tumacyA mAlakIcyA asAvyAta kiMvA ApalyA mitrAMcyA gharI, tumacyAvara yAtahI kAhI gunhA nAhI kI tumhI sarva ekatra basUna jevaNa ghyAve kiMvA vegavegaLe basUna paraMtu jevhA tumhI gharAMmadhye praveza karU lAgAla tevhA ApalyA gharacyA lokAMnA salAma karIta jA. zubha kAmanA Ahe, jI maMgalaprada ANi pavitra allAhatarphe avatarita Ahe. azA prakAre allAha, Apale Adeza tumhAlA spaSTa karUna sAMgata Ahe, yAsAThI kI tumhI samajUna ghyAve.

ImAna rAkhaNAre loka tara teca Aheta je allAhavara ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAvara ImAna rAkhatAta, ANi jevhA azA samasyeta, lokAMnI ekatra hoNyAcI AvazyakatA asate paigaMbarAMsobata asatAta, tevhA joparyaMta tumacyAkaDUna anumatI gheta nAhIta, koThehI jAta nAhIta. je loka (azA prasaMgI) tumacyAkaDUna anumatI ghetAta, vAstivaka te heca loka hota, jyAMnI allAhavara ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAvara ImAna rAkhalele Ahe. tevhA ase loka jevhA tumacyAkaDUna ApalyA ekhAdyA kAmAkaritA anumatI (paravanAgI) mAgatIla tevhA tumhI tyAMcyApaikI jyAlA icchita asAla anumatI dyA ANi tyAMcyAsAThI allAhajavaLa mAphIcI prArthanA karA. niHsaMzaya, allAha mApha karaNArA, dayA kRpA karaNArA Ahe.

tumhI (allAhacyA) paigaMbarAcyA bolivaNyAsa ase sarvasAdhAraNa bolivaNe samajU nakA jase ApasAta ekamekAMce asate. tumacyApaikI allAha tyAMnA cAMgalyA prakAre jANato je najara TALUna gupacUpa nighUna jAtAta. (aikA) je loka paigaMbarAcyA AdezAcA virodha karatAta tyAMnI bhaya bALagUna rAhAve kI kadAcita tyAMcyAvara ekhAdA phAra moThA upadrava (phitanA) yeUna na kosaLAvA kiMvA tyAcyAvara ekhAdA duHkhAcA AghAta na vhAvA.

jANUna ghyA kI AkAzAMta ANi dharatIvara je kAhI Ahe sarva allAhaceca Ahe, jyA mArgAvara tumhI AhAta, to mArga allAha cAMgalyA prakAre jANato ANi jyA divazI he sarva tyAcyAkaDe paratavile jAtIla, tyA divazI tyAMnA tyAMcyA kRtakarmAMzI avagata karavila ANi sarvazreSTha allAha sarva kAhI jANaNArA Ahe.
moThA barakatazAlI (samRddhazAlI) Ahe to allAha jyAne ApalyA dAsAvara phuraqAna avatirata kele. yAsAThI kI to samasta lokAMkaritA khabaradAra karaNArA TharAvA.

tyAca allAhace adhirAjya Ahe AkAzAMvara ANi dharatIvara ANi to koNatIhI saMtatI bALagata nAhI, nA tyAcyA rAjyasatteta tyAcA koNI bhAgIdAra Ahe, ANi pratyeka vastUlA nirmANa karUna tyAne eka nirdhArita svarUpa dile Ahe.

ANi tyA lokAMnI allAhakherIja jyAMnA Apale ArAdhya daivata banavUna Thevale Ahe, te koNatIhI vastU nirmANa karU zakata nAhI, kiMbahunA te svataH(ekhAdyAkaDUna) nirmANa kele jAtAta te svataH ApalyA lAbha-hAnicA adhikAra bALagata nAhIta ANi nA jIvana-mRtyucA ANi nA dusar2yAMdA jivaMta hoUna uThaNyAce te mAlaka Aheta.

ANi kAphira (inkArI) loka mhaNAle, he tara kevaLa tyAne svataH racalele asatya Ahe jyA kAmAta dusar2yA lokAMnIhI tyAlA madata kelI Ahe. vastutaH he kAphira moThe atyAcArI ANi nivvaLa asatya ANaNAre banaleta.
ANi te asehI mhaNAle kI yA tara pUrvI hoUna gelelyA lokAMcyA kathA-kahANyA Aheta, jyA tyAne lihUna ThevalyA Aheta, ANi tyAca sakALa-saMdhyAkALa tyAcyAsamora vAcalyA jAtAta.
sAMgA, yAlA tara tyA allAhane avatarita kele Ahe, jo AkAza va dharatIcyA sarva lapalelyA goSTI jANato. niHsaMzaya to moThA mApha karaNArA ANi dayA karaNArA Ahe.

ANi te mhaNAle kI hA kasA paigaMbara Ahe kI bhojana karato ANi bAjArAta cAlato phirato, tyAcyAjavaLa ekhAdA phariztA kA nAhI pAThavilA jAta kI to dekhIla tyAcyA sobatIlA rAhUna khabaradAra karaNArA banalA asatA.

kiMvA tyAcyAjavaLa ekhAdA khajinAca TAkalA gelA asatA kiMvA tyAcI ekhAdI bAga tarI asatI, jyAtUna to khAta rAhilA asatA. ANi tyA atyAcArI lokAMnI mhaTale kI tumhI tara azA mANasAcyA mAge cAlU lAgalAta, jyAcyAvara jAdU-ToNA kelA gelA Ahe.
jarA vicAra karA, he loka tumacyAviSayI kasakazA goSTI bolata Aheta kI jyAmuLe svataHca mArgabhraSTa hota Aheta ANi kazAhI prakAre mArgAvara yeU zakata nAhI.

allAha tara asA samRddhazAlI Ahe kI tyAne icchilyAsa tumhAlA azA aneka bAgA pradAna karIla, jyA tyAMnI sAMgitalelyA bAgAMpekSA khUpa cAMgalyA asatIla, jyAMcyA khAlI pravAha vAhata asAveta ANi tumhAlA aneka pakke mahAla dekhIla pradAna karIla.
kharI goSTa azI kI loka kayAmatalA khoTe samajatAta ANi kayAmatalA khoTe TharaviNAr2yAMkaritA AmhI dhagadhagaNArI Aga tayAra karUna ThevalI Ahe.
jevhA tI yAMnA durUna pAhIla tevhA he tice krodhAne bekAbU hoNe ANi bhayaMkara garjanA aikatIla.
ANi jevhA yAMnA jahannamacyA ekhAdyA taMga (saMkucita) jAgeta bAMdhUna phekUna dile jAIla tevhA tithe ApalyAsAThI maraNAlA pukAratIla.
(tyAMnA sAMgitale jAIla) Aja ekAca maraNAlA pukArU nakA, kiMbahunA aneka maraNAMnA hAka mArA.
tumhI sAMgA, kAya he adhika cAMgale Ahe kI tI kAyamasvarUpI jannata, jicA vAyadA neka- sadAcArI lokAMnA dilA gelA Ahe, jo tyAMcA mobadalA Ahe ANi tyAMcyA paratIce mULa ThikANa Ahe.
te je kAhI icchitIla te tyAMcyAsAThI tithe hajara asela, nehamI rAhaNAre hA tara tumacyA pAlanakartyAcA vAyadA Ahe, jyAcI mAgaNI kelI gelI pAhije.

ANi jyA divazI allAha tyAMnA ANi allAhakherIja jyAcI he upAsanA karIta rAhile tyA sarvAMnA ekatra karUna vicArela, kAya mAjh‌yA yA dAsAMnA tumhI mArgabhraSTa kele kI he svataH mArgApAsUna vicalita jhAle?

te uttara detIla, pavitra Ahesa tU! svataH AmacyAsAThI he yogya navhate kI tujhyAkherIja dusar2yAMnA ApalA mitra- sahAyyaka banavile asate. kharI goSTa azI kI tU yAMnA ANi yAMcyA vADavaDilAMnA sukha- saMpannatA pradAna kelI yetheparyaMta kI he bodha- upadeza visarale. he loka vinAzAsa pAtraca hote.

tevhA tyAMnI tumhAlA tumacyA sarva goSTIMmadhye khoTe Tharavile. AtA nA tara tumacyAta ApalI zikSA TALaNyAcI tAkada Ahe nA madata karaNyAcI. tumacyApaikI jyAne dekhIla atyAcAra kelA, AmhI tyAlA sakta zikSA- yAtanecI goDI cAkhavU.

ANi AmhI tumacyApUrvI jevaDhe dekhIla paigaMbara pAThavile te sarva bhojanahI karIta asata ANi bAjArAtahI hiMData phirata asata, ANi AmhI tumacyApaikI pratyekAlA dusar2yAcyA kasoTIce mAdhyama banavile. kAya tumhI dhIra- saMyama rAkhAla? ANi tumacA pAlanakartA sarva kAhI pAhaNArA Ahe.

ANi jyAMnA AmacyA bheTIcI AzA nAhI, te mhaNAle kI AmacyAvara pharizte kA nAhI avatarita kele jAta? kiMvA AmhI (ApalyA DoLyAMnI) ApalyA pAlanakartyAsa pAhile asate? tyA lokAMnI svataH ApalyAlAca khUpa moThe samajUna ghetale Ahe ANi phAra avajJA kelI Ahe.
jyA divazI he phariztyAMnA pAhatIla tyA divazI yA aparAdhyAMkaritA koNatAhI AnaMda nasela ANi mhaNatIla kI vaMcitaca vaMcita Thevale gelo.
ANi tyAMnI je je karma kele hote AmhI tyAMcyAkaDe puDhe hoUna tyAMnA kaNAMpramANe kSata-vikSata karUna TAkale.
(paraMtu) tyA divazI jannatamadhye rAhaNAr2yAMce ThikANa phAra cAMgale asela, ANi vizrAmasthAnahI sukhadAyaka asela.
ANi jyA divazI AkAza DhagAMsaha phATUna jAIla ANi pharizte satata utaravile jAtIla.
tyA divazI yogyarityA rAjyasattA kevaLa rahamAnacIca(kRpALu) asela, ANi hA divasa kAphirAMkaritA moThA sakta asela.
ANi tyA divazI atyAcArI, ApalyA hAtAMnA cAvA gheUna mhaNela, arere! mI paigaMbarAcA mArga aMgIkAralA asatA tara bare jhAle asate!
arere! mI amuka ekA isamAlA mitra banavile nasate tara bare jhAle asate!
tyAne tara malA tyAnaMtara mArgabhraSTa kele, jevhA upadeza mAjhyAjavaLa yeUna pohocalA hotA ANi saitAna tara mAnavAlA (veLevara) dagA deNArA Ahe.
ANi paigaMbara mhaNela kI he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! niHsaMzaya, mAjhyA janasamUhAne yA kuraAnAsa soDUna dile hote.
ANi azA prakAre AmhI kAhI aparAdhyAMnA pratyeka paigaMbarAMce zatrU banavile Ahe ANi tumacA pAlanakartAca mArgadarzana karaNArA ANi madata karaNArA puresA Ahe.

ANi kAphira mhaNAle kI tyAcyAvara saMpUrNa kuraAna ekAca veLI kA nAhI avatarita kele gele? azA prakAre (AmhI thoDe thoDe karUna avatarita kele) yAsAThI kI yAdvaAre AmhI tumacyA hRdayAsa majabUtI pradAna karAvI. ANi AmhI tyAsa thAMbUna thAMbUnaca vAcUna aikavile Ahe.
ANi he tumacyAjavaLa je kAhI udAharaNa gheUna yetIla AmhI tyAce khare uttara ANi yogya spaSTIkaraNa sAMgU.
je loka toMDaghazI pADUna jahannamakaDe ekatra kele jAtIla, tara teca moThyA vAITa ThikANAce ANi bhraSTa mArgAce Aheta.
ANi niHsaMzaya, AmhI mUsAlA graMtha pradAna kelA ANi tyAMcyAsobata tyAMcA bhAU hArUnalA tyAMcA sahAyyaka banavile.
ANi sAMgitale kI tumhI doghe tyA lokAMkaDe jA, je AmacyA nizANyAMnA khoTe Tharavita Aheta. maga AmhI tyAMcA agadI sarvanAza kelA.

ANi nUhacyA janasamUhAnehI jevhA paigaMbarAMnA khoTe Tharavile, tevhA AmhI tyAMnA buDavUna TAkale ANi lokAMkaritA tyAMnA bodhaprAptIce cinha banavile ANi AmhI atyAcArIMkaritA moThI kaThora zikSA tayAra karUna ThevalI Ahe.
ANi ‘Ada’ janasamUha ANi ‘samUda’ janasamUha ANi vihIravAlyAMnA ANi tyAMcyA daramyAnacyA aneka saMpradAyAMnA naSTa karUna TAkale.
ANi AmhI pratyekAsamora udAharaNe prastuta kelI, maga pratyekAlA pUrNataH naSTa kele.

ANi he loka tyA vastIjavaLUnahI ye-jA karatAta, jicyAvara moThA vAITa prakAracA pAUsa pADalA gelA. kAya he tarIhI te pAhata nAhIta? kharI goSTa azI kI tyAMnA melyAnaMtara dusar2yAMdA jivaMta hoUna ubhe rAhaNyAvara vizvAsaca nAhI.
ANi tumhAlA jevhA kadhI pAhatAta, tevhA tumacI thaTTA uDavU lAgatAta, hAca kAya to mANUsa jyAlA allAhane rasUla banavUna pAThavilA Ahe?

(evaDhe bare) kI AmhI aTaLa rAhilo, anyathA yAne tara AmhAlA AmacyA ArAdhya daivatAMpAsUna vicalita karaNyAta kAhIca kasara soDalI navhatI. ANi jevhA he (allAhacyA) zikSA- yAtanAMnA pAhatIla tevhA tyAMnA spaSTataH kaLUna yeIla kI pUrNapaNe mArgApAsUna bhaTakalelA koNa hotA?
kAya tumhI tyAlAhI pAhile jyAne ApalyA icchA-AkAMkSAMnA devatA (upAsya) banavUna Thevale Ahe. kAya tumhI tyAcI jabAbadArI gheU zakatA?
kAya tumhI yAca vicArAta AhAta kI tyAMcyApaikI bahuteka jaNa aikatAta kiMvA samajatAta. te tara agadI janAvarAMsArakhe Aheta, kiMbahunA tyAMcyApekSAhI adhika vATa cukalele.
kAya tumhI nAhI pAhile kI tumacyA pAlanakartyAne sAvalIlA kazA prakAre vistRta kele Ahe. tyAne icchile asate tara tilA sthira kele asate, maga sUryAlA AmhI tyAvara pramANa Tharavile.
maga AmhI tyAlA haLU haLU ApalyAkaDe oDhUna ghetale.
ANi toca Ahe, jyAne rAtrIlA tumacyAsAThI poSAkha banavile, ANi jhopelA sukha zAMtImaya banavile ANi divasAlA uThUna ubhe rAhaNyAcI veLa.
ANi toca Ahe jo kRpAsvarUpa pAvasApUrvI khUzakhabara deNAr2yA havelA pAThavito ANi AmhI AkAzAtUna atizaya svaccha- zuddha (pAka) pANI varSavito.
yAsAThI kI tyAcyAdvAre mRta jhAlelyA zaharAlA jivaMta karAve ANi te AmhI ApalyA nirmitIpaikI adhikAMza janAvarAMnA ANi mANasAMnA pAjato.
ANi niHsaMzaya, AmhI yAsa tyAMcyA daramyAna aneka prakAre varNana kele yAsAThI kI tyAMnI bodha prApta karAvA, paraMtu tarIhI adhikAMza lokAMnI kRtaghnatekherIja (ANakhI kAhI) mAnale nAhI.
ANi AmhI jara icchile asate tara pratyeka vastIta eka bhaya dAkhaviNArA pAThavilA asatA.
tevhA tumhI kAphirAMce mhaNaNe mAnya karU nakA ANi kuraAnadvAre pUrNa zaktIne tyAMcyAzI mahAdharmayuddha (jihAda) karA.
ANi toca Ahe jyAne dona samudrAMnA ApasAta miLavUna Thevale Ahe. eka Ahe goDa cavadAra ANi dusarA khArA kaDU ANi ANi yA doghAMcyA daramyAna eka ADa paDadA ANi bhakkama ADa ubhA kelA.

ANi toca Ahe jyAne pANyApAsUna mAnavAlA nirmANa kele, maga tyAlA vaMza bALagaNArA ANi sAsaravADIce nAtesaMbaMdha rAkhaNArA banavile. niHsaMzaya, tumacA pAlanakartA pratyeka goSTa karaNyAsa samartha Ahe.
ANi he allAhaaivajI azAMcI upAsanA karatAta je nA tyAMnA kAhI lAbha pohacavU zakatAta ANi nA kAhI hAni pohacavU zakatAta. kAphira tara Aheca ApalyA pAlanakartyAvirUddha (saitAnA) cA sahAyyaka.
ANi AmhI tumhAlA khUzakhabara deNArA ANi khabaradAra karaNArA (paigaMbara) banavUna pAThavile Ahe.
sAMgA kI mI (kuraAna pohacavilyAbaddala) tumacyAkaDUna kasalehI pArizramika icchita nAhI, paraMtu he kI jo icchila tyAne ApalyA pAlanakartyAcA mArga aMgIkArAvA.

ANi tyA cirakAla rAhaNAr2yA allAhavara pUrNa vizvAsa rAkhAvA, jyAlA kadhIhI mRtyu nAhI tyAcyA prazaMsesaha tyAcI pavitratA (tasbIha) varNana karIta rAhAve. to ApalyA dAsAMce aparAdha cAMgalyA prakAre jANato.

toca Ahe jyAne AkAzAMnA ANi jaminIlA ANi tyAMcyA daramyAna asalelyA samasta vastUMnA sahA divasAMta nirmANa kele, maga to arza (Iza-siMhAsanA) vara bulaMda jhAlA. to rahamAna Ahe, tumhI tyAcyAviSayI ekhAdyA jANakArAlA vicArA.

ANi tyAMnA jevhA dekhIla sAMgitale jAte kI rahamAna (dayAvAna allAha) lA sajadA karA (tyAcyApuDhe mAthA TekA) tevhA te mhaNatAta kI rahamAna kAya Ahe? kAya AmhI tyAlA sajadA karAvA, jyAcA Adeza tumhI AmhAlA deta AhAta ANi (yA AvAhanAne) tyAMcyA tiraskArAta vADhaca hote.
