moThA zubha- maMgalaprada Ahe to jyAne AkAzAta buruja banavile, ANi tyAta sUrya banavilA ANi prakAzamAna caMdra dekhIla.
ANi tyAneca rAtra ANi divasAlA ekA pAThopATha ye-jA karaNArA banavile tyA mANasAcyA bodha- upadezAkaritA, jo bodha prApta karaNyAcA kiMvA kRtajJazIla hoNyAcA irAdA rAkhata asela.
ANi rahamAna (dayAvAna allAha) ce sacce dAsa te Aheta, je jaminIvara naramIne cAlatAta ANi jevhA ajJAnI loka tyAMcyAzI bolU lAgatAta, tevhA te mhaNatAta salAma Ahe.
ANi je ApalyA pAlanakartyAsamora sajadA karatAta ANi ubhe rAhUna (namAjacyA avastheta) rAtra ghAlavitAta.
ANi je duA (prArthanA) karatAta kI he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! jahannamacyA zikSA- yAtanelA AmacyApAsUna dUraca Theva, kAraNa ticI zikSA agadI cikaTUna rAhaNArI Ahe.
te kAyamasvarUpI ThikANa ANi nivAsAcyA dRSTIne moThI vAITa jAgA Ahe.
ANi je kharca karatAnAhI nA udhaLapaTTI karatAta, nA kaMjUsapaNA, kiMbahunA yA doghAMmadhIla samatola mArga asato.

ANi je allAhasobata dusar2yA ekhAdyA upAsyAlA pukArata nAhI, ANi ekhAdyA azA mANasAlA, jyAcI hatyA karaNe allAhane harAma (avaidha) kele asAve, tyAcI nAhaka hatyA karIta nAhI, nA te vyabhicAra karatAta ANi jo koNI he karma karIla tara to svataHvara kaThora zikSA oDhavUna gheIla.
tyAlA kayAmatacyA divazI duppaTa az2Aba (zikSA- yAtanA) dilA jAIla ANi to apamAna ANi anAdarAsaha sadaiva tetheca rAhIla.
tyA lokAMkherIja, je mAphI mAgatIla ANi ImAna rAkhatIla ANi nekIce karma karatIla tara azA lokAMce aparAdha, allAha satkamarmAta badalato. allAha moThA mApha karaNArA ANi dayA karaNArA Ahe.
ANi jo manuSya mAphI mAgela ANi satkarma karata rAhIla tara to vAstavikapaNe allAhakaDe kharA jhukAva rAkhato.
ANi je khoTI sAkSa deta nAhIta, ANi jevhA te ekhAdyA nirarthaka ANi vyartha goSTIjavaLUna jAtAta, tevhA pratiSThApUrvaka jAtAta.
ANi jevhA tyAMnA tyAMcyA pAlanakartyA (cI vacane ANi vAyadyAMsaMbaMdhI) cyA AyatI aikavilyA jAtAta tevhA te tyAvara AMdhaLe-bahIre hoUna uDI gheta nAhIta.
ANi azI duA (prArthanA) karatAta kI he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! tU AmhAlA AmacyA patnyA ANi saMtatIdvAre netrAMnA zitalatA pradAna kara ANi AmhAlA neka- sadAcArI lokAMcA netA banava.
heca te loka hota, jyAMnA tyAMcyA sahanazIlatecyA mobadalyAta (jannatace uMca) sajje pradAna kele jAtIla, tithe tyAMnA AzIrvAda ANi salAma pohacavilA jAIla.
tithe te nehamI nehamI rAhatIla, tI atizaya cAMgalI jAgA ANi ArAmAce ThikANa Ahe.
sAMgA, jara tumacI mRdu- komala duA (prArthanA) nasatI, tara mAjhyA pAlanakartyAne tumacI kadApi parvA kelI nasatI. tumhI tara khoTe Tharavile Ahe. AtA lavakaraca tyAcI zikSA tumhAlA yeUna dharela.
tA - sIna - mIma.
yA divya graMthAcyA AyatI Aheta.
tyAMnI ImAna na rAkhalyAbaddala kadAcita tumhI ApalA jIva soDAla.
jara AmhI icchile asate tara tyAMcyAvara AkAzAtUna ekhAdI azI nizANI avatarita kelI asatI kI jicyAsamora tyAMcyA mAnA jhukalyA asatyA.
ANi tyAMcyAjavaLa rahamAna (dayAvAna allAha) kaDUna je dekhIla nave bodha- upadeza Ale, tyAkaDUna toMDa phiraviNAre banale.
tyA lokAMnI khoTe Tharavile Ahe, AtA lavakaraca tyAMcyAjavaLa, tyA goSTIcI vArtA yeUna pohacela, jicI te thaTTA uDavita Aheta.
kAya tyAMnI jaminIkaDe nAhI pAhile kI AmhI ticyAta pratyeka prakAracyA suMdara joDyA kitItarI ugavilyA Aheta.
niHsaMzaya tyAta moThI nizANI Ahe, tathApi tyAMcyApaikI bahuteka loka ImAna rAkhaNAra nAhIta.
ANi niHsaMzaya tumacA pAlanakartA varcasvazAlI ANi dayAvAna Ahe.
ANi jevhA tumacyA pAlanakartyAne mUsAlA pukArale kI tU atyAcArI janasamUhAjavaLa jA.
phiraaunacyA janasamUhAjavaLa. kAya te sadAcaraNa karaNAra nAhIta?
mUsA mhaNAle, he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! malA tara bhaya vATate kI kadAcita tyAMnI malA khoTe (na) TharavAve.
ANi mAjhI chAtI (hRdaya) saMkucita hota Ahe. mAjhI jIbha vaLata nAhI yAstava tU hArUnakaDehI vahayI (prakAzanA) pAThava.
ANi tyAMcA mAjhyAvara, mAjhyA ekA cukIcA (dAvA) hI Ahe. malA bhaya vATate kI kadAcita tyAMnI mAjhI hatyA na karUna TAkAvI.
(allAhane) pharmAvile, ase kadApi hoNAra nAhI. thumhI doghe AmacyA nizANyAMsaha jA. AmhI svataH aikaNAre tumacyA sobatIlA Ahota.
tumhI doghe phiraaunajavaLa jAUna sAMgA kI niHsaMzaya AmhI sAr2yA jagAcyA pAlanakartyAtarphe pAThavilele Ahota.
kI tU AmacyAsobata isrAIlacyA saMtatIlA pAThava.
(phiraauna) mhaNAlA, kAya AmhI tujhe, tujhyA bAlapaNAta ApalyA yethe pAlanapoSaNa kele navhate? ANi tU ApalyA vayAcI (AyUSyAcI) aneka varSe AmacyAta nAhI kADhalIta?
ANi naMtara tU je Apale kAma kele te kele ANi tU kRtaghna lokAMpaikI Ahesa.
(mUsA) mhaNAle, mI he kAma azA veLI kele jevhA mI vATa cukalelyA lokAMpaikI hoto.
naMtara mI tumacyA dahazatImuLe tumacyApAsUna paLAlo, maga malA mAjhyA pAlanakartyAne Adeza va jJAna pradAna kele ANi malA ApalyA paigaMbarAMpaikI kele.
ANi kAya mAjhyAvara tujhA hAca to upakAra Ahe? jo tU jAhIra karIta Ahesa kI tU isrAIlacyA saMtatIlA gulAma banavUna Thevale Ahe.
phiraauna mhaNAlA kI sarva vizvAMcA svAmI va pAlanakartA kAya Ahe?
(hajarata mUsA) mhaNAle, to AkAzAMcA ANi dharatIcA ANi tyAMcyA daramyAnacyA samasta vastUMcA svAmI va pAlanakartA Ahe, jara tumhI ImAna rAkhaNAre asAla.
(phiraauna) ApalyA nikaTacyA lokAMnA mhaNAlA, kAya tumhI aikata nAhI?
(hajarata mUsA) mhaNAle, to tumacA ANi tumacyA pUrvajAMcAhI svAmI va pAlanakartA Ahe.
(phiraauna) mhaNAlA, (lokAMno) tumacA hA paigaMbara, jo tumacyAkaDe pAThavilA gelA Ahe, hA tara agadIca veDA Ahe.
(hajarata mUsA) mhaNAle, toca pUrva ANi pazcimecA ANi tyAcyA daramyAna asalelyA samasta vastUMcA pAlanakartA Ahe, jara tumhI akkala bALagata asAla.
(phiraauna) mhaNAlA, khabaradAra jara tU mAjhyAzivAya dusar2yA koNAlA upAsya banavile tara mI tulA kaida karUna TAkIna.
(mUsA) mhaNAle, mI tujhyAjavaLa ekhAdI spaSTa vastU gheUna AlyAvarahI?
(phiraauna) mhaNAlA, jara tU saccA lokAMpaikI Ahesa tara tI sAdara kara.
tyAMnI (tyAca veLI) ApalI kAThI khAlI TAkalI tI acAnaka ughaDa ughaDa (phAra moThA) ajagara banalI.
ANi ApalA hAta bAhera kADhalA tara to dekhIla tyAca kSaNI pAhaNAr2yAMnA zubhra prakAzamaya disU lAgalA.
(phiraauna) ApalyA javaLacyA saradArAMnA mhaNU lAgalA kI hA tara phAra moThA niSNAta jAdUgAra Ahe.
hA tara ase icchito kI ApalyA jAdUcyA jorAvara tumhAlA tumacyA bhUmItUna bAhera kADhAve. sAMgA, AtA tumhI kAya sallA detA?
te sarva mhaNAle, tumhI yAlA ANi yAcyA bhAvAlA savaDa dyA ANi sarva zaharAMmadhye (lokAMnA) ekatra karaNAre pAThavA.
jyAMnI tumacyAjavaLa niSNAta jAdUgArAMnA gheUna yAve.
maga ekA nirdhArita divasAcyA veLI sarva jAdUgAra ekatrita kele gele.
ANi sarvasAmAnya lokAMnAhI sAMgitale gele kI tumhI dekhIla jamA vhAla.
yAsAThI kI jara jAdUgAra prabhAvI Tharale tara AmhI tyAMceca anusaraNa karU.
jAdUgAra yeUna phiraaunalA mhaNU lAgale kI jara AmhI jiMkalo tara AmhAlA kAhI bakSIsa vagaire miLela nA!
(phiraauna) mhaNAlA, hoya! (moThyA khuzIne) kiMbahunA azA paristhitIta tumhI mAjhe khAsa darabArI vhAla.
(hajarata) mUsA jAdUgArAMnA mhaNAle, je kAya tumhAlA TAkAyace Ahe, te TAkA.
tyAMnI ApalyA dor2yA ANi kAThyA khAlI TAkalyA ANi mhaNAle, phiraaunacyA pratiSThecI zapatha, AmhI avazya vijayI hoU.
AtA (hajarata) mUsA yAMnIhI ApalI kAThI khAlI TAkalI, jine tyAca kSaNI tyAMcA asatyAcA banavilelA kheLa giLAyalA suruvAta kelI.
he pAhatAca te jAdUgAra sajadyAta paDale.
ANi tyAMnI spaSTapaNe sAMgitale kI AmhI tara sarva vizvAcyA pAlanakartyAvara ImAna rAkhale.
arthAta mUsA ANi hArUnacyA pAlanakartyAvara.

(phiraauna) mhaNAlA, mAjhI paravAnagI gheNyApUrvIca tumhI tyAcyAvara ImAna rAkhale, nizcitaca hA tumacA saradAra (moThA gurU) Ahe, jyAne tumhA sarvAMnA jAdU zikavalI Ahe. tevhA tumhAlA attAca mAhIta paDela. zapatha Ahe. mI dekhIla tumace hAta pAya virUddha dizAMnI kApUna TAkIna ANi tumhA sarvAMnA phAsAvara laTakavIna.
te mhaNAle, kAhI harakata nAhI, AmhI tara ApalyA pAlanakartyAkaDe paratUna jANAraca Ahota.
yA kAraNAstava kI AmhI sarvAMta prathama ImAna rAkhaNAre banalo Ahota, AmhI AzA bALagato kI AmacA svAmI va pAlanakartA AmacyA sarva cukA mApha karIla.
ANi AmhI mUsAvara vahayI (prakAzanA) kelI kI rAtrIcyA rAtrI mAjhyA dAsAMnA gheUna nighA. tumhA sarvAMcA pAThalAga kelA jAIla.
phiraaunane zaharAMmadhye jamA karaNAr2yAMnA pAThavile.
kI nizcitaca hA samUha atizaya kamI saMkhyeta Ahe.
ANi tyAvara he AmhAlA phAra krodhita karIta Aheta.
ANi niHsaMzaya, AmhI moThyA saMkhyeta Ahota, tyAMcyApAsUna sAvadha rAhaNAre.
zevaTI AmhI tyAMnA bAgAMmadhUna va jhar2yAMmadhUna bAhera kADhale.
ANi khajinyAMmadhUna ANi cAMgalyA cAMgalyA ThikANAMmadhUna.
azA prakAre jhAle, ANi AmhI tyA (sarva vastUM) cA vArasa isrAIlacyA saMtatIlA banavile.
yAstava phiraaunace anuyAyI sUrya ugavatAca tyAMcA pAThalAga karaNyAsa nighAle.
yAsAThI jevhA doghAMnI ekamekAMnA pAhile tevhA mUsAce sAthIdAra mhaNAle, AmhI tara khAtrIne pakaDIta Alo.
(hajarata mUsA) mhaNAle, kadApi nAhI. vizvAsa rAkhA, mAjhA raba (pAlanakartA) mAjhyA sobatIlA Ahe. jo jarUra malA mArga dAkhavila.
AmhI mUsAkaDe vahayI (prakAzanA) pAThavilI kI samudrAcyA pANyAvara ApalyA kAThIcA prahAra karA tevhA tyAca kSaNI samudra dubhaMgalA ANi pratyeka hissA pANyAcyA moThyA parvatAitakA jhAlA.
ANi AmhI tyAca ThikANI dusar2yAMnA javaLa ANUna ubhe kele.
ANi mUsA ANi tyAMcyA sarva sAthIdArAMnA muktI pradAna kelI.
maga itara sarvAMnA buDavUna TAkale.
niHsaMzaya, yAta phAra moThA bodha Ahe ANi tyAMcyApaikI adhikAMza loka ImAna rAkhaNAre nAhIta.
ANi niHsaMzaya tumacA pAlanakartA moThA varcasvazAlI ANi dayA karaNArA Ahe.
ANi tyAMnA ibrAhImacA vRttAMtahI aikavA.
jevhA tyAMnI ApalyA pityAsa ANi ApalyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMnA pharmAvile kI tumhI koNAcI upAsanA karatA?
tyAMnI uttara dile kI AmhI mUrtIMcI upAsanA karato. AmhI tara satata tyAMce upAsaka banUna basalo Ahota.
paigaMbara (ibrAhIma alai.) yAMnI vicArale, jevhA tumhI yAMnA pukAratA tevhA kAya te aikatAtahI?
kiMvA tumhAlA naphA - nukasAnahI pohacavU zakatAta?
te mhaNAle, he (sarva AmhI nAhI jANata) AmhAlA tara Amace pUrvaja aseca karatAnA ADhaLale Aheta.
(ibrAhIma) mhaNAle, tyAMnA kAhI jANatA, jyAMcI tumhI pUjA karIta AhAta?
tumhI ANi tumacyA pUrvIce vADavaDIla.
te sarva mAjhe zatrU Aheta, tyA saccA allAhakherIja, jo sarva vizvAcA pAlanakartA Ahe.
jyAne malA nirmANa kele ANi toca malA mArgadarzana karato.
toca Ahe jo malA khAU-piU ghAlato.
taseca jevhA mI AjArI paDato tevhA to malA svAsthya pradAna karato.
ANi toca malA mRtyu deIla ANi maga punhA jivaMta karIla.
ANi jyAcyAkaDUna AzA bALagato kI to mobadalA dilA jANyAcyA divazI mAjhe aparAdha mApha karIla.
he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! malA hikamata (buddhI kauzalya) pradAna kara ANi malA neka- sadAcArI lokAMmadhye sAmIla kara.
ANi mAjhe pavitra - smaraNa (bhaviSyAta) yeNAr2yA lokAMmadhyehI bAkI Theva.
ANi malA sukhAMnI bharalelyA jannatacyA vArasAMpaikI banava.
ANi mAjhyA pityAsa kSamA kara. niHsaMzaya to mArgabhraSTa lokAMpaikI hotA.
ANi jyA divazI loka dusar2yAMdA jivaMta kele jAtIla, malA apamAnita karU nakosa.
jyA divazI dhana-saMpattI ANi saMtatI kAhIca upayogI paDaNAra nAhI.
paraMtu (lAbhAnvita toca Tharela) jo allAhasamora vyaMgavirahita hRdaya neIla.
ANi neka sadAcArI lokAMkaritA jannatalA agadI javaLa ANale jAIla.
ANi mArgabhraSTa lokAMkaritA jahannama ughaDa kelI jAIla.
ANi tyAMnA vicArale jAIla kI tumhI jyAMcI upAsanA karIta rAhile, te koThe Aheta?
je sarvazreSTha allAhakherIjace hote. kAya he tumacI madata karatAta kiMvA ekhAdA badalA gheU zakatAta?
yAstava te sarva ANi samasta mArgabhraSTa loka jahannamamadhye vara khAlI phekale jAtIla.
ANi iblisa (saitAnA) ce saMpUrNa sainyahI.
tithe te ApasAta bhAMDaNa - taMTA karIta mhaNatIla,
allAhacI zapatha! niHsaMzaya, AmhI tara ughaTa azA cukIMvara hoto.
vAstavika tumhAlA sarva vizvAcyA pAlanakartyAsamAna samajata hoto.
ANi AmhAlA tara gunhegArAMkherIja itara koNIhI mArgabhraSTa kele navhate.
AtA tara AmacI koNI ziphArasa karaNArAhI nAhI.
ANi nA ekhAdA (saccA) hitaciMtaka mitra.
jara AmhAlA eka veLa dusar2yAMdA jANyAcI saMdhI lAbhalI asatI tara AmhI pakke sacce ImAnadhAraka banalo asato.
niHsaMzaya, yAta eka phAra moThI nizANI Ahe, paraMtu tyAMcyApaikI bahuteka loka ImAna rAkhaNAre nAhIta.
ANi niHsaMzaya, tumacA pAlanakartAca varcasvazAlI, dayAvAna Ahe.
nUhacyA janasamUhAnehI paigaMbarAMnA khoTe Tharavile.
jevhA tyAMcA bhAU nUha yAMnI sAMgitale, kAya tumhI allAhace bhaya nAhI rAkhata?
(aikA!) mI tumacyAkaDe allAhacA vizvasta rasUla (paigaMbara) Ahe.
tevhA tumhI allAhace bhaya bALagale pAhije ANi mAjhe mhaNaNe mAnya kele pAhije.
ANi mI tumacyAkaDUna tyAbaddala koNatAhI mobadalA icchita nAhI. mAjhA mobadalA tara kevaLa sarva vizvAMcA pAlanakartyAjavaLa Ahe.
yAstava tumhI allAhace bhaya rAkhA ANi mAjhe AjJApAlana karA.
(janasamUhAne) uttara dile kI kAya AmhI tumacyAvara ImAna rAkhAve? tumace AjJApAlana karaNAre tara halakyA pratIce loka Aheta.
(nUha) mhaNAle, malA kAya mAhIta kI pUrvI te kAya karIta rAhileta?
tyAMcyA hizobAcI jabAbadArI tara mAjhyA pAlanakartyAvara Ahe. jara samaja bALagata asAla.
ANi mI ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMnA dhakke deNArA (jhiDakAraNArA) nAhI.
mI tara spaSTataH khabaradAra karaNArA Ahe.
te mhaNAle, he nUha! jara tU he thAMbavale nAhIsa tara avazya tulA dagaDAMcA mArA karUna ThAra kele jAIla.
(nUha) mhaNAle, he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! mAjhyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMnI malA khoTe Tharavile.
tevhA tU, mAjhyA ANi tyAMcyA daramyAna nizcitaca phaisalA kara, ANi malA va mAjhyA ImAnadhAraka sAthIdArAMnA muktI pradAna kara.
yAstava AmhI tyAlA ANi tyAcyA sAthIdArAMnA bharalelyA nauketa (svAra karUna) suTakA pradAna kelI.
maga tyAnaMtara bAkIcyA sarva lokAMnA AmhI buDavUna TAkale.
niHsaMzaya, yAta moThA bodha Ahe paraMtu tyAMcyApaikI bahusaMkhya loka ImAna rAkhaNAre navhateca.
ANi niHsaMzaya, tumacA pAlanakartA moThA prabhAvazAlI, dayAvAna Ahe.
Ada (janasamUha) nehI paigaMbarAMnA khoTe Tharavile.
jevhA tyAMnA tyAcA bhAU hUdane sAMgitale, kAya tumhI allAhace bhaya nAhI rAkhata.
mI tumacA vizvasta paigaMbara (saMdezavAhaka) Ahe.
tevhA allAhace bhaya rAkhA ANi mAjhe mhaNaNe mAnya karA.
ANi mI tyAbaddala tumacyAkaDUna kasalAhI mobadalA mAgata nAhI, mAjhe pArizramika (mobadalA) tara sarva vizvAMcyA pAlanakartyAjavaLa Ahe.
kAya tumhI pratyeka uMca sthAnAvara kheLasvarUpa karamaNukIce cinha (smAraka) banavita AhAta?
ANi moThyA udyogAce (majabUta mahAla nirmANa) karIta AhAta, jaNU kAhI tumhI sadaivakALa itheca rAhAla.
ANi jevhA ekhAdyAvara hAta TAkatA, tevhA moThyA kaThorapaNe pakaDatA.
tevhA allAhace bhaya rAkhA ANi mAjhe mhaNaNe mAnya karA,
ANi tyAce bhaya bALagA, jyAne tyA goSTIdvAre tumacI madata kelI, jyAMnA tumhI jANatA.
tyAne tumacI madata kelI saMpattI ANi saMtatIdvAre.
ANi bAgA ANi jhar2yAMdvAre.
malA tara tumacyAbAbata moThyA divasAcyA zikSA- yAtanece bhaya vATate.
(te) mhaNAle kI tumhI upadeza karA kiMvA upadeza karaNAr2yAMpaikI rAhU nakA AmacyAkaritA sArakheca Ahe.
hA tara prAcIna kALAcyA lokAMcA dIna (dharma) Ahe.
ANi AmhI kadApi zikSA- yAtanA prApta karaNAr2yAMpaikI asaNAra nAhI.

jyAarthI ‘Ada’ janasamUhAcyA lokAMnI (hajarata) hUda yAMnA khoTe Tharavile yAsAThI AmhI tyAMnA naSTa kele. niHsaMzaya, yAta moThI nizANI Ahe, paraMtu tyAMcyApaikI bahuteka loka ImAna rAkhaNAre navhate.
ANi niHsaMzaya tumacA pAlanakartAca varcasvazAlI, dayAvAna Ahe.
‘samUda’ samudAyAcyA lokAMnIhI paigaMbarAsa khoTe Tharavile.
jevhA tyAMce baMdhu ‘svAleha’ne tyAMnA sAMgitale kI kAya tumhI allAhace bhaya bALagata nAhI?
mI tumacyAkaDe allAhacA vizvasta paigaMbara Ahe.
tevhA tumhI allAhace bhaya rAkhA ANi mAjhe AjJApAlana karA.
ANi mI tyAbaddala tumacyAkaDUna kasalAhI mobadalA mAgata nAhI. mAjhA mobadalA tara sarva vizvAMcyA pAlanakartyAkaDe Ahe.
kAya vastUM (deNagyAM) madhye, jyA ithe Aheta, tumhAlA zAMtIpUrvaka soDale jAIla?
arthAta tyA bAgAMmadhye ANi tyA jhar2yAMmadhye.
ANi tyA zetAMmadhye ANi tyA khajurIMcyA bAgAMmadhye jyAMce ghosa (bhAra vADhalyAne) tuTUna paDatAta.
ANi tumhI parvatAMnA korUna AkarSaka (suMdara) imAratI nirmANa karatA.
yAstava allAhace bhaya rAkhA ANi mAjhe anusaraNa karA.
ANi maryAdece ullaMghana karaNAr2yAMce anusaraNa karaNyApAsuna thAMbA.
je dharatIta phasAda (utpAta) pasaravita Aheta ANi sudhAraNA karIta nAhI.
te mhaNAle, tU tara azA lokAMpaikI Ahesa, jyAMcyAvara jAdUToNA kelA gelA Ahe.
tU tara AmacyAsArakhAca eka manuSya Ahe. jara tU saccA lokAMpaikI Ahesa tara ekhAdA mojijA (IzacamatkAra) gheUna ye.
(svAleha) mhaNAle, hI sAMDaNI Ahe. pANI pyAyacI eka pALI hicI, ANi ekA nirdhArita divazI pANI piNyAcI pALI tumacI.
(ANi khabaradAra!) hilA vAITa hetune hAta lAvU nakA, anyathA ekA moThyA divasAcI zikSA- yAtanA tumhAlA yeUna dharela.
tarIhI tyAMnI tice hAta pAya kApUna TAkale, naMtara pazcAttApa karaNAre jhAle.
tevhA az2Aba (allAhacyA zikSA- yAtane) ne tyAMnA yeUna dharale. niHsaMzaya, yAta moThI zikavaNa (bodha) Ahe, paraMtu tyAMcyApaikI bahusaMkhya loka ImAna rAkhaNAre navhate.
ANi niHsaMzaya tumacA pAlanakartA moThA prabhAvazAlI, dayAvAna Ahe.
lUtacyA janasamUhAnehI paigaMbarAMnA khoTe Tharavile.
jevhA tyAMcA bhAU lUta yAMnI tyAMnA sAMgitale kI kAya tumhI allAhace bhaya nAhI bALagata?
mI tumacyAkaDe vizvasta rasUla (paigaMbara) Ahe.
tevhA tumhI allAhace bhaya rAkhA ANi mAjhe AjJApAlana karA.
ANi mI tumacyAkaDUna yAbaddala koNatAhI mobadalA mAgata nAhI, mAjhyA mobadalyAcI jabAbadArI kevaLa sarva vizvAMcyA pAlanakartyAvara Ahe.
kAya tumhI jagAtalyA lokAMpaikI puruSAMjavaLa jAtA?
ANi tumacyA jyA striyAMnA allAhane tumacI patnI banavile Ahe tyAMnA soDUna detA, kharI goSTa azI kI tumhI AhAtaca maryAdA olAMDaNAre.
(tyAMnA) uttara dile kI he lUta! jara tU he thAMbavale nAhIsa tara avazya tulA bAhera kADhale jAIla.
(lUta) mhaNAle, mI tumacyA AcaraNAne agadI aprasanna Ahe.
he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! malA ANi mAjhyA kuTuMbAlA yA (kukarmA) pAsUna vAcava, je he karIta Aheta.
yAstava AmhI tyAMnA ANi tyAMcyAzI saMbaMdha (nAte) asalelyA sarvAMnA vAcavile.
ekA vRddha strIkherIja kI tI mAge rAhaNAr2yAMpaikI jhAlI.
maga AmhI itara sarvAMnA naSTa karUna TAkale.
ANi AmhI tyAMcyAvara eka khAsa prakAracA pAUsa pADalA. to moThA vAITa pAUsa hotA, jo khabaradAra kelyA gelelyA lokAMvara paDalA.
niHsaMzaya, yAtahI moThI nizANI Ahe, paraMtu tyAMcyApaikI adhikAMza loka ImAna rAkhaNAre navhate.
niHsaMzaya, tumacA pAlanakartAca varcasvazAlI, dayA karaNArA Ahe.
eyakAvAlyAMnIhI paigaMbarAMnA khoTe Tharavile.
jevhA (paigaMbara) zuaiba tyAMnA mhaNAle, kAya tumhI allAhace bhaya nAhI rAkhata?
mI tumacyAkaDe vizvasta paigaMbara Ahe.
tevhA tumhI allAhace bhaya rAkhA, ANi mAjhe AjJApAlana karA.
ANi mI tyAbaddala tumacyAkaDUna kasalyAhI mobadalyAcI apekSA karIta nAhI. mAjhyA mobadalyAcI jabAbadArI tara sarva vizvAMcyA pAlanakartyAra Ahe.
mApa - tola purepUra karA ANi kamI deNAr2yAMmadhye sAmIla hoU nakA.
ANi saraLa (ucita) tarAjUne tola karUna dyA.
ANi lokAMnA tyAMcyA vastU kamI karUna deU nakA ANi (nirbhaya hoUna) dharatIvara utpAta (phasAda) mAjavita phirU nakA.
ANi tyA allAhace bhaya rAkhA, jyAne svataH tumhAlA ANi pUrvIcyA nirmitIlA nirmANa kele.
(te) mhaNAle, tU tara tyA lokAMpaikI Ahesa, jyAMcyAvara jAdUToNA kelA jAto.
ANi tU tara AmacyAsArakhAca eka manuSya Ahe ANi AmhI tara tulA khoTe bolaNAr2yAMpaikIca samajato.
jara tumhI saccA lokAMpaikI asAla tara AmacyAvara AkAzAcA ekhAdA tukaDA kosaLavA.
paigaMbara mhaNAle kI mAjhA pAlanakartA cAMgalyA prakAre jANaNArA Ahe, je kAhI tumhI karIta AhAta.
yAstava tyAMnI tyAlA khoTe Tharavile, tevhA tyAMnA sAvalIvAlyA divasAcyA az2Aba (zikSA- yAtane) ne dharale. to moThyA bhayaMkara divasAcA az2Aba hotA.
niHsaMzaya, tyAta moThI nizANI Ahe, paraMtu tyAMcyApaikI bahusaMkhya loka ImAna rAkhaNAre navhate.
ANi niHsaMzaya, tumacA pAlanakartAca varcasvazAlI, dayAvAna Ahe.
ANi niHsaMzaya hA (kuraAna) sarva vizvAMcyA pAlanakartyAne avatarita kelA Ahe.
yAsa vizvasta phariztA (jibrIla) gheUna AlA Ahe.
tumacyA hRdayAvara (avataralA Ahe) yAsAThI kI tumhI (lokAMnA) khabaradAra karaNAr2yAMpaikI vhAve.
spaSTa arabI bhASeta Ahe.
ANi pUrvI hoUna gelelyA paigaMbarAMcyA graMthAMmadhyehI yA (kuraAna) cI carcA Ahe.
kAya tyAMcyAsAThI hI nizANI purezI nAhI kI (kuraAnacyA satyatelA) isrAIlacyA saMtatIce vidvAnahI jANatAta.
ANi jara AmhI yAlA (arabI bhASeaivajI) anya ekhAdyA bhASecyA vyaktIvara avatarita kele asate.
tara tyAne tyAMcyAsamora yAce vAcana kele asate, paNa yAMnI tyAsa mAnale nasate.
azA prakAre AmhI durAcArI lokAMcyA manAta (inkAra) dAkhala kelA Ahe.
te joparyaMta duHkhadAyaka zikSA- yAtanA (svataH) pAhUna gheta nAhIta. to paryaMta ImAna rAkhaNAra nAhIta.
yAstava to (az2Aba) acAnaka yeUna pohocela ANi tyAMnA tyAMcI kalpanA (anumAna) dekhIla nasela.
tyA veLI mhaNatIla, kAya AmhAlA thoDA avasara (saMdhI) dilA jAIla?
tara kAya he AmacyA zikSA- yAtanekaritA ghAI mAjavita Ahe?
bare, he sAMgA kI jara AmhI tyAMnA varSAnuvarSe phAyadA ucalU dilA,
maga tyAMnA to (az2Aba) yeUna pohocalA, jyA viSayI tyAMnA bhaya dAkhavale jAta hote.
tara je kAhI phAyade tyAMnA pohocavile jAta rAhile, tyApaikI kAhIhI tyAMnA upayoga paDU zakaNAra nAhI.
ANi AmhI koNatyAhI vastIlA naSTa kele nAhI, paraMtu azAca sthitIta kI ticyAsAThI khabaradAra karaNAre hote.
bodha (upadezA) cyA svarUpAta ANi AmhI atyAcAra karaNAra nAhI.
ANi yA (kuraAna) lA saitAna gheUna Ale nAhIta.
ANi nA te yAcyA yogya Aheta, nA tyAMnA yAce sAmarthya Ahe.
kiMbahunA te tara aikaNyApAsUnahI vaMcita kele gele Aheta.
yAstava tumhI allAhacyA sobata dusar2yA ekhAdyA ArAdhya daivatAlA pukArU nakA anyathA tumhIhI zikSA prApta karaNAr2yAMpaikI vhAla.
ANi ApalyA javaLacyA nAtevAIkAMnA (allAhace) bhaya dAkhavA.
ANi tyAMcyAzI naramIne vAgA, jo koNI ImAnadhAraka hoUna tumacyA adhIna hoIla.
jara he loka tumacI avajJA karatIla tara tumhI ailAna karA kI tumhI je kAhI karIta AhAta mI tyApAsUna alipta Ahe.
ANi ApalA pUrNa bharosA tyAvara rAkhA jo varcasvazAlI, dayAvAna Ahe.
jo tumhAlA pAhata asato, jevhA tumhI (namAjasAThI) ubhe rAhatA.
ANi sajadA karaNAr2yAMmadhye tumace hiMDaNe phiraNehI.
niHsaMzaya to (allAha) moThA aikaNArA ANi moThA jANaNArA Ahe.
kAya mI tumhAlA sAMgU kI saitAna koNAvara utaratAta?
te pratyeka khoTyA, durAcArIvara utaratAta.
te (varavara) aikalelI goSTa pohacavitAta ANi tyAMcyApaikI bahuteka khoTe Aheta.
ANi kavIMce anusaraNa teca loka karatAta, je pathabhraSTa asAveta.
kAya tumhI nAhI pAhile kI kavI darI - darIta Doke ApaTata phiratAta.
ANi te je mhaNatAta te karata nAhIta.

tyAMcyAkherIja jyAMnI ImAna rAkhale ANi satkarme kelIta ANi moThyA saMkhyene allAhacI prazaMsA (nAmaHsmaraNa) karIta rAhile ANi ApaNa atyAcArapIDita asalyAnaMtara sUDa ghetalA, ANi jyAMnI atyAcAra kelA Ahe te dekhIla lavakaraca jANUna ghetIla kI koNatyA kuzIvara ulaTatAta.
tA - sIna yA AyatI Aheta kuraAnacyA (arthAta spaSTa) ANi divya graMthAcyA.
mArgadarzana ANi khUzakhabara, ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMkaritA.
je namAja kAyama karatAta ANi jakAta adA karatAta ANi Akhiratavara ImAna rAkhatAta.
je loka kayAmatavara ImAna rAkhata nAhI, AmhI tyAMcyAsAThI tyAMcI karme suzobhita karUna dAkhavilI Aheta, yAstava te bhaTakata phiratAta.
heca te loka hota, jyAMcyAsAThI moThI vAITa zikSA- yAtanA Ahe, ANi AkhiratamadhyehI te moThe nukasAna ucalaNAre Aheta.
ANi niHsaMzaya tumhAlA kuraAna zikavilA jAta Ahe, hikamatazAlI ANi sarvakAhI jANaNAr2yA allAhatarphe.

jevhA mUsA ApalyA kuTuMbiyAMnA mhaNAle, mI Aga pAhilI Ahe. mI tethUna eka tara kAhI bAtamI gheUna yeIna kiMvA AgIcA ekhAdA dhagadhagatA vistava gheUna lageca tumacyAjavaLa yeIna, yAsAThI kI tumhI zekUna ghyAve.
jevhA tithe pohocale tevhA tyAMnA hAka dilI gelI kI zubha Ahe to, jo tyA AgIta Ahe ANi zubha Ahe to jo ticyAjavaLa pAsa Ahe ANi moThA pavitra Ahe allAha, sarva vizvAMcA svAmI va pAlanakartA.
mUsA (aikA) kharI goSTa hI kI mIca allAha Ahe jabaradasta ANi hikamata (buddhIkauzalya) bALagaNArA.

ANi tumhI ApalI kAThI khAlI TAkA. (hajarata mUsA yAMnI) jevhA tilA hAlacAla karatAnA pAhile azA prakAre kI jaNU sApa Ahe, tevhA toMDa phiravUna pATha vaLavUna paLAle ANi mAge vaLUnahI pAhile nAhI. he mUsA! bhiU nakA. mAjhyAsamora paigaMbara bhita nasatAta.
paraMtu je loka atyAcAra karatIla, maga tyAsa nekI (satkarmA) ne badalatIla tyA durAcArAnaMtara tara mI dekhIla mApha karaNArA, dayA karaNArA Ahe.

ANi ApalA hAta ApalyA gaLapaTTIta TAkA to zubhra (ANi tejasvI) hoUna nighela, kasalyAhI vyAdhIvinA. (tumhI) naU nizANyA gheUna phiraauna ANi tyAcyA anuyAyIMjavaLa (jA) niHsaMzaya to durAcArI lokAMcA samUha Ahe.
yAstava, jevhA tyAMcyAjavaLa DoLe ughaDaviNAre Amace camatkAra (mojije) pohocale, tevhA te mhaNU lAgale kI hI tara ughaDa jAdU Ahe.
ANi tyAMnI inkAra kelA, vAstivaka tyAMcyA manAta vizvAsa basalA hotA kevaLa atyAcAra va ghameMDImuLe (tyAMnI inkAra kelA) tara pAhA, tyA durAcArI lokAMcA kAya zevaTa jhAlA!
ANi niHsaMzaya, AmhI dAUda ANi sulemAnalA jJAna pradAna kele hote ANi doghe mhaNAle, sarva prazaMsA tyA allAhakaritA Ahe, jyAne AmhAlA ApalyA aneka ImAnadhAraka dAsAMvara zreSThatva pradAna kele Ahe.
ANi dAUdace vArasa sulemAna jhAle ANi mhaNAle, lokAMno! AmhAlA pakSyAMcI bolI (bhASA) zikivalI gelI Ahe. ANi AmhAlA sarva kAhI dile gele Ahee. niHsaMzaya hA (allAhacA) moThA ughaDa upakAra Ahe.
ANi sulemAnacyA samora tyAMce sarva sainya jinna ANi manuSya ANi pakSI jamA kele gele (pratyeka prakArAlA) vegavegaLe ubhe kele gele.
jevhA te muMgyAMcyA maidAnAta pohocale, tevhA eka muMgI mhaNAlI, he muMgyAno! ApApalyA biLAta paTakana ghusA (ase na vhAve kI) asAvadhAnImuLe sulemAna ANi tyAMcyA sainyAne tumhAlA pAyAkhAlI tuDavAve.

ticyA yA bolaNyAvara (hajarata sulemAna) yAMnI smitahAsya kele ANi duA (prArthanA) karU lAgale kI he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! tU malA tauphika (subuddhI) pradAna kara kI mI tujhyA yA deNagyAMbaddala kRtajJatA vyakta karAvI, jyA tU mAjhyAvara kelyA Aheta ANi mAjhyA mAtA-pityAMvara ANi mI azI satkarme karIta rAhAve, jyAmuLe tU prasanna rAhAve ANi malA ApalyA dayA- kRpene ApalyA neka- sadAcArI dAsAMmadhye sAmIla kara.
ANi tyAMnI pakSyAMce nirIkSaNa kele va mhaNAle, kAya goSTa Ahe kI malA huda huda disUna yeta nAhI? kAya kharokhara to hajara nAhI?
niHsaMzaya mI tyAlA kaThora daMDa deIna kiMvA tyAlA kApUna TAkIna kiMvA tyAne mAjhyAsamora yogya kAraNa sAdara karAve.
kAhI jAsta veLa jhAlA navhatA, tevaDhyAta to (yeUna) mhaNAlA, mI azA goSTIcI khabara ANalI Ahe kI jyAviSayI tumhI jANataca nAhI. mI ‘sabA’cI agadI vizvasanIya bAtamI gheUna tumacyAjavaLa Alo Ahe.
mI pAhile kI eka strI tyAMcyAvara rAjya karIta Ahe, jilA sarva prakAracyA vastUMpaikI kAhI na kAhI pradAna kele gele Ahe ANi tice siMhAsana dekhIla moThe bhavya Ahe.

mI tilA ANi ticyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMnA allAhaaivajI sUryAlA sajadA karatAnA pAhile. saitAnAne tyAcI karme tyAMnA bhale cAMgale asalyAce dAkhavUna satya mArgApAsUna tyAMnA rokhale Ahe, yAstava tyAMnA sanmArga prApta hota nAhI.
kI kevaLa tyAca allAhalA sajadA karAvA, jo AkAzAMcyA ANi dharatIcyA lapalelyA vastUMnA bAhera kADhato, ANi je kAhI tumhI lapavUna ThevatA ANi jAhIra karatA to te sarva kAhI jANato.
(arthAta) allAha! tyAcyAkherIja koNIhI upAsanIya nAhI. toca mahAna arza (Iza-siMhAsanAM) cA svAmI Ahe.
(sulemAna) mhaNAle, AtA AmhI pAhato kI tU khare bolalAsa kI tU khoTA Ahe.
mAjhe he patra neUna tyAMnA de, maga tyAMcyApAsUna dUra hoUna pAhA kI te kAya uttara detAta.
tI mhaNAlI, he saradArAMno! mAjhyAjavaLa eka mahattvapUrNa patra TAkale gele Ahe.
je sulemAnatarphe Ahe ANi jyAcA AraMbha atizaya dayAvAna, moThyA meharabAna allAhacyA nAvAne Ahe.
he kI tumhI mAjhyAsamora vidroha karU nakA ANi muslima hoUna mAjhyAjavaLa yA.
tI (rANI) mhaNAlI, he mAjhyA darabArI lokAMno! tumhI mAjhyA yA samasyebAbata malA sallA dyA. mI koNatyAhI goSTIcA aMtima phaisalA, joparyaMta tumacI upisthatI ANi mata nasela, karata nasate.
tyA sarvAMnI uttara dile, AmhI moThe majabUta ANi zaktizAlI ANi khUpa laDhavayye Ahota. AtA yApuDhe tumacA adhikAra Ahe. tumhI svataHca vicAra karA kI tumhI AmhAlA koNatA Adeza detA.

tI (rANI) mhaNAlI, bAdazAha (rAje-mahArAje) jevhA ekhAdyA vastIta praveza karatAta, tevhA tilA osADa karUna TAkatAta ANi tithalyA pratiSThita lokAMnA apamAnita karatAta tevhA loka dekhIla aseca karatIla.
ANi mI tyAMnA eka najarANA pAThaviNAra Ahe, maga pAhate kI dUta kAya uttara gheUna parata yetAta.

yAstava (rAjadUta) jevhA (hajarata) sulemAnajavaLa pohocalA, tevhA sulemAna mhaNAle, kAya tumhI loka dhana deUna mAjhI madata karU icchitA? malA tara mAjhyA pAlanakartyAne yAhUna khUpa jAsta deUna Thevale Ahe, je tyAne tumhAlA dile Ahe. tevhA ApalyA najarANyAne tumhIca khUza rAhA.
jA, parata jA, tyAMcyAkaDe AmhI tyAMcyAvara ase sainya pAThavU kI jyAcA sAmanA karaNyAcI tyAMcyAta tAkata nAhI ANi AmhI tyAMnA apamAnita va parAbhUta karUna tithUna bAhera ghAlavU.
(sulemAna) mhaNAle, he saradArAMno! tumacyApaikI koNI asA Ahe, jo tyAMce muslima hoUna pohacaNyApUrvIca, tice siMhAsana mAjhyAjavaLa ANUna deIla.
eka balADhya jinna mhaNAlA, tumhI ApalyA jAgevarUna uThaNyApUrvIca mI te tumacyAjavaLa ANato. vizvAsa rAkhA, mI yAce sAmarthya rAkhato. ANi mI amAnatadAra (visvasta) hI Ahe.

jyAcyAjavaLa graMthAce jJAna hote, to mhaNAle, kI tumacI pApaNI lavaNyApUrvIca mI tyAsa tumacyAjavaLa pohacavU zakato. jevhA paigaMbara (sulemAna) ne te (siMhAsana) ApalyAjavaLa hajara asalele pAhile, tevhA mhaNAle, hA mAjhyA pAlanakartyAcA upakAra Ahe. yAsAThI kI tyAne mAjhI kasoTI ghyAvI kI mI kRtajJatA darzavito kI kRtaghnatA. kRtajJatA vyakta karaNArA ApalyA phAyadyAsAThIca kRtajJatA vyakta karato. ANi jo kRtaghnatA darzavIla tara mAjhA pAlanakartA moThA niHspRha ANi moThA meherabAna Ahe.
(hajarata sulemAnane) Adeza dilA kI rANIcyA siMhAsanAce svarUpa kAhIse badalUna TAkA. maga pAhU yA, tI mArgadarzana prApta karate kI tyA lokAMpaikI Tharate je mArgadarzana prApta karIta nAhI.
maga jevhA tI hajara jhAlI tevhA tilA vicArale gele kI tumace siMhAsana aseca Ahe? tine uttara dile, he jaNU teca Ahe AmhAlA yAcyApUrvIca jJAna dile gele hote ANi AmhI muslima hoto.
ANi tilA tyAMnI rokhUna Thevale hote, jyAMcI tI allAhakherIja upAsanA karIta rAhilI, niHsaMzaya tI kAphira lokAMpaikI hotI.

tilA sAMgitale gele kI mahAlAta praveza karA. jevhA tine pAhile tevhA tilA ase vATale kI hA jalAzaya (hauda) Ahe, tine ApalyA poTar2yA ughaDyA kelyA (sulemAna) mhaNAle, hA tara kAcecA banalelA Ahe. tI mhaNAlI, he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! mI ApalyA prANAvara atyAcAra kelA. AtA mI sulemAnasobata, sarva vizvAMcyA pAlanakartyA allAhacI AjJAdhAraka banate.
ANi niHsaMzaya, AmhI ‘samUda’kaDe tyAMcA bhAU ‘svAleha’lA pAThavile (yA saMdezAsaha) kI tumhI sarva allAhacI upAsanA karA. tarIhI te dona gaTa banUna ApasAta bhAMDaNataMTA karU lAgale.

(paigaMbara svAleha) mhaNAle, he mAjhyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMno! tumhI bhalepaNAcyA AdI vAITa goSTIcI ghAI kA mAjavita AhAta. tumhI allAhajavaLa mAphI kA nAhI mAgata? yAsAThI kI tumacyAvara dayA kelI jAvI.
(te) mhaNAle kI AmhI tara tumhAlA ANi tumacyA sAthIdArAMnA apazakunI samajato (paigaMbarAnI) uttara dile, tumacA apazakUna allAhajavaLa Ahe. kiMbahunA tumhI tara kasoTIta paDalele loka AhAta.
yA zaharAta naU (pramukha) mANase hotI, je dharatIta utpAta (phasAda) pasaravita hote ANi sudhAraNece kAma karIta navhate.

tyAMnI ApasAta allAhacI zapatha gheUna pratijJA kelI kI rAtrItUnaca ‘svAleha’ ANi tyAMcyA kuTuMbiyAMvara hallA caDhavU ANi tyAMcyA vArasadArAlA sAMgU kI AmhI tyAMcyA kuTuMbAcyA hatyecyA veLI hajara navhato ANi AmhI khare bolata Ahota.
ANi tyAMnI DAva kheLA ANi AmhI dekhIla ANi te tyAsa samajataca navhate.
AtA pAhA, tyAMcyA kaTa-kArasthAnAcA kAya pariNAma jhAlA? AmhI tyAMnA ANi tyAMcyA janasamUhAlA, sarvAMnAca naSTa karUna TAkale.
hI tyAMcI ghare Aheta, jI tyAMcyA atyAcArAmuLe osADa paDalI Aheta. je loka jJAna bALagatAta, tyAMcyAsAThI tyAta moThI nizANI Ahe.
ANi AmhI tyAMnA, jyAMnI ImAna rAkhale hote ANi je satkarma karIta hote, pUrNapaNe vAcavile.
ANi lUtacA (ullekha karA) jevhA te ApalyA janasamUhAlA mhaNAle, kI jANUnabujUnahI tumhI kukarma (puruSa sahavAsa) karatA?
hI kAya goSTa Ahe? kI tumhI striyAMnA soDUna puruSAMjavaLa kAmavAsanApUrtIsAThI yetA? kharI goSTI azI kI tumhI moThe ajJAna pUrNa kAma karIta AhAta.
tyAMcyA janasamUhAce uttara yA bolaNyAvyatirikta dusare kAhI navhate kI lUtacyA kuTuMbiyAMnA ApalyA zaharAtUna bAhera ghAlavA, he loka moThI pavitratatA (satzIlatA) dAkhavita Aheta.
ANi AmhI tyAMnA ANi tyAMcyA kuTuMbAlA, tyAcyA patnIkherIja sarvAMnA vAcivale. yAce anumAna(rtaka) tara mAge rAhaNAr2yAMmadhye AmhI lAvaleca hote.
ANi tyAMcyAvara eka (vizeSa prakAracA) pAUsa pADalA. yAstava tyA khabaradAra kelyA gelelyA lokAMvara vAITa pAUsa paDalA.
tevhA tumhI sAMgA kI samasta prazaMsA allAhakaritAca Ahe ANi tyAcyA nivaDaka dAsAMvara salAma (zAMti) Ahe. kAya allAha adhika cAMgalA Ahe kI te, jyAMnA he loka (allAhacA) sahabhAgI banavata Aheta.

(bare he sAMgA) AkAzAMnA ANi jaminIlA koNI nirmANa kele? koNI AkAzAtUna pAUsa pADalA? maga tyAdvAre hiravyA TavaTavIta suMdara bAgA koNI ugavilyA? yA bAgAMce vRkSa tumhI kadhIhI ugavU zakata nAhI. kAya allAhakherIja dusarA koNI upAsanA karaNyAyogya Ahe? kiMbahunA he loka (saraLa mArgApAsUna) dUra hotAta.

kAya to, jyAne dharatIlA nivAsasthAna banavile, ticyA daramyAna nadyA pravAhita kelyA, ticyAsAThI parvata banavile ANi dona samudrAMcyA daramyAna ADa paDadA ghAtalA, kAya allAhasobata dusarA koNI upAsanA karaNyAyogya Ahe? kiMbahunA tyAMcyApaikI bahuteka loka jANataca nAhIta.

vivaza ANi agatika vyaktIce Arjava, jevhA to pukArato, koNa svIkArUna tyAcyA trAsa- yAtanesa dUra karato, ANi tumhAlA dharatIcA khalIfA (sattAdhikArI) banavito. kAya allAhasobata dusarA koNI upAsanA karaNyAyogya Ahe? tumhI loka phAra kamI bodha grahaNa karatAta.

asA koNa Ahe, jo tumhAlA khuSkI ANi samudrAcyA aMdhArAta mArga dAkhavito ANi jo ApalyA kRpecyA (yeNyA) pUrvIca khUzakhabara deNArI havA (vAre) pAThavito. kAya allAhasobata dusare ekhAde ArAdhyA daivatahI Ahe? jyAMnA he (allAhacA) sahabhAgI TharavitAta, tyA sarvAMpekSA allAha ati ucca Ahe.

asA koNa Ahe jo sRSTInirmitIlA pahilyAMdA nirmANa karato, maga tilA punhA nirmANa karIla jo tumhAlA AkAza ANi jaminitUna AjivikA pradAna karIta Ahe. kAya allAhasobata dusarAhI koNI upAsya Ahe? sAMgA, sacce asAla tara Apale pramANa (purAvA) ANA.
sAMgA kI AkAzavAlyAMpaikI ANi dharatIvAlyAMpaikI, allAhakherIja koNIhI parokSa jJAna bALagata nAhI te tara he dekhIla jANata nAhIta kI tyAMnA dusar2yAMdA kevhA jivaMta kele jAIla?
kiMbahunA Akhirata (maraNottara jIvanA) viSayI tyAMce jJAna saMpuSTAta Ale Ahe, kiMbahunA he tyA saMdarbhAta saMzayagrasta Aheta, evaDheca navhe tara he tyApAsUna AMdhaLe Aheta.
kAphira (satya-virodhaka) mhaNAle, kAya jevhA AmhI mAtI hoUna jAU ANi Amace vADavaDIlahI, kAya AmhI punhA bAhera kADhale jAU?
AmhAlA ANi AmacyA pUrvajAMnA phAra pUrvIpAsUna he vAyade dile jAta rAhile. kAhI nAhI, yA tara pUrvI hoUna gelelyA lokAMcyA kAlpanika kathA mAtra Aheta.
sAMgA kI, jaminIvara jarA hiMDUna phirUna pAhA kI aparAdhI lokAMcA kAya pariNAma jhAlA?
ANi tumhI tyAMcyAviSayI ciMtAgrasta hoU nakA ANi tyAMcyA kaTa-kArasthAnAMmuLe mana saMkucita karU nakA.
ANi mhaNatAta kI hA vAyadA kevhA pUrNa hoIla, sacce asAla tara sAMgA.
tyAMnA uttara dyA kI kadAcita kAhI azA goSTI, jyAMcI tumhI evaDhI ghAI mAjavita AhAta, tumacyA khUpa javaLa yeUna ThepalyA Aheta.
ANi niHsaMzaya, tumacA pAlanakartA samasta lokAMvara moThA kRpAvAna Ahe, paraMtu adhikAMza loka kRtajJatA dAkhavita nAhI.
ANi niHsaMzaya, tumacA pAlanakartA, tyA goSTIMnAhI jANato, jyAMnA te ApalyA manAta lapavita Aheta, ANi jyAMnA vyakta karIta Aheta.
AkAza ANi dharatIcI koNatIhI lapalelI goSTa azI nAhI, jI divya spaSTa graMthAta sAmIla nasAvI.
niHsaMzaya hA kuraAna isrAIlacyA saMtatIsamora adhika tara tyA goSTIMce nivedana karIta Ahe, jyAta he matabheda karatAta.
ANi hA (kuraAna) ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMkaritA nizcitaca mArgadarzana ANi dayA- kRpA Ahe.
tumacA pAlanakartA tyAMcyA daramyAna ApalyA AdezAne (sarva) phaisalA karIla. to moThA varcasvazAlI ANi jJAna rAkhaNArA Ahe.
tevhA, tumhI allAhavaraca bharavasA rAkhA. niHsaMzaya, tumhI satya ANi ughaDa azA dIna (dharmA) vara AhAta.
niHsaMzaya, tumhI nA mRtAMnA aikavU zakatA ANi nA bahir2yAMnA ApalI pukAra (hAka) aikavU zakatA, jevhA te pATha phiravUna vimukha hota asatIla.
ANi nA tumhI AMdhaLyAMnA tyAMcyA mArgabhraSTatepAsUna haTavUna, sanmArgAlA lAvU zakatA, tumhI tara kevaLa tyAMnA aikavU zakatA, jyAMnI AmacyA AyatIMvara ImAna rAkhale Ahe, maga te AjJAdhAraka hotAta.
ANi jevhA tyAMcyAvara zikSA- yAtane (az2Aba) cA vAyadA lAgU hoIla, AmhI jaminItUna tyAMcyAsAThI eka janAvara bAhera kADhU, je tyAMcyAzI bolata asela kI loka AmacyA AyatIMvara vizvAsa Thevata navhate.
ANi jyA divazI AmhI pratyeka janasamUhAmadhUna, azA lokAMce samUha, je AmacyA AyatIMnA khoTe Tharavita hote, gherUna ANU, maga te sarvacyA sarva vegaLe kele jAtIla.

jevhA sarvacyA sarva yeUna pohacatIla tevhA allAha pharmAvila kI tumhI mAjhyA AyatIMnA, yAnaMtarahI kI tumhAlA tyAMce pUrNa jJAna navhate, kA khoTe Tharavile? ANi hehI sAMgA kI tumhI kAya (karma) karIta rAhilAta?
ANi yAce kAraNa he kI tyAMnI atyAcAra kelA hotA, tyAmuLe Amace pharmAna tyAcyAvara lAgU hoIla ANi te kAhIca bolU zakaNAra nAhIta.

kAya te pAhata nAhIta kI AmhI rAtra azAsAThI banavilI Ahe kI tyAMnI ticyAta ArAma karU zakAve ANi divasAlA AmhI dAkhaviNArA banavile Ahe. niHsaMzaya yAta tyA lokAMkaritA nizANyA Aheta, je ImAna rAkhatAta.

ANi jyA divazI sUra phuMkalA jAIla tevhA te sarvacyA sarva, je AkAzAMmadhye ANi jaminIvara Aheta ghAbarUna uThatIla, paraMtu jyAlA allAha icchila (surakSita ThevIla) ANi sarvacyA sarva vivaza, lAcAra hoUna tyAcyAsamora hajara hotIla.

ANi tumhI parvatAMnA ApalyA jAgI nizcita va sthira samajatA, paraMtu te dekhIla DhagAsArakhe uData phiratIla. hI nirmitI (kAryakuzalatA) Ahe allAhacI, jyAne pratyeka vastU majabUta banavilI Ahe. tumhI je kAhI karatA, allAha te cAMgalyA prakAre jANato.
jo manuSya satkarma gheUna yeIla, tyAlA tyAhUna cAMgalA mobadalA miLela ANi ase loka tyA divasAcyA dahazatIpAsUna nirdhAsta asatIla.
ANi je loka duSkarma gheUna yetIla tyAMnA adhomukhI (jahannamacyA) AgIta jhokale jAIla. tumhAlA kevaLa tyAcAca mobadalA dilA jAIla, je tumhI karIta rAhile.

malA tara kevaLa hAca Adeza dilA gelA Ahe kI mI yA zaharAcyA pAlanakartyAcI upAsanA karIta rAhAve, jyAne yAsa Adara sanmAnapUrNa banavile Ahe ANi jo pratyeka vastUcA svAmI Ahe ANi malA hA AdezahI dilA gelA Ahe kI mI muslamAna (AjJAdhArakAM) paikI vhAve.
ANi mI kuraAnAce paThaNa karIta rAhAve, tevhA jo mArgadarzana aMgIkArIla, ANi jo mArgabhraSTa hoIla tara sAMgA, mI kevaLa sAvadhAna karaNAr2yAMpaikI Ahe.

ANi sAMgA, samasta prazaMsA allAhakaritAca Ahe. to lavakaraca tumhAlA ApalyA nizANyA dAkhavila, jyA tumhI svataH oLakhUna ghyAla, ANi je kAhI tumhI karIta AhAta, tumacA pAlanakartA tyApAsUna anabhijJa (ajANa) nAhI.
tA-sIna-mIma.
yA divya graMthAcyA AyatI Aheta.
AmhI tumacyAsamora mUsA ANi phiraaunacI satya ghaTanA varNana karato azA lokAMkaritA, je ImAna rAkhatAta.

niHsaMzaya, phiraaunane dharatIvara utpAta (phasAda) mAjivalA hotA, ANi tithalyA lokAMcA (eka eka) gaTa banavilA hotA. tyAMcyA ekA gaTAlA durbala banavUna Thevale hote. tyAMcyA lahAna mulAMnA tara mArUna TAkata ase ANi mulIMnA jivaMta soDUna deta ase. niHsaMzaya to moThA durAcArI (va duSTa) hotA.
ANi maga AmhI icchile kI tyAMcyAvara dayA karAvI, jyAMnA dharatIvara atizaya durbala kele gele hote ANi AmhI tyAMnAca pramukha ANi (dharatIcA) vArasa banavAve.
ANi hehI kI tyAMna dharatIvara zaktI-sAmarthya va sattAdhikAra pradAna karAvA ANi phiraauna ANi hAmAna va tyAMcyA sainyAMnA te dAkhavAve, jyApAsUna te bhayabhIta Aheta.

ANi AmhI mUsAcyA mAtelA vahayI (prakAzanA) kelI kI tyAlA dUdha pAjata rAhA ANi jevhA tulA tyAcyAviSayI kAhI bhaya jANavela tevhA tyAlA nadIta vAhavUna de ANi kasalehI bhaya, zoka va duHkha karU nakosa. AmhI niHzaMsaya, tyAlA tujhyAkaDe paratavU ANi tyAlA ApalyA paigaMbarAMpaikI banaviNAra Ahota.

zevaTI phiraaunacyA lokAMnI te bAlaka ucalUna ghetale, yAsAThI kI akherIsa heca bAlaka tyAMce vairI Tharale ANi tyAMcyA duHkhAce kAraNa banale. yAta zaMkA nAhI kI phiraauna ANi hAmAna va tyAMce sainya moThe aparAdhI hote.

ANi phiraaunacI patnI mhaNAlI kI hA tara mAjhyA ANi tumacyA netrAMcI zitalatA Ahe. yAcI hatyA karU nakA. phAra saMbhava Ahe kI hA AmhAlA kAhI lAbha pohacavila kiMvA AmhI yAlA ApalAca putra TharavAve, ANi he loka akkalaca bALagata navhate.

ANi mUsA (alai.) cyA mAtece hRdaya vyAkuLa jhAle,tara AmhI ticyA manAlA dhIra dilA nasatA.tara tI yA goSTIcI vAstavikatA agadI spaSTa karaNyAcA betAta hotI. he azAsAThI kI tI ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMpaikI rAhAvI.
mUsA (alai.) cyA mAtene tyA (bALA) cyA bahiNIsa sAMgitale kI tU yAcyA pAThopATha jA, tevhA tI tyAlA durunaca pAhata rAhilI. ANi phiraaunacyA lokAMnA yA goSTIcI jANIvahI jhAlI nAhI.

ANi tyA (bALA) cyA pohacaNyApUrvIca AmhI mUsAkaritA dAyAMce dUdha harAma (niSiddha) kele hote. tI (bahINa) mhaNAlI kI, kAya mI tumhAlA ase kuTuMba dAkhavU je yA bALAce pAlanapoSaNa tumacyAsAThI karIla ANi yA bALAce hitaciMtaka asela.

azA prakAre AmhI tyA bALAlA tyAcyA mAtekaDe parata pohacavile yAsAThI kI tice netra zItala rAhAveta ANi tI duHkhI hoU naye. ANi tine jANUna ghyAve kI allAhacA vAyadA saccA Ahe. paraMtu adhikAMza loka jANata nAhI.

ANi jevhA mUsA (alai.) ApalyA tAruNyAvasthesa pohacale ANi pUrNataH zaktizAlI jhAle, AmhI tyAMnA buddhIkauzalya ANi jJAna pradAna kele. satkarma karaNAr2yAMnA AmhI azAca prakAracA mobadalA deta asato.

ANi (mUsA) azA veLI zaharAta Ale, jevhA zaharavAsI jhopalele hote. ithe dona mANase laDhata asatAnA ADhaLale. hA eka tara tyAMcyA samUhApaikI hotA ANi hA dusarA tyAMcyA zatrUMpaikI. jo tyAMcyA samUhApaikI hotA tyAne tyA mANasAcyA virodhAta, tyA zatrU pakSAcA hotA tyAMcyAkaDe madata mAgitalI. jyAvara mUsAne tyAlA ThosA mAralA. pariNAmI to maraNa pAvalA. mUsA mhaNAle, he tara saitAnI kRtya Ahe niHsaMzaya, saitAna zatrU ANi ughaDarityA bahakaviNArA Ahe.

maga mUsA duA (prArthanA) karU lAgale kI he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! mI tara svataHvaraca atyAcAra karUna ghetalA. tU malA mApha kara. allAhane tyAMnA mApha kele. niHsaMzaya, allAha moThA mApha karaNArA ANi moThA dayAvAna Ahe.
(mUsA) mhaNAle, he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! jasA tU mAjhyAvara hA upakAra kelA, mI dekhIla AtA yApuDhe koNatyAhI aparAdhyAcA sahAyyaka banaNAra nAhI.

maga (dusar2yA divazI) sakALI sakALI bhaya rAkhata bAtamI gheNyAcyA hetUne zaharAta gele, tevaDhyAta toca manuSya jyAne kAla tyAMcyAjavaLa madata mAgitalI hotI, punhA tyAMcyAjavaLa vinaMtI karIta Ahe. mUsA tyAlA mhaNAle, niHsaMzaya, tU tara ughaDarityA pathabhraSTa Ahesa.

maga jevhA ApalyA ANi tyAcyA zatrUlA dharU icchile, to mhaNAlA, he mUsA! kAya jyA prakAre tumhI kAla ekA mANasAlA ThAra mArale, (Aja) malAhI ThAra karU icchitA? tumhI tara dezAta julamI va utpAta karaNAre banU icchitA ANi tumacA hA irAdAca nAhI kI samajotA (sameTa) karaNAr2yAMpaikI vhAve.

ANi zaharAcyA dUracyA kinAr2yAkaDUna dhAvata dhAvata eka manuSya AlA ANi mhaNU lAgalA kI he mUsA! ithale pramukha loka tumacyA vadhAcI sallAmasalata karIta Aheta. yAstava tumhI (phAra lavakara) yethUna nighUna jA. malA ApalA hitaciMtaka mAnA.
yAstava mUsA bhayabhIta hoUna sAvadhapaNe tethUna nighAle. mhaNAle, he pAlanakartyA! malA atyAcArI samUhApAsUna vAcava.
ANi jevhA madayanakaDe jAU lAgale tevhA mhaNAle, mAjhA vizvAsa Ahe kI mAjhA pAlanakartA malA saraLa mArga dAkhavila.

ANi madayana yethe jevhA pANyAcyA ThikANI pohacale tevhA pAhile kI lokAMcA eka samUha tithe pANI pAjata Ahe ANi dona striyA ekA bAjUlA (ApalyA janAvarAMnA) rokhUna ubhyA asalelyA disalyA. vicArale kI tumacI kAya samasyA Ahe? tyA mhaNAlyA kI joparyaMta he gurAkhI paratUna jAta nAhIta, AmhI toparyaMta pANI pAjU zakata nAhI ANi Amace pitA phAra mhAtAre Aheta.

yAstava tyAMnI svataH(musA) tyA (janAvarAM) nA pANI pAjale, maga sAvalIkaDe cAlata gele ANi mhaNAle, he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! tU je kAhI mAMgalyA mAjhyAvara avatarita karazIla, mI tyAcA garajavaMta Ahe.

itakyAta tyA doghIMpaikI eka tyAMcyAkaDe lAjata lAjata AlI ANi mhaNAlI kI mAjhe pitA tumhAlA bolavita Aheta, yAsAThI kI tumhI je AmacyA janAvarAMnA pANI pAjale Ahe, tyAcA mobadalA dyAvA. jevhA (hajarata mUsA) tyAMcyAjavaLa pohacale ANi tyAMnA ApalI sarva kathA aikavilI, tevhA te (pitA) mhaNAle, AtA bhaya bALagU nakA. tumhI atyAcArI lokAMpAsUna muktI prApta kelI.
tyA doghIMpaikI eka mhaNAlI, he pitA! tumhI tyAMnA majurIvara ThevUna ghyA, kAraNa tyAMnA tumhI majurIvara rAkhAla tyAMcyApaikI sarvAMta cAMgalA to Ahe jo balavAna ANi vizvasta asAvA.

tyA (vRddha pityA) ne mhaTale kI mI ApalyA yA dona mulIMpaikI ekIlA tumacyA vivAha (baMdhanA) madhye deU icchito yA (mahara- strIdhanA) vara kI tumhI ATha varSAM paryaMta mAjhe kAmakAja karAve, mAtra jara tumhI dahA varSAM paryaMta karAla tara he tumacyAtarphe upakAra mhaNUna Ahe. mI kadhIhI ase icchita nAhI kI tumacyAvara kazAhI prakAracI kaSTa- yAtanA TAkAvI. allAhane icchile tara bhaviSyAta tumhI malA eka bhalA mANUsa pAhAla.

(mUsA alai.) mhaNAle, ThIka Ahe. hI goSTa tara mAjhyA ANi tumacyA daramyAna nizcita TharalI. mI yA donhIM mudatIMpaikI jI mudata pUrNa karena, mAjhyAvara jorajabaradastI hoU naye. AmhI he je kAhI (ApasAta) bolata Ahota, tyAvara allAha (sAkSI ANi) nirIkSaka Ahe.

jevhA (hajarata) mUsA (alai.) yAMnI mudata pUrNa kelI ANi ApalyA kuTuMbiyAMnA gheUna nighAle, tevhA tUra nAvAcyA parvatAkaDe Aga pAhilI. ApalyA patnIlA mhaNAle, thAMbA! mI Aga pAhilI Ahe. phAra saMbhava Ahe kI mI tethUna ekhAdI bAtamI ANAvI kiMvA AgIcA nikhArA (vistava) ANAvA, yAsAThI kI tumhI zekUna ghyAve.
yAstava, jevhA tyA ThikANI pohacale tevhA tyA zubha dharatIcyA maidAnAcyA ujavIkaDIla jhADAmadhUna sAda ghAtalI gelI kI, he mUsA! niHsaMzaya, mIca allAha Ahe, sarva vizvAMcA pAlanakartA.

ANi he kI ApalI kAThI khAlI TAkA. maga jevhA tilA pAhile, tI sApAsArakhI vaLavaLa karIta Ahe tevhA pATha phiravUna paratale ANi mAge vaLUna toMDahI dAkhavale nAhI. AmhI pharmAvile, he mUsA! puDhe yA. bhayabhIta hoU nakA. niHsaMzaya, tumhI sarva prakAre agadI surakSita AhAta.

ApalA hAta ApalyA khizAta ghAlA, to kasalyAhI prakAracyA DAgAvinA pUrNa zubhra cakAkaNArA hoUna bAhera nighela ANi bhaya- dahazatIpAsUna ApalA bacAva karaNyAkaritA ApalI bhujA ApalyAzI sameTUna ghyA. he dona camatkAra (mojije) tumacyA pAlanakartyAtarphe Aheta, phiraauna ANi tyAcyA samUhAkaDe (prastuta karaNyAsAThI). niHsaMzaya, te sarvacyA sarva avajJA karaNAre durAcArI loka Aheta.
(mUsA alai.) mhaNAle, he pAlanakartyA! mI tyAMcyA ekA mANasAcI hatyA kelI hotI. AtA malA bhaya vATate kI tehI malA ThAra karatIla.

ANi mAjhA bhAU hAruna mAjhyApekSA adhika sApha bolaNArA Ahe. tU tyAlA dekhIla mAjhA sahAyyaka banavUna mAjhyAsobata pAThava, yAsAThI kI tyAne malA khare mAnAve. malA tara bhItI vATate kI te sarva malA khoTe TharavatIla.

(allAhane) pharmAvile, AmhI tumacyA baMdhudvAre tumhAlA majabUta bAjU pradAna karU ANi tumhA doghAMnA varcasvazAlI karU, tevhA phiraaunace loka tumacyAparyaMta pohacUca zakaNAra nAhIta. AmacyA nizANyAMmuLe tumhI doghe ANi tumace anuyAyIca saphala TharatIla.

yAstava jevhA mUsA (alai.) tyAMcyAjavaLa AmhI dilele ughaDa camatkAra (mojije) gheUna pohocale, tevhA te mhaNU lAgale kI hI tara kevaLa banAvaTI jAdU Ahe. AmhI ApalyApUrvI hoUna gelelyAMcyA kALAta ase kadhI aikale nAhI.

ANi (hajarata) mUsA mhaNAle, mAjhA pAlanakartA tyAlA cAMgalyA prakAre jANato, jo tyAcyAjavaLace mArgadarzana gheUna yetA| ANi jyAcyAsAThI AkhiratacA cAMgalA pariNAma asato. niHsaMzaya, atyAcArI lokAMce (kadhIhI) bhale hoNAra nAhI.

ANi phiraauna mhaNAlA, he darabArI lokAMno! mI tara ApalyAkherIja dusar2yA koNAlA tumacA upAsya (mAbUda) jANata nAhI. aika, he hAmAna! tU mAjhyAsAThI mAtIlA AgIta bhAjava, maga mAjhyAsAThI eka mahAla tayAra kara, yAsAThI kI mUsAcyA upAsyAlA DokAvUna pAhAve. mI tara tyAlA khoTyA lokAMpaikIca samajata Ahe.
tyAne ANi tyAcyA sainyAne nAhaka dezAta ghameMDa kelI, ANi ase samajUna ghetale kI AmacyAkaDe paratavile jANAraca nAhIta.
zevaTI AmhI tyAlA ANi tyAcyA sainyAlA dharale ANi samudrAta buDavUna TAkale. AtA pAhA kI tyA atyAcArIMcA aMta kasA jhAlA!
ANi AmhI tyAMnA ase pezave banavile kI lokAMnA jahannamakaDe AmaMtrita karatIla ANi kayAmatacyA divazIhI tyAMnA madata kelI jANAra nAhI.
ANi AmhI yA jagAta dekhIla tyAMcyA mAge ApalI lAnata (nirbhartsanA) lAvalI, ANi kayAmatacyA divazIhI te vAITa avasthA asaNAr2yA lokAMpaikI asatIla.

ANi AmhI pUrvIcyA kALAtIla lokAMnA naSTa kelyAnaMtara mUsAlA asA graMtha pradAna kelA, jo lokAMsAThI pramANa, ANi mArgadarzana va (allAhacI) kRpA hoUna AlA hotA, yAsAThI kI tyAMnI bodha grahaNa karAvA.
ANi tUra parvatAcyA pazcima dizekaDe jevhA AmhI mUsAlA AdezAcI vahayI (prakAzanA) pohacavilI hotI, tevhA nA tumhI hajara hote, nA tumhI pAhaNAr2yAMpaikI hote.

paraMtu AmhI aneka vaMza nirmANa kele, jyAMcyAvara dIrgha kAlAvadhI loTalA, ANi nA tumhI madayanace rahivAzI hote kI tyAMcyAsamora AmacyA AyatIMce paThaNa kele asate, kiMbahunA paigaMbarAMnA pAThaviNAre AmhIca rAhilo.

ANi nA tumhI tUra parvatAkaDe hajara hote jevhA AmhI (mUsAlA) pukArale hote. kiMbahunA hI tumacyA pAlanakartyAtarphe kRpA hoya, yAsAThI kI tumhI azA lokAMnA khabaradAra karAve, jyAMcyAjavaLa tumacyApUrvI koNI khabaradAra karaNArA pohacalA nAhI. navala navhe kI tyAMnI bodha prApta karUna ghyAvA.

ANi jara ase nasate kI tyAMnA, tyAMcyA ApalyA hAtAMnI puDhe pAThavilelyA karmAMpAyI ekhAdI kaSTa-yAtanA pohacalI asatI, tevhA he ud‌gArale asate kI AmacyA pAlanakartyA! tU AmacyAkaDe ekhAdA rasUla (paigaMbara) kA nAhI pAThavilA kI AmhI tujhyA AyatIMce pAlana kele asate ANi ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMpaikI jhAlo asato.

maga jevhA tyAMcyAjavaLa AmacyAtarphe satya yeUna pohacale, tevhA mhaNU lAgale, kA nAhI dilI gelI yAlA tazI vastU jazI mUsAlA dilI gelI hotI. tara kAya mUsAlA yApUrvI je kAhI dile gele hote tyAcA lokAMnI inkAra navhatA kelA? (ughaDapaNe) mhaNAle hote kI he doghe jAdUgAra Aheta. je ekamekAMce sahAyyaka Aheta ANi AmhI tara tyA sarvAMcA inkAra karaNAre Ahota.
tyAMnA sAMgA kI jara sacce asAla tara tumhI dekhIla allAhakaDUna asA ekhAdA graMtha gheUna yA, jo yA doghAMpekSA jAsta mArgadarzana karaNArA asAvA. mI tyAceca anusaraNa karena.

maga jara he tumace mhaNaNe mAnata nasatIla tara tumhI vizvAsa karA kI he kevaLa ApalyA icchA AkAMkSAMce anusaraNa karIta Aheta. ANi tyA mANasApekSA adhika mArgabhraSTa koNa Ahe, jo ApalyA icchA AkAMkSAMmAge dhAvata asela, allAhacyA mArgadarzanAvinA? khAtrIne allAha atyAcArI lokAMnA kadApi mArga dAkhavita nAhI.
ANi AmhI sAtatyAne lokAMsAThI ApalI vANI pAThavita rAhilo yAsAThI kI tyAMnI bodha prApta karAvA.
jyA lokAMnA AmhI yApUrvI graMtha pradAna kelA hotA, te tara yAvara ImAna rAkhatAta.

ANi jevhA (tyAcyA AyatI) tyAMcyAsamora vAcUna aikavilyA jAtAta tevhA te ase mhaNatAta kI AmacyA pAlanakartyAtarphe he satya asaNyAvara Amace ImAna (pUrNa vizvAsa) Ahe. AmhI tara yAcyA pUrvIpAsUna muslima Ahota.

he ase loka Aheta, jyAMnA ApalyA kelelyA dhIra-saMyamAcyA badalyAta duppaTa mobadalA pradAna kelA jAIla. he satkarmAdvAre duSkarmAlA dUra karatAta ANi AmhI je yAMnA deUna Thevale Ahe, tyAtUna deta rAhatAta.

jevhA vyartha goSTa kAnI paDate, tevhA ticyApAsUna alipta hotAta ANi mhaNatAta kI Amace AcaraNa AmacyAsAThI ANi tumace AcaraNa tumacyAsAThI, tumacyAvara salAma aso. AmhI aDANI lokAMzI vAda ghAlU icchita nAhI.
tumhI vATela tyAlA Iza-mArgadarzana deU zakata nAhI, kiMbahunA allAhaca jyAlA icchila tyAlA mArgadarzana deto. mArgadarzana prApta lokAMnA toca cAMgalyA prakAre jANato.

ANi mhaNU lAgale kI jara AmhI ApalyAsobata mArgadarzanAce anusaraNa karU lAgalo tara Amace, AmacyA bhUmI (dezA) tUna uccATana kele jAIla. kAya AmhI tyAMnA zAMta va surikSata ANi Adara sanmAnapUrNa haramamadhye jAgA nAhI dilI, jithe pratyeka prakArace phaLa AkarSita hoUna cAlata yete je AmacyAkaDUna AjivikA svarUpAta Ahe? tathApi tyAMcyApaikI adhikAMza loka kAhI jANata nAhI.

ANi AmhI azA aneka vastyA naSTa karUna TAkalyA, jyA ApalyA sukha vilAsAta unmatta jhAlyA hotyA. hI Aheta tyAMcI nivAsasthAne jI tyAMcyAnaMtara phAraca kamI AbAda kelI gelIta. ANi akherIsa AmhIca sarva kAhIce vArasa Ahota.

ANi tumacA pAlanakartA kadhIhI koNA ekA vastIlAhI tyA veLeparyaMta naSTa karIta nAhI, joparyaMta tyAMcyA ekhAdyA moThyA vastIta ApalA ekhAdA paigaMbara pAThavita nAhI, jo tyAMnA AmacyA AyatI vAcUna aikavila ANi AmhI vastyAMnA azA veLI naSTa karato, jevhA tithale rahivAzI atyAcArI vhAveta.

ANi tumhAlA je kAhI dile gele Ahe, tI kevaLa yA jagAcyA jIvanAcI sAmugrI Ahe ANi tyAcI zobhA sajAvaTa Ahe. mAtra allAhajavaLa je Ahe, te sarvAMta uttama ANi bAkI rAhaNAre Ahe. kAya tumhI samajata nAhIta?

kAya to manuSya, jyAlA AmhI cAMgalA vAyadA dilA Ahe, jyAsa to nizcitapaNe prApta karaNAra Ahe, tyA mANasAsArakhA asU zakato, jyAlA AmhI aihika jIvanAcI kAhI sukhe azIca pradAna kelI, dusar2yAMdA zevaTI to kayAmatacyA divazI (jakhaDalelyA avastheta) hajara kelA jAIla?
ANi jyA divazI allAha tyAMnA pukArUna sAMgela kI tumhI jyAMnA ApalyA samajutInusAra mAjhA sahabhAgI Tharavita hote, te koThe Aheta?

jyAMcyAvara Amace pharmAna lAgU jhAle, te uttara detIla kI, he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! heca te hota, jyAMnA AmhI mArgabhraSTa kele hote. AmhI tyAMnA azAca prakAre pathabhraSTa kele, jyA prakAre AmhI pathabhraSTa jhAlo hoto. AmhI tujhyA seveta svataHlA yAMcyApAsUna vegaLe karato. he AmacI upAsanA karIta navhate.

ANi tyAMnA sAMgile jAIla kI ApalyA sahabhAgI (IzvarAMnA) bolavA, tevhA te bolavatIla, paraMtu te tyAMnA uttara dekhIla deNAra nAhIta. ANi sarva az2Aba (allAhacI zikSA- yAtanA) pAhatIla. yA lokAMnI mArgadarzana prApta kele asate tara bare jhAle asate!
ANi tyA divazI tyAMnA bolAvUna vicArela kI tumhI paigaMbarAMnA kAya uttara dile hote?
maga tara tyA divazI tyAMce sagaLe samAcAra AMdhaLe hotIla ANi te ekamekAMnA kAhI vicAraNArahI nAhIta.
paraMtu jo manuSya (allAhajavaLa) mAphI mAgUna ImAna rAkhela ANi satkarma karIta rAhIla, nizcitaca to saphalatA prApta karaNAr2yAMpaikI Tharela.

ANi tumacA pAlanakartA je icchito, nirmANa karato, ANi jyAlA icchito, tyAMcyAmadhUna nivaDUna gheto, koNAlA kasalAhI adhikAra nAhI. allAhakaritAca pAkI (pavitratA) Ahe. to atizaya ucca Ahe tyA pratyeka vastUpAsUna, jyAlA loka (allAhacA) sahabhAgI banavitAta.
ANi tumacA pAlanakartA sarva kAhI jANato, je kAhI te ApalyA chAtIta (hRdayAta) lapavitAta, ANi je kAhI vyakta karatAta.
ANi toca allAha Ahe, tyAcyAkherIja upAsanA karaNyAyogya asA dusarA koNIhI nAhI. yA jagAta ANi Akhiratamadhye tyAcIca prazaMsA Ahe. tyAcAca Adeza Ahe ANi tyAcyAcakaDe tumhI sarva paratavile jAla.

sAMgA kI, jarA vicAra karA, jara allAha kayAmataparyaMta tumacyAvara niraMtara rAtraca rAtra AcchAdita karIla tara allAhakherIja te koNate ArAdhya daivata Ahe, je tumacyAvara divasAcA prakAza ANIla? kAya tumhI aikata nAhI?

tyAMnA vicArA, hAhI vicAra karA, jara allAha kayAmataparyaMta tumacyAvara niraMtara divasaca divasa ThevIla tara azA sthitItahI allAhakherIja te koNate daivata (mAbUda) Ahe je tumacyAjavaLa rAtra ANIla, jyAta tumhI ArAma karU zakAve. kAya tumhI pAhata nAhIta?

ANi tyAneca tumacyAsAThI ApalyA dayA kRpene divasa rAtra nirdhArita kele Aheta, yAsAThI kI rAtrI tumhI ArAma karU zakAve ANi divasA tyAcyA (pAThavilelyA) AjivikecA zodha ghyAvA. he azAsAThI kI tumhI kRtajJatA vyakta karAvI.
ANi jyA divazI tyAMnA hAka mArUna allAha pharmAvila kI jyAMnA tumhI mAjhA sahabhAgI samajata hote, te Aheta koThe?

ANi tumhI pratyeka janasamudAyAtUna eka sAkSI vegaLA karU ANi sAMgU kI ApalA purAvA sAdara karA, jevhA tyA veLI jANUna ghetIla kI satya allAhacyA bAjUne Ahe ANi je kAhI asatya te racata rAhile te sarva tyAMcyA javaLUna haravale jAIla.

kAruna mUsAcyA janasamUhApaikI hotA, paraMtu to tyAcyAvara atyAcAra karU lAgalA hotA. AmhI tyAlA evaDhA pracaMDa khajinA deUna ThevalA hotA kI kityeka zaktizAlI loka moThyA kaSTAne tyAcyA cAvyA ucalU zakata hote. ekadA tyAcyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMnI tyAlA mhaTale kI dimAkha dAkhavU nakosa. allAha, dimAkha dAkhaviNAr2yAMzI prema karIta nAhI.

ANi je kAhI allAhane tulA pradAna kele Ahe, tyAtUna AkhiratacyA gharAcA zodhahI Theva ANi ApalA aihika hissAhI visarU nakosa ANi jyA prakAre allAhane tujhyAvara upakAra kelA Ahe, tU dekhIla sad‌vartana kara ANi dezAta utpAta (mAjaviNyA) cI icchA dharU nakosa. nizcitaca, allAha utpAta (phasAda) mAjaviNAr2yAMzI prema rAkhata nAhI.

kAruna mhaNAlA, he sarva kAhI malA mAjhyA svataHcyA jJAnAmuLe dile gele Ahe. kAya AtAparyaMta tyAlA he mAhIta jhAle nAhI kI allAhane tyAcyApUrvI kitItarI vastIvAlyAMnA naSTa karUna TAkale je tyAcyApekSA jAsta balavAna ANi jAsta dhanavAna hote, ANi aparAdhyAMnA tyAMcyA aparAdhAMviSayI azA veLI vicArale jAta nAhI.

yAstava (kAruna) saMpUrNa thATAmATAsaha ApalyA janasamUhAcyA jamAvAta nighAlA, tevhA aihika jIvanAcI AsaktI bALagaNAre mhaNAle, AmhAlA kazAhI prakAre te lAbhale asate, je kArunalA dile gele Ahe, tara kitI bare jhAle asate! hA tara moThA bhAgyazAlI Ahe.

ANi vidvAna (dharmajJAnI) loka tyAMnA samajAvU lAgale kI moThyA khedAcI goSTa Ahe! uttama goSTa tara tI Ahe jI nekI (satkarmA) cyA rUpAta tyAMnA lAbhela, je allAhavara ImAna rAkhatIla ANi satkarma karIta rAhatIla. hI goSTa tyAMcyAca manAta TAkalI (prerita kelI) jAte, je dhairyazIla ANi sahanazIla asAveta.
(zevaTI) AmhI tyAlA tyAcyA mahAlAsamaveta jaminIta dhasavale ANi allAhakherIja, koNatAhI samUha tyAcyA madatIkaritA tayAra jhAlA nAhI, nA to svataHlA vAcaviNAr2yAMpaikI hoU zakalA.

ANi je loka kAlaparyaMta tyAcyA padAparyaMta pohacaNyAcI AzA karIta hote, te Aja mhaNU lAgale kI, kAya tumhI pAhata nAhI kI allAha ApalyA dAsAMpaikI jyAcyAsAThI i‌cchito AjivikA (rojI) vyApaka karato, ANi kamI dekhIla. jara allAhane AmacyAvara upakAra kelA nasatA tara AmhAlAhI dhasavile asate. kAya pAhata nAhI kI kRtaghna lokAMnA saphalatA kadApi prApta hota nAhI.

Akhiratace he (bhale) ghara AmhI azAca lokAMsAThI nizcita karato je dharatIvara ghameMDa ANi garva karIta nAhI, ANi nA utpAta (phasAda) karU icchitAta ANi allAhace bhaya rAkhUna AcaraNa karaNAr2yAMkaritA phAra cAMgalA mobadalA Ahe.
jo manuSya nekI (satkarma) gheUna yeIla, tyAlA tyAhUna adhika cAMgale lAbhela ANi jo duSkarma gheUna yeIla tara azA durAcArI lokAMnA tyAMcyA tyAca AcaraNAcA mobadalA dilA jAIla, je te karIta hote.

jyA (allAha) ne tumacyAvara kuraAna avatarita kele Ahe to tumhAlA dusar2yAMdA pahilyA sthAnAvara ANaNAra Ahe. sAMgA, mAjhA pAlanakartA tyAlAhI cAMgalyA prakAre jANato, tyAne mArgadarzana prApta kele Ahe, ANi tyAlAhI jo ughaDa mArgabhraSTateta paDalA Ahe.
ANi tumhI kadhIhI vicArahI kelA navhatA kI tumacyAvara graMtha avatarita kelA jAIla, paraMtu hA tumacyA pAlanakartyAcyA dayA kRpene (avatarita jhAlA) AtA tumhI kadhIhI kAphirAMce sahAyyaka hoU naye.

(lakSAta ThevA) yA kAphirAMnI tumhAlA, allAhacyA AyatIMcA pracAra karaNyApAsUna rokhU naye, yAnaMtara kI tyA tumacyAvara avatarita kelyA jANyAta. tevhA ApalyA pAlanakartyAkaDe bolavita rAhA, ANi anekezvaravAdI lokAMpaikI hoU nakA.

ANi allAhacyA sobata dusar2yA ekhAdyA daivatAlA pukArU nakA. allAhakherIja dusarA koNIhI upAsanA karaNyA yogya nAhI. pratyeka vastU nAza pAvaNAra Ahe, paraMtu tyAce mukha, tyAceca zAsana Ahe ANi tumhI tyAcyAcakaDe paratavile jAla.
alipha - lAma - mIma.
kAya lokAMnI ase samajUna ghetale Ahe kI tyAMcyA kevaLa yA bolaNyAvara kI AmhI ImAna rAkhale Ahe, tyAMnA parIkSA ghetalyAvinA aseca soDUna dile jAIla?
tyAMcyA pUrvI hoUna gelelyA lokAMcIhI AmhI cAMgalyA prakAre kasoTI ghetalI. niHsaMzaya, allAha tyAMnAhI jANUna gheIla, je khare bolatAta, ANi tyAMnAhI jANUna gheIla je khoTAraDe Aheta.
kAya je loka duSkarma karIta Aheta, tyAMnI ase samajUna ghetale Aheta kI te AmacyA kAbUtUna bAhera jAtIla? kasA vAITa vicAra he loka karIta Aheta!
jyAlA allAhacyA bheTIcI apekSA asela, tara allAhacI nirdhArita kelelI veLa nizcitaca yeNAra Ahe. to sarva kAhI aikaNArA, sarva kAhI jANaNArA Ahe.
ANi pratyeka prayatna karaNArA ApalyA svataHcyAca bhalyAkaritA prayatna karato. niHsaMzaya allAha samasta jagavAlyAMpAsUna niHspRha Ahe.
ANi jyAMnI ImAna bALagale ANi (paigaMbara AcaraNacyA dRSTIne) satkarma kele, AmhI tyAMcyA sarva aparAdhAMnA tyAMcyApAsUna dUra karU, ANi tyAMcyA neka kAmAMcA cAMgalA mobadalA pradAna karU.

AmhI pratyeka mANasAlA ApalyA mAtA-pityAzI sad‌vartana karaNyAcI zikavaNa dilI Ahe. tathApi jara te hA prayatna karatIla kI tumhI mAjhyAsobata tyAlA sahabhAgI karUna ghyAve, jyAce tumhAlA jJAna nAhI tara tyAMce mhaNaNe mAnya karU nakA. tumhA sarvAMnA paratUna mAjhyAcakaDe yAyace Ahe, maga mI tyA pratyeka goSTIzI, jI tumhI karIta hote avagata karavIna.
ANi jyA lokAMnI ImAna kabUla kele, ANi satmarka karIta rAhile tyAMnA AmhI ApalyA neka (sadAcArI) dAsAMmadhye sAmIla karU.

ANi kAhI loka asehI Aheta, je toMDAne mhaNatAta kI AmhI ImAna rAkhale Ahe. paraMtu jevhA allAhacyA mArgAta ekhAdyA duHkhAcA sAmanA hoto, tevhA lokAMkaDUna dilA jANAr2yA kaSTa- yAtanelA allAhacyA zikSA- yAtanesamAna TharavitAta, paraMtu jara allAhacI madata yeUna pohacalI tara tevhA mhaNU lAgatAta kI AmhI tara tumacyAca sAthIlA Ahota, kAya samasta vizvA (mANasAMcyA) manAta je kAhI Ahe, te allAha jANata nAhI?
ANi jyA lokAMnI ImAna rAkhale, allAha tyAMnAhI jANUna ghetalyAvinA rAhaNAra nAhI ANi ImAnadhAraka asaNyAce DhoMga racaNAr2yAMnAhI jANUna ghetalyAvinA rAhaNAra nAhI.

ANi kAphira (satya virodhaka) ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMnA mhaNAle, tumhI AmacyA mArgAce anusaraNa karA, tumace aparAdha AmhI ApalyA (zirA) vara gheU, vAstavika te tyAMcyA aparAdhAMpaikI kAhI eka ApalyAvara gheNAra nAhIta. te tara agadI khoTAraDe Aheta.
(evaDhe nizcita kI) he Apale ojhe ucalatIla ANi ApalyA ojhyAMsobata itara ojhe dekhIla, ANi te je kAhI asatya racata Aheta tyA sarvAMbAbata tyAMnA vicAraNA kelI jAIla.
ANi AmhI nUha (alai.) lA tyAMcyA janasamUhAkaDe pAThavile, te tyAMcyA daramyAna sADe naUze varSAMparyaMta rAhile, maga tyAMnA vAdaLAne yeUna dharale ANi te hoteca moThe atyAcArI.
maga AmhI tyAMnA ANi naukAvAlyAMnA muktI dilI, ANi AmhI yA ghaTanelA saMpUrNa jagAkaritA bodhacinha banavile.
ANi ibrAhIma (alai.) dekhIla ApalyA janasamUhAsa mhaNAle kI allAhacI upAsanA karA ANi tyAce bhaya bALagUna rAhA, jara tumhI akkalavAna asAla tara, heca tumacyAsAThI adhika cAMgale Ahe.

tumhI tara allAhalA soDUna mUrtIcI pUjA karIta AhAta, ANi khoTyA goSTI manAne racUna ghetA. (aikA) tumhI allAhaaivajI jyAMcI jyAMcI pUjA arcanA karIta AhAta, te tara tumacyA Ajivikece mAlaka nAhIta, tevhA tumhI allAhakaDeca rojI (AjivikA) mAgitalI pAhije. ANi tyAcIca upAsanA karA ANi tyAcyAzIca kRtajJazIla rAhA ANi tyAcyAcakaDe tumhI paratavile jAla.
ANi jara tumhI khoTe TharavAla tara tumacyApUrvI hoUna gelelyA lokAMnIhI khoTe Tharavile Ahe, ANi paigaMbarAce kartavya tara kevaLa spaSTarityA pohacavUna deNeca Ahe.
kAya tyAMnI nAhI pAhile kI allAhane sRSTI-nirmitIcI utpattI kazA prakAre kelI, maga allAha ticI punarAvRttI karIla. he tara allAhakaritA phAra sope Ahe.

sAMgA, jaminIvara hiMDUna phirUna pAhA kI kazA prakAre allAhane sarvAMta prathama nirmitIlA utpanna kele, maga allAhaca dusarI navI utpattI karela. niHsaMzaya, allAha pratyeka goSTIce sAmarthya bALagato.
to jyAlA icchila az2Aba deIla ANi jyAvara icchila dayA karIla, sarva tyAcyAcakaDe paratavile jAla.
tumhI nA jaminIvara allAhalA vivaza (lAcAra) karU zakatA, nA AkAzAta, allAhakherIja tumacA koNI nA saMrakSaka Ahe nA sahAyyaka.
ANi je loka allAhacyA AyatIMnA ANi tyAcyA bheTIlA khoTe TharavitAta tyAMnI mAjhyA dayA- kRpecI Asa rAkhU naye ANi tyAcyAkaritA duHkhadAyaka az2Aba (zikSA- yAtanA) Ahe.

tyAcyA janasamUhAce uttara yAkherIja dusare kAhI navhate kI te mhaNAle, yAlA mArUna TAkA kiMvA yAlA jALUna TAkA. zevaTI allAhane tyAMnA AgIpAsUna vAcavile. yAta ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMkaritA aneka nizANyA Aheta.

(hajarata ibrAhIma alai.) mhaNAle kI tumhI allAhaaivajI jyA mUrtI (daivatAM) cI pUjA arcanA kelI Ahe tyAMnA tumhI ApalyA aihika maitrIce kAraNa banavile Ahe. tumhI sarva kayAmatacyA divazI ekamekAMcA inkAra karU lAgAla ANi ekamekAMnA dhiHkkArU lAgAla ANi tumhA sarrAMce ThikANa jahannamadhye asela, ANi koNI tumacI madata karaNArAhI nasela.

tevhA tyAcyA (hajarata ibrAhIma alai.) vara (hajarata) lUta (alai.) yAMnI ImAna rAkhale ANi mhaNAle, mI ApalyA pAlanakartyAkaDe hijarata (sthalAMtara) karaNArA Ahe. to moThA varcasvazAlI ANi hikamata (buddhI-kauzalya) bALagaNArA Ahe.

ANi AmhI tyAlA (ibrAhIma alai. yAMnA) isahAka ANi yAkUba pradAna kele, ANi AmhI preSitva ANi graMtha tyAMcyA vaMzAta rAkhalA, ANi AmhI yA jagAtahI tyAMnA cAMgalA mobadalA dilA ANi Akhiratamadhye tara te sadAcArI lokAMpaikI Aheta.
ANi (hajarata) lUta (alai.) yAMcAhI (ullekha karA) jevhA te ApalyA janasamUhAlA mhaNAle kI tumhI tara ase nirlajjapaNAce kAma karatA je tumacyApUrvI saMpUrNa jagApaikI koNIhI kele nAhI.

kAya tumhI (kAmavAsanA pUrtIkaritA) puruSAMjavaLa yetA, ANi vATamAra karatAta ANi ApalyA Ama sabhAmadhye nirlajjatece kAma karatA? tevhA tyAcyA uttarAdAkhala tyAMcyA janasamUhAne yAkherIja dusare kAhI sAMgitale nAhI kI pure kara, jara saccA Ahesa tara AmacyAvara allAhacA az2Aba (zikSA) ANUna dAkhava.
(hajarata) lUta (alai.) yAMnI duA (prArthanA) kelI kI, he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! yA durAcArI lokAMcyA virodhAta mAjhI madata kara.

ANi jevhA AmhI pAThavilele pharizte (hajarata) ibrAhIma (alai.) javaLa zubha samAcAra gheUna pohocale tevhA mhaNAle, AmhI yA vastIcyA lokAMcA nAza karaNAra Ahota. niHsaMzaya ithale rahivAzI moThe atyAcArI Aheta.

(hajarata) ibrAhIma) mhaNAle, tyA vastIta tara lUta (alai.) Aheta. pharizte mhaNAle, ithe je Aheta, tyAMnA AmhI cAMgalyA prakAre jANato lUta ANi tyAMcyA kuTuMbAlA, tyAMcyA patnIkherIja, AmhI vAcavU. niHsaMzaya tI strI mAge rAhaNAr2yAMpaikI Ahe.

ANi maga jevhA AmhI pAThavilele pharizte lUta (alai.) javaLa pohocale, tevhA te tyAMcyAmuLe duHkhI kaSTI jhAle ANi manAtalyA manAta zokAkula jhAle. saMdezavAhaka mhaNAle, tumhI bhiU nakA ANi duHkhI hoU nakA, AmhI tumhAlA tumacyA kuTuMbAsahita surakSita ThevU tumacyA pat‌IlA soDUna, kAraNa tI az2Aba (zikSe) sAThI bAkI rAhaNAr2yAMpaikI asela.
AmhI yA vastIcyA lokAMvara AkAzAtUna az2Aba utaraviNAra Ahota, yA kAraNAstava kI he durAcArI hota Aheta.
ANi AmhI yA vastIlA spaSTa bodha grahaNa karaNyAsAThI cinha banavile tyA lokAMkaritA je buddhI bALagatAta.

ANi madayanakaDe (AmhI) tyAMce bhAU zuaiba (alai.) yAMnA pAThavile. te mhaNAle, he mAjhyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMno! allAhacI upAsanA karA, kayAmatacyA divasAcI AzA bALagA ANi jaminIvara utpAta (phasAda) pasaravita phirU nakA.
tarIhI tyA lokAMnI tyAMnA khoTe Tharavile, zevaTI bhUkaMpAne tyAMnA dharale ANi te ApalyA gharAMmadhye basalyA basalyA mRta jhAle.

ANi AmhI ‘Ada’ ANi ‘samUda’ (janasamUhA) cyA lokAMnAhI (naSTa kele) jyAMce kAhI bhagna avazeSa tumacyAsamora hajara Aheta. ANi saitAnAne tyAMcyA duSkarmAlA suzobhita karUna dAkhavile hote ANi tyAMnA sanmArgApAsUna rokhale hote. yAnaMtara kI he DoLe rAkhaNAre ANi calAkha hote.

ANi kAruna, phiraauna ANi hAmAnalA dekhIla. tyAcyAjavaLa (hajarata) mUsA ughaDa svarUpAce camatkAra (mojije) gheUna Ale hote tarIhI tyAMnI dharatIvara ghameMDa kelI, tathApi AmacyA puDhe jANAre hoU zakale nAhIta.

maga tara AmhI pratyekAlA tyAcyA duSkarmAcI zikSA deNyAsAThI dharale. tyAMcyApaikI kAhIMvara AmhI dagaDAMcA varSAva kelA, tyAMcyApaikI kAhIMnA bhayaMkara citkArAne gherale, tyAMcyApaikI kAhIMnA AmhI jaminIta dhasavale ANi tyAcyApaikI kAhIMnA AmhI pANyAta buDavile. allAha asA nAhI kI tyAMcyAvara atyAcAra karIla, ulaTa teca loka ApalyA prANAMvara julUma atyAcAra karIta hote.

jyA lokAMnI allAhakherIja dusar2yAMnA valI (daivata) TharavUna ghetale Ahe, tyAMce udAharaNa koSTI kiTakAsArakhe Ahe kAraNa tohI eka ghara banavito, vAstavika sarva gharAMpekSA jAsta kamajora ghara koSTI kiTakAce ghara Ahe. tyAMnI he jANUna ghetale asate tara bare jhAle asate!
allAha samasta vastUMnA jANato, jyAMnA te tyAcyAkherIja pukArata Aheta. ANi to moThA jabaradasta ANi buddhI kauzalya bALagaNArA Ahe.
ANi AmhI hI udAharaNa lokAMkaritA nivedana karIta Ahota ANi yAMnA kevaLa teca loka samajatAta je jJAna rAkhatAta.
allAhane AkAzAMnA ANi jaminIlA satyAsaha nirmANa kele Ahe ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMkaritA yAta phAra moThI nizANI Ahe.

jo graMtha tumacyAkaDe vahayI (avatarita) kelA gelA Ahe, tyAce paThaNa karA ANi namAja kAyama karA (niyamitapaNe paDhata rAhA) niHsaMzaya namAja, nirlajjatA ANi duSkarmApAsUna rokhate ANi niHsaMzaya allAhace nAmaHsmaraNa phAra moThI goSTa Ahe. tumhI je kAhI karIta AhAta, allAha te jANato.

ANi graMthadhArakAMzI khUpa cAMgalyA ritIne vAdavivAda karA, azA lokAMkherIja, je tyAMcyAta atyAcArI Aheta. ANi spaSTa ailAna karA kI AmhI tara tyA graMthAvarahI ImAna rAkhato, jo AmacyAvara avatarita kelA gelA Ahe ANi tyAvarahI, jo tumacyAvara avatarita kelA gelA. AmacA ANi tumacA pAlanakartA ekaca Ahe. AmhI sarva tyAceca AjJAdhAraka Ahota.

ANi AmhI tyAca prakAre tumacyAkaDe ApalA graMtha avatarita kelA Ahe, yAstava jyAMnA AmhI graMtha pradAna kelA Ahe, te tyAvara ImAna rAkhatAta ANi tyAMcyApaikI kAhI tyAvara ImAna rAkhatAta ANi AmacyA AyatIMcA inkAra kevaLa kAphiraca karatAta.
ANi yApUrvI tara tumhI ekhAdA graMtha vAcata hote ANi nA ekhAdA graMtha ApalyA hAtAne lihita hote kI (jyAmuLe) asatyAce pujArI zaMkA saMzayAta paDale asate.
vAstavika yA (kuraAnAcyA) divya (spaSTa) AyatI Aheta, jyA vidvAnAMcyA hRdayAta surakSita Aheta. AmacyA AyatIMcA inkAra karaNArA, atyAcArIkherIja dusarA koNI nAhI.

ANi te mhaNAle, yAcyAvara kAhI nizANyA yAcyA pAlanakartyAtarphe kA nAhI avatarita kelyA gelyA? (tumhI) sAMgA, nizANyA tara sarva allAhajavaLa Aheta. mAjhI yogyatA tara kevaLa spaSTataH khabaradAra (sAvadha) karaNAr2yAcI Ahe.

kAya tyAMcyAsAThI he nizANa purese nAhI kI AmhI tumacyAvara ApalA graMtha avatarita kelA, jo tyAMnA vAcUna aikavilA jAta Ahe. yAta (allAhacI) dayA-kRpAhI Ahe ANi bodha upadezahI, tyA lokAMsAThI je ImAna rAkhaNAre Aheta.

tyAMnA sAMgA, mAjhyA ANi tumacyA daramyAna allAhace sAkSI asaNe purese Ahe. to tara AkAza ANi jaminIcyA pratyeka vastUlA jANaNArA Ahe. je loka asatyAlA mAnaNAre Aheta ANi allAhazI kupra (inkAra) karaNAre Aheta, te phAra moThyA nukasAnAta Aheta.

ANi he loka tumacyAjavaLa zikSA-yAtanecI ghAI mAjavita Aheta. jara mAjhyAtarphe eka nizcita veLa TharavilI gelI nasatI tara AtAparyaMta tyAMcyAjavaLa zikSA-yAtanA yeUna pohacalI asatI. evaDhe mAtra nizcita kI acAnaka tyAMcyA nakaLata az2Aba tyAMcyAjavaLa yeUna pohocela.
he loka az2Aba (zikSe) sAThI ghAI mAjavita Aheta, ANi (samAdhAna rAkhA) jahannama kAphirAMnA gherUna TAkaNAra Ahe.
tyA divazI tyAMnA, tyAMcyA varUna ANi khAlUna az2Aba jhAkata asela ANi sarvazreSTha allAha pharmAvila, AtA ApalyA duSkarmAMcI goDI cAkhA.
he mAjhyA ImAna rAkhaNAr2yA dAsAMno! mAjhI jamIna phAra vistRta Ahe. tevhA tumhI mAjhIca upAsanA karA.
pratyeka jIvAlA mRtyucI goDI cAkhAyacI Ahe ANi tumhI sarva AmacyAcakaDe paratavile jAla.

ANi jyA lokAMnI ImAna rAkhale ANi satkarma karIta rAhile, tyAMnA AmhI nizcitapaNe jannatacyA uMca mahAlAMmadhye jAgA deU, jyAMcyA khAlUna nadyA vAhata Ahe, jithe te sadaivakALa rAhatIla. (cAMgale) karma karaNAr2yAMcA kitI cAMgalA mobadalA Ahe!
te, jyAMnI dhIra - saMyama rAkhalA ANi je ApalyA pAlanakartyAvara bharavasA ThevatAta.
ANi kityeka prANI ase Aheta, je ApalI AjivikA ucalUna phirata nAhI. tyA sarvAMnA ANi tumhAlAhI allAhaca AjivikA pradAna karato. to sarva kAhI aikaNArA, jANaNArA Ahe.
ANi jara tumhI tyAMnA vicArAla kI AkAza va jaminIcA nirmANa karaNArA ANi sUrya va caMdrAlA kAmAsa lAvaNArA koNa Ahe, tara te heca uttara detIla kI allAha! tevhA maga koThe ulaTa jAta AhAta?
allAha ApalyA dAsAMpaikI jyAlA icchito, adhika AjivikA pradAna karato ANi jyAlA icchito kamI. niHsaMzaya, allAha pratyeka goSTa jANaNArA Ahe.

ANi jara tumhI tyAMnA vicArAla kI AkAzAtUna pANyAcA varSAva karUna, jaminIlA ticyA mRtyunaMtara jivaMta karaNArA koNa Ahe, tevhA nizcitaca tyAMce uttara heca asela kI allAha! tumhI sAMgA kI samasta stutI- prazaMsA allAhakaritAca Ahe, kiMbahunA tyAMcyAta adhikAMza loka nirbodha Aheta. (Akalana akakala rAkhata nAhI)
ANi yA jagAce jIvana tara kevaLa manoraMjana ANi kheLa krIDA Ahe paraMtu khare jIvana tara Akhiratace ghara Ahe. yA lokAMnI he jANale asate tara bare jhAle asate!

jevhA he loka nauketa svAra hotAta, tevhA allAhalAca pukAratAta, tyAcyAsAThI upAsanelA khAsakarUna, maga jevhA to tyAMnA khuzkIkaDe surakSita gheUna yeto, tevhA lageca zirka (anekaIzvaraupAsanA) karU lAgatAta.
yAsAThI kI AmhI kelelyA upakArAMzI kRtaghna vhAve ANi lAbha gheta rAhAvA. AtA lavakaraca tyAMnA kaLUna yeIla.

kAya he nAhI pAhata kI AmhI haramalA zAMtIce staLa banavile, vastutaH tyAMcyA javaLacyA ilAkyAtUna loka apahRta kele jAtAta. kAya he asatyAvara tara vizvAsa ThevatAta ANi allAhacyA kRpA- deNagyAMvara kRtaghnatA dAkhavitAta?

ANi tyAhUna moThA atyAcArI koNa asela, jo allAhazI choTyA goSTIcA saMbaMdha joDela kiMvA satya tyAcyAjavaLa yeUna pohacale asatA, to tyAlA khoTe asalyAce sAMgela. kAya azA kAphirAMce ThikANa jahannamamadhye nasela?
ANi je loka AmacyA mArgAta duHkha sahana karatAta, AmhI tyAMnA ApalA mArga avazya dAkhavU. niHsaMzaya, allAha satkarma karaNAr2yAMcA sobatI Ahe.
alipha. lAma. mIma
romana parAjita jhAle.
javaLacyA pradezAta ANi te parAjita jhAlyAnaMtara bhaviSyAta varcasvazAlI hotIla.
kAhI varSAMcyA Ataca, yAcyApUrvI ANi yAnaMtarahI adhikAra phakta allAhacAca Ahe, ANi tyA divazI ImAna rAkhaNAre khUza hotIla.
allAhacyA madatIne to jyAlA icchito madata karato, ANi kharA vijetA ANi varcasvazAlI ANi dayAvAna toca Ahe.
allAhacA vAyadA Ahe. allAha ApalyA vAyadyAMcA bhaMga karIta nAhI, paraMtu bahuteka loka jANata nAhIta.
te tara (phakta) aihika jIvanAcyA bAhya svarUpAlAca jANatAta. ANi AkhiratapAsUna tara agadI gAphIla Aheta.

kAya tyA lokAMnI ApalyA manAta yAvara vicAra nAhI kelA kI allAha ne AkAzAMnA va jaminIlA ANi tyAMcyA daramyAna je kAhI Ahe tyA sarvAMnA uttama anumAnAne, nirdhArita veLeparyaMta (ca) nirmANa kele Ahe, tathApi adhikAMza loka ApalyA pAlanakartyAcyA bheTIcA inkAra karatAta.

kAya tyAMnI jaminIvara hiMDUna phirUna pAhile nAhI kI tyAMcyApUrvI hoUna gelelyA lokAMcA pariNAma (aMta) kasA (vAITa) jhAlA? te yAMcyApekSA jAsta zaktizAlI hote ANi tyAMnI dekhIla jamIna peralI-nAMgaralI hotI ANi yAMcyApekSA jAsta AbAdI kelI hotI. ANi tyAMcyAjavaLa tyAMce rasUla (paigaMbara) Iza-camatkAra (mojije) gheUna Ale hote. he tara azakya hote kI allAhane tyAMcyAvara julUma atyAcAra kelA asatA. paraMtu (khare pAhatA) te svataH ApalyA prANAMvara atyAcAra karIta hote.
maga zevaTI vAITa lokAMcI pariNItI vAITa jhAlI, yAsAThI kI te allAhacyA AyatIMnA khoTe TharavIta ANi tyAMcI thaTTA uDavIta.
allAhaca sRSTI-nirmitIcA AraMbha karato, maga toca tilA dusar2yAMdA nirmANa karIla, maga tumhI sarva tyAcyAcakaDe paratavile jAla.
ANi jyA divazI kayAmata prasthApita hoIla, tyA divazI aparAdhI Azcaryacakita hotIla.
ANi tyAMnI TharavilelyA sarva sahabhAgyAMpaikI ekahI tyAMcI ziphArasa karaNAra nAhI. ANi svataH hedekhIla ApalyA ArAdhya daivatAMcA (sahabhAgI IzvarAMcA) inkAra karatIla.
ANi jyA divazI kayAmata prasthApita hoIla, tyA divazI (sarva samUha) vibhAgale jAtIla.
maga je ImAna bALagUna satkarma karIta rAhatIla, tyAMnA jannatamadhye khUza kele jAIla.
ANi jyAMnI (kupra) inkAra kelA hotA, ANi AmacyA AyatIMnA va AkhiratacyA bheTIlA khoTe Tharavile hote, tyA sarvAMnA zikSA - yAtanAgrasta karUna hajara kele jAIla.
tevhA allAhacI stutI-prazaMsA karIta rAhA, jevhA tumhI saMdhyAkALa karAla ANi jevhA sakALa karAla.
ANi sarva stutI- prazaMsesa yogya, AkAzAta va jaminIvara toca Ahe tisar2yA praharI ANi dupAracyA veLIhI tyAcI pavitratA varNana karA.
toca jivitAlA melelyAtUna bAhera kADhato ANi melelyAsa, jivitAtUna bAhera kADhato, ANi toca jaminIlA ticyA mRtyUnaMtara jivaMta karato. azAca prakAre tumhI (dekhIla) bAhera kADhale jAla.
ANi allAhacyA nizANyAMpaikI Ahe kI tumhAlA mAtIpAsUna nirmANa kele, maga AtA manuSya banUna (cAlata phirata) pasarata AhAta.

ANi tyAcyA nizANyAMpaikI Ahe kI tumacyAca (mAnava) jAtImadhUna patnyA nirmANa kelyA, yAsAThI kI tumhI tyAMcyApAsUna sukha zAMtI prApta karAvI. tyAne tumacyA daramyAna prema ANi karuNA nirmANa kelI. niHsaMzaya, vicAra ciMtana karaNAr2yAMkaritA yAta aneka nizANyA Aheta.
ANi tyAcyA sAmarthyAcyA nizANyAMpaikI AkAzAMcI va jaminIcI nirmitI, ANi tumacyA bhASA ANi varNAMcI vibhinnatA (dekhIla) hoya. buddhimAnAMkaritA nizcitaca yAta moThyA nizANyA Aheta.

ANi tyAcyA sAmarthyAcA nizANyAMpaikI tumacyA rAtra ANi divasAcyA jhopeta Ahe ANi tyAcyA kRpelA (arthAta AjivikelA) tumace zodhaNe (hI) Ahe. je loka kAna lAvUna (lakSapUrvaka) aikaNAre Aheta, tyAMcyAsAThI yAta moThyA nizANyA Aheta.

ANi tyAcyA nizANyAMpaikI eka nizANI hI dekhIla Ahe kI to tumhAlA bhayabhIta va AzAvAna banaviNyAkaritA vijecI camaka dAkhavito, ANi AkAzAtUna pANI varSavito ANi tyAdvAre mRta jaminIlA jivaMta karato. yAta dekhIla buddhimAna lokAMkaritA moThyA nizANyA Aheta.
ANi tyAcI eka nizANI hI dekhIla Ahe kI AkAza ANi dharatI tyAcyA AdezAne kAyama Aheta, maga jevhA to tumhAlA hAka mArela, kevaLa eka veLacyA pukAraNyAneca tumhI sarva jaminItUna bAhera paDAla.
ANi AkAza va dharatIcyA samasta vastUMcA toca svAmI (mAlaka) Ahe ANi sarvacyA sarva tyAcyA hukumAcyA adhIna Aheta.

ANi toca Ahe jo pahilyAMdA sRSTI nirmANa karato, toca punhA dusar2yAMdA nirmANa karIla ANi he tyAcyAkaritA phAraca sope Ahe. tyAcIca uttama ANi ucca guNavizeSatA Ahe AkAzAMmadhye ANi dharatItahI. to moThA jabaradasta buddhikauzalya (hikamata) bALagaNArA Ahe.

allAhane eka udAharaNa svataH tumaceca sAMgitale. je kAhI AmhI tumhAlA pradAna kele Ahe, kAya tyAta tumacyA dAsAMpaikI koNI tumacA bhAgIdAra Ahe kI tumhI ANi to yAta samAna padAce asAveta? ANi tumhI tyAce bhaya azA prakAre rAkhatA, jase svataH ApalyA lokAMce? AmhI buddhimAnAMkaritA azAca prakAre spaSTataH AyatI nivedana karato.
kharI goSTa azI kI he atyAcArI jJAnAvinA icchA-AkAMkSAMce bhakta Aheta, tyAlA koNa mArga dAkhavila jyAlA allAha pathabhraSTa karIla? tyAMnA koNI ekahI madata karaNArA nAhI.

tevhA tumhI ekAgracitta hoUna ApalA ceharA dIna (dharmA) kaDe keMdrita karA. allAhacA to svAbhAvika (dharma) jyAvara tyAne lokAMnA nirmANa kele Ahe. allAhacyA racaneta parivartana nAhI. hAca kharA dIna (dharma) Ahe. paraMtu adhikAMza loka samajata nAhIta.
(lokAMno!) allAhakaDe AkarSita hoUna tyAce bhaya bALagata rAhA ANi namAja kAyama rAkhA ANi aneka IzvarAMcI bhaktI karaNAr2yAMpaikI hoU nakA.
tyA lokAMpaikI jyAMnI ApalyA dIna (dharmA) lA kSata-vikSata karUna TAkale ANi svataHhI samUhA-samUhAta vibhAjita jhAle. pratyeka samUha ApalyAjavaLa je Ahe, tyAtaca magna Ahe.

ANi lokAMnA jevhA ekhAde duHkha pohacate, tevhA ApalyA pAlanakartyAkaDe rujU hoUna duA- prArthanA karU lAgatAta ANi jevhA to ApalyAtarphe dayA-kRpecI goDI cAkhavito, tevhA tyAMcyAtalA eka gaTa ApalyA pAlanakartyAsobata dusar2yAlA tyAcA sahabhAgI TharavU lAgato.
yAsAThI kI, je kAhI AmhI tyAMnA pradAna kele Ahe kRtaghnatA dAkhavAvI. ThIka Ahe. tumhI lAbha ucalUna ghyA. phAra lavakara tumhAlA mAhIta paDela.
kAya AmhI yAMcyAvara ekhAdI sanada avatarita kelI Ahe, jI tyAsa nivedite, jyAsa he allAhasobata sahabhAgI TharavIta Aheta.
ANi jevhA AmhI lokAMnA rahamata (dayA-kRpe)cI goDI cAkhivato tevhA te khUpa AnaMdita hotAta ANi jara tyAMnA ApalyA hAtAMcyA duSkarmAmuLe ekhAde duHkha pohacate, tevhA acAnaka te nirAza hotAta.
kAya tyAMnI he nAhI pAhile kI allAha jyAlA icchito bharapUra AjivikA (rojI) deto ANi jyAlA icchito kamI. yAtahI tyA lokAMkaritA nizANyA Aheta, je ImAna rAkhatAta.
yAstava javaLacyA nAtevAIkAlA, garIbAlA, pravAzAlA, pratyekAlA tyAcA hakka dyA. he tyAMcyAsAThI adhika cAMgale Ahe je allAhacyA mukhAce darzana gheU icchitAta. aseca loka muktI prApta karaNAre Aheta.

ANi tumhI je kAhI vyAjAne detA kI lokAMce dhana vADhata rAhAve te allAhacyA yethe vADhata nAhI ANi je kAhI (sadakA-dAna ANi) jakAta (kartavya dAna) tumhI allAhace mukha pAhaNyA (marjI saMpAdaNyA) karitA dyAla tara aseca loka Apale (dhana) vADhaviNAre Aheta.

allAha to Ahe, jyAne tumhAlA nirmANa kele, maga AjivikA pradAna kelI, maga mRtyu deIla, punhA dusar2yAMdA jivaMta karIla. AtA sAMgA, tumhI TharavilelyA (allAhacyA) sahabhAgIMpaikI eka tarI asA Ahe jo yA goSTIMpaikI kAhItarI karU zakata asela. allAhakaritA pavitratA ANi zreSThatA Ahe azA tyA pratyeka sahabhAgIpekSA, jyAlA he loka manAne racUna ghetAta.
khuSkI ANi pANyAta lokAMcyA duSkarmAMmuLe utpAta (phasAda) pasaralA, yAsAThI kI tyAMnA, tyAMcyA kAhI duSkarmAMce phaLa allAhane cAkhavAve. (phAra) saMbhava Ahe kI tyAMnI (duSkarma karaNe) thAMbavAve.
tumhI sAMgA, jarA jaminIvara hiMDUna phirUna pAhA tarI kI pUrvI hoUna gelelyA lokAMcA zevaTa kasA jhAlA, jyAMcyAta adhikAMza loka aneka IzvarAMcI pUjA karaNAre hote.
tevhA tumhI tumace toMDa tyA saraLa ANi saccA dIna (dharmA) kaDeca rAkhA, yAAdhI kI to divasa yAvA, jyAce parataNe allAhatarphe nAhIca. tyA divazI sarva vegavegaLe hotIla.
(satyAcA) inkAra karaNAr2yAMvara tyAMcA inkAra oDhavela, ANi satkarma karaNAre ApalyAca vizrAmagRhAlA suMdara banavita Aheta.
yAsAThI kI allAhane ApalyA kRpene tyAMnA phala pradAna karAve. jyAne ImAna rAkhale ANi satkarma karIta rAhilA to kAphirAMnA dosta rAkhata nAhI.

ANi tyAcyA nizANyAMpaikI zubha samAcAra deNAr2yA vAr2yAMnA cAlaviNehI Ahe, yAsAThI kI tumhAlA ApalyA dayA-kRpecI goDI cAkhavAvI, ANi yAsAThI kI tyAcyA AdezAne naukA cAlavAvyAta ANi yAsAThI kI tyAcyA kRpecA tumhI zodha ghyAvA, ANi yAsAThI kI tumhI kRtajJatA vyakta karAvI.

ANi AmhI tumacyA pUrvIhI (ApalyA) paigaMbarAMnA tyAMcyA janasamUhAMkaDe pAThavile, te tyAMcyAjavaLa pramANa (purAve) gheUna Ale, maga AmhI tumacyA aparAdhAMcA sUDa (pratizodha) ghetalA. ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMnA madata karaNe AmacyAvara anivArya Ahe.

to allAhaca hoya jo vAre vAhavito, te DhagAMnA ucalatAta, maga allAha ApalyA marjIne tyAMnA AkAzAta pasaravito ANi tyAMce tukaDe tukaDe karato, maga tumhI pAhatA kI tyAMcyAtUna (pANyAce) theMba bAhera paDatAta ANi jyAMnA allAha icchito, tyA dAsAMvara to parjanyavRSTI karato tevhA te khUpa AnaMdita hotAta.
ANi vizvAsa karA kI pAUsa tyAMcyAvara paDaNyApUrvI te nirAza hota hote.

tevhA tumhI allAhacyA kRpA-cinhAMnA pAhA kI jaminIcyA mRtyunaMtara kazA prakAre allAha tilA (punhA) jivaMta karato. niHsaMzaya, toca melelyAMnA (punazca) jivaMta karaNArA Ahe ANi to pratyeka goSTa karaNyAsa samartha Ahe.
ANi jara AmhI vegavAna vArA vAhavU ANi he loka ApalyA zetIlA (komejalelI) pivaLI paDalelI pAhatIla tara maga tyAnaMtara te kRtaghnatA dAkhavU lAgatIla.
