niHsaMzaya, tumhI mRtAMnA aikavU zakata nAhI ANi nA bahir2yAMnA (ApalI) pukAra aikavU zakatA, jevhA te pATha phiravUna vaLale asatIla.
ANi nA tumhI AMdhaLyAMnA tyAMcyA mArgabhraSTatetUna kADhUna mArgadarzana karaNAre AhAta. tumhI tara kevaLa azAca lokAMnA aikavU zakatA je AmacyA AyatIMvara ImAna rAkhatAta ANi te AjJAdhArakahI Aheta.

allAha to Ahe, jyAne tumhAlA kamajora avastheta nirmANa kele, maga tyA durbalatenaMtara zaktI-sAmarthya pradAna kele, maga tyA zaktInaMtara kamajorI ANi mhAtArapaNa dile. to je icchito nirmANa karato, to sarvAMnA cAMgalyA prakAre jANato ANi sarvAMvara pUrNa sAmarthya rAkhato.
ANi jyA divazI kayAmata yeIla, aparAdhI loka zapathapUrvaka sAMgatIla kI (jagAta) eka kSaNAzivAya jAsta rAhilo nAhIta. azAca prakAre bahakaleleca rAhile.

ANi jyA lokAMnA jJAna ANi ImAna pradAna kele gele, te uttara detIla kI, tumhI tara jase kI allAhacyA graMthAta Ahe, kayAmatacyA divasAparyaMta rAhilAta. AjacA hA divasa kayAmatacAca divasa Ahe. paraMtu tumhI tara vizvAsaca Thevata navhate.
tevhA tyA divazI atyAcArI lokAMnA tyAMce pramANa-purAve kAhIca upayogI paDaNAra nAhIta ANi nA tyAMcyAkaDUna kSamA-yAcanecI mAgaNI kelI jAIla, nA karma mAgitale jAIla.
ANi niHsaMzaya, AmhI yA kuraAnAta lokAMsamora sarva udAharaNe prastuta kelI Aheta. tumhI tyAMcyAjavaLa koNatIhI nizANI ANAla tarI te heca mhaNatIla kI tumhI khoTe AhAta.
allAha, tyA lokAMcyA hRdayAMvara, je samaja bALagata nAhIta, azAca prakAre mohara (sIla) lAvato.
yAstava tumhI dhIra-saMyama rAkhA. niHsaMzaya, allAhacA vAyadA saccA Ahe. tumhAlA tyA lokAMnI halake (adhIra) jANU naye, je vizvAsa bALagata nAhIta.
alipha. lAma. mIma
yA divya jJAnayukta graMthAcyA AyatI Aheta.
jo allAhace bhaya rAkhaNAr2yAMkaritA mArgadarzana ANi (sarvathA) dayA-kRpA Ahe.
je loka nehamI vaktazIrapaNe namAja paDhatAta ANi jakAta (dharmadAna) detAta, ANi Akhiratavara (pUrNa) vizvAsa ThevatAta.
heca te loka hota, je ApalyA pAlanakartyAtarphe mArgadarzanAvara Aheta ANi heca loka muktI prApta karaNAre Aheta.

ANi kAhI loka asehI Aheta je nirarthaka, vAhyAta goSTI vikata ghetAta kI ajJAnatesaha lokAMnA allAhacyA mArgApAsUna dUra karAve ANi tyAlA thaTTA-maskarI banavAve. heca te loka hota, jyAMcyAsAThI apamAnita karaNArA az2Aba (zikSA-yAtanA) Ahe.

ANi jevhA tyAcyAsamora AmacyA AyatI vAcUna aikavilyA jAtAta tevhA ghameMDIne azA prakAre toMDa phiravito kI jaNU tyAne aikaleca nAhI, jaNU kAhI tyAcyA donhI kAnAta badhiratA Ahe. tumhI tyAlA duHkhadAyaka az2Aba (zikSA-yAtane) cI khabara dyA.
niHsaMzaya, jyA lokAMnI ImAna svIkArale va je satkarma karIta rAhile tyAcyAkaritA sukhAMnI yukta azI jannata Ahe.
jithe te sadaiva kALa rAhatIla, allAhacA saccA vAyadA Ahe. to moThA prabhutvazAlI ANi pUrNataH buddhikauzalya (hikamata) bALagaNArA Ahe.

tyAneca AkAzAMnA khAMbAMvinA banavile Ahe. tumhI tyAMnA pAhatA ANi tyAne jaminIvara pahADa rovale, yAsAThI kI tine tumhAlA kaMpita karU na zakAve ANi pratyeka prakArace sajIva jaminIta pasaravile ANi tyAne AkAzAtUna pAUsa pADUna pratyeka prakAracyA suMdara joDyA ugavilyA.
hI Ahe allAhacI sRSTI (makhalUka), AtA tumhI malA yAcyAkherIja dusar2yA koNAcI sRSTI tara dAkhavA (kAhI nAhI) he atyAcArI loka ughaDa mArgabhraSTateta Aheta.

ANi AmhI niHsaMzaya lukamAnalA buddhikauzalya pradAna kele kI tumhI allAhazI kRtajJazIla rAhA. pratyeka kRtajJazIla manuSya ApalyAca phAyadyAkaritA kRtajJatA vyakta karato, jo koNI kRtaghnatA darzavIla tara tyAne jANUna ghyAve kI allAha niHspRha, prazaMsanIya Ahe.

ANi jevhA lukamAna upadeza karatAnA ApalyA putrAsa mhaNAle, he mAjhyA priya putrA! allAhasobata dusar2yA koNAlA sahabhAgI TharavU nakosa. niHsaMzaya, allA cA sahabhAgI TharaviNe phAra moThA atyAcAra Ahe.

AmhI mANasAlA mAtA-pityAviSayI zikavaNa dilI Ahe. tyAcyA mAtene yAtanAMvara yAtanA sahana karUna tyAlA garbhAta Thevale ANi tyAce dUdha soDaviNyAta dona varSe lAgalI. tevhA tU mAjhe ANi ApalyA mAtA-pityAce AbhAra mAna. zevaTI mAjhyAcakaDe paratUna yAyace Ahe.

ANi jara te doghe (mAtA-pitA) tujhyAvara yA goSTIcA dabAva TAkatIla kI tU mAjhyAsobata (dusar2yAlA) sahabhAgI Tharava, jyAce tulA jJAna nasAve, tevhA tU tyAMce AjJApAlana karU nakosa, paraMtu yA jagAta tyAMcyAzI bhalepaNAcA vyavahAra kara ANi tyAcyA mArgAvara cAlata rAhA, jo mAjhyAkaDe jhukalelA asela. tumhA sarvAMce parataNe mAjhyAcakaDe Ahe. tumhI je kAhI karatA tyAsaMbaMdhI mI tyA veLI tumhAlA mAhIta karena.

priya putrA! jara ekhAdI vastU rAIcyA dANyAitakI asela, maga tohI ekhAdyA dagaDAkhAlI asela kiMvA AkAzAMmadhye asela kiMvA jaminIta asela, tara tilA allAha avazya ANIla. allAha atizaya sUkSmadarza ANi jANaNArA Ahe.

he mAjhyA priya putrA! tU namAja kAyama rAkha, satkarmAMcA Adeza de ANi duSkarmAMpAsUna rokhata jA, ANi jara tujhyAvara saMkaTa Ale tara dhIra-saMyama rAkha (vizvAsa Theva) hI sarva tAkIdI kAmAMpaikI Aheta.
ANi lokAMsamora Apale gAla phugavU nakA ANi jaminIvara tAThapaNAne ghameMDa dAkhavata cAlU nakA. koNatyAhI garviSTha, ghameMDI mANasAlA allAha pasaMta karIta nAhI.
ANi ApalyA cAlaNyAta madhyamatA rAkhA, ANi ApalA AvAja (svara) saumya rAkha, niHsaMzaya, gADhavAcA AvAja atizaya vAITa AvAja Ahe.

kAya tumhI nAhI pAhata kI allAhane jamIna ANi AkAzAcyA pratyeka vastUlA AmacyA sevesa lAvUna Thevale Ahe ANi ApalyA ughaDa ANi lapalelyA deNyA tumacyAvara pUrNa kelyA Aheta, ANi kAhI loka allAhaviSayI kasalyAhI jJAnAvinA, mArgadarzanAvinA ANi divya graMthAvinA vAda ghAlatAta.

ANi jevhA tyAMnA sAMgitale jAte kI allAhane avatarita kelelyA vahayI (prakAzanA) ce anusaraNa karA, tevhA mhaNatAta kI AmhI tara jyA mArgAvara ApalyA vADavaDilAMnA pAhile Ahe, tyAca mArgAce anusaraNa karU. maga saitAna tyAMcyA vADavaDilAMnA jahannamacyA zikSA-yAtanekaDe bolavita asalA tarI!
ANi jo manuSya ApalyA cehar2yAlA (svataHlA) allAhacyA havAlI karIla ANi tI neka sadAcArIhI asela tara nizcitaca tyAne majabUta AdhAra dharalA. samasta karmAMcI pariNItI allAhakaDe Ahe.

ANi kAphirAMcyA kupra (inkArA) ne tumhI duHkhI hoU nakA. zevaTI tyA sarvAMnA AmacyAcakaDe paratUna yAyace Ahe. tyA veLI AmhI tyAMnA dAkhavU je kAhI te karIta rAhile. niHsaMzaya, allAha hRdayAtIla rahasyabhedAMnAhI jANato.
AmhI tyAMnA kAhIsA phAyadA asAca pohacavita rAhU, paraMtu zevaTI AmhI tyAMnA atizaya lAcArIcyA avastheta sakta zikSA-yAtanekaDe hAkata neU.

ANi jara tumhI tyAMnA vicArAla kI AkAza ANi jaminIcA nirmANa karaNArA koNa Ahe? tara he avazya uttara detIla, allAha! tevhA tyAMnA sAMgA kI sarva prazaMsesa yogya allAhaca Ahe. paraMtu tyAMcyApaikI bahuteka loka jANata nAhIta.
AkAzAMmadhye ANi dharatIta je kAhI Ahe te sarva allAhaceca Ahe niHsaMzaya, allAha moThA niHspRha ANi stutI-prazaMsesa pAtra Ahe.

ANi sAr2yA dharatIvarIla vRkSAMcyA jara lekhaNyA hotIla ANi sAre samudra zAI banatIla ANi tyAMcyAnaMtara sAta samudra dusare asatIla tarIhI allAhacI prazaMsA saMpU zakata nAhI. niHsaMzaya, allAha moThA varcasvazAlI ANi hikamata (buddhikuzalatA) bALagaNArA Ahe.
tumhI sarvAMnA nirmANa karaNe ANi melyAnaMtara punhA jivaMta karaNe aseca Ahe jase ekA jIvAlA. niHsaMzaya, allAha aikaNArA, pAhaNArA Ahe.

kiMvA tumhI nAhI pAhata kI allAha rAtrIlA, divasAta ANi divasAlA rAtrIta dAkhala karato. sUrya ANi caMdrAlA tyAneca AjJAdhAraka banavUna Thevale Ahe kI pratyeka nirdhArita veLeparyaMta cAlata rAhAvA tumhI je kAhI karma karatA, allAha te pratyeka karma jANato.

he sarva (vyavasthA) yA kAraNAstava Ahe kI allAha satya Ahe, ANi tyAcyAkherIja jyAMnA loka (upAsya samajUna) pukAratAta, sarva khoTe (mithyA) Aheta, ANi niHsaMzaya allAha atiucca ANi moThA mahAna Ahe.

kAya tumhI yA goSTIvara vicAra nAhI karIta kI pANyAta naukA allAhacyA kRpA-deNagIne cAlata Aheta, yAsAThI kI tyAne tumhAlA ApalyA nizANyA dAkhavAvyAta. nizcitaca yAta pratyeka saburI rAkhaNAr2yA ANi kRtajJazIla asaNAr2yAkaritA aneka nizANyA Aheta.

ANi jevhA tyAMcyAvara lATA, tyA sAvalyAMpramANe AcchAdita hotAta tevhA te (moThA) vizvAsa bALagUna allAhalAca pukAratAta, ANi jevhA allAha tyAMnA tyAtUna soDavUna khuSkIkaDe pohacavito, tevhA tyAMcyApaikI kAhI saMtulita rAhatAta, ANi AmacyA AyatIMcA inkAra kevaLa teca loka karatAta, je vacana bhaMga karaNAre ANi kRtaghna asatIla.

lokAMno! ApalyA pAlanakartyAce bhaya rAkhA ANi tyA divasAce bhaya ThevA, jyA divazI pitA ApalyA putrAlA kasalAhI lAbha pohacavU zakaNAra nAhI ANi nA putra ApalyA pityAsa kiMcitahI lAbha pohacaviNArA asela. lakSAta ThevA! allAhacA vAyadA saccA Ahe. pAhA! tumhAlA aihika jIvanAne dhokyAta TAkU naye ANi nA dhokebAja (saitAnA) ne tumhAlA dhokyAta TAkAve.

niHsaMzaya, allAhacyAca javaLa kayAmatace jJAna Ahe. toca parjanyavRSTI karato, ANi mAtecyA garbhAta je kAhI Ahe te jANato. koNIhI jANata nAhI kI udyA kAya kamavIla? nA koNAlA he mAhIta Ahe kI to koNatyA bhUmIvara maraNa pAvela. lakSAta ThevA, allAhaca saMpUrNa jJAna bALagaNArA ANi satya jANaNArA Ahe.
alipha. lAma. mIma
niHsaMzaya, hA graMtha sarva vizvAMcyA pAlanakartyAtarphe avatarita jhAlA Ahe.

kAya he ase mhaNatAta kI yAne hA graMtha manAne racUna ghetalA Ahe? muLIca nAhI. kiMbahunA hA tumacyA pAlanakartyAtarphe satya Ahe, yAsAThI kI tumhI tyAMnA bhaya dAkhavAve, jyAMcyAjavaLa tumacyApUrvI koNI bhaya dAkhaviNArA AlA nAhI. saMbhavataH te satya mArgAvara yAveta.

allAha to Ahe, jyAne AkAzAMnA ANi dharatIlA ANi je kAhI tyAMcyA daramyAna Ahe, sarva kAhI sahA divasAMta nirmANa kele, maga arza (IzasiMhAsanA) vara ucca jhAlA. tumacyAkaritA, tyAcyAkherIja koNIhI madata karaNArA, ziphArasa karaNArA nAhI, maga kAya tarIhI tumhI bodha grahaNa karIta nAhI?
to AkAzApAsUna dharatIparyaMta kArya-vyavasthA karato, maga (te kArya) ekA azA divasAta tyAcyA dizene vara caDhate, jyAce anumAna tumacyA hizobAcyA eka hajAra varSAMitake Ahe.
toca vidyamAna ANi aparokSAcA jANaNArA Ahe, jabaradasta varcasvazAlI, moThA meherabAna.
tyAne jI vastu dekhIla banavilI khUpa suMdara banavilI ANi mAnavAcI nirmitI mAtIpAsUna surU kelI.
maga tyAcA vaMza ekA tuccha pANyAcyA sAra tattvAne banavilA.
jyAlA yathAyogya karUna, tyAta ApalA prANa (ruha) phuMkalA, ANi tyAneca tumace kAna, DoLe ANi hRdaya banavile (tarIdekhIla) tumhI phAraca kamI kRtajJatA dAkhavitA.
ANi te mhaNAle kI kAya AmhI jevhA jaminIta misaLUna haravale jAU, kAya maga punhA navyA jIvanAta yeU? kharI goSTa azI kI yA lokAMnA ApalyA pAlanakartyAcyA bheTIcA vizvAsaca nAhI.
tyAMnA sAMgA, tumhAlA mRtyucA phariztA maraNa deIla jo tumacyAvara tainAta kelA gelA Ahe, maga tumhI sarva ApalyA pAlanakartyAkaDe paratavile jAla.

ANi jara tumhI yAMnA (tyA veLacyA avastheta) pAhile asate, jevhA durAcArI loka ApalyA pAlanakartyAsamora natamastaka asatIla, mhaNatIla kI he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! AmhI pAhile ANi aikale, AtA tU AmhAlA parata pAThavazIla tara AmhI satkarma karU. AmhI ImAna rAkhaNAre Ahota.
ANi AmhI icchile asate tara pratyeka mANasAlA mArgadarzana pradAna kele asate, paraMtu mAjhI hI goSTa pUrNataH kharI TharalI Ahe kI mI avazya jahannamalA mANasAMnI va jinnAMnI bharUna TAkIna.
AtA tumhI ApalyA tyA divasAcyA bheTIlA visaraNyAcI goDI cAkhA. AmhIhI tumhAlA visaralo, ApaNa kelelyA karmAMcyA (duSpariNatI) dvAre niraMtara zikSA- yAtanecI goDI cAkhA.

AmacyA AyatIMvara kevaLa teca loka ImAna rAkhatAta, jyAMnA jevhA jevhA zikavaNa dilI jAte tevhA sajadyAta jAtAta (mAthA TekatAta) ANi ApalyA pAlanakartyAcI prazaMsesaha tasbIha (guNagAna) karatAta ANi garvApAsUna alipta rAhatAta.
tyAMcI kUsa ApalyA bichAnyAMpAsUna alaga rAhate. ApalyA pAlanakartyAlA bhaya ANi Azesaha pukAratAta ANi je kAhI AmhI tyAMnA deUna Thevale Ahe tyAtUna kharca karatAta.
koNatAhI jIva jANata nAhI, je kAhI AmhI tyAMcyA DoLyAMcI zitalatA tyAMcyAsAThI lapavUna ThevalI Ahe. te je kAhI karIta hote, hA tyAcA mobadalA Ahe.
kAya to, jo ImAna rAkhaNArA asela, tyA mANasAsArakhA Ahe, jo durAcArI asela? donhI kadApi samAna TharU zakata nAhI.
jyA lokAMnI ImAna svIkArale ANi je satkarma karIta rAhile, tyAMcyAsAThI sadaivakALa asaNArI jannata Ahe, atithya Ahe tyAMcyA karmAMcyA mobadalyAta je te karIta hote.

tathApi jyAMnI avajJA kelI tara tyAMce ThikANa jahannama Ahe, jevhA jevhA te tyAtUna bAhera paDU icchitIla, punhA tyAtaca paratavile jAtIla ANi tyAMnA sAMgitale jAIla, ApalyA khoTe TharaviNyApAyI AgIcI goDI cAkhA.
ANi niHsaMzaya, AmhI tyAMnA nikaTacyA kAhI lahAna zikSA - yAtanA, tyA moThyA az2AbacyA vyatirikta cAkhavU yAsAThI kI tyAMnI rujU vhAve.
ANi tyAhUna adhika atyAcArI koNa Ahe, jyAlA allAhacyA AyatIMdvAre pravacana dile jAve tarIhI tyAne tyApAsUna toMDa phiravAve. nizcitaca AmhIhI durAcAr2yAMzI sUDa (badalA) gheNAra Ahota.
ANi vastutaH AmhI mUsAlA graMtha pradAna kelA tevhA tumhI tyAcyA prAptIsaMbaMdhI kadhIhI saMzaya karU naye ANi AmhI tyAsa isrAIlacyA saMtatIcyA mArgadarzanAce sAdhana banavile.
ANi AmhI tyAMcyApaikI jyAarthI tyA lokAMnI sahanazIlatA rAkhalI ase nete (pramukha) banavile, je AmacyA AdezAne lokAMnA mArgadarzana karIta hote ANi AmacyA AyatIMvara vizvAsa Thevata hote.
niHsaMzaya, tumacA pAlanakartA tyA sarvAMcyA daramyAna yA sarva goSTIMcA phaisalA kayAmatacyA divazI karela, jyA goSTIMmadhye te matabheda karIta Aheta.

kAya yA goSTInehI tyAMnA mArgadarzana pradAna kele nAhI kI AmhI tyAMcyA pUrvIcyA aneka jamAtIMnA naSTa karUna TAkale, jyAMcyA vastyAMmadhye he cAlata phirata Aheta. nizcitaca tyAta moThe bodha Aheta. kAya tarIhI he aikata nAhI?
kAya he pAhata nAhI kI AmhI pANyAlA paDIka (nApIka) jaminIkaDe vAhavUna neto, maga tyAdvAre AmhI zetIMnA ugavito, jyAsa tyAMcI gure-Dhore ANi te svataHhI khAtAta. kAya tarIhI yAMnA disUna yeta nAhI?
ANi mhaNatAta, hA phaisalA kevhA hoIla? jara tumhI sacce asAla tara sAMgA.
tyAMnA uttara dyA kI phaisalyAcyA divazI ImAna rAkhaNe kupra (inkAra) karaNAr2yAMcyA kAhIca upayogI paDaNAra nAhI ANi nA tyAMnA DhIla (savaDa) dilI jAIla.
AtA tumhI tyAMcA vicArahI soDUna dyA ANi pratIkSA karIta rAhA. he dekhIla pratIkSA karIta Aheta.
he paigaMbara! allAhace bhaya bALagUna rAhA ANi kAphira ANi munAphika (dAMbhika ImAnadhAraka) lokAMce mhaNaNe mAnU nakA. allAha moThA jJAna bALagaNArA, moThA buddhikauzalya bALagaNArA Ahe.
ANi je kAhI tumacyAkaDe, tumacyA pAlanakartyAtarphe vahayI (prakAzanA) kelI jAte, tice anusaraNa karA (vizvAsa karA), kAraNa allAha tumacyA pratyeka karmAzI paricita Ahe.
ANi tumhI allAhavaraca bharavasA rAkhA, allAha kAma banaviNyAkaritA puresA Ahe.

koNatyAhI mANasAcyA chAtIta allAhane dona hRdaya ThevalI nAhIta. ANi ApalyA jyA patnyAMnA tumhI mAtA mhaNUna saMbodhUna basatA, tyAMnA allAhane tumacyA (khar2yAkhur2yA) mAtA banavile nAhI ANi nA tumacyA dattaka ghetalelyA bAlakAMnA (vastutaH) tumace putra banavile Ahe. yA tara tumacyA toMDacyA goSTI Aheta. allAha satya goSTI sAMgato ANi toca saraLa mArga dAkhavito.

dattaka ghetalelyA mulAMnA tyAMcyA (khar2yA) pityAMcyA saMbaMdhAne hAka mArA. allAhajavaLa pUrNa nyAya hAca Ahe. maga jara tumhAlA tyAMce (khare) pitA mAhIta nasatIla tara te tumace dharma-bAMdhava ANi mitra Aheta. tumacyAkaDUna bhUlacUka mhaNUna kAhI ghaDalyAsa tyAbAbata tumacyAvara kasalAhI gunhA nAhI, paraMtu gunhA to Ahe, jyAcA tumhI irAdA karAla ANi irAdA manApAsUna karAla. allAha moThA mApha karaNArA, dayA karaNArA Ahe.

paigaMbara, ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMvara svataH tyAMcyApekSAhI adhika hakka rAkhaNAre Aheta ANi paigaMbarAcyA patnyA ImAnadhArakAMcyA mAtA Aheta ANi nAtevAIka, allAhacyA graMthAcyA AdhArAvara itara ImAnadhAraka ANi svadezatyAga kelelyAMcyA tulaneta jAsta hakkadAra Aheta. (tathApi) tumhAlA ApalyA mitrAMzI sad‌vyavahAra karaNyAcI anumatI Ahe. hA Adeza ‘surikSata graMthA’ (lauhe mahaphUja) madhye lihilelA Ahe.

ANi jevhA AmhI samasta paigaMbarAMkaDUna vacana ghetale (vizeSataH) tumacyAkaDUna ANi nUhakaDUna ANi ibrAhImakaDUna ANi mUsAkaDUna ANi mariyamace putra IsAkaDUna ANi AmhI tyA sarvAMkaDUna pakke vacana ghetale hote.
yAsAThI kI allAhane saccA lokAMnA tyAMcyA saccepaNAviSayI vicAraNA karAvI ANi na mAnaNAr2yAMkaritA AmhI duHkhadAyaka az2Aba (zikSA-yAtanA) tayAra karUna ThevalA Ahe.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! allAhane jo upakAra tumacyAvara kelA Ahe, tyAce smaraNa karA jevhA tumacA sAmanA karaNyAkaritA sainyAMvara sainye AlI maga AmhI tyAMcyAvara vegavAna vAdaLa ANi ase sainya pAThavile, je tumhI pAhileca nAhI ANi tumhI je kAhI karatA allAha te sarva pAhato.
jevhA (zatrU) tumacyA varacyA bAjUne ANi khAlacyA bAjUne cAlUna Ale ANi jevhA DoLe nizcala jhAle ANi kALIja toMDAzI Ale, ANi tumhI allAhaviSayI vibhinna vicAra karU lAgale.
itheca ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMcI kasoTI ghetalI gelI ANi pUrNataH te halavUna soDale gele.
ANi tyA veLI dAMbhika (munAphika) ANi manAta roga bALagaNAre mhaNU lAgale kI allAha ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAne AmacyAzI kevaLa dhokyAceca vAyade kele hote.

ANi tyAMcyAca ekA gaTAne pukAruna mhaTale, he yAsaribacyA lokAno! tumacyA thAMbaNyAce he sthAna nAhI, parata nighA ANi tyAMcA eka dusarA gaTa, paigaMbarAjavaLa hI anumatI mAgU lAgalA kI AmacI ghare khAlI (ughaDI) ANi asurakSita Aheta. vAstavika tI (ughaDI) asurakSita navhatI, (paraMtu) tyAMnI paLa kADhaNyAcA pakkA irAdA kelA hotA.

ANi jara madInecyA cohIbAjUMnI tyAMcyAvara (sainye) dAkhala kelI gelI asatI, maga tyAMcyAzI utpAta (phasAda) cI mAgaNI kelI gelI asatI, tara tyAMnI utpAta avazya mAjavilA asatA. ANi kAhI laDhalehI asate paNa thoDese.
ANi yAcyApUrvI tara tyAMnI allAhazI vAyadA kelA hotA kI pATha phiraviNAra nAhI ANi allAhazI kelyA gelelyA vAyadyAcI vicArapUsa nizcitaca hoIla.
tyAMnA sAMgA, jara tumhI mRtyucyA kiMvA hatyecyA bhayAne paLa kADhAla tara he paLa kADhaNe tumacyA kAhIca upayogI paDaNAra nAhI ANi tyA veLI tumhI phAra kamI lAbhAnvita kele jAla.

tyAMnA vicArA kI jara allAha tumhAlA kAhI hAni pohacavU icchila kiMvA tumacyAvara ekhAdI dayA kRpA karU icchila tara asA koNa Ahe jo tumhAlA vAcavU zakela (kiMvA tumacyApAsUna rokhU zakela) (allAhacyA virodhAta) ApalyAkaritA, allAhakherIja tyAMnA nA koNI mitra ADhaLUna yeIla nA koNI sahAyyaka.
allAha tumacyApaikI tyAMnA (cAMgalyA prakAre) jANato, je dusar2yAMnA rokhatAta ANi ApalyA bAMdhavAMnA sAMgatAta kI AmacyAjavaLa yA ANi kadhItarI yuddhAta sahabhAga ghetAta.

tumacI madata karaNyAta (pUrNapaNe) kaMjUsa Aheta, maga jevhA bhaya - dahazatIcA prasaMga yeto tevhA tumhI tyAMnA pAhAla kI te tumacyAkaDe dRSTI keMdrita karatAta ANi tyAMce DoLe azA prakAre garagarA phirU lAgatAta, tyA mANasAsArakhe, jyAcyAvara mRtyucI murchA AlelI asAvI, maga jevhA bhItI nAhIzI hote, tevhA tumacyAzI ApalyA tIkSNa jIbhene moThamoThyA goSTI bolU lAgatAta. dhanAce moThe lobhI Aheta. yA lokAMnI ImAna rAkhaleca nAhI. allAhane tyAMcI sarva karme vAyA ghAlavilI Aheta ANi ase karaNe allAhakaritA phAra sope Ahe.

he loka samajatAta kI sainye adyApa gelI nAhIta ANi jara sainye parata AlI tara he azI icchA bALagatAta kI te vanAta rAhaNAr2yAMmadhye vanavAsI lokAMsobata asate tara bare jhAle asate yAsAThI kI tumacI khabara bAta gheta rAhile asate. jara te tumacyAta hajara asate (tarIdekhIla?) ugAca bolaNyAcA mAna rAkhaNyAsAThI thoDese laDhale asate.
niHsaMzaya, tumacyAsAThI allAhacyA paigaMbarAmadhye uttama namunA Ahe tyA pratyeka mANasAkaritA jo allAhacI ANi kayAmatacyA divasAcI AzA bALagato ANi allAhace atyAdhika smaraNa karato.

ANi jevhA ImAnadhArakAMnI (kAphirAMcI) sainye pAhilI, tevhA (acAnaka) ud‌gArale kI yAcAca vAyadA AmhAlA allAhane ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAne dilA hotA ANi allAha ANi tyAce paigaMbara sacce Aheta ANi tyA (goSTI) ne tyAMcyA ImAnAta ANi AjJApAlanAta ANakhI jAsta vADha kelI.

ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMmadhye (ase) lokahI Aheta, jyAMnI allAhazI jo vAyadA kelA hotA to kharA karUna dAkhavilA. kAhIMnI tara ApalA vAyadA pUrNa kelA ANi kAhI (saMdhIcI) pratIkSA karIta Aheta. ANi tyAMnI kasalAhI badala kelA nAhI.

yAsAThI kI allAhane saccA lokAMnA tyAMcyA kharepaNAcA mobadalA pradAna karAvA ANi icchilyAsa munAphika (dAMbhika) lokAMnA zikSA-yAtanA dyAvI kiMvA tyAMcIhI kSamA- yAcanA kabUla karAvI. allAha moThA kSamAzIla ANi moThA dayAvAna Ahe.

ANi allAhane kAphirAMnA krodhAne bhArAvalelyA avasthetaca (asaphala) paratavile, jyAmuLe tyAMcI koNatIhI icchA pUrNa jhAlI nAhI ANi tyA yuddhAta allAha svataHca ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMsAThI puresA TharalA. allAha moThA zaktizAlI ANi varcasvazAlI Ahe.

ANi jyA graMthadhArakAMnI, tyAMcyAzI lAgebAMdhe juLavUna ghetale hote tyAMnAhI allAhane tyAMcyA killyAMmadhUna bAhera kADhale ANi tyAMcyA manAta asA dhAka basavilA kI tumhI ekA samUhAsa ThAra karIta rAhile ANi ekA samUhAlA kaidI banavita rAhile.

ANi tyAne tumhAlA tyAMcyA jaminIce ANi tyAcyA gharAMce ANi dhana-saMpattIce mAlaka banavile ANi tyA jaminIcehI jicyAvara tumhI adyApa pAUlahI Thevale nAhI. allAha sarva kAhI karaNyAce sAmarthya rAkhato.
he paigaMbara! ApalyA patnIMnA sAMgA kI aihika jIvanAcI ANi aihika zobhA sajAvaTIcI icchA bALagata asAla tara yA mI tumhAlA kAhI deUna savarUna cAMgalyA ritIne soDUna dyAve.

ANi jara tumacI icchA allAha ANi tyAcA rasUla (paigaMbara) ANi Akhiratace ghara Ahe tara (vizvAsa ThevA kI) tumacyApaikI satkarma karaNArIMkaritA allAhane phAra cAMgalA mobadalA tayAra karUna ThevalA Ahe.
he paigaMbarAMcyA patnIMno! tumacyApaikI jI (patnI) dekhIla ughaDapaNe nirlajjatece kRtya karIla tara tilA duppaTa az2Aba dilA jAIla. allAhakaritA hI phAra sopI goSTa Ahe.

ANi tumacyApaikI jo koNI allAha ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAce AjJApAlana karIla ANi satkarma karIla tara AmhI tilA duppaTa mobadalA pradAna karU ANi ticyAsAThI AmhI ati uttama AjivikA tayAra karUna ThevalI Ahe.

he paigaMbarAMcyA patnIMno! tumhI sarvasAdhAraNa striyAMsArakhyA nAhIta. jara tumhI allAhace bhaya rAkhaNAr2yA asAla tara komala svarAta bolata jAU nakA kI (jyAmuLe) jyAcyA manAta roga asela tyAne ekhAdA vAITa irAdA karAvA, tathApi niyamAlA anusarUna bolata rAhA.

ANi ApalyA gharAMmadhye sthairyapUrvaka rAhA, ANi pUrvIcyA ajJAnakALApramANe ApalyA zRMgArA (sauMdaryA) ce pradarzana karU nakA ANi namAja niyimatapaNe adA karIta rAhA ANi jakAta (dharmadAna) deta rAhA, ANi allAha ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAcyA AdezAce pAlana karA. allAha heca icchito kI he paigaMbarAMcyA patnIMno! tumacyApAsUna tyAne pratyeka (prakAracI) apavitratA dUra karAvI, ANi tumhAlA khUpa pavitra karAve.
ANi tumacyA gharAMmadhye allAhacyA jyA AyatI ANi paigaMbarAMcI vacane (hadIsa) vAcalI jAtAta, tyA smaraNAta asU dyA. niHsaMzaya allAha moThA sUkSmadarzI, mAhitagAra Ahe.

niHsaMzaya, muslima puruSa ANi muslima striyA, ImAna rAkhaNAre puruSa ANi ImAna rAkhaNAr2yA striyA, AjJApAlana karaNAre puruSa ANi AjJApAlana karaNAr2yA striyA, satyavacanI puruSa ANi satyavacanI striyA, sahanazIlatA rAkhaNAre puruSa ANi sahanazIlatA rAkhaNAr2yA striyA (allAhalA) vinaMtI karaNAre puruSa ANi vinaMtI karaNAr2yA striyA, dAna (sadakA) karaNAre puruSa ANi dAna karaNAr2yA striyA, rojA (upavAsa-vrata) karaNAre puruSa ANi rojA rAkhaNAr2yA striyA, ApalyA lajjAsthAnA (guptAMgA) ce rakSaNa karaNAre puruSa ANi ApalyA lajjAsthAnAce rakSaNa karaNAr2yA striyA, allAhace atyAdhika smaraNa karaNAre puruSa ANi atyAdhika smaraNa karaNAr2yA striyA, yA sarvAMsAThI allAhane moThI kSamA ANi mahAna mobadalA tayAra karUna ThevalA Ahe.

ANi (lakSAta ThevA) koNatyAhI ImAna rAkhaNAr2yA puruSAlA ANi strIlA, allAha ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAcyA phaisalyAnaMtara ApalyA ekhAdyA goSTIcA kasalAhI adhikAra bAkI rAhata nAhI (lakSAta ThevA) allAha ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAcI jo koNI avajJA karIla, to ughaDa mArgabhraSTateta jAUna paDela.

ANi (smaraNa karA) jevhA tumhI tyA mANasAlA sAMgata hote, jyAvara allAhane anugraha kelA ANi tu‌mhI dekhIla kI ApalyA patnIlA ApalyA javaLa ThevA, ANi allAhace bhaya bALagA ANi tumhI ApalyA manAta hI goSTa lapavUna ThevalI hotI jilA allAha ughaDa karaNAra hotA, ANi tumhI lokAMce bhaya bALagata hotA, vAstivaka allAha yA goSTIcA adhika hakka rAkhata hotA kI tumhI tyAce bhaya bALagAve, maga jevhA jaidane tyA strIkaDUna ApalI garaja pUrNa karUna ghetalI, tevhA tilA AmhI tumacyA vivAhAta dile. yAsAThI kI ImAna rAkhaNAr2yA lokAMnA, tyAMcyA dattaka putrAMcyA patnIMbAbata kasalyAhI prakAracA saMkoca rAhU naye, jevhA te tyAMcyAkaDUna ApalI garaja pUrNa karUna ghetIla, allAhacA hA Adeza kAryAnvita hoNAraca hotA.

jyA goSTI allAhane ApalyA paigaMbarAkaritA ucita (mAnya) kelyA Aheta, tyAMcyA bAbatIta paigaMbarAvara kAhI harakata nAhI. allAhacA hAca niyama tyAM (paigaMbarAM) cyAbAbatahI rAhilA je pUrvI hoUna gele ANi allAhacI kAme anumAnAne nirdhArita kelele asatAta.
te sarva ase hote kI allAhace Adeza pohacavita nasata ANi allAhaceca bhaya bALagata ANi allAhakherIja koNAcehI bhaya bALagata nasa, ANi allAha hizoba gheNyAsAThI puresA Ahe.

lokAMno! tumacyA puruSAMpaikI muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi vasallama) koNAcehI pitA nAhIta, tathApi te allAhace rasUla (paigaMbara) Aheta ANi samasta paigaMbarAMmadhye aMtima paigaMbara Aheta, ANi allAha pratyeka goSTa cAMgalyA prakAre jANaNArA Ahe.
he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! allAhace atyAdhika smaraNa karA.
ANi sakALa saMdhyAkALa tyAcI pavitratA varNana karIta rAhA.

toca Ahe, jo tumacyAvara ApalI dayA - kRpA pAThavito ANi tyAce pharizte (tumacyAsAThI dayA yAcanecI prArthanA karatAta) yAsAThI kI tyAne tumhAlA aMdhArAtUna kADhUna prakAzAkaDe nyAve, ANi allAha ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMvara moThA dayA karaNArA Ahe.
jyA divazI he allAhalA bheTatIla, tyAMce svAgata salAmadvAre hoIla, tyAMcyAsAThI allAhane mAna-sanmAnapUrNa mobadalA tayAra karUna ThevalA Ahe.
he paigaMbara! niHsaMzaya, AmhIca tumhAlA (rasUla) sAkSI, khUzakhabara deNArA ANi khabaradAra karaNArA banavUna pAThavile Ahe.
ANi allAhacyA AdezAne tyAcyAkaDe bolaviNArA ANi ujjvala (prakAzamAna) dIpa banavUna.
ANi tumhI ImAna rAkhaNAr2yA lokAMnA hI zubhavArtA aikavA kI tyAMcyAkaritA allAhakaDUna phAra moThA anugraha Ahe.
ANi kAphirAMce va DhoMgI musalamAnAMce mhaNaNe mAnU nakA, ANi je duHkha (tyAMcyAkaDUna) pohocela tyAcI ciMtA karU nakA. allAhavara bharavasA rAkhA, allAha kAma banaviNyAsAThI puresA Ahe.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! jevhA tumhI ImAna rAkhaNAr2yA striyAMzI vivAha karAla, maga tyAMnA hAta lAvaNyApUrvI talAka (ghaTasphoTa) dyAla, tara tyAMcyAvara tumacA kasalAhI (adhikAra) iddata (talAkanaMtara nirdhArita veLeparyaMtacI pratibaMdhita mudatI) cA nAhI, jicI tumhI gaNanA karAvI. tevhA tumhI tyAMnA kAhI na kAhI dyA ANi bhalyA ritIne tyAMnA niropa dyA.

he paigaMbara (sa.)! AmhI tumacyAsAThI tumacyA tyA patnyA halAla (vaidha) kelyA Aheta, jyAMnA tumhI tyAMce mahara (strIdhana) deUna TAkale Ahe ANi tyA dAsI dekhIla, jyAMnA allAhane yuddhAta tumhAlA pradAna kelyA Aheta ANi tumacyA kAkAcyA kanyA, AtyAcyA kanyA, tumacyA mAmAcyA kanyA ANi tumacyA mAvazIcyA kanyA dekhIla, jyAMnI tumacyAsobata hijarata (svadezatyAga) kelI Ahe ANi tI ImAnadhAraka strI jI svataHlA paigaMbarAMnA dAna karIla, he tyA sthitIta kI svataH jara paigaMbarahI ticyAzI vivAha karU icchitIla. he vizeSataH tumacyAsAThIca Ahe ANi itara ImAnadhArakAMsAThI nAhI. AmhI tyAlA cAMgalyA prakAre jANato je AmhI tyAMcyAvara tyAMcyA patnyA ANi dAsIMviSayI (ce Adeza) nirdhArita kele Aheta. he yAsAThI kI tumacyAvara ekhAdI aDacaNa ud‌bhavU naye. allAha moThA mApha karaNArA ANi moThA dayA karaNArA Ahe.

tyAMcyApaikI jilA tumhI icchita asAla dUra rAkhA ANi jilA icchita asAla ApalyA javaLa ThevA ANi jara tumhI tyAMcyApaikI ekhAdIlA ApalyA javaLa bolAvUna ghyAla, jyAMnA tumhI vegaLe karUna Thevale hote, tara yAta tumhAlA kAhI harakata nAhI. yAdvAre yA goSTIcI adhika AzA bALagalI jAU zakate kI yA (striyAM) ce netra zitala rAhAveta ANi tyA duHkhI na vhAvyAta ANi tumhI je kAhI tyAMnA dyAla tyAvara tyA sarva rAjI khuzI rAhatIla. tumacyA manAta je kAhI Ahe te allAha cAMgalyA prakAre jANato. allAha moThA jJAna bALagaNArA sahanazIla Ahe.

yAnaMtara itara striyA tumacyAkaritA halAla (vaidha) nAhIta ANi nA he (ucita Ahe) kI tyAMnA soDUna dusar2yA striyAMzI (vivAha karAvA) jarI tyAMce rUpa (sauMdarya) kitIhI cAMgale vATata asela. paraMtu tumacyA dAsIkherIja, allAha pratyeka goSTIvara dekharekha karaNArA Ahe.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yA lokAMno! joparyaMta tumhAlA (Ata yeNyAcI) anumatI dilI jAta nAhI, toparyaMta tumhI paigaMbarAcyA gharAta praveza karU nakA. bhojanAkaritA azA veLI kI bhojana tayAra hoNyAcI pratIkSA karIta rAhAve, kiMbahunA jevhA bolAvile jAIla, tevhA jA ANi jevhA bhojana karU ghyAla tevhA nighaNyAcI tayArI karA. titheca (basUna) gappA goSTIta magna hoU nakA. paigaMbarAnA tumacyA yA kAmAcA trAsa hoto, paraMtu te tumacA Adara (saMkoca) karatAta, ANi allAha satya goSTa sAMgaNyAta koNAcIhI parvA karIta nAhI, ANi jevhA tumhI paigaMbarAcyA patnIMkaDUna ekhAdI vastU mAgAla tara paDadyAADUna mAgA. tumacyA ANi tyAMcyA hRdayAMkaritA purNa pavitratA hIca Ahe. tumacyAsAThI he yogya navhe kI tumhI allAhacyA paigaMbarAsa trAsa dyAvA ANi nA tumacyAsAThI he ucita Ahe kI paigaMbara (sa.) yAMcyAnaMtara tyAMcyA patnIMzI vivAha karAvA (lakSAta ThevA) allAhajavaLa he mahAbhayaMkara (pApa) Ahe.
tumhI ekhAdI goSTa jAhIra karA kiMvA lapavUna ThevA, allAha pratyeka goSTIce cAMgalyA prakAre jJAna rAkhaNArA Ahe.

tyA striyAMvara kasalAhI gunhA nAhI tyA ApalyA pityAMcyA, ApalyA putrAMcyA ANi bhAvAMcyA, ApalyA putaNyAMcyA, bhAcyAMcyA ANi ApalyA (paricita) striyAMcyA ANi jyAMcyA tyA mAlaka Aheta tyAM (dAsa dAsIM) cyA samora asAvyAta. striyAMno! allAhace bhaya bALagata rAhA, allAha niHsaMzaya, pratyeka goSTIvara sAkSI Ahe.
allAha ANi tyAce pharizte yA paigaMbarAvara daruda pAThavitAta. he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! tumhI (dekhIla) yAMcyAvara daruda pAThavA ANi jAsta salAma (hI) pAThavata rAhA.
je loka allAha ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAlA duHkha- trAsa detAta, tyAMcyAvara yA jagAta va Akhiratamadhye allAhatarphe dhiHkkAra Ahe ANi tyAMcyAsAThI moThA apamAnita karaNArA az2Aba (zikSA-yAtanA) Ahe.
ANi je loka ImAna rAkhaNAr2yA puruSa va striyAMnA azA ekhAdyA aparAdhAbaddala duHkha - trAsa detAta, jo tyAMcyAkaDUna ghaDalA nasela tara te phAra moThA Aropa ANi khulyA aparAdhAce ojhe ucalatAta.

he paigaMbara! ApalyA patnIMnA ANi ApalyA kanyAMnA ANi ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMcyA striyAMnA sAMgA kI tyAMnI ApalyA aMgAvara ApalyA cAdarI TAkUna gheta jAve. azAne tyA tvarita oLakhalyA jAtIla, maga tyAMnA trAsa pohacavilA jANAra nAhI, ANi allAha moThA mApha karaNArA ANi dayA karaNArA Ahe.

jara (ajUnahI) he munAphika (ImAnadhAraka asalyAce DhoMga karaNAre) ANi te, jyAMcyA manAta roga Ahe ANi madInAce te rahivAzI je khoTyA aphavA uDavitAta, thAMbale nAhIta tara AmhI tumhAlA tyAMcyA (nAzA) vara lAvUna deU, maga tara te kAhI divasaca tumacyAsobata yA (zaharA) ta rAhU zakatIla.
tyAMcyAvara dhiHkkArAcA varSAva kelA gelA, jyA jyA ThikANI sApaDAveta, dharale jAveta ANi khUpa tukaDe tukaDe kele jAveta.
tyAMcyApUrvI hoUna gelelyA lokAMsAThIhI allAhacA hAca niyama lAgU rAhilA ANi tumhAlA allAhacyA vidhI-niyamAta kevhAhI badala ADhaLaNAra nAhI.
loka tumhAlA kayAmata (cyA veLe) viSayI vicAratAta. (tumhI) sAMgA, yAce jJAna tara kevaLa allAhalAca Ahe, tumhAlA kAya mAhIta, phAra saMbhava Ahe kI kayAmata agadI javaLa yeUna ThepalI asela.
allAhane kAphirAMcA dhiHkkAra kelelA Ahe ANi tyAMcyAsAThI dhagadhagaNArI Aga tayAra karUna ThevalI Ahe.
jicyAta te sadaivakALa rAhatIla, tyAMnA nA koNI pAThIrAkhA mitra lAbhela ANi nA koNI madata karaNArA.
tyA divazI tyAMce cehare AgIta ulaTa pAlaTa kele jAtIla (te moThyA pazcAttApAne ANi duHkhAne) mhaNatIla kI AmhI allAhace ANi paigaMbarAMce AjJApAlana kele asate tara bare jhAle asate!
ANi te mhaNatIla, he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! AmhI ApalyA pramukhAMce ANi thorA-moThyAMce mhaNaNe aikale (mAnale) jyAMnI AmhAlA saraLa mArgApAsUna vicalita kele.
he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! tU tyAMnA duppaTa az2Aba (zikSA-yAtanA) de ANi tyAMcyAvara phAra moThA dhiHkkAra (lAnata) pAThava.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! tyA lokAMsArakhe hoU nakA, jyAMnI mUsAlA kleza - yAtanA dilI, tara jI goSTa tyAMnI sAMgitalI hotI allAhane tyAMnA tyA goSTIpAsUna mukta kele ANi allAhajavaLa mUsA pratiSThita hote.
he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! allAhace bhaya rAkhA ANi saraLa saraLa (satya) goSTI bolata jA.

yAsAThI kI allAhane tumacyA AcaraNAta sudhAraNA karAvI ANi tumace aparAdha mApha karAveta ANi jo manuSya dekhIla allAha ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAcyA AdezAce pAlana karIla, tyAne phAra moThI saphalatA prApta karUna ghetalI.

AmhI ApalyA amAnatIlA AkAzAMcyA ANi jaminIcyA ANi parvatAMcyA samora sAdara kele (paraMtu) sarvAMnI tI ucalaNyAbAbata inkAra kelA ANi ticyApAsUna bhayabhita jhAle (tathApi) mAnavAne tilA ucalUna ghetale, niHsaMzaya to moThA atyAcArI ANi aDANI Ahe.

(he azAsAThI) kI allAhane munAphika puruSa ANi munAphika striyA ANi anekezvaravAdI puruSa ANi anekezvaravAdI striyAMnA sajA dyAvI ANi ImAna rAkhaNAr2yA puruSAMcI ANi ImAna rAkhaNAr2yA striyAMcI taubA (kSamA-yAcanA) kabUla karAvI, ANi allAha moThA mApha karaNArA ANi dayA karaNArA Ahe.
samasta prazaMsA allAhakaritAca Ahe, jo AkAzAMcyA ANi jaminIcyA samasta vastUMcA svAmI Ahe ANi AkhiratamadhyehI prazaMsA tyAcyAcakaritA Ahe. to (moThA) hikamatazAlI ANi (pUrNataH) jANakAra Ahe.
je kAhI jaminIta dAkhala hote ANi je kAhI ticyAtUna nighate ANi je AkAzAtUna avatarita hote ANi je caDhUna tyAta jAte, te sarva kAhI to jANato, ANi to moThA dayA karaNArA, moThA mApha karaNArA Ahe.

ANi kAphira mhaNatAta kI AmacyAvara kayAmata sthApita hoNAra nAhI. tumhI sAMgA, malA mAjhyA pAlanakartyAcI zapatha! jo aparokSa jANaNArA Ahe kI tI nizcitaca tumacyAvara kAyama hoIla. allAhapAsUna ekA kaNAitakIhI vastU lapalelI nAhI, nA AkAzAMmadhye ANi nA dharatIta, kiMbahunA tyAhUnahI lahAna ANi moThI sarva vastU (va goSTI) ekA khulyA (spaSTa) graMthA vidyamAna Aheta.
yAsAThI kI tyAne (allAhane) ImAna rAkhaNAr2yA ANi sadAcArI lokAMnA cAMgalA mobadalA pradAna karAvA. heca te loka hota, jyAMcyAkaritA kSamA, sanmAnapUrNa AjivikA Ahe.
ANi AmacyA AyatIMcA avamAna karaNyAta jyAMnI prayatna kelA Ahe, tara te ase loka Aheta, jyAMcyAsAThI atizaya vAITa prakAracA sakta az2Aba Ahe.

ANi jyAMnA jJAna Ahe te pAhatIla kI je kAhI tumacyAkaDe, tumacyA pAlanakartyAtarphe avatarita jhAle Ahe te (paripUrNa) satya Ahe ANi te allAhacA mArga dAkhavite jo moThA varcasvazAlI, prazaMsanIya Ahe.

ANi kAphira (inkArI loka) mhaNAle, yA, AmhI tumhAlA eka asA manuSya dAkhavAvA, jo tumhAlA hI khabara pohacavita Ahe kI jevhA tumhI pUrNapaNe kaNa kaNa (cUra cUra) hoUna jAla, tevhA tumhI punhA ekA navyA jIvanAta yAla.

(AmhI nAhI sAMgata) kI svataH tyAneca allAhavara asatya racale Ahe kiMvA tyAlA veDa lAgale Ahe, kiMbahunA (kharI goSTa azI) kI Akhiratavara ImAna na rAkhaNAreca zikSA-yAtaneta ANi dUracyA mArgabhraSTateta paDale Aheta.

tevhA kAya te ApalyA puDhe mAge AkAza va dharatIlA pAhata nAhIta? jara AmhI icchile tara tyAMnA jaminIta dhasavUna TAkU kiMvA tyAMcyAvara AkAzAce tukaDe kosaLavU. niHsaMzaya yAta phAra moThe pramANa Ahe tyA pratyeka dAsAkaritA, jo (manApAsUna) rujU karaNArA asAvA.
ANi AmhI dAUdavara ApalI kRpA kelI. he parvatAMno! tyAMcyAsobata (tumhIhI) mAjhI tasbIha (guNagAna) karIta jA ANi pakSyAMnA dekhIla (hAca Adeza Ahe) ANi AmhI tyAMcyAkaritA lokhaMDAsa narama kele.
(yAsAThI) kI tumhI pUre pUre kavaca (cilakhate) banavA ANi tyAMcyA kaDyA ThIka ThIka anumAnAne rAkhA ANi tumhI sarva nekIcI kAme karA (vizvAsa rAkhA) mI tumace (pratyeka) karma pAhata Ahe.

ANi AmhI havelA sulemAnacyA adhIna kele kI sakALacI majala ticI eka mahinyAcI rAhAta ase ANi saMdhyAkALacI majala dekhIla ANi AmhI tyAMcyAsAThI tAMbyAcA jharA pravAhita kelA ANi tyAMcyA pAlanakartyAcyA AdezAne kAhI jinna dekhIla, je tyAMcyA tAbyAta rAhUna tyAMcyAjavaLa kAma karIta asata ANi tyAMcyApaikI jo koNI AmacyA AdezAcI avajJA karIta ase, AmhI tyAlA bhaDakatyA AgIcyA az2Aba (zikSe) cI goDI cAkhavita asU.

sulemAna je kAhI icchita asata te (jinnAta) tayAra karUna deta, jase killA, citra (smAraka), talAvAsArakhyA parAtI ANi culIMvara kAyama TikUna rAhaNAr2yA DegA (moThe moThe pAtele) he dAUdacyA vaMzajAMno! tyAcyAzI kRtajJatA vyakta karaNyAkaritA satkarme karA, mAjhyA dAsAMpaikI kRtajJazIla dAsa phAra kamIca asatAta.

maga jevhA AmhI tyAMcyAvara mRtyucA Adeza pAThavilA, tevhA tI khabara (jinnAMnA) koNIhI dilI nAhI, vALavIcyA kiDyAkherIja, jo tyAMcI lAThI khAta hotA. tara jevhA (sulemAna) khAlI kosaLale, tyA kSaNI jinnAMnI jANUna ghetale kI jara te aparokSa jJAna bALagata asate tara yA apamAnAcyA zikSeta paDUna rAhile nasate.

sabAcyA janasamUhAkaritA, tyAMcyA vastIMmadhyeca (allAhacyA sAmarthyAcI) nizANI hotI. tyAMcyA ujavyA DAvyA bAjUlA dona bAgA hotyA. (AmhI tyAMnA Adeza dilA hotA kI) ApalyA pAlanakartyAne pradAna kelelI AjivikA khA ANi tyAce AbhAra mAnata rAhA. hI svaccha - zuddha bhUmI Ahe ANi pAlanakartA kSamAzIla Ahe.

paraMtu tyAMnI toMDa phiravile, maga AmhI tyAMcyAvara vegavAna mahApurAce (pANI) pAThavile ANi tyAMcyA (hiravyA TavaTavIta) bAgAMaivajI dona (azA) bAgA dilyA, jyA svAdAta kaDavaTa ANi adhikAMza jhADe-jhuDape ANi kAhI borIMcI jhADe asalelyA hotyA.
AmhI tyAMcyA kRtaghnatecA hA mobadalA tyAMnA dilA. AmhI (azI sakta) sajA moThamoThyA kRtaghna lokAMnAca deto.

ANi AmhI tyAcyA va tyA vastIMcyA daramyAna, jyAMcyAta AmhI sukha-samRddhI pradAna karUna ThevalI hotI. kAhI vastyA dusar2yA ThevalyA hotyA, jyA, mArgAvara disUna yeta hotyA ANi tyAMcyAta cAlaNyAcI (pravAsAcI) ThikANe nizcita kelI hotI, tyAta rAtrI ANi divasA zAMtI surakSApUrvaka hiMData phirata rAhA.

paraMtu tyAMnI dusar2yAMdA duA (prArthanA) kelI kI he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! Amace pravAsa dUra dUraparyaMta kara ANi jyAarthI tyAMnI svataH ApalyA hAtAMnI Apale vAITa karUna ghetale, yAstava AmhI tyAMnA (junyA) kahANIcyA rUpAta karUna TAkale ANi tyAMce tukaDe tukaDe karuna TAkaleta niHsaMzaya, pratyeka sahanazIla ANi kRtajJazIla mANasAkaritA yA (ghaTane) ta aneka nizANyA Aheta.
ANi saitAnAne tyAMcyAviSayI ApalA irAdA (anumAna) kharA karUna dAkhavilA, he loka (sarvacyA sarva) tyAce anuyAyI banale, ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMcyA ekA gaTAkherIja.

ANi saitAnAcA tyAMcyAvara koNatAhI dabAva (ANi jora) navhatA, paraMtu azAsAThI kI AmhI tyA lokAMnA, je Akhiratavara ImAna rAkhatAta, tyA lokAMmadhye (cAMgalyA prakAre) jAhIra karAve, je tyAbAbata saMzayagrasta Aheta, ANi tumacA pAlanakartA pratyeka goSTIcA saMrakSaka Ahe.

sAMgA kI allAhakherIja jyAMcA jyAMcA tumhAlA (upAsya asaNyAcA) bhrama Ahe (tyA sarvAMnA) hAka dyA. tyAMcyApaikI nA koNAlA AkAzAMmadhye ANi dharatIta kaNAitakAhI adhikAra Ahe, nA tyAMcA yA doghAMta kasalAhI hissA Ahe ANi nA tyAMcyApaikI koNI allAhacA sahabhAgI Ahe.

ANi ziphArasa (cI duA - prArthanA) hI tyAcyAsamora kAhI lAbha deta nAhI, tyAMcyAkherIja, jyAMcyAsAThI anumAnita asAvI. yetheparyaMta kI, jevhA tyAMcyA hRdayAtUna bhaya-dahazata dUra kelI jAte, tevhA te vicAratAta, tumacyA pAlanakartyAne kAya sAMgitale? uttara detAta kI khare sAMgitale ANi to moThA uccatama ANi moThA mahAna Ahe.

tyAMnA vicArA kI tumhAlA AkAzAmadhUna ANi jaminItUna AjivikA koNa pohacavito? (svataH) uttara dyA kI (mahAna) allAha! (aikA) AmhI athavA tumhI, eka tara nizcitapaNe mArgadarzanAvara Ahe kiMvA ughaDa mArgabhraSTateta Ahe.
sAMgA kI AmhI kelelyA aparAdhAMbAbata tumhAlA kAhI vicArale jANAra nAhI ANi nA tumacyA karmAMsaMbaMdhI AmhAlA vicArale jAIla.
(tyAMnA) khabaradAra karA kI AmhA sarvAMnA AmacA pAlanakartA ekatra karUna maga AmacyA daramyAna satyAsaha phaisalA karIla ANi to phaisalA karaNArA, sarva kAhI jANaNArA Ahe.
sAMgA kI bare malAhI tyAMnA dAkhavA, jyAMnA tumhI allAhacA sahabhAgI banavUna tyAcyAsobata sAmIla karIta AhAta. ase kadApi nAhI, kiMbahunA toca allAha Ahe, jabaradasta va hikamatazAlI.
ANi AmhI tumhAlA sarva lokAMkaritA zubha samAcAra aikaviNArA ANi khabaradAra karaNArA banavUna pAThavile Ahe, paraMtu (kharI goSTa azI kI) adhikAMza loka jANata nAhIta.
ANi vicAratAta kI to vAyadA kevhA pUrNa hoIla? sacce asAla tara sAMgA.
uttara dyA, vAyadyAcA divasa agadI nizcita Ahe, jyApAsUna eka kSaNa nA tumhI mAge haTU zakatA, ANi nA puDhe jAU zakatA.

ANi kAphira (inkArI loka) mhaNAle, AmhI tara yA kuraAnAsa mAnaNAre nAhIta, nA yAcyA pUrvIcyA graMthAMnA ANi jara tumhI pAhile asate, jevhA he atyAcArI ApalyA pAlanakartyAsamora ubhe, ekamekAMvara doSAropa Thevata asatIla. khAlacyA darjAce loka, ucca darjAcyA lokAMnA mhaNatIla, jara tumhI rAhile nasate tara (khAtrIne) AmhI ImAna rAkhaNAre asato.
he ucca darjAce loka tyA durbala lokAMnA uttara detIla kI, kAya tumacyAjavaLa mArgadarzana yeUna pohocalyAnaMtara AmhI tumhAlA tyApAsUna rokhale hote (nAhI), ulaTa tumhI (svataH) atyAcArI hote.

(ANi yAlA uttara detAnA) he durbala loka tyA ghameMDI lokAMnA sAMgatIla (muLIca nAhI) kiMbahunA rAtraMdivasa labADIne AmhAlA, allAhasobata kupra karaNyAsa ANi tyAcyAsobata sahabhAgI TharaviNyAsa tumacA Adeza deNe, AmacyA beImAnIce kAraNa Tharale ANi az2AbalA (zikSA-yAtanelA) pAhatAca sarvacyA sarva manAtalyA manAta lajjita hota asatIla ANi kAphirAMcyA gaLyAta AmhI tauka (jokhaDa) TAkU, tyAMnA kevaLa tyAMcyA kRtakarmAMcA mobadalA dilA jAIla.

ANi AmhI jyA jyA vastIta ekhAdA khabaradAra karaNArA pAThavilA, tevhA tithalyA sukhasaMpanna avasthecyA lokAMnI heca mhaTale kI jyA goSTIsaha tumhI pAThavile gele AhAta, AmhI tyAcA inkAra karaNAre Ahota.
ANi mhaNAle kI AmhI dhana-saMpattI ANi saMtatI adhika bALagato ANi AmhAlA az2Aba (zikSA - yAtanA) dilIca jANAra nAhI.
sAMgA kI mAjhA pAlanakartA, jyAcyAsAThI icchito rojI (AjivikA) vyApaka karato, ANi jyAcyAsAThI icchito taMga (saMkucita) karato, paraMtu bahuteka loka he jANata nAhIta.

ANi tumacI dhana-saMpattI ANi saMtatI azI goSTa navhe kI tumhAlA AmacyAjavaLa (darjAMnI) nikaTa karIla, paraMtu jyAMnI ImAna rAkhale ANi je satkarma karIta rAhile tara tyAMcyAsAThI tyAMcyA satkarmAMcA duppaTa mobadalA Ahe ANi te nirbhaya ANi samAdhAnI hoUna uMca mahAlAMmadhye rAhatIla.
ANi je loka AmacyA AyatIMnA avamAnita karaNyAcyA dhAvapaLIta magna rAhatAta tara azAca lokAMnA az2Aba (zikSA-yAtanA) grasta karUna hajara kele jAIla.

sAMgA kI mAjhA pAlanakartA ApalyA dAsAMpaikI jyAcyAsAThI icchito rojI (AjivikA) vyApaka karato, ANi jyAcyAsAThI icchito taMga (mojUna mApUna) deto ANi tumhI je kAhI allAhacyA mArgAta kharca karAla, allAha tyAcA (purepUra) mobadalA pradAna karIla. to tara sarvAMta uttama rojI (AjivikA) pradAna karaNArA Ahe.
ANi tyA sarvAMnA allAha tyA divazI ekatra karUna phariztyAMnA vicArela, kAya he loka tumacI upAsanA karIta hote?
te mhaNatIla, tU pavitra Ahesa, ANi AmacA mitra - saMrakSaka tara tU Ahesa, he loka navheta. he tara jinnAMcI upAsanA karata hote. yAMcyApaikI bahutekAMce tyAMcyAvaraca ImAna hote.
tevhA Aja tumacyApaikI koNIhI, koNAcyAhIkaritA (kazAhI prakAre) lAbha - hAnI (pohacaviNyA) cA mAlaka nasela ANi AmhI atyAcArIMnA sAMgU kI tyA AgIcI goDI cAkhA, jilA tumhI khoTe Tharavita rAhile.

ANi jevhA tyAMcyAsamora AmacyA spaSTa AyatI vAcUna aikavilyA jAtAta, tevhA mhaNatAta kI hA asA manuSya Ahe, jo tumhAlA, tumacyA vADavaDilAMcyA upAsya daivatAMpAsUna rokhU icchito (yAkherIja ANakhI kAhI nAhI) ANi ase mhaNatAta kI hA tara manAne racalelA Aropa Ahe, ANi satya tyAMcyAjavaLa yeUna pohocale tarIhI inkAra karaNAre heca mhaNata rAhile kI hI tara ughaDa jAdU Ahe!
ANi yA (makkAcyA rahivAzAM) nA, AmhI nA graMtha pradAna karUna Thevale Aheta, jyAMnA he vAcata asAveta ANi nA tyAMcyAjavaLa tumacyApUrvI koNI khabaradAra karaNArA AlA.

ANi yAMcyApUrvIcyA lokAMnIhI AmacyA goSTIMnA khoTe Tharavile hote. ANi tyAMnA AmhI je deUna Thevale hote, tyAcyA dahAvyA hizzyAparyaMtahI he pohacale nAhIta. tevhA, tyAMnI mAjhyA paigaMbarAMnA khoTe Tharavile, (maga pAhA) mAjhyA zikSA yAtanecI kitI (kaThora) avasthA jhAlI.

sAMgA kI mI tumhAlA kevaLa ekAca goSTIcA upadeza karato kI tumhI allAhakaritA (prAmANikapaNe, haTTa soDUna) dona dona miLUna kiMvA ekaTyA ekaTyAne ubhe rAhUna vicAra tara karA. tumacyA yA sAthIdArAlA kAhI veDa vagaire lAgale nAhI. to tara tumhAlA ekA moThyA (sakta) zikSA - yAtanecyA yeNyApUrvI sAvadha karaNArA Ahe.
sAMgA kI jo mobadalA mI tumacyAkaDUna mAgena, to tumacyAkaritA Ahe. mAjhA mobadalA deNyAcI jabAbadArI allAhavara Ahe, ANi to pratyeka goSTIsa sAkSI Ahe.
sAMgA, mAjhA pAlanakartA satya (vahayI) avatarita karato. to pratyeka lapalelI goSTa (gaiba) jANaNArA Ahe.
sAMgA, satya yeUna pohocale. asatyAne nA pahilyAMdA Doke vara kADhale ANi nA dusar2yAMdA Doke vara kADhU zakela.

sAMgA kI jara mI mArgabhraSTa hoIna tara mAjhyA mArgabhraSTatece (saMkaTa) mAjhyAvaraca Ahe ANi jara mI satya mArgAvara Ahe tara tyA vahayImuLe jilA mAjhA pAlanakartA mAjhyAvara avatarita karato. to moThA aikaNArA, atizaya nikaTa Ahe.
ANi jara tumhI (tI veLa) pAhAla jevhA he kAphira ghAbaralelyA sthitIta phiratIla, maga paLUna nighUna jANyAcI koNatIhI avasthA (mArga) nasela ANi javaLacyA ThikANAhUna dharale jAtIla.
ANi tyA veLI mhaNatIla kI AmhI yA (kuraAnA) vara imAna rAkhale Ahe, paraMtu evaDhyA dUracyA (apekSita vastU) kazI hAtI yeU zakate?
ANi yAcyApUrvI tara tyAMnI yAcA inkAra kelA hotA ANi lAMbUnaca na pAhatA aTakaLIce tIra cAlavita rAhile.
ANi tyAMcyA va tyAMcyA icchA AkAMkSAMcyA daramyAna ADa paDadA TAkalA gelA, jyA prakAre yApUrvIhI yAMcyAsArakhyAMzI kele gele te dekhIla (yAMcyApramANeca) zaMkA saMzayAta paDale hote.

tyA allAkaritA samasta stutI - prazaMsA Ahe, jo AkAzAMnA ANi dharatIlA nirmANa karaNArA ANi dona dona, tIna tIna ANi cAra cAra paMkha bALagaNAr2yA phariztyAMnA ApalA saMdezavAhaka banaviNArA Ahe sRSTInirmitIta je icchito vADhavito. niHsaMzaya, allAha pratyeka goSTIce sAmarthya bALagaNArA Ahe.

allAha jo dayA - kRpA (dvAra) lokAMkaritA ughaDa karIla tara tyAsa koNI baMda karaNArA nAhI ANi jyAcyAsAThI baMda karIla tara tyAnaMtara tyAsa koNI surU karaNArA (ughaDaNArA) nAhI ANi toca jabaradasta hikamatazAlI Ahe.

lokAMno! tumacyAvara allAhane je upakAra kele Aheta, tyAMce smaraNa karA. kAya allAhakherIja dusarAhI koNI nirmAtA Ahe, jo tumhAlA AkAzAtUna ANi jaminIpAsUna rojI (AjivikA) deta asAvA? tyAcyAkherIja koNIhI upAsya nAhI, tevhA tumhI koThe ulaTa jAta AhAta?
ANi jara te tumhAlA khoTe TharavitAta tara tumacyA pUrvIce (sarva) paigaMbarahI khoTe Tharavile gele Aheta ANi samasta kArye allAhacyAcakaDe paratavile jAtAta.
he lokAMno! allAhacA vAyadA saccA Ahe. aihika jIvanAne tumhAlA dhokyAta na TAkAve ANi nA dagAbAja (saitAnA) ne tumhAlA gaphalatIta magna ThevAve.
(lakSAta ThevA) saitAna tumacA zatrU Ahe, tumhI tyAlA zatrUca jANA, to tara ApalyA ToLIlA kevaLa azAsAThI bolavito kI te sarva jahannamamadhye jANAre vhAveta.
je loka kAphira (inkArI) jhAle, tyAMcyAkaritA sakta az2Aba Ahe ANi jyA lokAMnI ImAna rAkhale ANi satkarma karIta rAhile tyAMcyAsAThI kSamA ANi moThA cAMgalA mobadalA Ahe.

kAya to manuSya, jyAcyAkaritA tyAcI duSkarme suzobhita kelI gelI Aheta tara to tyAM (karmAM) nA cAMgale samajato (kAya to mArgadarzana prApta karaNAr2yA mANasA samAna Ahe?) (nizcitaca) allAha jyAlA icchito, mArgabhraSTa karato, ANi jyAlA icchito mArga dAkhavito. tevhA tumhI tyAMcyAbaddala duHkhI kaSTI hoUna ApalA jIva kaSTa yAtaneta TAkU naye. he loka je kAhI karIta Aheta niHsaMzaya, allAha te cAMgalyA prakAre jANato.

ANi allAhaca vAr2yAMnA vADhavito, je DhagAMnA uMca netAta, maga AmhI tyA DhagAMnA koraDyA jaminIkaDe neto ANi tyAdvAre tyA jaminIlA ticyA mRtyunaMtara (punhA) jivaMta karato. azAca prakAre dusar2yAMdA jivaMta hoUna uThaNehI Ahe.

jo manuSya mAna-sanmAna prApta karU icchita asela, tara (tyAne jANUna ghyAve kI) samasta mAna-pratiSThA allAhakaritAca Ahe. samasta pavitra vacane tyAcyAcakaDe caDhatAta ANi satkarma tyAMnA uMcavite, ANi je loka duSkarmAMcyA kaTa kArasthAnAta vyasta rAhatAta, tyAMcyAsAThI moThA sakta az2Aba Ahe ANi tyAMce he pAkhaMDa nAza pAvela.

loka ho! allAhane tumhAla mAtIpAsUna nirmANa kele, maga vIryApAsUna, maga tumhAlA joDI (joDape nara-nArI) banavile. striyAMce garbha dhAraNa karaNe ANi bALAce janma gheNe, yA sarvAMce tyAlA jJAna Ahe, ANi koNatAhI AyuSyamAna dIrghAyuSya prApta karIta nAhI ANi nA koNAce AyuSya ghaDate, paraMtu he sarva ekA graMthAta astitvAta Ahe. allAkaritA hI goSTa phAra sopI Ahe.

ANi dona samudra samAna nAhIta. hA goDa Ahe, tahAna bhAgavito, pyAyalA cAMgalA ANi to dusarA khAraTa Ahe, kaDU. tumhI yA doghAMpAsUna tAje mAMsa khAtA ANi te dAgine kADhatA, jyAMnA tumhI aMgAvara ghAlatA ANi tumhI pAhatA kI moThamoThyA nAvA, pANyAlA chedaNAr2yA, tyA samudrAta Ahe, yAsAThI kI tumhI tyAcyA kRpecA zodha ghyAvA ANi yAsAThI kI tumhI tyAce AbhAra mAnAveta.

to rAtrIlA divasAta ANi divasAlA rAtrIta dAkhala karato ANi sUrya va caMdrAlA tyAneca kAmAsa lAvale Ahe. pratyeka ekA nirdhArita avadhIpAveto cAlata Ahe. hAca allAha hoya, tumhA sarvAMcA pAlanakartA. tyAcIca rAjya sattA Ahe, ANi jyAMnA tumhI tyAcyAkherIja pukArata AhAta, te tara khajurIcyA bI sAlapaTAcehI mAlaka nAhIta.

jara tumhI tyAMnA pukArAla tara te tumacI pukAra aikaNAraca nAhIta. ANi jara (samajA) aikUnahI ghetIla tara kabUla karaNAra nAhIta. kiMbahunA kayAmatacyA divazI tumacyA zirka (anekaIzvaraupAsanA ) cA sApha inkAra karatIla ANi tumhAlA koNIhI allAhasArakhA jANakAra (vAstavapUrNa) khabarI deNAra nAhI.
loka ho! tumhI allAhace bhikArI AhAta ANi allAhaca niHspRha (garaja nasalelA) prazaMsanIya Ahe.
jara tyAne icchile tara tumacA sarvanAza karUna TAkIla ANi eka navI nirmitI (sRSTI) nirmANa karIla.
ANi hI goSTa allAhakaritA kAhIca kaThINa nAhI.

ANi koNIhI ojhe ucalaNArA, dusar2yAce ojhe ucalaNAra nAhI ANi jara koNI jAsta vajanAce ojhe bALagaNArA ApalA bhAra ucalaNyAkaritA dusar2yA koNAlA bolavila tara to tyAtUna kAhIca ucalU zakaNAra nAhI, maga to javaLacA nAtevAIka kA asenA. tumhI kevaLa azAMnAca sAvadha karU zakatA, je pAhilyAvinAca ApalyA pAlanakartyAce bhaya bALagatAta ANi namAja niyamitapaNe paDhatAta ANi jo pAka (svaccha - zuddha) hoIla, to ApalyAca phAyadyAsAThI pAka hoIla ANi (zevaTI) allAhakaDeca paratUna jAyace Ahe.
ANi AMdhaLA va DoLasa donhI samAna nAhIta.
ANi nA aMdhAra ANi nA prakAza.
ANi nA sAvalI ANi nA Una.
ANi jIvita va mRta doghe samAna asU zakata nAhI, ANi allAha jyAlA icchito aikavito, ANi tumhI tyA lokAMnA aikavU zakata nAhI, je kabarIMmadhye Aheta.
tumhI tara phakta khabaradAra karaNAre AhAta.
AmhIca tumhAlA satyAsaha khUzakhabara aikaviNArA ANi bhaya dAkhaviNArA banavUna pAThavile Ahe ANi koNatAhI janasamudAya asA hoUna gelA nAhI kI jyAta ekhAdA khabaradAra karaNArA AlA nasAvA.

ANi jara he loka tumhAlA khoTe TharavatIla tara tyAMcyApUrvI hoUna gelelyA lokAMnIhI khoTe Tharavile hote, tyAMcyAjavaLadekhIla tyAMce paigaMbara mojije (IzacamatkAra), sahIphe (pothI) ANi spaSTa graMtha gheUna Ale hote.
maga mI tyA kAphirAMnA (satya-virodhakAMnA) dharale, tara kazI hotI mAjhI zikSA!

kAya tumhI yA goSTIkaDe lakSa dile nAhI kI allAhane AkAzAtUna pANI avatarita kele, maga AmhI tyAcyAdvAre aneka raMgAcI phaLe nirmANa kelI ANi parvatAMcehI aneka hisse Aheta sapheda ANi lAla kI tyAMce dekhIla aneka raMga Aheta ANi gaDada kALehI.

ANi azAca prakAre mANasAMmadhye, janAvarAMmadhye ANi catuSpAda prANyAMmadhyehI kAhI ase Aheta jyAMce raMga vegavegaLe Aheta. allAhazI tyAce teca dAsa bhaya rAkhatAta, je jJAna bALagatAta. vAstavika allAha moThA varcasvazAlI, mApha karaNArA Ahe.

je loka allAhacyA graMthAce paThaNa (tilAvata) karatAta ANi namAja nitya nemAne paDhatAta ANi je kAhI AmhI tyAMnA pradAna kele Ahe tyAtUna guptapaNe ANi ughaDapaNe kharca karatAta, te azA vyApArAcI AzA bALagatAta, jo kadhIhI toTyAta rAhaNAra nAhI.
yAsAThI kI tyAMnA tyAMcA mobadalA purepUra dilA jAvA ANi tyAMnA ApalyA kRpene ANakhI jAsta pradAna karAve. niHsaMzaya, to moThA mApha karaNArA, guNagrAhaka Ahe.

ANi hA graMtha jo AmhI tumacyAkaDe vahayI (prakAzanA) dvAre pAThavilA Ahe to pUrNataH satya Ahe, jo ApalyA pUrvIcyA graMthAMcIhI puSTI karato. niHsaMzaya, allAha ApalyA dAsAMcI pUrNa mAhitI ThevaNArA, cAMgalyA prakAre pAhaNArA Ahe.

maga (yA) graMthAcA uttarAdhikArI AmhI tyA lokAMnA banavile, jyAMnA AmhI ApalyA dAsAMmadhUna nivaDUna ghetale. maga kAhI tara ApalyA prANAMvara atyAcAra karaNAre Aheta, ANi kAhI madhyama darjAce Aheta ANi tyAMcyApaikI kAhI allAhane dilelyA tauphika (subuddhI) ne satkarmAta puDheca jAta rAhatAta. hA phAra moThA anugraha Ahe.
sadaiva kALa rAhaNyAcyA tyA bAgA Aheta, jyAta he loka praveza karatIla, tithe tyAMnA sonyAcI kAMkaNe ANi motI (aMgAvara) ghAtalI jAtIla ANi tithe tyAMcI vastre rezamAcI asatIla.
ANi mhaNatIla kI allAhace anaMta upakAra Aheta, jyAne AmacyApAsUna duHkha dUra kele. niHsaMzaya, AmacA pAlanakartA moThA mApha karaNArA ANi kadara jANaNArA Ahe.
jyAne AmhAlA ApalyA kRpene sadaiva kALa rAhaNyAcyA ThikANI utaravile, jithe nA AmhAlA kAhI kaSTa pohocela ANi nA kasalA thakavA jANavela.

ANi je loka kAphira (inkArI) Aheta, tyAMcyAsAThI jahannamacI Aga Ahe, nA tara tyAMnA mRtyu yeIla kI te maruna jAveta ANi nA jahannamacI zikSAca kamI kelI jAIla. AmhI pratyeka kAphirAlA azIca zikSA - yAtanA deto.

ANi te loka tyAta (jahannamamadhye) moThamoThyAne oraDatIla kI he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! AmhAlA (yAtUna) bAhera kADha AmhI cAMgale karma karU, tyA karmAMkherIja, je AmhI karIta hoto (allAha pharmAvila) kI kAya AmhI tumhAlA evaDhe AyuSya dile navhate kI jyAlA samajUna ghyAyace asate, to samajU zakata hotA ANi tumacyAjavaLa khabaradAra karaNArAhI pohacalA hotA, tevhA AtA goDI cAkhA (azA) julamI atyAcArI lokAMcA koNIhI sahAyya karaNArA nAhI.
niHsaMzaya, allAha AkAzAMcyA ANi jaminIcyA lapalelyA vastUMnA jANaNArA Ahe. niHsaMzaya, to chAtItalyA (manAtalyA) goSTIMnAhI jANaNArA Ahe.

toca asA Ahe, jyAne tumhAlA dharatIvara basavile, tevhA jo manuSya kupra (inkAra) karIla tara tyAcyA kuprace ojhe tyAcyAvaraca yeIla ANi kAphira lokAMkaritA, tyAMcA inkAra tyAMcyA pAlanakartyAjavaLa krodha vADhaviNyAceca kAraNa Tharato ANi kAphirAMsAThI tyAMcA inkAra nukasAna vADhaviNyAcIca sababa Tharato.

(tumhI) sAMgA kI tumhI ApalyA (TharavilelyA) sahabhAgI IzvarAMcI avasthA tara sAMgA, tyAMnA tumhI allAhakherIja pukArIta asatA, arthAta malA he sAMgA kI tyAMnI dharatIcA koNatA (hissA) banavilA Ahe kiMvA tyAMcA AkAzAta kAhI sahabhAga Ahe athavA AmhI tyAMMnA ekhAdA graMtha dilA Ahe kI he tyAcyA purAvyAvara aTaLa asAveta? navhe, kiMbahunA he atyAcArI ekamekAMzI kevaLa phasavaNukIcyA goSTIMce vAyade karIta asatAta.

niHsaMzaya, allAhane AkAzAMnA ANi jaminIlA dharUna Thevale Ahe kI te DagamagU nayeta ANi jara te Dagamagale tara maga allAhakherIja koNI tyAMnA dharUhI zakata nAhI. niHsaMzaya to moThA sahanazIla, mApha karaNArA Ahe.

ANi yA kAphira lokAMnI moThI dRDhazapatha ghetalI hotI kI jara tyAMcyAjavaLa koNI khabaradAra karaNArA AlA tara te pratyeka samudAyA (ummata) pekSA jAsta mArgadarzana prApta karaNAre banatIla, maga jevhA tyAMcyAjavaLa eka paigaMbara yeUna pohocalA tevhA tyAMcyA tiraskArAtaca pragati jhAlI.

jagAta svataHlA moThA samajalyAmuLe ANi tyAMcyA vAITa prayatnAMmuLe ANi vAITa prayatna karaNAr2yAMcI zikSA te prayatna karaNAr2yAMnAca bhogAvI lAgate tara kAya he tyAca vyavahArAcyA pratIkSeta Aheta, jo pUrvIcyA lokAMzI kelA jAta rAhilA? tevhA tumhAlA allAhacyA paddhatIta kadhIhI badala ADhaLaNAra nAhI ANi tumhAlA allAhacyA niyamAta kadhI badala hota asalelA ADhaLaNAra nAhI.

kAya he loka dharatIvara hiMDale phirale nAhIta kI tyAMnI pAhile asate kI je loka yAMcyApUrvI hoUna geleta, tyAMcA aMta kasA jhAlA. vAstavika te loka yAMcyApekSA adhika zaktizAlI hote. ANi AkAzAMmadhye va dharatIvara azI koNatIhI vastU nAhI jI allAhalA lAcAra karIla. to sarva kAhI jANaNArA, moThA sAmarthyazAlI Ahe.

ANi jara allAha, lokAMnA tyAMcyA karmAMmuLe tvarita pakaDIta gheU lAgalA asatA tara saMpUrNa dharatIvara eka jIvadekhIla soDalA nasatA tathApi allAha tyAMnA ekA nirdhArita samayAparyaMta savaDa deta Ahe, tara jevhA tyAMcI tI veLa yeUna pohocela tevhA allAha ApalyA dAsAMnA svataH pAhUna gheIla.
yAsIna *
zapatha Ahe buddhI-kauzalyayukta (ANi majabUta) kuraAnAcI.
kI nizcitaca tumhI paigaMbarAMpaikI AhAta.
saraLa mArgAvara AhAta.
(hA kuraAna, allAha) jabaradasta, moThyA dayA karaNAr2yAtarphe avatarita kelA gelA Ahe.
yAsAThI kI tumhI azA lokAMnA khabaradAra karAve, jyAMcyA vADavaDilAMnA khabaradAra kele gele navhate. yAstava te gaphalatIta paDale Aheta.
tyAMcyApaikI adhikAMza lokAMbAbata hI goSTa sAbita jhAlI Ahe. yAstava he loka ImAna rAkhaNAra nAhIta.
AmhI tyAMcyA mAnAMvara tauka (jokhaMDa) TAkale Ahe, je tyAMcyA hanuvaTIparyaMta Ahe, jyAmuLe tyAMcI DokI vara uThalelyA sthitIta Aheta.
ANi AmhI eka ADa tyAMcyAsamora ubhA kelA ANi eka ADa tyAMcyA mAge ubhA kelA, jyAdvAre AmhI tyAMnA jhAkUna TAkale, tevhA te pAhU zakata nAhI.
ANi tyAMcyA saMdarbhAta tumace bhaya dAkhaviNe kiMvA na dAkhaviNe donhI sArakheca Ahe. he ImAna bALagaNAra nAhIta.

tumhI kevaLa azAca mANasAlA bhaya dAkhavU zakatA, jo upadezAce anusaraNa karIla ANi rahamAna (allAha) ce na pAhatA bhaya bALagela, tevhA tumhI azA mANasAlA kSamA ANi uttama mobadalA dilA jANyAcI khUzakhabara aikavA.

niHsaMzaya, AmhI mRtAMnA jivaMta karU ANi AmhI lihita asato je karma dekhIla loka puDhe pAThavitAta ANi tyAMcI tI karmehI, jI te mAge soDUna jAtAta ANi pratyeka goSTIsa AmhI ekA spaSTa graMthAta saMkalita karUna Thevale Ahe.
ANi tumhI tyAMcyAsamora eka udAharaNa (arthAta ekA) vastIvAlyAMcA kissA (tyA kALacA) sAdara karA, jevhA tyA vastIta aneka rasUla Ale.
jevhA AmhI tyAMcyAjavaLa dona rasUla pAThavileta, tevhA tyA lokAMnI (prathama) tyA doghAMnA samarthana dile, tevhA te tighe mhaNAle, AmhI tumacyAkaDe (paigaMbara banavUna) pAThavilo gelo Ahota.
te loka mhaNAle, tumhI tara AmacyAsArakheca sAdhAraNa manuSya AhAta ANi rahamAna (dayAvAna) ne koNatIhI goSTa avatarita kelI nAhI. tumhI kevaLa khoTe bolatA.
te rasUla mhaNAle, AmacA pAlanakartA jANato kI AmhAlA tumacyAkaDe rasUla banavUna pAThavile gele Ahe.
ANi Amace kartavya tara kevaLa spaSTapaNe pohacaviNe evaDheca Ahe.
te mhaNAle kI AmhI tara tumhAlA abhadra samajato ANi jara tumhI he thAMbavile nAhI tara AmhI tumhAlA dagaDAMnI ThecUna tumace kAmaca tamAma karUna TAkU ANi tumhAlA AmacyAtarphe sakta zikSA miLela.
te paigaMbara mhaNAle kI tumacI abhadratA tara tumacyA sobatIlA Ahe, kAya tilA (azubha samajatA) kI tumhAlA zikavaNa dilI jAvI, kiMbahunA tumhI tara maryAdece ullaMghana karaNAre loka AhAta.
ANi eka muSya tyA zaharAcyA zevaTacyA kinAr2yAkaDUna dhAvata AlA, to mhaNAlA, he mAjhyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMno! yA paigaMbarAMcyA mArgAce anusaraNa karA.
azA lokAMcyA mArgAce anusaraNa karA, je tumacyAkaDUna kasalAhI mobadalA mAgata nAhIta ANi te satya - mArgAvara Aheta.
ANi malA kAya jhAle Ahe kI mI tyAcI upAsanA na karAvI, jyAne malA nirmANa kele ANi tumhI sarva tyAcyAcakaDe paratavile jAla.

kAya mI tyAlA soDUna azAMnA upAsya banavU kI jara (allAha) dayAvAna (rahamAna) malA ekhAde nukasAna pohacavU icchila tara tyAMcI ziphArasa malA kAhIca phAyadA pohacavU zakaNAra nAhI ANi nA te malA vAcavU zakatIla.
maga tara mI nizcitaca ughaDa mArgabhraSTateta Ahe.
mAjhe mhaNaNe aikA! mI tara (sApha manAne) tumhA sarvAMcyA pAlanakartyAvara ImAna rAkhale Ahe.
(tyAlA) sAMgitale gele kI jannatamadhye dAkhala ho. to mhaNAlA, mAjhyA janasamUhAnehI jANUna ghetale asate tara bare jhAle asate!
kI malA mAjhyA pAlanakartyAne mApha kele ANi malA pratiSThita lokAMmadhye sAmIla kele.
ANi tyAnaMtara AmhI tyAcyA janasamUhAvara AkAzAtUna ekhAde sainya avatarita kele nAhI ANi nA azA prakAre AmhI avatarita karato.
to tara kevaLa eka bhayaMkara citkAra hotA, jyAmuLe te sarvacyA sarva vijhUna gele.
(azA) dAsAMbaddala kheda! kadhIhI asA koNatAhI rasUla (paigaMbara) tyAMcyAjavaLa AlA nAhI, jyAcI tyAMnI thaTTA uDavilI nasela.
kAya tyAMnI nAhI pAhile kI tyAMcyApUrvI kityeka janasamUhAMnA AmhI naSTa karUna TAkale kI te yAMcyAkaDe parataNAra nAhIta.
pratyeka janasamUha ekatrita hoUna AmacyA samora hajara kelA jAIla.
ANi tyAMcyAsAThI eka nizANI mRta (koraDI) jamIna Ahe jilA AmhI jivaMta kele ANi ticyAtUna anna (dhAnya) kADhale jyAtUna te khAtAta.
ANi AmhI ticyAta khajurIcyA ANi drAkSAMcyA bAgA nirmANa kelyA ANi jyAMcyAta jhare dekhIla pravAhita kele.
yAsAThI kI (lokAMnI) ticI phaLe khAvIta ANi tyAMcyA hAtAMnI te banavile nAhI, maga te kRtajJatA kA nAhI vyakta karIta?

to (allAha) moThA pavitra Ahe, jyAne pratyeka vastUcyA joDyA nirmANa kelyA, maga tyA jaminItUna ugavilelyA vastU asota, kiMvA yAMce svataHce (astitva) aso, maga tyA (vastU) asota, jyAMnA he jANatahI nAhIta.
ANi tyAMcyAsAThI eka nizANI rAtra Ahe, jicyAtUna AmhI divasAlA oDhUna gheto, tevhA te acAnaka aMdhArAta rAhatAta.
ANi sUryAkaritA je nirdhArita mArga Aheta, to tyAvaraca cAlata rAhato. he Ahe nirdhArita kelele jabaradasta jJAnI (allAha) ce.
ANi caMdrAcyA AmhI majalI nirdhArita kelelyA Aheta. yetheparyaMta kI to punazca junyA phAMdIsArakhA hoto.
nA sUryAcyA AvAkyAta Ahe kI caMdrAlA jAUna dharAve ANi nA rAtra, divasAcyA puDhe jANArI Ahe ANi sarvacyA sarva AkAzAta taraMgata phiratAta.
ANi tyAMcyAsAThI eka nizANI (hI dekhIla) Ahe kI AmhI tyAMcyA saMtatIlA bharalelyA nauketa svAra kele.
ANi yAMcyAsAThI tyAsArakhyAca itara vastU nirmANa kelyA, jyAMcyAvara te svAra hotAta.
ANi jara AmhI icchile asate tara tyAMnA buDavUna TAkale asate, maga nA koNI tyAMcI madata karaNArA asatA ANi nA te vAcavale gele asate.
paraMtu AmhI ApalyAtarphe dayA - kRpA karato ANi ekA TharAvika mudatIparyaMta tyAMnA lAbha deta Ahota.
ANi tyAMnA jevhA (kadhI) sAMgitale jAte kI puDhacyA - mAgacyA (duSkarmAM) pAsUna alipta rAhA, yAsAThI kI tumacyAvara dayA kelI jAvI.
ANi tyAMcyAjavaLa tyAMcyA pAlanakartyAkaDUna azI ekhAdI nizANI yeta nAhI jicyApAsUna he toMDa phiravita nasAveta.

ANi tyAMnA jevhA sAMgitale jAte kI allAhane je dile Ahe, tyAtUna kAhI kharca karA, tevhA he kAphira, ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMnA uttara detAta kI AmhI tyAMnA kA khAU ghAlAve, jyAMnA allAhane icchile asate tara svataHca khAU - piU ghAtale asate? tumhI tara AhAtaca ughaDa mArgabhraSTateta.
ANi te mhaNatAta, hA vAyadA (kayAmatacI dhamakI) kevhA pUrNa hoIla, sacce asAla tara sAMgA.
tyAMnA kevaLa ekA bhayaMkara citkArAcI pratIkSA Ahe, jo tyAMnA yeUna dharela ANi he ApasAta laDhata - bhAMDataca asatIla.
tyAveLI he nA vasIyata (mRtyupatra) karU zakatIla ANi nA - ApalyA kuTuMbAkaDe paratU zakatIla.
ANi sUra (zaMkha) phuMkalA jAtAca sarvacyA sarva ApalyA kabarImadhUna ApalyA pAlanakartyAkaDe (jalada gatIne) cAlU lAgatIla.
mhaNatIla, arere! AmhAlA AmacyA ArAmacyA jAgetUna koNI uThavile? heca Ahe te, jyAcA vAyadA rahamAna (dayAvAna) ne kelA hotA, ANi paigaMbarAMnI khare khare sAMgitale hote.
ase navhe, paraMtu eka bhayaMkara garjanA kI acAnaka sarvacyA sarva jamA hoUna AmacyA samora hajara kele jAtIla.
tevhA Aja koNatyAhI mANasAvara kiMcitahI atyAcAra kelA jANAra nAhI ANi tumhAlA tyAca karmAMcA mobadalA dilA jAIla, je tumhI karIta hote.
niHsaMzaya, jannatavAle loka AjacyA divazI ApalyA (manoraMjana) kAryAta vyasta ANi AnaMdita Aheta.
te ANi tyAMcyA patnyA sAvalIta AsanAMvara takke lAvUna basale asatIla.
tyAMcyAkaritA jannatamadhye pratyeka prakArace meve asatIla, ANi itarahI, je kAhI te mAgatIla.
dayA karaNAr2yA pAlanakartyAtarphe tyAMnA ‘salAma’ mhaTale jAIla.
ANi he aparAdhyAMno! Aja tumhI vegaLe vhA.
he AdamacI saMtatI! kAya mI tumacyAkaDUna vacana navhate ghetale kI tumhI saitAnAcI upAsanA na karAvI. to tara tumacA ughaDa zatrU Ahe.
ANi phakta mAjhIca upAsanA karAvI. hAca saraLa mArga Ahe.
ANi saitAnAne tara tumacyApaikI adhikAMza samUhAMnA mArgabhraSTa kele Ahe. kAya tumhI akkala nAhI bALagata?
hIca tI jahannama Ahe, jicA vAyadA tumhAlA dilA jAta hotA.
ApalyA kupra (inkArA) cA mobadalA prApta karaNyAkaritA Aja ticyAta dAkhala vhA.
AmhI Aja tyAMcyA toMDAvara mohara lAvUna deU ANi tyAMce hAta AmacyAzI bolatIla ANi tyAMce pAya sAkSa detIla, tyAMcyA tyA karmAMcI, je te karIta hote.
ANi AmhI icchile asate tara tyAMce DoLe AMdhaLe karUna TAkale asate, maga he mArgAkaDe dhAvata gele asate, maga tyAMnA kazA prakAre disUna Ale asate?
ANi AmhI icchile asate tara tyAMcyA jAgevaraca tyAMce cehare bighaDavUna (vikRta karUna) TAkale asate. maga nA te hiMDU phirU zakale asate ANi nA paratU zakale asate.
ANi AmhI jyAlA vRddha karato, tyAlA janmAcyA veLecyA avasthekaDe dusar2yAMdA paratavito, maga kAya he tarIhI samajUna gheta nAhI?
ANi nA tara AmhI yA paigaMbarAsa kAvya (kavitA) zikavile, ANi nA hA tyAsa yogya Ahe. hA tara kevaLa bodha upadeza ANi spaSTa kuraAna Ahe.
yAsAThI kI tyAne pratyeka mANasAlA sAvadha karAve, jo jivaMta Ahe ANi satya (pramANa) prasthApita vhAve.
kAya te nAhI pAhAta kI AmhI ApalyA hAtAMnI banavilelyA vastUMpaikI, tyAcyAsAThI catuSpAda (gure-Dhore) hI nirmANa kele jyAMce he mAlaka banale Aheta.
ANi tyAM (pazUM) nA AmhI tyAMcyA adhIna kele Ahe, jyAMcyApaikI kAhI tara tyAMcI vAhane Aheta ANi kAhIM (ce mAMsa) khAtAta.
ANi tyAMnA tyAMcyApAsUna itarahI aneka phAyade Aheta, ANi piNyAcyA vastU kAya tarIhI he kRtajJatA darzavita nAhI?
ANi te allAhakherIja dusar2yAMnAhI upAsya banavitAta (yA Azene) kI tyAMcI madata kelI jAvI.
(vAstavika) tyAMnA madata karaNyAce te sAmarthya bALagata nAhIta, tathApi he (anekezvaravAdI) tyAMce sainya yA nAtyAne hajara Aheta.
yAstava tyAMcyA goSTI (bolaNyA) ne duHkhI kaSTI na vhAve AmhI tyAMcyA lapalelyA va ughaDa sarvaca goSTIMnA (cAMgalyA prakAre) jANato.
kAya mANasAlA evaDhehI mAhIta nAhI kI AmhI tyAlA viryApAsUna nirmANa kele Ahe, tarIhI to ughaDa bhAMDakhora banUna basalA.
ANi tyAne AmacyAsAThI udAharaNe sAMgitalI ANi ApalyA (mULa) utpattIlA visaralA, mhaNAlA kI yA saDalyA kujalyA hADAMnA koNa (punhA) jivaMta karU zakato?
sAMgA kI tyAMnA to jivaMta karIla, jyAne tyAMnA pahilyAMdA nirmANa kele, jo sarva prakAracI utpattI cAMgalyA prakAre jANaNArA Ahe.
toca hoya, jyAne tumacyAsAThI hiravyA vRkSApAsUna Aga nirmANa kelI, jyAdvAre tumhI Aga prajvalita karatA.
jyAne AkAzAMnA ANi dharatIlA nirmANa kele Ahe, kAya to yAMcyAsArakhyAMnA nirmANa karaNyAsa samartha nAhI? nizcitaca samartha Ahe ANi toca nirmANa karaNArA, jANaNArA Ahe.
jevhA to ekhAdyA goSTIcA irAdA karato, tevhA tyAce evaDhe mhaNaNe (purese) Ahe kI ghaDUna ye, tI goSTa tatkALa ghaDUna yete.
moThA pavitra Ahe to allAha, jyAcyA hAtI pratyeka goSTIcA sattAdhikAra Ahe ANi jyAcyAkaDe tumhI sarva paratavile jAla.
zapatha Ahe paMktibaddha hoNAr2yAM (phariztyAM) cI.
maga pUrNataH daraDAviNAr2yAMcI.
maga allAhacA pATha karaNAr2yAMcI.
niHsaMzaya, tumhA sarvAMcA upAsya (mAbUda) ekaca Ahe.
AkAzAMcyA ANi dharatIcyA ANi tyAMcyA daramyAnacyA sarva vastUMcA ANi samasta pUrva dizAMcA toca svAmI Ahe.
AmhI jagAcyA (javaLa asalelyA) AkAzAlA tArakAMnI sajavile ANi suzobhita kele Ahe.
ANi (AmhI tyAce) pratyeka vidrohI saitAnApAsUna rakSaNa kele Ahe.
ucca vizvAcyA phariztyAM (cyA goSTI) aikaNyAkaritA te kAnahI lAvU zakata nAhI, kiMbahunA cohIkaDUna tyAMcyAvara mArA hota asato.
piTALUna lAvaNyAkaritA ANi tyAMcyA sAThI kAyamasvarUpI az2Aba (zikSA - yAtanA) Ahe.
paraMtu jo ghAIgardIne ekhAdI goSTI hisakAvUna paLela tara (tatkSaNI) eka dhagadhagatA nikhArA tyAcyA pAThIzI lAgato.
yA kAphira lokAMnA vicArA kI tyAMnA nirmANa karaNe jAsta kaThINa Ahe kI jyAMnA AmhI nirmANa kele Ahe? AmhI tara mAnavAMnA cikaNa mAtIpAsUna nirmANa kele Ahe.
kiMbahunA tumhI Azcarya vyakta karata AhAta ANi he loka thaTTA uDavita Aheta.
ANi jevhA tyAMnA upadeza kelA jAto tevhA te mAnata nAhIta.
ANi jevhA ekhAdA Iza-camatkAra (mojijA) pAhatAta tevhA te thaTTA uDavitAta.
ANi mhaNatAta kI hI tara pUrNapaNe ughaDa jAdU Ahe.
kAya jevhA AmhI maraNa pAvaNAra ANi mAtI va hADe hoUna jAU, maga kAya (kharokhara) AmhI jivaMta kele jAU?
ANi AmacyApUrvI hoUna gelele vADavaDIlahI?
(tumhI) uttara dyA kI hoya, ANi tumhI apamAnitahI vhAla.
tI tara kevaLa eka joradAra daTAvaNI asela kI te acAnaka pAhU lAgatIla.
ANi mhaNatIla kI, arere AmacA vinAza, hAca mobadalyAcA divasa Ahe.
hAca to phaisalyAcA (nirNayAcA) divasa, jyAlA tumhI khoTe Tharavita rAhilAta.
atyAcArIMnA ANi tyAMcyA sAthIdArAMnA ANi jyAMcI jyAMcI te (allAhakherIja) upAsanA karIta hote.
(tyA sarvAMnA) ekatra karUna, tyAMnA jahannamacA mArga dAkhavA.
ANi tyAMnA thAMbavUna ghyA (yAsAThI) kI tyAMnA Avazyaka prazna vicArale jANAra Aheta.
(yA veLI) tumhI ekamekAMcI madata karIta nAhIta, yAlA kAraNa kAya?
kiMbahunA te (sarvajaNa) Aja AjJAdhAraka banale Aheta.
ANi te ekamekAMnA saMbodhUna praznottara karU lAgatIla.
mhaNatIla kI tumhI tara AmacyAjavaLa AmacyA ujavyA bAjUne yeta asata.
te uttara detIla kI navhe, ulaTa tumhIca ImAna rAkhaNAre navhate.
ANi AmacyA tumacyAvara kAhIca jora navhatA, kiMbahunA tumhI tara (svataH) vidrohI loka hote.
AtA AmhA (sarvAM) vara AmacyA pAlanakartyAce he pharmAna lAgU jhAleca Ahe kI AmhI (zikSA-yAtanAcI) goDI cAkhaNAra Ahota.
tevhA AmhI tumhAlA pathabhraSTa kele, AmhI tara svataHdekhIla pathabhraSTateta hoto.
tevhA AjacyA divazI (sarvaca) zikSA yAtanece vATekarI Aheta.
AmhI aparAdhI lokAMzI asAca (vyavahAra) karato.
he ase (loka) Aheta kI jevhA tyAMnA sAMgitale jAte kI allAhakherIja koNIhI upAsya nAhI, tevhA he ghameMDa karIta asata.
ANi mhaNata kI kAya AmhI ApalyA daivatAMnA ekA veDyA kavIcyA bolaNyAvarUna soDUna dyAve!
(nAhI muLIca nAhI) kiMbahunA paigaMbara tara satya (saccA dIna dharma) gheUna Ale Aheta ANi sarva paigaMbarAMnA khare jANatAta.
niHsaMzaya, tumhI duHkhadAyaka zikSA-yAtanAM (cI goDI) cAkhaNAra AhAta.
ANi tumhAlA tyAcAca mobadalA dilA jAIla, je tumhI karIta hote.
tathApi allAhace sacce, prAmANika dAsa!
tyAMcyAcakaritA nirdhArita AjivikA (rojI) Ahe.
(pratyeka prakArace) meve ANi te sanmAnita AdaraNIya asatIla.
sukhAMnI bharalelyA jannatImadhye.
AsanAMvara ekamekAMcyA samora basale asatIla.
pravAhita (vAhatyA) madyAce pyAle tyAMcyA daramyAna phirata asatIla.
je svaccha sapheda ANi pyAyalA svAdiSTa asela.
nA tyAdvAre DokedukhI hoIla ANi nA te pyAyalyAne bahakatIla.
ANi tyAMcyAjavaLa najara khAlI ThevaNAr2yA ANi moThamoThe suMdara netra asaNAr2yA (hUra-par2yA) asatIla.
azA kI jaNU lapavUna ThevalelI aMDI!
(jannatace loka) ekamekAMkaDe toMDa karUna vicAratIla.
tyAMcyApaikI eka sAMgaNArA sAMgela kI mAjhA eka javaLacA (sobatI) hotA.
jo (malA) sAMgata ase kI kAya tU (kayAmatacyA yeNyAcA) vizvAsa rAkhaNAr2yAMpaikI Ahesa?
kAya jevhA AmhI melyAvara mAtI ANi hADe hoUna jAU, kAya tyA veLI AmhAlA (kRta karmAMcA) mobadalA dilA jAIla?
sAMgitale jAIla, tumhI icchitA kI DokAvUna pAhAve?
DokAvUna pAhatAca tyAlA jahannamamadhye madhyabhAgI (jaLatAnA) disela.
to mhaNela, allAhacI zapatha! tU tara mAjhAhI sarvanAza karaNyAcyA javaLa hotA.
jara mAjhyAvara mAjhyA pAlanakartyAcI kRpA nasatI tara mI dekhIla jahannamamadhye hajara kelyA jANAr2yAMpaikI asato.
kAya (he ucita Ahe kI) AmhI maraNa pAvaNAraca nAhIta?
pahilyA ekA mRtyukherIja, ANi nA AmhAlA az2Aba (zikSA - yAtanA) dilA jAIla.
maga tara (spaSTa Ahe kI) hI phAra moThI saphalatA Ahe.
azI (saphalatA) prApta karaNyAsAThI AcaraNa karaNAr2yAMnI AcaraNa kele pAhije.
kAya he Atithya adhika cAMgale Ahe kI jakkUmace jhADa?
jyAlA AmhI atyAcArI lokAMkaritA kaThINa kasoTI banavile Ahe.
niHsaMzaya, te jhADa jahannamacyA taLApAsUna nighate.
jyAce ghoMsa (gucche) saitAnAcyA DokyAMsArakhe asatAta.
jahannamavAsI yAca jhADAlA khAtIla ANi yAcyAcadvAre poTa bharatIla.
maga tyAvara ukaLate pANI pyAve lAgale.

ANi tumhI kAhI kALAparyaMta tyAMcyAkaDUna dhyAna haTavA.
ANi pAhAta rAhA, he suddhA lavakaraca pAhatIla.
pavitra Ahe tumacA pAlanakartA, jo moThA pratiSThA bALagaNArA Ahe, tyA pratyeka goSTIhUna jI (anekezvaravAdI) bolata asatAta.
ANi paigaMbarAMvara salAma Ahe.
ANi samasta prazaMsA, sarva vizvAMcyA pAlanakartyA allAhakaritA Ahe.
sAda, yA bodha upadezapUrNa kuraAnAcI zapatha.
paraMtu kAphira (inkArI loka) ghameMDa ANi virodhAta paDale Aheta.
AmhI yAcyApUrvIhI aneka janasamUhAMnA naSTa karUna TAkale, tyAMnI pratyeka prakAre AraDAoraDa kelI, paraMtu tI veLa suTakecI navhatI.
ANi kAphira lokAMnA yA goSTIbaddala Azcarya vATale kI tyAMcyApaikIca eka khabaradAra karaNArA AlA ANi mhaNU lAgale kI hA jAdUgAra ANi khoTAraDA Ahe.
kAya yAne evaDhyA sAr2yA ArAdhya daivatAMnA ekaca daivata (mAbUda) banavUna TAkale, kharokhara hI moThA vicitra goSTa Ahe!
tyAMce saradAra (pramukha) ase bolata nighUna jAU lAgale, jA, ApalyA daivatAMvara majabUta (aTaLa) rAhA. niHsaMzaya, yA goSTIta kAhItarI uddiSTa (svArtha) Ahe.
AmhI tara hI goSTa prAcIna dharmAMmadhyehI aikalI nAhI kAhI nAhI, hI kevaLa manAne racalelI goSTI Ahe.

kAya AmhI sarvAMpaikI tyAcyAvaraca (allAhacI) vahayI avatarita kelI gelI? vastutaH he loka mAjhyA vahayI (prakAzanA) bAbata saMzayagrasta Aheta, kiMbahunA (kharetara) tyAMnI mAjhyA zikSA yAtanecI goDI adyApa cAkhalIca nAhI.
kAya tyAMcyAjavaLa, tumacyA varcasvazAlI, bharapUra pradAna karaNAr2yA pAlanakartyAcyA kRpece khajIne Aheta?
kiMvA AkAza ANi dharatI ANi tyAMcyA daramyAnacyA pratyeka goSTIce rAjya tyAMceca Ahe, ase Ahe tara dor2yA tANUna (AkAzAta) caDhUna jAve.
hedekhIla (vizAla) sainyAMpaikI parAbhUta (lahAnase) sainya Ahe.
tyAMcyA pUrvIhI nUhacA janasamUha ANi AdacA janasamUha ANi khiLe (mekhAM) vAlyA phiraaunane khoTe Tharavile hote.
ANi samUda va lUta janasamUhAne ANi vanAta rAhaNAr2yAMnIhI, hIca vizAla sainye hotI.
yAMcyApaikI eka dekhIla asA navhatA, jyAne paigaMbarAMnA khoTe Tharavile nasela, tevhA mAjhA az2Aba tyAMcyAvara lAgU jhAlA.
ANi tyAMnA kevaLa ekA tIvra (bhayaMkara) citkArAcI pratIkSA Ahe, jyAta kasalAhI aDathaLA (ANi vilaMba) nAhI.
ANi (te) mhaNAle kI he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! AmacA vATA tU AmhAlA hizobAcyA divasApUrvIca pradAna kara.
tumhI tyAMcyA bolaNyAvara sahanazIlatA rAkhA ANi Amace dAsa dAUdace smaraNa karA jo moThA zaktizAlI hotA, niHsaMzaya, to (allAhakaDe) moThA rujU karaNArA hotA.
AmhI parvatAMnA tyAMcyA adhIna kele (tAbyAta dile) hote kI tyAcyAsobata sakALa saMdhyAkALa allAhacyA pavitratecA jApa (tasbIha) karAvA.
ANi (uDaNAr2yA) pakSAMnAhI ekatra hoUna sarvacyA sarva tyAcyA adhIna hote.
AmhI tyAce rAjya majabUta kele hote ANi tyAlA hikamata (buddhikauzalya) pradAna kele hote ANi goSTIcA phaisalA (sucavilA hotA.)
ANi kAya tumhAlA bhAMDaNa karaNAr2yAMcI khabara pohocalI, jevhA te bhiMta olAMDUna meharAbamadhye (upAsanecyA ThikANI) Ale.

jevhA te dAUdajavaLa pohocale, tevhA te yAMnA pAhUna ghAbarale. te mhaNAle, bhiU nakA, AmacA ApasAtIla taMTA Ahe. AmacyApaikI ekAne dusar2yAvara atyAcAra kelA Ahe, tevhA tumhI AmacyA daramyAna nyAyapUrvaka phaisalA karAvA ANi anyAya karU nakA ANi AmhAlA saraLa mArga dAkhavA.

(aikA!) hA mAjhA bhAU Ahe. yAcyAjavaLa navyANNava meMDhyA Aheta. ANi mAjhyAjavaLa ekaca Ahe. paraMtu hA malA mhaNato kI tujhI tI eka dekhIla malA deUna TAka ANi mAjhyAvara bolaNyAta moThA sakta mAmalA (vyavahAra) karato.

(dAUda) mhaNAle, tyAce ApalyA meMDhyAMsobata tujhI eka meMDhI sAmIla karUna gheNyAcA prazna nizcitaca tujhyAvara atyAcAra Ahe. ANi adhikAMza bhAgIdAra ANi sahabhAgI (aseca asatAta kI) ekamekAMvara julUma atyAcAra ANi anyAya karatAta, mAtra tyAMcyAkherIja, jyAMnI ImAna rAkhale ANi je satkarma karIta rAhile, tathApi ase loka phAraca kamI Aheta ANi dAUda (alai.) yAMnI jANuna ghetale kI AmhI tyAMcI parIkSA ghetalI Ahe, maga tara ApalyA pAlanakartyA (allAha) javaLa taubA (kSamA yAcanA) karU lAgale ANi moThyA vinamratene khAlI paDale (sajadyAta gele) ANi (pUrNapaNe) rujU jhAle.
tevhA AmhI dekhIla tyAMcI hI (cUka) mApha kelI. niHsaMzaya, te AmacyAjavaLa moThe ucca sthAna rAkhaNAre ANi sarvAMta cAMgale ThikANa bALagaNAre Aheta.

he dAUda! AmhI tumhAlA dharatIvara khalIphA banavile, tevhA tumhI lokAMcyA daramyAna nyAyAsaha phaisalA karA ANi ApalyA manAcyA icchA AkAMkSAMce anusaraNa karU nakA, anyathA tI tumhAlA allAhacyA mArgApAsUna haTavila. niHsaMzaya, je loka allAhacyA mArgApAsUna bhaTakatAta, tyAMcyAsAThI sakta az2Aba (zikSA-yAtanA) Ahe. azAsAThI kI tyAMnI hizobAcyA divasAcA visara pADalA Ahe.
ANi AmhI AkAza va dharatI ANi tyAMcyA daramyAnacyA vastUMnA (astitvAMnA) vyartha (ANi akAraNa) nirmANa nAhI kele. hI zaMkA tara kAphira (inkArI) lokAMcI Ahe, tevhA kAphirAMkaritA AgIcA vinAza Ahe.
kAya AmhI tyA lokAMnA, jyAMnI ImAna rAkhale ANi satkarme kelI tyA lokAMsamAna TharavU je (roja) dharatIvara utpAta (phasAda) mAjavita rAhile, kiMvA neka sadAcArI lokAMnA durAcAr2yAMsArakhaM banavU?
hA moThA zubhagraMtha Ahe, jo AmhI tumacyAkaDe azAsAThI avatarita kelA Ahe kI lokAMnI yAcyA AyatIMvara vicAra ciMtana karAve ANi buddhI rAkhaNAr2yAMnI yApAsUna bodha grahaNa karAvA.
ANi AmhI dAUdalA sulaimAna (nAvAcA putra) pradAna kelA. jo moThA uttama dAsa hotA ANi (allAhakaDe) khUpa rujU karaNArA hotA.
jevhA tyAMcyAsamora saMdhyAkALI vegAta cAlaNAre khAsa ghoDe sAdara kele gele.
tevhA mhaNAle, mI ApalyA pAlanakartyA (allAha) cyA smaraNAvara yA ghoDyAcyA premAlA prAdhAnya dile, yetheparyaMta kI sUrya buDAlA.
yA ghoDyAMnA punhA mAjhyAsamora ANA, maga poTar2yAMvara ANi mAnAMvara hAta phiravU lAgale.
ANi AmhI sulemAnacI kasoTI ghetalI ANi tyAMcyA siMhAsanAvara eka dhaDa (mRta zarIra) TAkUna dile, maga te dhyAnamagna jhAle.
mhaNAle kI he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA malA kSamA kara ANi malA ase rAjya pradAna kara, je mAjhyAkherIja koNatyAhI (mANasAsa) pAtra nasAve. tU phAra moThA dAtA Ahesa.
tevhA AmhI havelA tyAMcyA adhIna kele. tI tyAMcyA AdezAnaM, jikaDe te icchita, naramIne pohacavU deta ase.
ANi (zaktizAlI) jinnAMnA dekhIla, tyAMcyA adhIna (tAbe) kele hote ANi pratyeka ghara banaviNAr2yAlA ANi pANabuDyAlA.
ANi itara (jinnAMnA) dekhIla, je zRMkhalAMnI jakhaDalele rAhata.
hA Ahe AmacA anugraha, AtA tumhI upakAra karA kiMvA rokhUna ThevA, kAhI hizoba nAhI.
ANi tyAMcyAsAThI AmacyAjavaLa moThI nikaTatA Ahe, ANi phAra cAMgale ThikANa Ahaie.
ANi Amace dAsa ayyUbacIhI carcA karA, jevhA tyAne ApalyA pAlanakartyAlA pukArale kI malA saitAnAne duHkha - yAtanA pohacavilI Ahe.
ApalA pAya jaminIvara mArA. he AMghoLIce thaMDa ANi piNyAce pANI Ahe.
ANi AmhI tyAlA tyAce saMpUrNa kuTuMba pradAna kele, kiMbahunA tevaDheca ANakhIhI tyAsobata ApalyA khAsa kRpene, ANi buddhimAnAMkaritA bodhaprAptIsAThI.

ANi ApalyA hAtAta kADyAMcA gucchA gheUna tyAne mAra ANi zapatha toDU nako. khare tara ase kI AmhAlA to moThA sahanazIla dAsa ADhaLalA. to moThA neka sadAcArI dAsa hotA ANi (allAhakaDe) moThA rujU karaNArA.
ANi Amace dAsa ibrAhIma, isahAka ANi yAkUba yAMcIhI (lokAMmadhye) carcA karA je hAta ANi DoLe rAkhaNAre hote.
AmhI tyAMnA eka vizeSa goSTa arthAta AkhiratacyA smaraNAsobata khAsarityA saMbaMdhita karUna ghetale hote.
ANi he sarva AmacyAjavaLa nivaDaka ANi sarvAdhika cAMgalyA lokAMpaikI hote.
ANi ismAIla, yasaa ANi julakiphla yAMcehI varNana karA. he sarva neka loka hote.
hA upadeza Ahe ANi vizvAsa karA kI neka sadAcArI lokAMsAThI sarvAMta uttama sthAna Ahe.
arthAta sadaiva kALa rAhaNArI jannata, jyAMcI dAre tyAMcyAsAThI khulI Aheta.
jyAMcyAta te (moThyA cainIne) takke lAvUna basale asatIla. vegavegaLyA prakArace meve (phaLe) ANi aneka prakAracI peye mAgata asatIla.
ANi tyAMcyAjavaLa najara khAlI ThevaNAr2yA samavayaska hUra (par2yA) asatIla.
hIca tI goSTa jicA vAyadA tumhAlA hizobAcyA divasAkaritA dilA jAta hotA.
niHsaMzaya, hI AjivikA, AmacA (vizeSa) upahAra Ahe, jI kadhIhI saMpaNAra nAhI.
hA tara jhAlA mobadalA (lakSAta ThevA kI) vidrohI lokAMkaritA moThe vAITa sthAna Ahe.
jahannama Ahe, jyAta te dAkhala hotIla (arere!) kitI vAITa bichonA Ahe.
he Ahe, tyAMnI te cAkhAve, garama (ukaLate) pANI ANi pU.
ANi kAhI itara prakAracyA zikSA.
hA eka samudAya Ahe, jo tumacyAsobata (AgIta) jANAra Ahe. tyAMcyAsAThI kasalIhI svAgata nAhI. heca jahannamamadhye jANAra Aheta.
(te) mhaNatIla kI, kiMbahunA tumhIca te AhAta jyAMcyAsAThI kasalehI svAgata nAhI. tumhIca tara yAsa AdhIpAsUnaca AmacyAsamora ANUna Thevale hote. tevhA rAhaNyAce moThe vAITa sthAna Ahe.
(te) mhaNatIla kI he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! jyAne tI (kupracI prathA) AmacyAsAThI sarvAMta prathama surU kelI asela, tyAcyAsAThI jahannamacI zikSA duppaTa kara.
ANi (jahannamavAsI) mhaNatIla kI, he kAya! AmhAlA te loka disUna yeta nAhIta, jyAMcI gaNanA AmhI vAITa lokAMmadhye karIta hoto.
kAya AmhIca tyAMnA thaTTA-maskarI banavUna Thevale hote kI Amace DoLe tyAMcyApAsUna bahakUna gele Aheta.
niHsaMzaya, jahannamavAlyAMce he bhAMDaNa avazya hoIla.
sAMgA kI mI tara kevaLa eka khabaradAra karaNArA Ahe ANi ekameva jabaradasta allAhakherIja dusarA koNIhI upAsanesa pAtra nAhI.
jo svAmI va pAlanakartA Ahe AkAzAMcA ANi dharatIcA, ANi je kAhI tyAMcyA daramyAna Ahe, to moThA jabaradasta (mahAna) ANi moThA mApha karaNArA Ahe.
sAMgA kI hI phAra moThI khabara Ahe.
ticyApAsUna tumhI toMDa phiravita AhAta.
malA tyA ucca padastha phariztyAM (cyA saMbhASaNA) ce kiMcitahI jJAna nAhI, jevhA te bhAMDaNa karIta hote.
mAjhyAkaDe kevaLa hIca vahayI kelI jAte kI mI tara spaSTapaNe sAvadha karaNArA Ahe.
jevhA tumacyA pAlanakartyA (allAha) ne phariztyAMnA sAMgitale, mI mAtIpAsUna mAnavAlA nirmANa karaNAra Ahe.
tara jevhA mI tyAlA yathAyogya karIna ANi tyAcyAta ApalA AtmA phuMkIna, tevhA tumhI sarva tyAcyAsamora sajadA karA (mAthA TekA)
tevhA sarva phariztyAMnI sajadA kelA.
paraMtu iblisane (kelA nAhI) tyAne ghameMDa kelI ANi to inkAra karaNAr2yAMpaikI hotA.

(allAhane) pharmAvile kI he iblisa! tyAlA (AdamalA) sajadA karaNyApAsUna tulA koNatyA goSTIne rokhale, jyAlA mI ApalyA hAtAMnI banavile, kAya tU garviSTha jhAlA Ahesa kI tU ucca darjA rAkhaNAr2yAMpaikI Ahesa?
(tyAne) uttara dile kI mI yAcyApekSA adhika zreSTha Ahe, tU malA AgIpAsUna nirmANa kele ANi yAlA mAtIpAsUna nirmANa kele.
pharmAvile kI tU yethUna nighUna jA, tU tiraskRta (dhiHkkArita) jhAlA.
ANi kayAmatacyA divasAparyaMta tujhA mAjhyAtarphe dhiHkkAra Ahe.
to mhaNAlA, he mAjhyA svAmI! malA tyA divasAparyaMta savaDa pradAna kara, jevhA loka (jivaMta karUna) uThavile jAtIla.
(allAhane) pharmAvile, tU savaDa dilyA jANAr2yAMpaikI Ahesa.
nirdhArita veLecyA divasAparyaMta.
mhaNAlA, maga tara tujhyA pratiSThecI zapatha! mI yA sarvAMnA avazya bhaTakavIna.
mAtra tujhyA tyA dAsAMkherIja, je nivaDaka (ANi priya, pavitra) asatIla.
pharmAvile, satya heca Ahe ANi mI satyaca sAMgata asato.
kI mI tujhyAdvAre ANi tujhyA sarva anuyAyIMdvAre jahannamalA bharUna TAkena.
sAMgA kI mI yAbaddala tumacyAkaDUna kasalAhI mobadalA mAgata nAhI ANi ANi mI banAvaTa karaNAr2yAMpaikI nAhI.
hA tara sarva jagavAlyAMkaritA paripUrNa upadeza ANi smaraNa Ahe.
niHsaMzaya, tumhI yAcI vAstavikatA thoDyAca kALAnaMtara (ucitarityA) jANUna ghyAla.
yA graMthAlA avatarita karaNe allAhatarphe Ahe, jo moThA varcasvazAlI, ANi hikamata bALagaNArA Ahe.
niHsaMzaya, AmhI hA graMtha satyAsaha tumacyAkaDe avatarita kelA Ahe, tevhA tumhI kevaLa allAhacIca bhaktI - upAsanA karA, tyAcyAcakaritA dIna (dharmA) lA vizuddha karIta.
