aikA! allAhacyAcakaritA vizuddha (nirbheLa) upAsanA karaNe Ahe, ANi jyA lokAMnI tyAcyAkherIja avaliyA banavUna Thevale Aheta (ANi ase mhaNatAta) kI AmhI yAMcI upAsanA kevaLa evaDhyAsAThI karato kI he (bujurga, thora) AmhAlA allAhacyA nikaTa karatIla, he loka jyA goSTIbAbata matabheda karIta Aheta, ticA (nyAyasaMgata) phaisalA allAha svataH karIla, khoTyA ANi kRtaghna lokAMnA allAha mArga dAkhavita nAhI.

jara allAhane saMtatIca icchilI asatI, tara ApalyA nirmitImadhUna jyAlA icchile asate tyAcI nivaDa kelI asatI (paraMtu) to tara pavitra (vyaMga-doSavirahita) Ahe. toca allAha Ahe eka ANi zaktI - sAmarthya rAkhaNArA.

khUpa cAMgalyA paddhatIne tyAne AkAzAMcI ANi dharatIcI nirmitI kelI. to rAtrIlA divasAvara ANi divasAlA rAtrIvara guMDALato ANi tyAne sUrya va caMdrAlA kAryarata kele Ahe. pratyeka nirdhArita avadhIparyaMta cAlata Ahe. vizvAsa karA kI toca varcasvazAlI ANi aparAdhAMnA mApha karaNArA Ahe.

tyAne tumhA sarvAMnA ekAca jivApAsUna nirmANa kele, maga tyApAsUna tyAcI joDI nirmANa kelI ANi tumacyAkaritA janAvarAMpaikI ATha joDe (nara-mAdA) avatarita kele. to tumhAlA tumacyA mAtAMcyA garbhAmadhye ekA svarUpAnaMtara dusar2yA svarupAta ghaDavito, tIna tIna aMdhArAmadhye hAca allAha tumacA raba (svAmI va pAlanakartA) Ahe tyAcyAcakaritA rAjyasattA Ahe, tyAcyAkherIja koNIhI upAsya nAhI. maga tumhI koThe bhaTakata jAta AhAta?

jara tumhI kRtaghnatA karAla tara (lakSAta ThevA kI) allAha tumhA sarvAMpAsUna niHspRha Ahe ANi to ApalyA dAsAMcyA kRtaghnatene khUza nAhI ANi jara tumhI kRtajJatA vyakta karAla tara to tyAsa tumacyAsAThI pasaMta karIla ANi koNIhI koNAce ojhe ucalaNAra nAhI, maga tumhA sarvAMce parataNe tumacyA pAlanakartyAkaDeca Ahe, to tumhAlA dAkhavUna deIla, je kAhI tumhI karata hote. niHsaMzaya, to manAtalyA goSTI dekhIla jANato.

ANi mANasAlA jevhA ekhAde duHkha pohocate, tevhA to khUpa dhyAna ekavaTUna ApalyA pAlanakartyAsa pukArato. maga jevhA allahA ApalyAkaDuna tyAlA sukha pradAna karato to yAcyApUrvI jI duA - prArthanA karIta hotA, tilA pUrNapaNe visarato, ANi allAhace bhAgIdAra TharavU lAgato. jyAdvAre (itarAMnAhI) tyAcyA mArgApAsUna vicalita karAve. (tumhI) sAMgA kI ApalyA kupra (satya-virodhA) cA phAyadA ANakhI kAhI divasa ucalUna ghyA, (zevaTI) tU jahannamavAsIMpaikI hoNAra Ahesa.

kAya to manuSya, jo rAtrIcyA veLI sajadA ANi ubhe rAhaNyAcyA avastheta upAsanA karaNyAta ghAlavita asela, Akhiratace bhaya bALagata asela ANi ApalyA pAlanakartyAcyA dayA - kRpecI Asa bALagata asela, ANi to, jo yAcyA ulaTa asela, samAna asU zakatAta, bare he sAMgA kI vidvAna ANi ajJAnI doghe samAna Aheta? niHsaMzaya, bodha tara teca prApta karatAta, je buddhimAna asatIla.

sAMgA, (allAha pharmAvito) kI he mAjhyA ImAna rAkhaNAr2yA dAsAMno! ApalyA pAlanakartyAce bhaya bALagata rAhA. je yA jagAta satkarma karIta rAhatAta tyAcyAsAThI uttama mobadalA Ahe ANi allAhacI dharatI moThI vizAla (vistRta) Ahe. dhIra saMyama rAkhaNAr2yAMnAca tyAMcA purepUra agaNita mobadalA dilA jAto.
(tumhI) sAMgA kI, malA hA Adeza dilA gelA Ahe kI allAhacI azA prakAre upAsanA karAvI kI tyAcyAcakaritA upAsanelA vizuddha (nirbheLa) karUna.
ANi malA Adeza dilA gelA Ahe kI mI sarvAMta prathama AjJAdhAraka (muslima) vhAve.
sAMgA kI malA tara ApalyA pAlanakartyA (allAha) cI avajJA karatAnA moThyA divasAcyA az2Aba (zikSA - yAtane) ce bhaya vATate.
sAMgA kI mI tara agadI sacoTIne (nikhAlasapaNe) kevaLa allAhacIca upAsanA karato.

tumhI tyAcyAkherIja vATela tyAcI bhaktI - upAsanA karIta rAhA, sAMgA kI vastutaH toTyAta teca Aheta, je svataHlA ANi ApalyA kuTuMbiyAMnA kayAmatacyA divazI hAnIgrasta karatIla. lakSAta ThevA, ughaDa svarUpAcA toTA hAca Ahe.
tyAMnA varUna-khAlUna AgIcyA jvAlA chatAsArakhyA jhAkata asatIla. hAca az2Aba hoya, jyApAsUna allAha ApalyA dAsAMnA bhaya dAkhavita Ahe. he mAjhyA dAsAMno! mAjhe bhaya bALagata rAhA.

ANi je loka allAhakherIja tAgUta (itarAM) cI upAsanA karaNyApAsUna alipta rAhile ANi tana-manapUrvaka allAhakaDe AkarSita rAhile, te zubha-samAcArAce hakkadAra Aheta. tevhA mAjhyA dAsAMnA khUzakhabara aikavA.

je loka kathanAsa kAna lAvUna (lakSyapUrvaka) aikatAta, maga jI moThI cAMgalI goSTa asela, ticyAnusAra AcaraNa karatAta, heca te loka hota, jyAMnA allAhane mArgadarzana kele Ahe ANi heca loka buddhimAnahI Aheta.
bare, jyA mANasAlA az2Aba (zikSe) ce pharmAna lAgU jhAle Ahe tara kAya tumhI tyAlA, jo jahannamadhye Ahe, soDavU zakatA?

mAtra te loka, je ApalyA pAlanakartyAce bhaya bALagata rAhile, tyAMcyAsAThI ucca ghare Aheta. jyAMcyAvara dekhIla majale banale Aheta ANi tyAMcyA khAlI jalapravAha (jhare) vAhata Aheta. hA allAhacA vAyadA Ahe ANi to vacana bhaMga karIta nAhI.

kAya tumhI nAhI pAhile kI allAha AkAzAtUna pANI avatarita karato ANi tyAsa jaminIcyA jhar2yAMmadhye pohacavito, maga tyAcyAcadvAre aneka prakAracI zetI ugavito, maga tI (zete) sukatAta ANi tumhI tyAMnA pivaLyA raMgAta pAhatAta, maga tyAMcA agadI curADA karUna TAkato. yAta buddhimAnAMkaritA moThA bodha Ahe.

kAya to manuSya jyAcI chAtI (hRdaya) allAhane islAmakaritA khulI kelII Ahe, tara to ApalyA pAlanakartyAtarphe ekA nUra (prakAzA) vara Ahe, ANi sarvanAza Ahe tyA lokAMkaritA, jyAMcI hRdaye allAhacyA smaraNAne (prabhAvita hota nAhI, kiMbahunA) kaThora jhAlI Aheta. he loka pUrNataH mArgabhraSTateta paDale Aheta.

allAhane sarvAMta uttama vANI avatarita kelI Ahe, jo asA graMtha Ahe kI ApasAta miLatAjuLatA ANi vAraMvAra punarAvRttI kelelyA AyatIMcA Ahe, jyAdvAre tyA lokAMcyA zarIrAMcA tharakApa hoto, je ApalyA pAlanakartyAce bhaya rAkhatAta. zevaTI tyAMcI zarIre ANi hRdaye allAhacyA nAmaHsmaraNAkaDe (komala hoUna) jhukatAta. he Ahe allAhace mArgadarzana. jyAcyAdvAre to jyAlA icchito satya-mArgAlA lAvato, ANi jyAlA allAhaca mArgAcA visara pADIla tara tyAlA mArga dAkhaviNArA koNI nAhI.
bare, jo manuSya kayAmatacyA divasAcyA phAra adhika vAITa zikSA-yAtanAMcI DhAla ApalyA cehar2yAlA banavila (tara azA) atyAcArI lokAMnA sAMgitale jAIla kI ApalyA kRta karmAMcI goDI cAkhA.
tyAMcyApUrvI hoUna gelelyA lokAMnIhI khoTe Tharavile, maga tyAMcyAvara tethUna az2Aba yeUna kosaLalA, jethUna (yeNyAce) tyAMnA anumAnahI navhate.
ANi allAhane tyAMnA yA jagAcyA jIvanAta apamAnAcI goDI cAkhavalI ANi ajUna AkhiratacA ajAba tara moThA sakta ANi kaThora Ahe. yA lokAMnI he samajUna ghetale asate tara!
nizcitaca AmhI yA kuraAnAta lokAMkaritA pratyeka prakArace udAharaNa sAMgitale Ahe. saMbhavataH tyAMnI bodha prApta karUna ghyAvA.
arabI bhASeta kuraAna Ahe, jyAta kasalIhI vakratA nAhI, saMbhavataH tyAMnI saMyama (durAcArApAsUna aliptatA) aMgikArAvA.

allAha eka udAharaNa nivedana karIta Ahe kI eka asA manuSya, jyAta aneka ApasAta bhinnatA rAkhaNAre bhAgIdAra Aheta ANi dusarA to manuSya, jo phakta ekAcAca dAsa Ahe. kAya he doghe guNavaiziSTyAta ekasamAna Aheta? sarva prazaMsA allAhakaritA Ahe. vAstavika, tyAMcyApaikI adhikAMza loka jANata nAhIta.
niHsaMzaya, svataH tumhAlAhI mRtyu yeIla ANi he sarva dekhIla maraNa pAvaNAra Aheta.
maga tumhI sarvacyA sarva kayAmatacyA divazI ApalyA pAlanakartyAsamora taMTA-vivAda karAla.
tyAhUna jAsta atyAcArI koNa Ahe, jo allAhacyA saMbaMdhAne khoTe bolela ANi satya (dharma) tyAcyAjavaLa AlA asatA, to tyAsa khoTe asalyAce sAMgela? kAya azA kAphirAMce ThikANa jahannama navhe?
ANi je loka satya (dharma) gheUna Ale, ANi jyAMnI tyAsa satya jANale, heca loka allAhace bhaya bALagaNAre Aheta.
tyAMcyAsAThI, tyAcyA pAlanakartyAjavaLa tI pratyeka goSTa Ahe, jI te icchitIla neka sadAcArI lokAMcA hAca mobadalA Ahe.
yAsAThI kI allAhane tyAMcyApAsUna tyAMcyA duSkarmAMnA dUra karAve ANi jI satkarme tyAMnI kelI Aheta, tyAMcA uttama mobadalA tyAMnA pradAna karAvA.
kAya allAha ApalyA dAsAMkaritA paryApta nAhI? he loka tumhAlA allAhakherIja itarAMce bhaya dAkhavita Aheta, ANi jyAlA allAha mArgabhraSTa karIla, tyAlA mArga dAkhaviNArA koNIhI nAhI.
ANi jyAlA allAha mArgadarzana pradAna karIla, tyAlA koNI mArgabhraSTa karaNArA nAhI. kAya allAha varcasvazAlI ANi pratizodha gheNAra nAhI?

jara tumhI tyAMnA vicArAla kI AkAzAMnA va dharatIlA koNI nirmANa kele Ahe, tara te nizcita heca uttara detIla kI allAhane! tumhI tyAMnA sAMgA kI, bare he tara sAMgA kI jyAMnA tumhI allAhakherIja pukAratA, jara allAha malA nukasAna pohocavU icchila, tara kAya he tyAcyA nukasAnAlA haTavU zakatAta kiMvA jara allAha mAjhyAvara kRpA karU icchita asela tara kAya he tyAcyA kRpelA aDavU zakatAta? (tumhI) sAMgA kI allAha (mahAna) malA puresA Ahe. bharavasA rAkhaNAre tyAcyAvaraca bharavasA rAkhatAta.
sAMgA kI, he mAjhyA janasamudAyA (ummata) cyA lokAMno! tumhI ApalyA jAgI karma karIta rAhA, mI ApalyA jAgI karma karIta Ahe. lavakaraca tumhI (pariNAma) jANUna ghyAla.
kI koNAvara apamAnita karaNArA az2Aba avatarato ANi koNAvara niraMtara (kAyamasvarupI) apamAnita karaNArA az2Aba avatarita hoto.

niHsaMzaya, AmhI tumacyAvara satyAsaha hA graMtha lokAMsAThI avatarita kelA Ahe, tevhA jo manuSya saraLa mArgAvara yeIla tara te tyAcyA svataHcyA (phAyadyA) karitA Ahe ANi jo mArgabhraSTa hoIla tara tyAcyA mArgabhraSTatece ojhe tyAcyAca (zirA) vara Ahe. tumhI tyAMcyAbAbata jabAbadAra nAhI.

allAhaca jIvAMnA (AtmyAMnA) tyAMcyA mRtyusamayI ANi jyAMcA mRtyu AlA nAhI tyAMnA tyAMcyA nidrAvastheta kAbIja karUna gheto, maga jyAMcyA mRtyucA Adeza dilA gelA Ahe, tyAMnA to rokhUna gheto ANi itara (AtmyAMnA) ekA nirdhArita veLeparyarMta soDUna deto. vicAra ciMtana karaNAr2yAMsAThI yAta nizcitapaNe aneka nizANyA Aheta.
kAya tyA lokAMnI allAhakherIja (dusar2yAMnA) ziphArasa karaNAre nirdhArita karUna Thevale Aheta? (tumhI) sAMgA kI maga te kAhIca hakka rAkhata nasale tarI ANi kAhI akkala rAkhata nasale tarIhI?
sAMgA kI sarva ziphArasIMcA mAlaka allAhaca Ahe. sarva AkAzAMce ANi dharatIce rAjya tyAcyAcakaritA Ahe, maga tumhI sarva tyAcyAcakaDe paratavile jAla.

ANi jevhA ekameva allAhace varNana kele jAte tevhA tyA lokAMcI hRdaye tiraskAra karU lAgatAta, je Akhiratavara ImAna rAkhata nAhIta, ANi jevhA tyAcyAkherIja (itarAM) ce varNana kele jAte, tevhA tyAMcI hRdaye spaSTataH AnaMdita hotAta.

(tumhI) sAMgA kI he allAha! AkAzAMnA ANi dharatIlA nirmANa karaNAr2yA, lapalelyA va ughaDa goSTI jANaNAr2yA! tUca ApalyA dAsAMcyA daramyAna tyA goSTIMcA phaisalA karazIla, jyA goSTIMmadhye te matabheda karIta hote.

ANi atyAcArI lokAMjavaLa jara te sarva kAhI asAve je dharatIvara Ahe, ANi tyAsobata ANakhI tevaDheca asAve tarI dekhIla kaThora zikSA yAtanecyA mobadalyAta kayAmatacyA divazI he sarva kAhI deUna TAkatIla, ANi tyAMcyAsamora allAhatarphe ase jAhIra hoIla jyAce tyAMnI anumAnahI kele navhate.
ANi je kAhI (karma) tyAMnI kele hote, tyAcI duSpariNatI tyAMcyAvara ughaDa hoIla ANi jyA goSTIcI te thaTTA uDavita hote, tI tyAMnA yeUna gherIla.

mANasAlA jevhA ekhAde duHkha yAtanA pohocate tevhA to AmhAlA pukArato, maga jevhA AmhI tyAlA ApalyAtarphe ekhAde sukhapradAna karato, tevhA mhaNU lAgato kI he tara malA kevaLa ApalyA akkala huzArImuLe pradAna kele gele Ahe, kiMbahunA hI kasoTI Ahe, paraMtu tyAMcyApaikI bahuteka loka he jANata nAhIta.
yAMcyA pUrvIce loka dekhIla hIca goSTa bolale Aheta, tevhA tyAMcI kRta karme tyAMcyA kAhIca upayogI paDalI nAhIta.

maga tyAMcyA (karmAMcI) samasta duSpariNatI tyAMcyAvara yeUna kosaLalI ANi yAMcyApaikI je durAcArI Aheta, tyAMcyA kRta-karmAMcI duSpariNatIhI AtA tyAMcyAvara yeUna kosaLela. he (AmhAlA) parAsta karaNAre nAhIta.
kAya tyAMnA he nAhI mAhIta kI allAha jyAcyAsAThI icchito AjivikA vADhavito ANi jyAcyAsAThI icchito mojUna mApUna deto, ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMkaritA yAta moThamoThyA nizANyA Aheta.

(mAjhyAtarphe) sAMgA kI, he mAjhyA dAsAMno! jyAMnI ApalyA prANAMvara atyAcAra kelA Ahe, tumhI allAhacyA kRpepAsUna nirAza hoU nakA. niHsaMzaya, allAha samasta aparAdhAMnA mApha karato. vastutaH to moThA mApha karaNArA, moThA dayA karaNArA Ahe.
ANi tumhI sarva ApalyA pAlanakartyAkaDe jhukA ANi tyAce AjJApAlana karIta rAhA, yApUrvI kI tumacyAjavaLa az2Aba yeUna pohacAvA, maga tumacI madata na kelI jAvI.

ANi anusaraNa karA tyA sarvAMta uttama goSTIce, jI tumacyAkaDe tumacyA pAlanakartyAtarphe avatarita kelI gelI Ahe, yApUrvI kI tumacyAvara acAnaka allAhacI zikSA yAtanA yAvI ANi tumhAlA khabarahI na vhAvI.
(ase na vhAve kI) ekhAdyA mANasAne mhaNAve kI, arere! kheda Ahe yA goSTIvara kI mI allAhacyA bAbatIta sustI kelI, kiMbahunA mI thaTTA uDaviNAr2yAMmadhyeca rAhilo.
kiMvA mhaNAve kI jara allAhane malA mArga dAkhavilA asatA tara mI dekhIla allAhace bhaya rAkhaNAr2yAMpaikI rAhilo asato.
kiMvA zikSA yAtanAMnA pAhUna mhaNU lAgAve, kazAhI prakAre mAjhe parata jANe jhAle asate tara mI dekhIla neka sadAcArI lokAMpaikI rAhilo asato.
kA nAhI? nizcitaca tumacyAjavaLa mAjhyA AyatI pohacalyA hotyA jyAMnA tU khoTe Tharavile ANi ghameMDa (va garva) kelA ANi tU kAphira (satyavirodhaka) lokAMpaikIca hotAsa.
ANi jyA lokAMnI allAhaviSayI asatya racale Ahe, tara tumhI pAhAla kI kayAmatacyA divazI tyAMce cehare kALe jhAle asatIla. kAya ghameMDa karaNAr2yAMce ThikANa jahannamamadhye nAhI?
ANi jyA lokAMnI allAhace bhaya (takavA) bALagale, tyAMnA allAha tyAMcyA saphalatesaha vAcavila, tyAMnA ekhAde duHkha sparzahI karU zakaNAra nAhI ANi nA te kazAhI prakAre duHkhI hotIla.
allAha samasta vastUMcA nirmANakartA Ahe, ANi toca pratyeka vastUcA saMrakSaka Ahe.
AkAzAMcyA ANi dharatIcyA cAvyAMcA mAlaka toca Ahee jyA jyA lokAMnI allAhacyA AyatIMcA inkAra kelA Ahe, teca nukasAna bhogaNAre Aheta.
(tumhI) sAMgA kI he mUrkhAMno! kAya tumhI malA, allAhakherIja itarAMcI upAsanA karaNyAsa sAMgatA?

ANi niHsaMzaya, tumacyAkaDehI ANi tumacyApUrvIcyA (sarva paigaMbarAM) kaDehI vahayI kelI gelI Ahe kI jara tumhI zirka (allAhakherIja dusar2yAMcI bhaktI upAsanA) kelyAsa, nizcitaca tumace sarva karma vAyA jAIla ANi khAtrIne tumhI nukasAna ucalaNAr2yAMpaikI vhAla.
kiMbahunA tumhI allAhacIca upAsanA karA ANi kRtajJatA vyakta karaNAr2yAMpaikI vhA.

ANi tyA lokAMnI, allAhacA jasA sanmAna karAyalA pAhije hotA tasA kelA nAhI. samasta dharatI, kayAmatacyA divazI tyAcyA muThIta asela ANi saMpUrNa AkAza tyAcyA ujavyA hAtAta guMDALalele asela to moThA pavitra ANi ati ucca Ahe, tyA pratyeka vastU (va goSTI) pAsUna jilA loka tyAcA sahabhAgI TharavitAta.

ANi sUra (kayAmatacA AraMbha darzaviNArA zaMkha) phuMkalA jAIla, tevhA AkAzAMmadhye ANi dharatIta astitvAta asaNAre sarva bezuddha hoUna kosaLatIla tathApi jyAlA allAha icchila (to salAmata rAhIla), maga dusar2yAMdA sUra phuMkalA jAIla tevhA te acAnaka ubhe rAhUna pAhU lAgatIla.

ANi dharatI ApalyA pAlanakartyAcyA divya tejAne lakhkha cakAkela. karma-lekha sAdara kele jAtIla. paigaMbarAMnA ANi sAkSIMnA ANale jAIla ANi lokAMcyA daramyAna nyAyapUrvaka phaisale kele jAtIla ANi tyAMcyAvara atyAcAra kelA jANAra nAhI.
ANi jyA mANasAne je kAhI kele Ahe te tyAlA pUrNapaNe dile jAIla ANi loka je kAhI karIta Aheta te to cAMgalyA prakAre jANato.

ANi kAphirAMce jhuMDacyA jhuMDa jahannamakaDe hAkata nele jAtIla jevhA te ticyAjavaLa pohacatIla, tice daravAje tyAMcyAsAThI ughaDale jAtIla ANi tithale rakSaka tyAMnA vicAratIla kI kAya tumacyA javaLa tumacyAcamadhUna rasUla (saMdezavAhaka) Ale navhate? je tumhAlA tumacyA pAlanakartyAMcyA AyatI vAcUna aikavita hote ANi tumhAlA yA divasAcyA bheTIbAbata sAvadha karIta hote. he uttara detIla kI hoya! kA nAhI? paraMtu az2Aba (zikSA yAtane) ce pharmAna kAphirAMnA (zevaTI) lAgU jhAle.
pharmAvile jAIla, AtA jahannamacyA daravAjyAMmadhye dAkhala vhA jithe te nehamI rAhatIla, tevhA avajJAkArI lokAMce ThikANa moThe vAITa Ahe.

ANi je loka ApalyA pAlanakartyAce bhaya rAkhata hote, tyAMce samUhacyA samUha jannatakaDe pAThavile jAtIla, yetheparyarMta kI jevhA te jannatajavaLa pohocatIla ANi daravAje ughaDale jAtIla, ANi tithale rakSaka tyAMnA mhaNatIla kI tumacyAvara salAma aso, tumhI khUza rAhA. tara tumhI yAMcyAta sadaivakALAkaritA yA.

ANi he mhaNatIla kI, AbhArI Ahota allAhace, jyAne ApalA vAyadA pUrNa kelA, ANi AmhAlA yA dharatIcA vArasa banavile kI jannatamadhye vATela tithe rAhAve. tevhA satkarma karaNAr2yAMcA kitI cAMgalA mobadalA Ahe!

ANi tumhI phariztyAMnA allAhacyA arza (siMhAsanA) bhovatI gherA banavita, ApalyA pAlanakartyAcI prazaMsA ANi pAvitryAce guNagAna karatAnA pAhAla, ANi tyAMcyA daramyAna nyAyapUrNa phaisalA kelA jAIla, ANi sAMgitale jAIla kI samasta prazaMsA allAhakaritAca Ahe, jo samasta vizvAcA svAmI va pAlanakartA Ahe.
hA. mIma
yA graMthAce avatarita karaNe, tyA allAhatarphe Ahe jo varcasvazAlI ANi jJAna bALagaNArA Ahe.

aparAdhAMnA mApha karaNArA ANi taubA (kSamA -yAtanA) kabUla karaNArA, kaThora zikSA - yAtanA deNArA, upakAra (kRpA) ANi sAmarthya bALagaNArA, jyAcyAkherIja koNI upAsya nAhI, tyAcyAcakaDe paratAvayAce Ahe.
allAhacyA AyatIMmadhye teca loka vAda ghAlatAta, je kAphira Aheta tevhA tyA lokAMce zaharAMmadhye hiMDaNe phiraNe tumhAlA dhokyAta na TAkAve.

tyAMcyApUrvI nUhacyA janasamUhAne ANi tyAMcyA naMtaracyA itara janasamUhAMnI dekhIla khoTe Tharavile hote ANi pratyeka janasamudAyAne ApalyA paigaMbarAlA baMdista banaviNyAcA irAdA kelA ANi asatyAdvaAre haTavAdIpaNA kelA, yAsAThI kI tyAdvAre satyAlA naSTa karUna TAkAve, tevhA mI tyAMnA pakaDIta ghetale, tara baghA kazI hotI mAjhI zikSA!
ANi yA prakAre tumacyA pAlanakartyAce pharmAna lokAMvarahI lAgU jhAle. jyAMnI kupra (inkAra) kelA kI te jahannamI Aheta.

arza (allAhacyA siMhAsanA) lA ucalUna dharaNAre ANi tyAcyAbhovatI asaNAre pharizte ApalyA pAlanakartyAcyA pavitratece guNagAna, prazaMsesaha karatAta ANi tyAcyAvara ImAna rAkhatAta ANi ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMsAThI kSamA - yAcanecI prArthanA karatAta, (mhaNatAta) kI he AmacyA svAmI va pAlanakartyA! tU pratyeka goSTIlA ApalyA dayA ANi jJAnAne gherUna Thevale Ahe, tevhA tU tyAMnA mApha kara, je mAphI mAgatIla ANi tujhyA mArgAce anusaraNa karatIla, ANi tU tyAMnA jahannamacyA zikSA - yAtanepAsUnahI surakSita Theva.

he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! tU tyAMnA sadaivakALa rAhaNAr2yA jannatIMmadhye madhye dAkhala kara, jyAMcA tU tyAMnA vAyadA dilA Ahesa, ANi tyAMcyA vADavaDIla ANi patnyA ANi saMtatIpaikI (hI) tyA sarvAMnA je neka sadAcArI Aheta. niHsaMzaya, tU jabaradasta va hikamatazAlI Ahe.
ANi tyAMnA kukarmAMpAsUnahI surakSita Theva (kharI goSTa azI kI) tyA divazI jyAlA tU duSkarmApAsUna vAcavUna ghetale, tyAcyAvara tU nizcitaca dayA - kRpA kelIsa ANi sarvAMta moThI saphalatA hIca Ahe.

niHsaMzaya, jyA lokAMnI kupra (inkAra) kelA, tyAMnA moThyA AvAjAne sAMgitale jAIla kI nizcitaca allAhace tumacyAvara nArAja hoNe tyAhUna phAra jAsta Ahe, je tumhI nArAja hota hote ApalyA manAne, jevhA tumhAlA ImAnAkaDe bolavile jAta hote, maga tumhI kupra (inkAra) karU lAgata asata.
(te) mhaNatIla, he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! tU AmhAlA dusar2yAMdA mRtyu dilA ANi dusar2yAMdAca jivaMta kele, AtA AmhI Apale aparAdha kabUla karato. tara kAya AtA ekhAdA mArga bAhera paDaNyAcAhI Ahe?

hI zikSA tumhAlA evaDhyAsAThI Ahe kI jevhA kevaLa ekameva allAhakaDe bolAvile jAta ase, tevhA tumhI inkAra karIta ANi jara tyAcyAsobata dusar2yA koNAlA sahabhAgI karUna ghetale jAta ase, tevhA tumhI mAnya karUna gheta, tevhA AtA phaisalA, sarvocca ANi sarvazreSTha allAhacAca Ahe.
toca hoya jo tumhAlA ApalyA nizANyA dAkhavito, ANi tumacyAsAThI AkAzAtUna rojI (AjivikA) avatarita karato. bodha kevaLa teca grahaNa karatAta, je (allAhakaDe) jhukatAta.
tumhI allAhalA pukArata rAhA, tyAcyAsAThI dIna (dharmA) lA nikhAlasa karUna, maga te kAphirAMnA kitIhI apriya vATo!
ati ucca darjA bALagaNArA arza (IzasiMhAsanA) cA svAmI. to ApalyA dAsAMpaikI jyAcyAvara icchito, vahayI (prakAzanA) avatarita karato, yAsAThI kI tyAne bheTIcyA divazApAsUna khabaradAra karAve.
jyA divazI sarva loka jAhIra hotIla, tyAMcI koNatIhI goSTa allAhapAsUna lapUna rAhaNAra nAhI. Aja koNAce rAjya Ahe? kevaLa ekamevaANi jabaradasta azA allAhace!
Aja pratyeka jIvAlA tyAcyA kRta-karmAcA mobadalA dilA jAIla, Aja (kazAhI prakAracA) atyAcAra nAhI. niHsaMzaya, allAha lavakaraca hizoba gheNAra Ahe.

ANi tyAMnA phAra javaLa yeNAr2yA (kayAmata) viSayI sAvadha karA, jevhA hRdaye gaLyAparyarMta pohacatIla ANi sarva zAMta rAhatIla, atyAcArIMcA nA koNI mitra asela ANi nA ziphArasa karaNArA kI jyAce mhaNaNe mAnya kele jAve.
to DoLyAMcyA beImAnIlA ANi chAtI (hRdayA) cyA lapalelyA goSTIMnA (cAMgalyA prakAre) jANato.

ANi sarvazreSTha allAha agadI ucita phaisalA karela, ANi tyAcyAkherIja jyAMnA jyAMnA he loka pukAratAta te koNatyAhI goSTIcA phaisalA karU zakata nAhI. niHsaMzaya, allAha cAMgalyA prakAre aikaNArA ANi cAMgalyA prakAre pAhaNArA Ahe.

kAya he loka jaminIvara hiMDale phirale nAhIta kI tyAMnI pAhile asate kI je loka yAMcyApUrvI hoUna gele tyAMcA pariNAma (aMta) kasA jhAlA. te zaktI ANi sAmarthya ANi dharatIvara ApalI smarake soDUna jANyAcyA AdhArAvara yAMcyA tulaneta khUpa jAsta hote, tarIhI allAhane tyAMnA tyAMcyA aparAdhAMpAyI dharale ANi asA koNI hoUna gelA nAhI jyAne tyAMnA allAhacyA zikSA - yAtanAMpAsUna vAcavUna ghetale asate.

he yA kAraNAstava kI tyAMcyAjavaLa tyAMce paigaMbara camatkAra (mojije) gheUna yeta hote, tevhA te inkAra karIta asata, maga allAha tyAMnA pakaDIta gheta ase. niHsaMzaya, to moThA zaktizAlI ANi sakta zikSA - yAtanA deNArA Ahe.
ANi AmhI mUsA (alai.) lA ApalyA AyatI (nizANyA) ANi spaSTa pramANAMsaha pAThavile.
phiraauna ANi hAmAna ANi kArUnakaDe, tevhA te mhaNAle kI (hA tara) jAdUgAra ANi khoTAraDA Ahe.

tara jevhA tyAMcyAjavaLa mUsA (alai.) AmacyAtarphe satya (dharma) gheUna Ale, tevhA te mhaNAle kI yAcyAsobata je ImAna rAkhaNAre Aheta, tyAMcyA putrAMnA ThAra mArUna TAkA ANi kanyAMnA jivaMta ThevA, ANi kAphirAMce je nimitta Ahe te mArgabhraSTatevaraca Ahe.

ANi phiraauna mhaNAlA kI malA soDA kI mI mUsAlA mArUna TAkAve ANi tyAne ApalyA pAlanakartyAlA pukArAve. malA tara hI bhItI vATate kI yAne kadAcita tumacA dIna (dharma) badalUna na TAkAvA kiMvA dezAta ekhAdA phAra moThA utpAta (phasAda) nirmANa na karAvA.
ANi mUsA (alai.) mhaNAle kI mI ApalyA va tumacyA pAlanakartyAcyA zaraNAta yeto, tyA pratyeka gharmeDI mANasAcyA (upadravA) pAsUna jo (karmAMcyA) hizobAcyA divasAvara ImAna rAkhata nAhI.

ANi ekA ImAna rAkhaNAr2yA mANasAne jo phiraaunacyA kuTuMbiyAMpaikI hotA, ANi Apale ImAna lapavUna hotA, mhaNAlA kI kAya tumhI ekA mANasAlA kevaLa yA goSTIbaddala ThAra karU icchitA kI to mhaNato kI mAjhA svAmI va pAlanakartA allAha Ahe ANi tumacyA pAlanakartyAtarphe spaSTa pramANa gheUna Alo Ahe, jara to khoTA Ahe, tara tyAcyA khoTepaNAce saMkaTa tyAcyAvaraca Ahe ANi jara to saccA Ahe tara to jyA (zikSA - yAtanAM) cA vAyadA tumhAlA deta Ahe, tyApaikI eka nA eka tumacyAvara (nakkIca) yeUna kosaLela. allAha, azA lokAMnA mArga dAkhavita nAhI je maryAdA olAMDaNAre ANi khoTAraDe asAveta.

he mAjhyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMno! Aja tara rAjya tumace Ahe kI tumhI yA dharatIvara varcasvazAlI AhAta, paraMtu jara allAhacA az2Aba (prakopa) AmacyAvara jhAlA tara koNa AmacI madata karela? phiraauna mhaNAlA kI mI tara tumhAlA toca sallA deta Ahe, je svataH pAhata Ahe ANi mI tara tumhAlA bhalAIcAca mArga dAkhavita Ahe.
ANi to ImAna rAkhaNArA mhaNAlA kI he mAjhyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMno! malA tara he bhaya jANavate kI kadAcita tumacyAvarahI tasAca divasa (az2Aba) na yAvA, jasA dusar2yA janasamUhAMvara AlA.
jazI nUhacyA janasamUhAcI ANi Ada va samUda ANi tyAMcyAnaMtaracyA samudAyAMcI (avasthA jhAlI) ANi allAha ApalyA dAsAMvara koNatyAhI prakAracA atyAcAra karU icchita nAhI.
ANi he mAjhyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMno! malA tara tumacyAviSayI pukAralyA jANyAcyA divasAcehI bhaya Ahe.
jyA divazI pATha phiravUna paratAla. tumhAlA allAhapAsUna vAcaviNArA koNIhI nasela ANi jyAlA allAha mArgabhraSTa karIla, tyAlA mArga dAkhaviNArA koNIhI nAhI.

ANi tyApUrvI tumacyAjavaLa yUsupha nizANyA gheUna Ale. tarIhI tumhI tyAMnI ANalelyA nizANyAMbAbata zaMkA saMzaya karItaca rAhile, yethaparyaMta kI jevhA tyAMcA mRtyu jhAlA, tevhA tumhI mhaNU lAgale kI tyAMcyAnaMtara tara allAha ekhAdA paigaMbara pAThaviNAraca nAhI. azA prakAre allAha tyA pratyeka mANasAlA pathabhraSTa karato, jo maryAdece ullaMghana karaNArA ANi zaMkA - saMzaya karaNArA asAvA.

je kasalyAhI purAvyAvinA, jo tyAMcyAjavaLa AlA asela, allAhacyA AyatIMbAbata vAda ghAlatAta, hI goSTI allAha ANi ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMcyA najIka phAra nArAjIcI goSTI Ahe, azA prakAre allAha, pratyeka ghameMDI, avajJAkArI mANasAcyA hRdayAvara mohara lAvato.
ANi phiraauna mhaNAle, he hAmAna! mAjhyAsAThI eka uMca mahAla banava, kadAcita mI tyA daravAjyAMparyarMta pohocAve.

je AkAzAce daravAje Aheta ANi mUsAcyA upAsyA (IzvarA) lA DokAvUna pAhAve ANi mAjhI tara pUrNa khAtrI Ahe kI to khoTAraDA Ahe ANi azA prakAre phiraaunacI vAITa kRtye tyAcyA najareta bhalI cAMgalI dAkhavilI gelIta ANi tyAlA sanmArgApAsUna rokhale gele ANi phiraunace (pratyeka) kaTa-kArasthAna vinAzAtaca rAhile.
ANi to ImAna rAkhaNArA manuSya mhaNAlA kI he mAjhyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMno! tumhI (sarva) mAjhe anusaraNa karA mI nekIcyA mArgAkaDe tumace mArgadarzana karena.
he mAjhyA samudAyAcyA lokAMno! yA jagAce he jIvana nAza pAvaNArI sAmugrI Ahe. (vizvAsa karA kI zAMtI) ANi kAyamasvarUpI ghara tara Akhirataca Ahe.

jyAne aparAdha (duSkarma kelA Ahe, tyAlA tara tevaDhAca mobadalA miLela ANi jyAne nekI (satkarma) kele Ahe, maga to puruSa aso kiMvA strI ANi to ImAna rAkhaNArAhI asela tara ase loka jannatamadhye dAkhala hotIla ANi tithe agaNita rojI (AjivikA) prApta karatIla.
ANi he mAjhyA jamAtIcyA lokAMno! he kAya kI mI tumhAlA muktIkaDe bolAvita Ahe ANi tumhI, malA jahannamakaDe bolAvita AhAta.

tumhI malA yA goSTIce AmaMtraNa deta AhAta kI mI allAhacA inkAra karAvA ANi (dusar2yAlA) tyAcA sahabhAgI karAve, jyAce malA kasalehI jJAna nAhI, ANi mI tumhAlA varcasvazAlI, mApha karaNAr2yA (allAha) kaDe bolAvita Ahe.

he agadI nizcita kI tumhI malA jyAcyAkaDe bolAvita AhAta, to nA tara yA jagAta pukAraNyAyogya Ahe ANi nA Akhiratamadhye ANi he dekhIla agadI nizcita kI AmhA sarvAMce parataNe allAhacyAkaDe Ahe ANi maryAdece ullaMghana karaNAre nizcitaca jahannamI Aheta.
tevhA bhaviSyAta tumhI mAjhyA goSTIMcI (bolaNyAcI) AThavaNa karAla, mI ApalA mAmalA allAhacyA havAlI karato, niHsaMzaya, allAha ApalyA dAsAMnA pAhaNArA Ahe.
tevhA allAhane tyAlA tyA sarva vAITa goSTIpAsUna surakSita Thevale jyA, tyA lokAMnI yojilyA hotyA ANi phiraaunacyA anuyAyIMvara moThyA vAITa prakAracA az2Aba kosaLalA.
Aga Ahe jicyAsamora he pratyeka sakALa ANi saMdhyAkALa ANale jAtAta, ANi jyA divazI kayAmata prasthApita hoIla (Adeza dilA jAIla kI) phiraaunacyA anuyAyIMnA atizaya kaThora zikSA - yAtaneta TAkA.

ANi jevhA te jahannamamadhye ekamekAMzI bhAMDatIla, tevhA kamajora loka, moThyA lokAMnA (jyAMcyA tAbyAta he hote) mhaNatIla kI, AmhI tara tumace anuyAyI hoto, tara kAya AtA tumhI AmacyApAsUna yA AgIcA ekhAdA hissA haTavU zakatA?
te moThe loka uttara detIla kI AmhI tara sarva yAca AgIta Ahota. allAhane ApalyA dAsAMcyA daramyAna phaisalA kelelA Ahe.
ANi sarva jahannamI loka (ekatra hoUna) jahannamacyA rakSakAMnA sAMgatIla kI tumhIca ApalyA pAlanakartyAsa duA (prArthanA) karA kI tyAne koNA ekA divazI AmacyA zikSeta kamI karAvI.

te uttara detIla kI kAya tumacyAjavaLa tumace paigaMbara camatkAra (mojije) gheUna Ale navhate. te mhaNatIla, kA nAhI? tyAvara te mhaNatIla, maga tumhIca duA - prArthanA karA ANi kAphira lokAMcI duA (prArthanA) agadI (niSprabha ANi) vyartha Ahe!
niHsaMzaya, AmhI ApalyA paigaMbarAMcI ANi ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMcI yA jagAcyA jIvanAtahI madata karU ANi tyA divazIhI, jevhA sAkSa deNAre ubhe rAhatIla.
jyA divazI atyAcArI lokAMcI lAcArI kAhIca phAyadA deNAra nAhI ANi tyAMcyAsAThI dhiHkkAra asela ANi tyAMcyAsAThI vAITa ghara asela.
ANi AmhI mUsAlA mArgadarzana pradAna kele ANi isrAIlacyA saMtatIlA yA graMthAcA uttarAdhikArI banavile.
kI buddhimAnAMkaritA to, mArgadarzana ANi bodha hotA.

tevhA (he paigaMbara!) tumhI dhIra - saMyama rAkhA, allAhacA vAyadA agadI saccA Ahe, tumhI ApalyA aparAdhAMcI kSamA mAgata rAhA ANi sakALa saMdhyAkALa ApalyA pAlanakartyAcyA pAvitryAce guNagAna va stutI - prazaMsA karIta rAhA.

niHsaMzaya, je loka ApalyAjavaLa koNatehI pramANa nasatAnAhI allAhacyA AyatIMbAbata vAda ghAlatAta, tyAMcyA manAta ahaMkArAzivAya dusare kAhI nAhI, je yA moThepaNAparyaMta pohacavaNAra nAhIta tevhA tumhI allAhace zaraNa mAgata rAhA. niHsaMzaya, to pUrNapaNe aikaNArA ANi sarvAdhika pAhaNArA Ahe.
AkAzAMcI ANi dharatIcI nirmitI nizcitaca mAnavAMcyA nirmitIpekSA phAra moThe kAma Ahe, paraMtu (hI goSTa vegaLI kI) bahuteka loka he jANata nAhIta.
ANi AMdhaLA va DoLasa doghe samAna nAhI, nA te loka, jyAMnI ImAna rAkhale ANi satkarma karIta rAhile, duSkarma karaNAr2yAMcyA (samAna Aheta) tumhI (phAraca) kamI bodha grahaNa karIta AhAta.
kayAmata khAtrIne ANi niHsaMzaya yeNAra Ahe, tathApi (hI goSTa vegaLI kI) adhikAMza loka ImAna rAkhata nAhIta.

ANi tumacyA pAlanakartyAcA Adeza (lAgU jhAlelA Ahe) kI malA duA (prArthanA) karA, mI tumacyA duA (prArthanA) nA kabUla karena, niHsaMzaya je loka mAjhyA upAsanezI ghameMDa karatAta, te lavakaraca apamAnita hoUna jahannamamadhye dAkhala hotIla.

allAhane tumacyAsAThI rAtra banavilI Ahe kI tumhI ticyAta ArAma karU zakAve ANi divasAlA, dAkhaviNArA banavile. niHsaMzaya allAha lokAMvara upakAra (kRpA) ANi dayA karaNArA Ahe, paraMtu adhikAMza loka kRtajJatA vyakta karIta nAhI.
hAca allAha Ahe tumhA sarvAMcA pAlanapoSaNa karaNArA. pratyeka vastUMcA racayitA, tyAcyAkherIja koNIhI saccA upAsya (mAbUda) nAhI, maga tumhI koNatyA bAjUlA bhaTakavile jAta AhAta?
tyAca prakAre te loka dekhIla bahakAvile jAta rAhile, je allAhacyA AyatIMcA inkAra karIta hote.

to allAha hoya, jyAne tumacyAsAThI jaminIlA rAhaNyAce ThikANa ANi AkAzAlA chata banavile ANi tumhAlA rUpa dile ANi khUpa cAMgale banavile ANi tumhAlA khUpa cAMgalyA cAMgalyA vastU khANyAsAThI dilyAta. toca allAha tumacA pAlanakartA Ahe. tevhA moThA zubha Ahe allAha, jo samasta vizvAMcA svAmI va pAlanakartA Ahe.
to jivaMta Ahe, tyAcyAkherIja koNIhI upAsya nAhI, tevhA tumhI vizuddha manAne tyAcIca upAsanA karIta tyAlA pukArA, sarva prazaMsA allAha karItAca Ahe, jo samasta vizvAMcA svAmI va pAlanakartA Ahe.

(tumhI) sAMgA kI malA tyAMcI upAsanA karaNyApAsUna rokhale gele Ahe, jyAMnA tumhI allAhakherIja pukArata AhAta1 yA kAraNAstava kI mAjhyAjavaLa mAjhyA pAlanakartyAce spaSTa purAve yeUna pohocale Aheta. malA hA Adeza dilA gelA Ahe kI mI samasta vizvAMcyA pAlanakartyAcyA hukumAadhIna vhAve.

toca hoya, jyAne tumhAlA mAtIpAsUna, maga vIryApAsUna, maga raktAcyA (jamalelyA) goLyApAsUna nirmANa kele, maga tumhAlA arbhakAcyA svarUpAta bAhera kADhale, maga to tumhAlA vADhIsa lAvato kI tumhI ApalyA pUrNa zaktI - sAmarthyAsa pohocAve, maga mhAtAre vhAve ANi tumacyApaikI kAhIMcA yAcyA AdhIca mRtyu hoto (ANi to tumhAlA soDUna deto yAsAThI kI tumhI nirdhArita AyuparyarMta pohocAve ANi yAsAThI kI tumhI vicAra - ciMtana karAve.
toca hoya, jo jIvana ANi mRtyu deto, maga jevhA to ekhAde kArya karaNyAcA nirNaya gheto tevhA tyAsa phakta evaDheca mhaNato ‘ghaDUna ye’ ANi te ghaDUna yete.
kAya tumhI tyAMnA nAhI pAhile, je allAhacyA AyatIMsadarbhAta vAda ghAlatAta. tyAMnA koThe paratavile jAta Ahe?
jyA lokAMnI graMthAlA khoTe Tharavile ANi tyAlAhI jo AmhI ApalyA paigaMbarAMsobata pAThavilA, tyAMnA phAra lavakara vastusthitIce jJAna hoIla.
jevhA tyAMcyA gaLyAMmadhye jokhaDa (tauka) asatIla ANi zaMkhalA asatIla, pharaphaTata oDhUna nele jAtIla.
ukaLatyA pANyAta ANi maga jahannamacyA AgIta jALale jAtIla.
maga tyAMnA vicArale jAIla kI jyAMnA tumhI (allAhace) sahabhAgI Tharavita hote, te Aheta koThe?
je allAhakherIja hote, te mhaNatIla kI te AmacyAkaDUna haravaleta kiMbahunA AmhI tara yApUrvI koNAlAhI pukArata navhato. allAha kAphira (inkArI) lokAMnA azAca prakAre mArgabhraSTa karato.
he azAsAThI kI tumhI jaminIvara nAhaka torA miravita hote, ANi (vyartha) Daula dAkhavita phirata hote.
(AtA yA) jahannamadhye nehamI nehamI rAhaNyAkaritA (tyAcyA) daravAjyAMmadhye dAkhala vhA, kevaDhe vAITa ThikANa Ahe ahaMkAra karaNAr2yAMkaritA.

tevhA tumhI dhIra - saMyama rAkhA, allAhacA vAyadA pUrNataH saccA Ahe. AmhI tyAMnA jo vAyadA deUna ThevalA Ahe, tyApaikI kAhI AmhI tumhAlA dAkhavUna dyAve kiMvA tyA AdhI tumhAlA mRtyu dyAvA, tyAMce paratavile jANe tara AmacyAcakaDe Ahe.

niHsaMzaya, AmhI tumacyA pUrvIhI aneka rasUla (paigaMbara) pAThavile Aheta, jyAMcyApaikI kAhIMce vRttAMta AmhI tumhAlA aikavile Aheta. ANi tyAMcyApaikI kAhIMce vRttAMta AmhI tumhAlA aikavile nAhIta ANi koNA paigaMbarAcyA (avAkyAta he) navhate kI ekhAdA camatkAra (mojijA) allAhacyA anumatIvinA ANU zakalA asatA, maga jyA veLI allAhacA Adeza yeIla, satyAsaha phaisalA kelA jAIla ANi tyA veLI asatyAce pujArI nukasAnAtaca rAhatIla.
allAha to Ahe jyAne tumacyAsAThI catuSpAda janAvare (gure) nirmANa kelIta, jyAMcyApaikI kAhIMvara tumhI svAra hotA ANi kAhIMnA tumhI khAtAta.

ANi itarahI tumacyAsAThI tyAMcyAta aneka phAyade Aheta, yAsAThI kI ApalyA manAta lapalelyA garajAMnA, tyAMcyAvara svAra hoUna tumhI pUrNa karUna ghyAve ANi jyA janAvarAMvara ANi naukAMvara tumhI svAra kele jAtA.
ANi allAha tumhAlA ApalyA nizANyA dAkhavita Ahe, tevhA tumhI allAhacyA koNakoNatyA nizANyAMcA inkAra karIta rAhAla?

kiMvA tyAMnI dharatIvara hiMDUna phirUna ApalyA pUrvI hoUna gelelyA lokAMcI pariNati nAhI pAhilI, je saMkhyeta yAMcyApekSA jAsta hote, zaktI - sAmarthyAta sakta ANi dharatIta tyAMnI aneka avazeSa mAge soDale hote. (paraMtu) tyAMcyA kelelyA kAryAMnI tyAMnA kiMcitahI lAbha pohacavilA nAhI.

tara jevhA jevhA tyAMcyAjavaLa tyAMce rasUla (paigaMbara) spaSTa nizANyA gheUna Ale, tevhA he ApalyAjavaLa asalelyA jJAnAvara ghameMDa dAkhavU lAgale. zevaTI jyA goSTIcI thaTTA uDavita hote, tIca tyAMcyAvara ulaTalI.
maga AmacI zikSA-yAtanA pAhatAca mhaNU lAgale kI ekameva allAhavara AmhI ImAna rAkhale ANi jyAMnA jyAMnA AmhI tyAcA sahabhAgI Tharavita hoto, AmhI tyA sarvAMcA inkAra kelA.

paraMtu AmacyA zikSA - yAtanelA pAhUna ghetalyAnaMtara tyAMcyA ImAna rAkhaNyAne tyAMnA lAbha dilA nAhI, allAhane ApalA hAca niyama nirdhArita kelelA Ahe, jo tyAcyA dAsAMmadhye satata cAlata AlA Ahe ANi tyA ThikANI kAphira durdazAgrasta (ANi durbala) jhAle.
hA. mIma.
(hA graMtha) moThyA kRpAvAna, moThyA dayAvAnatarphe avatarita jhAlA Ahe.
(asA) graMtha Ahe, jyAcyA AyatIM (sUtrAM) cA spaSTa tapazIla dilA gelA Ahe (azA sthitIta kI) kuraAna arabI bhASeta Ahe, tyA lokAMsAThI je jANatAta.
zubha samAcAra aikaviNArA ANi bhaya dAkhaviNArA Ahe. tarIhI tyAMcyApaikI adhikAMza lokAMnI toMDa phiravile ANi te aikatahI nAhIta.

ANi te mhaNAle, tumhI jyA goSTIkaDe AmhAlA bolAvita AhAta, tyApAsUna AmacI hRdaye paDadyAta Aheta. AmacyA kAnAta badhIratA Ahe (kiMvA kAhI aikAyalA yeta nAhI) ANi AmacyA va tumacyA daramyAna eka ADa-paDadA Ahe. tevhA tumhI Apale kAma karata jA, AmhIhI nizcita Apale kAma karIta rAhU.

(tumhI) sAMgA kI mI tara tumacyAsArakhAca eka manuSya Ahe. mAjhyAvara vahayI (prakAzanA) kelI jAta Ahe kI tumhA sarvAMcA mAbUda (upAsya) kevaLa eka allAhaca Ahe, tevhA tumhI tyAcyAkaDe dhyAna keMdrita karA ANi tyAcyAkaDe aparAdhAMcI kSamA mAgA ANi tyA aneka IzvarAMcyA upAsakAMkaritA sarvanAza Ahe.
je jakAta deta nAhIta ANi AkhiratacAhI inkAra karatAta.
niHsaMzaya, jyA lokAMnI ImAna rAkhale ANi satkarma karIta rAhile tyAMcyAkaritA asIma va amaryAda mobadalA Ahe.
(tumhI sAMgA kI, kAya tumhI tyA (allAha) cA inkAra karatA, ANi tyAce sahabhAgI TharavitA, jyAne dona divasAMta jaminIlA nirmANa kele. sarva vizvAMcA svAmI va pAlanakartA toca Ahe.

ANi tyAne jaminIta ticyAvarUnaca parvata rovale ANi ticyAta samRddhI rAkhalI ANi ticyAta rAhaNAr2yAMcyA AhArA (anna sAmugrI) cehI anumAna ticyAtaca kele, kevaLa cAra divasAMtaca. vicAraNA (kiMvA yAcanA) karaNAr2yAMkaritA samAnarityA.
maga AkAzAkaDe ucAvalA je dhUrAsArakhe hote, tevhA tyAlA ANi jaminIlA Adeza dilA kI tumhI doghe yA icchene kiMvA anicchene doghAMnA nivedana kele kI AmhI rAjIkhuzIne hajara Ahota.

tevhA dona divasAMta sAta AkAza banavileta. pratyeka AkAzAta tyAcyA yogya AdezAMcI vahayI pAThavilI ANi AmhI yA jagAcyA AkAzAlA tAr2yAMnI suzobhita kele va tyAce rakSaNa kele. hI yojanA prabhutvazAlI va sarvajJa azA allAhacI Ahe.

ANi tarIhI jara he toMDa phiravita asatIla tara sAMgA kI mI tumhAlA tyA vIjecyA kaDADaNyA (AkAziya az2Aba) ce bhaya dAkhavito, jo Ada janasamUha ANi samUda janasamUhAvara kosaLalelyA, vIjecyA kaDADaNyAsamAna asela.

tyAcyAjavaLa jevhA tyAMcyA puDhUna-mAgUna paigaMbara Ale kI tumhI allAhakherIja koNAcIhI upAsanA karU nakA, tevhA tyAMnI uttara dile kI jara AmacyA pAlanakartyAne icchile asate, tyAne phariztyAMnA pAThavile asate. AmhI tara tumacyA preSitvAcA pUrNataH inkAra karato.

tara jevhA Adane akAraNa dharatIvara ghameMDa karAyalA suruvAta kelI ANi mhaNU lAgale kI AmacyAhUna zaktizAlI koNa Ahe, kAya tyAMnA he disUna yeta nAhI kI jyAne tyAMnA nirmANa kele Ahe, to tyAMcyApekSA adhika zaktizAlI Ahe. te (zevaTaparyarMta) AmacyA AyatIMcA inkAraca karIta rAhile.

tevhA zevaTI AmhI tyAMcyAvara eka sosATyAce vAdaLa azubha divasAta pAThavile, yAsAThI kI tyAMnA aihika jIvanAta apamAnadAyaka zikSA - yAtanecI goDI cAkhavAvI, (vizvAsa karA) kI AkhiratacA az2Aba, yApekSA jAsta apamAnita karaNArA Ahe ANi tyAMnA madatahI kelI jANAra nAhI.

ANi rAhileta samUda, tara AmhI tyAMnAhI mArgadarzana kele, paraMtu tyAMnI mArgadarzanAcyA tulaneta AMdhaLepaNAsa jAsta mahatva dile. jyAmuLe tyAMnA (pUrNapaNe) apamAnadAyaka zikSecyA kaDADaNyAne tyAMcyA karatUtIMpAyI dharale.
ANi ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMnA va allAhace bhaya bALagaNAr2yAMnA AmhI (pUrNataH) vAcavile.
ANi jyA divazI allAhace vairI jahannamakaDe ANale jAtIla, ANi tyA (sarvAM) nA ekatrita kele jAIla.
yetheparyaMta kI jevhA jahannamacyA agadI javaLa yeUna pohacatIla tevhA tyAMcyAvara tyAMce kAna ANi tyAMce DoLe va tyAMcyA tvacA tyAMcyA karmAMcI sAkSa detIla.

ANi ApalyA tvacAMnA mhaNatIla kI tumhI AmacyAvirUddha sAkSa kA dilI, te uttara detIla kI AmhAlA tyA allAhane bolaNyAce sAmarthya pradAna kele, jyAne pratyeka vastUlA bolaNyAce sAmarthya pradAna kele Ahe. tyAneca pahilyAMdA tumhAlA nirmANa kele ANi tyAcyAca kaDe tumhI sarva paratavile jAla.

ANi tumhI (ApalI duSkarme) yA kAraNAne lapavUna Thevataca navhate kI tumacyAvara tumace kAna, tumace DoLe ANi tumacyA tvacA sAkSa detIla ANi tumhI ase samajata rAhilAta kI tumhI je kAhI karIta AhAta, tyApaikI bahuteka karmAMzI allAha anabhijJa Ahe.
ANi tumacyA yA kuvicArAMnI, je tumhI ApalyA pAlanakartyAviSayI kelele hote, tumacA sarvanAza kelA ANi zevaTI tumhI nukasAna ucalaNAr2yAMpaikI jhAlAta.
AtA jara he sahanazIlatA rAkhatIla, tarIhI tyAMce ThikANa jahannamaca Ahe ANi jara he taubA (kSamA-yAcanA) hI karU icchitIla, tarIhI tyAMnA mApha kele jANAra nAhI.

ANi AmhI tyAMce kAhI sAthIdAra nirdhArita kelele hote, jyAMnI tyAMcyA puDhacyA mAgacyA karmAMnA tyAMcyA najareta suMdara suzobhita banavUna Thevale hote, ANi tyAMcyA bAbatItahI allAhacA vAyadA tyA janasamUhAMsobata pUrNa jhAla, je tyAMcyApUrvI jinnAMce ANi mAnavAMce hoUna gele Aheta. niHsaMzaya te nukasAna ucalaNAre siddha Tharale.
ANi kAphira mhaNAle, yA kuraAnAsa aikUca nakA (tyAce paThaNa hota asatAnA) ANi vAhyAta baDabaDa karA, navala navhe kI tumhI varacaDha TharAla.
tara niHsaMzaya, AmhI tyA kAphirAMnA sakta az2Aba (zikSe) cI goDI cAkhavU ANi tyAMnA tyAMcyA atizaya vAITa karmAcA mobadalA (nizcitaca) deU.
allAhacyA zatrUMcA mobadalA (zikSA) jahannamacI hIca Aga Ahe, jyAta tyAMce nehamIce ghara Ahe. (hA) mobadalA Ahe, AmacyA AyatIMcA inkAra karaNAr2yAMcA.

ANi kAphira loka mhaNatIla kI he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! AmhAlA jinna ANi mAnavAMcyA tyA (donhI samUhAM) nA dAkhava, jyAMnI AmhAlA mArgabhraSTa kele, (yAsAThI kI) AmhI tyAMnA ApalA pAyAkhAlI tuDavAve yAsAThI kI te khUpa khAlI (sakta zikSA - yAtanAgrasta) vhAveta.

vAstavika jyA lokAMnI ase mhaTale kI AmacA svAmI va pAlanakartA allAha Ahe, maga tyAvara aTaLa rAhile tara tyAMcyAjavaLa pharizte (he sAMgata) yetAta kI tumhI muLIca bhayabhIta ANi duHkhI hoU nakA. (kiMbahunA) tyA jahannatacA zubha samAcAra aikavA, jicA tumhAlA vAyadA dilA gelA Ahe.

tumacyA aihika jIvanAtahI AmhI tumace mitra va madata karaNAre hoto ANi AkhiratamadhyehI rAhU. jyA goSTIcI tumacyA manAlA icchA hoIla ANi je kAhI mAgAla, te sarva tumacyAsAThI (jannatamadhye hajara) Ahe.
moThA mApha karaNAr2yA, moThA meherabAna azA (allAha) tarphe he sarva kAhI pAhuNacArAcyA svarUpAta Ahe.
ANi tyAcyApekSA adhika cAMgalI goSTa bolaNArA koNa Ahe, jo allAhakaDe bolAvila, satkarma karIla ANi ase mhaNela kI mI khAtrIne muslimAMpaikI Ahe.
ANi satkarma va duSkarma samAna asU zakata nAhI, vAITa goSTIce bhalepaNAne nivAraNa karA, maga toca, jyAcyA va tumacyA daramyAna zatrUtA Ahe, asA hoIla jaNU jIvalaga mitra.
ANi hI goSTa tyAMcyAca sad‌bhAgyAta asate, je dhIra - saMyama rAkhatAta ANi tilA moThyA bhAgyavAnAMkherIja koNIhI prApta karU zakata nAhI.
ANi jara saitAnAkaDUna ekhAdI zaMkA nirmANa jhAlI tara allAhace zaraNa mAgA. niHsaMzaya, to moThA aikaNArA, jANaNArA Ahe.

ANi divasa-rAtra ANi sUrya va caMdra dekhIla tyAcyA nizANyAMpaikI Aheta. tumhI sUrya ANi caMdrAsamora natamastaka hoU nakA, kiMbahunA ApalA mAthA tyA allAhasamora TekavA, jyAne tyA sarvAMnA nirmANa kele Ahe, jara tumhAlA tyAcIca upAsanA karAyacI Ahe.
tarIhI jara te ghameMDa karatIla tara te (pharizte) je tumacyA pAlanakartyAcyA nikaTa Aheta, te tara rAtraMdivasa tyAcyA pAvitryAcA jApa karIta rAhatAta ANi (kadhIhI) thakata nAhIta.

ANi tyA (allAha) cyA nizANyAMpaikI (hehI) Ahe kI tumhI jaminIlA dAbalI gelelI (koraDI paDalelI) pAhatA, maga jevhA AmhI ticyAvara parjanyavRSTI karato, tevhA tI hiravI TavaTavIta hoUna vADhIsa lAgate, jyAne tilA jivaMta kele toca khAtrIne mRtAMnAhI jivaMta karaNArA Ahe. niHsaMzaya to pratyeka goSTa karaNyAsa samartha Ahe.

niHsaMzaya, je loka AmacyA AyatIMmadhye vAkaDepaNA ANatAta te (kAhI) AmacyApAsUna lapalele nAhIta. (jarA sAMgA) jo AgIta TAkalA jAvA, to cAMgalA Ahe kiMvA to, jo zAMtipUrvaka kayAmatacyA divazI yAvA. tumhI vATela te karIta rAhA. to tumace sarva kele karavile pAhAta Ahe.
jyA lokAMnI ApalyAjavaLa kuraAna pohocalyAnaMtarahI tyAcA inkAra kelA (tedekhIla) AmacyApAsUna lapalele nAhIta niHsaMzaya, hA moThA bhavya-divya (sanmAnapUrNa) graMtha Ahe.
asatya, tyAcyA javaLUnahI jAU zakata nAhI, nA tyAcyApuDhUna, ANi nA tyAcyA mAgUna hA (graMtha) tyA (allAha) kaDUna avatarita kelA gelA Ahe, jo moThA hikamatazAlI ANi guNasaMpanna Ahe.

(he paigaMbara!) tumhAlAhI teca sAMgitale jAta Ahe, je tumacyA pUrvIcyA paigaMbarAMnAhI sAMgitale gele Ahe. niHsaMzaya, tumacA pAlanakartA moThA mApha karaNArA ANi duHkhadAyaka zikSA - yAtanA deNArA Ahe.

ANi jara AmhI tyAlA arabIaivajI dusar2yA bhASecA kuraAna banavile asate, tara mhaNAle asate kI yAcyA AyatI (vacane) spaSTapaNe kA nAhI sAMgitalI gelIta? he kAya kI graMtha arabIaivajI dusar2yA bhASeta ANi tumhI arabI rasUla? (tumhI) sAMgA kI hA (graMtha) ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMkaritA mArgadarzana va rogamuktI Ahe ANi je ImAna rAkhata nAhIta tara tyAMcyA kAnAMmadhye badhIratA Ahe ANi hA tyAMcyAsAThI aMdhatva Ahe. he ase loka Aheta, jyAMnA dUracyA ThikANApAsUna pukArale jAta Ahe.

ANi niHsaMzaya, AmhI mUsA (alai.) lA graMtha pradAna kelA hotA tevhA tyAcyAtahI matabheda kelA gelA ANi jara tI goSTa nasatI jI tumacyA pAlanakartyAtarphe yA AdhIca nizcita jhAlelI Ahe, tara tyAMcyA daramyAna (kevhAca) phaisalA jhAlA asatA. he loka tara tyAcyAviSayI sakta becaina karaNAr2yA saMzayAta Aheta.
jo manuSya satkarma karela, te to ApalyA phAyadyAkaritA ANi jo duSkarma karela tara tyA (pApA) ce ojhe tyAcyAvaraca Ahe ANi tumacA pAlanakartA dAsAMvara atyAcAra karaNArA nAhI.

kayAmatace jJAna allAhakaDeca paratavile jAte ANi je je phaLa ApalyA gAbhyAMmadhUna (boMDAmadhUna) bAhera paDate ANi jI mAdI garbhavatI asate ANi jyA bALAlA tI janma dete, tyA sarvAMce jJAna tyAlA Ahe, ANi jyA divazI allAha tyA (anekezvara upAsakAMnA) bolAvUna vicArela kI mAjhe sahabhAgI koThe Aheta? te uttara detIla kI AmhI tara sAMgUna TAkale kI AmacyApaikI koNIhI tyAcA sAkSI nAhI.
ANi he jyAMcI bhaktI - ArAdhanA yApUrvI karIta hote, te sarva tyAMcyA najaretUna nAhIse jhAle ANi tyAMnI samajUna ghetale kI AtA tyAMcyA suTakecA (mArga) nAhI.
bhalepaNAcI yAcanA karaNyApAsUna manuSya thakata nAhI, ANi jara tyAlA ekhAdA trAsa kiMvA yAtanA pohacate, tevhA hatAza ANi nAumeda hoto.

ANi jI kaSTa - yAtanA tyAlA pohacalI Ahe, tyAnaMtara jara AmhI tyAlA ekhAdyA dayA - kRpecI goDI cAkhavito, tevhA to ud‌gArato, mI tara yAsa pAtra hotoca ANi malA nAhI vATata kI kayAmata prasthApita hoIla ANi jara malA ApalyA pAlanakartyAkaDe paratavile geleca, tarIhI khAtrIne tyAcyAjavaLahI mAjhyAsAThI bhalAIca asela. niHsaMzaya, AmhI tyA kAphirAMnA tyAMcyA karmAMzI avagata karU, ANi tyAMnA kaThora zikSA - yAtanecI goDI cAkhavU.
ANi jevhA AmhI mANasAvara ApalA upakAra karato, tevhA to toMDa phiravito ANi bAjU badalUna gheto ANi jevhA tyAcyAvara duHkha kosaLale tevhA mAtra lAMbalacaka duA (prArthanA) karaNArA banato.

(tumhI) sAMgA, bare he tara sAMgA kI jara hA kuraAna allAhatarphe AlelA asela, maga tumhI tyAsa mAnale nAhI tara tyAcyApekSA adhika pathabhraSTa ANakhI koNa asela, jo (satyAcA) virodha karaNyAta dUra nighUna jAvA.

lavakaraca AmhI tyAMnA ApalyA nizANyA jagAcyA kinAr2yAM (kSitijAM) madhyehI dAkhavU ANi svataH tyAMcyA astitvAtahI, yethe paryarMta kI tyAMnA spaSTataH kaLUna yAve kI satya heca Ahe. kAya tumacyA pAlanakartyAce pratyeka goSTIzI avagata asaNe purese nAhI?
vizvAsa karA kI he loka ApalyA pAlanakartyAsamora hajara hoNyAbAbata sAzaMka Aheta. lakSAta ThevA, allAhane samasta goSTIMnA gherUna Thevale Ahe.
hA mIma.
aina. sIna. kApha.
allAha, jo moThA varcasvazAlI ANi hikamatazAlI Ahe, azA prakAre tumacyAkaDe ANi tumacyA pUrvIcyA lokAMkaDe vahayI pAThavita rAhilA.
je kAhI AkAzAMmadhye Ahe ANi je kAhI dharatIta Ahe sarva tyAceca Ahe ANi to sarvocca va sarvAMta mahAna Ahe.

nikaTa Ahe kI AkAza ApalyAvarUna vidIrNa vhAve, ANi sarva pharizte ApalyA pAlanakartyAcI pavitratA tyAcyA prazaMsesaha varNana karIta Aheta ANi dharatIvara asaNAr2yAMkaritA kSamA-yAcanA karIta Aheta. khUpa lakSAta ghyA kI allAhaca mApha karaNArA, dayA karaNArA Ahe.
ANi jyA lokAMnI tyAcyAkherIja dusar2yAMnA auliyA (mitra, sahAyyaka) banavUna ghetale Ahe, allAha tyAMnA cAMgalyA prakAre pAhata Ahe, ANi tumhI tyAMcyAkaritA uttaradAyI (jabAbadAra) nAhIta.

ANi tyAca prakAre AmhI ApalyAkaDe arabI kuraAnAcI vahayI kelI Ahe, yAsAThI kI tumhI makkA ANi tyAcyA javaLapAsacyA ilAkyAta rAhaNAr2yAMnA khabaradAra karAve ANi ekatrita kele jANyAcyA divasApAsUna, jyAcyA yeNyAbAbata kAhI zaMkA nAhI, bhaya dAkhavAve. eka gaTa jannatamadhye asela ANi eka gaTa jahannamamadhye asela.
jara allAhane icchile asate tara tyA sarvAMnA ekaca samudAya (ummata) banavile asate, paraMtu to jyAlA icchito ApalyA dayA-kRpeta sAmIla karato ANi atyAcArIMcA pAThIrAkhA ANi sahAyyaka koNIhI nAhI.
kAya tyA lokAMnI allAhakherIja dusare kArya sAdhaka banavUna ghetale Ahe, (vastutaH) allAhaca vAlI (saMrakSaka) Ahe. toca mRtAMnA jivaMta karIla ANi toca pratyeka goSTa karaNyAsa samartha Ahe.
ANi jyA jyA goSTIta tumacA matabheda asela, tyAcA phaisalA allAhacyA hAtI Ahe. hAca allAha mAjhA svAmI va pAlanakartA Ahe, jyAvara mI bharavasA ThevalA Ahe ANi jyAcyAkaDe mI jhukato.

to AkAza ANi dharatIlA nirmANa karaNArA Ahe. tyAne tumacyAsAThI tumacyA jAtI-prakArAtUna joDyA banavilyA Aheta ANi catuSpAda prANyAMcyAhI joDyA banavilyA Aheta. tumhAlA to tyAta pasaravita Ahe, tyAcyAsArakhe anya kAhIhI nAhI. to sarva kAhI aikaNArA ANi pAhaNArA Ahe.
AkAzAMcyA va dharatIcyA cAvyA tyAcyAca tAbyAta Aheta. jyAlA icchito amApa rojI (AjivikA) pradAna karato ANi jyAlA icchito aparyApta deto. niHsaMzaya, to pratyeka goSTIce jJAna bALagaNArA Ahe.

allAhane tumacyAsAThI toca dIna (dharma) nirdhArita kelA Ahe, jyAlA kAyama karaNyAcA Adeza tyAne nUha (alai.) lA dilA hotA, jo (vahayIdvAre) AmhI tumacyAkaDe pAThavilA Ahe ANi jyAcA khAsa Adeza AmhI ibrAhIma ANi mUsA ANi IsA (alai.) yAMnA dilA hotA kI yA dIna (dharmA) lA kAyama rAkhA ANi yAta phUTa pADU nakA, jyA goSTIkaDe tumhI tyAMnA bolAvita AhAta, tI tara (tyA) anekezvaravAdyAMnA apriya vATate. allAha jyAlA icchito ApalA nivaDaka (dAsa) banavito ANi jo dekhIla tyAcyAkaDe lakSa keMdrita karato, tara azAMce to yathAyogya mArgadarzana karato.

ANi tyA lokAMnI ApalyAjavaLa jJAna yeUna pohocalyAnaMtara matabheda kelA (kevaLa) haTTApAyI ANi jara tumacyA pAlanakartyAce pharmAna ekA nirdhArita avadhIparyarMta AdhIpAsUna nizcita kele gele nasate tara tyAMcA phaisalA kevhAca jhAlA asatA ANi jyAMnA, tyAMcyAnaMtara graMtha dilA gelA Ahe, tehI tyAcyA saMbaMdhAne saMzayAta paDale Aheta.

tevhA tumhI tyAcyAcakaDe lokAMnA bolavita rAhA ANi je kAhI tumhAlA sAMgitale gele Ahe, tyAvara dRDhatApUrvaka rAhA ANi tyAMcyA icchA - AkAMkSAMce anusaraNa karU nakA ANi sAMgA kI allAhane jevaDhe graMtha avatarita kele Aheta, mI tyAMcyAvara ImAna rAkhato ANi malA Adeza dilA gelA Ahe kI tumacyA daramyAna nyAya-nivADA karIta rAhAve. AmacA ANi tumhA sarvAMcA svAmI va pAlanakartA allAhaca Ahe. Amace AcaraNa AmacyAsAThI Ahe ANi tumace AcaraNa tumacyAsAThI Ahe. AmacyA va tumacyA daramyAna kasalAhI taMTA nAhI, allAha AmhA sarvAMnA ekatra karIla ANi tyAcyAcakaDe paratUna jAyace Ahe.

ANi je loka allAhacyA saMdarbhAta vAda nirmANa karatAta, yA uparAMta kI (sRSTIne) te mAnya kele Ahe, tyAMcA vivAda allAhacyA nikaTa khoTA Ahe ANi tyAMcyAvara Iza-prakopa Ahe ANi tyAMcyAsAThI sakta az2Aba (zikSA - yAtanA) Ahe.
allAhane satyAsaha graMtha avatarita kelA Ahe ANi tarAjU dekhIla (avatarita kelA Ahe) ANi tumhAlA kAya mAhIta kI kadAcita kayAmata javaLaca yeUna ThepalI asela.

yAcI ghAI tyAMnAca paDalI Ahe, je tyAvara ImAna rAkhata nAhIta ANi je tyAvara ImAna rAkhatAta, te tyAce bhaya bALagatAta ANi tyAMnA te satya asaNyAce pUrNa jJAna Ahe. lakSAta ThevA, je loka kayAmataviSayI vAda-vivAda karIta Aheta, te dUracyA mArgabhraSTateta jAUna paDale Aheta.
allAha ApalyA dAsAMvara moThA kRpA karaNArA Ahe, jyAlA icchito adhika AjivikA (rojI) pradAna karato ANi to moThA zaktizAlI moThA varcasvazAlI Ahe.

jyAcA saMkalpa AkhiratacyA zetIcA asela tara AmhI tyAcyA zetIta ANakhI jAsta vADhakarU ANi jo aihika zetIcI icchA bALagata asela tara AmhI tyAlA tyAtUna kAhI deUna TAkU, mAtra azA mANasAcA Akhiratamadhye kasalAhI hissA nAhI.

kAya tyA lokAMnI (allAhace) ase sahabhAgI (nirdhArita kele) Aheta, jyAMnI ase dhArmika Adeza nizcita kele Aheta, je allAhane pharmAvilele nAhIta. jara phaisalyAcyA divasAcA vAyadA nasatA tara (yAca kSaNI) tyAMcA phaisalA kelA gelA asatA. niHsaMzaya, tyA atyAcArIMkaritAca duHkhadAyaka zikSA - yAtanA Ahe.

tumhI pAhAla kI he atyAcArI ApalyA duSkarmAM (cyA duSpariNatI) ce bhaya bALagata asatIla, je nizcitaca tyAMcyAvara ghaDUna yeNAra Ahe, ANi jyA lokAMnI ImAna rAkhale ANi je satkarmahI karIta rAhile tara te je kAhI icchitIla, tyAMnA ApalyA pAlanakartyAjavaLa lAbhela hAca Ahe moThA anugraha.

heca te hoya, jyAcA zubha samAcAra allAha tyA dAsAMnA deta Ahe jyAMnI ImAna rAkhale ANi (paigaMbara AcaraNazailInusAra) karma karIta rAhile, tevhA sAMgA kI mI tyAbaddala tumacyAkaDUna kasalAhI mobadalA icchita nAhI, paraMtu nAte-saMbaMdhAce prema, ANi jo manuSya satkarma karIla AmhI tyAcyA satkarmAta ANakhI jAsta vADhakarU. niHsaMzaya, allAha moThA mApha karaNArA, moThA kadara jANaNArA Ahe.

kAya he ase sAMgatAta kI (paigaMbarAne) allAhaviSayI khoTe racale Ahe. allAhane icchile tara tumacyA hRdayAvara mohara lAvIla, ANi allAha ApalyA kathanAMnI asatyAlA miTavito ANi satyAlA bAkI rAkhato. to tara chAtI (manA) talyA gupta goSTIhI jANaNArA Ahe.
ANi toca Ahe jo ApalyA dAsAMcI taubA (kSamA - yAcanA) kabUla karato ANi aparAdhAMnA kSamA karato ANi tumhI je kAhI karIta AhAta, te sarva jANato.
ANi ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMcI va neka sadAcArI lokAMcI (duA - prArthanA) aikato ANi tyAMnA ApalyA kRpene ANakhI jAsta pradAna karato, ANi kAphirAMsAThI kaThora zikSA - yAtanA Ahe.

ANi jara allAhane ApalyA samasta dAsAMnA vizAlatApUrvaka rojI (AjivikA) dilI asatI tara tyAMnI dharatIvara utpAta (phasAda) mAjavilA asatA, paraMtu to anumAnAne je kAhI icchito avatarita karato. to ApalyA dAsAMviSayI cAMgalyA prakAre jANakAra Ahe ANi cAMgalyA prakAre pAhaNArA Ahe.
ANi toca hoya, jo lokAMce nirAza jhAlyAnaMtara parjanyavRSTI karato. ANi ApalyA dayelA vistRta karato. toca Ahe mitra- sahAyyaka, ANi zreSThatA va prazaMsesa pAtra.
ANi tyAcyA nizANyAMpaikI AkAza va dharatIce nirmANa karaNe, ANi tyAMcyAta sajIvAMnA pasaraviNe hoya. to yA goSTIsahI samartha Ahe kI jevhA icchila tyAMnA ekatra karIla.
ANi je kAhI saMkaTa tumhAlA pohocate, te tumacyA ApalyA hAtAMcyA duSkarmAMce (phaLa) Ahe ANi to bahuteka goSTIMnA mApha karato.
ANi tumhI AmhAlA dharatIvara agatika (lAcAra) karaNAre nAhIta. ANi tumacyAsAThI allAhakherIja koNIhI mitra - sahAyyaka nAhI ANi nA koNI madata karaNArA.
ANi samudrAta cAlaNAr2yA parvatAMsamAna naukA, tyAcyA nizANyAMpaikI Aheta.
jara tyAne icchile tara havA baMda karIla ANi yA naukA samudrAta sthira thAMbatIla. niHsaMzaya, yAta pratyeka sahanazIla, kRtajJazIla mANasAkaritA nizANyA Aheta.
kiMvA tyAMnA tyAMcyA duSkRtyAMpAyI naSTa karUna TAkIla. to tara bahuteka cUkA mApha karato.
ANi yAsAThI kI je loka AmacyA nizANyAMbAbata vAda ghAlatAta, tyAMnI jANUna ghyAve kI tyAMcyAkaritA kazAhI prakAre suTakA nAhI.

tevhA tumhAlA je kAhI dile gele Ahe te aihika jIvanAcI alpazI sAdhana-sAmugrI Ahe ANi allAhajavaLa je Ahe te tyApekSA aneka paTIMnI cAMgale va bAkI rAhaNAre Ahe. te tyA lokAMkaritA Ahe jyAMnI ImAna rAkhale ANi je kevaLa ApalyA pAlakanartyAvaraca bharavasA rAkhatAta.
ANi te moThyA aparAdhAMpAsUna ANi nirlajjatecyA kAmAMpAsUna alipta rAhatAta ANi krodhAcyA veLIhI mApha karatAta.

ANi ApalyA pAlanakartyAcA Adeza svIkAratAta ANi namAjalA niyamitapaNe kAyama karatAta ANi tyAMce pratyeka kAma ApasAtIla sallAmasalatIne pAra paDate. ANi AmhI je kAhI tyAMnA deUna Thevale Ahe, tyAtUna (AmacyA nAvAne) deta asatAta.
ANi jevhA tyAMcyAvara atyAcAra (va krUratA) hote tevhA te kevaLa pratizodha ghetAta.

ANi ducArAcA mobadalA tyAca prakAracA durAcAra Ahe ANi jo koNI mApha karIla ANi (ApalyA AcaraNAta) sudhAraNA karUna gheIla tara tyAcA mobadalA allAhacyA jabAbadArIvara Ahe, vastutaH allAha atyAcArIMzI prema rAkhata nAhI.
ANi jo manuSya ApalyAvara atyAcAra jhAlyAnaMtara sUDa gheIla tara azA mANasAvara doSAropa ThevaNyAcA mArga nAhI.

(doSAropAcA) mArga tara azA lokAMvara Ahe, je svataH dusar2yAMvara julUma atyAcAra karatAta ANi dharatIvara nAhaka utpAta (phasAda) mAjavita phiratAta. azAca lokAMkaritA duHkhadAyaka zikSA-yAtanA (az2Aba) Ahe.
ANi jo manuSya sahanazIlatA rAkhela ANi mApha karela tara niHsaMzaya he moThyA hiMmatIcyA kAmAMpaikI (eka kAma) Ahe.
ANi jyAlA allAha pathabhraSTa karIla, tyAnaMtara tyAcA koNI mitra va saMrakSaka nAhI, ANi tumhI pAhAla kI atyAcArI loka zikSA-yAtanAMnA pAhUna mhaNata asatIla kI, paratIcA ekhAdA mArga Ahe kAya?

ANi tumhI tyAMnA pAhAlA kI te (jahannamacyA) samora ANUna ubhe kele jAtIla. apamAnApAyI jhukata jAtIla, khAlacyA najarene pAhata asatIla. ImAna rAkhaNAre spaSTapaNe sAMgatIla kI, vastutaH toTyAta rAhaNAre te loka Aheta, jyAMnI Aja kayAmatacyA divazI svataHlA ANi ApalyA kuTuMbiyAMnA hAnigrasta kele. lakSAta ThevA kI, atyAcArI loka nizcitaca kAyamasvarUpI az2Abamadhye Aheta.
ANi tyAMnA koNI madata karaNArA nasela, jo allAhavyatirikta tyAMcI madata karU zakela ANi jyAlA allAha mArgApAsUna haTavila, tyAcyAsAThI koNatAhI mArga nAhI.

ApalyA pAlanakartyAcA Adeza mAnya karA, yApUrvI kI allAhatarphe to divasa yAvA, jyAce TaLaNe asaMbhava Ahe. tumhAlA tyA divazI nA tara ekhAde AzrayasthAna lAbhela ANi nA lapUna anabhijJa banaNyAce (ThikANa).

jara te toMDa phiravita asatIla tara AmhI tumhAlA tyAMcyAvara dekharekha ThevaNArA banavUna pAThavile nAhI. tumace kartavya kevaLa (AmacA) saMdeza pohacaviNyAce Ahe. ANi jevhA AmhI mANasAlA ApalyA dayA-kRpecI goDI cAkhavito, tevhA to tyAvara zekhI miravU lAgato ANi jara tyAMcyAvara, tyAMcyA AcaraNAmuLe ekhAde saMkaTa yete, tevhA nizcitaca manuSya moThA kRtaghna Ahe.
AkAzAMcI ANi dharatIcI rAjyasattA allAhakaritAca Ahe. to je kAhI icchito, nirmANa karato, jyAlA icchito kanyA deto, ANi jyAlA icchito putra deto.
kiMvA tyAMnA putra ANi kanyA donhI miLUna pradAna karato, ANi jyAlA icchito niHsaMtAna Thevato, to moThA jJAna rAkhaNArA ANi sAmarthyazAlI Ahe.

ekhAdyA dAsAzI (mANasAzI) allAhane saMbhASaNa karAve he azakya Ahe tathApi vahayIcyA svarUpAta kiMvA paDadyAmAgUna athavA ekhAdA phariztA pAThavUna, ANi to allAhacyA AdezAne, to je icchila vahayI karIla. niHsaMzaya to (allAha) sarvAMta mahAna ANi hikamatazAlI Ahe.

ANi yAca prakAre AmhI tumacyAkaDe ApalyA AdezAne ruha (AtmA) avatarita kelA Ahe. tumhI tyApUrvI hehI jANata navhate kI graMtha ANi ImAna kAya Ahe? paraMtu AmhI tyAsa nUra (divya prakAza) banavile. tyAcyAdvAre ApalyA dAsAMpaikI, jyAlA icchito, mArgadarzana karato. niHsaMzaya tumhI satya mArga dAkhavita AhAta.
tyA allAhacyA mArgAce jyAcyA svAmItvAta AkAzAMcI ANi dharatIcI pratyeka vastU Ahe. khabaradAra asA, samasta kArye - allAhakaDeca paratatAta.
hA - mIma
zapatha Ahe yA spaSTa graMthAcI.
AmhI yAsa arabI bhASecA kuraAna banavilA Ahe, yAsAThI kI tumhI samajUna ghyAve.
ANi niHsaMzaya, hA surakSita graMthAta Ahe ANi AmacyA nikaTa ucca darjAcA Ahe. buddhI-kauzalyapUrNa Ahe.
kAya AmhI yA sadupadezAlA tumacyApAsUna yA kAraNAstava haTavAve kI tumhI maryAdA olAMDaNAre loka AhAta.
ANi AmhI pUrvIcyA janasamUhAMmadhyehI aneka paigaMbara pAThavile.
ANi jo dekhIla paigaMbara tyAMcyAjavaLa AlA, tyAMnI tyAcI thaTTAca uDavilI.
tevhA AmhI tyAMcyApekSA jAsta zaktizAlI lokAMnA naSTa karUna TAkale ANi pUrvIcyA lokAMcI udAharaNe dilI gelI Aheta.

ANi jara tumhI tyAMnA vicArAla kI AkAzAMnA va dharatIlA koNI nirmANa kele, tara niHsaMzaya tyAMce uttara heca asela kI, tyAMnA sarvAMta jabaradasta ANi sarvAdhika jJAna bALagaNAr2yA (allAha) neca nirmANa kele Ahe.
(toca Ahe) jyAne tumacyAsAThI jaminIlA bichAIta (ANi aMtharuNa) banavile ANi ticyAta tumacyAsAThI raste banavile, yAsAThI kI tumhI mArga prApta karUna ghyAvA.
ANi tyAneca AkAzAtUna ekA anumAnAnusAra parjanyavRSTI kelI tevhA AmhI tyAdvAre mRta zaharAlA jivaMta kele. yAca prakAre tumhI bAhera kADhale jAla.
ANi jyAne sarva vastUMcyA joDyA banavilyA ANi tumacyA (vAhanA) karitA naukA banavilyA ANi catuSpAda pazu nirmANa kele, jyAMcyAvara tumhI svAra hotA.

yAsAThI kI tumhI tyAMcyA pAThIvara svAra vhAve ANi jevhA tumhI yAMcyAvara vyavasthita basAla, tevhA ApalyA pAlanakartyAne (pradAna kelelyA) deNagyAMce smaraNa karA ANi mhaNA, moThA pavitra Ahe to, jyAne yAsa AmacyA adhIna kele, anyathA yAsa kAbUta ANaNyAcI AmacI tAkada navhatI.
ANi nizcitapaNe AmhI ApalyA pAlanakartyAkaDe parataNAra Ahota.
ANi tyAMnI allAhacyA kAhI dAsAMnA tyAcA aMza banavUna ghetale. niHsaMzaya, manuSya, spaSTapaNe kRtaghna Ahe.
kAya allAhane ApalyA nirmitImadhUna kanyA, svataHsAThI rAkhalyAta ANi tumhAlA putrAMnI suzobhita kele?
jevhA tyAMcyApaikI ekhAdyAlA tyA goSTIMcI khabara dilI jAte jice udAharaNa tyAne dayAvAna allAhakaritA sAMgitale Ahe, tevhA tyAcA ceharA kALavaMDato ANi to duHkhI hoto.
kiMvA, kAya (allAhacI saMtatI mulI Aheta) jyA dAga-dAginyAMta vADhatAta ANi bhAMDaNa-taMTyAta (Apale mhaNaNe) spaSTa bolU zakata nAhIta.

ANi tyAMnI dayAvAna (allAha) cI upAsanA karaNAr2yA phariztyAMnA strI banavUna TAkale. kAya tyAMcyA nirmitIcyA veLI te hajara hote? thyAMcI hI sAkSa lihUna ghetalI jAIla ANi tyAMnA tyAsaMbaMdhI vicAraNA kelI jAIla.
ANi mhaNatAta kI allAhane icchile asate tara AmhI tyAMcI upAsanA kelI nasatI. tyAMnA tyAce kAhIca jJAna nAhI. he tara kevaLa aTakaLIcyA (khoTyA goSTI) bolatAta.
kAya AmhI yApUrvI tyAMnA (dusarA) ekhAdA graMtha pradAna kelA Ahe jyAlA yAMnI majabUtapaNe dharUna Thevale Ahe?
(navhe) kiMbahunA he tara mhaNatAta kI AmhAlA Amace vADavaDIla ekA dharmAvara ADhaLale, ANi AmhI tyAMcyAca padacinhAMvara cAlUna sanmArga prApta kelA Ahe.

ANi azAca prakAre tumacyA pUrvIhI AmhI, jyA jyA vastIta ekhAdA khabaradAra karaNArA pAThavilA, tithalyA sukhavastU lokAMnI heca uttara dile kI AmhAlA Apale pUrvaja (vADavaDIla) (ekAca pAUlavATevara ANi) ekA dharmAvara ADhaLale ANi AmhI tara tyAMcyAca padacinhAMce anusaraNa karaNAre Ahota.

(paigaMbarAne) sAMgitalehI kI jarI mI tyAhUna adhika cAMgalyA (dhyeyAparyaMta pohacaviNArA) mArga gheUna Alo Ahe, jyAvara tumhAlA Apale vADavaDIla ADhaLale (tarIhI tumhI tyAMceca anusaraNa karAla?) tevhA tyAMnI uttara dile kI, AmhI te mAnya karaNAra nAhIta, je deUna tumhAlA pAThavile gele Ahe.
tevhA AmhI tyAMcA sUDa ghetalA ANi pAhA, khoTe TharaviNAr2yAMcA kAya pariNAma (aMta) jhAlA!
ANi jevhA ibrAhIma (alai.) ApalyA pityAsa ANi ApalyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMnA mhaNAle, mI tyA goSTIMpAsUna alaga Ahe, jyAMcI tumhI upAsanA karatA.
tyA zaktI-sAmarthyAkherIja, jyAne malA nirmANa kele Ahe ANi toca malA mArgadarzanahI karela.
ANi ibrAhIma (alai.) tilAca ApalyA saMtatIlAhI bAkI rAhaNArI goSTa kAyama karUna gele, yAsAThI kI lokAMnI (anekezvaraupAsanepAsUna) ApalA bacAva karIta rAhAve.
kiMbahunA mI tyA lokAMnA ANi tyAMcyA pUrvajAMnA sAmugrI (ANi sAdhana) pradAna kelI, yethapAveto kI tyAMcyAjavaLa satya ANi spaSTarityA aikaviNArA rasUla (paigaMbara) AlA.
ANi satya yeUna pohocatAca he ud‌gArale kI hI tara jAdU Ahe, ANi AmhI yAcA inkAra karaNAre Ahota.
ANi mhaNU lAgale kI hA kuraAna yA donhI vastyAMpaikI ekhAdyA sukhasaMpanna mANasAvara kA avatarita kelA gelA nAhI?

kAya tumacyA pAlanakartyAcyA dayA-kRpecI he vibhAgaNI karatAta? AmhIca tyAMcyA aihika jIvanAcI (AjivikA) tyAMcyAta vATUna dilI Ahe ANi ekAlA dusar2yAhUna adhika cAMgale kele Ahe yAsAThI kI ekamekAMnA adhIna karUna ghyAve ANi jyAlA he loka jamA karIta phirata Aheta, tyAhUna tumacyA pAlanakartyAcI dayA - kRpA atizaya uttama Ahe.

ANi jara azI goSTa nasatI kI sarva loka ekAca paddhatIce anusaraNa karatIla tara dayAvAna (rahamAna) zI kupra (inkAra) karaNAr2yAMcyA gharAMcI chate AmhI cAMdIcI banavilI asatI ANi jine (pAyar2yA) dekhIla, jyAvara te caDhatAta.
ANi tyAMcyA gharAMce daravAje va Asane dekhIla, jyAvara te takke (loDa) lAvUna basatAta.
ANi sonyAcehI, ANi hA sarva kAhI yA jagAcAca lAbha Ahe, ANi Akhirata tara tumacyA pAlanakartyAcyA nikaTa kevaLa neka sadAcArI lokAMkaritAca Ahe.
ANi jo manuSya allAhacyA smaraNApAsUna sustI karIla, AmhI tyAcyAvara eka saitAna nirdhArita karato. toca tyAcA sAthIdAra banato.
ANi te tyAMnA (allAhacyA) mArgApAsUna rokhatAta ANi he yAca vicArAta rAhatAta kI AmhI mArgadarzana prApta kelele Ahota.
yetheparyaMta kI jevhA to AmacyAjavaLa yeIla, tevhA mhaNela kI mAjhyA ANi tujhyA daramyAna pUrva ANi pazcimece aMtara asate tara phAra bare jhAle asate. tU moThA vAITa sobatI Ahesa.
ANi jevhA tumhI atyAcAra karUnaca basAla tara tumhAlA Aja kadhIhI tumhA sarvAMcyA zikSA - yAtaneta sahabhAgI hoNe kAhIca lAbhadAyaka TharaNAra nAhI.
tevhA kAya tumhI bahir2yAlA aikavU zakatA kiMvA AMdhaLyAlA mArga dAkhavU zakatA ANi tyAlA jo ughaDa mArgabhraSTateta asAvA.
maga jara AmhI tumhAlA yethUna jarI nele tarIhI AmhI tyAMcyAzI sUDa gheNAraca Ahota.
kiMvA jo kAhI vAyadA tyAMcyAzI kelA Ahe, to tumhAlA dAkhavU AmhI tyAMcyAvarahI sAmarthya bALagato.
tevhA jI vahayI (prakAzanA) tumacyAkaDe kelI gelI Ahe tilA dRDhapaNe bALagUna rAhA. niHsaMzaya, tumhI saraLa mArgAvara AhAta.
ANi niHsaMzaya, hA (svataH) tumacyAkaritA ANi tumacyA janasamUhAkaritA upadeza Ahe ANi nikaTa bhaviSyAta tumacI vicAraNA hoIla.

ANi AmacyA tyA paigaMbarAMkaDUna mAhIta karUna ghyA, jyAMnA AmhI tumacyA pUrvI pAThavile hote kI kAya AmhI rahamAna (dayAvAna allAha) cyA kherIja dusarI upAsye (ArAdhya daivate) nirdhArita kelI hotI, jyAMcI upAsanA kelI jAvI.
ANi AmhI mUsA (alai.) lA ApalyA nizANyAsa deUna, phiraauna ANi tyAcyA darabArI lokAMjavaLa pAThavile, tevhA (mUsA, tyAMnA) mhaNAle kI mI samasta vizvAMcyA pAlanakartyAcA rasUla (saMdezavAhaka) Ahe.
tara jevhA te AmacyA nizANyA gheUna tyA lokAMjavaLa Ale, tevhA te acAnaka tyAMcI thaTTA uDavU lAgale.
ANi AmhI jI nizANI tyAMnA dAkhavita hoto, tI dusar2yA nizANIpekSA sarasa ase, ANi AmhI tyAMnA zikSA - yAtaneta dharale, yAsAThI kI tyAMnI rujU karAve.
ANi te mhaNAle, he jAdUgAra! AmacyAsAThI ApalyA pAlanakartyAlA tyA goSTIcI duA-prArthanA kara jicA tyAne tulA vAyadA dilelA Ahe vizvAsa kara kI AmhI sarnmAlA lAgU.
maga jevhA AmhI tyAMcyAvarUna to az2Aba haTavilA tevhA tyAMnI tyAca veLI ApalA vAyadA va ApalyA vacanAcA bhaMga kelA.

ANi phiraaunane ApalyA janasamUhAta ailAna karavile va mhaNAlA, he mAjhyA jamAtIcyA lokAno! kAya misracA deza mAjhA nAhI, ANi mAjhyA rAjamahAlAMcyA khAlI je he jalapravAha vAhata Aheta, kAya tumhI pAhAta nAhI?
kiMbahunA mI zreSThatama Ahe yAcyA tulaneta jo tuccha Ahe ANi sApha (spaSTapaNe) bolUhI zakata nAhI.
bare, yAcyAvara sonyAcI kAMkaNe kA nAhI avatarita jhAlIta, kiMvA yAcyAsobata pharizteca jhuMDIne (goLA hoUna) Ale asate.
tevhA tyAne ApalyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMnA mUrkha banavile ANi tyAMnI tyAce mhaNaNe mAnale. niHsaMzaya, te sarva durAcArI loka hote.
maga jevhA tyAMnI AmhAlA krodhita kele, tevhA AmhI tyAMcA sUDa ghetalA ANi sarvAMnA (samudrAta) buDavUna TAkale.
tevhA AmhI tyAMnA bhUtakAlIna karUna TAkale ANi naMtaracyA lokAMkaritA namUnA banavile.
ANi jevhA mariyamacyA putrAce udAharaNa sAMgitale gele, tevhA tyA vRttAMtAne tumacA janasamUha (AnaMdAne) oraDalA.
ANi te mhaNAle kI AmacI upAsye cAMgalI Aheta kI to? tumhAlA tyAMce he sAMgaNe kevaLa vAda ghAlaNyAcyA hetUne Ahe, kiMbahunA he loka Ahetaca bhAMDakhora.
to (IsA alai.) dekhIla kevaLa eka dAsa mAtra Ahe, jyAcyAvara AmhI upakAra kelA ANi tyAlA isrAIlacyA saMtatIkaritA (ApalyA sAmarthyAcI) nizANI banavile.
jara AmhI icchile asate tara tumacyAaivajI pharizte banavile asate jyAMnI dharatIvara ekamekAMce vArasa mhaNUna kAma kele asate.
ANi niHsaMzaya, to (IsA alai.) kayAmatacI nizANI Ahe, tevhA tumhI kayAmataviSayI zaMkA karU nakA ANi mAjhe mhaNaNe mAnya karA. hAca saraLa mArga Ahe.
ANi saitAnAne tumhAlA pratibaMdha ghAlU naye. niHsaMzaya, to tumacA ughaDa zatrU Ahe.

ANi jevhA IsA (alai.) IzacamatkAra (mojije) gheUna Ale, tevhA mhaNAle, mI tumacyAjavaLa jJAna gheUna Alo Ahe ANi azAsAThI Alo Ahe kI jyA jyA goSTIMmadhye tumhI matabheda karatA, tyA spaSTa karAvyAta. tevhA tumhI allAhace bhaya bALagA ANi mAjhe AjJApAlana karA.
mAjhA ANi tumacA svAmI va pAlanakartA allAhaca Ahe. tevhA tumhI sarva tyAcIca upAsanA karA. hAca saraLa mArga Ahe.
maga (isrAIlacyA saMtatIcyA) samUhAMnI ApasAta matabheda kelA tevhA atyAcArI lokAMkaritA sarvanAza Ahe. duHkhadAyaka divasAcyA az2Aba (zikSA - yAtane) ne.
he loka phakta kayAmatacyA pratIkSeta Aheta kI tI acAnaka tyAMcyAvara yeUna kosaLAvI ANi tyAMnA khabarahI na vhAvI.
tyA divazI (jIvalaga) mitra dekhIla ekamekAMce zatrU banatIla, mAtra allAhace bhaya rAkhaNAr2yAMkherIja.
he mAjhyA dAsAMno! Aja nA tumacyAvara ekhAde bhaya Ahe ANi nA tumhI duHkhI vhAla.
jyAMnI AmacyA AyatIMvara ImAna rAkhale ANi je muslima (AjJAdhAraka) banUna rAhile.
tumhI ANi tumacyA patnyA AnaMdita va khUza hoUna jannatamadhye dAkhala vhA.

tyAMcyA cohIbAjUMnA sonyAcI tATe ANi sonyAce pyAle phiravile jAtIla. yAta te sarva kAhI asela, je manAlA AvaDaNAre ANi netyAMnA sukhadAyaka TharaNAre asela, ANi tumhI tyAta nehamI-nehamIkaritA rAhAla.
ANi hIca tI jannata hoya kI tumhI ApalyA AcaraNAcyA mobadalyAta tice uttarAdhikArI (vArasa) banavile gele AhAta.
ithe tumacyAsAThI vipula pramANAta meve Aheta, jyAMnA tumhI khAta rAhAla.
niHsaMzaya, aparAdhI loka jahannamacyA zikSA-yAtaneta sadaiva rAhatIla.
hI (zikSA-yAtanA) kadhIhI tyAMcyAvarUna saumya kelI jANAra nAhI ANi te ticyAtaca nairAzyagrasta paDUna rAhatIla.
ANi AmhI tyAMcyAvara atyAcAra nAhI kelA, ulaTa te svataHca atyAcArI hote.
te hAka mArUna mhaNatIla kI he mAlaka! tumacA pAlanakartA tara AmacA puratA nAyanATa karUna TAkIla! to mhaNela, tumhAlA tara (yAca avastheta nehamI) rAhAvayAce Ahe.
AmhI tara tumacyAjavaLa satya gheUna Alo, paraMtu tumacyApaikI bahuteka loka satyAzI tiraskAra karaNAre hote.
kAya tyAMnI ekhAdyA kAmAcA majabUta irAdA karUna ghetalA Ahe? tara maga khAtrI bALagA kI AmhIhI majabUta kAma karaNAre Ahota.

kAya tyAMnI ase gRhita dharale Ahe kI AmhI tyAMcyA gupta goSTIMnA ANi tyAMcyA kAnagoSTIMnA aikata nAhIta? (niHsaMzaya AmhI sarva kAhI aikato) kiMbahunA AmhI pAThavilele (pharizte) tyAMcyAjavaLaca lihita Aheta.
(tumhI) sAMgA kI, jara samajA rahamAna (dayAvAna allAha) cI ekhAdI saMtatI asatI tara mI sarvAMta prathama upAsanA karaNArA rAhile asato.
AkAzAMcA ANi dharatI va arza (Iza-siMhAsanA) cA svAmI, tyA goSTIMpAsUna pavitra (vyaMga-doSa virahita) Ahe. jyA (he) sAMgatAta.
AtA tumhI tyAMnA yAca vAda-vivAdAta ANi kheLaNyA-bAgaDaNyAta soDUna dyA. yetheparyaMta kI tyAMcI tyA divasAzI gATha paDAvI, jyAcA yAMnA vAyadA dilA jAta Ahe.
ANi toca AkAzAMmadhyehI pUjya (upAsanIya) Ahe ANi dharatIvarahI toca upAsanA karaNyAyogya Ahe ANi to moThA buddhikauzalya bALagaNArA ANi saMpUrNa jJAna rAkhaNArA Ahe.

ANi to moThA zubha-kalyANakArI Ahe, jyAcyA hAtI AkAzAMce ANi dharatIce ANi yA doghAMcyA daramyAnace rAjya Ahe ANi kayAmatace jJAna dekhIla tyAcyAcajavaLa Ahe ANi tyAcyAcakaDe tumhI sarva paratavile jAla.
ANi jyAMnA he loka allAhakherIja pukAratAta, te ziphArasa karaNyAcA adhikAra bALagata nAhI, tathApi (ziphArasIcA hakka te bALagatAta) je satya goSTIMcA svIkAra karatIla ANi tyAMnA jJAnahI asAve.
jara tumhI tyAMnA vicArAla kI tyAMnA koNI nirmANa kele tara he avazya uttara detIla kI allAhane, maga he koThe ulaTa jAta Aheta?
ANi tyAMce (paigaMbarAMce adhikAMza) he mhaNaNe kI he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! niHsaMzaya, he ase loka Aheta, je ImAna rAkhata nAhIta.
tevhA tumhI tyAMcyAkaDUna toMDa phiravUna ghyA ANi (niropAcA) salAma sAMgA. tyAMnA (svataHlAca) mAhIta paDela.
hA. mIma.
zapatha Ahe yA spaSTa graMthAcI.
niHsaMzaya, AmhI yA graMthAlA ekA zubharAtrIta avatarita kele Ahe. niHsaMzaya, AmhI avagata karUna deNAre Ahota.
tyAca rAtrIta pratyeka mahattvapUrNa kAryAcA nirNaya ghetalA jAto.
AmacyAkaDUna eka pharmAna banUna AmhIca Ahota rasUla (saMdezavAhaka) banavUna pAThaviNAre.
tumacyA pAlanakartyAcyA kRpene, toca Ahe aikaNArA ANi jANaNArA.
jo AkAzAMcA ANi dharatIcA ANi tyAMcyA daramyAna je kAhI Ahe tyA sarvAMcA svAmI Ahe, jara tumhI vizvAsa rAkhaNAre asAla.
tyAcyAzivAya dusarA koNIhI upAsanA karaNyAsa pAtra nAhI. toca jivaMta karato ANi mArato. toca tumacA ANi tumacyApUrvI hoUna gelelyA pUrvajAMcA svAmI va pAlanakartA Ahe.
kiMbahunA te saMzayAta paDUna kheLata Aheta.
tumhI tyA divasAcyA pratIkSeta rAhA, jevhA AkAza ughaDa svarUpAcA dhUra ANIla.
jo lokAMnA gherA TAkIla. hI moThI duHkhadAyaka zikSA - yAtanA Ahe.
(mhaNatIla kI) he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! hA az2Aba (zikSA - yAtanA) AmacyApAsUna dUra kara, AmhI ImAna svIkArale.
tyAMcyAsAThI AtA upadeza koThe Ahe? spaSTarityA nivedana karaNAre paigaMbara tyAMcyAjavaLa (kevhAca) yeUna geleta.
tarIhI tyAMnI tyAMcyAkaDUna toMDa phiravile ANi sAMgitale kI hA tara zikavilelA veDA Ahe.
AmhI zikSA - yAtanelA thoDese dUrahI karU tarI tumhI parata punhA ApalyA tyAca avastheta yAla.
jyA divazI AmhI moThyA sakta pakaDIta dharU, nizcitaca AmhI pratizodha (sUDa) gheNAra Ahota.
ANi niHsaMzaya, AmhI yApUrvI phiraaunacyA janasamUhAcI (hI) parIkSA ghetalI Ahe jyAMcyAjavaLa (allAhacA) pratiSThAsaMpanna rasUla (paigaMbara) AlA.
kI allAhacyA dAsAMnA mAjhyA havAlI karA, vizvAsa rAkhA kI mI tumacyAsAThI vizvasta paigaMbara Ahe.
ANi tumhI allAhasamora vidroha dAkhavU nakA. mI tumacyAsamora ughaDa purAvA prastuta karena.
ANi mI, ApalyA va tumacyA pAlanakartyAcyA zaraNAta yeto. yA goSTIpAsUna kI tumhI malA dagaDAMnI ThecUna mArAve.
ANi jara tumhI mAjhyAvara ImAna rAkhata nasAla tara mAjhyApAsUna alaga rAhA.
maga tyAMnI ApalyA pAlanakartyAlA duA-prArthanA kelI kI he sarva aparAdhI loka Aheta.
(AmhI pharmAvile) kI rAtrItUnaca tumhI mAjhyA dAsAMnA gheUna nighA. nizcitaca tumacA pAThalAga kelA jAIla.
ANi tumhI samudrAlA sthira avastheta soDUna nighUna jA. niHsaMzaya, he sainya buDavile jAIla.
te aneka bAgA ANi jhare soDUna gele.
ANi zete va uttama nivAsasthAne.
ANi tyA sukhadAyaka vastU jyAMcyAta te sukha bhogata hote.
azA prakAre ghaDale, ANi AmhI tyA sarvAMcA uttarAdhikArI (vArasa) dusar2yA janasamUhAlA banavile.
tevhA tyAMcyAsAThI nA AkAza raDale nA dharatI ANi nA tyAMnA kasalI saMdhI lAbhalI.
ANi AmhIca isrAIlacyA saMtatIlA (atizaya) apamAnadAyaka zikSA-yAtanepAsUna muktI dilI.
(jI) phiraaunatarphe (dilI jAta) hotI. vAstavika to vidrohI ANi maryAdece ullaMghana karaNAr2yAMpaikI hotA.
ANi AmhI jANUnabujUna isrAIlacyA saMtatIlA jagAtIla lokAMvara zreSThatA pradAna kelI.
ANi AmhI tyAMnA azA nizANyA pradAna kelyA, jyAMcyAta ughaDa kasoTI hotI.
he loka tara heca mhaNatAta.
kI (aMtima goSTa) heca Amace pahilyAMdA (jagAta) maraNa pAvaNe Ahe ANi AmhI dusar2yAMdA uThavilo jANAra nAhIta.
jara tumhI sacce asAla tara AmacyA pUrvajAMnA gheUna yA.
kAya he loka adhika cAMgale Aheta kI tubbaa cyA janasamUhAce loka ANi je tyAMcyAhI pUrvIce hote? AmhI tyA sarvAMnA naSTa karUna TAkale. niHsaMzaya, te aparAdhI hote.
ANi AmhI AkAzAMnA va dharatIlA ANi tyAMcyA daramyAnacyA vastUMnA kheLa svarUpAta nirmANa kele nAhI.
kiMbahunA AmhI tyAMnA ucita hetusahaca nirmANa kele Ahe. paraMtu adhikAMza loka he jANata nAhIta.
niHsaMzaya, nirNayAcA divasa tyA sarvAMsAThI nirdhArita veLI Ahe.
tyA divazI koNI mitra koNA mitrAcyA kAhIca kAmI yeNAra nAhI ANi nA tyAMcI madata kelI jAIla.
paraMtu (tyAcyAkherIja) jyAcyAvara allAhacI dayA - kRpA vhAvI. niHsaMzaya, to moThA zaktizAlI ANi dayA karaNArA Ahe.
niHsaMzaya, jakkUmace jhADa
gunhegArAMce bhojana Ahe
je vitaLalelyA tAMbyAsArakhe Ahe ANi poTAta ukaLata rAhate.
khUpa garama ukaLatyA pANyAsArakhe.
tyAlA dharA, maga pharaphaTata oDhata neUna jahannamacyA madhyabhAgI pohacavA,
maga tyAcyA DokyAvara garama ukaLatyA pANyAcI yAtanA (az2Aba) otA.
(tyAlA sAMgitale jAIla) cAkhata jA (goDI), tU tara moThA pratiSThita ANi AdarasanmAna bALagaNArA hotA.
hIca tI goSTa hoya, jicyAbAbata tumhI zaMkA karIta asata.
niHsaMzaya, allAhace bhaya bALagaNAre zAMtIpUrNa ThikANI asatIla
bAgAMmadhye ANi jalasrotAM (jhar2yAM) madhye.
pAtaLa va mulAyama rezamI vastre ghAtalele, samorAsamora basale asatIla.
he tyAca prakAre Ahe, ANi AmhI moThayA netrAMcyA hUra-parIMzI tyAMcA vivAha karUna deU.
nirbhayatApUrvaka tithe pratyeka prakAracyA mevyAcI mAgaNI karatIla.
tithe te mRtyucA svAda cAkhaNAra nAhIta, pahilyA mRtyukherIja (jo jagAta ghaDalA) tyAMnA allAhane jahannamacyA (bhayaMkara) zikSA - yAtane (az2Aba) pAsUna vAcavile.
hI kevaLa tumacyA pAlanakartyAcI kRpA Ahe. hIca Ahe moThI saphalatA.
AmhI yA (kuraAnA) lA tumacyA bhASeta sope kele, yAsAThI kI tyAMnI (lokAMnI) bodha grahaNa karAvA.
AtA tumhI pratIkSA karA, he dekhIla pratIkSA karIta Aheta.
hA. mIma
hA graMtha, jabaradasta hikamata (buddhikauzalya) bALagaNAr2yA allAhatarphe avatarita jhAlA Ahe.
AkAzAMmadhye ANi dharatIta ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMkaritA aneka nizANyA Aheta.
ANi svataH tumacyA janmAta ANi janAvarAMcyA pasaraviNyAta, vizvAsa ThevaNAr2yA janasamUhAkaritA aneka nizANyA (bodhacinhe) Aheta.

ANi rAtra va divasAcyA pherabadalAta ANi jI kAhI AjivikA (rojI) allAha, AkAzAtUna avatarita karUna jaminIlA, ticyA mRtyunaMtara (punhA) jivaMta karato, tyAta ANi vAr2yAMcyA pherabadalAtahI, tyA lokAMkaritA nizANyA Aheta, je buddhI bALagatAta.
yA Aheta allAhacyA AyatI, jyA AmhI tumhAlA satyAsaha aikavita Ahota, tevhA allAha ANi tyAcyA AyatInaMtara he (akhera) koNatyA goSTIvara ImAna rAkhatIla?
dhiHkkAra (ANi kheda Ahe) pratyeka khoTyA aparAdhIbAbata.
allAhacyA AyatI ApalyAsamora vAcalyA jAta asatAnA jo aikela, tarIhI garva karIla azA prakAre aDUna rAhAvA, jaNU tyAne aikaleca nAhI, tara azA lokAMnA duHkhadAyaka zikSecI khabara dyA.
ANi jevhA to AmacyA AyatIMpaikI ekhAdyA AyatIcI khabara miLavito tevhA ticI thaTTA uDavito. heca te loka hota, jyAMcyAkaritA apamAnadAyaka az2Aba (zikSA-yAtanA) Ahe.

tyAMcyA mAge jahannama Ahe, je kAhI tyAMnI sAdhya kele hote, te tyAMnA kAhIca upayogI paDaNAra nAhI ANi nA te (kAhI upayogI paDatIla) jyAMnA tyAMnI allAhakherIja valI (saMrakSaka, mitra) banavUna Thevale hote. tyAMcyAsAThI tara moThA bhayaMMkara az2Aba Ahe.
he (paripUrNa) mArgadarzana Ahe, ANi jyA lokAMnI ApalyA pAlanakartyAcyA AyatIMcA inkAra kelA, tyAMcyAsAThI moThI kaThINa zikSA - yAtanA Ahe.
allAhaca Ahe jyAne tumacyAsAThI samudrAlA tAbedAra banavile, yAsAThI kI tyAcyA AdezAne tyAta naukA cAlAvyAta ANi tumhI tyAcyA kRpecA zodha ghyAvA ANi yAsAThI kI tumhI tyAcyAzI kRtajJa vhAve.
ANi AkAzAMcyA va dharatIcyA pratyeka vastUlAhI tyAne ApalyAtarphe tumacyA seveta lAvUna Thevale Ahe, niHsaMzaya, vicAra-ciMtana karaNAr2yA lokAMnA yAta aneka nizANyA ADhaLUna yetIla.

tumhI ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMnA sAMgA kI tyAMnI azA lokAMnA mApha karata rAhAve, je allAhacyA divasAMcI AzA bALagata nAhI, yAsAThI kI sarvazreSTha allAhane ekA janamasUhAcyA lokAMnA tyAMcyA duSkRtyAMcA mobadalA dyAvA.
jo koNI satkarma karIla to ApalyA svataHcyA bhalyAkaritA ANi jo duSkarma karIla, tyAcI duSpariNatI tyAcyAvaraca Ahe. maga tumhI sarva ApalyA pAlanakartyAkaDe paratavile jAla.

ANi niHsaMzaya, AmhI isrAIlacyA saMtatIlA graMtha, rAjyasattA ANi paigaMbarapada pradAna kele hote, ANi AmhI tyAMnA pAka (svaccha - zuddha) va cAMgalI rojI (AjivikA) pradAna kelI hotI, ANi tyAMnA jagAtIla lokAMvara zreSThatA pradAna kelI hotI.

ANi AmhI tyAMnA dharmAcyA spaSTa nizANyA pradAna kelyA, maga tyAMnI ApalyAjavaLa jJAna yeUna pohocalyAnaMtara ApasAtIla dveSa-vivAdApAyI matabheda kelA. he jyA jyA goSTIta matabheda karIta Aheta tyAMcA phaisalA kayAmatacyA divazI tyAMcyA daramyAna tumacA pAlanakartA svataH karIla.
maga AmhI tumhAlA dharmAcyA (spaSTa) mArgAvara kAyama kele. tevhA tumhI tyAca mArgAce anusaraNa karIta rAhA ANi nAdAna aDANI lokAMcyA icchA AkAMkSAMce anusaraNa karU nakA.

(lakSAta ThevA) kI he loka kadhIhI allAhasamora tumacyA kAhIca kAmI yeU zakata nAhI (jANUna ghyA kI) atyAcArI loka ApasAta ekamekAMce mitra asatAta ANi allAhace bhaya rAkhaNAr2yAMcA sakhA - sobatI, mahAna allAha Ahe.
hA kuraAna lokAMkaritA aMtardRSTIcyA goSTI ANi mArgadarzana va dayA Ahe, tyA lokAMkaritA je vizvAsa rAkhatAta.

kAya tyA lokAMnI, je vAITa karma karatAta, ase samajUna ghetale Ahe kI AmhI tyAMnA tyA lokAMsArakhe TharavU, jyAMnI ImAna rAkhale ANi satkarma karIta rAhile kI tyAMce jagaNe-maraNe ekasamAna vhAve. moThA vAITa phaisalA Ahe, jo te karIta Aheta.
ANi AkAzAMnA va dharatIlA allAhane atizaya nyAyAsaha nirmANa kele Ahe ANi yAsAThI kI pratyeka mANasAlA tyAcyA kRta-karmAcA purepUra mobadalA dilA jAvA ANi tyAMcyAvara julUma kelA jANAra nAhI.

kAya tumhI tyAlAhI pAhile, jyAne ApalyA manAcyA icchelA ApalA upAsya (mAbUda) banavUna Thevale Ahe ANi allAhane jANIvapUrvaka tyAlA pathabhraSTa kele Ahe ANi tyAcyA kAnAvara ANi hRdayAMvara mohara lAvalI Ahe ANi tyAcyA DoLyAMvara paDadA TAkalA Ahe, AtA azA mANasAlA allAhanaMtara koNa mArgadarzana karU zakato? kAya ajUnahI tumhI bodha grahaNa karIta nAhIta?

ANi te mhaNAle, Amace jIvana kevaLa yAca jagAce jIvana Ahe, AmhI maraNa pAvato ANi jagato ANi AmhAlA kevaLa kALaca maraNa deto. (vastutaH) tyAMnA tyAce kAhI jJAnaca nAhI, he tara kevaLa anumAna ANi aTakaLIcAca vApara karatAta.
ANi jevhA tyAMcyAsamora AmacyA spaSTa AyatIMce paThaNa kele jAte tevhA tyAMcyAjavaLa yA kathanAkherIja koNatehI pramANa nasate kI jara tumhI sacce asAla tara AmacyA vADavaDilAMnA gheUna yA.
(tumhI) sAMgA kI allAhaca tumhAlA jivaMta karato, maga tumhAlA mRtyu deto, maga tumhAlA kayAmatacyA divazI ekatrita karIla, jyAbAbata kasalIhI zaMkA nAhI, paraMtu adhikAMza loka he jANata nAhIta.
ANi AkAzAMcI va dharatIcI rAjyasattA allAhacIca Ahe ANi jyA divazI kayAmata prasthApita hoIla tyA divazI asatyAce pujArI moThyA toTyAta rAhatIla.
ANi tumhI pAhAla kI pratyeka janasamUha guDaghe TekUna paDalA asela. pratyeka samUha ApalyA karma-lekhAkaDe bolAvilA jAIla. Aja tumhAlA ApalyA kRta-karmAcA mobadalA dilA jAIla.
hA Ahe AmacA graMtha, jo tumacyAviSayI khare khare bolata Ahe. AmhI tumacI karme lihavUna gheta hoto.
tevhA, jyAMnI ImAna rAkhale va je satkarma karIta rAhile tara tyAMnA tyAMcA pAlanakartA (allAha) ApalyA dayA - kRpecyA sAvalIta gheIla, hIca spaSTa saphalatA Ahe.
paratu jyA lokAMnI kupra (inkAra) kelA, tara (mI tyAMnA pharmAvina) kI kAya mAjhyA AyatI tumhAlA aikavilyA jAta navhatyA? tarIhI tumhI garva karIta rAhile ANi tumhI hoteca aparAdhI loka.

ANi jevhA kadhI sAMgitale jAta ase kI allAhacA vAyadA nizcitaca kharA Ahe ANi kayAmatacyA yeNyAbAbata kasalIhI zaMkA nAhI, tevhA tumhI uttara deta kI AmhI nAhI jANata kayAmata kAya Ahe. AmacyA manAta asAca kAhI vicAra yeto, paraMtu AmhAlA khAtrI nAhI.
ANi tyAMcyAvara tyAMcyA karmAMcA vAITapaNA ughaDa jhAlA ANi jyA goSTIcI te thaTTA uDavita rAhile, tineca tyAMnA gherale.
ANi sAMgitale gele kI Aja AmhI tumacA visara pADU jasA tumhI ApalyA yA divasAcyA bheTIcA visara pADalA hotA, tumace ThikANa jahannama Ahe ANi tumacI madata karaNArA koNIhI nAhI.

he azAsAThI kI tumhI allAhacyA AyatIMcI thaTTA uDavilI hotI, ANi aihika jIvanAne tumhAlA dhokyAta TAkale hote tevhA AjacyA divazI nA tara te (jahannamamadhUna) bAhera kADhale jAtIla ANi nA tyAMcyAkaDUna lAcArI va bahANA kabUla kelA jAIla.
tevhA sarva prazaMsA allAhakaritA Ahe, jo AkAzAMcA va jaminIcA, ANi sarva vizvAMcA pAlanakartA Ahe.
ANi samasta (prazaMsA va) mahAnatA, AkAzAMmadhye va dharatIta tyAcIca Ahe, ANi toca varcasvazAlI ANi hikamata bALagaNArA Ahe.
hA mIma.
yA graMthAlA avatarita karaNe, jabaradasta hikamata (buddhikauzalya) bALagaNAr2yA allAhatarphe Ahe.

AmhI AkAzAMnA ANi dharatIlA ANi tyA doghAMcyA daramyAnacyA samasta vastUMnA ati uttama yojanesaha nirdhArita avadhIkaritA banavile Ahe ANi kAphira lokAMnA jyA goSTIce bhaya dAkhavile jAte ticyApAsUna toMDa phiravitAta.

(tumhI) sAMgA kI, bare jyAMnA tumhI allAhakherIja pukAratA, malAhI dAkhavA kI tyAMnI jaminIcA koNatA hissA banavilA Ahe kiMvA AkAzAMmadhye tyAMcA koNatA hissA Ahe? jara tumhI sacce asAla tara yAcyA pUrvIcAca evAdA graMtha kiMvA ekhAde jJAna, je ud‌dhRta kele jAta asela, mAjhyAjavaLa ANA.

ANi tyAhUna jAsta mArgabhraSTa dusarA koNa asela, jo allAhakherIja azAMnA pukArato, je kayAmataparyaMta tyAcI duA - prArthanA kabUla karU zakaNAra nAhIta, ulaTa tyAcyA pukAraNyApAsUna gAphIlaca asAveta.
ANi jevhA lokAMnA ekatra kele jAIla, tevhA he tyAMce vairI hotIla ANi yAMcyA upAsanecA sApha inkAra karatIla.
