ANi jevhA tyAMnA AmacyA spaSTa AyatI vAcUna aikavilyA jAtAta tevhA kAphira loka satya goSTIsa, jevhA tI tyAMcyAprata yeUna pohocalI, sAMgatAta kI hI tara ughaDa jAdU Ahe.

kAya te ase mhaNatAta kI te tara tyAne svataH banavile Ahe. (tumhI) sAMgA kI jara mIca te banavUna ANale Ahe tara tumhI mAjhyAsAThI allAhatarphe koNatyAhI goSTIcA adhikAra bALagata nAhI. tumhI yA kuraAnAviSayI je kAhI sAMgata aikata AhAta, te allAha cAMgalyA prakAre jANato. mAjhyA ANi tumacyA daramyAna sAkSa deNyAsa toca puresA Ahe ANi to moThA mApha karaNArA, moThA dayAvAna Ahe.

(tumhI) sAMgA kI mI kAhI agadI navIna paigaMbara tara nAhI ANi nA malA he mAhIta kI mAjhyAzI va tumacyAzI kasA vyavahAra kelA jAIla. mI tara phakta tyAca goSTIce anusaraNa karato, jI mAjhyAkaDe vahayI kelI jAte ANi mI tara spaSTapaNe sAvadha karaNArA Ahe.

(tumhI) sAMgA kI jara hA kuraAna allAhatarphe asela ANi tumhI tyAsa mAnya kele nasela ANi isrAilacyA saMtatIcA eka sAkSI tyAsArakhI sAkSahI deUna cukalA asela ANi tyAne ImAnahI rAkhale asela ANi tumhI vidroha kelA asela tara niHsaMzaya, allAha atyAcArI lokAMnA mArga dAkhavita nAhI.

ANi kAphira (inkArI) loka ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMviSayI mhaNAle kI jara hA (dharma) cAMgalA asatA tara he loka tyAcyAkaDe AmacyA AdhI jAU zakale nasate ANi jyAarthI tyAMnI kuraAnApAsUna mArgadarzana prApta kele nAhI, tevhA ase mhaNatIla kI he june asatya Ahe.

ANi yAcyApUrvI mUsAcA graMtha mArgadarzaka va dayA mhaNUna hotA, ANi hA graMtha tyAce satya-samarthana karaNArA Ahe arabI bhASeta, yAsAThI kI atyAcArI lokAMnA bhaya dAkhavAve ANi allAhace bhaya bALagaNAr2yA lokAMsAThI zubha samAcAra TharAvA.
niHsaMzaya, jyA lokAMnI sAMgitale kI AmacA svAmI va pAlanakartA allAha Ahe, maga tyAvara aTaLa rAhileta tara azA lokAMnA nA kasale bhaya rAhIla ANi nA te duHkhI hotIla.
he tara jannatamadhye jANAre loka Aheta, je sadaiva ticyAtaca rAhatIla, tyA karmAMcyA mobadalyAta je te karIta hote.

ANi AmhI mANasAlA, ApalyA mAtA-pityAzI sad‌vartana karaNyAcA Adeza dilA Ahe. tyAcyA mAtene tyAlA kaSTa-yAtanA jhelUna udarAta Thevale ANi yAtanA sahana karUna tyAlA janma dilA. tyAcI garbhadhAraNA ANi tyAce dUdha soDaviNyAcI mudata tIsa mahinyAMcI Ahe.yetheparyarMta kI jevhA to ApalyA pUrNa vayAsa (taruNa vayAsa) ANi cALIsa varSAMcyA vayAsa pohacalA, tevhA mhaNU lAgalA, he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! malA tauphIka (subuddhI) de kI mI tujhyA tyA deNagIbaddala kRtajJatA vyakta karU zakAve, jI tU malA ANi mAjhyA mAtA-pityAsa pradAna kelI Ahe ANi he kI mI azI satkarme karAvIta, jyAMnI tU prasanna vhAve ANi tU mAjhyA saMtatIlAhI neka sadAcArI banava. mI tujhyAkaDe lakSa keMdrita karato ANi mI muslimAMpaikI Ahe.
heca te loka hota, jyAMcI satkarme AmhI kabUla karato ANi duSkarmAMnA mApha karato, (he) jannatamadhye dAkhala hoNAr2yA lokAMpaikI Aheta, tyA saccA vAyadyAnusAra, jo tyAMcyAzI kelA jAta hotA.

ANi jyAne ApalyA mAtA-pityAsa mhaTale kI, dhiHkkAra aso tumacA (mI tumacyApAsUna agadI bejAra jhAlo) tumhI malA heca sAMgata rAhAla kI (mI melyAnaMtara punhA dusar2yAMdA) jivaMta kelA jAIla, mAjhyApUrvIhI aneka janasamUha hoUna geleta. te doghe allAhacyA darabArAta vinaMtI (gAr2hANe) karatAta, (ANi mhaNatAta) vAITa hovo tujhe, tU ImAna rAkhaNArA ho, niHsaMzaya, allAhacA vAyadA saccA Ahe, to uttara deto kI he tara kevaLa pUrvI hoUna gelelyA lokAMce kisse Aheta.
(heca) te loka hota, jyAMcyAvara allAha (cyA az2Aba) ce pharmAna lAgU jhAle tyA jinna ANi mAnavAMcyA samUhAMsobata, je tyAMcyApUrvI hoUna geleta he nizcitapaNe toTyAta rAhile.
ANi pratyekAlA ApApalyA AcaraNAnusAra darjA miLela, yAsAThI kI tyAMnA tyAMcyA karmAMcA purepUra mobadalA dyAvA ANi tyAMcyAvara julUma atyAcAra kelA jANAra nAhI.

ANi jyA divazI kAphirAMnA jahannamacyA kinAr2yAzI ANale jAIla, (tevhA sAMgitale jAIla) kI tumhI ApalI satkarme aihika jIvanAtaca saMpavUna TAkalIta ANi tyAMcyApAsUna lAbha prApta karUna ghetalA, tevhA Aja tumhAlA apamAnadAyaka zikSA-yAtanecA daMDa dilA jAIla, yA kAraNAne kI tumhI dharatIvara ahaMkAra karIta hote ANi yA kAraNAnehI kI tumhI AdezAce pAlana karIta navhate.

ANi AdacyA bhAvAce smaraNa karA, jevhA tyAne ApalyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMnA ahakAphamadhye (vALUcyA TekaDIvara) khabaradAra kele, ANi niHsaMzaya, tyAcyA pUrvIhI bhaya dAkhaviNAre hoUna geleta ANi tyAcyA naMtarahI kI tumhI allAhakherIja dusar2yAMcI upAsanA karU nakA. niHsaMzaya, malA tumacyAbaddala moThyA divasAcyA az2Abace bhaya vATate.

janasamUhAcyA lokAMnI uttara dile kI kAya tumhI AmacyAjavaLa azAsAThI AlAta kI AmhAlA AmacyA daivatAMcI pUjA arcanA karaNyApAsUna rokhAve, tevhA jara tumhI sacce asAla tara jyA zikSA - yAtanAM (az2Aba) cA tumhI vAyadA karIta AhAta, tyA AmacyAvara ANUna soDA.
(hajarata hUda) mhaNAle, (yAce) jJAna tara allAhajavaLa Ahe. malA tara jo saMdeza deUna pAThavile gele Ahe, toca tumhAlA mI pohacavita Ahe, paraMtu mI ase pAhato kI tumhI mUrkhapaNA karIta AhAta.

maga jevhA tyAMnI az2Aba (zikSA - yAtane) lA DhagAcyA svarUpAta pAhile ApalyA maidAnAMkaDe yeta asalelA, tevhA mhaNU lAgale kI hA Dhaga AmacyAvara pAUsa pADaNAra Ahe (navhe), kiMbahunA, vastutaH hA Dhaga to (prakopa) Ahe jyAcI tumhI ghAI mAjavita hote. hI havA (vAdaLa) Ahe jyAta duHkhadAyaka az2Aba (zikSA - yAtanA) Ahe.

jI ApalyA pAlanakartyAcyA AdezAne, pratyeka vastUMcA vidhvaMsa karUna TAkIla, tevhA tyAMcI azI avasthA jhAlI kI tyAMcyA gharAMkherIja dusare kAhI disUna yeta navhate. aparAdhyAMcyA samUhAlA AmhI azAca prakAre zikSA deto.

ANi nizcitapaNe AmhI (AdacyA samudAyAlA) te zaktI-sAmarthya pradAna kele hote, je tumhAlA dileca nAhI ANi AmhI tyAMnA kAna, DoLe ANi hRdayehI deUna ThevalI hotI, paraMtu tyAMcyA kAMnAnI, DoLyAMnI ANi hRdayAMnI tyAMnA kAhIca lAbha pohacavilA nAhI. jevhA te allAhacyA AyatIMcA inkAra karU lAgale ANi jyA goSTIcI te thaTTA uDavita asata, tIca tyAMcyAvara ulaTalI.
ANi niHsaMzaya, AmhI tumacyA javaLapAsa (pradezA) cyA vastyAMcA nAyanATa karUna TAkalA, ANi (aneka prakAre) AmhI ApalyA nizANyA sAdara kelyA, yAsAThI kI tyAMnI (allAhakaDe) vaLAve.

tevhA allAhace sAnnidhya prApta karaNyAkaritA tyAMnI jyAMnA jyAMnA upAsya (daivata) banavUna Thevale hote, tyAMnI tyAMcI madata kA nAhI kelI, kiMbahunA te tara tyAMcyApAsUna haravale geleta (vastutaH) he tyAMce kevaLa asatya ANi (pUrNataH) mithyAropa hotA.

ANi smaraNa karA, jevhA AmhI jinnAMcA eka samUha tumacyAkaDe vaLavilA, yAsAThI kI tyAMnI kuraAna aikAve, tara jevhA te paigaMbarAMjavaLa pohacale, tevhA (ekamekAMnA) mhaNU lAgale kI gappa rAhA. maga jevhA paThaNa samApta jhAle tevhA ApalyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMnA khabaradAra karaNyAkaritA paratale.

mhaNAle, he AmacyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMno! AmhI khAtrIne to graMtha aikalA Ahe, jo mUsA (alai.) naMtara avatarita kelA gelA Ahe, jo ApalyA pUrvIcyA graMthAcI puSTI karaNArA Ahe, jo satya-dharma ANi saraLa mArgAkaDe mArgadarzana karato.

he AmacyA jAtIsamUhAcyA lokAMno! allAhakaDe bolaviNAr2yAce mhaNaNe mAnya karA, tyAcyAvara ImAna rAkhA, tara (allAha) tumace kAhI aparAdha mApha karIla ANi tumhAlA duHkhadAyaka az2Aba (zikSA - yAtane) pAsUna vAcavIla.

ANi jo manuSya allAhakaDe bolaviNAr2yAce mhaNaNe mAnaNAra nAhI tara to jaminIvara koThehI (paLUna jAUna allAhalA) lAcAra karU zakata nAhI ANi nA allAhakherIja tyAlA koNI madata karaNArA asela, he loka ughaDa mArgabhraSTateta Aheta.

kAya te nAhI pAhata kI jyA allAhane AkAzAMnA va dharatIlA nirmANa kele Ahe ANi tyAMcI nirmitI karUna to thakalA nAhI, to niHsaMzaya mRtAMnA jivaMta karaNyAce sAmarthya bALagato, kA navhe? niHsaMzaya, to pratyeka goSTIce sAmarthya bALagato.

ANi te loka jyAMnI kupra (inkAra) kelA jyA divazI jahannamacyA samora ANale jAtIla (ANi tyAMnA sAMgitale jAIla) kI kAya he satya nAhI? tevhA te uttara detIla kI hoya, kA navhe? zapatha Ahe AmacyA pAlanakartyAcI (he agadI satya Ahe). (allAha) pharmAvila kI AtA ApalyA inkArAcyA mobadalyAta az2AbacA svAda cAkhA.

tevhA (he paigaMbarA!) tumhI ase dhairya rAkhA, jase dhairya dRDhasaMkalpa ANi sAhasa bALagaNAr2yA paigaMbarAMnI rAkhale, ANi tyAMcyAsAThI (zikSA mAgaNyAta) ghAI karU nakA. he jyA divazI to az2Aba pAhUna ghetIla jyAcA vAyadA tyAMnA dilA jAta Ahe, tevhA (tyAMnA he jANavU lAgela kI) divasAcI eka ghaTikA mAtra (te jagAta) rAhile hote. he Ahe saMdeza pohacaviNe. durAcArI lokAMkherIja koNI naSTa kelA jANAra nAhI.
jyA lokAMnI kupra (inkAra) kelA ANi allAhacyA mArgApAsUna rokhale, allAhane tyAMcI karme niSphaLa karUna TAkalIta.

ANi jyA lokAMnI ImAna rAkhaleta ANi satkarme kelIta ANi tyAvarahI vizvAsa rAkhalA jo muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi vasallama) vara avatarita kelA gelA Ahe ANi vastutaH tyAMcyA pAlanakartyAtarphe satya (dharma) dekhIla toca Ahe. allAhane tyAce aparAdha miTavile ANi tyAMcyA avastheta sudhAraNA kelI.

he azAsAThI kI kAphira (inkArI) lokAMnI asatyAce anusaraNa kele ANi ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMnI tyA satya (dharmA) ce anusaraNa kele, jo tyAMcyA pAlanakartyAtarphe Ahe. allAha lokAMnA tyAMcI sthitI azA prakAre darzavito.

tara jevhA kAphirAMzI tumacA sAmanA hoIla, tevhA tyAcyA mAnAMvara vAra karA yethe paryarMta kI jevhA tyAMnA khUpa cAMgalyA prakAre ThecUna kADhAla, tara AtA khUpa majabUta kArAgRhAta kaida karA (maga tumhAlA adhikAra Ahe kI) upakAra karUna kaidetUna mukta karA kiMvA kAhI arthadaMDa (phidiyA) gheUna, joparyaMta yuddha (karaNAre) Apale zastra khAlI ThevatIla. hAca Adeza Ahe ANi jara allAhane icchile asate tara svataHca tyAMcA sUDa ghetalA asatA, paraMtu (to ase icchito) kI tumacyApaikI ekAcI parIkSA dusar2yAkaDUna ghyAvI ANi je loka allAhacyA mArgAta zahIda kele jAtAta, allAha tyAMcI karme kadhIhI vAyA jAU deNAra nAhI.
to tyAMnA mArgadarzana karIla ANi tyAMcyA avastheta sudhAraNA karIla.
ANi tyAMnA tyA jannatamadhye dAkhala karIla, jicA paricaya tyAMnA karUna dilA gelA Ahe.
he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! jara tumhI allAha (cyA dharmA) cI madata karAla, tara to tumacI madata karela ANi tumace pAya majabUta (sthira) rAkhela.
ANi je loka kAphira (inkArI) jhAleta, tyAMcA sarvanAza aso, allAhane tyAMcI karme niSphaLa kelI.
he azAsAThI kI allAhane avatarita kelelyA goSTIpAsUna nArAja jhAle, tevhA allAhane dekhIla tyAMcI karme vAyA ghAlavalIta.

kAya tyA lokAMnI jaminIvara hiMDUna phirUna yA goSTIce nirIkSaNa nAhI kele kI tyAMcyA pUrvI hoUna gelelyA lokAMcI kAya pariNItI jhAlI? allAhane tyAMnA naSTa karUna TAkale ANi kAphirAMsAThI azIca zikSA Ahe.
te yAsAThI kI ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMcA saMrakSaka svataH allAha Ahe, ANi yAsAThI kI kAphira lokAMcA koNIhI saMrakSaka nAhI.

jyA lokAMnI ImAna rAkhale ANi satkarme kelIta, tyAMnA allAha nizcitapaNe azA bAgAMmadhye dAkhala karIla, jyAMcyAkhAlI pravAha vAhata Aheta ANi je loka kAphira (inkArI) jhAleta, te (kevaLa yA jagAcAca) lAbha gheta Aheta ANi janAvarAMsArakhe khAta Aheta. tyAMce (khare) ThikANa jahannama Ahe.
ANi AmhI kityeka vastyAMnA, jyA zaktI-sAmarthyAta tumacyA yA vastIpekSA adhika hotyA, jicyAtUna tumhAlA bAhera kADhale gele. AmhI tyAMnA naSTa karUna TAkale, jyAMcI madata karaNArA koNIhI navhatA.

kAya te loka, je ApalyA pAlanakartyAtarphe spaSTa pramANAvara asAveta tyA mANasAsArakhe asU zakatAta, jyAcyAsAThI tyAcI duSkarme cAMgalI (suzobhita) banavilI gelI asAvI. ANi to ApalyA icchA AkAMkSAMce anusaraNa karata asAvA?

tyA jannatace vaiziSTya, jicA vAyadA allAhace bhaya rAkhaNAr2yA lokAMzI kelA gelA Ahe, ase Ahe kI ticyAta (zItala) jalapravAha vAhata Aheta, jyAMnA durgaMdha nAhI ANi dudhAcyA nadyA Aheta, jyAMcA svAda badalaNAra nAhI. ANi madyAce pravAha Aheta. jyAMcyAta piNAr2yAMkaritA khUpa svAda Ahe ANi sraccha nirbheLa madhAce pravAha Aheta, ANi tyAMcyAsAThI tithe pratyeka prakArace meve (phaLa) Aheta, ANi tyAMcyA pAlanakartyAtarphe kSamA Ahe, kAya he tyA lokAMsamAna Aheta, je nehamI AgIta rAhaNAre Aheta ANi jyAMnA khUpa garama ukaLate pANI pAjale jAIla, je tyAMcyA AtaDIMce tukaDe tukaDe karIla.

ANi tyAMcyApaikI kAhI (asehI Aheta kI) je tumacyAkaDe kAna lAvatAta yetheparyaMta kI jevhA tumacyA javaLUna jAtAta, tevhA jJAna bALagaNAr2yAMnA (sustI ANi bAvaLaTapaNe) vicAratAta kI tyAne (paigaMbarAne) AtA evaDhyAta kAya sAMgitale hote? heca loka hota, jyAMcyA hRdayAMvara allAhane mohara lAvalI Ahe ANi te ApalyA icchA AkAMkSAMce anusaraNa karatAta.
ANi jyA lokAMnI sanmArga prApta karUna ghetalA Ahe, allAhane tyAMcyA mArgadarzanAta ANakhI vADha kelI Ahe, ANi tyAMnA tyAMcA sadAcAra pradAna kelA Ahe.

tara kAya he loka kayAmatacI pratIkSA karIta Aheta kI tI tyAMcyAjavaLa acAnaka yeUna pohacAvI. niHsaMzaya, ticI lakSaNe tara jAhIra jhAlI Aheta, maga jevhA kayAmata tyAMcyAjavaLa yeUna pohocela, tevhA tyAMcyAsAThI bodha prApta karaNyAcI saMdhI koThe bAkI rAhIla?

tevhA (he paigaMbara!) tumhI khAtrI bALagA kI allAhakherIja dusarA koNI (saccA) upAsya nAhI, ANi ApalyA aparAdhAMcI mAphI mAgata rAhA ANi ImAna rAkhaNAr2yA puruSAMkaritA va ImAna rAkhaNAr2yA striyAMkaritAhI allAha tumacyA yeNyA-jANyAcyA va nivAsAcyA ThikANAsa cAMgalyA prakAre jANato.

ANi jyAMnI ImAna rAkhale te mhaNatAta kI ekhAdI sUraha (adhyAya) kA nAhI avatarita kelI gelI, maga jevhA ekhAdI spaSTa arthAcI sUraha avatarita kelI jAte ANi ticyAta jihAdacA ullekha kelA jAto, tevhA tumhI pAhatA kI jyAMcyA manAta roga Ahe, te tumacyAkaDe azA prakAre pAhatAta jase to manuSya pAhato, jo mRtyune mUrchita jhAlA asela. tevhA phAra cAMgale hote tyAMcyAkaritA.
AjJApAlana karaNe ANi bhalyA cAMgalyA goSTI bolaNe maga jevhA kArya nirdhArita hoIla, tevhA jara te allAhazI sacoTIne rAhatIla tara tyAMcyAsAThI bhalAI Ahe.
ANi tumacyAkaDUna tehI dUra (asaMbhava) nAhI kI jara tumhAlA rAjya lAbhela, tara tumhI dharatIvara utpAta (phasAda) nirmANa karAla ANi nAte saMbaMdha toDAla.
heca te loka hota, jyAMcA allAhane dhiHkkAra kelA Ahe ANi (allAhane) jyAMcI zravaNa zaktI ANi DoLyAMcA prakAza hirAvUna ghetalA Ahe.
kAya he loka kuraAnAvara vicAra ciMtana nAhI karIta kiMvA tyAMcyA hRdayAMvara kulupe lAvalI gelI Aheta?
jyA lokAMnI mArgadarzana spaSTa jhAlyAnaMtarahI ApalI pATha phiravalI tara niHsaMzaya, saitAnAne tyAMcyAkaritA (tyAMcyA karmAMnA) suzobhita kele Ahe ANi tyAMnA DhIla (savaDa) deUna ThevalI Ahe.

he azAsAThI kI, tyAMnI tyA lokAMnA, jyAMnI allAhane avatarita kelelyA (vahayI)lA nApasaMta kele, he sAMgitale kI AmhIhI nikaTa bhaviSyAta kAhI kAmAMmadhye tumace mhaNaNe mAnya karUna ANi allAha tyAMcyA rahasyabhedAMnA cAMgalyA prakAre jANato.
tevhA tyAMcI kazI durAvasthA hoIla, jevhA pharizte tyAMce prANa kADhatAnA tyAMcyA toMDAvara ANi kaMbarevara mAratIla.
he yA kAraNAstava kI yAMnI tyA mArgAce anusaraNa kele, jyAmuLe (tyAMnI) allAhalA nArAja kele ANi tyAMnI tyAcyA prasannatelA vAITa jANale, tevhA allAhane tyAMcyA karmAMnA niSphaLa kele.
kAya tyA lokAMnI, jyAMcyA manAta roga (vikRtI) Ahe, ase samajUna ghetale Ahe kI allAha tyAMce kapaTa jAhIra karaNAraca nAhI.

ANi jara AmhI icchile asate tara tumhAlA, tyA sarvAMnA dAkhavile asate tevhA tumhI tyAMcyA cehar2yAMvarUnaca tyAMnA oLakhale asate, ANi niHsaMzaya, tumhI tyAMnA tyAMcyA saMbhASaNa zailIvarUna oLakhAla, tumacI samasta karme allAha jANUna Ahe.
ANi niHsaMzaya AmhI tumacI kasoTI gheU yAsAThI kI tumacyApaikI jihAda karaNAr2yAMnA ANi dhairya-saMyama rAkhaNAr2yAMnA pAhAve, ANi tumacyA avasthAMcIhI jAca paDatALa karUna ghyAvI.

niHsaMzaya, jyA lokAMnI kupra (inkAra) kelA ANi allAhacyA mArgApAsUna lokAMnA rokhale ANi paigaMbarAcA virodha kelA yAnaMtara kI tyAMcyAsAThI mArgadarzana spaSTa jhAle, he kadhIhI allAhalA kasalehI nukasAna pohacaviNAra nAhIta. allAha lavakaraca tyAMcyA karmAMnA naSTa karUna TAkIla.
he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! allAhace AjJApAlana karA ANi paigaMbarAMce AjJApAlana karA ANi ApalI karme vAyA ghAlavU nakA.
niHsaMzaya, jyA lokAMnI kupra (inkAra) kelA ANi allAhacyA mArgApAsUna (dusar2yAMnA) rokhale, maga kupracyA avasthetaca maraNa pAvale (vizvAsa rAkhA kI) allAha tyA lokAMnA kadhIhI mApha karaNAra nAhI.

tevhA tumhI kamajora banUna taha (samajotA) cI vinaMtI karaNyAcyA starAvara yeU nakA, jevhA kI tumhIca (vijayI ANi) varcasvazAlI rAhAla,1 ANi allAha tumacyA sobatIlA Ahe (ApalyA jJAnAdvAre) azakya Ahe kI to tumacI karme vAyA ghAlavila.

vastutaH yA jagAce jIvana tara kheLa tamAzA Ahe ANi jara tumhI ImAna rAkhAla ANi allAhace bhaya (takavA) aMgIkArAla, tara allAha tumhAlA tumacyA karmAMcA mobadalA pradAna karIla ANi to tumacyAkaDUna tumacI dhana-daulata mAgata nAhI.
jara to tumacyAkaDUna tumace dhana mAgela ANi balapUrvaka mAgela tara tumhI tyAcyAzI kaMjUsapaNA karU lAgAla ANi to tumacA vyaMga- doSa jAhIra karela.

khabaradAra! tumhI te loka AhAta kI allAhacyA mArgAta kharca karaNyAsAThI bolavile jAtAta, tevhA tumacyApaikI kAhI jaNa kaMjUsapaNA karU lAgatAta ANi jo kaMjUsapaNA karato, to niHsaMzaya svataHzIca kaMjUsapaNA karato. sarvazreSTha allAha niHspRha Ahe ANi tumhI garajavaMta AhAta, ANi jara tumhI toMDa phiraviNAre vhAla tara to tumacyA jAgI, tumacyAkherIja dusar2yA lokAMnA ANila je maga tumacyAsArakhe nasatIla.
niHsaMzaya, (he paigaMbara!) AmhI tumhAlA eka khulA vijaya pradAna kelA Ahe.
yAsAThI kI allAhane tumacyA puDhacyA mAgacyA cukA mApha karAvyAta, ANi tumacyAvara ApalI kRpA-deNagI pUrNa karAvI ANi tumhAlA saraLa mArgAvara cAlavAve.
ANi tumhAlA eka bharapUra madata pradAna karAvI.

toca Ahe jyAne musalamAnAMcyA manAta zAMtI (ANi AtmivazvAsa) avatarita kelA, yAsAThI kI tyAMnI ApalyA ImAnAsobataca ANakhI jAsta ImAnAta vRddhiMgata vhAve. ANi AkAzAMcI va dharatIcI samasta sainye allAhacIca Aheta, ANi allAha jANaNArA, hikamatazAlI Ahe.

yAsAThI kI muslima puruSAMnA ANi striyAMnA tyA jannatIMmadhye dAkhala karAve, jyAMcyA khAlI pravAha vAhata Aheta, jithe te sadaiva kALa rAhatIla ANi tyAMcyApAsUna tyAMcI duSkarme dUra karAvIta ANi allAhacyA javaLahI phAra moThI saphalatA Ahe.

ANi yAsAThI kI tyA munAphika (dAMbhika) puruSAMnA ANi munAphika striyAMnA, ANi mUrtipUjaka puruSAMnA va mUrtipUjaka striyAMnA az2Aba (zikSA) dyAvI, je allAhaviSayI gairasamaja bALagatAta (vastutaH) tyAcyAvaraca vAITapaNAce cakra Ahe. allAha tyAMcyAvara nArAja jhAlA ANi tyAne tyAMnA dhiHkkArale ANi tyAMcyAsAThI jahannama tayAra kelI ANi te paratIce moThe vAITa ThikANa Ahe.
ANi allAhacyAcakaritA AkAzAMcI ANi dharatIcI sainye Aheta, ANi allAha varcasvazAlI, hikamata bALagaNArA Ahe.
niHsaMzaya, AmhI tumhAlA sAkSa deNArA ANi zubha samAcAra aikaviNArA va khabaradAra karaNArA banavUna pAThavile Ahe.
yAsAThI kI (he ImAnadhArakAMno!) tumhI allAha ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAvara ImAna rAkhA ANi tyAlA sahAyya karA va tyAcA Adara rAkhA, ANi allAhace pAvitrya sakALa-saMdhyAkALa varNana karA.

niHsaMzaya, je loka tumacyAzI baiata (allAha ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAMce AjJApAlana va anusaraNa karaNyAcA vAyadA tAkIdapUrvaka jAhIra karaNe) karatAta, te niHsaMzaya, allAhazIca baiata karatAta. tyAMcyA hAtAvara allAhacA hAta Ahe, tevhA jo manuSya vacana bhaMga karIla tara to svataHvaraca vacana bhaMga karato, ANi jo manuSya to vAyadA pUrNa karIla, jo tyAne allAhazI kelA Ahe, tara tyAlA lavakaraca allAha phAra mahAna mobadalA pradAna karIla.

grAmINAMpaikI je mAge soDUna dile gele hote, te AtA tumhAlA nizcita mhaNatIla kI AmhI ApalyA dhana-saMpattI va saMtatItaca vyasta rAhilo, tevhA tumhI AmacyAsAThI mAphIcI duA-prArthanA karA. he loka ApalyA toMDAMnI te bolatAta, je tyAMcyA manAta nAhI. tumhI uttara dyA kI tumacyAsAThI allAhatarphe ekhAdyA goSTIcAhI adhikAra koNa bALagato, jara to tumhAlA nukasAna pohacavU icchila kiMvA tumhAlA kAhI lAbha pohacavU icchila? kiMbahunA tumhI je kAhI karIta AhAta, allAha te cAMgalyA prakAre jANato.

(navhe) kiMbahunA tumhI tara ase gRhIta dharale hote kI paigaMbara ANi musalamAnAMce ApalyA gharAMkaDe parataNe agadI azakya Ahe ANi hAca vicAra tumacyA manAMmadhye rujalA, tumhI durAgraha bALagalA hotA (vAstavika) tumhI loka AhAtaca naSTa hoNAre.
ANi jo manuSya allAhavara ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAvara ImAna rAkhaNAre nAhI tara AmhI dekhIla azA kAphirAMkaritA dhagadhagaNArI Aga tayAra karUna ThevalI Ahe.
ANi AkAzAMcI va dharatIcI rAjya-sattA allAhakaritAca Ahe to jyAlA icchila mApha karIla ANi jyAlA icchila az2Aba (zikSA) deIla ANi allAha moThA mApha karaNArA, dayA karaNArA Ahe.

jevhA tumhI (yuddhAta hAtI lAgalelA) parihAra gheNyAsa jAU lAgalA, tevhA tvarita he mAge soDalele loka mhaNatIla kI AmhAlAhI ApalyA sobata yeNyAcI AjJA dyA. te ase icchitAta kI allAhace kathana badalUna TAkAve (tumhI tyAMnA) sAMgA kI, allAhane yA AdhIca sAMgUna TAkale Ahe kI tumhI kadhIhI Amace anusaraNa na karAla tevhA te yAvara uttara detIla kI (nAhI, nAhI) kiMbahunA tumhIca AmacA matsara karatA. (kharI goSTa azI kI) he loka phAra kamI samajatAta.

(tumhI) mAge soDalelyA grAmINa lokAMnA sAMgA kI lavakaraca tumhI ekA moThyA zUravIra janasamUhAkaDe bolAvile jAla, kI tumhI tyAcyAzI yuddha karAla kiMvA te ImAnadhAraka hotIla. tevhA jara tumhI AjJApAlana karAla, tara allAha tumhAlA phAra cAMgalA mobadalA pradAna karIla ANi jara tumhI toMDa phiravile, jase kI tumhI yApUrvI toMDa phiravUna ghetale Ahe, tara to tumhAlA duHkhadAyaka zikSA yAtanA deIla.

AMdhaLyAvara kasalAhI aparAdha nAhI, nA pAMgaLyAvara kAhI aparAdha Ahe ANi nA AjArI mANasAvara kAhI aparAdha Ahe ANi jo koNI allAha ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAce AdezAce pAlana karIla, tyAlA allAha azA jannatamadhye dAkhala karIla, jicyA khAlI pravAha vAhata Aheta ANi jo toMDa phiravila, tyAlA to duHkhadAyaka az2Aba (zikSA-yAtanA) deIla.

niHsaMzaya, allAha ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMzI prasanna jhAlA, jevhA te jhADAkhAlI tumacyAzI baiata (pratijJA) karIta hote. tyAcyA manAta je kAhI hote, te tyAne mAhIta karUna ghetale ANi tyAcyAvara zAMtI avatarita kelI ANi tyAMnA nikaTacA vijaya pradAna kelA.
ANi yuddhAta jiMkalelA aneka prakAracA mAla, jo te prApta karatIla ANi allAha varcasvazAlI, hikamata bALagaNArA Ahe.

allAhane tumacyAzI khUpa jAsta yuddhAta jiMkalelyA mAlAcA vAyadA kelA Ahe, jo tumhI prApta karAla ANi he tara tumhAlA tvarita pradAna kele, ANi lokAMce hAta tumacyApAsUna rokhale, yAsAThI kI ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMkaritA hI eka nizANI TharAvI, ANi yAsAThI kI tyAne tumhAlA saraLa mArgAvara cAlavAve.

ANi (to) tumhAlA itara ganImatI (yuddhAta hAtI lAgalelA mAla) dekhIla deIla, jyAMcyAvara tumhI ajUna kAbU miLavilA nAhI allAhane tyAMnA kAbUta Thevale Ahe ANi allAha pratyeka goSTa karaNyAsa samartha Ahe.
ANi jara tumacyAzI kAphirAMnI laDhAI kelI asatI tara niHsaMzaya te pATha dAkhavUna paLAle asate. maga nA tyAMnA koNI kAryasAdhaka ADhaLalA asatA, nA koNI madata karaNArA.
allAhacyA tyA niyamAnusAra jo pahilyApAsUna cAlata AlA Ahe ANi tumhAlA allAhacyA niyamAta kadhIhI badala jhAlelA ADhaLata nAhI.

toca Ahe, jyAne khAsa makkA yethe kAphirAMcyA hAtAMnA tumacyApAsUna ANi tumacyA hAtAMnA tyAMcyApAsUna rokhale. yAnaMtara kI tyAne tumhAlA tyAMcyAvara vijayI kele, ANi tumhI je kAhI karIta AhAta allAha te sarva pAhata Ahe.

heca te loka hota, jyAMnI kupra (inkAra) kelA ANi tumhAlA masjidee harAma (kAbAgRhA) pAsUna rokhale ANi kurbAnIsAThI thAMbalelyA janAvarAMnA tyAcyA ThikANAparyaMta pohacaNyApAsUna (rokhale) ANi jara ase (aneka) muslima puruSa ANi (aneka) muslima striyA nasatyA, jyAMcI tumhAlA khabara navhatI kI tumhI tyAMnA (ajANatepaNI) ciraDUna TAkAla, jyAbaddala tyAMcyAmuLe tumhAlAhI nakaLata hAni pohacalI asatI (tara tumhAlA laDhaNyAcI anumatI dilI gelI asatI, paraMtu ase kele gele nAhI) yAsAThI kI allAhane ApalyA dayA kRpeta, jyAlA icchila tyAlA dAkhala karAve, ANi jara te vegavegaLe rAhile asate, tara tyAMcyAta je kAphira hote, AmhI tyAMnA duHkhadAyaka az2Aba (zikSA-yAtanA) dilA asatA.

jevhA tyA kAphirAMnI ApalyA manAta pakSapAta bhAvanelA sthAna dile, ANi pakSapAtahI aDANIpaNAcA, tevhA allAhane ApalyA paigaMbarAvara ANi ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMvara ApalyAtarphe zAMtI avatarita kelI, ANi ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMnA IzabhayA (takavA) cyA goSTIvara dRDharAkhale1 ANi te yA goSTIsa pAtra ANi jAsta hakkadAra hote ANi allAha pratyeka goSTIsa cAMgalyA prakAre jANato.

vastutaH allAhane ApalyA paigaMbarAlA, khare svapna dAkhavile kI jara allAhane icchile tara tumhI avazya zAMtI-surakSApUrvaka masjidee harAmamadhye dAkhala vhAla, Doke muMDavita ANi DokyAce kesa kApavUna gheta agadI nirbhaya hoUna. to tyA goSTI jANato, jyA tumhI jANata nAhIta, tevhA tyAne tumhAlA yApUrvI eka nikaTacA vijaya pradAna kelA.
toca hoya, jyAne ApalyA paigaMbarAlA mArgadarzana ANi satya dharmAsaha pAThavile, yAsAThI kI tyAlA pratyeka dharmAvara varcasvazAlI karAve, ANi sAkSa deNyAsAThI allAha puresA Ahe.

muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi vasallama) allAhace rasUla (paigaMbara) Aheta ANi je loka tyAMcyAsobata Aheta, te kAphirAMvara kaThora Aheta. ApasAta dayAzIla Aheta. tumhI tyAMnA pAhAla kI rukUa va sajade karIta Aheta. allAhacI kRpA va tyAcyA prasannatecI kAmanA karaNyAta (magna) Aheta. tyAMce nizANa tyAcyA cehar2yAMvara sajadyAMcyA prabhAvAne Ahe. tyAMcA hAca guNavizeSa (udAharaNa) taurAtamadhye Ahe ANi tyAMce udAharaNa iMjIlamadhye Ahe, tyA zetIsArakhe, jine Apale aMkUra bAhera kADhale, maga tyAlA majabUtI dilI ANi te jADa jhAle, maga ApalyA khoDAvara saraLa ubhe rAhile ANi zetakar2yAMnA AnaMdita karU lAgale, yAsAThI kI tyAMcyAmuLe kAphirAMnA ciDavAve, ANi ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMzI va neka sadAcArI lokAMzI allAhane mAphIcA ANi phAra moThyA mobadalyAcA vAyadA kelA Ahe.
he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! allAha ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAcyA puDhe jAU nakA ANi allAhace bhaya bALagata rAhA. niHsaMzaya allAha aikaNArA, jANaNArA Ahe.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! ApalA svara (AvAja) paigaMbarAcyA svarApekSA uMcAvU nakA, ANi tyAMcyAzI azA prakAre uMca svarAta bolU nakA jyA prakAre ApasAta ekamekAMzI bolatA. (kadAcita ase na vhAve) kI tumacI karme vAyA jAvIta ANi tumhAlA khabarahI na vhAvI.

vastutaH je loka paigaMbara (sallallAhu alaihi vasallama) yAMcyA samora ApalA svara dhImA (khAlacA) rAkhatAta, heca te loka hota, jyAMcyA hRdayAMnA, allAhane takavA (allAhacyA bhayA) karItA pArakhUna ghetale Ahe, tyAMcyAsAThI mAphI Ahe ANi phAra moThe puNya Ahe.
niHsaMzaya, je loka tumhAlA kholyAMcyA mAgUna hAka mAratAta, tyAMcyApaikI adhikAMza (pUrNataH) nirbuddha Aheta.

ANi jara yA lokAMnI yetheparyaMta dhIra saMyama rAkhalA asatA kI tumhI (svataH) tyAMcyA javaLa Ale asate tara heca tyAMcyAsAThI adhika cAMgale jhAle asate, ANi allAha mApha karaNArA, dayA karaNArA Ahe.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! jara tumhAlA ekhAdA durAcArI khabara deIla tara tumhI tyAcI cAMgalyA prakAre caukazI karUna gheta jA (ase na vhAve) kI ajANatepaNAmuLe tumhI ekhAdyA samudAyAlA hAnI pohacavAvI, maga naMtara ApalyA kRtyAvara pazcAttApa karU lAgAve.

ANi jANUna asA kI tumacyA daramyAna allAhacA paigaMbara hajara Ahe jara bahuteka goSTIMmadhye te tumace mhaNaNe mAnata rAhile tara tumhI aDacaNIta paDAla, paraMtu allAhane tumacyAsAThI ImAnAsa priya banavile ANi tyAsa tumacyA hRdayAta suzobhita kele Ahe ANi kupra (inkAra) lA ANi duSkarmAMnA va avajJAkAritelA tumacyA najareta apriya banavele Ahe. heca loka sanmArga prApta jhAlele Aheta.
allAhacyA kRpA ANi anugrahAne, ANi allAha jANaNArA va buddhikauzalya bALagaNArA Ahe.

ANi jara musalamAnAMce dona gaTa ApasAta laDhU lAgatIla tara tyAcyAta sameTa (milApha) ghaDavUna ANA, maga jara tyAMcyApaikI eka gaTa dusar2yA gaTAvara atyAcAra karIla, tara tumhI (sarva) atyAcAra karaNAr2yA gaTAzI laDhA. yethe paryarMta kI to allAhacyA AdezAkaDe parata yAvA, jara paratUna AlA tara nyAyapUrvaka tyAMcyA daramyAna samajotA karA ANi nyAya karA. niHsaMzaya, allAha nyAya karaNAr2yAMzI prema rAkhato.

(lakSAta ThevA) samasta ImAna rAkhaNAre (ApasAta) bhAU bhAU Aheta, tevhA ApalyA dona bAMdhavAMcyA daramyAna sameTa (milApha) karUna deta rAhA ANi allAhace bhaya bALagata rAhA, yAsAThI kI tumacyAvara dayA kRpA kelI jAvI.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! puruSAMnI dusar2yA puruSAMcI thaTTA uDavU naye, saMbhavataH te yAMcyAhUna adhika cAMgale asAveta ANi nA striyAMnI (itara) striyAMcI thaTTA karAvI. saMbhavataH tyA, tyAMcyAhUna adhika cAMgalyA asAvyAta, ANi ApasAta ekamekAMvara doSAropa ThevU nakA ANi nA ekhAdyAlA vAITa TopaNa nAva dyA. ImAnAnaMtara phiska (vAITa zabda) vAITa nAva Ahe| ANi je kSamA-yAcanA na karatIla, tara teca atyAcArI loka Aheta.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! aneka vAITa tarka (durAgraha) karaNyApAsUna dUra rAhA, vizvAsa rAkhA kI kAhI tarka aparAdha Aheta ANi bheda (jANUna gheNyAsAThI) pALatIvara rAhU nakA ANi nA tumacyApaikI koNI ekhAdyAcI nidA-nAlastI (tyAcyA pazcAta) karAvI. kAya tumacyApaikI koNIhI ApalyA melelyA bhAvAce mAMsa khANe pasaMta karato? tumhAlA tara tyA goSTIcA tiraskAraca vATela ANi allAhace bhaya bALagata rAhA. niHsaMzaya, allAha mAphI kabUla karaNArA dayAzIla Ahe.

lokAMno! AmhI tumhAlA ekAca puruSa ANi strIpAsUna nirmANa kele Ahe ANi yAsAThI kI tumhI ApasAta ekamekAMnA oLakhAve, aneka jAtI ANi prajAtI banavilyA, allAhacyA najareta tumhA sarvAMta pratiSThAsaMpanna to Ahe, jo sarvAMta jAsta (allAhace) bhaya bALagaNArA Ahe. niHsaMzaya, allAha jANaNArA, cAMgalyA prakAre jANato.

grAmINa loka mhaNatAta kI AmhI ImAna rAkhale. (tumhI) sAMgA kI, tumhI ImAna rAkhale nAhI, paraMtu tumhI ase mhaNA kI AmhI islAmacA svIkAra kelA (virodha soDUna AjJAdhAraka jhAlota) vAstavika ajUnaparyaMta ImAna tumacyA hRdayAta dAkhala jhAleca nAhI. jara tumhI allAha ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAce AjJApAlana karU lAgAla tara allAha tumacyA karmAMmadhUna kAhIca ghaTaviNAra nAhI. niHsaMzaya, allAha moThA mApha karaNArA dayA karaNArA Ahe.

ImAna rAkhaNAre (khare) tara te Aheta, je allAhavara ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAvara (majabUta) ImAna rAkhatIla, maga zaMkA saMzaya na karatIla ANi ApalyA dhanAne ANi ApalyA prANAne allAhacyA mArgAta jihAda (dharmayuddha) karIta rAhatIla (ApalyA ImAnAcyA dAvyAta) heca sacce Aheta.
sAMgA kI kAya tumhI allAhalA ApalyA dhArmikatecI jANIva karUna deta AhAta? allAha, te sarva kAhI je AkAzAMmadhye ANi dharatIta Ahe, cAMgalyA prakAre jANato, ANi allAha pratyeka goSTa jANaNArA Ahe.

te tumhAlA ApalyA musalamAna hoNyAcA upakAra jANivatAta. (tumhI) sAMgA kI ApalyA musalamAna hoNyAcA upakAra mAjhyAvara ThevU nakA, kiMbahunA allAhacA tumacyAvara upakAra Ahe kI tyAne tumhAlA ImAnakaDe mArgadarzana kele, jara tumhI sacce asAla.
niHsaMzaya, AkAzAMcyA ANi jaminIcyA sarva lapalelyA goSTI allAha cAMgalyA prakAre jANato, ANi je kAhI tumhI karIta AhAta, te allAha cAMgalyA prakAre pAhata Ahe.
qApha. phAra moThI garimA rAkhaNAr2yA yA kuraAnAcI zapatha Ahe.
tathApi tyAMnA Azcarya vATale kI tyAMcyAjavaLa tyAMcyAmadhUnaca eka khabaradAra karaNArA AlA, tevhA kAphira mhaNAle, hI eka vicitra goSTa Ahe.
kAya jevhA AmhI melyAvara mAtI hoUna jAU, maga he parataNe dUracI goSTa Ahe.
jamIna je kAhI tyAMcyAtUna ghaTavite, te AmhI jANato ANi AmacyAjavaLa sarva smaraNAta rAkhaNArA graMtha Ahe.
tathApi tyAMnI satya goSTIlA khoTe mhaTale, jevhA tI tyAMcyAjavaLa pohacalI, tevhA te goMdhaLAta paDale Aheta.
kAya tyAMnI AkAzAlA ApalyAvara (asalele) pAhile nAhI kI AmhI te kazA prakAre banavile Ahe ANi tyAlA suzobhita kele Ahe? tyAta koThehI phaTa (kiMvA chidra) nAhI.
ANi jaminIlA AmhI bichavile Ahe ANi ticyAvara AmhI parvata rovale ANi ticyAta vegavegaLyA prakAracyA suMdara vastU ugavilyA.
yAsAThI kI pratyeka (allAhakaDe) parataNAr2yA dAsAkaritA pAhaNyAce va samajaNyAce sAdhana vhAve.
ANi AmhI AkAzAtUna zubha pANyAcA varSAva kelA ANi tyAdvAre bAgA ANi kApaNI kelyA jANAr2yA zetAce anna-dhAnya nirmANa kele.
ANi khajurIMce uMca uMca vRkSa, jyAMce gucche ekAvara eka Aheta.
dAsAMcyA AjivikekaritA ANi AmhI pANyAdvAre mRta zaharAlA jivaMta kele. azAca prakAre (kabarIMmadhUna) nighAyace Ahe.
tyAMcyApUrvI nUhacyA janasamUhAne ANi rassacyA nivAsIMnI ANi samUdacyA lokAMnI khoTe Tharavile hote.
ANi Adane ANi phiraaunane ANi lUtacyA bAMdhavAMnI
ANi AyakAvAlyAMnI ANi tubbaacyA janasamUhAne (dekhIla khoTe Tharavile hote) sarvAMnI paigaMbarAMnA khoTe Tharavile, tevhA mAjhA zikSecA vAyadA tyAMcyAkaritA kharA TharalA.
kAya AmhI pahilyAMdA nirmANa kelyAne thakalo? kiMbahunA he loka navyA jIvanAcyA saMdarbhAta saMzayagrasta Aheta.
AmhI mANasAlA nirmANa kele Ahe ANi tyAcyA manAta je vicAra nirmANa hotAta AmhI tyAMnA jANato, ANi AmhI tyAcyA mukhya zire (prANa nADI) pekSAhI adhika tyAcyA samIpa Ahota.
jevhA dona (noMda) gheNAre je ghetAta, eka ujavyA bAjUlA, ANi dusarA DAvyA bAjUlA basalA Ahe.
(manuSya) toMDAne ekhAdA zabda kADhata nAhI toca tyAcyAjavaLa rakSaka (pahArekarI) tayAra Ahe.
ANi mRtyucI murchA satyAsaha yeUna pohacalI, hIca tI goSTa hoya, jicyApAsUna tU paLa kADhata hotAsa.
ANi sUra phuMkalA jAIla az2Aba (zikSA-yAtane) cyA vAyadyAcA divasa hAca Ahe.
ANi pratyeka manuSya azA prakAre yeIla kI tyAcyAsobata eka hAkaNArA asela ANi eka sAkSa deNArA.
niHsaMzaya, tU yApAsUna besAvadha (gaphalatIta) hotA, paraMtu AmhI tujhyA samorUna paDadA haTavilA, tevhA Aja tujhI najara phAra tIkSNa Ahe.
tyAcyAsobata rAhaNAre pharizte mhaNatIla, hA hajara Ahe, jo kI mAjhyAjavaLa hotA.
doghe TAkUna dyA jahannamamadhye pratyeka kAphira, udaMDa(udhdaTa) mANasAlA.
jo satkarmAMpAsUna rokhaNArA, maryAdA bhaMga karaNArA ANi saMzayI hotA.
jyAne allAhasobata dusarA mAbUda (upAsya) TharavUna ghetalA hotA, tevhA tyAlA kaThora zikSA - yAtaneta TAkUna dyA.
tyAcA sAthIdAra (saitAna) mhaNela kI he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! mI yAlA mArgabhraSTa kele navhate, ulaTa hA svataHca dUracyA mArgabhraSTateta hotA.
(allAha) pharmAvila kI, mAjhyAsamora vAdavivAda karU nakA. mI tara AdhIca tumacyAkaDe zikSA - yAtanecA vAyadA pAThavilA hotA.
mAjhyAjavaLa goSTa badalalI jAta nAhI ANi nA mI ApalyA dAsAMvara (upAsakAMvara) kiMcitahI atyAcAra karaNArA Ahe.
jyA divazI AmhI jahannamalA vicArU kI kAya tU (pUrNataH) bharalI? tI uttara deIla kI, ANakhI kAhI jAsta Ahe kA?
ANi jannata, neka sadAcArI lokAMsAThI agadI javaLa kelI jAIla kiMcitahI dUra nasela.
he Ahe, jyAcA vAyadA tumacyAzI kelA jAta hotA, azA tyA pratyeka mANasAsAThI, jo dhyAnamagna ANi niyamita (AjJApAlana) karaNArA asela.
jo rahamAna (dayAvAna allAha) ce guptapaNe bhaya rAkhata asela ANi rujU hoNAre hRdaya gheUna AlA asela.
tumhI yA jannatamadhye zAMtIpUrvaka dAkhala vhA. hA nehamI rAhaNyAcA divasa Ahe.
he tithe je kAhI icchitIla te tyAMnA miLela (kiMbahunA) AmacyAjavaLa ANakhIhI jAsta Ahe.
ANi tyAMcyApUrvIhI AmhI aneka janasamUhAMnA naSTa karUna TAkale Ahe, je tyAcyApekSA zaktI sAmarthyAta khUpa jAsta hote. te zaharAmadhye phirataca rAhile kI ekhAde paLa kADhaNyAce sthAna Ahe?
yAta, tyA pratyeka mANasAkaritA bodha upadeza Ahe, jo hRdaya bALagata asela kiMvA lakSapUrvaka aikata asela ANi to hajara asela.
niHsaMzaya, AmhI AkAzAMcyA ANi dharatIcyA ANi tyA doghAMcyA daramyAna je kAhI Ahe, te sarva (phakta) sahA divasAMta nirmANa kele, ANi AmhAlA thakavyAne sparzahI kelA nAhI.
yAstava tumhI tyA goSTIMvara dhIra-saMyama rAkhA ANi ApalyA pAlanakartyAce pAvitryagAna, prazaMsesaha sUryodayApUrvIhI ANi sUryAstApUrvIhI karIta rAhA.
ANi rAtrIcyA kAhI kALAtahI mahimAgAna karA ANi namAjanaMtarahI.
ANi aikA kI jyA divasI eka pukAraNArA javaLacyA ThikANAhUnaca pukArela.
jyA divazI to bhayaMkara AvAja khAtrIpUrvaka aikatIla, hA bAhera paDaNyAcA divasa asela.
AmhIca jivaMta karato ANi AmhIca mRtyu deto ANi AmacyAcakaDe paratUna yAyace Ahe.
jyA divazI jamIna vidIrNa hoIla ANi he dhAvata paLata (bAhera paDatIla) he ekatrita karaNe AmacyAsAThI phAra sope Ahe.
AmhI cAMgalyA prakAre jANato, je kAhI he sAMgata Aheta ANi tumhI tyAMnA jabaradastIpUrvaka rAjI karUna gheNAre nAhI, tevhA tumhI tyAMnA kuraAnAcyA mAdhyamAne samajAvita rAhA, je mAjhyA tAkIdIce bhaya
zapatha Ahe uDavUna vikhuraNAr2yAM (vAr2yAM) cI
maga ojhe ucalaNAr2yAMcI
maga dhImyA gatIne cAlaNAr2yAMcI
maga kAmAcI vATaNI karaNAr2yAMcI.
niHsaMzaya, tumhAlA je vAyade dile jAtAta (te sarva) khare Aheta.
ANi nizcitaca nyAya hoNAra Ahe.
zapatha Ahe, mArga rAkhaNAr2yA AkAzAcI.
nizcitaca tumhI vibhinna goSTIta paDalA AhAta.
tyA (satyA) pAsUna toca phiravilA jAto, jo phiravilA gelA asAvA.
aTakaLIcyA goSTI bolaNAre naSTa kele gele.
je cetanAhIna Aheta ANi visara paDalele.
vicAratAta kI mobadalyAcA divasa kevhA yeIla?
(hoya) hA to divasa Ahe kI he AgIvara tApavile jAtIla.
svAda cAkhA. heca te, jyAcI tumhI ghAI mAjavita hote.
niHsaMzaya, allAhace bhaya bALagaNAre jannatIMmadhye ANi (zItala) jhar2yAMmadhye asatIla.
tyAMcyA pAlanakartyAne je kAhI tyAMnA pradAna kele Ahe, te gheta asatIla te tara tyApUrvIca satkarma karaNAre hote.
te rAtrI phAra kamI jhopata asata.
ANi te rAtrIcyA aMtima praharI (pahATe) kSamA - yAcanA karIta.
ANi tyAMcyA dhana-saMpattIta yAcakAMcA(mAgaNAr2yAMcA)ANi yAcanA karaNyApAsUna alipta rAhaNAr2yAMcA hakka hotA.
ANi vizvAsa rAkhaNAr2yAMkaritA tara dharatIta aneka nizANyA Aheta.
ANi svataH tumacyA astitvAta dekhIla, tara kAya tumhI pAhata nAhIta?
ANi tumacI AjivikA(anna sAmugrI) ANi jo tumhAlA vAyadA dilA jAta Ahe, sarva AkAzAta Ahe.
tevhA AkAza ANi dharatIcyA svAmI va pAlanakartyAcI zapatha! he agadI satya Ahe, aseca khAtrIpUrvaka, jase tumhI bolatA.
kAya tumhAlA ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) cyA sanmAnita atithIMcI vArtAhI pohacalI Ahe?
te jevhA tyAMcyAjavaLa Ale tevhA salAma kelA. (ibrAhIma) yAMnI salAmalA uttara dile (ANi mhaNAle, he tara) anoLakhI loka Aheta.
maga (gupacupa ghAIghAIne) ApalyA kuTuMbiyAMkaDe gele ANi ekA laThTha vAsaruce (mAMsa) gheUna Ale.
ANi te tyAMcyA puDhe Thevale ANi mhaNAle, tumhI khAta kA nAhI?
maga manAtalyA manAta tyAMcyApAsUna bhayabhita jhAle. (atithI) mhaNAle, tumhI bhiU nakA ANi tyAMnA (hajarata) ibrAhImalA ekA jJAnI putraprAptIcI zubhavArtA dilI.
tevhA tyAMcyA patnIne Azcaryacakita hoUna ApalyA toMDAvara hAta mArUna mhaTale kI mI tara mhAtArI Ahe, tyAcabarobara vAMjha dekhIla.
te mhaNAle kI hoya, tumacyA pAlanakartyA (allAha) ne aseca pharmAvile Ahe. niHsaMzaya, to hikamazAlI ANi jANaNArA Ahe.
(hajarata ibrAhIma alai.) mhaNAle kI allAhane pAThavilelyA (phariztyAM) no! tumacyA (yeNyAcA) hetU kAya?
tyAMnI uttara dile kI AmhI aparAdhI lokAMkaDe pAThavile gelo Ahota.
yAsAThI kI AmhI tyAcyAvara (bhAjalelyA) mAtIcyA dagaDAMcA varSAva karAvA.
je tumacyA pAlanakartyAtarphe cinhAMkita jhAle Aheta tyA maryAdA bhaMga karaNAr2yAMkaritA.
tevhA jevaDhe ImAna rAkhaNAre tithe hote, AmhI tyAMnA tethUna kADhale.
ANi AmhAlA tithe musalamAnAMce phakta ekaca ghara ADhaLale.
ANi AmhI tithe tyAMcyAsAThI, je duHkhadAyaka zikSA yAtanece bhaya bALagatAta, eka pUrNa cinha soDale.
ANi mUsAcyA vRttAMtAta (hI AmacyAtarphe taMbI Ahe) jevhA AmhI tyAMnA phiraaunakaDe spaSTa pramANAsaha pAThavile.
tevhA tyAne ApalyA sAmarthyAcyA ghameMDIta toMDa phiravile, ANi mhaNAle, hA (ekatara) jAdUgAra Ahe kiMvA veDasara Ahe.
zevaTI AmhI tyAlA ANi tyAcyA sainyAlA ApalyA zikSA-yAtaneta dharUna, samudrAta TAkale. to hotAca nirbhartsanA karaNyAyogya.
tyAcapramANe AdacyA lokAMmadhyehI (AmacyAtarphe taMbI Ahe) jevhA AmhI tyAMcyAvara vAMjha (azubha) vAdaLa pAThavile.
te jyA jyA vastUvarUna gele, tilA jIrNa hADAMpramANe cUrecUra karUna TAkale.
ANi samUda (cyA vRttAMtA) madhyehI (bodha) Ahe, jevhA tyAMnA sAMgitale gele kI tumhI kAhI divasAparyaMta lAbha prApta karUna ghyA.
paraMtu tyAMnI ApalyA pAlanakartyAcyA AdezAce pAlana kele nAhI, jyAbaddala tyAMnA ekA bhayaMkara garjanene naSTa karUna TAkale ANi te baghataca rAhile.
maga nA tara te ubhe rAhU zakale, ANi nA sUDa gheU zakale.
ANi nUha (alai.) yAMcyA janasamUhAcI dekhIla yAcyA AdhI (hIca avasthA jhAlI hotI) te dekhIla moThe avajJAkArI loka hote.
ANi AkAzAlA AmhI (ApalyA) hAtAMnI banavile Ahe ANi niHsaMzaya, AmhI vyApaka karaNAre Ahota.
ANi jaminIlA AmhI bichAIta banavile Ahe, tevhA AmhI kitI cAMgale bichAIta karaNAre Ahota.
ANi pratyeka vastUlA AmhI joDI joDIne nirmANa kele Ahe, yAsAThI kI tumhI bodha grahaNa karAvA.
tevhA tumhI allAhakaDe dhAva ghyA. niHsaMzaya, mI tumhAlA tyAcyAtarphe khabaradAra karaNArA Ahe.
ANi allAhasobata dusar2yA koNAlAhI upAsya (daivata) banavU nakA, nizcitaca, mI tumhAlA tyAcyAtarphe spaSTataH sAvadha karaNArA Ahe.
azAca prakAre je loka tyAMcyA pUrvI hoUna geleta, tyAMcyAjavaLa jo dekhIla paigaMbara AlA, tyAlA te mhaNAle kI ekatara hA jAdUgAra Ahe kiMvA veDA!
kAya he, yA goSTIcI ekamekAMnA tAkIda karata geleta, navhe, kiMbahunA he sarva vidrohI (unmatta) loka Aheta.
tevhA tumhI tyAMcyAkaDUna toMDa phiravUna ghyA, tumacyAvara kasalAhI doSAropa nAhI.
ANi upadeza karIta rAhA, niHsaMzaya hA upadeza ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMnA lAbha deIla.
mI jinnAMnA ANi mAnavAMnA phakta azAsAThI nirmANa kele Ahe kI tyAMnI kevaLa mAjhI upAsanA karAvI.
tyAMcyAkaDUna mI nA AjivikA (rojI) icchito nA ase icchito kI tyAMnI malA khAU ghAlAve.
niHsaMzaya, allAha svataH rojI deNArA sAmarthyazAlI va balavAna Ahe.
tevhA jyA lokAMnI atyAcAra kelA Ahe, tyAMnAhI tyAMcyA sAthIdArAMcyA hizzyAitakAca hissA miLela, yAstava tyAMnI mAjhyAzI ghAIne mAgU naye.
tevhA durdazA Ahe kAphirAMsAThI, tyAMcyA tyA divazI jyAcA tyAMnA vAyadA dilA jAta Ahe.
zapatha Ahe tUracI
ANi likhita graMthAcI.
jo pAtaLa cAmaDyAcyA khulyA pRSThAMmadhye Ahe.
ANi AbAda gharAcI.
ANi bulaMda chatAcI.
ANi uphALalelyA sAgarAcI.
niHsaMzaya, tumacyA pAlanakartyAcA prakopa hoIlaca.
tyAlA koNI rokhaNArA nAhI.
jyA divazI AkAza tharatharu lAgela.
ANi parvata cAlAyalA lAgatIla.
tyA divazI khoTe TharaviNAr2yAMcA sarvanAza Ahe.
je ApalyA vAhyAta goSTIMmadhye kheLata bAgaData Aheta.
jyA divazI tyAMnA dhakke deUna jahannamacyA AgIkaDe ANale jAIla.
hIca tI (jahannamacI) Aga hoya, jilA tumhI khoTe Tharavita hote.
(AtA sAMgA) kAya hI jAdU Ahe? kI tumhI pAhAtaca nAhIta?
dAkhala vhA yAta (jahannamamadhye) AtA tumace dhIra-saMyama rAkhaNe ANi na rAkhaNe tumacyAsAThI sArakheca Ahe. tumhAlA kevaLa tumacyA karmAMcA mobadalA dilA jAIla.
niHsaMzaya, neka sadAcArI loka jannatamadhye sukhAMmadhye Aheta.
tyAMnA, tyAMcyA pAlanakartyAne je deUna Thevale Ahe tyAvara khUza Aheta ANi tyAMnA tyAMcyA pAlanakartyAne jahannamacyA az2Aba (zikSA-yAtane) pAsUnahI vAcavile.
tumhI majene khAta-pIta rAhA, tyA karmAMcyA mobadalyAta jI tumhI karIta hote.
barobarIne mAMDalelyA suMdara AsanAMvara takke lAvUna, ANi AmhI tyAcA vivAha moThyA neJAcyA hUra (parIM) zI karavilA Ahe.

ANi jyA lokAMnI ImAna rAkhale, ANi tyAMcyA saMtatInehI ImAna rAkhaNyAta tyAMce anusaraNa kele, AmhI tyAMcyA saMtatIlA tyAMcyAparyaMta pohacavU ANi AmhI tyAMcyA karmAMmadhUna kAhIca kamI karaNAra nAhI. pratyeka manuSya ApApalyA karmAMcyA badalI gahANa Ahe.
ANi AmhI tyAMcyAsAThI meve ANi svAdiSTa mAMsAcI adhikatA karU.
(AnaMdAne) te ekamekAMpAsUna (madyAce) pyAle hisakAvUna gheta asatIla, tyA madyAcyA svAdAta nA vAhyAta goSTI bolatIla ANi nA aparAdha asela.
ANi tyAMcyA cArI bAjUlA sevesAThI (sevaka mhaNUna) lahAna mule phirata asatIla, jaNU kAhI te motI hote, jyAMnA lapavUna Thevale hote.
ANi te ApasAta ekamekAMkaDe toMDa karUna vicArapUsa karatIla.
mhaNatIla kI yAcyApUrvI ApalyA kuTuMbiyAMmadhye phAra bhaya rAkhata hoto.
tevhA allAhane AmacyAvara phAra moThA upakAra kelA ANi AmhAlA horapaLUna TAkaNAr2yA ati uSNa havecyA prakopA (az2Aba) pAsUna vAcavile.
AmhI yAcyA pUrvIhI tyAlA pukArata hoto. niHsaMzaya, to moThA upakAra karaNArA ANi moThA dayA karaNArA Ahe.
tevhA tumhI samajAvita rAhA, kAraNa kI tumhI ApalyA pAlanakartyAcyA kRpene nA tara jyotiSI AhAta, nA veDasara.
kAya (kAphira) ase mhaNatAta kI hA kavI Ahe, AmhI tyAcyAsAThI kAla cakrA (arthAta mRtyu) cI pratIkSA karIta Ahota.
(tumhI) sAMgA kI tumhI pratIkSA karA mI dekhIla tumacyAsobata pratIkSA karaNAr2yAMpaikI Ahe.
kAya tyAMcyA akalA tyAMnA heca zikavitAta? kiMvA he loka Ahetaca udhdaTa (vidrohI)?
kAya he mhaNatA kI yA (paigaMbarA) ne (kuraAna) svataH racale Ahe, vastutaH he ImAna rAkhata nAhIta.
bare, jara he sacce Aheta tara maga yAsArakhI eka tarI goSTa yAMnI ANUna dAkhavAvI.
kAya he ekhAdyA (nirmANa karaNAr2yA) cyA vinA svataH (ApoApa) nirmANa jhAle Aheta? kiMvA he svataH nirmANa karaNAre Aheta?
kAya tyAMnIca AkAzAMnA ANi jaminIlA nirmANa kele Ahe? kiMbahunA he vizvAsa na rAkhaNAre loka Aheta.
athavA kAya yAMcyAjavaLa tumacyA pAlanakartyAce khajine Aheta? kiMvA (tyA khajinyAMce) he saMrakSaka Aheta?
kiMvA yAMcyAjavaLa ekhAdI ziDI Ahe, jicyAvara caDhUna he aikatAta? (jara ase Ahe) tara aikaNAr2yAne ekhAde spaSTa pramANa sAdara karAve.
kAya allAhakaritA sarva kanyA Aheta ANi tumacyAsAThI putra?
kAya tumhI yAMcyAkaDUna kAhI majurI mAgatA kI he tyA ojhyAne dAbale jAta Aheta?
kAya yAMcyAjavaLa parokSa jJAna Ahe kI he lihUna gheta asatAta?
kAya he loka ekhAdA kAvebAjapaNA karU icchitAta? tara (vizvAsa ThevA) kI kapaTa kArasthAna karaNArA gaTa kAphirAMcA Ahe.
kAya allAhakherIja tyAMcA koNI dusarA mAbUda (upAsya) Ahe? (kadApi nAhI) allAha tyAMcyA sahabhAgI TharaviNyApAsUna (zuddha) ANi pavitra Ahe.
jara he loka AkAzAcA ekhAdA tukaDA jarI kosaLatAnA pAhatIla tarI heca mhaNatIla kI he tharAvara thara Dhaga Aheta.
tevhA tumhI tyAMnA soDA, yethe paryarMta kI yAMcI ApalyA tyA divasAzI bheTa vhAvI jyAta he bezuddha kele jAtIla.
jyA divazI tyAMnA tyAMcI cAla (kheLI) kAhIca kAmI yeNAra nAhI ANi nA tyAMnA madata kelI jAIla.
niHsaMzaya, atyAcArI lokAMkaritA yAkherIjahI anya zikSA-yAtanA Aheta, paraMtu tyA lokAMpaikI adhikAMza loka he jANata nAhIta.
tumhI ApalyA pAlanakartyAcyA AdezAcyA pratIkSeta dhIra - saMyama rAkhA. niHsaMzaya, tumhI AmacyA DoLyAMsamora AhAta ANi sakALI jevhA tumhI uThAla, ApalyA pAlanakartyAcI pavitratesaha prazaMsA karA.
ANi rAtrI dekhIla tyAce mahimAgAna karA ANi tAr2yAMcyA astAsa jANyAcyA veLIhI.
tAr2yAcI zapatha Ahe, jevhA to kosaLela.
kI tumacA sAthIdAra nA vATa cukalelA Ahe, nA to vAkaDyA mArgAvara Ahe.
ANi nA ApalyA marjIne to kAhI bolato.
tI tara kevaLa vahayI (AkAzavANI) Ahe, jI avatarita kelI jAte.
tyAlA pUrNa sAmarthyazAlI phariztyAne zikavile Ahe.
jo moThA zaktizAlI Ahe, maga to saraLa ubhA rAhilA.
ANi to ati ucca AkAzAcyA kinAr2yA (kSitijA) vara hotA.
maga javaLa AlA ANi avataralA.
tevhA to dona kamAnIitakyA aMtarAvara rAhilA, kiMbahunA tyAhUna kamI.
maga tyAne allAhacyA dAsAlA saMdeza pohacavilA, jo kAhI pohacavilA.
hRdayAne khoTe mhaTale nAhI, je (paigaMbarA) ne pAhile.
kAya tumhI tyA goSTIbaddala vAda ghAlatA, je paigaMbara pAhatAta.
tyAlA tara ANakhI ekA veLI pAhile hote.
‘sidaratula muntahA’cyA javaLa.
tyAcyAca nikaTa ‘jannatula mAvA’ Ahe.
jevhA sidaralA lapavUna gheta hotI, tI vastU, jI tyAvara AcchAdita hota hotI.
nA tara dRSTI vaLalI, nA maryAdecyA puDhe gelI.
nizcitaca tyAne ApalyA pAlanakartyAcyA moThamoThyA nizANyAMpaikI kAhI nizANyA pAhilyA hotyA.
kAya tumhI ‘lAta’ ANi ‘ujjA’lA pAhile?
ANi tisar2yA aMtima ‘manAta’lA?
kAya tumacyAsAThI putra ANi tyA (allAha) sAThI kanyA Aheta?
hI tara moThI anyAyapUrNa vATaNI Ahe!

vAstavika tI kevaLa nAve Aheta, jI tumhI ANi tumacyA vADavaDilAMnI tyAMnA ThevalI Aheta. allAhane tyAMcI koNatIhI sanada avatarita kelI nAhI. he loka tara kevaLa aTakaLa (bhrama) ANi ApalyA manAcyA icchA AkAMkSAMmAge lAgale Aheta. ANi niHsaMzaya, tyAMcyA pAlanakartyAtarphe tyAMcyAjavaLa mArgadarzana yeUna pohocale Ahe.
kAya pratyeka manuSya jI kAmanA dekhIla karIla tI tyAlA sAdhya hoIla?
allAhakaritAca Ahe he vizva ANi tI Akhirata.
ANakhI kitItarI pharizte AkAzAMmadhye Aheta, jyAMcI ziphArasa kAhIca upayogI paDU zakata nAhI, mAtra hI goSTa vegaLI kI allAha ApalyA icchene va ApalyA khuzIne jyAlA icchila AjJA (anumatI) deIla.
niHsaMzaya, je loka Akhiratavara ImAna rAkhata nAhI, te phariztyAMnA strIrUpI devatAMcI nAve detAta.
vAstavika tyAMnA yAce kAhIca jJAna nAhI. te kevaLa ApalyA bhramAcyA mAge lAgale Aheta ANi niHsaMzaya, bhrama (ANi anumAna) satyAsamora kAhIca upayogI paData nAhI.
tevhA tumhI tyAcyAkaDUna toMDa phiravUna ghyA, jo AmacyA smaraNAMpAsUna toMDa phiravila ANi jyAMcA uddeza kevaLa aihika jIvanAkherIja kAhI nasAvA.
hIca tyAMcyA jJAnAcI sImA Ahe. tumacA pAlanakartA tyAlA cAMgalyA prakAre jANato, jo tyAcyA mArgApAsUna vicalita jhAlA Ahe ANi toca cAMgalyA prakAre jANato tyAlA dekhIla, jo sanmArgAvara Ahe.

ANi allAhaceca Ahe, je kAhI AkAzAMmadhye Ahe ANi je kAhI dharatIta Ahe, yAsAThI kI tyAne (allAhane) duSkarma karaNAr2yAMnA tyAMcyA karmAMcA mobadalA dyAvA ANi satkarma karaNAr2yA lokAMnA cAMgalA mobadalA dyAvA.

je loka moThamoThe aparAdha ANi ughaDa nirlajjatecyA kRtyAMpAsUna dUra rAhatAta, yAkherIja kI kAhI lahAna sahAna aparAdha tyAMcyAkaDUna ghaDatAta, niHsaMzaya, (azA lokAMsAThI) tumacyA pAlanakartyAcI kSamAzIlatA ati vizAla Ahe. to tumhAlA cAMgalyA prakAre jANato, jevhA tyAne tumhAlA jaminItUna nirmANa kele ANi jevhA tumhI ApalyA mAtAMcyA garbhAta mUla (arbhaka) hote tevhA tumhI Apale pAvitrya svataH sAMgU nakA. toca neka - sadAcArI lokAMnA cAMgalyA prakAre jANato.
kAya tumhI tyAlA pAhile, jyAne toMDa phiravUna ghetale,
ANi phAra kamI dile ANi hAta rokhalA.
kAya tyAlA parokSa jJAna Ahe kI to (sarva kAhI) pAhata Ahe?
kAya tyAlA tyA goSTIcI khabara nAhI dilI gelI, jI mUsA (alai.) cyA graMthAta hotI.
ANi ekaniSTha ibrAhIma (alai.) cyA graMthAta hotI.
kI koNatAhI manuSya dusar2yA koNAcehI ojhe ucalaNAra nAhI.
ANi he kI pratyeka mANasAkaritA kevaLa teca Ahe, jyAcA tyAne svataH prayatna kelA.
ANi he kI niHsaMzaya, tyAcA prayatna lavakaraca pAhilA jAIla.
maga tyAlA purepUra mobadalA dilA jAIla.
ANi he kI tumacyA pAlanakartyA (allAha) kaDeca pohacAyace Ahe.
ANi he kI toca hasavito ANi toca raDavito.
ANi he kI toca mArato ANi toca jivaMta karato.
ANi he kI tyAneca joDA arthAta nara - mAdI nirmANa kelA.
vIryApAsUna jevhA to TapakavilA jAto.
ANi he kI dusar2yAMdA jivaMta karaNe tyAcIca jabAbadArI Ahe.
ANi he kI toca dhanavAna banavito ANi dhana deto.
ANi he kI toca zearA (tAr2yA) cA svAmI va pAlanakartA Ahe.
ANi he kI tyAneca pahilyA AdalA naSTa kele Ahe,
ANi samUdalA dekhIla, (jyApaikI) ekAlAhI zillaka Thevale nAhI.
ANi tyAcyApUrvI nUhacyA janasamUhAlA. niHsaMzaya, te moThe atyAcArI ANi udhdaTa loka hote.
ANi ‘mutaphikA’ (zahara kiMvA pAlathyA paDalelyA vastyAMnA) tyAneca pAlathe ghAtale.
maga tyAMcyAvara AcchAdita kele, je kAhI AcchAdita kele.
tevhA he mAnavA! tU ApalyA pAlanakartyAcyA koNakoNatyA kRpA deNagI (nemata) baddala vAda karazIla?
he (paigaMbara) khabaradAra karaNAre Aheta, pUrvI hoUna gelelyA khabaradAra karaNAr2yAMpaikI.
yeNArI veLa (ghaTikA) javaLa yeUna ThepalI Ahe.
allAhazivAya tilA jAhIra karaNArA anya koNI nAhI.
tevhA kAya tumhI yA goSTIvara Azcarya karatA?
ANi hasata AhAta, raData nAhI?
(kiMbahunA) tumhI kheLata AhAta!
AtA allAhasamora sajade karA (mAthA TekA) ANi (tyAcIca) upAsanA karA.
kayAmata javaLa AlI ANi caMdra dubhaMgalA.
he jevhA ekhAdA mojijA (camatkAra) pAhatAta, tevhA toMDa phiravitAta, ANi mhaNatAta hI tara pahilyApAsUna cAlata AlelI jAdU Ahe.
ANi tyAMnI khoTe Tharavile va ApalyA icchA AkAMkSAMce anusaraNa kele. ANi pratyeka kArya nizcita veLevaraca nirdhArita Ahe.
niHsaMzaya, tyAcyAjavaLa tyA vArtA yeUna pohacalyA Aheta, jyAta taMbI - tAkIdI (cI zikavaNa) Aheta.
ANi pUrNa buddhikauzalyAcI goSTa Ahe, paraMtu yA bhayabhIta karaNAr2yA goSTIMnIhI kAhI lAbha dilA nAhI.
(tevhA, he paigaMbara!) tumhI tyAMcyAkaDUna toMDa phiravA, jyA divazI eka pukAraNArA apriya goSTIkaDe bolAvila.
he jhukalelyA netrAMnI kabarImadhUna azA prakAre uThUna ubhe rAhatIla kI jaNU itastataH pasaralelA ToLa thavA.
pukAraNAr2yAkaDe dhAvata jAta asatIla ANi kAphira mhaNatIla kI hA divasa tara moThA kaThINa Ahe!
tyAMcyApUrvI nUhacyA janasamUhAnehI AmacyA dAsAlA khoTe Tharavile hote. ANi veDA darzavUna jhiDakArale hote.
tevhA tyAne ApalyA pAlanakartyAjavaLa duA (prArthanA) kelI kI mI tAvaDIta sApaDalelo Ahe. tU mAjhI madata kara.
tevhA AmhI AkAzAce daravAje musaLadhAra pAvasAne ughaDale.
ANi jaminItUna jhare pravAhita kele, tevhA tyA kAryAsAThI je bhAgyAta lihile gele hote, (doghehI) pANI ekatrita jhAle.
ANi AmhI tyAlA azA nauketa caDhavile, jI takte ANi mekhA asalelI hotI.
jI AmacyA DoLyAMsamora cAlata hotI. hA mobadalA tyAcyAtarphe, jyAcA inkAra kelA gelA hotA.
ANi niHsaMzaya, AmhI yA ghaTanelA nizANI banavUna bAkI rAkhale tevhA Ahe koNI bodha grahaNa karaNArA?
tevhA (sAMgA) kasA hotA mAjhA prakopa ANi mAjhI bhayapUrNa taMbI.

jI lokAMnA ucalUna ApaTata hotI, jaNU muLAsakaTa ukhaDalele khajurIce vRkSa Aheta.
tevhA kasA hotA mAjhA prakopa ANi mAjhe bhayabhIta karaNe.
