ANi tyA kathanAta sacce asAla tara to prANa paratavUna dAkhavA.
tara jo koNI (allAhacyA darabArAta) nikaTatama asela
tyAcyAsAThI aiSaArAma Ahe (uttama bhojana Ahe ANi deNagyAMnI yukta azI jannata Ahe.
ANi jo manuSya ujavyA hAtAcyA lokAMpaikI Ahe
tarIhI salAma (zAMtI salAmatI) Ahe tujhyAsAThI kI tU ujavyA hAtAcyA lokAMpaikI Ahesa.
paraMtu jara koNI khoTe TharaviNAr2yA mArgabhraSTa lokAMpaikI Ahe
tara ukaLatyA pANyAne tyAcA pAhuNacAra Ahe
ANi jahannamamadhye jAyace Ahe.
hI (vArtA) agadI satya ANi nizcita Ahe.
tevhA tumhI ApalyA (atimahAna) pAlanakartyAcyA nAvAce pAvitrya varNana karA.
AkAzAMmadhye ANi dharatIta je kAhI Ahe (te sarva) allAhace mahimAgAna karIta Aheta ANi to moThA varcasvazAlI, hikamatazAlI Ahe.
AkAzAMce ANi dharatIce (samasta) rAjya tyAceca Ahe, toca jIvana deto ANi mRtyuhI ANi to pratyeka goSTIce sAmarthya rAkhato.
toca Adya ANi toca aMtima Ahe, toca ughaDa ANi toca lapalelA Ahe ANi to pratyeka goSTa cAMgalyA prakAre jANaNArA Ahe.

toca Ahe jyAne AkAzAMnA va jaminIlA sahA divasAMta nirmANa kele, maga arza (siMhAsanA) vara uMcAvalA to cAMgalyA prakAre jANato tyA goSTIlA, jI jaminIta jAte ANi jI ticyAtUna nighate, ANi jI AkAzAtUna khAlI yete ANi jI caDhUna AkAzAta jAte ANi tumhI koThehI ‌sA, to tumacyAsobata Ahe ANi tumhI je kAhI karIta AhAta, allAha te pAhAta Ahe.
AkAzAMcI va dharatIcI rAjyasattA tyAcIca Ahe ANi samasta kArya tyAcyAcakaDe paratavilI jAtAta.
toca rAtrIlA divasAta dAkhala karato ANi toca divasAlA rAtrIta dAkhala karato ANi chAtI (manA) madhye lapalelyA goSTIMce to pUrNa jJAna rAkhaNArA Ahe.

allAhavara ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAvara ImAna rAkhA ANi dhanAtUna kharca karA jyAta allAhane tumhAlA (itarAMcA) vArasa banavile Ahe tevhA tumacyApaikI jo koNI ImAna rAkhela ANi kharca karela tara azAMnA phAra moThe puNya lAbhela.

tumhI allAhavara ImAna kA nAhI rAkhata? vAstavika paigaMbara svataH tumhAlA ApalyA pAlanakartyAvara ImAna rAkhaNyAce AvAhana karIta Ahe ANi jara tumhI ImAna rAkhaNAre asAla tara tyAne tumacyAkaDUna dRDhavacana ghetale Ahe.
to (allAha) ca Ahe, jo ApalyA dAsAvara spaSTa AyatI avatarita karato, yAsAThI kI tyAne tumhAlA aMdhArAkaDUna ujeDAkaDe nyAve. niHsaMzaya allAha tumacyAvara sneha, dayA karaNArA Ahe.

ANi tumhAlA jhAle tarI kAya kI tumhI allAhacyA mArgAta kharca nAhI karIta? vAstavika AkAzAMcyA ANi dharatIcyA samasta vastUMcA svAmI (ekaTA) allAhaca Ahe. tumacyApaikI jyA lokAMnI vijayApUrvI allAhacyA mArgAta dile Ahe ANi dharmayuddha (jihAda) kele Ahe te dusar2yAMcyA samAna nAhIta kiMbahunA tyAMcyApekSA ucca padAce Aheta, jyAMnI vijaya prAptInaMtara dAna dile ANi jihAda kele. hoya bhalAIcA vAyadA tara allAhacA tyA sarvAMzI Ahe ANi je kAhI tumhI karIta AhAta, allAha te jANato.
asA koNa Ahe, jo allAhalA cAMgalyA prakAre karja deIla, maga allAha tyAcyAsAThI te vADhavita jAIla ANi tyAcA cAMgalA mobadalA TharAvA.

(kayAmatacyA) divazI tumhI pAhAla kI ImAna rAkhaNAr2yA puruSAMce ANi striyAMce teja (nUra) tyAMcyA puDhe puDhe ANi tyAMcyA ujavIkaDe dhAvata asela. Aja tumhAlA tyA jannatIMcA zubha samAcAra Ahe, jyAMcyA khAlI (thaMDa pANyAce) pravAha vAhata Aheta, jyAta te nehamI rAhatIla, hIca moThI saphalatA Ahe.

tyA divazI dAMbhika (mUnAphika) puruSa ANi dAMbhika striyA ImAnadhArakAMnA mhaNatIla kI AmacI pratIkSA tara karA kI AmhIhI tumacyA prakAzAmadhUna thoDA prakAzA ghyAvA, uttara dile jAIla kI tumhI mAge phirA ANi prakAza zodhA, maga tyAMcyA ANi yAMcyA daramyAna eka bhiMta ubhI kelI jAIla, jicyAta daravAjAhI asela, tyAcyA AtalyA bhAgAta rahamata (allAhacI kRpA) asela ANi bAheracyA bhAgAta az2Aba (zikSA - yAtanA) asela.

he oraDUna oraDUna tyAMnA sAMgatIla kI kAya AmhI tumacyAsobata navhato? te mhaNatIla, ho, hote jarUra, paraMtu tumhI svataHlA mArgabhraSTateta Thevale hote. ANi pratIkSA karIta rAhile ANi zaMkA - saMzaya karIta rAhile ANi tumhAlA tumacyA (nirarthaka) icchA AkAMkSAMnI dhokyAtaca Thevale yetheparyaMta kI allAhacA Adeza yeUna pohocalA ANi tumhAlA allAhacyA bAbatIta dhokA deNAr2yAne dhokyAtaca Thevale.
tevhA Aja nA tumacyAkaDUna phidiyA (ANi na badalA) svIkAralA jAIla ANi nA kAphirAMkaDUna. tumhA sarvAMce ThikANa jahannama Ahe. tIca tumacI sobatI Ahe ANi te moThe vAITa ThikANa Ahe.

kAya ajUnaparyaMta ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMkaritA tI veLa nAhI AlI kI tyAMcI hRdaye allAhacyA smaraNAne ANi je satya avatarita jhAle Ahe tyAne komala vhAvIta, ANi tyA lokAMsArakhI na vhAvIta, jyAMnA yAMcyA pUrvI graMtha pradAna kelA gelA, maga jevhA tyAMcyAvara eka dIrgha mudata loTalI, tevhA tyAMcI hRdaye kaThora jhAlIta ANi tyAMcyApaikI adhikAMza durAcArI Aheta.
vizvAsa rAkhA kI allAhaca dharatIlA ticyA mRtyunaMtara jivaMta karato. AmhI tara tumacyAsAThI ApalyA nizANyA spaSTa sAMgitalyA, yAsAThI kI tumhI samajUna ghyAve.
niHsaMzaya, dAna deNAre puruSa ANi striyA ANi je allAhalA premAne cAMgale karja deta Aheta tyAMcyAsAThI aneka paTIMnI vADhavile jAIla, ANi tyAMcyAsAThI uttama asA mobadalA Ahe.

allAha ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAvara je loka ImAna rAkhatAta teca ApalyA pAlanakartyAjavaLa sacce ANi zahIda Aheta. tyAMcyAsAThI tyAMcA mobadalA ANi tyAMce divya teja Ahe, ANi je kupra (inkAra) karatAta ANi AmacyA nizANyAMnA khoTe TharavitAta te jahannamI Aheta.

lakSAta ThevA kI yA jagAce jIvana tara kevaLa kheLa tamAzA ANi zobhA sajAvaTa ANi ApasAta abhimAna (ANi ahaMkAra) ANi dhana va saMtatIta ekamekAhUna svataHlA jAsta dAkhaviNe Ahe. jyApramANe pAUsa ANi tyApAsUna jhAlelI paidAvAra zetakar2yAMnA sukhada vATate, maga jevhA tI sukate tevhA tilA tumhI pivaLyA raMgAta pAhatAta, maga tI agadI curecUra hoUna jAte, ANi Akhiratamadhye sakta zikSA-yAtanA ANi allAhacI mAphI ANi prasannatA Ahe ANi yA jagAce jIvana kevaLa dhokyAcyA sAmugrIzivAya ANakhI kAhIca nAhI.

(yA) dhAvA ApalyA pAlanakartyAcyA mAphIkaDe ANi tyA jannatakaDe jicA vistAra AkAza ANi jaminIcyA vistArAitakA Ahe. tI azA lokAMsAThI banavilI gelI Ahe, je allAhavara ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAMvara ImAna rAkhatAta, hI allAhacI dayA kRpA Ahe, jyAlA icchito pradAna karato ANi allAha moThA kRpAvAna Ahe.

koNatehI saMkaTa yA jagAvara yeta nAhI nA khAsa tumacyA prANAMvara paraMtu yApUrvI kI AmhI tyAsa nirmANa karAve, te ekA vizeSa graMthAta lihilele Ahe. niHsaMzaya he kAma allAhakaritA (moThe) sope Ahe.

yAsAThI kI tumhI ApalyAkaDUna hirAvUna ghetalyA jANAr2yA goSTIbaddala duHkhI na vhAve ANi nA pradAna kelelyA goSTIbaddala garviSTha vhAve ANi zekhI miraviNAr2yA, ghameMDa karaNAr2yAMzI allAha prema rAkhata nAhI.
je (svataHhI) kaMjUsapaNA karatAta ANi itarAMnAhI kaMjUsapaNA karaNyAcI zikavaNa detAta, (aikA!) jo koNI toMDa phiravila, allAha niHspRha ANi prazaMsesa pAtra Ahe.

niHsaMzaya, AmhI ApalyA paigaMbarAMnA (saMdezavAhakAMnA) spaSTa nizANyA deUna pAThavile ANi tyAMcyAsobata graMtha ANi nyAya (tarAjU) avatarita kelA, yAsAThI kI lokAMnI nyAyAvarakAyama rAhAve ANi AmhI lokhaMDahI avatarita kele, jyAta moThI (haibata ANi) tAkada Ahe ANi lokAMsAThI itarahI aneka phAyade Aheta ANi yAsAThIhI kI allAhane he jANUna ghyAve kI tyAcI va tyAcyA paigaMbarAMcI madata na pAhatA koNa karato. niHsaMzaya, allAha moThA zaktizAlI ANi varcasvazAlI Ahe.

niHsaMzaya, AmhI nUha ANi ibrAhIma (alai.) yAMnA (paigaMbara banavUna) pAThavile ANi AmhI tyA doghAMcyA saMtatIta preSitva ANi graMtha kAyama ThevalA, tevhA tyAMcyApaikI kAhIMnI mArgadarzana aMgIkArale ANi tyAMcyApaikI bahuteka jaNa durAcArI rAhile.

tyAMcyAnaMtara, tarIhI AmhI satata Apale paigaMbara pAThavita rAhilo ANi tyAMcyAnaMtara mariyamacA putra IsAlA pAThavile va tyAMnA iMjIla (graMtha) pradAna kelA ANi tyAMcyA anuyAyIMcyA manAta prema ANi dayecI bhAvanA ThevalI, paraMtu vairAgyAcA mArga tyAMnI svataH zodhUna kaDhalA, AmhI to tyAMcyAsAThI anivArya kelA navhatA, allAhacyA prasannatecA zodha gheNyAkherIja, tevhA tyAMnI tyAce pUrNataH pAlana kele nAhI, tarI dekhIla AmhI tyAMcyApaikI jyAMnI ImAna rAkhale hote, tyAMnA tyAMcA mobadalA pradAna kelA ANi tyAMcyApaikI adhikAMza loka durAcArI Aheta.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yA lokAMno! allAhace bhaya bALagata rAhA ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAvara ImAna rAkhA, allAha tumhAlA ApalyA dayene duppaTa hissA deIla ANi tumhAlA divya teja (nUra) pradAna karIla, jyAcyA prakAzAta tumhI cAlAla ANi to (tumace aparAdhIhI) mApha karIla, allAha moThA mApha karaNArA atizaya dayAvAna Ahe.

he azAsAThI kI (allAhacA) graMtha bALagaNAr2yAMnI jANUna ghyAve kI allAhacyA kRpecyA koNatyAhI hizyAvara tyAMcA adhikAra nAhI ANi he kI, samasta kRpA allAhacyAca hAtI Ahe, to jyAlA icchila, deIla ANi allAhaca moThA kRpAvaMta Ahe.

nizcitaca, allAhane tyA strIce mhaNaNe aikale, jI tumacyAzI ApalyA patIbAbata vAda ghAlIta hotI, ANi allAhasamora gAr2hANe karIta hotI. allAha tumhA doghAMcA vArtAlApa (vAdavivAda) aikata hotA. niHsaMzaya, allAha aikaNArA, pAhaNArA Ahe.

tumacyApaikI je loka ApalyA patnIMzI jihAra karatAta (mhaNaje tyAMnA mAtA saMbodhUna basatAta) tyA vAstavika tyAMcyA mAtA nAhIta, tyAMcyA mAtA tara tyAca Aheta, jyAMcyA garbhAtUna tyAMnI janma ghetalA Ahe, niHsaMzaya he loka eka ayogya ANi asatya goSTa bolatAta. niHsaMzaya, allAha moThA kSamAzIla ANi mApha karaNArA Ahe.

je loka ApalyA patnIMzI jihAra karUna basatIla, maga Apale kathana parata ghetIla tara tyAMnA, ApasAta ekamekAMnA hAta lAvaNyAAdhI eka gulAma (dAsa) mukta karAvA lAgela. yAcyAdvAre tumhAlA upadeza kelA jAta Ahe, ANi allAha tumacyA samasta karmAMnA jANato.

tathApi jyAlA gulAma ADhaLUna na AlA tara tyAne dona mahIne satata roje rAkhAveta, yApUrvI kI ekamekAMnA hAta lAvAvA ANi jyAlA yAcehI sAmarthya nasela tara tyAne sATha garIbAMnA jeU ghAlAve, he yAsAThI kI tumhI allAhavara ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAvara ImAna rAkhAve. yA allAhane nirdhArita kelelyA sImA (maryAdA) Aheta ANi kAphirAMsAThIca duHkhadAyaka az2Aba (zikSA-yAtanA) Aheta.

niHsaMzaya, je loka allAha ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAcA virodha karatAta te apamAnita kele jAtIla, jase tyAMcyA pUrvIce loka apamAnita kele gele ANi niHsaMzaya, AmhI spaSTa AyatI avatarita kelyA Aheta ANi kAphira (satya virodhaka) lokAMsAThI apamAnita karaNArA az2Aba Ahe.

jyA divazI allAha tyA sarvAMnA (jivaMta karUna) uThavila, maga tyAMnA tyAMcyA kRta-karmAMzI avagata karIla (jyAsa) allAhane mojUna Thevale Ahe ANi jyAcA yAMnA visara paDalA hotA ANi allAha pratyeka goSTIzI avagata Ahe.

kAya tumhI nAhI pAhile kI allAha AkAzAMcI va jaminIcI pratyeka goSTa jANato. ase nAhI hota kI tIna mANasAMmadhye kAnagoSTI vhAvyAta ANi tyAMcyAta cauthA allAha nasAvA ANi nA pAca mANasAMmadhye, va tyAMcyAta sahAvA allAha nasAvA. kAnagoSTI karaNAre yAhUna kamI asota kiMvA jAsta asota, to tyAMcyAsobataca asato. maga te koThehI asota, maga kayAmatacyA divazI tyAMnA tyAMcyA karmAMzI avagata karavila. niHsaMzaya, allAha pratyeka goSTIce jJAna bALagato.

kAya tumhI tyA lokAMnA nAhI pAhile, jyAMnA kAnagoSTI karaNyApAsUna rokhale gele hote, tarIhI te tyA manAI kelelyA kAmAlA punhA karatAta ANi ApasAta aparAdhAcyA, anyAyAcyA ANi paigaMbarAzI avajJA karaNyAcyA kAnagoSTI karatAta ANi jevhA tumacyAjavaLa yetAta, tevhA tumhAlA tyA zabdAMta salAma karatAta, jyA zabdAMta allAhane sAMgitale nAhI, ANi ApalyA manAta mhaNatAta kI allAha AmhAlA AmacyA azA bolaNyAvara zikSA kA nAhI deta? tyAMcyAsAThI jahannama purezI Ahe, jyAta he loka dAkhala hotIla, tevhA kitI vAITa ThikANa Ahe!

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! jevhA tumhI kAnagoSTI karAla tara yA kAnagoSTI aparAdha, atireka (udaMDatA) ANi paigaMbarAMcI avajJAsaMbaMdhI nasAvyAta. kiMbahunA satkarma ANi allAhacyA bhayAsaMbaMdha asAvyAta ANi tyA allAhace bhaya bALagata rAhA, jyAcyAjavaLa tumhI ekatrita kele jAla.

(vAITa) kAnagoSTI saitAnAce kAma Ahe, jyAmuLe ImAnadhArakAMnA duHkha vhAve. vastutaH allAhacyA marjIvinA to tyAMnA kAhIca nukasAna pohacavU zakata nAhI. ANi ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMnI allAhavaraca bharavasA ThevalA pAhije.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! jevhA tumhAlA sAMgitale jAIla kI sabhA-baiThakAMmadhye jarA vistArapUrvaka basA, tevhA tumhI jAgA vyApaka karA. allAha tumhAlA vistAra pradAna karela ANi jevhA sAMgitale jAIla kI uThUna ubhe rAhA, tevhA tumhI uThUna ubhe rAhA. allAha tumacyApaikI tyA lokAMce, jyAMnI ImAna rAkhale Ahe va jyAMnA jJAna dile gele Ahe, darjA uMcAvila ANi allAha (te pratyeka karma) je tumhI karIta AhAta, (cAMgalyA prakAre) jANato.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! jevhA tumhI paigaMbarAzI ekAMtAta bolU icchita asAla tara ApalyA yA ekAMtAta bolaNyApUrvI kAhI dAna (sadakA) karata jA, he tumacyAsAThI adhika cAMgale ANi pavitra (nirmaLa) Ahe, mAtra jara kAhIca nasela tara niHsaMzaya, allAha mApha karaNArA, dayA karaNArA Ahe.

kAya tumhI kAnagoSTIpUrvI dAna karaNyAsa bhyAle tara jevhA tumhI ase kele nAhI ANi allAhane dekhIla tumhAlA mApha kele tevhA AtA (ucitapaNe) namAjAMnA kAyama rAkhA, jakAta deta rAhA ANi allAha ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAcyA AdezAce pAlana karIta rAhA ANi tumhI je kAhI karatA te sarva allAha (cAMgalyA prakAre) jANUna Ahe.

kAya tumhI tyA lokAMnA nAhI pAhile, jyAMnI tyA janasamUhAzI maitrI kelI, jyAMcyAvara allAha nArAja jhAlA Ahe, he nA tumacyApaikI Aheta, nA tyAMcyApaikI, ANi jJAna asatAnAhI khoTyA goSTIMvara zapatha gheta Aheta.
allAhane tyAMcyAsAThI kaThora zikSA yAtanA tayAra karUna ThevalI Ahe. khAtrIne he je kAhI karIta Aheta, vAITa karIta Aheta.
yA lokAMnI ApalyA zapathAMnA DhAla banavUna Thevale Ahe ANi lokAMnA allAhacyA mArgApAsUna rokhatAta, tevhA tyAMcyAsAThI apamAnadAyaka az2Aba (zikSA-yAtanA) Ahe.
tyAMcI dhana-saMpattI ANi tyAMcI saMtatI allAhasamora kAhIca upayogI paDaNAra nAhI. he tara jahannamamadhye jANAra Aheta, nehamI ticyAtaca rAhatIla.

jyA divazI allAha tyA sarvAMnA uThavUna ubhe karIla, tevhA he jyA prakAre tumacyAsamora zapatha ghetAta, allAhacyA samorahI zapatha gheU lAgatIla ANi samajatIla kI te dekhIla ekhAdyA (pramANA) vara Aheta, vizvAsa karA kI niHsaMzaya teca khoTAraDe Aheta.
tyAcyAvara saitAnAne varcasva prApta kele Ahe ANi tyAMnA allAhacyA smaraNAcA visara pADalA Ahe. hI saitAnAcI senA Ahe. aikA! saitAnAcI senAca toTyAta rAhaNAra Ahe.
niHsaMzaya, allAhacA ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAcA je loka virodha karatAta, teca loka savArdhika apamAnita hoNAr2yAMpaikI Aheta.
allAhane lihUna TAkale Ahe kI niHsaMzaya, mI ANi mAjhe rasUla varcasvazAlI (vijayI) rAhatIla. niHsaMzaya, allAha moThA zaktizAlI ANi varcasvazAlI Ahe.

allAhavara ANi kayAmatacyA divasAvara ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMnA tumhI allAha ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAcyA virodhakAMzI sneha prema rAkhata asalele pAhaNAra nAhI, maga te tyAMce pitA kiMvA tyAMce putra kiMvA tyAMce bAMdhava kiMvA tyAMce nAtevAIka (kuTuMbAcyA javaLace) kA asenAta heca loka Aheta, jyAMcyA manAta allAhane ImAna lihUna dile Ahe, ANi jyAMce samarthana ApalyA AtmyAdvAre kele Ahe ANi jyAMnA azA jannatIMmadhye dAkhala karIla, jyAMcyA khAlI (thaMDa) pANyAce pravAha vAhata Aheta, jithe he sadaiva kALa rAhatIla. allAha tyAMcyAzI rAjI Ahe ANi he allAhazI rAjI Aheta. hI allAhacI phauja Ahe. jANUna ghyA kI niHsaMzaya, allAhacyA samUhAce lokaca yazasvI loka Aheta.
AkAzAMcI ANi dharatIcI pratyeka vastU allAhacyA pavitratesaha guNagAna karate ANi to moThA varcasvazAlI, hikamata bALagaNArA Ahe.

toca Ahe jyAne graMthadhArakAMmadhalyA kAphirAMnA tyAMcyA gharAtUna pahilyA hazra (ekatra hoNyAcA) veLI kADhale. tumhAlA kalpanAhI navhatI kI te nighatIla ANi te svataH samajata hote kI tyAce majabUta kille tyAMnA allAhacyA zikSA yAtanepAsUna vAcavUna ghetIla. tevhA tyAMcyAvara allAha (cA prakopa) azA ThikANAhUna yeUna kosaLalA kI tyAMnA tyAce anumAnahI navhatI ANi tyAMcyA manAta allAhane bhaya TAkale, te ApalyA gharAMnA ApalyAca hAtAMnI osADa karIta hote ANi ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMcyA hAtUna (naSTa karIta hote) tevhA, he DoLe rAkhaNAr2yAMno! bodha grahaNa karA.
ANi jara allAhane tyAMcyAsAThI haddapArI lihilI nasatI tara nizcitaca tyAMnA yA jagAtaca zikSA yAtanA dilI asatI ANi Akhiratamadhye (tara) tyAMcyAsAThI AgIcI zikSA Aheca.
he azAsAThI kI tyAMnI allAha ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAcA virodha kelA, ANi jo dekhIla allAhacA virodha karIla tara allAha dekhIla moThI kaThora zikSA yAtanA deNArA Ahe.
khajurIMcI jI jhADe tumhI kApUna TAkalIta ANi jyAMnA tumhI tyAMcyA muLAsakaTa bAkI rAhU dile tara he sarva allAhacyA AdezAne jhAle, ANi yAsAThIhI kI durAcArI lokAMnA allAhane apamAnita karAve.

ANi tyAMcI jI saMpattI allAhane ApalyA paigaMbarAcyA hAtI dilI jyAsAThI tumhI nA ghoDe dauDavile Aheta nA UMTa, kiMbahunA allAha ApalyA paigaMbarAlA, jyAcyAvara icchito varcasvazAlI karato ANi allAha pratyeka goSTa karaNyAsa samartha Ahe.

vastyAvAlyAMce je dhana allAhane tumacyA laDhaNyAvinAca ApalyA paigaMbarAcyA hAtI dile, te allAhace Ahe ANi paigaMbarAce Ahe, javaLacyA nAtevAIkAMce, anAthAMce, goragarIbAMce va pravAzAMce Ahe yAsAThI kI tumacyAtalyA dhanavAnAMcyAca hAtAta he dhana phirata rAhU naye ANi tumhAlA paigaMbara je kAhI deIla te ghyA ANi jyApAsUna rokhela tyApAsUna alipta rAhA ANi allAhace bhaya bALagata rAhA. niHsaMzaya, allAha moThI sakta zikSA yAtanA deNArA Ahe.

he dhana tyA garIba muhAjira lokAM (dezatyAga kelelyA ImAnadhArakAM) karitA Ahe, jyAMnA ApalyA gharAtUna ANi ApalyA saMpattItUna bAhera kADhale gele Ahe. te allAhacI dayA kRpA va prasannatA icchitAta ANi allAhacI ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAcI madata karatAta. heca loka sacce Aheta.

ANi (tyAMcyAkaritA) jyAMnI yA gharAta (arthAta madIneta) ANi ImAna rAkhaNyAta tyAMcyApUrvI sthAna banavUna ghetale ANi ApalyAkaDe hijarata (dezatyAga) karUna yeNAr2yAMzI prema rAkhatAta ANi dezatyAga kelelyAM (muhAjira lokAM) nA je kAhI dile jAte, tyAbaddala te ApalyA chAtIta (manAta) kasalAhI saMkoca karIta nAhIta, ulaTa svataH ApalyAvara tyAMnA prAdhAnya detAta, maga te svataH kitIhI garajavaMta asota (kharI goSTa azI kI) jo koNI ApalyA manAcyA icchA abhilASAMpAsUna vAcavilA gelA, toca saphalatA prApta karaNArA Ahe.1

ANi (tyAMcyAsAThI) je tyAMcyAnaMtara Ale, je mhaNatIla kI, he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! AmhAlA mApha kara ANi AmacyA tyA bAMdhavAMnAhI, jyAMnI AmacyA AdhI ImAna rAkhale Ahe ANi ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMcyAviSayI AmacyA manAta kapaTa (ANi vairabhAvanA) ANU nako. he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! niHsaMzaya, tU prema ANi dayA karaNArA Ahe.

kAya tumhI tyA dAMbhika (munAphika) lokAMnA nAhI pAhile, je ApalyA graMtha bALagaNAr2yAMmadhIla kAphira bAMdhavAMnA mhaNatAta kI jara tumhAlA dezAbAhera ghAlavile gele tara AmhIhI avazya tumacyAsobata dezatyAga karU ANi tumacyAviSayI kadhIhI koNAce mhaNaNe mAnya karaNAra nAhI ANi jara tumacyAzI yuddha kele kele tara nizcita AmhI tumacI madata karU, paraMtu allAha sAkSa deto kI he agadI khoTAraDe Aheta.

jara tyAMnA dezAbAhera ghAlavile gele tara he tyAMcyAsobata jANAra nAhIta ANi jara tyAMcyAzI yuddha cheDale gele tara he tyAMcI madatahI karaNAra nAhIta ANi (samajA) he madata karaNyAsa tayArahI jhAleta tara pATha dAkhavUna (paLa kADhatIla) maga tyAMcI madata kelI jANAra nAhI.
(musalamAnAMno! vizvAsa karA) kI tumace bhaya tyAMcyA chAtIta (manAta) allAhacyA bhayAcyA tulaneta phAra jAsta Ahe, he yAsAThI kI te sujJatA bALagata nAhI.

he sarva miLUnahI tumacyAzI laDhU zakata nAhI, mAtra hI goSTa vegaLI kI killyAne gheralelyA ThikANI asAveta kiMvA bhiMtIMcyA ADozAlA asAveta. tyAMcI laDhAI tara ApasAtaca moThI sakta Ahe. jarI tumhI tyAMnA ekasaMgha samajata AhAta tarI, vastutaH tyAMcI mane ApasAta vibhakta Aheta he azAsAThI kI he nirbuddha loka Aheta.
tyA lokAMsArakhe, je tyAMcyA thoDyAcapUrvI hoUna geleta, jyAMnI ApalyA duSkarmAMcI goDI cAkhalI ANi jyAMcyAsAThI duHkhadAyaka zikSA (tayAra) Ahe.
saitAnAsArakhe kI to mANasAlA mhaNato, kupra (inkAra) kara, maga jevhA to kupra karUna basato, tevhA mhaNato, mI tujhyApAsUna vegaLA Ahe. mI tara sAr2yA vizvAMcyA pAlanakartyAMce bhaya bALagato.
tevhA doghAMcA pariNAma hA jhAlA kI (jahannamacyA) AgIta nehamI nehamIkaritA gele ANi atyAcArI lokAMcI hIca zikSA Ahe.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! allAhace bhaya bALagata rAhA ANi pratyeka mANasAne he baghAve kI udyA (kayAmatakaritA) tyAne karmAMce koNate (bhAMDAra) pAThavile Ahe, ANi (pratyeka kSaNI) allAhace bhaya rAkhA, allAha tumacyA samasta karmAMzI paricita Ahe.
ANi tumhI tyA lokAMsArakhe hoU nakA, jyAMnI allAha (cyA AdezA) cA visara pADalA, tevhA allAhane tyAMnA svataHceca vismaraNa ghaDavile. aseca loka durAcArI asatAta.
jahannamavAle ANi jannatavAle (ApasAta) samAna nAhIta. je jannatavAle Aheta teca saphala Aheta.

jara AmhI kuraAnAlA ekhAdyA parvatAvara avatarita kele asate tevhA tumhI pAhile asate kI allAhacyA bhayAne to jhukUna cUra cUra (kaNa kaNa) jhAlA asatA. AmhI hI udAharaNe lokAMsAThI nivedita Ahota yAsAThI kI tyAMnI vicAra ciMtana karAve.
toca allAha Ahe, jyAcyAkherIja koNIhI upAsanIya (pUjya) nAhI. lapalelyA va ughaDa goSTI jANaNArA, toca mApha va dayA karaNArA.

toca allAha Ahe, jyAcyAkherIja koNI saccA mAbUda (upAsya) nAhI. mAlaka (svAmI) atizaya pavitra, sarva vyaMga doSAMpAsUna mukta zAMtI (salAmatI) pradAna karaNArA, saMrakSaka, varcasvazAlI, zaktizAlI, mahAnatama pavitra Ahe allAha tyA goSTIMpAsUna jyAMnA he tyAcA sahabhAgI TharavitAta.

toca allAha Ahe nirmANakartA, racayitA, svarUpa deNArA, tyAcyAcasAThI (atizaya) uttama nAve Aheta. pratyeka vastU maga tI AkAzAta aso kiMvA dharatIta aso, tyAceca pavitra varNana karate ANi toca moThA jabaradasta ANi buddhikauzalya bALagaNArA Ahe.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yA lokAMno! mAjhyA ANi ApalyA zatrUMnA mitra banavU nakA. tumhI tara mitratvAne tyAMcyAkaDe saMdeza pAThavitA ANi te tyA satyAcA, je tumacyAjavaLa yeUna pohocale Ahe, inkAra karatAta, paigaMbarAlA ANi svataH tumhAlA kevaLa yA kAraNAstava (dezAbAhera) kADhatAta kI tumhI ApalyA pAlanakartyAvara ImAna rAkhatAta. jara tumhI mAjhyA mArgAta jihAda (dharmayuddhA) karitA ANi mAjhyA prasannatecyA zodhAta nighAle AhAta (tara tyAMcyAzI maitrI karU nakA). tumhI tyAMcyAjavaLa lapUna chapUna premasaMdeza pAThavitA, ANi malA cAgalyA prakAre mAhIta Ahe, je tumhI lapavile ANi tehI je tumhI jAhIra kele. tumacyApaikI jo koNI he kAma karIla, to niHsaMzaya saraLa mArgApAsUna vicalita hoIla.

jara tyAMnI tumacyAvara kAbU miLavilA tara te tumace (ughaDa) zatrU hotIla ANi vAITarityA tumacyAvara hAta ucalU lAgatIla ANi apazabda bolU lAgatIla ANi (manApAsUna) icchitIla kI tumhIhI kupra karU lAgAve.

tumace nAtesaMbaMdha ANi saMtatI tumhAlA kayAmatacyA divazI (kAhIca) upayogI paDaNAra nAhI. allAha tumacyA daramyAna phaisalA karIla ANi tumhI je kAhI karIta AhAta allAha te cAMgalyA prakAre pAhata Ahe.

(he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno!) tumacyAkaritA (hajarata) ibrAhIma ANi tyAMcyA sAthIdArAMmadhye phAra uttama namunA Ahe, jevhA tyA sarvAMnI ApalyA janasamUhAlA spaSTa zabdAMta sAMgitale kI AmhI tumacyApAsUna ANi jyAMcI tumhI allAhakherIja ArAdhanA karatA, tyA sarvAMpAsUna pUrNapaNe vibhakta Ahota. AmhI tumacyA (zraddhecA) inkAra karato ANi toparyaMta tumhI allAhacyA eka asaNyAvara ImAna rAkhata nAhI (toparyaMta) AmacyA va tumacyA daramyAna nehamIkaritA kapaTa ANi zatrutva nirmANa jhAle. paraMtu ibrAhIma ApalyA pityAsa ase mhaNAle hote kI mI tumacyAsAThI kSamA-yAcanA avazya karIna ANi tumacyAsAThI malA allAhasamora kasalAhI adhikAra nAhI. he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! tujhyAvaraca AmhI bharavasA rAkhalA Ahe ANi tujhyAcakaDe AmhI rujU hoto, ANi tujhyAkaDeca paratUna yAyace Ahe.
he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! tU AmhAlA kAphirAMcyA kasoTIta TAkU nako ANi he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! Amace aparAdha mApha kara. niHsaMzaya, tUca varcasvazAlI ANi hikamatazAlI Ahesa.

nisaMzaya, tumacyAsAThI tyA lokAMmadhye uttama Adarza (ANi cAMgale anusaraNa Ahe, vizeSataH) tyA pratyeka mANasAkaritA, jo allAha ANi kayAmatacyA divasAcyA bheTIvara vizvAsa rAkhata asela ANi jara koNI toMDa phiravila, tara allAha pUrNataH niHspRha Ahe ANi mahAnatA va prazaMsesa pAtra Ahe.
navala navhe kI allAhane, lavakaraca tumacyA ANi tyAMcyA daramyAna prema nirmANa karAve. allAha sarva sAmarthya bALagato ANi allAha moThA mApha karaNArA ANi dayA karaNArA Ahe.

jyA lokAMnI tumacyAzI dharmAcyA saMdarbhAta yuddha kele nAhI ANi tumhAlA dezAbAhera kADhale nAhI, tyAMcyAzI sad‌vyavahAra upakArAce va nyAyapUrNa vartana karaNyApAsUna allAha tumhAlA rokhata nAhI. (kiMbahunA) niHsaMzaya, allAha nyAya karaNAr2yAMzI prema rAkhato.

allAha tumhAlA kevaLa tyA lokAMzI prema rAkhaNyApAsUna rokhato, jyAMnI tumacyAzI dharmAcyA bAbatIta laDhAI kelI ANi tumhAlA dezAbAhera kADhale ANI dezAbAhera kADhaNAr2yAMnA madata kelI, je loka azA kAphirAMzI prema rAkhatIla teca nizcitapaNe atyAcArI Aheta.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! jevhA tumacyAjavaLa ImAna rAkhaNAr2yA striyA dezatyAga karUna yetIla, tevhA tumhI tyAMcI parIkSA gheta jA. vastutaH tyAMcyA ImAnAsa cAMgalyA prakAre jANaNArA tara allAhaca Ahe, paraMtu jara tyA tumhAlA ImAna rAkhaNAr2yA vATatIla, tara maga tumhI tyAMnA kAphirAMkaDe parata pAThavU nakA. yA tyAMcyAsAThI halAla (vaidha) nAhIta ANi nA te yAMcyAsAThI halAla Aheta, ANi jo kAhI kharca tyA kAphirAMnI kelA asela, to tyAMnA deUna TAkA, tyA striyAMnA tyAMcA mahara adA karUna tyAcyAzI vivAha karUna gheNyAta tumacyAvara kasalAhI gunhA nAhI. ANi kAphira striyAMcyA vivAhabaMdhanAsa ApalyA kabjAta ThevU nakA ANi jo kAhI kharca tumhI kelA asela to mAgUna ghyA ANi jo kAhI kharca tyA kAphirAMnI kelA asela, to tyAMnIhI mAgUna ghyAvA. hA allAhacA phaisalA Ahe, jo tumacyA daramyAna karIta Ahe ANi allAha jANaNArA (ANi) hikamata bALagaNArA Ahe.

ANi jara tumacI ekhAdI patnI tumacyA hAtUna nighUna jAvI ANi kAphirAMjavaLa cAlalI jAvI, maga tumhAlA sUDAcI saMdhI (veLa) miLAvI tara jyAMcyA patnyA cAlalyA gelyA Aheta, tyAMnA tyAMcyA kharcAitake adA karA, ANi tyA allAhace bhaya bALagata rAhA jyAvara tumhI ImAna rAkhatA.

he paigaMbara! jevhA ImAna rAkhaNAr2yA striyA tumacyAzI yA goSTIMvara baiata (pratijJA) karaNyAsAThI yetIla kI tyA allAhasobata dusar2yA koNAlA sahabhAgI banaviNAra nAhIta, corI karaNAra nAhIta, vyabhicAra karaNAra nAhIta, ApalyA saMtatIcI hatyA karaNAra nAhIta ANi nA asA ekhAdA AkSepa ThevatIla jo svataH ApalyA hAtA-pAyAMsamora racUna ghyAvA ANi ekhAdyA nekIcyA kAmAta tumacI avajJA karaNAra nAhIta tara tumhI tyAMcyAkaDUna baiata karUna gheta jA ANi tyAMcyAsAThI allAhakaDe kSamA-yAcanA karA. niHsaMzaya, allAha moThA mApha karaNArA dayAvAna Ahe.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! tumhI tyA lokAMzI maitrI ThevU nakA, jyAMcyAvara allAhacA prakopa AlelA Ahe, je AkhiratapAsUna azA prakAre nirAza jhAle Ahe jyA prakAre mRta kabarIvAlyAMpAsUna, kAphira nirAza Aheta.
AkAzAMcI ANi dharatIcI pratyeka vastU allAhacyA pavitratece guNagAna karate ANi toca varcasvazAlI ANi hikamata bALagaNArA Ahe.
he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! tumhI tI goSTa kA sAMgatA, jI (svataH) karIta nAhI.
tumhI je karIta nAhI te bolaNe allAhalA nApasaMta Ahe.
niHsaMzaya, allAha tyA lokAMnA priya rAkhato, je tyAcyA mArgAta paMktibaddha (rAMgArAMgAMnI) hoUna jihAda karatAta, jaNU te zisA pAjalelI imArata hoya.

ANi (smaraNa karA) jevhA mUsAne ApalyA samudAyAcyA lokAMnA mhaTale kI he mAjhyA janasamUhAcyA lokAMno! tumhI malA kleza yAtanA kA deta AhAta, vAstavika tumhAlA cAMgale mAhIta Ahe kI mI tumacyAkaDe allAhacA rasUla (paigaMbara) Ahe. tara jevhA te loka vAkaDeca rAhile tevhA allAhane tyAMcyA hRdayAMnA ANakhI vAkaDe karUna TAkale, ANi allAha avajJAkArI janasamUhAlA mArga dAkhavita nAhI.

ANi jevhA mariyamace putra IsA mhaNAle, he (mAjhyA lokAMno!) isrAIlacI saMtatI! mI tumhA sarvAMkaDe allAhacA rasUla (paigaMbara) Ahe, mAjhyA pUrvIcA graMtha taurAtace samarthana karaNArA Ahe ANi ApalyAnaMtara yeNAr2yA ekA paigaMbarAcI khUzakhabara aikaviNArA Ahe, jyAMce nAva ahamada Ahe. maga jevhA te tyAMcyAsamora spaSTa nizANyA gheUna Ale, tevhA te mhaNU lAgale kI hI tara ughaDa jAdU Ahe!
ANi tyA mANasAhUna adhika atyAcArI koNa asela, jo allAhabaddala asatya racela? vAstavika tyAlA islAmakaDe bolAvile jAte. ANi allAha azA atyAcArI lokAMnA mArgadarzana karIta nAhI.
allAhacyA divya tejAlA (nUralA) te ApalyA phuMkIna vijhavU icchitAta. ANi allAha Apale divya teca ucca padAMparyaMta gheUna jANArA Ahe, maga inkAra karaNAr2yA (kAphirAMnA) kitIhI vAITa vATo.

toca Ahe jyAne ApalyA paigaMbarAlA mArgadarzana ANi satya dharma deUna pAThavile, yAsAThI kI tyAsa anya sarva dharmAMvara varcasvazAlI karAve, maga aneka IzvarAMcI bhaktI-upAsanA karaNAr2yAMnA kitIhI apriya vATo.
he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! kAya mI tumhAlA to vyApAra dAkhavU jo tumhAlA kaSTa yAtanAdAyaka zikSA-yAtanepAsUna vAcavila.
allAha ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAvara ImAna rAkhA ANi allAhacyA mArgAta ApalyA tana, mana ANi dhanAne jihAda karA, he tumacyAsAThI adhika cAMgale Ahe jara tumhI jJAna bALagata asAla.

allAha tumace aparAdha mApha karIla ANi tumhAlA tyA jannatIMmadhye dAkhala karIla jyAMcyA khAlI pravAha vAhata asatIla ANi svaccha zuddha gharAMmadhye, je ‘adana’cyA jannatamadhye asatIla. hI phAra moThI saphalatA Ahe.
ANi tumhAlA eka dusarI deNagIhI pradAna karIla, jI tumhI icchitA, tI Ahe allAhacI madata ANi lavakaraca prApta hoNArA vijaya ANi ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMnA khUzakhabara dyA.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! tumhI allAhace sahAyyaka banA, jyApramANe (hajarata) mariyamace putra (hajarata) IsA yAMnI havArIMnA (mitrAMnA) sAMgitale, koNa Ahe jo allAhacyA mArgAta mAjhA madatanIsa banela? (tyAMce) mitra mhaNAle kI, AmhI allAhacyA mArgAta madatanIsa Ahota. tevhA isrAIlacyA saMtatIpaikI ekA gaTAne tara ImAna rAkhale ANi ekA gaTAne kupra (inkAra) kelA, tara AmhI ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMnA tyAMcyA zatrUMcyA
AkAzAMcyA ANi dharatIcyA samastU vastU allAhacyA pAvitryAce guNagAna karatAta jo bAdazahA (sarvasattAdhIza) ANi moThA pavitra, varcasvazAlI (ANi) buddhikauzalya bALagaNArA Ahe.

toca Ahe, jyAne nirakSara lokAMmadhye tyAMcyAtUnaca eka rasUla (paigaMbara) pAThavilA, jo tyAMnA tyAcyA AyatI vAcUna aikavito ANi tyAMnA svaccha zuddha (pAka) karato ANi tyAMnA graMtha va jJAna zikavito. niHsaMzaya he yApUrvI spaSTa azA mArgabhraSTateta hote.
ANi dusar2yAMkaritAhI tyAMcyAmadhUnaca je adyApa tyAMnA sAmIla jhAle nAhIta ANi toca varcasvazAlI ANi hikamata bALagaNArA Ahe.
hI allAhacI kRpA Ahe jyAlA icchito ApalI kRpA pradAna karato ANi allAha moThA kRpALU Ahe.

jyA lokAMnA taurAtanusAra kAma karaNyAcA Adeza dilA gelA, paraMtu tyAMnI to amalAta ANalA nAhI, tyAMce udAharaNa tyA gADhavAsArakhe Ahe jyAne (pAThIvara) aneka graMtha lAdalele asAveta. allAhacyA AyatIMnA yAlA khoTe TharaviNAr2yAMce phAra vAITa udAharaNa Ahe ANi allAha azA julamI lokAMnA mArgadarzana karIta nAhI.
sAMgA kI he yahudyAMno! jara tumacA hA dAvA Ahe kI tumhI allAhace dosta AhAta, itara lokAMkherIja, tara tumhI mRtyucI abhilASA karA jara tumhI sacce asAla.
he mRtyucI kAmanA kadhIhI karaNAra nAhIta, (ApalyA) tyA karmAMmuLe jI tyAMnI svahaste ApalyA AdhI pAThavilI Aheta ANi allAha atyAcArIMnA cAMgalyA prakAre jANato.

sAMgA kI, jyA mRtyupAsUna tumhI paLa kADhata AhAta, to tara tumhAlA avazya yeUna gAThela, maga tumhI sarva, lapalelyA va ughaDa goSTIMnA jANaNAr2yA allAhakaDe paratavile jAla ANi maga to dAkhavila kI tumhI kasakase karma karIta rAhilAta.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yA lokAMno! jumaaH (zukravAra) cyA divazI namAjasAThI ajAna dilI gelI asatA tumhI allAhacyA smaraNAkaDe tvarita yeta jA ANi kharedI - vikrI soDUna dyA he tumacyAsAThI adhika cAMgale Ahe, jara tumhI jANata asAla.
maga jevhA namAja pUrNa hoIla tevhA dharatIvara (itastataH) pasarA ANi allAhacI kRpA zodhA ANi allAhace atyAdhika smaraNa karA, yAsAThI kI tumhI saphalatA prApta karUna ghyAvI.

ANi jevhA ekhAdA saudA vikatAnA pAhatAta kiMvA ekhAdA tamAzA dRSTIsa paDalA asatA tyAkaDe dhAvatAta ANi tumhAlA ubheca soDUna detAta. (tumhI) sAMgA kI allAhajavaLa je kAhI Ahe te kheLa ANi vyApArApekSA adhika cAMgale Ahe ANi allAha sarvAMta cAMgalA rojI deNArA (annadAtA) Ahe.

dAMbhika (munAphika) jevhA tumacyAjavaLa yetAta, tevhA mhaNatAta kI AmhI yA goSTIsa sAkSa Ahota kI niHsaMzaya, tumhI allAhace rasUla (paigaMbara) AhAta ANi allAha jANato kI tumhI niHsaMzaya tyAce rasUla AhAta. ANi allAha sAkSa deto kI he munAphika (dAMbhika) nizcitapaNe khoTAraDe Aheta.
tyAMnI ApalyA zapathAMnA DhAla banavUna Thevale Ahe, tara allAhacyA mArgApAsUna thAMbale, niHsaMzaya phAra vAITa Ahe tA kAma je he karIta Aheta.
he yA kAraNAstava kI he ImAna rAkhUna punhA kAphira jhAle, tevhA tyAMcyA hRdayAMvara mohara lAvalI gelI AtA tyAMnA kAhIhI samajata nAhI.

ANi jevhA tumhI tyAMnA pAhAla tevhA tyAMcI zarIre tumhAlA manamohaka vATatIla ANi jevhA he bolU lAgatIla tevhA tyAMcyA goSTI (aikaNyA) sAThI kAna lAvAla, jyApramANe hI lAkaDe Aheta bhiMtIcyA AdhAre lAvalelI (te) pratyeka (uMca) AvAjAlA ApalyAvirUddha samajatAta. teca vAstavika zatrU Aheta, tyAMcyApAsUna sAvadha rAhA, allAha tyAMcA sarvanAza karo. koThe bharakaTata jAta Aheta?

ANi jevhA tyAMnA sAMgitale jAte kI, yA, allAhacyA paigaMbarAne tumacyAsAThI kSamA yAcanecI prArthanA karAvI, tevhA ApalyA mAnA phiravatAta ANi tumhI tyAMnA pAhAla kI te garva (ghameMDa) karIta thAMbatAta.
tumhI tyAMcyAkaritA mAphIcI prArthanA karaNe ANi na karaNe sArakheca Ahe. allAhacyAMnA kadhIhI mApha karaNAra nAhI. niHsaMzaya, allAha azA durAcArI lokAMnA mArga dAkhavita nAhI.

heca te loka hota je mhaNatAta kI je loka allAhacyA paigaMbarAsobata Aheta, tyAMcyAvara kAhI kharca karU nakA, yethe paryaMta kI te itastataH vhAveta vastutaH AkAzAMce ANi jaminIce sarva khajine allAhacyAca mAlakIce Aheta, paraMtu yA dAMbhikAMnA he samajata nAhI.

he mhaNatAta kI jara AmhI AtA paratUna madInA yethe gelo tara pratiSThA bALagaNArA, apamAnitAsa tethUna bAhera kADhIla. (aikA) mAna-pratiSThA tara kevaLa allAhakaritA ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAkaritA va ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMkaritA Ahe, tathApi he dAMbhika (munAphika) jANata nAhIta.
he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! tumacyA dhanasaMpattI va saMtatIne tumhAlA allAhacyA smaraNApAsUna gAphIla na karAve ANi je ase karatIla, teca loka nukasAna ucalaNAre (toTyAta rAhaNAre) Aheta.

ANi AmhI je kAhI tumhAlA pradAna kele Ahe, tyAcyAtUna (AmacyA mArgAta) kharca karA, yApUrvI kI tumacyApaikI ekhAdyAlA maraNa yAve, tevhA mhaNU lAgale kI, he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! tU malA thoDyA uzirAcI savaDa kA nAhI deta? kI mI dAna-puNya karAve ANi neka va sadAcArI lokAMpaikI vhAve.
ANi jevhA ekhAdyAcI nirdhArita veLa yeUna pohocate, maga allAha tyAlA kAhIca savaDa deta nAhI ANi tumhI je kAhI karatA allAha te cAMgalyA prakAre jANato.
AkAzAMcI ANi dharatIcI pratyeka vastU allAhacI pavitratA varNana karate, tyAcIca rAjya-sattA Ahe ANi tyAcIca stutI-prazaMsA Ahe. ANi to pratyeka goSTIce sAmarthya bALagato.
tyAneca tumhAlA nirmANa kele Ahe, maga tumacyApaikI kAhI kAphira (inkArI) Aheta ANi kAhI ImAna rAkhaNAre Aheta ANi tumhI je kAhI karIta AhAta, allAha te cAMgalyA prakAre pAhata Ahe.
tyAneca AkAzAMnA ANi dharatIlA satyAsaha (buddhikauzalyAne) nirmANa kele, tyAneca tumace cehare mohare banavile ANi khUpa suMdara banavile ANi tyAcyAcakaDe paratAyace Ahe.
to AkAzAMcyA ANi jaminIcyA sarva vastUMce jJAna rAkhato, ANi je kAhI tumhI lapavitA ANi jAhIra karatA te sarva to jANato. allAha tara chAtItalyA (manAtalyA) goSTI dekhIla jANato.
kAya tumhAlA yA pUrvIcyA kAphirAMcI khabara nAhI pohacalI, jyAMnI ApalyA karmAMcyA pariNAmAMcA svAda cAkhalA, ANi jyAMcyAsAThI duHkhadAyaka zikSA yAtanA Ahe.

he yA kAraNAstava kI tyAMcyAjavaLa tyAMce paigaMbara spaSTa pramANa (purAve) gheUna Ale tevhA te mhaNAle kI kAya eka manuSya AmhAlA mArgadarzana karIla? ANi inkAra kelA va toMDa phiravile ANi allAhane tyAMcI parvA kelI nAhI, ANi allAha tara Aheca moThA niHspRha, sarvaguNa saMpanna.

tyA kAphira (inkArI) lokAMnI ase gRhIta dharale Ahe kI tyAMnA dusar2yAMdA jivaMta kele jANAra nAhI. tumhI sAMgA kI kA nAhI? allAhacI zapatha! tumhAlA avazya punhA jivaMta kele jAIla, maga je kAhI (karma) tumhI kele Ahe tyAcI khabara tumhAlA dilI jAIla ANi allAhakaritA he phAraca sope Ahe.
tevhA tumhI allAhavara ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAvara ANi tyA divya tejAvara jo AmhI avatarita kelA Ahe, ImAna rAkhA, ANi allAha tumacyA pratyeka karmAlA (cAMgalyA prakAre) jANUna Ahe.

jyA divazI allAha tumhA sarvAMnA, tyA ekatrita kele jANyAcyA divazI ekatra karIla, toca parAjaya ANi vijayAcA divasa Ahe, ANi jo (manuSya) allAhavara ImAna rAkhUna satkarma karIla, allAha tyAcyApAsUna tyAcI duSkarme dUra karIla ANi tyAlA jannatImadhye dAkhala karIla, jyAMcyA khAlI pravAha vAhata Aheta, jyAMcyAta te sadaivakALa rAhatIla. hIca phAra moThI saphalatA Ahe.
ANi jyA lokAMnI kupra (inkAra) kelA ANi AmacyA AyatIMnA khoTe Tharavile, te sarvaca jahannamamadhye jANAre Aheta, jyAta te nehamI rAhatIla. te moThe vAITa ThikANa Ahe.
koNatehI saMkaTa allAhacyA AjJevinA pohacU zakata nAhI ANi jo koNI allAhavara ImAna rAkhato, allAha tyAcyA hRdayAlA mArgadarzana karato, ANi allAha pratyeka goSTa cAMgalyA prakAre jANaNArA Ahe.
(lokAMno!) allAhacyA AdezAce pAlana karA ANi paigaMbarAce AjJApAlana karA, maga jara tumhI toMDa phiraviNAre vhAla tara AmacyA paigaMbarAce kartavya kevaLa spaSTapaNe (saMdeza) pohacaviNe Ahe.
allAhakherIja koNIhI saccA mAbUda (kharA upAsya) nAhI, ANi ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMnI kevaLa allAhavaraca bharavasA ThevalA pAhije.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! tumacyA kAhI patnyA ANi saMtatIpaikI kAhI tumace zatrU Aheta, tevhA tyAMcyApAsUna satarka rAhA ANi jara tumhI mApha karAla, va soDUna dyAla ANi mApha karAla tara allAha mApha karaNArA, dayALU Ahe.
tumacI dhana-saMpattI ANi tumacI saMtatI (tara khAtrIne) tumacI kasoTI Ahe ANi phAra moThA mobadalA, allAhajavaLa Ahe.

tevhA yathAsaMbhava allAhace bhaya bALagata rAhA ANi aikata va AjJApAlana karIta rAhA, ANi (allAhacyA mArgAta) dAna karIta rAhA, je tumacyAsAThI adhika cAMgale Ahe ANi je loka ApalyA manAcyA lAlasepAsUna surakSita Thevale gele, teca saphala Aheta.

jara tumhI allAhalA cAMgale karja dyAla (arthAta tyAcyA mArgAta kharca karAla) tara to te tumacyAsAThI vADhavita jAIla ANi tumace aparAdhahI mApha karIla. ANi allAha moThA kadara karaNArA ANi sahana karaNArA Ahe.
to lapalelyA ANi ughaDa goSTI jANaNArA, jabaradasta va hikamatazAlI Ahe.

he paigaMbara! (ApalyA janasamudAyAcyA lokAMnA sAMgA) jevhA tumhI ApalyA patnyAMnA talAka deU icchita asAla tara tyAMcyA iddata (cI mudata surU hota) asatAnA talAka dyA ANi iddatacI gaNanA karA, ANi allAhace, jo tumacA pAlanakartA Ahe. bhaya bALagata rAhA, nA tumhI tyAMnA tyAMcyA gharAMmadhUna bAhera kADhAve ANi nA tyAMnI (svataH) nighAve, mAtra hI goSTa vegaLI kI tyAMnI ughaDapaNe duSkarma karUna basAve. yA allAhane nirdhArita kelelyA sImA (maryAdA) Aheta, ANi jo manuSya allAhacyA maryAdAMce ullaMghana karIla tyAne khAtrIne ApalyA svataHvara atyAcAra kelA, tumhI nAhI jANata kI kadAcita tyAnaMtara allAhane ekhAdI navI goSTa (sthitI) nirmANa karAvI.

tara jevhA yA (striyA) ApalA avadhI pUrNa karaNyAprata pohacatIla tevhA tyAMnA rItasara ApalyA vivAhabaMdhanAta rAhU dyA kiMvA niyamAnusAra tyAMnA vibhakta karA, ANi ApasAta dona nyAya karaNAr2yA mANasAMnA sAkSI banavUna ghyA, ANi allAhacyA prasannatesAThI yathAyogya sAkSa dyA, heca te, jyAcI zikavaNa tyAMnA dilI jAta Ahe, je allAhavara ANi kayAmatacyA divasAvara ImAna rAkhata asatIla, ANi jo manuSya allAhace bhaya bALagato allAha tyAcyAsAThI suTakecA mArga kADhato.

ANi tyAlA azA ThikANAhUna rojI (AjivikA) upalabdha karUna deto jyAcI tyAlA kalpanAhI nasela ANi jo manuSya allAhavara bharavasA karIla, allAha tyAcyAsAThI puresA asela. allAha Apale kArya pUrNa kelyAzivAya rAhaNAra nAhI. allAhane pratyeka goSTIce eka anumAna nirdhArita kelele Ahe.

tumacyA striyAMpaikI jyA striyA mAsika pALIbAbata nirAza jhAlyA asatIla, jara tumhAlA zaMkA asela tara tyAMcI iddata tIna mahIne Ahe, ANi tyAMcIdekhIla, jyAMnA ajUna mAsika pALI surU jhAlelI nasela, ANi garbhavatI striyAMcI iddata tyAMcI prastutI hoNe Ahe ANi jo manuSya allAhace bhaya bALagela, allAha tyAcyA pratyeka kAmAta sahajatA nirmANa karIla.
hA allAhacA Adeza Ahe, jo tyAne tumacyAkaDe avatarita kelA Ahe, ANi jo manuSya allAhace bhaya bALagela, allAha tyAce aparAdha miTavila ANi tyAlA phAra mahAna mobadalA pradAna karIla.

tumhI ApalyA sAmarthyAnusAra jithe rAhAta asAla tithe tyA (ghaTasphoTita) striyAMnA ThevA, ANi tyAMnA sataviNyAkaritA kaSTa yAtanA deU nakA, ANi jara tyA garbhavatI asatIla tara tyA prasUta hoI paryaMta tyAMnA kharca deta rAhA, maga jara tumacyA sAMgaNyAvarUna tyAca dUdha pAjatIla tara tumhI tyAMnA tyAMce pArazramika deUna TAkA, ANi ApasAta cAMgalyA prakAre sallAmasalata karUna gheta jA ANi jara tumhI ApasAta taNAva rAkhAla tara tyAcyA (pityAcyA) sAMgaNyAvarUna dusarI strI dUdha pAjela.

dhanavAnAne ApalyA dhana (sAmarthyA) nusAra kharca kelA pAhije, ANi jyAcI jIvikA (rojI) tyAcyAsAThI kamI kelI gelI asela tara allAhane je kAhI tyAlA deUna Thevale Ahe, tyAtUna tyAne (ApalyA sAmarthyAnusAra) dyAve, koNatyAhI mANasAvara allAha ojhe Thevata nAhI, paraMtu itakeca jevaDhe sAmarthya tyAlA dile gele Ahe. allAha garIbInaMtara dhana dekhIla pradAna karela.
ANi aneka vastI (vAlyAM) nI ApalyA pAlanakartyAcyA AdezAcI ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAcI avajJA kelI tevhA AmhI dekhIla tyAMcA sakta hizoba ghetalA ANi na pAhilelA (kaThora) az2Aba tyAMcyAvara TAkalA.
tevhA tyAMnI ApalyA kRta-karmAMcA svAda cAkhUna ghetalA ANi pariNAmasvarupI tyAMce nukasAna jhAle.

tyAMcyAsAThI allAhane phAra kaThora zikSA - yAtanA tayAra karUna ThevalI Ahe, tevhA he buddhimAna ImAnadhArakAMno, allAhace bhaya rAkhA, niHsaMzaya, allAhane tumacyAkaDe bodha - upadeza pAThavilA Ahe.

(arthAta) paigaMbara, jo tumhAlA allAhace spaSTa Adeza vAcUna aikavito, yAsAThI kI tyA lokAMnA, jyAMnI ImAna rAkhale ANi satkarma kele, tyAMnA aMdhArAkaDUna ujeDAkaDe ANAve ANi jo manuSya allAhavara ImAna rAkhela ANi satkarma karela, allAha tyAlA azA jannatamadhye dAkhala karela, jicyAkhAlI pravAha vAhata Aheta, jyAta te nehamI nehamI rAhatIla. niHsaMzaya, allAhane tyAlA sarvAMta uttama rojI (jIvikA) deUna ThevalI Ahe.

allAha to Ahe, jyAne sAta AkAza banavile ANi tyAcapramANe jamIna dekhIla. tyAcA Adeza tyAMcyA daramyAna avatarita hoto, yAsAThI kI tumhI jANUna ghyAve kI allAha pratyeka goSTa karaNyAsa samartha Ahe, ANi allAhane pratyeka goSTIlA ApalyA jJAnakakSeta gheralele Ahe.

he paigaMbara! jyA goSTIlA allAhane tumacyAsAThI halAla (vaidha) kele Ahe, tilA tumhI harAma (avaidha) kA TharavitA? (kAya) tumhI ApalyA patnIMcI prasannatA prApta karU icchitA, ANi allAha moThA mApha karaNArA, moThA dayALU Ahe.
niHsaMzaya, allAhane tumacyAsAThI (azA) zapathAMmadhUna bAhera paDaNyAcA mArga nirdhArita kelA Ahe, ANi allAha tumacA kAryasAdhaka (mitra) Ahe ANi toca (pUrNa) jJAna bALagaNArA ANi hikamatazAlI Ahe.

ANi (smaraNa karA) jevhA paigaMbarAMnI ApalyA kAhI patnIMnA gopanIyateta eka goSTa sAMgitalI tara jevhA tine tyA goSTIcI vAcyatA kelI, ANi allAhane ApalyA paigaMbarAlA tyAbAbata avagata kele, tevhA paigaMbarAMnI kAhI goSTa tara sAMgitalI ANi kAhI sAMgAyace TALale, maga jevhA paigaMbarAnI ApalyA tyA patnIlA hI goSTa sAMgitalI, tevhA tI mhaNAlI, yAcI khabara tumhAlA koNI dilI? sAMgitale, sarva kAhI jANaNAr2yA, pUrNa khabara rAkhaNAr2yA allAhane malA yAcI khabara dilI Ahe.

(he paigaMbarAcyA donhI patnIMno!) jara tumhI allAhakaDe mAphI mAgAla (tara phAra cAMgale Ahe). niHsaMzaya, tumacI hRdaye jhukalI Aheta ANi jara tumhI paigaMbarAcyA virodhAta ekamekAMcI madata karAla tara niHsaMzaya, tyAMcA mitra saMrakSaka allAha Ahe ANi jibrIla neka ImAna rAkhaNAre ANi tyAcyAkherIja phariztehI madata karaNAre Aheta.

jara to (rasUla) tumhAlA talAka deUna TAkIla tara lavakaraca tyAMnA, tyAMcA pAlanakartA (allAha) tumacyAaivajI tumacyApekSA cAMgalyA patnyA pradAna karIla, jyA islAma (dharma) bALagaNAr2yA, ImAna rAkhaNAr2yA, allAhasamora jhukaNAr2yA, mAphI mAgaNAr2yA, upAsanA karaNAr2yA, roje (vrata) rAkhaNAr2yA asatIla vidhavA ANi kumArikA.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! tumhI svataH ApalyAlA ANi ApalyA kuTuMbiyAMnA tyA AgIpAsUna vAcavA, jice iMdhana mAnava ANi dagaDa Aheta, jicyAvara kaThora hRdayAce sakta pharizte tainAta Aheta. jyAMnA allAha jo Adeza deto, tyAcI te avajJA karIta nAhIta, kiMbahunA jo kAhI Adeza dilA jAto tyAce pAlana karatAta.
he inkArI lokAMno! Aja tumhI (vivazatA ANi) bahANA dAkhavU nakA, tumhAlA kevaLa tumacyA duSkarmAMce pratiphaLa dile jAta Ahe.

he ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMno! tumhI allAhapuDhe (kharI ANi) nikhAlasa mAphI mAgA. saMbhavataH tumacyA pAlanakartyAne tumacI duSkarme miTavAvita. ANi tumhAlA azA jannatamadhye dAkhala karAve jicyA khAlI pravAha vAhata Aheta. jyA divazI allAha paigaMbarAlA ANi ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMnA, je tyAMcyAsobata Aheta apamAnita karaNAra nAhI. tyAMce divya teja (nUra) tyAMcyA puDhe ANi tyAMcyA ujavIkaDe dhAvata asela. he duA (prArthanA) karata asatIla kI he AmacyA pAlanakartyA! AmhAlA saMpUrNa teja (nUra) pradAna kara ANi AmhAlA kSamA kara. niHsaMzaya, tU pratyeka goSTIce sAmarthya bALagaNArA Ahe.
he paigaMbara! kAphirAMzI ANi munAphika (dAMbhika) lokAMzI jihAda karA ANi tyAMcyAvara saktI (kaThoratA) karA. tyAMce ThikANa jahannama Ahe ANi te moThe vAITa ThikANa Ahe.

allAhane kAphira lokAMkaritA nUhacyA ANi lUtacyA patnIMce udAharaNa dile Ahe. yA doghI AmacyA dAsAMpaikI dona neka sadAcArI dAsAMcyA kuTuMbAta hotyA. maga tyAMnI tyAMcyAzI vizvAsaghAta kelA, tevhA te donhI (dAsa) tyAMcyApAsUna allAhacyA (koNatyAhI zikSA - yAtanelA) rokhU zakale nAhIta ANi Adeza dilA gelA kI (striyAMno!) jahannamamadhye jANAr2yAMsobata tumhI doghIhI jA.

ANi allAhane ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMkaritA phiraaunacyA patnIce udAharaNa sAMgitale. jevhA tine duA (prArthanA) kelI kI he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! mAjhyAsAThI ApalyA javaLa jahannatamadhye eka ghara banava ANi malA phiraaunapAsUna va tyAcyA karmAMpAsUna vAcava ANi malA atyAcArI lokAMpAsUna muktI de.

ANi (udAharaNa dile) imarAnacI kanyA mariyamace jine ApalyA zIla-abrUce rakSaNa kele, maga AmhI ApalyAtarphe ticyAta prANa (AtmA) phuMkalA ANi (mariyama) ne ApalyA pAlanakartyAcyA vacanAMce ANi tyAcyA graMthAMce samarthana kele ANi tI upAsanA karaNArIM paikI hotI.
moThA samRddhazAlI Ahe to, jyAcyA hAtI rAjya (sattA) Ahe ANi jo pratyeka goSTIce sAmarthya bALagaNArA Ahe.
jyAne jIvana ANi mRtyulA azAsAThI nirmANa kele kI tumacI parIkSA ghyAvI kI tumacyApaikI cAMgale karma koNa karato ANi to varcasvazAlI ANi mApha karaNArA Ahe.

jyAne sAta AkAza vara-khAlI nirmANa kele (tevhA he pAhaNAr2yAMno!) rahamAna (allAha) cyA nirmitIta kasalIhI visaMgatI ADhaLaNAra nAhI. dusar2yAMdA paratUna pAhA kI kAya ekhAdA (vyaMga - doSa) disUna yeto?
maga parata punhA dona dona veLA pAhA, tujhI dRSTI tujhyAkaDe apamAnita (ANi lAcAra) hoUna thakalelI parata yeIla.

ANi niHsaMzaya, AmhI yA jagAcyA AkAzAlA divyAMnI (tAr2yAMnI) suzobhita kele ANi tyAMnA saitAnAMnA mAraNyAce sAdhana banavile. ANi saitAnAMkaritA AmhI (jahannamacA jALaNArA) az2Aba tayAra karUna ThevalA Ahe.
ANi ApalyA pAlanakartyAzI inkAra karaNAr2yAMkaritA jahannamacA az2Aba (zikSA - yAtanA) Ahe ANi te kitI vAITa sthAna Ahe!
jevhA he tyAta TAkale jAtIla, tevhA ticA (jahannamacA) bhayaMkara AvAja aikatIla ANi tI ukaLata asela.

(ase disela kI AtAca) krodhAtirekAne phATUna jAIla. jevhA jevhA tyAta ekhAdA samUha TAkalA jAIla, tevhA tyAlA jahannamacA rakSaka vicArela kI, kAya tumacyAjavaLa koNI khabaradAra karaNArA AlA navhatA?
te uttara detIla, niHsaMzaya, AlA tara hotA, paraMtu AmhI tyAlA khoTe Tharavile ANi mhaTale kI allAhane kAhIca avatarita kele nAhI, tumhI phAra moThyA mArgabhraSTateta AhAta.
ANi mhaNatIla kI jara AmhI aikale asate kiMvA samajUna ghetale asate tara jahannamavAlyAMmadhye (sAmIla) jhAlo nasato.
jevhA tyAMnI Apale aparAdha kabUla kele. AtA he jahannamI loka dUra hovota.
niHsaMzaya, je loka ApalyA pAlanakartyAce na pAhatAca bhaya bALagatAta, tyAMcyAsAThI mAphI Ahe ANi moThA mobadalA Ahe.
ANi tumhI ApalyA goSTI agadI haLU svarAta bolA kiMvA uMca AvAjAta, to tara chAtImadhye (manAta lapalelyA) goSTIMnAhI cAMgalyA prakAre jANato.
kAya toca nAhI jANaNAra, jyAne nirmANa kele? maga to sUkSmadarzI ANi khabara rAkhaNArAhI asAvA.

to, toca Ahe, jyAne tumacyAsAThI jaminIlA sakhala (ANi komala) banavile, yAsAThI kI tumhI ticyA rastyAMvara yeNe-jANe karIta rAhAve ANi tine dilelyA jIvike (anna-sAmugrI) lA khAve-pyAve. tyAcyAcakaDe (tumhAlA) jivaMta hoUna uThUna ubhe rAhAyace Ahe.
kAya tumhI yA goSTIpAsUna nirbhaya jhAlAta kI AkAzAMcyA svAmIne tumhAlA jaminIta dhasavUna TAkAve ANi jamIna akasmAta tharatharAvI.
kiMvA kAya tumhI yA goSTIpAsUna nirbhaya jhAlA AhAta kI AkAzAMcyA svAmIne tumacyAvara dagaDAMcA varSAva karAvA? maga tara tumhAlA kaLUnaca yeIla kI mAjhe bhaya dAkhavaNe kase hote?
ANi tyAMcyA pUrvI hoUna gelelyA lokAMnIhI khoTe Tharavile hote, (tara pAhA) tyAMcyAvara mAjhA prakopa (az2Aba) kasA jhAlA?

kAya he kadhI ApalyA vara pakSyAMnA paMkha pasaravitAnA ANi (kadhI) miTavitAnA pAhata nAhIta? tyAMnA rahamAna (allAha) neca (vAtAvaraNAta va AkAzAta) AdhAra dilelA Ahe. niHsaMzaya, pratyeka goSTa tyAcyA najareta Ahe.
allAhakherIja tumacI koNatI senA Ahe, jI tumhAlA madata karU zakela, kAphira (inkAra karaNAre) tara pUrNataH dhokyAtaca Aheta.

ANi tumacyAsAThI dharatIlA allAhane bichAIta banavile.
yAsAThI kI tumhI ticyA vistRta mArgAvara cAlAve phirAve.
(nUha) mhaNAle kI he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! tyA lokAMnI mAjhI avajJA kelI, ANi azAMce AjJApAlana kele, jyAMcyA saMpattI va saMtatIne tyAMcyA nukasAnAtaca bhara ghAtalI.
ANi tyA lokAMnI phAra moThA dhokA (kapaTa) kelA.
ANi te mhaNAle kI kadhIhI ApalyA daivatAMnA soDU nakA, ANi nA vadda, suvAa, yagUsa, yaauka ANi nasralA (soDA).
ANi tyAMnI aneka lokAMnA mArgabhraSTa kele. (he pAlanakartyA!) tU yA atyAcArI lokAMcyA mArgabhraSTateta ANakhI vADha kara.
he loka ApalyA aparAdhAMpAyI (pANyAta) buDavile gele ANi jahannamamadhye pohacavile gele ANi allAhakherIja tyAMnA ApalA koNI madata karaNArA ADhaLalA nAhI.
ANi (nUha) mhaNAle kI he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! tU yA dharatIvara koNatyAhI kAphirAlA (inkAra karaNAr2yAlA) vAstavya karaNArA soDU nakosa.
jara tyAMnA tU soDazIla tara niHsaMzaya he tujhyA dusar2yA dAsAMnAhI mArgabhraSTa karatIla ANi he duSkarma karaNAr2yA kAphirAMnAca janma detIla.

he mAjhyA pAlanakartyA! tU malA ANi mAjhyA mAtA-pityAlA ANi je dekhIla ImAna rAkhUna mAjhyA gharAta yetIla ANi samasta ImAnadhAraka puruSAMnA ANi samasta ImAnadhAraka striyAMnA mApha kara ANi kAphirAMnA vinAzAkherIja anya koNatyAhI goSTIta vRddhiMgata karU nakosa.
(he muhammada sa.) tumhI sAMgA kI malA vahayI (prakAzanA) kelI gelI Ahe kI jinnAMcyA ekA samUhAne (kuraAna) aikale ANi mhaTale kI AmhI moThe AzcaryakAraka kuraAna aikale Ahe.
jo satya mArga dAkhavito AmhI tara tyAvara ImAna rAkhale, (AtA) AmhI kadhIhI ApalyA pAlanakartyAcA dusar2yA ekhAdyAlA sahabhAgI banaviNAra nAhI.
ANi niHsaMzaya, AmacyA pAlanakartyAcI zAna (mahAnatA) ati ucca Ahe, tyAne nA koNAlA (ApalI) patnI banavile Ahe ANi nA saMtatI.
ANi niHsaMzaya, AmacyAtalA mUrkha, allAhaviSayI khoTyA goSTI bolata hotA.
ANi AmhI tara heca samajata rAhilo kI manuSya ANi jinna allAhaviSayI kadhIhI khoTe bolaNAra nAhIta.
vastutaH kAhI mANase, kAhI jinnAMkaDe zaraNa mAgata hote, jyAmuLe jinnAMcyA udaMDateta adhikaca bhara paDalI.
ANi (mAnavAM) nI dekhIla jinnAMpramANe he gRhIta dharale hote kI allAha kadhIhI koNAlA pAThaviNAra nAhI (kiMvA koNAlA dusar2yAMdA jivaMta karaNAra nAhI).
ANi AmhI AkAzAce nirIkSaNa karUna pAhile tevhA te sakta pahArekar2yAMnI ANi prakhara agni-zikhAMnI (jvAlAMnI) bharalele ADhaLale.
ANi yAcyApUrvI AmhI goSTI (bolaNe) aikaNyAkaritA AkAzAta ThikaThikANI basata asU, AtA jo dekhIla kAna lAvato, tyAlA eka jvAlA ApalyAvara TapUna asalyAce ADhaLate.
ANi AmhI nAhI jANata kI dharatIvara rAhaNAr2yAMzI ekhAdyA vAITa goSTIcA irAdA kelA gelA Ahe kI tyAMcyA pAlanakartyAcA irAdA tyAMcyAzI bhalAIcA Ahe.
ANi he kI (niHsaMzaya) AmacyApaikI kAhI tara neka sadAcArI Aheta ANi kAhI tyAcyA viparIta Aheta. AmhI aneka prakAre vibhAgalelo Ahota.
ANi AmhAlA (AtA) pUrNa khAtrI jhAlI kI AmhI allAhalA dharatIta kadhIhI vivaza karU zakata nAhI ANi nA AmhI paLUna jAUna tyAlA parAsta karU zakato.
ANi AmhI mArgadarzanAcI goSTa aikatAca ticyAvara ImAna rAkhale ANi jo dekhIla ApalyA pAlanakartyAvara ImAna rAkhela, tyAlA nA ekhAdyA hAnIce bhaya Ahe nA atyAcArA (va duHkhA) ce.
ANi AmacyApaikI kAhI muslima Aheta tara kAhI anyAyI Ahe, tevhA je muslima jhAle, tyAMnI sanmArga zodhUna ghetalA.
ANi je atyAcArI Aheta, te jahannamace iMdhana banale.
ANi he kI jara he loka saraLa mArgAvara dRDhapaNe rAhile asate, tara avazya AmhI tyAMnA bharapUra pANI pAjale asate.
yAsAThI kI AmhI yAta tyAMcI parIkSA ghyAvI ANi jo manuSya ApalyA pAlanakartyAcyA smaraNApAsUna toMDa phiravila, tara allAha tyAlA kaThora zikSA - yAtaneta TAkIla.
ANi he kI masjida kevaLa allAhacyAcakaritA (khAsa) Aheta. tevhA allAhasobata dusar2yA koNAlA pukAru nakA.
ANi jevhA allAhacA dAsa (upAsaka) tyAcyA upAsanesAThI ubhA rAhilA tevhA nikaTa hote kI te jamAvAjamAvAne tyAcyAvara tuTUna paDAveta.
(tumhI) sAMgA kI, mI tara kevaLa ApalyA pAlanakartyAsa pukArato ANi tyAcyAsobata dusar2yA koNAlA sahabhAgI banavita nAhI.
sAMgA, malA tumacyA bAbatIta kasalyAhI lAbha-hAnIcA adhikAra nAhI.
sAMgA kI malA allAhapAsUna kadhIhI koNI vAcavU zakata nAhI, ANi mI kadhIhI tyAcyAkherIja ekhAde AzrayasthAna prApta karU zakata nAhI.

tathApi (mAjhe kAma) tara kevaLa allAhacI vANI ANi tyAcA saMdeza (lokAMnA) pohacaviNe Ahe (AtA) jo dekhIla allAha ANi tyAcyA paigaMbarAcI avajJA karIla tara tyAcyAsAThI jahannamacI Aga Ahe, jicyAta ase loka sadaiva rAhatIla.
yetheparyaMta kI, jevhA te tilA pAhUna ghetIla, jicA tyAMnA vAyadA dilA jAta Ahe, tevhA nikaTa bhaviSyAta jANUna ghetIla kI koNAcA sahAyyaka kamajora ANi koNAcA samUha (saMkhyene) kamI Ahe.
(tumhI) sAMgA kI malA nAhI mAhIta kI jyA goSTIcA vAyadA tumacyAzI kelA jAta Ahe, tI javaLa Ahe kI mAjhA pAlanakartA tyAkaritA lAMbacI mudata nirdhArita karIla.
toca parokSa jJAtA Ahe ANi ApalyA parokSa (jJAnA) ne to koNAlAhI avagata karavita nAhI.
mAtra tyA rasUla (paigaMbarA) kherIja, jyAlA to pasaMta karIla, yAsAThI kI tyAcyAhI puDhe - mAge pahArekarI (saMrakSaka) tainAta karato.
yAsAThI kI he kaLUna ghyAve kI tyAMnI ApalyA pAlanakartyAce saMdeza pohacavileta. allAhane tyAMcyA nikaTacyA goSTIMnA gherUna Thevale Ahe ANi pratyeka goSTIcI gaNanA karUna ThevalI Ahe.
he cAdarIta lapeTUna gheNAr2yA,
rAtrI (tahajjudacyA namAjasAThI) uThUna ubhe rAhA, paraMtu thoDA veLa.
ardhI rAtra kiMvA tyApekSAhI kAhI kamI.
kiMvA tyAvara vADhavUna ANi kuraAnAce thoDe thAMbUna thAMbUna (spaSTataH) paThaNa karA.
niHsaMzaya, AmhI tumacyAvara eka bhAradasta goSTa lavakaraca avatarita karU.
niHsaMzaya, rAtrIce uThaNe manAcyA ekAgratekaritA phAra yogya Ahe ANi kathanAsa moThe durusta (ucita) karaNAre Ahe.
nizcitaca, divasA tumhAlA aneka kAme asatAta.
ANi tumhI ApalyA pAlanakartyAce nAmaHsmaraNa karIta jA ANi saMpUrNa sRSTI (nirmitI) pAsUna alaga hoUna tyAcyAkaDe dhyAnamagna vhA.
pUrva ANi pazcimecA svAmI, jyAcyAkherIja koNIhI upAsya nAhI. tumhI tyAlAca ApalA kAryasAdhaka (va saMrakSaka) banavA.
ANi je kAhI te sAMgatAta, tumhI te sahana karIta rAhA ANi tyAMnA cAMgalyA prakAre soDUna dyA.
ANi malA va tyA khoTe TharaviNAr2yA susaMpanna lokAMnA soDUna dyA, ANi tyAMnA thoDI savaDa dyA.
niHsaMzaya, AmacyAjavaLa kaThora beDyA Aheta, ANi dhagadhaga peTata asalelI jahannama Ahe.
ANi gaLyAta aDakaNAre jevaNa Ahe ANi duHkhadAyaka az2Aba Ahe.
jyA divazI dharatI ANi parvata kaMpita hotIla ANi parvata bhurabhurita vALUcyA TekaDyAMsArakhe hotIla.
niHsaMzaya, AmhI tumacyAkaDehI tumacyAvara sAkSa deNArA paigaMbara pAThavilA Ahe, jasA AmhI phiraaunakaDe rasUla (paigaMbara) pAThavilA hotA.
tevhA phiraaunane tyA paigaMbarAcI avajJA kelI tara AmhI tyAlA ghora saMkaTAta dharale.
tumhI jara inkArI rAhAla tara tyA divazI kase surakSita rAhAla, jo divasa lahAna bAlakAMnA vRddha karUna TAkIla.
jyA divazI AkAza vidIrNa hoIla, allAhacA hA vAyadA pUrNa jhAlyAzivAya rAhaNAra nAhI.
niHsaMzaya, hA bodha (upadeza) Ahe, tevhA jo icchila tyAne ApalyA pAlanakartyAkaDe (jANyA) cA mArga patkarAvA.

niHsaMzaya, tumacA pAlanakartA cAMgalyA prakAre jANato kI tumhI ANi tumacyAsobata asalelyA lokAMcA eka samUha sumAre dona tRtiyAMza rAtrIlA ANi ardhyA rAtrIlA ANi eka tRtiyAMza rAtrIlA (tahajjudacyA namAjasAThI) ubhe rAhatAta, ANi rAtra-divasAce pUrNa anumAna allAhalAca Ahe. to (cAMgalyA prakAre) jANato kI tumhI te muLIca nibhAvU zakaNAra nAhIta, tevhA tyAne tumacyAvara kRpA kelI, yAstava jevaDhe kuraAna paThaNa karaNe tumhAlA sahaja asela, tevaDheca paThaNa karA. to jANato kI tumacyApaikI kAhI rogIhI asatIla, dusare kAhI jaminIvara hiMDUna phirUna allAhacI kRpA (arthAta rojIroTI) zodhatIla ANi kAhI allAhacyA mArgAta jihAdahI karatIla, tevhA tumhI jevaDhe (kuraAna) paThaNa sahajapaNe karU zakatA, tevaDhe karA, ANi namAja niyamitapaNe paDhata rAhA ANi jakAta (dekhIla) deta rAhA, ANi allAhalA cAMgale karja dyA, ANi jI nekI (satkarme) tumhI ApalyA svataHsAThI puDhe pAThavAla tI allAhacyA ThikANI sarvottamarityA mobadalyAta adhika prApta karAla. ANi allAhajavaLa mAphI mAgata rAhA. niHsaMzaya, allAha moThA mApha karaNArA, dayA karaNArA Ahe.
he vastra pAMgharUNa gheNAre!
ubhe rAhA ANi khabaradAra karA.
ANi ApalyA pAlanakartyAcIca mahimA varNana karA.
ANi ApalyA vastrAMnA pavitra (svaccha zuddha) rAkhata jA.
ANi apavitratA (malInatA) soDUna dyA.
ANi upakAra karUna jAsta prApta karUna gheNyAcI icchA dharU nakA.
ANi ApalyA pAlanakartyAcyA mArgAta dhairya-saMyama rAkhA.
tara jevhA sUra (zaMkha) phuMkalA jAIla.
tara to divasa atizaya kaThINa divasa asela.
(jo) kAphirAMkaritA sahaja - sopA nasela.
malA ANi tyAlA soDUna dyA, jyAlA mI ekaTA nirmANa kele.
ANi tyAlA khUpa dhana deUna Thevale Ahe.
ANi hajara rAhaNAre putra dekhIla.
ANi mI tyAlA puSkaLazI vyApakatA (saMpannatA) deUna ThevalI Ahe.
tarIhI to icchA bALagato kI mI tyAlA ANakhI jAsta dyAve.
kadApi nAhI, to AmacyA AyatIMcA virodhaka Ahe.
lavakaraca mI tyAlA kaThINa caDha caDhavina.
tyAne vicAra karUna eka goSTa yojilI.
tyAcA nAza hovo! tyAne kazI goSTa yojilI.
to punhA naSTa hovo! tyAne kazI goSTa yojilI!
maga tyAne pAhile.
maga toMDAvara (kapALAvara) AThyA ghAtalyA ANi toMDa vAkaDe kele.
maga mAge sarakalA ANi garva kelA.
ANi mhaNAlA, hI tara phakta jAdU Ahe, jI sAdhya kelI jAte.
(he) mAnavI kathanAkherIja ANakhI kAhI nAhI.
mI lavakaraca tyAlA jahannamamadhye TAkIna.
ANi tumhAlA kAya mAhIta kI jahannama kAya Ahe?
tI nA bAkI Thevate ANi nA soDate.
tvacelA horapaLUna TAkate.
ANi ticyAvara ekoNIsa (pharizte tainAta) Aheta.

ANi AmhI jahannamace rakSaka kevaLa pharizte Thevale Aheta ANi AmhI tyAMcI saMkhyA kevaLa kAphirAMcyA kasoTIkaritA nirdhArita kelI Ahe. yAsAThI kI graMthadhArakAMnI vizvAsa karAvA ANi ImAna rAkhaNAr2yAMcyA ImAnAta vRddhI vhAvI ANi graMthadhAraka va muslimAMnI saMzaya karU naye, ANi jyAMcyA manAta roga Ahe tyAMnI va kAphirAMnI mhaNAve kI yA azA udAharaNAne allAhalA kAya abhipreta Ahe? azA prakAre allAha, jyAlA icchito mArgabhraSTa karato ANi jyAlA icchito sanmArga dAkhavito. ANi tumacyA pAlanakartyAcyA laSkarAMnA tyAcyAkherIja koNIhI jANata nAhI. hA samasta mAnavAMkaritA (paripUrNa) bodha (ANi bhalAI) Ahe.
kadApi nAhI. caMdrAcI zapatha
ANi rAtrIcI jevhA tI pAlaTate.
ANi prAtaHkALacI, jevhA to prakAzamAna vhAvA.
kI (niHsaMzaya tI jahannama) moThyA goSTIMpaikI eka Ahe.
mANasAlA bhayabhIta karaNArI
tyA mANasAMkaritA, je tumacyApaikI puDhe jAU icchitIla kiMvA mAge haTU icchitIla.
pratyeka manuSya ApalyA karmAMcyA aivajI gahANa Ahe.
paraMtu ujavyA hAtAce
(kI) te jannatIMmadhye (basUna) vicArata asatIla
aparAdhI lokAMnA
tumhAlA jahannamamadhye koNatyA goSTIne TAkale?
te uttara detIla kI AmhI namAja paDhaNAre navhato.
bhukelyAMnA jevu ghAlata navhato.
ANi AmhI nirarthaka goSTa (inkAra) karaNAr2yAMsobata nirarthaka goSTIta vyasta rAhAta hoto.
ANi AmhI mobadalyAcyA divasAlA khoTe Tharavita hoto.
yetheparyaMta kI AmacA mRtyu AlA.
tevhA tyAMnA ziphArasa karaNAr2yAMcI ziphArasa upayogI paDaNAra nAhI.
tyAMnA jhAle tarI kAya kI te upadezApAsUna toMDa phiravita Aheta.
jaNU kAhI bicakalelI gADhave hota.
je siMhApAsUna paLata asAve.
kiMbahunA tyAMcyApaikI pratyeka manuSya icchito kI tyAlA spaSTa graMtha dile jAveta.
ase kadApi (hoU zakata) nAhI, kiMbahunA he kayAmatabAbata nirbhaya Aheta.
kadApi nAhI! hA (kuraAna) eka upadeza Ahe.
AtA jo icchila, tyApAsUna bodha grahaNa karIla.
ANi he tyAca veLI bodha grahaNa karatIla, jevhA allAha icchila. to yA goSTIsa pAtra Ahe kI tyAce bhaya rAkhAve ANi yAsahI pAtra kI tyAne mApha karAve.
mI zapatha gheto kayAmatacyA divasAcI
ANi mI zapatha gheto, dhiHkkAra karaNAr2yA manA (AtmyA) cI.
kAya manuSya asA vicAra karato kI AmhI tyAcI hADe ekatra karaNAraca nAhIta?
hoya avazya karU, AmhAlA sAmarthya Ahe kI tyAcyA boTAMce eka eka pera ThIka karAve.
paraMtu manuSya tara icchito kI puDhe avajJA ANi avahelanA karIta rAhAve.
vicArato kI kayAmatacA divasa kevhA yeIla.
tara jevhA DoLe jaDavata hotIla.
ANi caMdra nisteja hoIla.
ANi sUrya va caMdra ekatra kele jAtIla.
tyA divazI manuSya mhaNela kI Aja paLUna jANyAsa jAgA koThe Ahe?
nAhI nAhI, Azraya gheNyAce koNatehI ThikANa nAhI.
Aja tara tujhyA pAlanakartyAkaDeca (AzrayAce) ThikANa Ahe.
Aja mANasAlA, tyAne je kAhI puDhe pAThavile ANi je kAhI mAge soDale, tyAviSayI avagata karUna dile jAIla.
kiMbahunA manuSya svataHca svataHvara pramANa Ahe.
maga to kitIhI sababI sAdara karIta asalA tarI.
(he paigaMbara!) tumhI kuraAnAsa tvarita toMDI pATha karaNyAsAThI ApalyA jIbhelA (ghAIne) halavU nakA.
tyAsa ekatra karaNe ANi (tumacyA toMDUna) paThaNa karaviNe AmacI jabAbadArI Ahe.
(yAstava) AmhI jevhA tyAce paThaNa saMpavU tevhA tumhI tyAcyA paThaNAce anusaraNa karA.
tyAsa spaSTa karaNe Amace kAma Ahe.
navhe, tumhI tara lavakara prApta hoNAr2yA (jagA) zI prema rAkhatA.
ANi AkhiratalA soDUna basalA AhAta.
tyA divazI aneka cehare tAje TavaTavIta (va tejasvI) asatIla.
ApalyA pAlanakartyAkaDe pAhata asatIla
ANi kityeka cehare tyA divazI (kurupa ANi) udAsa asatIla
samajata asatIla kI tyAMcyAzI kaMbara toDaNArA vyavahAra kelA jAIla.
nAhI nAhI jevhA (prANa) kaMThAzI pohacatIla
ANi sAMgitale jAIla kI koNI jhADa phuMka (taMtra maMtra) karaNArA Ahe?
ANi tyAne khAtrI kelI kI hI viyogAcI veLa Ahe.
ANi poTarIzI poTarI bilagela.
Aja tujhyA pAlanakartyAkaDe jAyace Ahe.
tevhA tyAne nA tara samarthana kele, nA namAja adA kelI.
ulaTa khoTe Tharavile ANi vimukha jhAlA
maga ApalyA kuTuMbiyAMkaDe tor2yAta gelA
kheda Ahe tujhyAbaddala! pazcAttApa Ahe tujhyAvara!
punhA duHkha Ahe ANi durdazA Ahe tujhyAsAThI!
kAya manuSya ase samajato kI tyAlA vyartha ase soDUna dile jAIla
kAya to eka gADha pANyAcA theMba navhatA, jo TapakavilA jAto?
maga to raktAcA goLA banalA, maga (allAhane) tyAlA nirmANa kele ANi yogyarityA banavile.
maga tyApAsUna joDI arthAta nara-mAdA banavile
kAya (allAha) yA goSTI samartha nAhI kI melelyAsa jivaMta karAvaM?
nizcitaca mANasAvara kALAcA eka samaya asAhI AlA Ahe, jevhA to kAhIca ullekha karaNyAyogya navhatA.
niHsaMzaya, AmhI mAnavAlA mizra vIryAdvAre kasoTIkaritA nirmANa kele, ANi tyAlA aikaNArA pAhaNArA banavile.
AmhI tyAlA mArga dAkhavilA maga to kRtajJa bano kiMvA kRtaghna.
niHsaMzaya, AmhI kAphira (inkArI) lokAMkaritA zRMkhalA ANi jokhaMDa va dhagadhagaNArI Aga tayAra karUna ThevalI Ahe.
niHsaMzaya, neka (sadAcArI) loka tyA pyAlyAne pitIla, jyAta kApUrAce mizraNa Ahe.
jo eka jharA Ahe, jyAtUna allAhace dAsa pitIla, tyAce pravAha (pATa) kADhatIla (jikaDe icchitIla)
je navasa pUrNa karatAta ANi tyA divasAce bhaya bALagatAta, jyAce saMkaTa cArI bAjUMnA pasaraNAra Ahe.
ANi allAhacyA premAkhAtara garIba, anAtha ANi kaidyAMnA jevU ghAlatAta.
AmhI tara tumhAlA kevaLa allAhacyA prasannatesAThI jevU ghAlato, tumacyAkaDUna nA mobadalA icchito, nA AbhAra.
niHsaMzaya, AmhI ApalyA pAlanakartyAtarphe tyA divasAce bhaya rAkhato jo moThA duHsthitIcA ANi kaThoratApUrNa asela.
tevhA allAhane tyAMnA tyA divasAcyA saMkaTApAsUna vAcavile. ANi tyAMnA tajelatA va AnaMda pradAna kelA.
ANi tyAMnA tyAMcyA dhIra - saMyamAcyA mobadalyAta jannata ANi rezamI vastra pradAna kele.
te tithe AsanAMvara takke lAvUna basatIla, tyAMnA tithe nA sUryAcI prakhara uSNatA jANavela, nA sakta thaMDIcI tIvratA.
ANi tyAMcyA (jannatacyA) sAvalyA tyAMcyAvara jhukalelyA asatIla ANi tyAMce (meve) ANi gucche khAlI loMbakaLata asatIla.
ANi tyAMcyA daramyAna cAMdIcI bhAMDI ANi kAcece pyAle ye - jA karatIla.
kAcahI cAMdIcI asela, jyAMnA (piNAr2yAMnI) anumAnAne mApUna Thevale asela.
ANi tyAMnA tithe azI peye pAjalI jAtIla, jyAta suMThIce mizraNa asela.
jannatacyA ekA pravAhAtUna jyAce nAva salasabIla Ahe.
ANi tyAMcyA cohIkaDe tI alpavayIna bAlake hiMData-phirata asatIla. je nehamI (bAlaka) rAhaNAre Aheta. jevhA tumhI tyAMnA pAhAla tara kalpanA karAla kI te (jaNU) vikhuralele (assala) motI Aheta.
ANi tumhI tithe, jikaDe pAhAla tikaDe pUrNa IzadeNagyA ANi mahAna rAjyasattA disUna yeIla.
tyAMcyA (zarIrA) vara hirave maulyavAna ANi jADa rezamI vastre asatIla. ANi tyAMnA cAMdIcyA kAMkaNAcA dAginA ghAtalA jAIla ANi tyAMnA tyAMcA pAlanakartA svaccha zuddha (pAka) madya pAjela.
(pharmAvile jAIla) hA Ahe tumacyA karmAMcA mobadalA ANi tumacyA prayatnAMcI prazaMsA kelI gelI.

vAstavika tyAMnA yAkherIja koNatAhI Adeza dilA gelA nAhI kI tyAMnI phakta allAhacIca upAsanA karAvI, tyAcyAcakaritA dIna (dharmA) lA vizuddha rAkhAve. (ibrAhIma) hanIphacyA dIna (dharmA) vara ANi namAjalA kAyama rAkhAve ANi jakAta (kartavya-dAna) deta rAhAve. hAca saraLa dIna (dharma) Ahe muslima saMpradAyAcA.
niHsaMzaya, je loka graMthadhArakAMpaikI inkArI jhAle. ANi anekezvaravAdI, sarvacyA sarva jahannamacyA AgIta (jAtIla), jyAta te nehamI (nehamI) rAhatIla. heca loka sarvAMta vAITa nirmitI hoya.
niHsaMzaya, jyA lokAMnI ImAna rAkhale ANi satkarma kele, tara ase loka (allAhacI) sarvAMta uttama nirmitI hoya.
